G1.full: Of Hebrew origin; the first letter of the alphabet: figuratively only (from its use as a numeral) the first. Often used (usually "an", before a vowel) also in composition (as a contraction from G427) in the sense of privation; so in many words beginning with this letter; occasionally in the sense of union (as a contraction of G260): - Alpha.

G2.full: Of Hebrew origin [H175]; Aaron, the brother of Moses: - Aaron.

G3.full: Of Hebrew origin [H11]; a destroying angel: - Abaddon.

G4.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G922; weightless, that is (figuratively) not burdensome: - from being burdensome.

G5.full: Of Chaldee origin [H2]; father (as a vocative): - Abba.

G6.full: Of Hebrew origin [H1893]; Abel, the son of Adam: - Abel.

G7.full: Of Hebrew origin [H29]; Abijah, the name of two Israelites: - Abia.

G8.full: Of Hebrew origin [H54]; Abiathar, an Israelite: - Abiathar.

G9.full: Of foreign origin (compare [H58]); Abilene, a region of Syria: - Abilene.

G10.full: Of Hebrew origin [H31]; Abihud, an Israelite: - Abiud.

G11.full: Of Hebrew origin [H85]; Abraham, the Hebrew patriarch. In Act_7:16 the text should probably read Jacob: - Abraham.

G12.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a variation of G1037; depthless, that is, (specifically), (infernal) "abyss": - deep, (bottomless) pit.

G13.full: Of Hebrew origin (compare [H2285]); Agabus, an Israelite: - Agabus.

G14.full: From G18 and G2041; to work good: - do good.

G15.full: From G17; to be a well-doer (as a favor or a duty): - (when) do good (well).

G16.full: From G17; well-doing, that is, virtue: - well-doing.

G17.full: From G18 and G4160; a well-doer, that is, virtuous: - them that do well.

G18.full: A primary word; "good" (in any sense, often as noun): - benefit, good (-s, things), well. Compare G2570.

G19.full: From G18; goodness, that is, virtue or beneficence: - goodness.

G20.full: From G21; exultation; specifically welcome: - gladness, (exceeding) joy.

G21.firstSense: be (exceeding) glad, with exceeding joy, rejoice (greatly)
G21.full: From á̓́ãáí agan (much) and G242; properly to jump for joy, that is, exult: - be (exceeding) glad, with exceeding joy, rejoice (greatly).

G22.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G1062; unmarried: - unmarried.

G23.firstSense: be much (sore) displeased, have (be moved with, with) indignation
G23.full: From á̓́ãáí agan (much) and á̓́÷èïò achhos̄ (grief; akin to the base of G43); to be greatly afflicted, that is, (figuratively) indignant: - be much (sore) displeased, have (be moved with, with) indignation.

G25.full: Perhaps from á̓́ãáí agan (much; or compare [H5689]); to love (in a social or moral sense): - (be-) love (-ed). Compare G5368.

G26.full: From G25; love, that is, affection or benevolence; specifically (plural) a love feast: - (feast of) charity ([-ably]), dear, love.

G27.full: From G25; beloved: - (dearly, well) beloved, dear.

G28.full: Of Hebrew origin [H1904]; Hagar, the concubine of Abraham: - Hagar.

G29.full: Of foreign origin (compare [H104]); properly to be a courier, that is, (by implication) to press into public service: - compel (to go).

G30.full: From á̓́ãêá́ëç aggos (a pail, perhaps as bent; compare the base of G43); a receptacle: - vessel.

G31.full: From G32; an announcement, that is, (by implication) precept: - message.

G32.full: From á̓ããǻëëù aggellō (probably derived from G71; compare G34; to bring tidings); a messenger; especially an "angel"; by implication a pastor: - angel, messenger.

G33.full: Imperative of G71; properly lead, that is, come on: - go to.

G34.full: From G71 (compare G32); a drove: - herd.

G35.full: From G1 (as negative particle) and G1075; unregistered as to birth: - without descent.

G36.full: From G1 (as negative particle) and G1085; properly without kin, that is, (of unknown descent, and by implication) ignoble: - base things.

G37.full: From G40; to make holy, that is, (ceremonially) purify or consecrate; (mentally) to venerate: - hallow, be holy, sanctify.

G38.full: From G37; properly purification, that is, (the state) purity; concretely (by Hebraism) a purifier: - holiness, sanctification.

G39.full: Neuter of G40; a sacred thing (that is, spot): - holiest (of all), holy place, sanctuary.

G40.full: From á̔́ãïò hagos (an awful thing) compare G53, [H2282]; sacred (physically pure, morally blameless or religious, ceremonially consecrated): - (most) holy (one, thing), saint.

G41.full: From G40; sanctity (that is, properly the state): - holiness.

G42.full: From G40; sacredness (that is, properly the quality): - holiness.

G43.full: From á̓́ãêïò agkos (a bend, "ache"); an arm (as curved): - arm.

G44.full: From the same as G43; a hook (as bent): - hook.

G45.full: From the same as G43; an "anchor" (as crooked): - anchor.

G46.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and the same as G1102; properly unfulled, that is, (by implication) new (cloth): - new.

G47.full: From G53; cleanliness (the quality), that is, (specifically) chastity: - purity.

G48.full: From G53; to make clean, that is, (figuratively) sanctify (ceremonially or morally): - purity (self).

G49.full: From G48; a cleansing (the act), that is, (ceremonially) lustration: - purification.

G50.firstSense: (be) ignorant (-ly), not know, not understand, unknown
G50.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G3539; not to know (through lack of information or intelligence); by implication to ignore (through disinclination): - (be) ignorant (-ly), not know, not understand, unknown.

G51.full: From G50; a thing ignored, that is, shortcoming: - error.

G52.full: From G50; ignorance (properly the quality): - ignorance.

G53.full: From the same as G40; properly clean, that is, (figuratively) innocent, modest, perfect: - chaste, clean, pure.

G54.full: From G53; cleanness (the state), that is, (figuratively) blamelessness: - pureness.

G55.full: Adverb from G53; purely, that is, honestly: - sincerely.

G56.full: From G1 (as negative particle) and G1108; ignorance (properly the state): - ignorance, not the knowledge.

G57.full: From G1 (as negative particle) and G1110; unknown: - unknown.

G58.full: From á̓ãåé́ñù "ageiro" (to gather; probably akin to G1453); properly the town square (as a place of public resort); by implication a market or thoroughfare: - market (-place), street.

G59.full: From G58; properly to go to market, that is, (by implication) to purchase; specifically to redeem: - buy, redeem.

G60.full: From G58; relating to the market place, that is, forensic (times); by implication vulgar: - baser sort, low.

G61.full: From G71; (abstractly) a catching (of fish); also (concretely) a haul (of fish): - draught.

G62.full: agrammatos ag-ram-mat-os From G1 (as negative particle) and G1121; unlettered, that is, illiterate: - unlearned.

G63.full: From G68 and G832 (in the sense of G833); to camp out: - abide in the field.

G64.full: From G61; to hunt, that is, (figuratively) to entrap: - catch.

G65.full: From G66 and G1636; an oleaster: - olive tree (which is) wild.

G66.full: From G68; wild (as pertaining to the country), literally (natural) or figuratively (fierce): - wild, raging.

G67.full: Apparently from G66 and G2462; wild-horse tamer; Agrippas, one of the Herods: - Agrippa.

G68.firstSense: country, farm, piece of ground, land
G68.full: From G71; a field (as a drive for cattle); generally the country; specifically a farm, that is, hamlet: - country, farm, piece of ground, land.

G69.full: Ultimately from G1 (as negative particle) and G5258; to be sleepless, that is, keep awake: - watch.

G70.full: From G69; sleeplessness, that is, a keeping awake: - watch.

G71.firstSense: be, bring (forth), carry, (let) go, keep, lead away, be open
G71.full: A primary verb; properly to lead; by implication to bring, drive, (reflexively) go, (specifically) pass (time), or (figuratively) induce: - be, bring (forth), carry, (let) go, keep, lead away, be open.

G72.full: Reduplicated from G71; a bringing up, that is, mode of living: - manner of life.

G73.full: From G71; properly a place of assembly (as if led), that is, (by implication) a contest (held there); figuratively an effort or anxiety: - conflict, contention, fight, race.

G74.full: From G73; a struggle (properly the state), that is, (figuratively) anguish: - agony.

G75.full: From G73; to struggle, literally (to compete for a prize), figuratively (to contend with an adversary), or generally (to endeavor to accomplish something): - fight, labor fervently, strive.

G76.full: Of Hebrew origin [H121]; Adam, the first man; typically (of Jesus) man (as his representative): - Adam.

G77.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G1160; costless, that is, gratuitous: - without expense.

G78.full: Probably of Hebrew origin (compare [H5716]); Addi, an Israelite: - Addi.

G79.full: Feminine of G80; a sister (natural or ecclesiastical): - sister.

G80.full: From G1 (as a connective particle) and äåëöṍò delphus (the womb); a brother (literally or figuratively) near or remote (much like [H1]): - brother.

G81.full: From G80; brotherhood (properly the feeling of brotherliness), that is, (the (Christian) fraternity: - brethren, brotherhood.

G82.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G1212; hidden, figuratively indistinct: - appear not, uncertain.

G85.firstSense: be full of heaviness, be very heavy
G85.full: From a derivative of á̓äǻù adeō (to be sated to loathing); to be in distress (of mind): - be full of heaviness, be very heavy.

G86.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G1492; properly unseen, that is, "Hades" or the place (state) of departed souls: - grave, hell.

G87.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G1252; properly undistinguished, that is, (actively) impartial: - without partiality.

G88.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a compound of G1223 and G3007; unintermitted, that is, permanent: - without ceasing, continual.

G89.full: Adverb from G88; uninterruptedly, that is, without omission (on an appropriate occasion): - without ceasing.

G90.full: From a derivative of a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G1311; incorruptibleness, that is, (figuratively) purity (of doctrine): - uncorruptness.

G91.firstSense: hurt, injure, be an offender, be unjust, (do, suffer, take) wrong
G91.full: From G94; to be unjust, that is, (actively) do wrong (morally, socially or physically): - hurt, injure, be an offender, be unjust, (do, suffer, take) wrong.

G92.firstSense: evil doing, iniquity, matter of wrong
G92.full: From G91; a wrong done: - evil doing, iniquity, matter of wrong.

G93.full: From G94; (legal) injustice (properly the quality, by implication the act); moral wrongfulness (of charater, life or act): - iniquity, unjust, unrighteousness, wrong.

G94.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G1349; unjust; by extension wicked; by implication treacherous; specifically heathen: - unjust, unrighteous.

G96.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G1384; unapproved, that is, rejected; by implication worthless (literally or morally): - castaway, rejected, reprobate.

G97.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G1388; undeceitful, that is, (figuratively) unadulterated: - sincere.

G98.full: From Á̓äñáìṍôôåéïí Adramutteion (a place in Asia Minor); Adramyttene or belonging to Adramyttium: - of Adramyttium.

G99.full: From Á̓äñé́á Adria (a place near its shore); the Adriatic sea (including the Ionian): - Adria.

G100.full: From á̔äñḯò hadros (stout); plumpness, that is, (figuratively) liberality: - abundance.

G101.full: From G102; to be unable, that is, (passively) impossible: - be impossible.

G102.firstSense: could not do, impossible, impotent, not possible, weak
G102.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G1415; unable, that is, weak (literally or figuratively); passively impossible: - could not do, impossible, impotent, not possible, weak.

G103.full: A primary verb; to sing: - sing.

G104.full: From an obsolete primary noun (apparently meaning continued duration); "ever"; by qualification regularly; by implication earnestly: - always, ever.

G105.full: From the same as G109; an eagle (from its wind like flight): - eagle.

G106.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G2219; unleavened, that is, (figuratively) uncorrupted; (in the neuter plural) specifically (by implication) the Passover week: - unleavened (bread).

G107.full: Of Hebrew origin (compare [H5809]); Azor, an Israelite: - Azor.

G108.full: Of Hebrew origin [H795]; Azotus (that is, Ashdod), a place in Palestine: - Azotus.

G109.full: From á̓́çìé aēmi (to breathe unconsciously, that is, respire; by analogy to blow); "air" (as naturally circumambient): - air. Compare G5594.

G110.full: From a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and G2288; deathlessness: - immortality.

G111.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of èǻìéò themis (statute; from the base of G5087); illegal; by implication flagitious: - abominable, unlawful thing.

G112.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G2316; godless: - without God.

G113.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G5087 (in the sense of enacting); lawless, that is, (by implication) criminal: - wicked.

G114.firstSense: cast off, despise, disannul, frustrate, bring to nought, reject
G114.full: From a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G5087; to set aside, that is, (by implication) to disesteem, neutralize or violate: - cast off, despise, disannul, frustrate, bring to nought, reject.

G115.full: From G114; cancellation (literally or figuratively): - disannulling, put away.

G116.full: Plural of Á̓èḉíç Athēnē (the goddess of wisdom, who was reputed to have founded the city); Athenae, the captital of Greece: - Athens.

G117.full: From G116; an Athenaean or inhabitant of Athenae: - Athenian.

G118.full: From á̓́èëïò athlos (a contest in the public lists); to contend in the competitive games: - strive.

G120.full: From a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and G2372; to be spiritless, that is, disheartened: - be dismayed.

G121.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a probable derivative of G5087 (meaning a penalty); not guilty: - innocent.

G122.full: Form áé̓́î aix (a goat); belonging to a goat: - goat.

G123.full: From á̓é̈́́óóù aissō (to rush) and G251 (in the sense of the sea); a beach (on which the waves dash): - shore.

G124.full: From G125; an Egyptian or inhabitant of AEgyptus: - Egyptian.

G125.full: Of uncertain derivation; AEgyptus, the land of the Nile: - Egypt.

G126.full: From G104; everduring (forward and backward, or foward only): - eternal, everlasting.

G127.full: Perhaps from G1 (as a negative particle) and G1492 (through the idea of downcast eyes); bashfulness, that is, (towards men), modesty or (towards God) awe: - reverence, shamefacedness.

G128.full: From áé̓́èù aithō (to scorch) and ù̓́ø ōps (the face, from G3700); an Ethiopian (as a blackamoor): - Ethiopian.

G129.full: Of uncertain derivation; blood, literally (of men or animals), figuratively (the juice of grapes) or specifically (the atoning blood of Christ); by implication bloodshed, also kindred: - blood.

G130.full: From G129 and a derivative of G1632; an effusion of blood: - shedding of blood.

G131.firstSense: diseased with an issue of blood
G131.full: From G129 and G4482; to flow blood, that is, have a haemorrhage: - diseased with an issue of blood.

G132.full: Of uncertain derivation; AEneas, an Israelite: - AEneas.

G133.full: From G134; a praising (the act), that is, (specifically) a thank (offering): - praise.

G135.full: From a derivative of G136 (in its primary sense); an obscure saying ("enigma"), that is, (abstractly) obscureness: - X darkly.

G136.full: Apparently a primary word; properly a story, but used in the sense of G1868; praise (of God): - praise.

G137.full: Of Hebrew origin (a derivative of [H5869], place of springs); AEnon, a place in Palestine: - AEnon.

G138.full: Probably akin to G142; to take for oneself, that is, to prefer. Some of the forms are borrowed from a cognate (å̔́ëëïìáé hellomai), which is otherwise obsolete: - choose. Some of the forms are borrowed from a cognate hellomai, hel-lom-ahee; which is otherwise obsolete.

G139.firstSense: heresy [which is the Greekord itself], sect
G139.full: From G138; properly a choice, that is, (specifically) a party or (abstractly) disunion. ("heresy" is the Greek word itself.): - heresy [which is the Greekord itself], sect.

G140.full: From a derivative of G138; to make a choice: - choose.

G141.full: From the same as G140; a schismatic. ("heretic" is the Greek word itself.): - heretic [the Greekord itself].

G142.firstSense: away with, bear (up), carry, lift up, loose, make to doubt, put away, remove, take (awa…
G142.full: A primary verb; to lift; by implication to take up or away; figuratively to raise (the voice), keep in suspense (the mind); specifically to sail away (that is, weigh anchor); by Hebraism (compare [H5375]) to expiate sin: - away with, bear (up), carry, lift up, loose, make to doubt, put away, remove, take (away, up).

G143.full: Of uncertain derivation; to apprehend (properly by the senses): - perceive.

G144.full: From G143; perception, that is, (figuratively) discernment: - judgment.

G145.full: From a derivative of G143; properly an organ of perception, that is, (figuratively) judgment: - senses.

G146.full: From G150 and êǻñäïò kerdos (gain); sordid: - given to (greedy of) filthy lucre.

G147.full: Adverb from G146; sordidly: - for filthy lucre's sake.

G148.full: From G150 and G3056; vile conversation: - filthy communication.

G149.full: Neuter of G150; a shameful thing, that is, indecorum: - shame.

G150.full: From the same as G153; shameful, that is, base (specifically venal): - filthy.

G151.full: From G150; shamefulness, that is, obscenity: - filthiness.

G152.full: From G153; shame or disgrace (abstractly or concretely): - dishonesty, shame.

G153.full: From áé̓͂ó÷ïò aischos (disfigurement, that is, disgrace); to feel shame (for oneself): - be ashamed.

G154.firstSense: ask, beg, call for, crave, desire, require
G154.full: Of uncertain derivation; to ask (in generally): - ask, beg, call for, crave, desire, require. Compare G4441.

G155.full: From G154; a thing asked or (abstractly) an asking: - petition, request, required.

G156.full: From the same as G154; a cause (as if asked for), that is, (logical) reason (motive, matter), (legal) crime (alleged or proved): - accusation, case, cause, crime, fault, [wh-]ere[-fore].

G157.full: From a derivative of G156; a thing charged: - complaint.

G158.full: Neuter of G159; a reason or crime (like G156): - cause, fault.

G159.full: From the same as G154; causative, that is, (concretely) a causer: - author.

G160.full: From a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and G5316 (compare G1810), (meaning non apparent); unexpected, that is, (adverbially) suddenly: - sudden, unawares.

G162.full: From G164; to capture (like G163): - lead captive.

G163.firstSense: lead away captive, bring into captivity
G163.full: From G164; to make captive: - lead away captive, bring into captivity.

G164.full: Fromáé̓÷ìḉ aichmē (a spear) and a derivative of the same as G259; properly a prisoner of war, that is, (generally) a captive: - captive.

G165.firstSense: age, course, eternal, (for) ever (-more), [n-]ever, (beginning of the, while the) world…
G165.full: From the same as G104; properly an age; by extension perpetuity (also past); by implication the world; specifically (Jewish) a Messianic period (present or future): - age, course, eternal, (for) ever (-more), [n-]ever, (beginning of the, while the) world (began, without end). Compare G5550.

G166.full: From G165; perpetual (also used of past time, or past and future as well): - eternal, for ever, everlasting, world (began).

G167.full: From G169; impurity (the quality), physically or morally: - uncleanness.

G168.full: From G169; impurity (the state), morally: - filthiness.

G169.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G2508 (meaning cleansed); impure (ceremonially, morally (lewd) or specifically (demonic)): - foul, unclean.

G170.full: From a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and G2540 (meaning unseasonable); to be inopportune (for oneself), that is, to fail of a proper occasion: - lack opportunity.

G171.full: Adverb from the same as G170; inopportunely: - out of season.

G172.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G2556; not bad, that is, (objectively) innocent or (subjectively) unsuspecting: - harmless, simple.

G173.full: Probably from the same as G188; a thorn: - thorn.

G175.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G2590; barren (literally or figuratively): - without fruit, unfruitful.

G176.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2607; unblamable: - that cannot be condemned.

G177.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a compound of G2596 and G2572; unveiled: - uncovered.

G178.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2632; without (legal) trial: - uncondemned.

G179.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2647; indissoluble, that is, (figuratively) permanent: - endless.

G180.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2664; unrefraining: - that cannot cease.

G181.full: From G182; instability, that is, disorder: - commotion, confusion, tumult.

G182.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2525; inconstant: - unstable.

G183.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2722; unrestrainable: - unruly.

G184.full: Of Chaldee origin (meaning field of blood; corresponding to [H2506] and [H1818]); Akeldama, a place near Jerusalem: - Aceldama.

G185.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G2767; unmixed, that is, (figuratively) innocent: - harmless, simple.

G186.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G2827; not leaning, (that is, (figuratively) firm: - without wavering.

G187.full: From the same as G188; to make a point, that is, (figuratively) mature: - be fully ripe.

G188.full: Accusative case of a noun ("acme") akin to á̓êḉ akē (a point) and meaning the same; adverbially just now, that is, still: - yet.

G189.firstSense: audience, ear, fame, which ye heard, hearing, preached, report, rumor
G189.full: From G191; hearing (the act, the sense or the thing heard): - audience, ear, fame, which ye heard, hearing, preached, report, rumor.

G190.full: From G1 (as a particle of union) and êǻëåõèïò keleuthos (a road); properly to be in the same way with, that is, to accompany (specifically as a disciple): - follow, reach.

G191.firstSense: give (in the) audience (of), come (to the ears), ([shall]) hear (-er, -ken), be noised,…
G191.full: A primary verb; to hear (in various senses): - give (in the) audience (of), come (to the ears), ([shall]) hear (-er, -ken), be noised, be reported, understand.

G192.full: From G193; want of self restraint: - excess, incontinency.

G193.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G2904; powerless, that is, without self control: - incontinent.

G194.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G2767; undiluted: - without mixture.

G195.full: From the same as G196; exactness: - perfect manner.

G196.full: Superlative of á̓êñéâçò akribēs (a derivative of the same as G206); most exact: - most straitest.

G197.full: Neuter of the comparative of the same as G196; (adverbially) more exactly: - more perfect (-ly).

G198.full: From the same as G196; to be exact, that is, ascertain: - enquire diligently.

G199.full: Adverb from the same as G196; exactly: - circumspectly, diligently, perfect (-ly).

G200.full: Apparently from the same as G206; a locust (as pointed, or as lighting on the top of vegetation): - locust.

G201.full: From G202; an audience room: - place of hearing.

G202.full: From á̓êñïá́ïìáé akroaomai (to listen; apparently an intensive of G191); a hearer (merely): - hearer.

G203.full: From G206 and probably a modified form of ðḯóèç posthē (the penis or male sexual organ); the prepuce; by implication an uncircumcised (that is, gentile, figuratively unregenerate) state or person: - not circumcised, uncircumcised [with G2192], uncircumcision.

G204.full: From G206 and G1137; belonging to the extreme corner: - chief corner.

G205.full: From G206 and èé́ò this (a heap); properly (in the plural) the top of the heap, that is, (by implication) best of the booty: - spoils.

G206.full: Neuter of an adjective probably akin to the base of G188; the extremity: - one end . . . other, tip, top, uttermost part.

G207.full: Probably for the Latin Aquila (an eagle); Akulas, an Israelite: - Aquila.

G208.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G2964; to invalidate: - disannul, make of none effect.

G209.full: Adverb from a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2967; in an unhindered manner, that is, freely: - no man forbidding him.

G210.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G1635; unwilling: - against the will.

G215.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2980; unspeakable: - unutterable, which cannot be uttered.

G216.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G2980; mute: - dumb.

G227.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G2990; true (as not concealing): - true, truly, truth.

G230.firstSense: indeed, surely, of a surety, truly, of a (in) truth, verily, very
G230.full: Adverb from G227; truly: - indeed, surely, of a surety, truly, of a (in) truth, verily, very.

G231.full: From G251; a sailor (as engaged on the salt water), that is, (by implication) a fisher: - fisher (-man).

G232.full: From G231; to be a fisher, that is, (by implication) to fish: - go a-fishing.

G234.full: From á̓ëéóãǻù alisgeō (to soil); (ceremonial) defilement: - pollution.

G235.firstSense: and, but (even), howbeit, indeed, nay, nevertheless, no, notwithstanding, save, therefo…
G235.full: Neuter plural of G243; properly other things, that is, (adverbially) contrariwise (in many relations): - and, but (even), howbeit, indeed, nay, nevertheless, no, notwithstanding, save, therefore, yea, yet.

G236.full: From G243; to make different: - change.

G237.full: From G243; from elsewhere: - some other way.

G238.full: From G243 andá̓ãïñǻù agoreō (to harangue (compare G58); to allegorize. (The Greek word itself.): - be an allegory [the Greek word itself].

G239.full: Of hebrew origin (imperative of [H1984] and [H3050]); praise ye Jah!, an adoring exclamation: - alleluiah.

G240.firstSense: each other, mutual, one another, (the other), (them-, your-) selves, (selves) together…
G240.full: Genitive plural from G243 reduplicated; one another. (Sometimes with G3326 or G4314.): - each other, mutual, one another, (the other), (them-, your-) selves, (selves) together [sometimes with G3326 or G4314].

G241.full: From G243 and G1085; foreign, that is, not a Jew: - stranger.

G242.full: Middle voice of apparently a primary verb; to jump; figuratively to gush: - leap, spring up.

G244.full: From G245 and G1985; overseeing others' affairs, that is, a meddler (specifically in Gentile customs): - busybody in other men's matters.

G245.full: From G243; another's, that is, not one's own; by extension foreign, not akin, hostile: - alien, (an-) other (man's, men's), strange (-r).

G246.full: From G243 and G5443; foreign, that is, (specifically) Gentile: - one of another nation.

G248.full: From the same as G257; to tread out grain: - thresh, tread out the corn.

G249.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G3056; irrational: - brute, unreasonable.

G250.full: Of foreign origin (compare [H174]); aloes (the gum): - aloes.

G251.full: hals halce A primary word; "salt": - salt.

G253.full: Comparative of a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and G3077; more without grief: - less sorrowful.

G254.full: Of uncertain derivation; a fetter or manacle: - bonds, chain.

G255.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and the base of G3081; gainless, that is, (by implication) pernicious: - unprofitable.

G256.full: Of Hebrew origin (compare [H2501]); Alpheus, an Israelite: - Alpheus.

G257.full: Probably form the base of G1507; a threshing floor (as rolled hard), that is, (figuratively) the grain (and chaff, as just threshed): - floor.

G258.full: Of uncertain derivation; a fox, that is, (figuratively) a cunning person: - fox

G259.full: From a collateral form of G138; capture: - be taken.

G260.full: A primary particle; properly at the "same" time, but freely used as a preposition or adverb denoting close association: - also, and, together, with (-al).

G261.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G3129; ignorant: - unlearned.

G262.full: From G263; "amaranthine", that is, (by implication) fadeless: - that fadeth not away.

G263.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G3133; unfading, that is, (by implication) perpetual: - that fadeth not away.

G264.firstSense: for your faults, offend, sin, trespass
G264.full: Perhaps from G1 (as a negative particle) and the base of G3313; properly to miss the mark (and so not share in the prize), that is, (figuratively) to err, especially (morally) to sin: - for your faults, offend, sin, trespass.

G265.full: From G264; a sin (properly concrete): - sin.

G266.full: From G264; sin (properly abstract): - offence, sin (-ful).

G267.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a form of G3144; unattested: - without witness.

G268.full: From G264; sinful, that is, a sinner: - sinful, sinner.

G269.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G3163; peaceable: - not a brawler.

G270.full: From G260; properly to collect, that is, (by implication) reap: - reap down.

G271.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3184; the amethyst (supposed to prevent intoxication): - amethyst.

G272.firstSense: make light of, neglect, be negligent, not regard
G272.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G3199; to be careless of: - make light of, neglect, be negligent, not regard.

G273.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3201; irreproachable: - blameless, faultless, unblamable.

G274.full: Adverb from G273; faultlessly: - blameless, unblamably.

G275.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G3308; not anxious: - without care (-fulness), secure.

G276.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3346; unchangeable, or (neuter as abstract) unchangeability: - immutable (-ility).

G277.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3334; immovable: - unmovable.

G278.firstSense: without repentance, not to be repented of
G278.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G3338; irrevocable: - without repentance, not to be repented of.

G279.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G3340; unrepentant: - impenitent.

G280.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G3358; immoderate: - (thing) without measure.

G281.full: Of Hebrew origin [H543]; properly firm, that is, (figuratively) trustworthy; adverbially surely (often as interjection so be it): - amen, verily.

G282.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G3384; motherless, that is, of unknown maternity: - without mother.

G283.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3392; unsoiled, that is, (figuratively) pure: - undefiled.

G284.full: Of Hebrew origin [H5992]; Aminadab, an Israelite: - Aminadab.

G285.full: Perhaps from G260; sand (as heaped on the beach): - sand.

G286.full: Apparently a primary word; a lamb: - lamb.

G287.full: From á̓ìåé́âù ameibō (to exchange); requital: - requite.

G288.full: Probably from the base of G297 and that of G257; a vine (as coiling about a support): - vine.

G289.full: From G288 and G2041; a vine worker, that is, pruner: - vine-dresser.

G291.full: Contracted for the Latin ampliatus (enlarged); Amplias, a Roman Christian: - Amplias.

G292.full: Middle voice of a primary verb; to ward off (for oneself), that is, protect: - defend.

G293.full: From a compound of the base of G297 and G906; a (fishing) net (as thrown about the fish): - net.

G294.full: From the base of G297 and å̔́ííõìé hennumi (to invest); to enrobe: - clothe.

G295.full: From the base of G297 and G4172; a city surrounded by a river; Amphipolis, a place in Macedonia: - Amphipolis.

G296.full: From the base of G297 and G3598; a fork in the road: - where two ways meet.

G297.full: Comparative of á̓ìöé́ amphi (around); (in plural) both: - both.

G298.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3469; unblameable: - blameless.

G299.firstSense: without blame (blemish, fault, spot), faultless, unblameable
G299.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G3470; unblemished (literally or figuratively): - without blame (blemish, fault, spot), faultless, unblameable.

G300.full: Of hebrew origin [H526]; Amon, an Israelite: - Amon.

G301.full: Of Hebrew origin [H531]; Amos, an Israelite: - Amos.

G302.full: an an A primary particle, denoting a supposition, wish, possibility or uncertainty: - [what-, where-, whither-, who-]soever. Usually unexpressed except by the subjunctive or potential mood. Also contraction for G1437.

G303.firstSense: and, apiece, by, each, every (man), in, through

G304.full: From G305 (compare G898); a stairway: - stairs.

G305.firstSense: arise, ascend (up), climb (go, grow, rise, spring) up, come (up)

G306.full: Middle voice from G303 and G906; to put off (for oneself): - defer.

G307.full: From G303 and a derivative of the base of G939; to cause to go up, that is, haul (a net): - draw.

G308.full: From G303 and G991; to look up; by implication to recover sight: - look (up), see, receive sight.

G309.full: From G308; restoration of sight: - recovering of sight.

G310.full: From G303 and G994; to halloo: - cry (aloud, out).

G311.full: From G306; a putting off: - delay.

G312.firstSense: declare, rehearse, report, show, speak, tell

G314.full: From G303 and G1097; to know again, that is, (by extension) to read: - read.

G315.full: From G318; to necessitate: - compel, constrain.

G316.full: From G318; necessary; by implication close (of kin): - near, necessary, necessity, needful.

G317.full: Adverb from a derivative of G315; compulsorily: - by constraint.

G318.firstSense: distress, must needs, (of) necessity (-sary), neededth, needful

G319.full: Middle voice from G303 and G1107; to make (oneself) known: - be made known.

G320.full: From G314; (the act of) reading: - reading.

G321.firstSense: bring (again, forth, up again), depart, launch (forth), lead (up), loose, offer, sail,…

G324.full: From G303 and G1209; to entertain (as a guest): - receive.

G325.full: From G303 and G1325; to hand over: - deliver.

G326.full: From G303 and G2198; to recover life (literally or figuratively): - (be a-) live again, revive.

G327.full: From G303 and G2212; to search out: - seek.

G328.full: From G303 and G2224; to gird afresh: - gird up.

G329.full: From G303 and a compound of the base of G2226 and G4442; to re-enkindle: - stir up.

G330.full: From G303 and èá́ëëù thallō (to flourish); to revive: - flourish again.

G331.full: From G394; a (religious) ban or (concretely) excommunicated (thing or person): - accursed, anathema, curse, X great.

G332.firstSense: (bind under a) curse, bind with an oath

G333.full: From G303 and G2334; to look again (that is, attentively) at (literally or figuratively): - behold, consider.

G334.full: From G394 (like G331, but in a good sense); a votive offering: - gift.

G335.full: From a compound of G1 (as a negative particle (compare G427)) and G127; impudence, that is, (by implication) importunity: - importunity.

G336.full: From G337; (the act of) killing: - death.

G338.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G159 (in the sense of G156); innocent: - blameless, guiltless.

G339.full: From G303 and G2523; properly to set up, that is, (reflexively) to sit up: - sit up.

G340.full: From G303 and a derivative of G2537; to restore: - renew.

G343.full: From G303 (in the sense of reversal) and G2572; to unveil: - open, ([un-]) taken away.

G344.full: From G303 and G2578; to turn back: - (re-) turn.

G346.firstSense: briefly comprehend, gather together in one

G347.full: From G303 and G2827; to lean back: - lay, (make) sit down.

G348.full: From G303 and G2875; to beat back, that is, check: - hinder.

G349.full: From G303 and G2896; to scream up (aloud): - cry out.

G350.firstSense: ask, question, discern, examine, judge, search

G352.full: From G303 (in the sense of reversal) and G2955; to unbend, that is, rise; figuratively be elated: - lift up, look up.

G356.full: From a compound of G303 and G3056; proportion: - proportion.

G358.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G251; saltless, that is, insipid: - X lose saltness.

G360.full: From G303 and G3089; to break up, that is, depart (literally or figuratively): - depart, return.

G361.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G264; sinless: - that is without sin.

G362.full: From G303 and G3306; to await: - wait for.

G363.firstSense: call to mind, (bring to, call to, put in), remember (-brance)

G365.full: From G303 and a derivative of G3501; to renovate, that is, reform: - renew.

G366.full: From G303 and G3525; to become sober again, that is, (figuratively) regain (one's) senses: - recover self.

G367.full: Of Hebrew origin [H2608]; Ananias, the name of three Israelites: - Ananias.

G368.full: From G1 (as a negatively particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of G473 and G4483; indisputable: - cannot be spoken against.

G369.full: Adverb from G368; promptly: - without gainsaying.

G370.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G514; unfit: - unworthy.

G372.full: From G373; intermission; by implication recreation: - rest.

G373.full: From G303 and G3973; (reflexively) to repose (literally or figuratively (be exempt), remain); by implication to refresh: - take ease, refresh, (give, take) rest.

G374.full: From G303 and G3982; to incite: - persuade.

G375.full: From G303 and G3992; to send up or back: - send (again).

G376.full: From G303 (in the sense of intensity) and ðç͂ñïò pēros (maimed); crippled: - maimed.

G377.full: From G303 and G4098; to fall back, that is, lie down, lean back: - lean, sit down (to meat).

G378.full: From G303 and G4137; to complete; by implication to occupy, supply; figuratively to accomplish (by coincidence or obedience): - fill up, fulfil, occupy, supply.

G379.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G626; indefensible: - without excuse, inexcuseable.

G380.full: From G303 (in the sense of reversal) and G4428; to unroll (a scroll or volume): - open.

G381.full: From G303 and G681; to enkindle: - kindle, light.

G382.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G705; unnumbered, that is, without number: - innumerable.

G383.full: From G303 and G4579; figuratively to excite: - move, stir up.

G384.full: From G303 (in the sense of reversal) and a derivative of G4632; properly to pack up (baggage), that is, (by implication and figuratively) to upset: - subvert.

G385.full: From G303 and G4685; to take up or extricate: - draw up, pull out.

G386.full: From G450; a standing up again, that is, (literally) a resurrection from death (individual, general or by implication (its author)), or (figuratively) a (moral) recovery (of spiritual truth): - raised to life again, resurrection, rise from the dead, that should rise, rising again.

G387.firstSense: trouble, turn upside down, make an uproar
G387.full: From a derivative of G450 (in the sense of removal); properly to drive out of home, that is, (by implication) to disturb (literally or figuratively): - trouble, turn upside down, make an uproar.

G388.full: From G303 and G4717; to recrucify (figuratively): - crucify afresh.

G389.full: From G303 and G4727; to sigh deeply: - sigh deeply.

G390.firstSense: abide, behave self, have conversation, live, overthrow, pass, return, be used
G390.full: From G303 and G4762; to overturn; also to return; by implication to busy oneself, that is, remain, live: - abide, behave self, have conversation, live, overthrow, pass, return, be used.

G392.full: From G303 and the middle of G5021; to arrange: - set in order.

G393.firstSense: (a-, make to) rise, at the rising of, spring (up), be up
G393.full: From G303 and the base of G5056; to (cause to) arise: - (a-, make to) rise, at the rising of, spring (up), be up.

G394.full: From G303 and the middle of G5087; to set forth (for oneself), that is, propound: - communicate, declare.

G395.full: From G393; a rising of light, that is, dawn (figuratively); by implication the east (also in plural): - dayspring, east, rising.

G396.full: From G303 and the base of G5157; to overturn (figuratively): - overthrow, subvert.

G397.full: From G303 and G5142; to rear (physically or mentally): - bring up, nourish (up).

G398.full: From G303 and G5316; to show, that is, (reflexively) appear, or (passively) have pointed out: - (should) appear, discover.

G399.full: From G303 and G5342; to take up (literally or figuratively): - bear, bring (carry, lead) up, offer (up).

G400.full: From G303 and G5455; to exclaim: - speak out.

G401.full: From a compound of G303 and ÷ǻù cheō (to pour); properly effusion, that is, (figuratively) license: - excess.

G402.firstSense: depart, give place, go (turn) aside, withdraw self
G402.full: From G303 and G5562; to retire: - depart, give place, go (turn) aside, withdraw self.

G403.full: From G404; properly a recovery of breath, that is, (figuratively) revival: - revival.

G404.full: From G303 and G5594; properly to cool off, that is, (figuratively) relieve: - refresh.

G405.full: From a derivative of a compound of G435 and G4228; an enslaver (as bringing men to his feet): - men-stealer.

G406.full: From G435; manly; Andreas, an Israelite: - Andrew.

G407.full: Middle voice from G435; to act manly: - quit like men.

G408.full: From G435 and G3534; man of victory; Andronicos, an Israelite: - Andronicus.

G409.full: From G435 and G5408; a murderer: - manslayer.

G410.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G1458; unaccused, that is, (by implication) irreproachable: - blameless.

G411.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G1555; not expounded in full, that is, indescribable: - unspeakable.

G412.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G1583; not spoken out, that is, (by implication) unutterable: - unspeakable.

G413.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G1587; not left out, that is, (by implication) inexhaustible: - that faileth not.

G414.full: Comparative of a derivative of G430; more endurable: - more tolerable.

G415.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G1655; merciless: - unmerciful.

G416.full: From G417; to toss with the wind: - drive with the wind.

G417.full: From the base of G109; wind; (plural) by implication (the four) quarters (of the earth): - wind.

G418.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of the same as G1735; unadmitted, that is, (by implication) not supposable: - impossible.

G419.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G1830; not searched out, that is, (by implication) inscrutable: - unsearchable.

G420.full: From G430 and G2556; enduring of ill, that is, forbearing: - patient.

G421.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of G1537 and a derivative of G2487; not tracked out, that is, (by implication) untraceable: - past finding out, unsearchable.

G422.firstSense: that neededth not to be ashamed
G422.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of G1909 and G153; not ashamed, that is, (by implication) irreprehensible: - that neededth not to be ashamed.

G423.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G1949; not arrested, that is, (by implication) inculpable: - blameless, unrebukeable.

G424.full: From G303 and G2064; to ascend: - go up.

G425.full: From G447; relaxation or (figuratively) relief: - eased, liberty, rest.

G426.full: From G303 and å̓ôá́æù etazō (to test); to investigate (judicially): - (should have) examine (-d).

G427.full: A primary particle; without: - without. Compare G1.

G428.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G2111; not well set, that is, inconvenient: - not commodious.

G429.full: From G303 and G2147; to find out: - find.

G430.full: Middle voice from G303 and G2192; to hold oneself up against, that is, (figuratively) put up with: - bear with endure, forbear, suffer.

G431.full: From G1 (as a particle of union) and an obsolete form íǻðïò nepos (a brood); properly akin, that is, (specifically) a cousin: - sister's son.

G432.full: Probably of foreign origin; dill: - anise.

G433.full: From G303 and G2240; to attain to, that is, (figuratively) be proper: - convenient, be fit.

G434.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and ç̔́ìåñïò hēmeros (lame); savage: - fierce.

G435.full: A primary word (compare G444); a man (properly as an individual male): - fellow, husband, man, sir.

G436.full: From G473 and G2476; to stand against, that is, oppose: - resist, withstand.

G437.full: From G473 and the middle of G3670; to confess in turn, that is, respond in praise: - give thanks.

G438.full: A primary word; a blossom: - flower.

G439.full: From G440; a bed of burning coals: - fire of coals.

G440.full: Of uncertain derivation; a live coal: - coal of fire.

G441.full: From G444 and G700; man courting, that is, fawning: - men-pleaser.

G442.firstSense: human, common to man, man[-kind], [man-]kind, men's, after the manner of men
G442.full: From G444; human: - human, common to man, man[-kind], [man-]kind, men's, after the manner of men.

G443.full: From G444 and êôåé́íù kteinē (to kill); a manslayer: - murderer. Compare G5406.

G444.full: From G435 and ù̓́ø ōps (the countenance; from G3700); manfaced, that is, a human being: - certain, man.

G445.full: From G446; to act as proconsul: - be the deputy.

G446.full: From G473 and a superlative of G5228; instead of the highest officer, that is, (specifically) a Roman proconsul: - deputy.

G447.full: From G303 and é̔́çìé hiēmi (to send); to let up, that is, (literally) slacken, or (figuratively) desert, desist from: - forbear, leave, loose.

G448.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G2436; inexorable: - without mercy.

G449.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G3538; without ablution: - unwashen.

G450.firstSense: arise, lift up, raise up (again), rise (again), stand up (-right)
G450.full: From G303 and G2476; to stand up (literally or figuratively, transitively or intransitively): - arise, lift up, raise up (again), rise (again), stand up (-right).

G451.full: Of Hebrew origin [H2584]; Anna, an Israelitess: - Anna.

G452.full: Of Hebrew origin [H2608]; Annas (that is, G367), an Israelite: - Annas.

G453.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3539; unintelligent; by implication sensual: - fool (-ish), unwise.

G454.full: From a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and G3563; stupidity; by implication rage: - folly, madness.

G455.full: From G303 and ïé̓́ãù oigō (to open); to open up (literally or figuratively, in various applications): - open.

G456.full: From G303 and G3618; to rebuild: - build again.

G458.firstSense: iniquity, X transgress (-ion of) the law, unrighteousness
G458.full: From G459; illegality, that is, violation of law or (generally) wickedness: - iniquity, X transgress (-ion of) the law, unrighteousness.

G459.firstSense: without law, lawless, transgressor, unlawful, wicked
G459.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G3551; lawless, that is, (negatively) not subject to (the Jewish) law; (by implication a Gentile), or (positively) wicked: - without law, lawless, transgressor, unlawful, wicked.

G460.full: Adverb from G459; lawlessly, that is, (specifically) not amenable to (the Jewish) law: - without law.

G461.full: From G303 and a derivative of the base of G3717; to straighten up: - lift (set) up, make straight.

G462.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G3741; wicked: - unholy.

G463.full: From G430; selfrestraint, that is, tolerance: - forbearance.

G464.full: From G473 and G75; to struggle against (figuratively), ("antagonize"): - strive against.

G465.full: From a compound of G473 and G236; an equivalent or ransom: - in exchange.

G466.full: From G473 and G378; to supplement: - fill up.

G467.full: From G473 and G591; to requite (good or evil): - recompense, render, repay.

G468.full: From G467; a requital (properly the thing): - recompense.

G469.full: From G467; requital (properly the act): - reward.

G470.full: From G473 and G611; to contradict or dispute: - answer again, reply against.

G471.full: From G473 and G2036; to refute or deny: - gainsay, say against.

G472.full: From G473 and the middle of G2192; to hold oneself opposite to, that is, (by implication) adhere to; by extension to care for: - hold fast, hold to, support.

G473.full: A primary particle; opposite, that is, instead or because of (rarely in addition to): - for, in the room of. Often used in composition to denote contrast, requital, substitution, correspondence, etc.

G474.full: From G473 and G906; to bandy: - have.

G475.full: From G473 and G1303; to set oneself opposite, that is, be disputatious: - that oppose themselves.

G476.full: From G473 and G1349; an opponent (in a lawsuit); specifically Satan (as the arch enemy): - adversary.

G477.full: From a compound of G473 and G5087; opposition, that is, a conflict (of theories): - opposition.

G478.full: From G473 and G2525; to set down (troops) against, that is, withstand: - resist.

G479.full: From G473 and G2564; to invite in return: - bid again.

G480.full: From G473 and G2749; to lie opposite, that is, be adverse (figuratively repugnant) to: - adversary, be contrary, oppose.

G481.full: Prolonged from G473; opposite: - over against.

G482.full: From G473 and the middle of G2983; to take hold of in turn, that is, succor; also to participate: - help, partaker support.

G483.firstSense: answer again, contradict, deny, gainsay (-er), speak against
G483.full: From G473 and G3004; to dispute, refuse: - answer again, contradict, deny, gainsay (-er), speak against.

G485.full: From a derivative of G483; dispute, disobedience: - contradiction, gainsaying, strife.

G486.full: From G473 and G3058; to rail in reply: - revile again.

G487.full: From G473 and G3083; a redemption price: - ransom.

G488.full: From G473 and G3354; to mete in return: - measure again.

G489.full: From a compound of G473 and G3408; requital, correspondence: - recompense.

G490.full: From Á̓íôé́ï÷ïò Antiochos (a Syrian king); Antiochia, a place in Syria: - Antioch.

G491.full: From G490; an Antiochian or inhabitant of Antiochia: - of Antioch.

G492.firstSense: pass by on the other side
G492.full: From G473 and G3928; to go along opposite: - pass by on the other side.

G493.full: Contracted for a compound of G473 and a derivative of G3962; Antipas, a Christian: - Antipas.

G494.full: From the same as G493; Antipatris, a place in Palestine: - Antipatris.

G495.full: From G473 and G4008; on the opposite side: - over against.

G496.full: From G473 and G4098 (including its alternate); to oppose: - resist.

G497.full: From G473 and G4754; (figuratively) to attack, that is, (by implication) destroy: - war against.

G498.full: From G473 and the middle of G5021; to range oneself against, that is, oppose: - oppose themselves, resist.

G499.full: Neuter of a compound of G473 and G5179; corresponding ("antitype"), that is, a representative, counterpart: - (like) figure (whereunto).

G500.full: From G473 and G5547; an opponent of the Messiah: - antichrist.

G501.full: From á̓́íôëïò antlos (the hold of a ship); to bale up (properly bilge water), that is, dip water (with a bucket, pitcher, etc.): - draw (out).

G502.full: From G501; a baling vessel: - thing to draw with.

G503.full: From a compound of G473 and G3788; to face: - bear up into.

G504.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G5204; waterless, that is, dry: - dry, without water.

G505.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G5271; undissembled, that is, sincere: - without dissimulation (hypocrisy), unfeigned.

G506.firstSense: disobedient, that is not put under, unruly
G506.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G5293; unsubdued, that is, insubordinate (in fact or temper): - disobedient, that is not put under, unruly.

G507.full: Adverb from G473; upward or on the top: - above, brim, high, up.

G508.full: From G507 and G1093; above the ground, that is, (properly) the second floor of a building; used for a dome or a balcony on the upper story: - upper room.

G509.firstSense: from above, again, from the beginning (very first), the top
G509.full: From G507; from above; by analogy from the first; by implication anew: - from above, again, from the beginning (very first), the top.

G510.full: From G511; superior, that is, (locally) more remote: - upper.

G511.full: Comparative degree of G507; upper, that is, (neuter as adverb) to a more conspicuous place, in a former part of the book: - above, higher.

G512.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and the base of G5624; useless or (neuter) inutility: - unprofitable(-ness).

G513.full: Probably from á̓́ãíõìé agnumi (to break; compare G4486); an axe: - axe.

G514.full: Probably from G71; deserving, comparable or suitable (as if drawing praise): - due reward, meet, [un-] worthy.

G515.full: From G514; to deem entitled or fit: - desire, think good, count (think) worthy.

G516.firstSense: as becometh, after a godly sort, worthily (-thy)
G516.full: Adverb from G514; appropriately: - as becometh, after a godly sort, worthily (-thy).

G517.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G3707; invisible: - invisible (thing).

G518.firstSense: bring word (again), declare, report, shew (again), tell
G518.full: From G575 and the base of G32; to announce: - bring word (again), declare, report, shew (again), tell.

G519.full: From G575 and á̓́ã÷ù agchō (to choke; akin to the base of G43); to strangle oneself off (that is, to death): - hang himself.

G520.firstSense: bring, carry away, lead (away), put to death, take away
G520.full: From G575 and G71; to take off (in various senses): - bring, carry away, lead (away), put to death, take away.

G521.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3811; uninstructed, that is, (figuratively) stupid: - unlearned.

G522.full: From G575 and G142; to lift off, that is, remove: - take (away).

G523.full: From G575 and G154; to demand back: - ask again, require.

G524.full: From G575 and á̓ëãǻù algeō (to smart); to grieve out, that is, become apathetic: - be past feeling.

G525.full: From G575 and G236; to change away, that is, release, (reflexively) remove: - deliver, depart.

G526.full: From G575 and a derivative of G245; to estrange away, that is, (passively and figuratively) to be non participant: - alienate, be alien.

G528.full: From G575 and a derivative of G473; to meet away, that is, encounter: - meet.

G530.full: Probably from G537; one (or a single) time (numerically or conclusively): - once.

G531.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3845; not passing away, that is, untransferable (perpetual): - unchangeable.

G532.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3903; unready: - unprepared.

G533.full: From G575 and G720; to deny utterly, that is, disown, abstain: - deny.

G534.full: From G575 and G737; from now, that is, henceforth (already): - from henceforth.

G535.full: From a derivative of G534; completion: - finishing.

G536.full: From a compound of G575 and G756; a beginning of sacrifice, that is, the (Jewish) first fruit (figuratively): - first-fruits.

G537.full: From G1 (as a particle of union) and G3956; absolutely all or (singular) every one: - all (things), every (one), whole.

G538.full: Of uncertain derivation; to cheat, that is, delude: - deceive.

G540.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G3962; fatherless, that is, of unrecorded paternity: - without father.

G541.full: From a compound of G575 and G826; an off flash, that is, effulgence: - brightness.

G542.full: From G575 and the same as G1492; to see fully: - see.

G543.full: From G545; disbelief (obstinate and rebellious): - disobedience, unbelief.

G544.firstSense: not believe, disobedient, obey not, unbelieving
G544.full: From G545; to disbelieve (wilfully and perversely): - not believe, disobedient, obey not, unbelieving.

G545.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G3982; unpersuadable, that is, contumacious: - disobedient.

G546.full: Of uncertain derivation; to menace; by implication to forbid: - threaten.

G547.full: From G546; a menace: - X straitly, threatening.

G548.full: From G575 and G1510; to be away: - be absent. Compare G549.

G549.full: From G575 and åé̓͂ìé eimi (to go); to go away: - go. Compare G548.

G550.full: Reflexive past of a compound of G575 and G2036; to say off for oneself, that is, disown: - renounce.

G551.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G3987; untried, that is, not temptable: - not to be tempted.

G552.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G3984; inexperienced, that is, ignorant: - unskilful.

G553.full: From G575 and G1551; to expect fully: - look (wait) for.

G554.full: Middle voice from G575 and G1562; to divest wholly oneself, or (for oneself) despoil: - put off, spoil.

G556.full: From G575 and G1643; to dismiss: - drive.

G557.full: From a compound of G575 and G1651; refutation, that is, (by implication) contempt: - nought.

G558.full: From G575 and G1658; one freed away, that is, a freedman: - freeman.

G559.full: Of Latin origin; Apelles, a Christian: - Apelles.

G560.full: From G575 and G1679; to hope out, that is, fully expect: - hope for again.

G561.firstSense: before, contrary, over against, in the presence of
G561.full: From G575 and G1725; from in front, that is, opposite, before or against: - before, contrary, over against, in the presence of.

G562.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a secondary derivative of G4008; unfinished, that is, (by implication) interminable: - endless.

G563.full: Adverb from a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G4049; undistractedly, that is, free from (domestic) solicitude: - without distraction.

G564.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G4059; uncircumcised (figuratively): - uncircumcised.

G565.firstSense: come, depart, go (aside, away, back, out,
G565.full: From G575 and G2064; to go off (that is, depart), aside (that is, apart) or behind (that is, follow), literally or figuratively: - come, depart, go (aside, away, back, out, . . . ways), pass away, be past.

G566.full: Third person singular present indicative active of G568 used impersonally; it is sufficient: - it is enough.

G567.full: Middle voice (reflexive) of G568; to hold oneself off, that is, refrain: - abstain.

G568.full: From G575 and G2192; (active) to have out, that is, receive in full; (intransitive) to keep (oneself) away, that is, be distant (literally or figuratively): - be, have, receive.

G569.full: From G571; to be unbelieving, that is, (transitively) disbelieve, or (by implication) disobey: - believe not.

G570.full: From G571; faithlessness, that is, (negatively) disbelief (want of Christian faith), or (positively) unfaithfulness (disobedience): - unbelief.

G571.firstSense: that believeth not, faithless, incredible thing, infidel, unbeliever (-ing)
G571.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G4103; (actively) disbelieving, that is, without Christian faith (specifically a heathen); (passively) untrustworthy (person), or incredible (thing): - that believeth not, faithless, incredible thing, infidel, unbeliever (-ing).

G572.full: From G573; singleness, that is, (subjectively) sincerity (without dissimulation or self seeking), or (objectively) generosity (copious bestowal): - bountifulness, liberal (-ity), simplicity, singleness.

G573.full: Probably from G1 (as a particle of union) and the base of G4120; properly folded together, that is, single (figuratively clear): - single.

G574.full: Adverb from G573 (in the objective sense of G572); bountifully: - liberally.

G575.firstSense: (X here-) after, ago, at, because of, before, by (the space of), for (-th), from, in, (…
G575.full: A primary particle; "off", that is, away (from something near), in various senses (of place, time, or relation; literally or figuratively): - (X here-) after, ago, at, because of, before, by (the space of), for (-th), from, in, (out) of, off, (up-) on (-ce), since, with. In composition (as a prefix) it usually denotes separation, departure, cessation, completion, reversal, etc.

G576.full: From G575 and the base of G939; literally to disembark; figuratively to eventuate: - become, go out, turn.

G577.full: From G575 and G906; to throw off; figuratively to lose: - cast away.

G578.full: From G575 and G991; to look away from everything else, that is, (figuratively) intently regard: - have respect.

G579.full: From G577; cast off, that is, (figuratively) such as to be rejected: - be refused.

G580.full: From G577; rejection; figuratively loss: - casting away, loss.

G581.full: Past participle of a compound of G575 and G1096; absent, that is, deceased (figuratively renounced): - being dead.

G582.full: From G583; an enrollment; by implication an assessment: - taxing.

G583.full: From G575 and G1125; to write off (a copy or list), that is, enrol: - tax, write.

G584.full: From G575 and G1166; to show off, that is, exhibit; figuratively to demonstrate, that is, accredit: - (ap-) prove, set forth, shew.

G586.full: From G575 and G1183; to tithe (as debtor or creditor): - (give, pay, take) tithe.

G587.full: From G588; accepted, that is, agreeable: - acceptable.

G588.full: From G575 and G1209; to take fully, that is, welcome (persons), approve (things): - accept, receive (gladly).

G589.firstSense: go (travel) into a far country, journey
G589.full: From G590; to go abroad, that is, visit a foreign land: - go (travel) into a far country, journey.

G590.full: From G575 and G1218; absent from one's own people, that is, a foreign traveller: - taking a far journey.

G591.firstSense: deliver (again), give (again), (re-) pay (-ment be made), perform, recompense, render,…
G591.full: From G575 and G1325; to give away, that is, up, over, back, etc. (in various applications): - deliver (again), give (again), (re-) pay (-ment be made), perform, recompense, render, requite, restore, reward, sell, yield,

G592.full: From G575 and a compound of G1223 and G3724; to disjoin (by a boundary, figuratively a party): - separate.

G593.full: From G575 and G1381; to disapprove, that is, (by implication) to repudiate: - disallow, reject.

G595.full: From G659; a laying aside (literally or figuratively): - putting away (off).

G596.full: From G659; a repository, that is, granary: - barn, garner.

G597.full: From G575 and G2343; to treasure away: - lay up in store.

G598.full: From G575 and G2346; to crowd from (every side): - press.

G599.firstSense: be dead, death, die, lie a-dying, be slain (X with)
G599.full: From G575 and G2348; to die off (literally or figuratively): - be dead, death, die, lie a-dying, be slain (X with).

G600.full: From G575 and G2525; to reconstitute (in health, home or organization): - restore (again).

G601.full: From G575 and G2572; to take off the cover, that is, disclose: - reveal.

G602.firstSense: appearing, coming, lighten, manifestation, be revealed, revelation
G602.full: From G601; disclosure: - appearing, coming, lighten, manifestation, be revealed, revelation.

G603.full: From a compound of G575 and a compound of êá́ñá kara (the head) and G1380 (in the sense of watching); intense anticipation: - earnest expectation.

G604.full: From G575 and G2644; to reconcile fully: - reconcile.

G606.full: From G575 and G2749; to be reserved; figuratively to await: - be appointed, (be) laid up.

G607.full: From G575 and G2776; to decapitate: - behead.

G608.full: From G575 and G2808; to close fully: - shut up.

G609.full: From G575 and G2875; to amputate; reflexively (by irony) to mutilate (the privy parts): - cut off. Compare G2699.

G610.full: From G611 (in its original sense of judging); a judicial decision: - sentence.

G611.full: From G575 and êñéíù krino; to conclude for oneself, that is, (by implication) to respond; by Hebraism (compare [H6030]) to begin to speak (where an address is expected): - answer.

G613.full: From G575 and G2928; to conceal away (that is, fully); figuratively to keep secret: - hide.

G614.full: From G613; secret; by implication treasured: - hid, kept secret.

G615.full: From G575 and êôåé́íù kteinō (to slay); to kill outright; figuratively to destroy: - put to death, kill, slay.

G616.full: From G575 and the base of G2949; to breed forth, that is, (by transformation) to generate (figuratively): - beget, bring forth.

G617.full: From G575 and G2947; to roll away: - roll away (back).

G618.full: From G575 and G2983; to receive (specifically in full, or as a host); also to take aside: - receive, take.

G619.full: From a compound of G575 and ëáṍù lauō (to enjoy); full enjoyment: - enjoy (-ment).

G620.full: From G575 and G3007; to leave behind (passively remain); by implication to forsake: - leave, remain.

G621.full: From G575 and ëåé́÷ù leichō (to "lick"); to lick clean: - lick.

G622.full: From G575 and the base of G3639; to destroy fully (reflexively to perish, or lose), literally or figuratively: - destroy, die, lose, mar, perish.

G623.full: Active participle of G622; a destroyer (that is, Satan): - Apollyon.

G624.full: From the pagan deity Á̓ðḯëëùí Apollōn (that is, the sun; from G622); Apollonia, a place in Macedonia: - Apollonia.

G625.full: Probably from the same as G624; Apollos, an Israelite: - Apollos.

G626.firstSense: answer (for self), make defence, excuse (self), speak for self
G626.full: Middle voice from a compound of G575 and G3056; to give an account (legal plea) of oneself, that is, exculpate (self): - answer (for self), make defence, excuse (self), speak for self.

G627.firstSense: answer (for self), clearing of self, defence
G627.full: From the same as G626; a plea ("apology"): - answer (for self), clearing of self, defence.

G628.full: From G575 and G3068; to wash fully, that is, (figuratively) have remitted (reflexively): - wash (away).

G629.full: From a compound of G575 and G3083; (the act) ransom in full, that is, (figuratively) riddance, or (specifically) Christian salvation: - deliverance, redemption.

G630.firstSense: (let) depart, dismiss, divorce, forgive, let go, loose, put (send) away, release, set a…
G630.full: From G575 and G3089; to free fully, that is, (literally) relieve, release, dismiss (reflexively depart), or (figuratively) let die, pardon, or (specifically) divorce: - (let) depart, dismiss, divorce, forgive, let go, loose, put (send) away, release, set at liberty.

G631.full: Middle voice from G575 and ìá́óóù massō (to squeeze, knead, smear); to scrape away: - wipe off.

G632.full: From G575 and the base of G3551; to apportion, that is, bestow: - give.

G633.full: From G575 and G3538; to wash off (reflexively one's own hands symbolically): - wash.

G634.full: From G575 and G4098; to fall off: - fall.

G635.full: From G575 and G4105; to lead astray (figuratively); passively to stray (from truth): - err, seduce.

G636.full: From G575 and G4126; to set sail: - sail away.

G637.full: From G575 and G4150; to rinse off: - wash.

G638.full: From G575 and G4155; to stifle (by drowning or overgrowth): - choke.

G639.full: From a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and the base of G4198; to have no way out, that is, be at a loss (mentally): - (stand in) doubt, be perplexed.

G640.full: From the same as G639; a (state of) quandary: - perplexity.

G641.full: From G575 and G4496; to hurl off, that is, precipitate (oneself): - cast.

G642.full: From G575 and a derivative of G3737; to bereave wholly, that is, (figuratively) separate (from intercourse): - take.

G643.full: From G575 and a derivative of G4632; to pack up (one's) baggage: - take up . . . carriages.

G644.full: From a compound of G575 and a derivative of G4639; a shading off, that is, obscuration: - shadow.

G645.firstSense: (with-) draw (away), after we were gotten from
G645.full: From G575 and G4685; to drag forth, that is, (literally) unsheathe (a sword), or relatively (with a degree of force implied) retire (personally or factiously): - (with-) draw (away), after we were gotten from.

G646.full: Feminine of the same as G647; defection from truth (properly the state), ("apostasy"): - falling away, forsake.

G647.full: Neuter of a (presumed) adjective from a derivative of G868; properly something separative, that is, (specifically) divorce: - (writing of) divorcement.

G648.full: From G575 and a derivative of G4721; to unroof: - uncover.

G649.firstSense: put in, send (away, forth, out), set [at liberty]
G649.full: From G575 and G4724; set apart, that is, (by implication) to send out (properly on a mission) literally or figuratively: - put in, send (away, forth, out), set [at liberty].

G650.firstSense: defraud, destitute, kept back by fraud
G650.full: From G575 and óôåñǻù stereō (to deprive); to despoil: - defraud, destitute, kept back by fraud.

G651.full: From G649; commission, that is, (specifically) apostolate: - apostleship.

G652.firstSense: apostle, messenger, he that is sent
G652.full: From G649; a delegate; specifically an ambassador of the Gospel; officially a commissioner of Christ ("apostle"), (with miraculous powers): - apostle, messenger, he that is sent.

G653.full: From G575 and a (presumed) derivative of G4750; to speak off hand (properly dictate), that is, to catechize (in an invidious manner): - provoke to speak.

G654.full: From G575 and G4762; to turn away or back (literally or figuratively): - bring again, pervert, turn away (from).

G655.full: From G575 and the base of G4767; to detest utterly: - abhor.

G656.full: From G575 and G4864; excommunicated: - (put) out of the synagogue (-s).

G657.firstSense: bid farewell, forsake, take leave, send away
G657.full: Middle voice from G575 and G5021; literally to say adieu (by departing or dismissing); figuratively to renounce: - bid farewell, forsake, take leave, send away.

G658.full: From G575 and G5055; to complete entirely, that is, consummate: - finish.

G659.firstSense: cast off, lay apart (aside, down), put away (off)
G659.full: From G575 and G5087; to put away (literally or figuratively): - cast off, lay apart (aside, down), put away (off).

G660.full: From G575 and ôéíá́óóù tinassō (to jostle); to brush off: - shake off.

G661.full: From G575 and G5099; to pay in full: - repay.

G662.full: From G575 and G5111; to venture plainly: - be very bold.

G663.full: From the base of G664; (figuratively) decisiveness, that is, rigor: - severity.

G664.full: Adverb from a derivative of a compound of G575 and ôǻìíù temnō (to cut); abruptly, that is, peremptorily: - sharply (-ness).

G665.full: From G575 and the base of G5157; to deflect, that is, (reflexively) avoid: - turn away.

G666.full: From the participle of G548; a being away: - absence.

G667.full: From G575 and G5342; to bear off (literally or relatively): - bring, carry (away).

G668.full: From G575 and G5343; (figuratively) to escape: - escape.

G669.full: From G575 and G5350; to enunciate plainly, that is, declare: - say, speak forth, utterance.

G670.full: From G575 and the middle voice of G5412; to unload: - unlade.

G671.full: From a compound of G575 and G5530; the act of using up, that is, consumption: - using.

G672.full: From G575 and G5562; to go away: - depart.

G673.full: From G575 and G5563; to rend apart; reflexively to separate: - depart (asunder).

G674.full: From G575 and G5594; to breathe out, that is, faint: - hearts failing.

G675.full: Of Latin origin; (in the genitive, that is, possessive case) of Appius, the name of a Roman: - Appii.

G676.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a compound of G4314 and åé̓͂ìé eimi (to go); inaccessible: - which no man can approach.

G677.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G4350; actively inoffensive, that is, not leading into sin; passively faultless, that is, not led into sin: - none (void of, without) offence.

G678.full: Adverb from a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a presumed compound of G4383 and G2983 (compare G4381); in a way not accepting the person, that is, impartially: - without respect of persons.

G679.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G4417; not stumbling, that is, (figuratively) without sin: - from falling.

G680.full: Reflexive of G681; properly to attach oneself to, that is, to touch (in many implied relations): - touch.

G681.full: A primary verb; properly to fasten to, that is, (specifically) to set on fire: - kindle, light.

G682.full: Probably of foreign origin; Apphia, a woman of Colossae: - Apphia.

G683.firstSense: cast away, put away (from), thrust way (from)
G683.full: From G575 and the middle voice of ù̓èǻù ōtheō or ù̓́èù ōthō (to shove); to push off, figuratively to reject: - cast away, put away (from), thrust way (from).

G684.firstSense: damnable (-nation), destruction, die, perdition, X perish, pernicious ways, waste
G684.full: From a presumed derivative of G622; ruin or loss (physical, spiritual or eternal): - damnable (-nation), destruction, die, perdition, X perish, pernicious ways, waste.

G685.full: Probably from G142; properly prayer (as lifted to Heaven), that is, (by implication) imprecation: - curse.

G686.firstSense: haply, (what) manner (of man), no doubt, perhaps, so be, then, therefore, truly, wherefore
G686.full: Probably from G142 (through the idea of drawing a conclusion); a particle denoting an inference more or less decisive (as follows): - haply, (what) manner (of man), no doubt, perhaps, so be, then, therefore, truly, wherefore. Often used in connection with other particles, especially G1065 or G3767 (after) or G1487 (before). Compare also G687.

G687.full: A form of G686, denoting an interrogation to which a negative answer is presumed: - therefore.

G688.full: Of Hebrew origin [H6152]; Arabia, a region of Asia: - Arabia.

G689.full: Of Hebrew origin [H7410]; Aram (that is, Ram), an Israelite: - Aram.

G690.full: From G688; an Arab or native of Arabia: - Arabian.

G691.full: From G692; to be idle, that is, (figuratively) to delay: - linger.

G692.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and G2041; inactive, that is, unemployed; (by implication) lazy, useless: - barren, idle, slow.

G693.full: From G696; made of silver: - (of) silver.

G694.full: Neuter of a presumed derivative of G696; silvery, that is, (by implication) cash; specifically a silverling (that is, drachma or shekel): - money, (piece of) silver (piece).

G695.full: From G696 and G2875; a beater (that is, worker) of silver: - silversmith.

G696.full: From á̓ñãḯò argos (shining); silver (the metal, in the articles or coin): - silver.

G697.full: From Á̓́ñçò Arēs (the name of the Greek deity of war) and a derivative of G4078; rock of Ares, a place in Athens: - Areopagus, Mars' Hill.

G698.full: From G697; an Areopagite or member of the court held on Mars' Hill: - Areopagite.

G699.full: From a derivative of G700; complaisance: - pleasing.

G700.full: Probably from G142 (through the idea of exciting emotion); to be agreeable (or by implication to seek to be so): - please.

G701.full: From G700; agreeable; by implication fit: - (things that) please (-ing), reason.

G702.full: Of foreign origin; Aretas, an Arabian: - Aretas.

G703.full: From the same as G730; properly manliness (valor), that is, excellence (intrinsic or attributed): - praise, virtue.

G704.full: Perhaps the same as G730; a lamb (as a male): - lamb.

G705.full: From G706; to enumerate or count: - number.

G706.full: From G142; a number (as reckoned up): - number.

G707.full: Of hebrew origin [H7414]; Arimathaea (or Ramah), a place in Palestine: - Arimatha.

G708.full: From the same as G712 and G757; best ruling; Aristarchus, a Macedonian: - Aristarchus.

G709.full: From G712; to take the principal meal: - dine.

G710.full: Apparently a compound of the same as G712; the left hand (as second best): - left [hand].

G711.full: From the same as G712 and G1012; best counselling; Aristoboulus, a Christian: - Aristobulus.

G712.full: Apparent neuter of a superlative from the same as G730; the best meal [or breakfast; perhaps from ç̓͂ñé ēri ("early")], that is, luncheon: - dinner.

G714.firstSense: be content, be enough, suffice, be sufficient
G714.full: Apparently a primary verb (but probably akin to G142 through the idea of raising a barrier); properly to ward off, that is, (by implication) to avail (figuratively be satisfactory): - be content, be enough, suffice, be sufficient.

G715.full: Probably from G714; a bear (as obstructing by ferocity): - bear.

G716.full: Probably from G142 (perhaps with G1 (as a particle of union) prefixed); a chariot (as raised or fitted together (compare G719)): - chariot.

G717.full: Of Hebrew origin [H2022] and [H4023]; Armageddon (or Har-Megiddon), a symbolical name: - Armageddon.

G718.full: From G719; to joint, that is, (figuratively) to woo (reflexively to betroth): - espouse.

G719.full: From the same as G716; an articulation (of the body): - joint.

G720.full: Perhaps from G1 (as a negative particle) and the middle of G4483; to contradict, that is, disavow, reject, abnegate: - deny, refuse.

G721.full: Diminutive from G704; a lambkin: - lamb.

G723.full: From á̓ñḯù aroō (to till); a plough: - plow.

G724.full: From G726; pillage (properly abstract): - extortion, ravening, spoiling.

G726.firstSense: catch (away, up), pluck, pull, take (by force)
G726.full: From a derivative of G138; to seize (in various applications): - catch (away, up), pluck, pull, take (by force).

G728.full: Of Hebrew origin [H6162]; a pledge, that is, part of the purchase money or property given in advance as security for the rest: - earnest.

G729.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of the same as G4476; unsewed, that is, of a single piece: - without seam.

G730.full: Probably from G142; male (as stronger for lifting): - male, man.

G731.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and the same as G4490; unsaid, that is, (by implication) inexpressible: - unspeakable.

G732.full: From G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G4517; infirm: - sick (folk, -ly).

G733.firstSense: abuser of (that defile) self with mankind
G733.full: From G730 and G2845; a sodomite: - abuser of (that defile) self with mankind.

G734.full: Contracted from a compound of G735 and G1435; gift of Artemis; Artemas (or Artemidorus), a Christian: - Artemas.

G735.full: Probably from the same as G736; prompt; Artemis, the name of a Grecian goddess borrowed by the Asiatics for one of their deities: - Diana.

G736.full: From a derivative of G737; properly something ready (or else more remotely from G142 (compare G740); something hung up), that is, (specifically) the topsail (rather foresail or jib) of a vessel: - mainsail.

G737.firstSense: this day (hour), hence [-forth], here [-after], hither [-to], (even) now, (this) present
