G1438.full: (Including all the other cases); from a reflexive pronoun otherwise obsolete and the genitive (dative or accusative) of G846; him (her, it, them, also [in conjunction with the personal pronoun of the other persons] my, thy, our, your) -self (-selves), etc.: - alone, her (own, -self), (he) himself, his (own), itself, one (to) another, our (thine) own (-selves), + that she had, their (own, own selves), (of) them (-selves), they, thyself, you, your (own, own conceits, own selves, -selves).

G1439.full: Of uncertain affinity; to let be, that is, permit or leave alone: - commit, leave, let (alone), suffer. See also G1436.

G1440.full: From G1442 and a modified form of G1176, seventy: - seventy, three score and ten.

G1441.full: Multiple adverb from G1440; seventy times: - seventy times.

G1443.full: Of Hebrew origin [H5677]; Eber, a patriarch: - Eber.

G1444.full: From G1443; Hebraic or the Jewish language: - Hebrew.

G1445.full: From G1443; a Hebraean (that is, Hebrew) or Jew: - Hebrew.

G1446.full: From G1443; the Hebraistic (that is, Hebrew) or Jewish (Chaldee) language: - Hebrew.

G1447.full: Adverb from G1446; Hebraistically or in the Jewish (Chaldee) language: - in (the) Hebrew (tongue).

G1448.firstSense: approach, be at hand, come (draw) near, be (come, draw) nigh
G1448.full: From G1451; to make near, that is, (reflexively) approach: - approach, be at hand, come (draw) near, be (come, draw) nigh.

G1449.full: From G1722 and G1125; to "engrave", that is, inscribe: - write (in).

G1450.full: From G1722 and ãõé͂ïí guion (a limb); pledged (as if articulated by a member), that is, a bondsman: - surety.

G1451.firstSense: from, at hand, near, nigh (at hand, unto), ready
G1451.full: From a primary verb á̓́ã÷ù agchō (to squeeze or throttle; akin to the base of G43); near (literally or figuratively, of place or time): - from, at hand, near, nigh (at hand, unto), ready.

G1452.full: Neuter of the compound of G1451; nearer: - nearer.

G1453.firstSense: awake, lift (up), raise (again, up), rear up, (a-) rise (again, up), stand, take up
G1453.full: Probably akin to the base of G58 (through the idea of collecting one's faculties); to waken (transitively or intransitively), that is, rouse (literally from sleep, from sitting or lying, from disease, from death; or figuratively from obscurity, inactivity, ruins, nonexistence): - awake, lift (up), raise (again, up), rear up, (a-) rise (again, up), stand, take up.

G1454.full: From G1453; a resurgence (from death): - resurrection.

G1455.full: From G1722 and a derivative of G2524; subinduced, that is, surreptitiously suborned as a lier in wait: - spy.

G1456.full: Neuter plural of a presumed compound from G1722 and G2537; innovatives, that is, (specifically) renewal (of religious services after the Antiochian interruption): - dedication.

G1457.full: From G1456; to renew, that is, inaugurate: - consecrate, dedicate.

G1458.firstSense: accuse, call in question, implead, lay to the charge
G1458.full: From G1722 and G2564; to call in (as a debt or demand), that is, bring to account (charge, criminate, etc.): - accuse, call in question, implead, lay to the charge.

G1459.full: From G1722 and G2641; to leave behind in some place, that is, (in a good sense) let remain over, or (in a bad one) to desert: - forsake, leave.

G1460.full: From G1722 and G2730; to settle down in a place, that is, reside: - dwell among.

G1461.full: From G1722 and a derivative of G2759; to prick in, that is, ingraft: - graff in (-to).

G1462.firstSense: crime laid against, laid to charge
G1462.full: From G1458; an accusation, that is, offence alleged: - crime laid against, laid to charge.

G1463.full: Middle voice from G1722 êïìâḯù komboō (to gird); to engirdle oneself (for labor), that is, figuratively (the apron being a badge of servitude) to wear (in token of mutual deference): - be clothed with.

G1464.full: From G1465; a hindrance: - X hinder.

G1465.full: From G1722 and G2875; to cut into, that is, (figuratively) impede, detain: - hinder, be tedious unto.

G1466.full: From G1468; self control (especially continence): - temperance.

G1467.full: Middle voice from G1468; to exercise self restraint (in diet and chastity): - can([-not]) contain, be temperate.

G1468.full: From G1722 and G2904; strong in a thing (masterful), that is, (figuratively and reflexively) self controlled (in appetite, etc.): - temperate.

G1469.full: From G1722 and G2919; to judge in, that is, count among: - make of the number.

G1470.full: From G1722 and G2928; to conceal in, that is, incorporate with: - hid in.

G1471.full: From G1722 and the base of G2949; swelling inside, that is, pregnant: - great with child.

G1472.full: From G1722 and G5548; to rub in (oil), that is, besmear: - anoint.

G1473.full: A primary pronoun of the first person, "I" (only expressed when emphatic): - I, me. For the other cases and the plural see G1691, G1698, G1700, G2248, G2249, G2254, G2257, etc.

G1474.full: From G1475; to raze: - lay even with the ground.

G1475.full: From the base of G1476; a basis (bottom), that is, the soil: - ground.

G1476.full: From a derivative of å̔́æïìáé hezomai (to sit); sedentary, that is, (by implication) immovable: - settled, stedfast.

G1477.full: From a derivative of G1476; a support, that is, (figuratively) basis: - ground.

G1478.full: Of Hebrew origin [H2396]; Ezekias (that is, Hezekiah), an Israelite: - Ezekias.

G1479.full: From G2309 and G2356; voluntary (arbitrary and unwarranted) piety, that is, sanctimony: - will worship.

G1480.full: From G1485; to accustom, that is, (neuter passive participle) customary: - custom.

G1481.full: From G1484 and G746; the governor [not king] of a district: - ethnarch.

G1482.full: From G1484; national ("ethnic"), that is, (specifically) a Gentile: - heathen (man).

G1483.full: Adverb from G1482; as a Gentile: - after the manner of Gentiles.

G1484.full: Probably from G1486; a race (as of the same habit), that is, a tribe; specifically a foreign (non-Jewish) one (usually by implication pagan): - Gentile, heathen, nation, people.

G1485.full: From G1486; a usage (prescribed by habit or law): - custom, manner, be wont.

G1486.full: A primary verb; to be used (by habit or conventionality); neuter perfect participle usage: - be custom (manner, wont).

G1487.firstSense: forasmuch as, if, that, ([al-]) though, whether
G1487.full: A primary particle of conditionality; if, whether, that, etc.: - forasmuch as, if, that, ([al-]) though, whether. Often used in connection or composition with other particles, especially as in G1489, G1490, G1499, G1508, G1509, G1512, G1513, G1536, and G1537. See also G1437.

G1488.full: Second parson singular present of G1510; thou art: - art, be.

G1489.full: From G1487 and G1065; if indeed, seeing that, unless, (with negative) otherwise: - if (so be that, yet).

G1490.full: From G1487, G1161 and G3361 (sometimes with G1065 added); but if not: - (or) else, if (not, otherwise), otherwise.

G1491.full: From G1492; a view, that is, form (literally or figuratively): - appearance, fashion, shape, sight.

G1492.firstSense: be aware, behold, X can (+ not tell), consider, (have) known (-ledge), look (on), perce…
G1492.full: A primary verb; used only in certain past tenses, the others being borrowed from the equivalent, G3700 and G3708; properly to see (literally or figuratively); by implication (in the perfect only) to know: - be aware, behold, X can (+ not tell), consider, (have) known (-ledge), look (on), perceive, see, be sure, tell, understand, wist, wot. Compare G3700.

G1493.full: Neuter of a presumed derivative of G1497; an image fane: - idol's temple.

G1494.firstSense: (meat, thing that is) offered (in sacrifice, sacrificed) to (unto) idols
G1494.full: Neuter of a compound of G1497 and a presumed derivative of G2380; an image sacrifice, that is, part of an idolatrous offering: - (meat, thing that is) offered (in sacrifice, sacrificed) to (unto) idols.

G1495.full: From G1497 and G2999; image worship (literally or figuratively): - idolatry.

G1496.full: From G1497 and the base of G3000; an image (servant or) worshipper (literally or figuratively): - idolater.

G1497.full: From G1491; an image (that is, for worship); by implication a heathen god, or (plural) the worship of such: - idol.

G1498.firstSense: mean, + perish, should be, was, were
G1498.full: Optative (that is, English subjunctive) present of G1510 (including the other person); might (could, would or should) be: - mean, + perish, should be, was, were.

G1499.full: ei kai i kahee From G1487 and G2532; if also (or even): - if (that), though.

G1500.full: Probably from G1502 (through the idea of failure); idly, that is, without reason (or effect): - without a cause, (in) vain (-ly.)

G1501.full: Of uncertain affinity; a score: - twenty.

G1502.full: Apparently a primary verb; properly to be weak, that is, yield: - give place.

G1503.full: Apparently a primary verb (perhaps akin to G1502 through the idea of faintness as a copy); to resemble: - be like.

G1504.full: From G1503; a likeness, that is, (literally) statue, profile, or (figuratively) representation, resemblance: - image.

G1505.full: From G1506; clearness, that is, (by implication) purity (figuratively): - sincerity.

G1506.full: From åé̔́ëç heilē (the sun's ray) and G2919; judged by sunlight, that is, tested as genuine (figuratively): - pure, sincere.

G1507.full: A prolonged form of a primary but defective verb åé̔́ëù heilō (of the same meaning); to coil or wrap: - roll together. See also G1667.

G1508.firstSense: but, except (that), if not, more than, save (only) that, saving, till
G1508.full: ei mē i may From G1487 and G3361; if not: - but, except (that), if not, more than, save (only) that, saving, till.

G1509.full: ei mē ti i may tee From G1508 and the neuter of G5100; if not somewhat: - except.

G1510.firstSense: am, have been, X it is I, was
G1510.full: First person singular present indicative; a prolonged form of a primary and defective verb; I exist (used only when emphatic): - am, have been, X it is I, was. See also G1488, G1498, G1511, G1527, G2258, G2071, G2070, G2075, G2076, G2771, G2468, G5600.

G1511.firstSense: am, are, come, is, X lust after, X please well, there is, to be, was
G1511.full: Present infinitive from G1510; to exist: - am, are, come, is, X lust after, X please well, there is, to be, was.

G1512.full: ei per i per From G1487 and G4007; if perhaps: - if so be (that), seeing, though.

G1513.full: ei pōs i poce From G1487 and G4458; if somehow: - if by any means.

G1514.firstSense: be at (have, live in) peace, live peaceably
G1514.full: From G1515; to be (act) peaceful: - be at (have, live in) peace, live peaceably.

G1515.firstSense: one, peace, quietness, rest, + set at one again
G1515.full: Probably from a primary verb åé̓́ñù eirō (to join); peace (literally or figuratively); by implication prosperity: - one, peace, quietness, rest, + set at one again.

G1516.full: From G1515; pacific; by implication salutary: - peaceable.

G1517.full: From G1518; to be a peace maker, that is, (figuratively) to harmonize: - make peace.

G1518.full: From G1518 and G4160; pacificatory, that is, (subjectively) peaceable: - peacemaker.

G1519.firstSense: [abundant-] ly, against, among, as, at, [back-] ward, before, by, concerning, + continu…
G1519.full: eis ice A primary preposition; to or into (indicating the point reached or entered), of place, time, or (figuratively) purpose (result, etc.); also in adverbial phrases.: - [abundant-] ly, against, among, as, at, [back-] ward, before, by, concerning, + continual, + far more exceeding, for [intent, purpose], fore, + forth, in (among, at unto, -so much that, -to), to the intent that, + of one mind, + never, of, (up-) on, + perish, + set at one again, (so) that, therefore (-unto), throughout, till, to (be, the end, -ward), (here-) until (-to), . . . ward, [where-] fore, with. Often used in composition with the same general import, but only with verbs (etc.) expressing motion (literally or figuratively.

G1520.firstSense: a (-n, -ny, certain), + abundantly, man, one (another), only, other, some
G1520.full: heis hice (Including the neuter [etc.] å̔́í hen); a primary numeral; one: - a (-n, -ny, certain), + abundantly, man, one (another), only, other, some. See also G1527, G3367, G3391, G3762.

G1521.firstSense: bring in (-to), (+ as to) lead into
G1521.full: From G1519 and G71; to introduce (literally or figuratively): - bring in (-to), (+ as to) lead into.

G1522.full: From G1519 and G191; to listen to: - hear.

G1523.full: From G1519 and G1209; to take into one's favor: - receive.

G1524.full: From G1519 and åé̓͂ìé eimi (to go); to enter: - enter (go) into.

G1525.firstSense: X arise, come (in, into), enter in (-to), go in (through)
G1525.full: From G1519 and G2064; to enter (literally or figuratively): - X arise, come (in, into), enter in (-to), go in (through).

G1526.firstSense: agree, are, be, dure, X is, were
G1526.full: Third person plural present indicative of G1510; they are: - agree, are, be, dure, X is, were.

G1527.full: heis kath heis hice kath hice From G1520 repeated with G2596 inserted; severally: - one by one.

G1528.full: From G1519 and G2564; to invite in: - call in.

G1529.full: From G1519 and G3598; an entrance (literally or figuratively): - coming, enter (-ing) in (to).

G1530.full: From G1519 and ðçäá́ù pēdaō (to leap); to rush in: - run (spring) in.

G1531.full: From G1519 and G4198; to enter (literally or figuratively): - come (enter) in, go into.

G1532.full: From G1519 and G5143; to hasten inward: - run in.

G1533.full: From G1519 and G5342; to carry inward (literally or figuratively): - bring (in), lead into.

G1534.full: Of uncertain affinity; a particle of succession (in time or logical enumeration), then, moreover: - after that (-ward), furthermore, then. See also G1899.

G1535.full: From G1487 and G5037; if too: - if, or, whether.

G1536.firstSense: he that, if a (-ny) man ('s thing, from any, ought), whether any, whosoever
G1536.full: ei tis i tis From G1487 and G5100; if any: - he that, if a (-ny) man ('s thing, from any, ought), whether any, whosoever.

G1537.firstSense: after, among, X are, at betwixt (-yond), by (the means of), exceedingly, (+ abundantly…
G1537.full: ek ex ek, ex A primary preposition denoting origin (the point whence motion or action proceeds), from, out (of place, time or cause; literally or figuratively; direct or remote): - after, among, X are, at betwixt (-yond), by (the means of), exceedingly, (+ abundantly above), for (-th), from (among, forth, up), + grudgingly, + heartily, X heavenly, X hereby, + very highly, in, . . . ly, (because, by reason) of, off (from), on, out among (from, of), over, since, X thenceforth, through, X unto, X vehemently, with (-out). Often used in composition, with the same general import; often of completion.

G1538.firstSense: any, both, each (one), every (man, one, woman), particularly
G1538.full: As if a superlative of å̔́êáò hekas (afar); each or every: - any, both, each (one), every (man, one, woman), particularly.

G1539.full: As if from G1538 and G5119; at every time: - always.

G1540.full: Of uncertain affinity; a hundred: - hundred.

G1541.full: From G1540 and G2094; centenarian: - hundred years old.

G1542.full: From G1540 and a presumed derivative of G4111; a hundred times: - hundredfold.

G1543.full: From G1540 and G757; the captain of one hundred men: - centurion.

G1544.firstSense: bring forth, cast (forth, out), drive (out), expel, leave, pluck (pull, take, thrust) o…
G1544.full: From G1537 and G906; to eject (literally or figuratively): - bring forth, cast (forth, out), drive (out), expel, leave, pluck (pull, take, thrust) out, put forth (out), send away (forth, out).

G1545.full: From a compound of G1537 and the base of G939 (meaning to go out); an exit (literally or figuratively): - end, way to escape.

G1546.full: From G1544; ejection, that is, (specifically) a throwing overboard of the cargo: - + lighten the ship.

G1547.full: From G1537 and a form of G1061 (compare G1548); to marry off a daughter: - give in marriage.

G1548.full: From G1537 and G1061; the same as G1547: - give in marriage.

G1549.full: Neuter of a derivative of a compound of G1537 and G1096; a descendant, that is, (specifically) grandchild: - nephew.

G1550.full: From G1537 and G1159; to expend (wholly), that is, (figuratively) exhaust: - spend.

G1551.full: From G1537 and G1209; to accept from some source, that is, (by implication) to await: - expect, look (tarry) for, wait (for).

G1552.full: From G1537 and G1212; wholly evident: - manifest.

G1553.full: From a compound of G1537 and G1218; to emigrate, that is, (figuratively) vacate or quit: - be absent.

G1554.full: From G1537 and G1325; to give forth, that is, (specifically) to lease: - let forth (out).

G1555.full: From G1537 and a compound of G1223 and G2233; to narrate through wholly: - declare.

G1556.full: From G1558; to vindicate, retaliate, punish: - a (re-) venge.

G1557.full: From G1556; vindication, retribution: - (a-, re-) venge (-ance), punishment.

G1558.full: From G1537 and G1349; carrying justice out, that is, a punisher: - a (re-) venger.

G1559.full: From G1537 and G1377; to pursue out, that is, expel or persecute implacably: - persecute.

G1560.full: From G1537 and a derivative of G1325; given out or over, that is, surrendered: - delivered.

G1562.full: From G1537 and the base of G1416; to cause to sink out of, that is, (specifically as of clothing) to divest: - strip, take off from, unclothe.

G1563.full: Of uncertain affinity; there; by extension thither: - there, thither (-ward), (to) yonder (place).

G1564.full: From G1563; thence: - from that place, (from) thence, there.

G1565.firstSense: he, it, the other (same), selfsame, that (same, very), X their, X them, they, this, those
G1565.full: From G1563; that one (or [neuter] thing); often intensified by the article prefixed: - he, it, the other (same), selfsame, that (same, very), X their, X them, they, this, those. See also G3778.

G1567.full: From G1537 and G2212; to search out, that is, (figuratively) investigate, crave, demand, (by Hebraism) worship: - en- (re-) quire, seek after (carefully, diligently).

G1568.full: From G1569; to astonish utterly: - affright, greatly (sore) amaze.

G1569.full: From G1537 and G2285; utterly astounded: - greatly, wondering.

G1570.full: From G1537 and a derivative of G5087; put out, that is, exposed to perish: - cast out.

G1571.full: From G1537 and G2508; to cleanse thoroughly: - purge (out).

G1572.full: From G1537 and G2545; to inflame deeply: - burn.

G1573.full: From G1537 and G2556; to be (bad or) weak, that is, (by implication) to fail (in heart): - faint, be weary.

G1574.full: From G1537 and the base of G2759; to transfix: - pierce.

G1575.full: From G1537 and G2806; to exscind: - break off.

G1576.full: From G1537 and G2808; to shut out (literally or figuratively): - exclude.

G1577.full: From a compound of G1537 and a derivative of G2564; a calling out, that is, (concretely) a popular meeting, especially a religious congregation (Jewish synagogue, or Christian community of members on earth or saints in heaven or both): - assembly, church.

G1578.firstSense: avoid, eschew, go out of the way
G1578.full: From G1537 and G2827; to deviate, that is, (absolutely) to shun (literally or figuratively), or (relatively) to decline (from piety): - avoid, eschew, go out of the way.

G1579.full: From G1537 and G2860; to escape by swimming: - swim out.

G1580.full: From G1537 and G2865; to bear forth (to burial): - carry out.

G1581.firstSense: cut down (off, out), hew down, hinder
G1581.full: From G1537 and G2875; to exscind; figuratively to frustrate: - cut down (off, out), hew down, hinder.

G1582.full: Middle voice from G1537 and G2910; to hang upon the lips of a speaker, that is, listen closely: - be very attentive.

G1583.full: From G1537 and G2980; to divulge: - tell.

G1584.full: From G1537 and G2989; to be resplendent: - shine forth.

G1585.full: Middle voice from G1537 and G2990; to be utterly oblivious of: - forget.

G1586.full: Middle voice from G1537 and G3004 (in its primary sense); to select: - make choice, choose (out), chosen.

G1587.full: From G1537 and G3007; to omit, that is, (by implication) cease (die): - fail.

G1588.full: From G1586; select; by implication favorite: - chosen, elect.

G1589.full: From G1586; (divine) selection (abstractly or concretely): - chosen, election.

G1590.full: From G1537 and G3089; to relax (literally or figuratively): - faint.

G1591.full: From G1537 and the base of G3145; to knead out, that is, (by analogy) to wipe dry: - wipe.

G1592.full: From G1537 and G3456; to sneer outright at: - deride.

G1593.full: From G1537 and G3506; (by analogy) to slip off, that is, quietly withdraw: - convey self away.

G1594.full: From G1537 and G3525; (figuratively) to rouse (oneself) out of stupor: - awake.

G1595.full: Neuter of a derivative from G1635; voluntariness: - willingly.

G1596.full: Adverb from the same as G1595; voluntarily: - wilfully, willingly.

G1597.firstSense: of a long time, of old
G1597.full: From G1537 and G3819; long ago, for a long while: - of a long time, of old.

G1598.full: From G1537 and G3985; to test thoroughly: - tempt.

G1599.full: From G1537 and G3992; to despatch: - send away (forth).

G1600.full: From G1537 and a form of G4072; to fly out, that is, (by analogy) extend: - stretch forth.

G1601.firstSense: be cast, fail, fall (away, off), take none effect
G1601.full: From G1537 and G4098; to drop away; specifically be driven out of one's course; figuratively to lose, become inefficient: - be cast, fail, fall (away, off), take none effect.

G1602.full: From G1537 and G4126; to depart by ship: - sail (away, thence).

G1603.full: From G1537 and G4137; to accomplish entirely: - fulfill.

G1605.full: From G1537 and G4141; to strike with astonishment: - amaze, astonish.

G1606.full: From G1537 and G4154; to expire: - give up the ghost.

G1607.firstSense: come (forth, out of), depart, go (forth, out), issue, proceed (out of)
G1607.full: From G1537 and G4198; to depart, be discharged, proceed, project: - come (forth, out of), depart, go (forth, out), issue, proceed (out of).

G1608.full: From G1537 and G4203; to be utterly unchaste: - give self over to fornication.

G1609.full: From G1537 and G4429; to spit out, that is, (figuratively) spurn: - reject.

G1610.firstSense: pluck up by the root, root up
G1610.full: From G1537 and G4492; to uproot: - pluck up by the root, root up.

G1611.full: From G1839; a displacement of the mind, that is, bewilderment, "ecstasy": - + be amazed, amazement, astonishment, trance.

G1612.full: From G1537 and G4762; to pervert (figuratively): - subvert.

G1613.full: From G1537 and G5015; to disturb wholly: - exceedingly trouble.

G1614.full: From G1537 and ôåé́íù teinō (to stretch); to extend: - cast, put forth, stretch forth (out).

G1615.full: From G1537 and G5055; to complete fully: - finish.

G1617.full: Neuter of the compound of G1618; more intently: - more earnestly.

G1618.full: From G1614; intent: - without ceasing, fervent.

G1620.full: From G1537 and G5087; to expose; figuratively to declare: - cast out, expound.

G1621.full: From G1537 and ôéíá́óóù tinassō (to swing); to shake violently: - shake (off).

G1622.firstSense: but, except (-ed), other than, out of, outside, unless, without
G1622.full: From G1537; the exterior; figuratively (as a preposition) aside from, besides: - but, except (-ed), other than, out of, outside, unless, without.

G1624.firstSense: avoid, turn (aside, out of the way)
G1624.full: From G1537 and the base of G5157; to deflect, that is, turn away (literally or figuratively): - avoid, turn (aside, out of the way).

G1625.full: From G1537 and G5142; to rear up to maturity, that is, (generally) to cherish or train: - bring up, nourish.

G1626.full: From a compound of G1537 and ôéôñù́óêù titrōskō (to wound); a miscarriage (abortion), that is, (by analogy) untimely birth: - born out of due time.

G1627.full: From G1537 and G5342; to bear out (literally or figuratively): - bear, bring forth, carry forth (out).

G1628.full: From G1537 and G5343; to flee out: - escape, flee.

G1629.full: From G1537 and G5399; to frighten utterly: - terrify.

G1630.full: From G1537 and G5401; frightened out of one's wits: - sore afraid, exceedingly fear.

G1631.full: From G1537 and G5453; to sprout up: - put forth.

G1632.firstSense: gush (pour) out, run greedily (out), shed (abroad, forth), spill
G1632.full: From G1537 and ÷ǻù cheō (to pour); to pour forth; figuratively to bestow: - gush (pour) out, run greedily (out), shed (abroad, forth), spill.

G1633.full: From G1537 and G5562; to depart: - depart out.

G1634.full: From G1537 and G5594; to expire: - give (yield) up the ghost.

G1636.full: Feminine of a presumed derivative from an obsolete primary; an olive (the tree or the fruit): - olive (berry, tree).

G1637.full: Neuter of the same as G1636; olive oil: - oil.

G1638.full: From G1636; an olive orchard, that is, (specifically) the Mount of Olives: - Olivet.

G1639.full: Of Hebrew origin [H5867]; an Elamite or Persian: - Elamite.

G1640.full: Compound of the same as G1646; smaller (in size, quantity, age or quality): - less, under, worse, younger.

G1641.full: From G1640; to diminish, that is, fall short: - have lack.

G1642.full: From G1640; to lessen (in rank or influence): - decrease, make lower.

G1643.full: A prolonged form of a primary verb (obsolete except in certain tenses as an alternate of this) of uncertain affinity; to push (as wind, oars or daemoniacal power): - carry, drive, row.

G1644.full: From G1645; levity (figuratively), that is, fickleness: - lightness.

G1645.full: Probably akin to G1643 and the base of G1640; light, that is, easy: - light.

G1646.full: The superlative of å̓́ëá÷õò elachus (short); used as equivalent to G3398; least (in size, amount, dignity, etc.): - least, very little (small), smallest.

G1647.full: Compound of G1646; far less: - less than the least.

G1648.full: Of Hebrew origin [H499]; Eleazar, an Israelite: - Eleazar.

G1649.full: From G1651; refutation, that is, reproof: - rebuke.

G1650.full: From G1651; proof, conviction: - evidence, reproof.

G1651.firstSense: convict, convince, tell a fault, rebuke, reprove
G1651.full: Of uncertain affinity; to confute, admonish: - convict, convince, tell a fault, rebuke, reprove.

G1653.firstSense: have compassion (pity on), have (obtain, receive, shew) mercy (on)
G1653.full: From G1656; to compassionate (by word or deed, specifically by divine grace): - have compassion (pity on), have (obtain, receive, shew) mercy (on).

G1654.full: From G1656; compassionateness, that is, (as exercised towards the poor) beneficence, or (concretely) a benefaction: - alms (-deeds).

G1656.full: Of uncertain affinity; compassion (human or divine, especially active): - (+ tender) mercy.

G1657.full: From G1658; freedom (legitimate or licentious, chiefly moral or ceremonial): - liberty.

G1658.full: Probably from the alternate of G2064; unrestrained (to go at pleasure), that is, (as a citizen) not a slave (whether freeborn or manumitted), or (generally) exempt (from obligation or liability): - free (man, woman), at liberty.

G1659.full: From G1658; to liberate, that is, (figuratively) to exempt (from moral, ceremonial or mortal liability): - deliver, make free.

G1660.full: From the alternate of G2064; an advent: - coming.

G1661.full: From å̓́ëåöáò elephas (an "elephant"); elephantine, that is, (by implication) composed of ivory: - of ivory.

G1662.full: Of Hebrew origin [H471]; Eliakim, an Israelite: - Eliakim.

G1663.full: Of Hebrew origin [H461]; Eliezer, an Israelite: - Eliezer.

G1664.full: Of Hebrew origin ([H410] and [H1935]); God of majesty; Eliud, an Israelite: - Eliud.

G1665.full: Of Hebrew origin [H472]; Elisabet, an Israelitess: - Elisabeth.

G1666.full: Of Hebrew origin [H477]; Elissaeus, an Israelite: - Elissus.

G1667.full: A form of G1507; to coil or wrap: - fold up.

G1668.full: Probably from G1670; an ulcer (as if drawn together): - sore.

G1669.full: From G1668; to cause to ulcerate, that is, (passively) be ulcerous: - full of sores.

G1670.full: Probably akin to G138; to drag (literally or figuratively): - draw. Compare G1667.

G1671.full: Of uncertain affinity; Hellas (or Greece), a country of Europe: - Greece.

G1672.full: From G1671; a Hellen (Grecian) or inhabitant of Hellas; by extension a Greek speaking person, especially a non-Jew: - Gentile, Greek.

G1673.full: From G1672; Hellenic, that is, Grecian (in language): - Greek.

G1674.full: Feminine of G1672; a Grecian (that is, non-Jewish) woman: - Greek.

G1675.full: From a derivative of G1672; a Hellenist or Greek speaking Jew: - Grecian.

G1676.full: Adverb from the same as G1675; Hellenistically, that is, in the Grecian language: - Greek.

G1677.full: From G1722 and G3056 (in the sense of account); to reckon in, that is, attribute: - impute, put on account.

G1678.full: Of Hebrew origin (perhaps for [H486]); Elmodam, an Israelite: - Elmodam.

G1679.full: From G1680; to expect or confide: - (have, thing) hope (-d) (for), trust.

G1680.full: Fromå̓́ëðù elpō which is a primary word (to anticipate, usually with pleasure); expectation (abstract or concrete) or confidence: - faith, hope.

G1681.full: Of foreign origin; Elymas, a wizard: - Elymas.

G1682.full: Of Chaldee origin ([H426] with pronoun suffix); my God: - Eloi.

G1683.full: Genitive, dative and accusative of a compound of G1700 and G846; of myself: - me, mine own (self), myself.

G1684.firstSense: come (get) into, enter (into), go (up) into, step in, take ship
G1684.full: From G1722 and the base of G939; to walk on, that is, embark (aboard a vessel), reach (a pool): - come (get) into, enter (into), go (up) into, step in, take ship.

G1685.full: From G1722 and G906; to throw on, that is, (figuratively) subject to (eternal punishment): - cast into.

G1686.full: From G1722 and G911; to whelm on, that is, wet (a part of the person, etc.) by contact with a fluid: - dip.

G1687.full: From G1722 and a presumed derivative of the base of G939; equivalent to G1684; to intrude on (figuratively): - intrude into.

G1688.full: From G1722 and âéâá́æù bibazō (to mount; causative of G1684); to place on, that is, transfer (aboard a vessel): - put in.

G1689.firstSense: behold, gaze up, look upon, (could) see
G1689.full: From G1722 and G991; to look on, that is, (relatively) to observe fixedly, or (absolutely) to discern clearly: - behold, gaze up, look upon, (could) see.

G1690.full: From G1722 and âñéìá́ïìáé brimaomai (to snort with anger); to have indignation on, that is, (transitively) to blame, (intransitively) to sigh with chagrin, (specifically) to sternly enjoin: - straitly charge, groan, murmur against.

G1691.full: A prolonged form of G3165; me: - I, me, my (-self).

G1692.full: Of uncertain affinity; to vomit: - (will) spue.

G1693.full: From G1722 and G3105; to rave on, that is, rage at: - be mad against.

G1694.full: Of Hebrew origin [H6005]; God with us; Emmanuel, a name of Christ: - Emmanuel.

G1695.full: Probably of Hebrew origin (compare [H3222]); Emmaus, a place in Palestine: - Emmaus.

G1696.full: From G1722 and G3306; to stay in the same place, that is, (figuratively) to persevere: - continue.

G1697.full: Of Hebrew origin [H2544]; Emmor (that is, Chamor), a Canaanite: - Emmor.

G1698.full: A prolonged form of G3427; to me: - I, me, mine, my.

G1699.full: From the oblique cases of G1473 (G1698, G1700, G1691); my: - of me, mine (own), my.

G1700.full: A prolonged form of G3449; of me: - me, mine, my.

G1702.full: From G1722 and G3815; to jeer at, that is, deride: - mock.

G1703.full: From G1702; a derider, that is, (by implication) a false teacher: - mocker, scoffer.

G1704.full: From G1722 and G4043; to perambulate on a place, that is, (figuratively) to be occupied among persons: - walk in.

G1705.full: From G1722 and the base of G4118; to fill in (up), that is, (by implication) to satisfy (literally or figuratively): - fill.

G1706.full: From G1722 and G4098; to fall on, that is, (literally) be entrapped by, or (figuratively) be overwhelmed with: - fall among (into).

G1707.full: From G1722 and G4120; to entwine, that is, (figuratively) involve with: - entangle (in, self with).

G1708.full: From G1707; elaborate braiding of the hair: - plaiting.

G1709.full: From G1722 and G4154; to inhale, that is, (figuratively) to be animated by (bent upon): - breathe.

G1710.full: From G1722 and G4198; to travel in (a country as a pedlar), that is, (by implication) to trade: - buy and sell, make merchandise.

G1712.full: Neuter from G1713; a mart ("emporium"): - merchandise.

G1713.full: From G1722 and the base of G4198; a (wholesale) tradesman: - merchant.

G1714.full: From G1722 and ðñḉèù prēthō (to blow a flame); to enkindle, that is, set on fire: - burn up.

G1715.firstSense: against, at, before, (in presence, sight) of
G1715.full: From G1722 and G4314; in front of (in place [literally or figuratively] or time): - against, at, before, (in presence, sight) of.

G1716.full: From G1722 and G4429; to spit at or on: - spit (upon).

G1717.full: From a compound of G1722 and G5316; apparent in self: - manifest, openly.

G1718.firstSense: appear, declare (plainly), inform, (will) manifest, shew, signify
G1718.full: From G1717; to exhibit (in person) or disclose (by words): - appear, declare (plainly), inform, (will) manifest, shew, signify.

G1719.full: From G1722 and G5401; in fear, that is, alarmed: - affrighted, afraid, tremble.

G1720.full: From G1722 and öõóá́ù phusaō (to puff; compare G5453); to blow at or on: - breathe on.

G1721.full: From G1722 and a derivative of G5453; implanted (figuratively): - engrafted.

G1722.firstSense: about, after, against, + almost, X altogether, among, X as, at, before, between, (here-…
G1722.full: en en A primary preposition denoting (fixed) position (in place, time or state), and (by implication) instrumentality (medially or constructively), that is, a relation of rest (intermediate between G1519 and G1537); "in", at, (up-) on, by, etc.: - about, after, against, + almost, X altogether, among, X as, at, before, between, (here-) by (+ all means), for (. . . sake of), + give self wholly to, (here-) in (-to, -wardly), X mightily, (because) of, (up-) on, [open-] ly, X outwardly, one, X quickly, X shortly, [speedi-] ly, X that, X there (-in, -on), through (-out), (un-) to(-ward), under, when, where (-with), while, with (-in). Often used in compounds, with substantially the same import; rarely with verbs of motion, and then not to indicate direction, except (elliptically) by a separate (and different) prep.

G1723.full: From G1722 and a derivative of G43; to take in one's arms, that is, embrace: - take up in arms.

G1724.full: From G1722 and G251; in the sea, that is, marine: - thing in the sea.

G1725.full: From G1722 and G473; in front (that is, figuratively presence) of: - before.

G1726.full: Neuter of G1727; (adverb) in the presence (view) of: - before, in the presence of.

G1727.full: From G1725; opposite; figuratively antagonistic: - (over) against, contrary.

G1728.full: From G1722 and G756; to commence on: - rule [by mistake for G757].

G1729.full: From a compound of G1722 and G1210 (in the sense of lacking); deficient in: - lacking.

G1730.full: From G1731; an indication (concretely): - manifest token.

G1731.full: From G1722 and G1166; to indicate (by word or act): - do, show (forth).

G1732.full: From G1731; indication (abstractly): - declare, evident token, proof.

G1733.full: From (the neuter of) G1520 and G1176; one and ten, that is, eleven: - eleven.

G1735.full: Third person singular present of a compound of G1722 and G1209; (impersonally) it is accepted in, that is, admitted (possible): - can (+ not) be.

G1736.full: From a compound of G1722 and G1218; to be in one's own country, that is, home (figuratively): - be at home (present).

G1737.full: A prolonged form of G1746; to invest (with a garment): - clothe in, wear.

G1738.full: From G1722 and G1349; in the right, that is, equitable: - just.

G1739.full: From a compound of G1722 and a derivative of the base of G1218; a housing in (residence), that is, structure: - building.

G1741.full: From G1722 and G1391; in glory, that is, splendid, (figuratively) noble: - glorious, gorgeous [-ly], honourable.

G1742.full: From G1746; apparel (especially the outer robe): - clothing, garment, raiment.

G1743.full: From G1722 and G1412; to empower: - enable, (increase in) strength (-en), be (make) strong.

G1744.full: From G1722 and G1416; to sink (by implication wrap (compare G1746)) on, that is, (figuratively) sneak: - creep.

G1745.full: From G1746; investment with clothing: - putting on.

G1746.full: From G1722 and G1416 (in the senese of sinking into a garment); to invest with clothing (literally or figuratively): - array, clothe (with), endue, have (put) on.

G1747.full: Feminine from G1722 and the base of G1476; an ambuscade, that is, (figuratively) murderous purpose: - lay wait. See also G1749.

G1748.full: From G1747; to lurk, that is, (figuratively) plot assassination: - lay wait for.

G1749.full: Neuter of the same as G1747; an ambush, that is, (figuratively) murderous design: - lying in wait.

G1750.full: From G1722 and the base of G1507; to enwrap: - wrap in.

G1751.full: From G1722 and G1510; to be within (neuter participle plural): - such things as . . . have. See also G1762.

G1752.firstSense: because, for (cause, sake), (where-) fore, by reason of, that
G1752.full: Of uncertain affinity; on account of: - because, for (cause, sake), (where-) fore, by reason of, that.

G1753.full: From G1756; efficiency ("energy"): - operation, strong, (effectual) working.

G1754.firstSense: do, (be) effectual (fervent), be mighty in, shew forth self, work (effectually in)
G1754.full: From G1756; to be active, efficient: - do, (be) effectual (fervent), be mighty in, shew forth self, work (effectually in).

G1755.full: From G1754; an effect: - operation, working.

G1756.full: From G1722 and G2041; active, operative: - effectual, powerful.

G1757.full: From G1722 and G2127; to confer a benefit on: - bless.

G1758.firstSense: entangle with, have a quarrel against, urge
G1758.full: From G1722 and G2192; to hold in or upon, that is, ensnare; by implication to keep a grudge: - entangle with, have a quarrel against, urge.

G1759.full: From a prolonged form of G1722; properly within, that is, (of place) here, hither: - (t-) here, hither.

G1760.full: From a compound of G1722 and G2372; to be inspirited, that is, ponder: - think.

G1762.full: Contracted for third person singular present indicative of G1751; impersonally there is in or among: - be, (there) is.

G1763.full: Prolonged from a primary word å̓́íïò enos (a year); a year: - year.

G1764.full: From G1722 and G2476; to place on hand, that is, (reflexively) impend, (participle) be instant: - come, be at hand, present.

G1765.full: From G1722 and G2480; to invigorate (transitively or reflexively): - strengthen.

G1768.full: From a (tenth) multiple of G1767 and G1767 itself; ninety nine: - ninety and nine.

G1769.full: From G1770; dumb (as making signs), that is, silent from astonishment: - speechless.

G1770.full: From G1722 and G3506; to nod at, that is, beckon or communicate by gesture: - make signs.

G1771.full: From a compound of G1722 and G3563; thoughtfulness, that is, moral understanding: - intent, mind.

G1772.full: From G1722 and G3551; (subjectively) legal, or (objectively) subject to: - lawful, under law.

G1773.full: Neuter of a compound of G1722 and G3571; (adverbially) by night: - before day.

G1774.full: From G1722 and G3611; to inhabit (figuratively): - dwell in.

G1775.full: From G1520; oneness, that is, (figuratively) unanimity: - unity.

G1776.full: From G1722 and G3791; to crowd in, that is, (figuratively) to annoy: - trouble.

G1777.firstSense: in danger of, guilty of, subject to
G1777.full: From G1758; liable to (a condition, penalty or imputation): - in danger of, guilty of, subject to.

G1778.full: From G1781; an injunction, that is, religious precept: - commandment.

G1779.full: From a compound of G1722 and G5028; to inswathe with cerements for interment: - bury.

G1780.full: From G1779; preparation for interment: - burying.

G1781.full: From G1722 and the base of G5056; to enjoin: - (give) charge, (give) command(-ments), injoin.

G1782.full: From the same as G1759; hence (literally or figuratively); (repeated) on both sides: - (from) hence, on either side.

G1783.full: From G1793; an interview, that is, (specifically) supplication: - intercession, prayer.

G1784.firstSense: dear, more honourable, precious, in reputation
G1784.full: From G1722 and G5092; valued (figuratively): - dear, more honourable, precious, in reputation.

G1785.full: From G1781; injunction, that is, an authoritative prescription: - commandment, precept.

G1786.full: From G1722 and G5117; a resident: - of that place.

G1787.full: From G1722; inside (adverb or noun): - within.

G1788.full: From G1722 and the base of G5157; to invert, that is, (figuratively and reflexively) in a good sense, to respect; or in a bad one, to confound: - regard, (give) reverence, shame.

G1789.full: From G1722 and G5142; (figuratively) to educate: - nourish up in.

G1790.full: From G1722 and G5156; terrified: - X quake, X trembled.

G1792.full: From G1722 and G5171; to revel in: - sporting selves.

G1793.full: From G1722 and G5177; to chance upon, that is, (by implication) confer with; by extension to entreat (in favor or against): - deal with, make intercession.

G1794.full: From G1722 andôõëé́óóù tulissō (to twist; probably akin to G1507); to entwine, that is, wind up in: - wrap in (together).

G1795.full: From G1722 and a derivative of G5179; to enstamp, that is, engrave: - engrave.

G1796.full: From G1722 and G5195; to insult: - do despite unto.

G1797.full: Middle voice from G1798; to dream: - dream (-er).

G1798.full: From G1722 and G5258; something seen in sleep, that is, a dream (vision in a dream): - dream.

G1799.firstSense: before, in the presence (sight) of, to
G1799.full: Neuter of a compound of G1722 and a derivation of G3700; in the face of (literally or figuratively): - before, in the presence (sight) of, to.

G1800.full: Of Hebrew origin [H583]; Enos (that is, Enosh), a patriarch: - Enos.

G1801.full: Middle voice from a compound of G1722 and G3775; to take in one's ear, that is, to listen: - hearken.

G1802.full: Of Hebrew origin [H2585]; Enoch (that is, Chanok), an antediluvian: - Enoch.

G1803.full: hex hex A primary numeral; six: - six.

G1804.full: From G1537 and the base of G32; to publish, that is, celebrate: - shew forth.

G1805.full: From G1537 and G59; to buy up, that is, ransom; figuratively to rescue from loss (improve opportunity): - redeem.

G1806.full: From G1537 and G71; to lead forth: - bring forth (out), fetch (lead) out.

G1807.full: From G1537 and G138; active voice to tear out; middle voice to select; figuratively to release: - deliver, pluck out, rescue.

G1808.full: From G1537 and G142; to remove: - put (take) away.

G1809.full: Middle voice from G1537 and G154; to demand (for trial): - desire.

G1810.full: From G1537 and the base of G160; of a sudden (unexpectedly): - suddenly. Compare G1819.

G1811.full: From G1537 and G190; to follow out, that is, (figuratively) to imitate, obey, yield to: - follow.

G1812.full: Plural ordinal from G1803 and G1540; six hundred: - six hundred.

G1813.full: From G1537 and G218; to smear out, that is, obliterate (erase tears, figuratively pardon sin): - blot out, wipe away.

G1814.full: From G1537 and G242; to spring forth: - leap up.

G1815.full: From G1817; a rising from death: - resurrection.

G1816.full: From G1537 and G393; to start up out of the ground, that is, germinate: - spring up.

G1817.full: From G1537 and G450; objectively to produce, that is, (figuratively) beget; subjectively to arise, that is, (figuratively) object: - raise (rise) up.

G1818.full: From G1537 and G538; to seduce wholly: - beguile, deceive.

G1819.full: From G1537 and a derivative of the same as G160; of a sudden, that is, unexpectedly: - suddenly. Compare G1810.

G1820.full: Middle voice from G1537 and G639; to be utterly at a loss, that is, despond: - (in) despair.

G1821.full: From G1537 and G649; to send away forth, that is, (on a mission) to despatch, or (peremptorily) to dismiss: - send (away, forth, out).

G1822.full: From G1537 and a derivative of G739; to finish out (time); figuratively to equip fully (a teacher): - accomplish, thoroughly furnish.

G1823.full: From G1537 and G797; to lighten forth, that is, (figuratively) to be radiant (of very white garments): - glistening.

G1824.firstSense: by and by, immediately, presently, straightway
G1824.full: From G1537 and the genitive singular feminine of G846 (G5610 being understood); from that hour, that is, instantly: - by and by, immediately, presently, straightway.

G1825.full: From G1537 and G1453; to rouse fully, that is, (figuratively) to resuscitate (from death), release (from infliction): - raise up.

G1826.full: From G1537 and åé̓͂ìé eimi (to go); to issue, that is, leave (a place), escape (to the shore): - depart, get [to land], go out.

G1827.full: From G1537 and G1651; to convict fully, that is, (by implication) to punish: - convince.

G1828.full: From G1537 and G1670; to drag forth, that is, (figuratively) to entice (to sin): - draw away.

G1829.full: From a compound of G1537 and a presumed form of å̓ñáù eraō (to spue); vomit, that is, food disgorged: - vomit.

G1830.full: From G1537 and G2045; to explore (figuratively): - search diligently.

G1831.firstSense: come-(forth, out), depart (out of), escape, get out, go (abroad, away, forth, out, then…
G1831.full: From G1537 and G2064; to issue (literally or figuratively): - come-(forth, out), depart (out of), escape, get out, go (abroad, away, forth, out, thence), proceed (forth), spread abroad.

G1832.full: Third person singular present indicative of a compound of G1537 and G1510; so also å̓îḯí exon; neuter present participle of the same (with or without some form of G1510 expressed); impersonally it is right (through the figurative idea of being out in public): - be lawful, let, X may (-est).

G1833.full: From G1537 and å̓ôá́æù etazō (to examine); to test thoroughly (by questions), that is, ascertain or interrogate: - ask, enquire, search.

G1834.full: From G1537 and G2233; to consider out (aloud), that is, rehearse, unfold: - declare, tell.

G1835.full: The tenth multiple of G1803; sixty: - sixty [-fold], threescore.

G1836.full: From G2192 (in the sense of taking hold of, that is, adjoining); successive: - after, following, X morrow, next.

G1837.full: Middle voice from G1537 and G2278; to "echo" forth, that is, resound (be generally reported): - sound forth.

G1838.full: From G2192; habit, that is, (by implication) practice: - use.

G1839.firstSense: amaze, be (make) astonished, be beside self (selves), bewitch, wonder
G1839.full: From G1537 and G2476; to put (stand) out of wits, that is, astound, or (reflexively) become astounded, insane: - amaze, be (make) astonished, be beside self (selves), bewitch, wonder.

G1840.full: From G1537 and G2480; to have full strength, that is, be entirely competent: - be able.

G1841.full: From G1537 and G3598; an exit, that is, (figuratively) death: - decease, departing.

G1842.full: From G1537 and G3645; to extirpate: - destroy.

G1843.full: From G1537 and G3670; to acknowledge or (by implication of assent) agree fully: - confess, profess, promise.

G1844.full: From G1537 and G3726; to exact an oath, that is, conjure: - adjure.

G1845.full: From G1844; one that binds by an oath (or spell), that is, (by implication) an "exorcist" (conjurer): - exorcist.

G1846.full: From G1537 and G3736; to dig out, that is, (by extension) to extract (an eye), remove (a roofing): - break up, pluck out.

G1847.full: From G1537 and a derivative of the neuter of G3762; to make utterly nothing of, that is, despise: - set at nought. See also G1848.

G1848.firstSense: contemptible, despise, least esteemed, set at nought
G1848.full: A variation of G1847 and meaning the same: - contemptible, despise, least esteemed, set at nought.

G1849.firstSense: authority, jurisdiction, liberty, power, right, strength
G1849.full: From G1832 (in the sense of ability); privilege, that is, (subjectively) force, capacity, competency, freedom, or (objectively) mastery (concretely magistrate, superhuman, potentate, token of control), delegated influence: - authority, jurisdiction, liberty, power, right, strength.

G1850.firstSense: exercise authority upon, bring under the (have) power of
G1850.full: From G1849; to control: - exercise authority upon, bring under the (have) power of.

G1851.full: From a compound of G1537 and G2192 (meaning to stand out); prominence (figuratively): - principal.

G1852.full: From G1853; to waken: - awake out of sleep.

G1853.full: From G1537 and G5258; awake: - X out of sleep.

G1854.full: Adverb from G1537; out (side, of doors), literally or figuratively: - away, forth, (with-) out (of, -ward), strange.

G1856.full: From G1537 and ù̓èǻù ōtheō (to push); to expel; by implication to propel: - drive out, thrust in.

G1858.full: From G1859; to observe a festival: - keep the feast.

G1859.full: Of uncertain affinity; a festival: - feast, holyday.

G1860.full: From G1861; an announcement (for information, assent or pledge; especially a divine assurance of good): - message, promise.

G1861.full: From G1909 and the base of G32; to announce upon (reflexively), that is, (by implication) to engage to do something, to assert something respecting oneself: - profess, (make) promise.

G1862.full: From G1861; a self committal (by assurance of conferring some good): - promise.

G1863.full: From G1909 and G71; to superinduce, that is, inflict (an evil), charge (a crime): - bring upon.

G1864.full: From G1909 and G75; to struggle for: - earnestly contend for.

G1865.full: From G1909 and á̓èñïé́æù athroizō (to assemble); to accumulate: - gather thick together.

G1866.full: From G1867; praised; Epaenetus, a Christian: - Epenetus.

G1867.full: From G1909 and G134; to applaud: - commend, laud, praise.

G1868.full: From G1909 and the base of G134; laudation; concretely a commendable thing: - praise.

G1869.full: From G1909 and G142; to raise up (literally or figuratively): - exalt self, poise (lift, take) up.

G1870.full: From G1909 and G153; to feel shame for something: - be ashamed.

G1871.full: From G1909 and G154; to ask for: - beg.

G1872.full: From G1909 and G190; to accompany: - follow (after).

G1873.full: From G1909 and G191; to hearken (favorably) to: - hear.

G1874.full: From G1909 and the base of G202; to listen (intently) to: - hear.

G1875.full: From G1909 and G302; a particle of indefinite contemporaneousnes; whenever, as soon as: - when.

G1876.full: Neuter of a presumed compound of G1909 and G318; (adverb) on necessity, that is, necessarily: - necessary.

G1877.full: From G1909 and G321; to lead up on, that is, (technically) to put out (to sea); (intransitively) to return: - launch (thrust) out, return.

G1878.full: From G1909 and G363; to remind of: - put in mind.

G1879.full: Middle voice from G1909 and G373; to settle on; literally (remain) or figuratively (rely): - rest in (upon).

G1880.full: From G1909 and G424; to come up on, that is, return: - come again, return.

G1881.full: Middle voice from G1909 and G450; to stand up on, that is, (figuratively) to attack: - rise up against.

G1882.full: From a compound of G1909 and G461; a straightening up again, that is, (figuratively) rectification (reformation): - correction.

G1883.full: From G1909 and G507; up above, that is, over or on (of place, amount, rank, etc.): - above, more than, (up-) on, over.

G1884.full: From G1909 and G714; to avail for, that is, help: - relieve.

G1885.full: From a compound of G1909 and G757 (meaning a governor of a district, "eparch"); a special region of government, that is, a Roman praefecture: - province.

G1886.firstSense: From G1909 and an equivalent of G833
G1886.full: From G1909 and an equivalent of G833; a hut over the head, that is, a dwelling.

G1887.full: From G1909 and G839; occuring on the succeeding day, that is, (G2250 being implied) tomorrow: - day following, morrow, next day (after).

G1888.full: From G1909 and G846 and (the dative singular of) a derivative of öù́ñ phōr (a thief); in theft itself, that is, (by analogy) in actual crime: - in the very act.

G1889.full: Contracted from G1891; Epaphras, a Christian: - Epaphras.

G1890.full: From G1909 and G875; to foam upon, that is, (figuratively) to exhibit (a vile passion): - foam out.

G1891.full: From G1909 (in the sense of devoted to) and Á̓öñïäé́ôç Aphroditē (Venus); Epaphroditus, a Christian: - Epaphroditus. Compare G1889.

G1892.full: From G1909 and G1453; to rouse upon, that is, (figuratively) to excite against: - raise, stir up.

G1893.firstSense: because, else, for that (then, -asmuch as), otherwise, seeing that, since, when
G1893.full: From G1909 and G1487; there upon, that is, since (of time or cause): - because, else, for that (then, -asmuch as), otherwise, seeing that, since, when.

G1894.firstSense: after that, because, for, (that, -asmuch as), seeing, since
G1894.full: From G1893 and G1211; since now, that is, (of time) when, or (of cause) whereas: - after that, because, for, (that, -asmuch as), seeing, since.

G1895.full: From G1894 and G4007; since indeed (of cause): - forasmuch.

G1896.full: From G1909 and G1492; to regard (favorably or otherwise): - behold, look upon.

G1897.full: From G1893 and G4007; since indeed (of cause): - seeing.

G1898.full: From a compound of G1909 and G1521; a superintroduction: - bringing in.

G1899.full: From G1909 nad G1534; thereafter: - after that (-ward), then.

G1900.full: From G1909 and (the accusative plural neuter of) G1565; upon those parts of, that is, on the further side of: - beyond.

G1901.full: Middle voice from G1909 and G1614; to stretch (oneself) forward upon: - reach forth.

G1902.full: Middle voice from G1909 and G1746; to invest upon oneself: - be clothed upon.

G1903.full: From G1902; a wrapper, that is, outer garment: - fisher's coat.

G1904.full: From G1909 and G2064; to supervene, that is, arrive, occur, impend, attack, (figuratively) influence: - come (in, upon).

G1905.full: From G1909 and G2065; to ask for, that is, inquire, seek: - ask (after, questions), demand, desire, question.

G1907.firstSense: give (take) heed unto, hold forth, mark, stay
G1907.full: From G1909 and G2192; to hold upon, that is, (by implication) to retain; (by extension) to detain; (with implication of G3563) to pay attention to: - give (take) heed unto, hold forth, mark, stay.

G1908.full: From a compound of G1909 and (probably) á̓ñåéá́ areia (threats); to insult, slander: - use despitefully, falsely accuse.

G1909.firstSense: about (the times), above, after, against, among, as long as (touching), at, beside, X h…
G1909.full: A primary preposition properly meaning superimposition (of time, place, order, etc.), as a relation of distribution [with the genitive case], that is, over, upon, etc.; of rest (with the dative case) at, on, etc.; of direction (with the accusative case) towards, upon, etc.: - about (the times), above, after, against, among, as long as (touching), at, beside, X have charge of, (be-, [where-]) fore, in (a place, as much as, the time of, -to), (because) of, (up-) on (behalf of) over, (by, for) the space of, through (-out), (un-) to (-ward), with. In compounds it retains essentially the same import, at, upon, etc. (literally or figuratively).

G1910.firstSense: come (into), enter into, go aboard, sit upon, take ship
G1910.full: From G1909 and the base of G939; to walk upon, that is, mount, ascend, embark, arrive: - come (into), enter into, go aboard, sit upon, take ship.

G1911.firstSense: beat into, cast (up-), on, fall, lay (on), put (unto), stretch forth, think on
G1911.full: From G1909 and G906; to throw upon (literally or figuratively, transitively or reflexively; usually with more or less force); specifically (with G1438 implied) to reflect; impersonally to belong to: - beat into, cast (up-), on, fall, lay (on), put (unto), stretch forth, think on.

G1912.full: From G1909 and G916; to be heavy upon, that is, (pecuniarily) to be expensive to; figuratively to be severe towards: - be chargeable to, overcharge.

G1913.full: From G1909 and a reduplicated derivation of the base of G939 (compare G307); to cause to mount (an animal): - set on.

G1914.firstSense: look upon, regard, have respect to
G1914.full: From G1909 and G991; to gaze at (with favor, pity or partiality): - look upon, regard, have respect to.

G1916.full: From G1909 and G994; to exclaim against: - cry.

G1917.full: From a presumed compound of G1909 and G1014; a plan against someone, that is, a plot: - laying (lying) in wait.

G1918.full: From G1909 and a derivative of G1062; to form affinity with, that is, (specifically) in a levirate way: - marry.

G1919.full: From G1909 and G1093; worldly (physically or morally): - earthly, in earth, terrestrial.

G1920.full: From G1909 and G1096; to arrive upon, that is, spring up (as a wind): - blow.

G1921.full: From G1909 and G1097; to know upon some mark, that is, recognise; by implication to become fully acquainted with, to acknowledge: - (ac-, have, take) know (-ledge, well), perceive.

G1922.full: From G1921; recognition, that is, (by implication) full discernment, acknowledgement: - (ac-) knowledge (-ing, -ment).

G1924.full: From G1909 and G1125; to inscribe (physically or mentally): - inscription, write in (over, thereon).

G1925.full: From G1909 and G1166; to exhibit (physically or mentally): - shew.

G1926.full: From G1909 and G1209; to admit (as a guest or [figuratively] teacher): - receive.

G1927.full: From a compound of G1909 and G1218; to make oneself at home, that is, (by extension) to reside (in a foreign country): - [be] dwelling (which were) there, stranger.

G1928.full: Middle voice from G1909 and G1299; to appoint besides, that is, supplement (as a codicil): - add to.

G1929.firstSense: deliver unto, give, let (+ [her drive]), offer
G1929.full: From G1909 and G1325; to give over (by hand or surrender): - deliver unto, give, let (+ [her drive]), offer.

G1930.full: From G1909 and a derivative of G3717; to straighten further, that is, (figuratively) arrange additionally: - set in order.

G1931.full: From G1909 and G1416; to set fully (as the sun): - go down.

G1932.full: From G1933; suitableness, that is, (by implication) equity, mildness: - clemency, gentleness.

G1933.full: From G1909 and G1503; appropriate, that is, (by implication) mild: - gentle, moderation, patient.

G1934.full: From G1909 and G2212; to search (inquire) for; intensively to demand, to crave: - desire, enquire, seek (after, for).

G1935.full: From G1909 and G2288; doomed to death: - appointed to death.

G1936.full: From G2007; an imposition (of hands officially): - laying (putting) on.

G1937.full: From G1909 and G2372; to set the heart upon, that is, long for (rightfully or otherwise): - covet, desire, would fain, lust (after).

G1938.full: From G1937; a craver: - + lust after.

G1939.full: From G1937; a longing (especially for what is forbidden): - concupiscence, desire, lust (after).

G1940.full: From G1909 and G2523; to seat upon: - set on.

G1941.full: Middle voice from G1909 and G2564; to entitle; by implication to invoke (for aid, worship, testimony, decision, etc.): - appeal (unto), call (on, upon), surname.

G1942.full: From G1943; a covering, that is, (figuratively) pretext: - cloke.

G1943.full: From G1909 and G2572; to conceal, that is, (figuratively) forgive: - cover.

G1944.full: From G1909 and a derivative of G2672; imprecated, that is, execrable: - accursed.

G1945.firstSense: impose, be instant, (be) laid (there-, up-) on, (when) lay (on), lie (on), press upon
G1945.full: From G1909 and G2749; to rest upon (literally or figuratively): - impose, be instant, (be) laid (there-, up-) on, (when) lay (on), lie (on), press upon.

G1946.full: From Å̓ðé́êïõñïò Epikouros (compare G1947; a noted philosopher); an Epicurean or follower of Epicurus: - Epicurean.

G1947.full: From a compound of G1909 and a (prolonged) form of the base of G2877 (in the sense of servant); assistance: - help.

G1948.full: From G1909 and G2919; to adjudge: - give sentence.

G1949.firstSense: catch, lay hold (up-) on, take (by, hold of, on)
G1949.full: Middle voice from G1909 and G2983; to seize (for help, injury, attainment or any other purpose; literally or figuratively): - catch, lay hold (up-) on, take (by, hold of, on).

G1950.full: Middle voice from G1909 and G2990; to lose out of mind; by implication to neglect: - (be) forget (-ful of).

G1951.full: Middle voice from G1909 and G3004; to surname, select: - call, choose.

G1952.full: From G1909 and G3007; to leave upon, that is, (figuratively) to be insufficient for: - fall.

G1953.full: From a derivative of G1950; negligence: - X forgetful.

G1954.full: From G1909 and G3062; left over, that is, remaining: - rest.

G1955.full: From G1956; explanation, that is, application: - interpretation.

G1956.full: From G1909 and G3089; to solve further, that is, (figuratively) to explain, decide: - determine, expound.

G1957.full: From G1909 and G3140; to attest further, that is, corroborate: - testify.

G1958.full: From G1959; carefulness, that is, kind attention (hospitality): - + refresh self.

G1959.full: Middle voice from G1909 and the same as G3199; to care for (physically or otherwise): - take care of.

G1960.full: Adverb from a derivative of G1959; carefully: - diligently.

G1961.full: From G1909 and G3306; to stay over, that is, remain (figuratively persevere): - abide (in), continue (in), tarry.

G1962.full: From G1909 and G3506; to nod at, that is, (by implication) to assent: - consent.

G1963.full: From G1909 and G3563; attention of the mind, that is, (by implication) purpose: - thought.

G1964.full: From G1965; to commit perjury: - forswear self.

G1965.full: From G1909 and G3727; on oath, that is, (falsely) a forswearer: - perjured person.

G1966.full: Feminine singular participle of a compound of G1909 and åé̔͂ìé heimi (to go); supervening, that is, (G2250 or G3571 being expressed or implied) the ensuing day or night: - following, next.

G1967.full: Perhaps from the same as G1966; to-morrow's; but more probably from G1909 and a derivative of the present participle feminine of G1510; for subsistence, that is, needful: - daily.

G1968.firstSense: fall into (on, upon), lie on, press upon
G1968.full: From G1909 and G4098; to embrace (with affection) or seize (with more or less violence; literally or figuratively): - fall into (on, upon), lie on, press upon.

G1969.full: From G1909 and G4141; to chastise, that is, (with words) to upbraid: - rebuke.

G1970.full: From G1909 and G4155; to throttle upon, that is, (figuratively) overgrow: - choke.

G1971.full: From G1909 and ðïèǻù potheō (to yearn); to dote upon, that is, intensely crave possession (lawfully or wrongfully): - (earnestly) desire (greatly), (greatly) long (after), lust.

G1972.full: From G1971; a longing for: - earnest (vehement) desire.

G1973.full: From G1909 and a derivative of the latter part of G1971; yearned upon, that is, greatly loved: - longed for.

G1974.full: From G1971; intense longing: - great desire.

G1975.full: From G1909 and G4198; to journey further, that is, travel on (reach): - come.

G1976.full: From G1909 and the base of G4476; to stitch upon, that is, fasten with the needle: - sew on.

G1977.full: From G1909 and G4496; to throw upon (literally or figuratively): - cast upon.

G1978.full: From G1909 and some form of the base of G4591; remarkable, that is, (figuratively) eminent: - notable, of note.

G1979.full: From a compound of G1909 and a derivative of G4621; a provisioning, that is, (concretely) food: - victuals.

G1980.full: ep-ee-skep'-tom-ahee; Middle voice from G1909 and the base of G4649; to inspect, that is, (by implication) to select; by extension to go to see, relieve: - look out, visit.

G1981.full: From G1909 and G4637; to tent upon, that is, (figuratively) abide with: - rest upon.

G1982.full: From G1909 and a derivative of G4639; to cast a shade upon, that is, (by analogy) to envelop in a haze of brilliancy; figuratively to invest with preternatural influence: - overshadow.

G1983.full: From G1909 and G4648; to oversee; by implication to beware: - look diligently, take the oversight.

G1984.firstSense: the office of a "bishop", bishoprick, visitation
G1984.full: From G1980; inspection (for relief); by implication superintendence; specifically the Christian "episcopate": - the office of a "bishop", bishoprick, visitation.

G1985.full: From G1909 and G4649 (in the sense of G1983); a superintendent, that is, Christian officer in general charge of a (or the) church (literally or figuratively): - bishop, overseer.

G1986.full: From G1909 and G4685; to draw over, that is, (with G203 implied) efface the mark of circumcision (by recovering with the foreskin): - become uncircumcised.

G1987.full: Apparently a middle voice of G2186 (with G3563 implied); to put the mind upon, that is, comprehend, or be acquainted with: - know, understand.

G1988.full: From G1909 and a presumed derivative of G2476; an appointee over, that is, commander (teacher): - master.

G1989.full: From G1909 and G4724; to enjoin (by writing), that is, (generally) to communicate by letter (for any purpose): - write (a letter, unto).

G1990.full: From G1987; intelligent: - endued with knowledge.

G1991.full: From G1909 and G4741; to support further, that is, reestablish: - confirm, strengthen.

G1992.full: From G1989; a written message: - "epistle", letter.

G1993.full: From G1909 and G4750; to put something over the mouth, that is, (figuratively) to silence: - stop mouths.

G1994.full: From G1909 and G4762; to revert (literally, figuratively or morally): - come (go) again, convert, (re-) turn (about, again).

G1995.full: From G1994; reversion, that is, moral revolution: - conversion.

G1996.full: From G1909 and G4863; to collect upon the same place: - gather (together).

G1997.full: From G1996; a complete collection; specifically a Christian meeting (for worship): - assembling (gathering) together.

G1998.full: From G1909 and G4936; to hasten together upon one place (or a particular occasion): - come running together.

G1999.firstSense: that which cometh upon, + raising up
G1999.full: From the middle of a compound of G1909 and G4921; a conspiracy, that is, concourse (riotous or friendly): - that which cometh upon, + raising up.

G2000.full: From a compound of G1909 and óöá́ëëù sphallō (to trip); figuratively insecure: - dangerous.

G2001.full: From G1909 and G2480; to avail further, that is, (figuratively) insist stoutly: - be the more fierce.

G2002.full: From G1909 and G4987; to accumulate further, that is, (figuratively) seek additionally: - heap.

G2003.full: From G2004; an injunction or decree; by implication authoritativeness: - authority, commandment.

G2004.full: From G1909 and G5021; to arrange upon, that is, order: - charge, command, injoin.

G2005.full: From G1909 and G5055; to fulfill further (or completely), that is, execute; by implication to terminate, undergo: - accomplish, do, finish, (make) (perfect), perform (X -ance).

G2006.full: From å̓ðéôçäǻò epitēdes (enough); serviceable, that is, (by implication) requisite: - things which are needful.

G2007.firstSense: add unto, lade, lay upon, put (up) on, set on (up), + surname, X wound
G2007.full: From G1909 and G5087; to impose (in a friendly or hostile sense): - add unto, lade, lay upon, put (up) on, set on (up), + surname, X wound.

G2008.full: From G1909 and G5091; to tax upon, that is, censure or admonish; by implication forbid: - (straitly) charge, rebuke.

G2009.full: From a compound of G1909 and G5092; properly esteem, that is, citizenship; used (in the sense of G2008) of a penalty: - punishment.

G2010.firstSense: give leave (liberty, license), let, permit, suffer
G2010.full: From G1909 and the base of G5157; to turn over (transfer), that is, allow: - give leave (liberty, license), let, permit, suffer.

G2011.full: From G2010; permission, that is, (by implication) full power: - commission.

G2012.full: From G1909 and G5158 (in the sense of G2011); a commissioner, that is, domestic manager, guardian: - steward, tutor.

G2013.full: From G1909 and G5177; to chance upon, that is, (by implication) attain: - obtain.

G2014.full: From G1909 and G5316; to shine upon, that is, become (literally) visible or (figuratively) known: - appear, give light.

G2015.full: From G2016; a manifestation, that is, (specifically) the advent of Christ (past or future): - appearing, brightness.

G2016.full: From G2014; conspicuous, that is, (figuratively) memorable: - notable.

G2017.full: A form of G2014; to illuminate (figuratively): - give light.

G2018.full: From G1909 and G5342; to bear upon (or further), that is, adduce (personally or judicially [accuse, inflict]), superinduce: - add, bring (against), take.

G2019.full: From G1909 and G5455; to call at something, that is, exclaim: - cry (against), give a shout.

G2020.firstSense: begin to dawn, X draw on
G2020.full: A form of G2017; to begin to grow light: - begin to dawn, X draw on.

G2021.full: From G1909 and G5495; to put the hand upon, that is, undertake: - go about, take in hand (upon).

G2022.full: From G1909 and ÷ǻù cheō (to pour); to pour upon: - pour in.

G2023.full: From G1909 and G5524; to furnish besides, that is, fully supply, (figuratively) aid or contribute: - add, minister (nourishment, unto).

G2025.full: From G1909 and G5548; to smear over: - anoint.

G2026.full: From G1909 and G3618; to build upon, that is, (figuratively) to rear up: - build thereon (thereupon, on, upon).

G2027.full: From G1909 and ï̓êǻëëù okellō (to urge); to drive upon the shore, that is, to beach a vessel: - run aground.

G2028.full: From G1909 and G3687; to name further, that is, denominate: - call.

G2029.full: From G1909 and a derivative of G3700; to inspect, that is, watch: - behold.

G2030.full: From G1909 and a presumed derivative of G3700; a looker on: - eye-witness.

G2031.full: From G2036; a word: - X say.

G2032.full: From G1909 and G3772; above the sky: - celestial, (in) heaven (-ly), high.

G2034.full: Adverb from G2033; seven times: - seven times.

G2035.full: From G2034 and G5507; seven times a thousand: - seven thousand.

G2036.firstSense: answer, bid, bring word, call, command, grant, say (on), speak, tell
G2036.full: A primary verb (used only in the definite past tense, the others being borrowed from G2046, G4483 and G5346); to speak or say (by word or writting): - answer, bid, bring word, call, command, grant, say (on), speak, tell. Compare G3004.

G2037.full: From å̓ñá́ù eraō (to love); beloved; Erastus, a Christian: - Erastus.

G2038.firstSense: commit, do, labor for, minister about, trade (by), work
G2038.full: Middle voice from G2041; to toil (as a task, occupation, etc.), (by implication) effect, be engaged in or with, etc.: - commit, do, labor for, minister about, trade (by), work.

G2039.full: From G2040; occupation; by implication profit, pains: - craft, diligence, gain, work.

G2040.full: From G2041; a toiler; figuratively a teacher: - labourer, worker (-men).

G2041.full: From å̓́ñãù ergō (a primary but obsolete word; to work); toil (as an effort or occupation); by implication an act: - deed, doing, labour, work.

G2042.full: From a presumed prolonged form of G2054; to stimulate (especially to anger): - provoke.

G2043.full: Of obscure affinity; to prop, that is, (reflexively) get fast: - stick fast.

G2044.full: Of uncertain affinity; to belch, that is, (figuratively) to speak out: - utter.

G2045.full: Apparently from G2046 (through the idea of inquiry); to seek, that is, (figuratively) to investigate: - search.

G2046.full: Probably a fuller form of G4483; an alternate for G2036 in certain tenses; to utter, that is, speak or say: - call, say, speak (of), tell.

G2048.full: Of uncertain affinity; lonesome, that is, (by implication) waste (usually as a noun, G5561 being implied): - desert, desolate, solitary, wilderness.

G2049.firstSense: (bring to, make) desolate (-ion), come to nought
G2049.full: From G2048; to lay waste (literally or figuratively): - (bring to, make) desolate (-ion), come to nought.

G2052.full: Perhaps from the same as G2042; properly intrigue, that is, (by implication) faction: - contention (-ious), strife.

G2054.full: Of uncertain affinity; a quarrel, that is, (by implication) wrangling: - contention, debate, strife, variance.

G2055.full: From G2056; a kidling, that is, (generally) goat (symbolically wicked person): - goat.

G2056.full: Perhaps from the same as G2053 (through the idea of hairiness); a kid or (generally) goat: - goat, kid.

G2057.full: Probably from G2060; Hermas, a Christian: - Hermas.

G2058.full: From the same as G2059; translation: - interpretation.

G2059.full: From a presumed derivative of G2060 (as the god of language); to translate: - interpret.

G2060.full: Perhaps from G2046; Hermes, the name of the messenger of the Greek deities; also of a Christian: - Hermes, Mercury.

G2061.full: From G2060 and G1096; born of Hermes; Hermogenes, an apostate Christian: - Hermogenes.

G2062.full: Neuter of a derivative of å̔́ñðù herpō (to creep); a reptile, that is, (by Hebraism (compare [H7431]) a small animal: - creeping thing, serpent.

G2063.full: Of uncertain affinity; red, that is, (with G2281) the red Sea: - red.

G2064.firstSense: accompany, appear, bring, come enter, fall out, go, grow, X light, X next, pass, resort…
G2064.full: Middle voice of a primary verb (used only in the present and imperfect tenses, the others being supplied by a kindred [middle voice] word, å̓ëåṍèïìáé eleuthomai or å̓́ëèù elthō; which do not otherwise occur); to come or go (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively): - accompany, appear, bring, come enter, fall out, go, grow, X light, X next, pass, resort, be set.

G2065.full: Apparently from G2046 (compare G2045); to interrogate; by implication to request: - ask, beseech, desire, intreat, pray. Compare G4441.

G2066.full: From å̓́ííõìé hennumi (to clothe); dress: - apparel, clothing, raiment, robe.

G2067.full: From a derivative of G2066; clothing (concretely): - garment.

G2068.full: Strengthened for a primary word å̓́äù edō (to eat); used only in certain tenses, the rest being supplied by G5315; to eat (usually literally): - devour, eat, live.

G2069.full: Of Hebrew origin (probably for [H454]); Esli, an Israelite: - Esli.

G2070.firstSense: are, be, have our being, X have hope, + [the gospel] was [preached unto] us
G2070.full: Frist person plural indicative of G1510; we are: - are, be, have our being, X have hope, + [the gospel] was [preached unto] us.

G2071.firstSense: shall (should) be (have), (shall) come (to pass), X may have, X fall, what would follow…
G2071.full: Future tense of G1510; will be: - shall (should) be (have), (shall) come (to pass), X may have, X fall, what would follow, X live long, X sojourn.

G2072.full: From G1519 and a presumed derivative of G3700; a mirror (for looking into): - glass. Compare G2734.

G2073.full: Feminine of an adjective å̔óðåñḯò hesperos (evening); the eve (G5610 being implied): - evening (-tide).

G2074.full: Of Hebrew origin [H2696]; Esrom (that is, Chetsron), an Israelite: - Esrom.

G2075.full: Second person plural present indicative of G1510; ye are: - be, have been, belong.

G2076.firstSense: are, be (-long), call, X can [-not], come, consisteth, X dure for awhile, + follow, X h…
G2076.full: Third person singular present indicative of G1510; he (she or it) is; also (with neuter plural) they are: - are, be (-long), call, X can [-not], come, consisteth, X dure for awhile, + follow, X have, (that) is (to say), make, meaneth, X must needs, + profit, + remaineth, + wrestle.

G2077.full: Second person singular present imperative and third person of G1510; be thou; let them be: - be.

G2078.firstSense: ends of, last, latter end, lowest, uttermost
G2078.full: A superlative probably from G2192 (in the sense of contiguity); farthest, final (of place or time): - ends of, last, latter end, lowest, uttermost.

G2079.full: Adverb from G2078; finally, that is, (with G2192) at the extremity of life: - point of death.

G2080.full: From G1519; inside (as preposition or adjective): - (with-) in (-ner, -to, -ward).

G2081.full: From G2080; from inside; also used as equivalent to G2080 (inside): - inward (-ly), (from) within, without.

G2082.full: Comparative of G2080; interior: - inner, within.

G2083.full: From å̓́ôçò etēs (a clansman); a comrade: - fellow, friend.

G2084.full: From G2087 and G1100; other tongued, that is, a foreigner: - man of other tongue.

G2085.full: From G2087 and G1320; to instruct differently: - teach other doctrine (-wise).

G2086.full: From a compound of G2087 and G2218; to yoke up differently, that is, (figuratively) to associate discordantly: - unequally yoke together with.

G2087.firstSense: altered, else, next (day), one, (an-) other, some, strange
G2087.full: Of uncertain affinity; (an-, the) other or different: - altered, else, next (day), one, (an-) other, some, strange.

G2089.firstSense: after that, also, ever, (any) further, (t-) henceforth (more), hereafter, (any) longer,…
G2089.full: Perhaps akin to G2094; "yet", still (of time or degree): - after that, also, ever, (any) further, (t-) henceforth (more), hereafter, (any) longer, (any) more (-one), now, still, yet.

G2090.full: From G2092; to prepare: - prepare, provide, make ready. Compare G2680.

G2092.full: From an old noun å̔́ôåïò heteos (fitness); adjusted, that is, ready: - prepared, (made) ready (-iness, to our hand).

G2093.full: Adverb from G2092; in readiness: - ready.

G2094.full: Apparently a primary word; a year: - year.

G2095.full: eu yoo Neuter of a primary word åõ̓͂ò eus (good); (adverbially) well: - good, well (done).

G2096.full: Of Hebrew origin [H2332]; Eua (or Eva, that is, Chavvah), the first woman: - Eve.

G2097.firstSense: declare, bring (declare, show) glad (good) tidings, preach (the gospel)
G2097.full: From G2095 and G32; to announce good news ("evangelize") especially the gospel: - declare, bring (declare, show) glad (good) tidings, preach (the gospel).

G2098.full: From the same as G2097; a good message, that is, the gospel: - gospel.

G2099.full: From G2097; a preacher of the gospel: - evangelist.

G2100.full: From G2101; to gratify entirely: - please (well).

G2101.full: From G2095 and G701; fully agreeable: - acceptable (-ted), wellpleasing.

G2102.full: From G2101; quite agreeably: - acceptably, + please well.

G2103.full: From G2095 and G1014; good willer; Eubulus, a Christian: - Eubulus.

G2104.full: From G2095 and G1096; well born, that is, (literally) high in rank, or (figuratively) generous: - more noble, nobleman.

G2105.full: Feminine from G2095 and the alternate of G2203 (as the god of the weather); a clear sky, that is, fine weather: - fair weather.

G2106.firstSense: think good, (be well) please (-d), be the good (have, take) pleasure, be willing
G2106.full: From G2095 and G1380; to think well of, that is, approve (an act); specifically to approbate (a person or thing): - think good, (be well) please (-d), be the good (have, take) pleasure, be willing.
