G2107.firstSense: desire, good pleasure (will), X seem good
G2107.full: From a presumed compound of G2095 and the base of G1380; satisfaction, that is, (subjectively) delight, or (objectively) kindness, wish, purpose: - desire, good pleasure (will), X seem good.

G2108.full: From G2110; beneficence (generally or specifically): - benefit, good deed done.

G2109.full: From G2110; to be philanthropic: - do good.

G2110.full: From G2095 and the base of G2041; a worker of good, that is, (specifically) a philanthropist: - benefactor.

G2111.full: From G2095 and a derivative of G5087; well placed, that is, (figuratively) appropriate: - fit, meet.

G2112.firstSense: anon, as soon as, forthwith, immediately, shortly, straightway
G2112.full: Adverb from G2117; directly, that is, at once or soon: - anon, as soon as, forthwith, immediately, shortly, straightway.

G2113.full: From G2117 and G1408; to lay a straight course, that is, sail direct: - (come) with a straight course.

G2114.full: From G2115; to cheer up, that is, (intransitively) be cheerful; neuter comparative (adverb) more cheerfully: - be of good cheer (merry).

G2115.firstSense: of good cheer, the more cheerfully
G2115.full: From G2095 and G2372; in fine spirits, that is, cheerful: - of good cheer, the more cheerfully.

G2116.full: From G2117; to straighten (level); technically to steer: - governor, make straight.

G2117.firstSense: anon, by and by, forthwith, immediately, straightway
G2117.full: Perhaps from G2095 and G5087; straight, that is, (literally) level, or (figuratively) true; adverbially (of time) at once: - anon, by and by, forthwith, immediately, straightway.

G2119.full: From G2121; to have good time, that is, opportunity or leisure: - have leisure (convenient time), spend time.

G2120.full: From G2121; a favorable occasion: - opportunity.

G2121.full: From G2095 and G2540; well timed, that is, opportune: - convenient, in time of need.

G2122.full: Adverb from G2121; opportunely: - conveniently, in season.

G2123.full: Comparative of a compound of G2095 and G2873; better for toil, that is, more facile: - easier.

G2124.full: From G2126; properly caution, that is, (religiously) reverence (piety); by implication dread (concretely): - fear (-ed).

G2125.full: Middle voice from G2126; to be circumspect, that is, (by implication) to be apprehensive; religiously, to reverence: - (moved with) fear.

G2126.full: From G2095 and G2983; taking well (carefully), that is, circumspect (religiously, pious): - devout.

G2127.full: From a compound of G2095 and G3056; to speak well of, that is, (religiously) to bless (thank or invoke a benediction upon, prosper): - bless, praise.

G2129.firstSense: blessing (a matter of) bounty (X -tifully), fair speech
G2129.full: From the same as G2127; fine speaking, that is, elegance of language; commendation ("eulogy"), that is, (reverentially) adoration; religiously, benediction; by implication consecration; by extension benefit or largess: - blessing (a matter of) bounty (X -tifully), fair speech.

G2130.full: From G2095 and a presumed derivative of G3330; good at imparting, that is, liberal: - ready to distribute.

G2131.full: From G2095 and G3529; victorious; Eunice, a Jewess: - Eunice.

G2132.full: From a compound of G2095 and G3563; to be well minded, that is, reconcile: - agree.

G2133.full: From the same as G2132; kindness; euphemistically conjugal duty: - benevolence, good will.

G2134.full: From G2135; to castrate (figuratively live unmarried): - make . . . eunuch.

G2135.full: From åõ̓íḉ eunē (a bed) and G2192; a castrated person (such being employed in Oriental bed chambers); by extension an impotent or unmarried man; by implication a chamberlain (state officer): - eunuch.

G2136.full: From the same as G2137; fine travelling; Euodia, a Christian woman: - Euodias.

G2137.full: From a compound of G2095 and G3598; to help on the road, that is, (passively) succeed in reaching; figuratively to succeed in business affairs: - (have a) prosper (-ous journey).

G2138.full: From G2095 and G3982; good for persuasion, that is, (intransitively) compliant: - easy to be intreated.

G2139.full: From G2095 and a derivative of a presumed compound of G4012 and G2476; well standing around, that is, (a competitor) thwarting (a racer) in every direction (figuratively of sin in general): - which doth so easily beset.

G2140.full: From a compound of G2095 and G4160; well doing, that is, beneficence: - to do good.

G2141.full: From a compound of G2090 and the base of G4197; (intransitively) to be good for passing through, that is, (figuratively) have pecuniary means: - ability.

G2142.full: From the same as G2141; pecuniary resources: - wealth.

G2143.full: From a compound of G2095 and G4241; good suitableness, that is, gracefulness: - grace.

G2144.full: From G2095 and a derivative of G4327; well received, that is, approved, favorable: - acceptable (-ted).

G2145.full: From G2095 and the same as G4332; sitting well towards, that is, (figuratively) assiduous (neuter diligent service): - X attend upon.

G2146.full: From a compound of G2095 and G4383; to be of good countenance, that is, (figuratively) to make a display: - make a fair show.

G2147.full: A prolonged form of a primary word åõ̔́ñù heurō; which (together with another cognate form, åõ̔ñǻù heureō) is used for it in all the tenses except the present and imperfect; to find (literally or figuratively): - find, get, obtain, perceive, see.

G2148.full: From Åõ̓͂ñïò Euros (the east wind) and G2830; a storm from the east (or south east), that is, (in modern phrase) a Levanter: - Euroklydon.

G2149.full: From åõ̓ñṍò eurus (wide) and G5561; spacious: - broad.

G2150.full: From G2152; piety; specifically the gospel scheme: - godliness, holiness.

G2151.full: From G2152; to be pious, that is, (towards God) to worship, or (towards parents) to respect (support): - show piety, worship.

G2152.full: From G2095 and G4576; well reverent, that is, pious: - devout, godly.

G2154.full: From G2095 and the base of G4591; well indicated, that is, (figuratively) significant: - easy to be understood.

G2155.full: From G2095 and G4698; well compassioned, that is, sympathetic: - pitiful, tender-hearted.

G2156.full: Adverb from G2158; decorously: - decently, honestly.

G2158.full: From G2095 and G4976; well formed, that is, (figuratively) decorous, noble (in rank): - comely, honourable.

G2159.full: Adverb from a compound of G2095 and a derivation of ôåé́íù teinō (to stretch); in a well strung manner, that is, (figuratively) intensely (in a good sense, cogently; in a bad one, fiercely): - mightily, vehemently.

G2160.full: From a compound of G2095 and a derivative of the base of G5157 (meaning well turned, that is, ready at repartee, jocose); witticism, that is, (in a vulgar sense) ribaldry: - jesting.

G2161.full: From G2095 and a derivative of G5177; well fated, that is, fortunate; Eutychus, a young man: - Eutychus.

G2162.full: From G2163; good language ("euphemy"), that is, praise (repute): - good report.

G2163.full: From G2095 and G5345; well spoken of, that is, reputable: - of good report.

G2164.full: From G2095 and G5409; to bear well, that is, be fertile: - bring forth abundantly.

G2165.firstSense: fare, make glad, be (make) merry, rejoice
G2165.full: From G2095 and G5424; to put (middle voice or passive voice be) in a good frame of mind, that is, rejoice: - fare, make glad, be (make) merry, rejoice.

G2166.full: Of foreign origin (compare [H6578]); Euphrates, a river of Asia: - Euphrates.

G2167.full: From the same as G2165; joyfulness: - gladness, joy.

G2168.full: From G2170; to be grateful, that is, (actually) to express gratitude (towards); specifically to say grace at a meal: - (give) thank (-ful, -s).

G2169.full: From G2170; gratitude; actually grateful language (to God, as an act of worship): - thankfulness, (giving of) thanks (-giving).

G2170.full: From G2095 and a derivative of G5483; well favored, that is, (by implication) grateful: - thankful.

G2171.full: From G2172; properly a wish, expressed as a petition to God, or in votive obligation: - prayer, vow.

G2172.full: Middle voice of a primary verb; to wish; by implication to pray to God: - pray, will, wish.

G2173.full: From G2095 and G5543; easily used, that is, useful: - profitable, meet for use.

G2174.full: From a compound of G2095 and G5590; to be in good spirits, that is, feel encouraged: - be of good comfort.

G2175.full: From a compound of G2095 and a derivative of G3605; good scentedness, that is, fragrance: - sweet savour (smell, -smelling).

G2176.full: From G2095 and G3686; properly well named (good omened), that is, the left (which was the lucky side among the pagan Greeks); neuter as adverb at the left hand: - (on the) left.

G2177.full: From G1909 and G242; to spring upon: - leap on.

G2178.full: From G1909 and G530; upon one occasion (only): - (at) once (for all).

G2179.full: From G2181; Ephesine, or situated at Ephesus: - of Ephesus.

G2180.full: From G2181; an Ephesian or inhabitant of Ephesus: - Ephesian, of Ephesus.

G2181.full: Probably of foreign origin; Ephesus, a city of Asia Minor: - Ephesus.

G2182.full: From a compound of G1909 and G2147; a discoverer, that is, contriver: - inventor.

G2183.full: From G2184; diurnality, that is, (specifically) the quotidian rotation or class of the Jewish priests' service at the Temple, as distributed by families: - course.

G2184.full: From G1909 and G2250; for a day ("ephemeral"), that is, diurnal: - daily.

G2185.full: From G1909 and a cognate of G2240; to arrive upon, that is, extend to: - reach.

G2186.firstSense: assault, come (in, to, unto, upon), be at hand (instant), present, stand (before, by, o…
G2186.full: From G1909 and G2476; to stand upon, that is, be present (in various applications, friendly or otherwise, usually literally): - assault, come (in, to, unto, upon), be at hand (instant), present, stand (before, by, over).

G2187.full: Of Hebrew origin ([H669] or better [H6085]); Ephraim, a place in Palestine: - Ephraim.

G2188.full: Of Chaldee origin [H6606]; be opened!: - Ephphatha.

G2189.full: Feminine of G2190; hostility; by implication a reason for opposition: - enmity, hatred.

G2190.full: From a primary word å̓́÷èù echthō (to hate); hateful (passively odious, or actively hostile); usually as a noun, an adversary (especially Satan): - enemy, foe.

G2191.full: Of uncertain origin; an adder or other poisonous snake (literally or figuratively): - viper.

G2192.firstSense: be (able, X hold, possessed with), accompany, + begin to amend, can (+ -not), X conceiv…
G2192.full: A primary verb (including an alternate form ó÷ǻù scheō skheh'-o used in certain tenses only); to hold (used in very various applications, literally or figuratively, direct or remote; such as possession, ability, contiguity, relation or condition): - be (able, X hold, possessed with), accompany, + begin to amend, can (+ -not), X conceive, count, diseased, do, + eat, + enjoy, + fear, following, have, hold, keep, + lack, + go to law, lie, + must needs, + of necessity, + need, next, + recover, + reign, + rest, return, X sick, take for, + tremble, + uncircumcised, use.

G2193.firstSense: even (until, unto), (as) far (as), how long, (un-) til (-l), (hither-, un-, up) to, whi…
G2193.full: Of uncertain affinity; a conjugation, preposition and adverb of continuance, until (of time and place): - even (until, unto), (as) far (as), how long, (un-) til (-l), (hither-, un-, up) to, while (-s).

G2194.full: Of Hebrew origin [H2074]; Zabulon (that is, Zebulon), a region of Palestine: - Zabulon.

G2195.full: Of Hebrew origin (compare [H2140]); Zacchaeus, an Israelite: - Zacchus.

G2196.full: Of Hebrew origin [H2226]; Zara (that is, Zerach), an Israelite: - Zara.

G2197.full: Of Hebrew origin [H2148]; Zacharias (that is, Zechariah), the name of two Israelites: - Zacharias.

G2198.full: A primary verb; to live (literally or figuratively): - life (-time), (a-) live (-ly), quick.

G2199.full: Of Hebrew origin (compare [H2067]); Zebedaeus, an Israelite: - Zebedee.

G2200.full: From G2204; boiled, that is, (by implication) calid (figuratively fervent): - hot.

G2201.full: From the same as G2218; a couple, that is, a team (of oxen yoked together) or brace (of birds tied together): - yoke, pair.

G2202.full: Feminine of a derivative (at the second stage) from the same as G2218; a fastening (tiller rope): - band.

G2203.full: Zeus dzyooce Of uncertain affinity; in the oblique cases there is used instead of it a (probably cognate) name Äé́ò Dis deece which is otherwise obsolete; Zeus or Dis (among the Latins Jupiter or Jove), the supreme deity of the Greeks: - Jupiter.

G2204.full: A primary verb; to be hot (boil, of liquids; or glow, of solids), that is, (figuratively) be fervid (earnest): - be fervent.

G2205.firstSense: emulation, envy (-ing), fervent mind, indignation, jealousy, zeal
G2205.full: From G2204; properly heat, that is, (figuratively) "zeal" (in a favorable sense, ardor; in an unfavorable one, jealousy, as of a husband [figuratively of God], or an enemy, malice): - emulation, envy (-ing), fervent mind, indignation, jealousy, zeal.

G2206.firstSense: affect, covet (earnestly), (have) desire, (move with) envy, be jealous over, (be) zealo…
G2206.full: From G2205; to have warmth of feeling for or against: - affect, covet (earnestly), (have) desire, (move with) envy, be jealous over, (be) zealous (-ly affect).

G2208.full: The same as G2207; a Zealot, that is, (specifically) partisan for Jewish political independence: - Zelotes.

G2209.full: Probably akin to the base of G1150 (through the idea of violence); detriment: - damage, loss.

G2210.firstSense: be cast away, receive damage, lose, suffer loss
G2210.full: From G2209; to injure, that is, (reflexively or passively) to experience detriment: - be cast away, receive damage, lose, suffer loss.

G2211.full: Probably contracted from a poetic form of G2203 and G1435; Jove given; Zenas, a Christian: - Zenas.

G2212.firstSense: be (go) about, desire, endeavour, enquire (for), require, (X will) seek (after, for, me…
G2212.full: Of uncertain affinity; to seek (literally or figuratively); specifically (by Hebraism) to worship (God), or (in a bad sense) to plot (against life): - be (go) about, desire, endeavour, enquire (for), require, (X will) seek (after, for, means). Compare G4441.

G2213.full: From G2212; a search (properly concrete), that is, (in words) a debate: - question.

G2214.full: From G2212; a searching (properly the act), that is, a dispute or its theme: - question.

G2215.full: Of uncertain origin; darnel or false grain: - tares.

G2216.full: Of Hebrew origin [H2216]; Zorobabel (that is, Zerubbabel), an Israelite: - Zorobabel.

G2217.full: Akin to the base of G3509; gloom (as shrouding like a cloud): - blackness, darkness, mist.

G2218.full: From the root of æåṍãíõìé zeugnumi (to join, especially by a "yoke"); a coupling, that is, (figuratively) servitude (a law or obligation); also (literally) the beam of the balance (as connecting the scales): - pair of balances, yoke.

G2219.full: Probably from G2204; ferment (as if boiling up): - leaven.

G2220.full: From G2219; to cause to ferment: - leaven.

G2221.full: From the same as G2226 and G64; to take alive (make a prisoner of war), that is, (figuratively) to capture or ensnare: - take captive, catch.

G2222.full: From G2198; life (literally or figuratively): - life (-time). Compare G5590.

G2223.full: Probably akin to the base of G2218; a belt; by implication a pocket: - girdle, purse.

G2224.full: From G2223; to bind about (especially with a belt): - gird.

G2225.full: From the same as G2226 and a derivative of G1096; to engender alive that is, (by analogy) to rescue (passively be saved) from death: - live, preserve.

G2226.full: Neuter of a derivative of G2198; a live thing, that is, an animal: - beast.

G2227.full: From the same as G2226 and G4160; to (re-) vitalize (literally or figuratively): - make alive, give life, quicken.

G2228.firstSense: and, but (either), (n-) either, except it be, (n-) or (else), rather, save, than, that,…
G2228.full: A primary particle of distinction between two connected terms; disjunctive, or; comparative, than: - and, but (either), (n-) either, except it be, (n-) or (else), rather, save, than, that, what, yea. Often used in connection with other particles. Compare especially G2235, G2260, G2273.

G2229.full: An adverb of confirmation; perhaps intensive of G2228; used only (in the N. T.) before G3303; assuredly: - surely.

G2230.full: From G2232; to act as ruler: - be governor.

G2231.full: From G2232; government, that is, (in time) official term: - reign.

G2232.full: From G2233; a leader, that is, chief person (or figuratively place) of a province: - governor, prince, ruler.

G2233.firstSense: account, (be) chief, count, esteem, governor, judge, have the rule over, suppose, think
G2233.full: Middle voice of a (presumed) strengthened form of G71; to lead, that is, command (with official authority); figuratively to deem, that is, consider: - account, (be) chief, count, esteem, governor, judge, have the rule over, suppose, think.

G2234.full: Adverb from a derivative of the base of G2237; sweetly, that is, (figuratively) with pleasure: - gladly.

G2235.full: Apparently from G2228 (or possibly G2229) and G1211; even now: - already, (even) now (already), by this time.

G2236.full: Neuter plural of the superlative of the same as G2234; with great pleasure: - most (very) gladly.

G2237.full: From á̔íäá́íù handanō (to please); sensual delight; by implication desire: - lust, pleasure.

G2238.full: Neuter of a compound of the same as G2234 and G3744; a sweet scented plant, that is, mint: - mint.

G2239.full: A strengthened form of G1485; usage, that is, (plural) moral habits: - manners.

G2240.full: A primary verb; to arrive, that is, be present (literally or figuratively): - come.

G2241.full: Of Hebrew origin ([H410] with pronoun suffix); my God: - Eli.

G2242.full: Of Hebrew origin [H5941]; Heli (that is, Eli), an Israelite: - Heli.

G2243.full: Of Hebrew origin [H452]; Helias (that is, Elijah), an Israelite: - Elias.

G2244.full: From the same as G2245; maturity (in years or size): - age, stature.

G2245.full: From ç̔͂ëéî hēlix (a comrade, that is, one of the same age); as big as, that is, (interjectively) how much: - how (what) great.

G2246.full: From å̔́ëç helē (a ray; perhaps akin to the alternate of G138); the sun; by implication light: - + east, sun.

G2247.full: Of uncertain affinity; a stud, that is, spike: - nail.

G2248.full: Accusative plural of G1473; us: - our, us, we.

G2249.full: Nomitive plural of G1473; we (only used when emphatic): - us, we (ourselves).

G2250.firstSense: age, + alway, (mid-) day (by day, [-ly]), + for ever, judgment, (day) time, while, years
G2250.full: Feminine (with G5610 implied) of a derivative of ç̔͂ìáé hēmai (to sit; akin to the base of G1476) meaning tame, that is, gentle; day, that is, (literally) the time space between dawn and dark, or the whole 24 hours (but several days were usually reckoned by the Jews as inclusive of the parts of both extremes); figuratively a period (always defined more or less clearly by the context): - age, + alway, (mid-) day (by day, [-ly]), + for ever, judgment, (day) time, while, years.

G2251.full: From G2349; our. (Or your by a different reading.): - our, your [by a different reading].

G2252.full: A prolonged form of G2358; I was. (Sometimes unexpressed.): - be, was. [Sometimes unexpressed.]

G2253.full: From a presumed compound of the base of G2255 and G2348; half dead, that is, entirely exhausted: - half dead.

G2254.full: Dative plural of G1473; to (or for, with, by) us: - our, (for) us, we.

G2255.full: Neuter of a derivative from an inseparable prefix akin to G260 (through the idea of partition involved in connection) and meaning semi-; (as noun) half: - half.

G2256.full: From the base of G2255 and G5610; a half hour: - half an hour.

G2257.full: Genitive plural of G1473; of (or from) us: - our (company), us, we.

G2258.firstSense: + agree, be, X have (+ charge of), hold, use, was (-t), were
G2258.full: Imperfect of G1510; I (thou, etc.) was (wast or were): - + agree, be, X have (+ charge of), hold, use, was (-t), were.

G2259.full: Of uncertain affinity; at which time: - when.

G2260.full: From G2228 and G4007; than at all (or than perhaps, than indeed): - than.

G2261.full: Probably from G2031; properly affable, that is, mild or kind: - gentle.

G2262.full: Of Hebrew origin [H6147]; Er, an Israelite: - Er.

G2263.full: Perhaps by transposition from G2048 (through the idea of stillness); tranquil: - quiet.

G2264.full: Compound of ç̔́ñùò hērōs (a "hero") and G1491; heroic; Herodes, the name of four Jewish kings: - Herod.

G2265.full: Plural of a derivative of G2264; Herodians, that is, partisans of Herodes: - Herodians.

G2266.full: From G2264; Herodias, a woman of the Herodian family: - Herodias.

G2267.full: From G2264; Herodion, a Christian: - Herodion.

G2268.full: Of Hebrew origin [H3470]; Hesaias (that is, Jeshajah), an Israelite: - Esaias.

G2269.full: Of Hebrew origin [H6215]; Esau, an Edomite: - Esau.

G2270.firstSense: cease, hold peace, be quiet, rest
G2270.full: From the same as G2272; to keep still (intransitively), that is, refrain from labor, meddlesomeness or speech: - cease, hold peace, be quiet, rest.

G2271.full: Feminine of G2272; (as noun) stillness, that is, desistance from bustle or language: - quietness, silence.

G2272.full: A prolonged form of a compound probably of a derivative of the base of G1476 and perhaps G2192; properly keeping one's seat (sedentary), that is, (by implication) still (undisturbed, undisturbing): - peaceable, quiet.

G2273.full: From G2228 and G5104; either indeed: - whether.

G2274.full: From the same as G2276; to make worse, that is, vanquish (literally or figuratively); by implication to rate lower: - be inferior, overcome.

G2275.full: From G2274; a deterioration, that is, (objectively) failure or (subjectively) loss: - diminishing, fault.

G2276.full: Neuter of a compound of ç̔͂êá hēka ( slightly) used for that of G2556; worse (as noun); by implication less (as adverb): - less, worse.

G2277.full: Third person singular imperative of G1510; let him (or it) be: - let . . . be.

G2278.full: From G2279; to make a loud noise, that is, reverberate: - roar, sound.

G2279.full: Of uncertain affinity; a loud or confused noise ("echo"), that is, roar; figuratively a rumor: - fame, sound.

G2280.full: Of uncertain origin; Thaddaeus, one of the Apostles: - Thaddus.

G2281.full: Probably prolonged from G251; the sea (generally or specifically): - sea.

G2282.full: Probably akin to èá́ëëù thallō (to warm); to brood, that is, (figuratively) to foster: - cherish.

G2283.full: Of Hebrew origin [H8559]; Thamar (that is, Tamar), an Israelitess: - Thamar.

G2284.full: From G2285; to stupefy (with surprise), that is, astound: - amaze, astonish.

G2285.full: Akin to an obsolete ôá́öù taphō (to dumbfound); stupefaction (by surprise), that is, astonishment: - X amazed, + astonished, wonder.

G2286.full: From G2288; fatal, that is, poisonous: - deadly.

G2287.full: From (the feminine form of) G2288 and G5342; death bearing, that is, fatal: - deadly.

G2288.full: From G2348; (properly an adjective used as a noun) death (literally or figuratively): - X deadly, (be . . .) death.

G2289.firstSense: become dead, (cause to be) put to death, kill, mortify
G2289.full: From G2288; to kill (literally or figuratively): - become dead, (cause to be) put to death, kill, mortify.

G2290.full: A primary verb; to celebrate funeral rites, that is, inter: - bury.

G2291.full: Of Hebrew origin [H8646]; Thara (that is, Terach), the father of Abraham: - Thara.

G2292.firstSense: be bold, X boldly, have confidence, be confident
G2292.full: Another form for G2293; to exercise courage: - be bold, X boldly, have confidence, be confident. Compare G5111.

G2293.full: From G2294; to have courage: - be of good cheer (comfort). Compare G2292.

G2294.full: Akin (by transposition) to èñá́óïò thrasos (daring); boldness (subjectively): - courage.

G2295.full: Apparently from a form of G2300; wonder (properly concrete; but by implication abstract): - admiration.

G2296.firstSense: admire, have in admiration, marvel, wonder
G2296.full: From G2295; to wonder; by implication to admire: - admire, have in admiration, marvel, wonder.

G2297.full: From G2295; wondrous, that is, (neuter as noun) a miracle: - wonderful thing.

G2298.full: From G2296; wondered at, that is, (by implication) wonderful: - marvel (-lous).

G2299.full: Feminine of G2316; a female deity: - goddess.

G2300.full: A prolonged form of a primary verb; to look closely at, that is, (by implication) to perceive (literally or figuratively); by extension to visit: - behold, look (upon), see. Compare G3700.

G2301.full: From G2302; to expose as a spectacle: - make a gazing stock.

G2302.full: From G2300; a place for public show ("theatre"), that is, general audience room; by implication a show itself (figuratively): - spectacle, theatre.

G2303.full: Probably neuter of G2304 (in its original sense of flashing); sulphur: - brimstone.

G2304.full: From G2316; godlike (neuter as noun, divinity): - divine, godhead.

G2306.full: From G2303 and G1491; sulphur like, that is, sulphurous: - brimstone.

G2307.full: From the prolonged form of G2309; a determination (properly the thing), that is, (actively) choice (specifically purpose, decree; abstractly volition) or (passively) inclination: - desire, pleasure, will.

G2308.full: From G2309; determination (properly the act), that is, option: - will.

G2309.firstSense: desire, be disposed (forward), intend, list, love, mean, please, have rather, (be) will…
G2309.full: Either the first or the second form may be used. In certain tenses èåëǻù theleō thel-eh'-o (and å̓èǻëǻù etheleō eth-el-eh'-o) are used, which are otherwise obsolete; apparently strengthened from the alternate form of G138; to determine (as an active voice option from subjective impulse; whereas G1014 properly denotes rather a passive voice acquiescence in objective considerations), that is, choose or prefer (literally or figuratively); by implication to wish, that is, be inclined to (sometimes adverbially gladly); impersonally for the future tense, to be about to; by Hebraism to delight in: - desire, be disposed (forward), intend, list, love, mean, please, have rather, (be) will (have, -ling, -ling [ly]).

G2310.full: From a derivative of G5087; something put down, that is, a substruction (of a building, etc.), (literally or figuratively): - foundation.

G2311.full: From G2310; to lay a basis for, that is, (literally) erect, or (figuratively) consolidate: - (lay the) found (-ation), ground, settle.

G2312.full: From G2316 and G1321; divinely instructed: - taught of God. theologos theh-ol-og'-os From G2316 and G3004; a "theologian": - divine.

G2313.full: From G2314; to resist deity: - fight against God.

G2314.full: From G2316 and G3164; an opponent of deity: - to fight against God.

G2315.full: From G2316 and a presumed derivative of G4154; divinely breathed in: - given by inspiration of God.

G2316.full: Of uncertain affinity; a deity, especially (with G3588) the supreme Divinity; figuratively a magistrate; by Hebraism very: - X exceeding, God, god [-ly, -ward].

G2317.full: From G2318; devoutness, that is, piety: - godliness.

G2318.full: From G2316 and G4576; reverent of God, that is, pious: - worshipper of God.

G2319.full: From G2316 and the base of G4767; hateful to God, that is, impious: - hater of God.

G2321.full: From G2316 and G5384; friend of God; Theophilus, a Christian: - Theophilus.

G2322.full: From G2323; attendance (specifically medical, that is, cure); figuratively and collectively domestics: - healing, household.

G2323.full: From the same as G2324; to wait upon menially, that is, (figuratively) to adore (God), or (specifically) to relieve (of disease): - cure, heal, worship.

G2324.full: Apparently a participle from an otherwise obsolete derivation of the base of G2330; a menial attendant (as if cherishing): - servant.

G2325.full: From G2330 (in the sense of the crop); to harvest: - reap.

G2326.full: From G2325; reaping, that is, the crop: - harvest.

G2328.full: From G2329; to heat (oneself): - (be) warm (-ed, self).

G2329.full: From the base of G2330; warmth: - heat.

G2330.full: From a primary word èǻñù therō (to heat); properly heat, that is, summer: - summer.

G2331.full: From G2332; a Thessalonican, that is, inhabitant of Thessalonice: - Thessalonian.

G2332.full: From Èåóóáëḯò Thessalos (a Thessalian) and G3529; Thessalonice, a place in Asia Minor: - Thessalonica.

G2333.full: Of uncertain origin; Theudas, as Israelite: - Theudas.

G2334.firstSense: behold, consider, look on, perceive, see
G2334.full: From a derivative of G2300 (perhaps by adverb of G3708); to be a spectator of, that is, discern, (literally, figuratively [experience] or intensively [acknowledge]): - behold, consider, look on, perceive, see. Compare G3700.

G2335.full: From the same as G2334; spectatorship, that is, (concretely) a spectacle: - sight.

G2336.full: From G5087; a receptacle, that is, scabbard: - sheath.

G2337.full: From èçëḉ thēlē (the nipple); to suckle; by implication to suck: - (give) suck (-ling).

G2338.full: From the same as G2337; female: - female, woman.

G2339.full: From èḉñ thēr (a wild animal, as game); hunting, that is, (figuratively) destruction: - trap.

G2340.full: From G2339; to hunt (an animal), that is, (figuratively) to carp at: - catch.

G2341.full: From a compound of G2342 and G3164; to be a beast fighter (in the gladiatorial show), that is, (figuratively) to encounter (furious men): - fight with wild beasts.

G2342.full: Diminutive from the same as G2339; a dangerous animal: - (venomous, wild) beast.

G2343.firstSense: lay up (treasure), (keep) in store, (heap) treasure (together, up)
G2343.full: From G2344; to amass or reserve (literally or figuratively): - lay up (treasure), (keep) in store, (heap) treasure (together, up).

G2344.full: From G5087; a deposit, that is, wealth (literally or figuratively): - treasure.

G2345.full: A prolonged form of an obsolete primary word èé́ãù thigō (to finger); to manipulate, that is, have to do with; by implication to injure: - handle, touch.

G2346.firstSense: afflict, narrow, throng, suffer tribulation, trouble
G2346.full: Akin to the base of G5147; to crowd (literally or figuratively): - afflict, narrow, throng, suffer tribulation, trouble.

G2347.firstSense: afflicted, (-tion), anguish, burdened, persecution, tribulation, trouble
G2347.full: From G2346; pressure (literally or figuratively): - afflicted, (-tion), anguish, burdened, persecution, tribulation, trouble.

G2348.full: A strengthened form of a simpler primary word èá́íù thanō (which is used for it only in certain tenses); to die (literally or figuratively): - be dead, die.

G2349.full: From G2348; liable to die: - mortal (-ity).

G2350.firstSense: make ado (a noise), trouble self, set on an uproar
G2350.full: From G2351; to be in tumult, that is, disturb, clamor: - make ado (a noise), trouble self, set on an uproar.

G2351.full: From the base of G2360; a disturbance: - tumult, uproar.

G2352.full: A primary verb; to crush: - bruise. Compare G4486.

G2353.full: From G5142; stock (as raised on a farm): - cattle.

G2354.full: From G2355; to bewail: - lament, mourn.

G2355.full: From the base of G2360; wailing: - lamentation.

G2356.full: From a derivative of G2357; ceremonial observance: - religion, worshipping.

G2357.full: Probably from the base of G2360; ceremonious in worship (as demonstrative), that is, pious: - religious.

G2358.full: From a prolonged compound of the base of G2360 and a derivative of G680 (meaning a noisy iambus, sung in honor of Bacchus); to make an acclamatory procession, that is, (figuratively) to conquer or (by Hebraism) to give victory: - (cause) to triumph (over).

G2359.full: thrix trichos threeks Of uncertain derivation; hair: - hair. Compare G2864.

G2360.full: From èñǻïìáé threomai (to wail); to clamor, that is, (by implication) to frighten: - trouble.

G2361.full: Perhaps from G5142 (in the sense of thickening); a clot: - great drop.

G2362.full: From èñá́ù thraō (to sit); a stately seat ("throne"); by implication power or (concretely) a potentate: - seat, throne.

G2363.full: Of uncertain derivation; Thyatira, a place in Asia Minor: - Thyatira.

G2364.full: Apparently a primary word (compare "daughter"); a female child, or (by Hebraism) descendant (or inhabitant): - daughter.

G2365.full: From G2364; a daughterling: - little (young) daughter.

G2366.full: From G2380 (in the sense of blowing) a storm: - tempest.

G2367.full: From a derivative of G2380 (in the sense of blowing; denoting a certain fragrant tree); made of citron wood: - thyine.

G2368.full: From G2370; an aroma, that is, fragrant powder burnt in religious service; by implication the burning itself: - incense, odour.

G2369.full: From a derivative of G2370; a place of fumigation, that is, the altar of incense (in the Temple): - censer.

G2370.full: From a derivative of G2380 (in the sense of smoking); to fumigate, that is, offer aromatic fumes: - burn incense.

G2371.full: From a presumed compound of G2372 and G3164; to be in a furious fight, that is, (figuratively) to be exasperated: - be highly displeased.

G2372.full: From G2380; passion (as if breathing hard): - fierceness, indignation, wrath. Compare G5590.

G2373.full: From G2372; to put in a passion, that is, enrage: - be wroth.

G2374.full: Apparently a primary word (compare "door"); a portal or entrance (the opening or the closure, literally or figuratively): - door, gate.

G2375.full: From G2374; a large shield (as door shaped): - shield.

G2376.full: From G2374; an aperture, that is, window: - window.

G2377.full: From G2374 and ïõ̓͂ñïò ouros (a watcher); a gate warden: - that kept the door, porter.

G2378.full: From G2380; sacrifice (the act or the victim, literally or figuratively): - sacrifice.

G2379.full: From a derivative of G2378; a place of sacrifice, that is, an altar (specifically or generally, literally or figuratively): - altar.

G2380.full: A primary verb; properly to rush (breathe hard, blow, smoke), that is, (by implication) to sacrifice (properly by fire, but generally); by extension to immolate (slaughter for any purpose): - kill, (do) sacrifice, slay.

G2381.full: Of Chaldee origin (compare [H8380]); the twin; Thomas, a Christian: - Thomas.

G2382.full: Of uncertain affinity; the chest ("thorax"), that is, (by implication) a corslet: - breastplate.

G2383.full: Of Hebrew origin [H2971]; Jairus (that is, Jair), an Israelite: - Jairus.

G2384.full: Of Hebrew origin [H3290]; Jacob (that is, Ja'akob), the pogenitor of the Israelites; also an Israelite: - Jacob.

G2385.full: The same as G2384 Graecized; Jacobus, the name of three Israelites: - James.

G2386.full: From G2390; a cure (the effect): - healing.

G2387.full: Of Egyptian origin; Jambres, an Egyptian: - Jambres.

G2388.full: Probably of Hebrew origin (compare [H3238]); Janna, an Israelite: - Janna.

G2389.full: Of Egyptian origin; Jannes, an Egyptian: - Jannes.

G2390.full: Middle voice of apparently a primary verb; to cure (literally or figuratively): - heal, make whole.

G2391.full: Of Hebrew origin [H3382]; Jared (that is, Jered), an antediluvian: - Jared.

G2392.full: From G2390; curing (the act): - cure, heal (-ing).

G2393.full: Probably of foreign origin (see [H3471]); "jasper", a gem: - jasper.

G2394.full: Future active participle masculine of G2390; about to cure; Jason, a Christian: - Jason.

G2396.full: Second person singular imperative active of G1492; used as interjection to denote surprise; lo!: - behold, lo, see.

G2397.full: From G1492; a sight (compare figuratively "idea"), that is, aspect: - countenance.

G2398.firstSense: X his acquaintance, when they were alone, apart, aside, due, his (own, proper, several)…
G2398.full: Of uncertain affinity; pertaining to self, that is, one's own; by implication private or separate: - X his acquaintance, when they were alone, apart, aside, due, his (own, proper, several), home, (her, our, thine, your) own (business), private (-ly), proper, severally, their (own).

G2399.full: From G2398; a private person, that is, (by implication) an ignoramus (compare "idiot"): - ignorant, rude, unlearned.

G2400.full: Second person singular imperative middle voice of G1492; used as imperative lo!: - behold, lo, see.

G2401.full: Of Hebrew origin [H123]; Idumaea (that is, Edom), a region East (and South) of Palestine: - Iduma.

G2402.full: A strengthened form of a primary word é̓́äïò idos (sweat); perspiration: - sweat.

G2403.full: Of Hebrew origin [H348]; Jezabel (that is, Jezebel), a Tyrian woman (used as a synonym of a termagant or false teacher): - Jezabel.

G2404.full: From G2413 and G4172; holy city; Hierapolis, a place in Asia Minor: - Hierapolis.

G2405.firstSense: office of the priesthood, priest's office
G2405.full: From G2407; priestliness, that is, the sacerdotal function: - office of the priesthood, priest's office.

G2406.full: From G2407; the priestly fraternity, that is, a sacerdotal order (figuratively): - priesthood.

G2407.full: Prolongation from G2409; to be a priest, that is, perform his functions: - execute the priest's office.

G2408.full: Of Hebrew origin [H3414]; Hieremias (that is, Jermijah), an Israelite: - Jeremiah.

G2409.full: From G2413; a priest (literally or figuratively): - (high) priest.

G2410.full: Of Hebrew origin [H3405]; Jericho, a place in Palestine: - Jericho.

G2411.full: Neuter of G2413; a sacred place, that is, the entire precincts (whereas G3485 denotes the central sanctuary itself) of the Temple (at Jerusalem or elsewhere): - temple.

G2412.full: From G2413 and the same as G4241; reverent: - as becometh holiness.

G2414.full: Of Hebrew origin [H3389]; Hierosolyma (that is, Jerushalaim), the capital of Palestine: - Jerusalem. Compare G2419.

G2415.full: From G2414; a Hierosolymite, that is, inhabitant of Hierosolyma: - of Jerusalem.

G2416.full: From G2417; to be a temple robber (figuratively): - commit sacrilege.

G2417.full: From G2411 and G4813; a temple despoiler: - robber of churches.

G2418.full: From a compound of G2411 and the base of G2041; to be a temple worker, that is, officiate as a priest (figuratively): - minister.

G2419.full: Of Hebrew origin [H3389]; Hierusalem (that is, Jerushalem), the capital of Palestine: - Jerusalem. Compare G2414.

G2420.full: From G2413; sacredness, that is, (by implication) the priestly office: - priesthood.

G2421.full: Of Hebrew origin [H3448]; Jessae (that is, Jishai), an Israelite: - Jesse.

G2422.full: Of Hebrew origin [H3316]; Jephthae (that is, Jiphtach), an Israelite: - Jephthah.

G2423.full: Of Hebrew origin [H3204]; Jechonias (. e. Jekonjah), an Israelite: - Jechonias.

G2424.full: Of Hebrew origin [H3091]; Jesus (that is, Jehoshua), the name of our Lord and two (three) other Israelites: - Jesus.

G2425.firstSense: able, + content, enough, good, great, large, long (while), many, meet, much, security,…
G2425.full: From é̔́êù hikō (é̔êá́íù or é̔êíǻïìáé; akin to G2240; to arrive); competent (as if coming in season), that is, ample (in amount) or fit (in character): - able, + content, enough, good, great, large, long (while), many, meet, much, security, sore, sufficient, worthy.

G2427.full: From G2425; to enable, that is, qualify: - make able (meet).

G2428.full: From a derivative of the base of G2425 (through the idea of approaching for a favor); intreaty: - supplication.

G2430.full: Perhaps from G1504; image like; Iconium, a place in Asia Minor: - Iconium.

G2431.full: From the same as G2436; propitious or merry ("hilarious"), that is, prompt or willing: - cheerful.

G2433.full: Middle voice from the same as G2436; to conciliate, that is, (transitively) to atone for (sin), or (intransitively) be propitious: - be merciful, make reconciliation for.

G2434.full: atonement, that is, (concretely) an expiator: - propitiation.

G2435.full: Neuter of a derivative of G2433; an expiatory (place or thing), that is, (concretely) an atoning victim, or (specifically) the lid of the Ark (in the Temple): - mercyseat, propitiation.

G2436.full: Perhaps from the alternate form of G138; cheerful (as attractive), that is, propitious; adverbially (by Hebraism) God be gracious!, that is, (in averting some calamity) far be it: - be it far, merciful.

G2437.full: Neuter of an adjective from a name of uncertain derivation; (the) Illyrican (shore), that is, (as a name itself) Illyricum, a region of Europe: - Illyricum.

G2438.full: Perhaps from the same as G260; a strap, that is, (specifically) the tie (of a sandal) or the lash (of a scourge): - latchet, thong.

G2440.firstSense: apparel, cloke, clothes, garment, raiment, robe, vesture
G2440.full: Neuter of a presumed derivative of å̔́ííõìé hennumi (to put on); a dress (inner or outer): - apparel, cloke, clothes, garment, raiment, robe, vesture.

G2441.full: From G2439; clothing: - apparel (X -led), array, raiment, vesture.

G2442.full: Middle voice from é̔́ìåñïò himeros (a yearning; of uncertain affinity); to long for: - be affectionately desirous.

G2443.firstSense: albeit, because, to the intent (that), lest, so as, (so) that, (for) to
G2443.full: Probably from the same as the former part of G1438 (through the demonstrative idea; compare G3588); in order that (denoting the purpose or the result): - albeit, because, to the intent (that), lest, so as, (so) that, (for) to. Compare G3363.

G2444.full: From G2443 and G5101; for what reason?, that is, why?: - wherefore, why.

G2445.full: Of Hebrew origin [H3305]; Joppe (that is, Japho), a place in Palestine: - Joppa.

G2446.full: Of Hebrew origin [H3383]; the Jordanes (that is, Jarden), a river of Palestine: - Jordan.

G2447.full: Perhaps from åé̓͂ìé eimi (to go) or é̔́çìé hiēmi (to send); rust (as if emitted by metals); also venom (as emitted by serpents): - poison, rust.

G2448.full: Of Hebrew origin [H3063] or perhaps [H3194]; Judah (that is, Jehudah or Juttah), a part of (or place in) Palestine: - Judah.

G2449.full: Feminine of G2453 (with G1093 implied); the Judaean land (that is, judaea), a region of Palestine: - Juda.

G2450.full: From G2453; to become a Judaean, that is, "judaize": - live as the Jews.

G2451.full: From G2453; Judaic, that is, resembling a Judaean: - Jewish.

G2452.full: Adverb from G2451; Judaically or in a manner resembling a Judaean: - as do the Jews.

G2453.full: From G2448 (in the sense of G2455 as a country); udaean, that is, belonging to Jehudah: - Jew (-ess), of Juda.

G2454.full: From G2450; "judaism", that is, the Jewish faith and usages: - Jews' religion.

G2455.full: Of Hebrew origin [H3063]; Judas (that is, Jehudah), the name of ten Israelites; also of the posterity of one of them and its region: - Juda (-h, -s); Jude.

G2456.full: Feminine of the same as G2457; Julia, a Christian woman: - Julia.

G2457.full: Of Latin origin; Julius, a centurion: - Julius.

G2458.full: Of Latin origin; Junias, a Christian: - Junias.

G2459.full: Of Latin origin ("just"); Justus, the name of three Christians: - Justus.

G2460.full: From G2462; an equestrian, that is, member of a cavalry corps: - horseman.

G2461.full: Neuter of a derivative of G2462; the cavalry force: - horse [-men].

G2462.full: Of uncertain affinity; a horse: - horse.

G2463.full: Perhaps from G2046 (as a symbol of the female messenger of the pagan deities); a rainbow ("iris"): - rainbow.

G2464.full: Of Hebrew origin [H3327]; Isaac (that is, Jitschak), the son of Abraham: - Isaac.

G2465.full: From G2470 and G32; like an angel, that is, angelic: - equal unto the angels.

G2466.full: Of Hebrew origin [H3485]; Isachar (that is, Jissaskar), a son of Jacob (figuratively his descendants): - Issachar.

G2467.full: Assumed by some as the base of certain irregular forms of G1942; to know: - know.

G2468.firstSense: + agree, be, X give thyself wholly to
G2468.full: Second person imperative present of G1510; be thou: - + agree, be, X give thyself wholly to.

G2469.full: Of Hebrew origin (probably [H377] and [H7149]); inhabitants of Kerioth; Iscariotes (that is, Keriothite), an epithet of Judas the traitor: - Iscariot.

G2470.full: Probably from G1492 (through the idea of seeming); similar (in amount or kind): - + agree, as much, equal, like.

G2471.full: likeness (in condition or proportion); by implication equity: - equal (-ity).

G2472.full: From G2470 and G5092; of equal value or honor: - like precious.

G2473.full: From G2470 and G5590; of similar spirit: - likeminded.

G2474.full: Of Hebrew origin [H3478]; Israel (that is, Jisrael), the adopted name of Jacob, including his descendants (literally or figuratively): - Israel.

G2475.full: From G2474; an "israelite", that is, descendant of Israel (literally or figuratively): - Israelite.

G2476.firstSense: abide, appoint, bring, continue, covenant, establish, hold up, lay, present, set (up),…
G2476.full: A prolonged form of a primary word óôá́ù staō (of the same meaning, and used for it in certain tenses); to stand (transitively or intransitively), used in various applications (literally or figuratively): - abide, appoint, bring, continue, covenant, establish, hold up, lay, present, set (up), stanch, stand (by, forth, still, up). Compare G5087.

G2477.full: From a derivative of G1492; to be knowing (learned), that is, (by implication) to visit for information (interview): - see.

G2478.firstSense: boisterous, mighty (-ier), powerful, strong (-er, man), valiant
G2478.full: From G2479; forcible (literally or figuratively): - boisterous, mighty (-ier), powerful, strong (-er, man), valiant.

G2479.full: From a derivative of é̔ò his (force; compare å̓́ó÷ïí eschon; a form of G2192); forcefulness (literally or figuratively): - ability, might ([-ily]), power, strength.

G2480.firstSense: beable, avail, can do ([-not]), could, be good, might, prevail, be of strength, be whol…
G2480.full: From G2479; to have (or exercise) force (literally or figuratively): - beable, avail, can do ([-not]), could, be good, might, prevail, be of strength, be whole, + much work.

G2481.full: Adverb from G2470; likely, that is, perhaps: - it may be.

G2482.full: Probably of foreign origin; Italia, a region of Europe: - Italy.

G2483.full: From G2482; Italic, that is, belonging to Italia: - Italian.

G2484.full: Of Hebrew origin [H3195]; Ituraea (that is, Jetur), a region of Palestine: - Itura.

G2485.full: Diminutive from G2486; a petty fish: - little (small) fish.

G2486.full: Of uncertain affinity; a fish: - fish.

G2487.full: From é̓êíǻïìáé ikneomai (to arrive; compare G2240); a track (figuratively): - step.

G2488.full: Of Hebrew origin [H3147]; Joatham (that is, Jotham), an Israelite: - Joatham.

G2489.full: Feminine of the same as G2491; Joanna, a Christian: - Joanna.

G2490.full: A form of G2491; Joannas, an Israelite: - Joannas.

G2491.full: Of Hebrew origin [H3110]; Joannes (that is, Jochanan), the name of four Israelites: - John.

G2492.full: Of Hebrew origin [H347]; Job (that is, Ijob), a patriarch: - Job.

G2493.full: Of Hebrew origin [H3100]; Joel, an Israelite: - Joel.

G2494.full: Probably for G2491 or G2495; Jonan, an Israelite: - Jonan.

G2495.full: Of Hebrew origin [H3124]; Jonas (that is, Jonah), the name of two Israelites: - Jonas.

G2496.full: Of Hebrew origin [H3141]; Joram, an Israelite: - Joram.

G2497.full: Perhaps for G2496; Jorim, an Israelite: - Jorim.

G2498.full: Of Hebrew origin [H3092]; Josaphat (that is, Jehoshaphat), an Israelite: - Josaphat.

G2499.full: Genitive case of G2500; Jose, an Israelite: - Jose.

G2500.full: Perhaps from G2501; Joses, the name of two Israelites: - Joses. Compare G2499.

G2501.full: Of Hebrew origin [H3130]; Joseph, the name of seven Israelites: - Joseph.

G2502.full: Of Hebrew origin [H2977]; Josias (that is, Joshiah), an Israelite: - Josias.

G2503.full: Of Hebrew origin (the tenth letter of the Hebrew alphabet); "iota", the name of the eighth letter of the Greek alphabet, put (figuratively) for a very small part of anything: - jot.

G2504.firstSense: (and, even, even so, so) I (also, in like wise), both me, me also
G2504.full: So also the dative (second form) and accusative (third form); from G2532 and G1473; and (or also, even, etc.) I, (to) me: - (and, even, even so, so) I (also, in like wise), both me, me also.

G2505.full: From G2596 and the neuter plural of G3739; according to which things, that is, just as: - as.

G2506.full: From G2507; demolition; figuratively extinction: - destruction, pulling down.

G2507.full: From G2596 and G138 (including its alternate); to lower (or with violence) demolish (literally or figuratively): - cast (pull, put, take) down, destroy.

G2508.full: From G2513; to cleanse, that is, (specifically) to prune; figuratively to expiate: - purge.

G2509.full: From G2505 and G4007; exactly as: - (even, as well) as.

G2510.full: From G2596 and G680; to seize upon: - fasten on.

G2511.full: From G2513; to cleanse (literally or figuratively): - (make) clean (-se), purge, purify.

G2512.full: From G2511; a washing off, that is, (ceremonially) ablution, (morally) expiation: - cleansing, + purge, purification, (-fying).

G2513.full: Of uncertain affinity; clean (literally or figuratively): - clean, clear, pure.

G2515.full: From G2596 and the same as G1476; a bench (literally or figuratively): - seat.

G2516.full: From G2596 and the base of G1476; to sit down: - sit.

G2517.full: From G2596 and G1836; thereafter, that is, consecutively; as a noun (by ellipsis of noun) a subsequent person or time: - after (-ward), by (in) order.

G2518.full: From G2596 and åõ̔́äù heudō (to sleep); to lie down to rest, that is, (by implication) to fall asleep (literally or figuratively): - (be a-) sleep.

G2519.full: From a compound of G2596 and G2233; a guide, that is, (figuratively) a teacher: - master.

G2520.full: From G2596 and G2240; to reach to, that is, (neuter of present active participle, figuratively as adjective) becoming: - convenient, fit.

G2521.full: From G2596 and ç̔͂ìáé hēmai (to sit; akin to the base of G1476); to sit down; figuratively to remain, reside: - dwell, sit (by, down).

G2522.full: From G2596 and G2250; quotidian: - daily.

G2523.full: Another (active) form for G2516; to seat down, that is, set (figuratively appoint); intransitively to sit (down); figuratively to settle (hover, dwell): - continue, set, sit (down), tarry.

G2524.full: From G2596 and é̔́çìé hiēmi (to send); to lower: - let down.

G2525.firstSense: appoint, be, conduct, make, ordain, set
G2525.full: From G2596 and G2476; to place down (permanently), that is, (figuratively) to designate, constitute, convoy: - appoint, be, conduct, make, ordain, set.

G2526.full: From G2596 and G3739; according to which thing, that is, precisely as, in proportion as: - according to that, (inasmuch) as. katholikos kath-ol-ee-kos' From G2527; universal: - general.

G2527.full: From G2596 and G3650; on the whole, that is, entirely: - at all.

G2528.full: From G2596 and G3695; to equip fully with armor: - arm.

G2529.full: From G2596 and G3708; to behold fully, that is, (figuratively) distinctly apprehend: - clearly see.

G2530.full: From G2596 and G3739 and G5100; according to which certain thing, that is, as far (or inasmuch) as: - (according, forasmuch) as, because (that).

G2531.firstSense: according to, (according, even) as, how, when
G2531.full: From G2596 and G5613; just (or inasmuch) as, that: - according to, (according, even) as, how, when.

G2532.firstSense: and, also, both, but, even, for, if, indeed, likewise, moreover, or, so, that, then, th…
G2532.full: kai kahee Apparently a primary particle, having a copulative and sometimes also a cumulative force; and, also, even, so, then, too, etc.; often used in connection (or composition) with other particles or small words: - and, also, both, but, even, for, if, indeed, likewise, moreover, or, so, that, then, therefore, when, yea, yet.

G2533.full: Of Chaldee origin; the dell; Caiaphas (that is, Cajepha), an Israelite: - Caiaphas.

G2534.full: From G2532 and G1065; and at least (or even, indeed): - and, at least.

G2535.full: Of Hebrew origin [H7014]; Cain (that is, Cajin), the son of Adam: - Cain.

G2536.full: Of Hebrew origin [H7018]; Cainan (that is, Kenan), the name of two patriarchs: - Cainan.

G2537.full: Of uncertain affinity; new (especially in freshness; while G3501 is properly so with respect to age): - new.

G2539.full: From G2532 and G4007; and indeed, that is, nevertheless or notwithstanding: - and yet, although.

G2540.firstSense: X always, opportunity, (convenient, due) season, (due, short, while) time, a while
G2540.full: Of uncertain affinity; an occasion, that is, set or proper time: - X always, opportunity, (convenient, due) season, (due, short, while) time, a while. Compare G5550.

G2541.full: Of Latin origin; Caesar, a title of the Roman emperor: - Csar.

G2542.full: From G2541; Caesaria, the name of two places in Palestine: - Csarea.

G2543.full: From G2532 and G5104; and yet, that is, nevertheless: - although.

G2544.full: From G2543 and G1065; and yet indeed, that is, although really: - nevertheless, though.

G2545.full: Apparently a primary verb; to set on fire, that is, kindle or (by implication) consume: - burn, light.

G2546.full: From G2532 and G1563; likewise in that place: - and there, there (thither) also.

G2547.full: From G2532 and G1564; likewise from that place (or time): - and afterward (from) (thence), thence also.

G2548.firstSense: and him (other, them), even he, him also, them (also), (and) they
G2548.full: From G2532 and G1565; likewise that (or those): - and him (other, them), even he, him also, them (also), (and) they.

G2549.full: From G2556; badness, that is, (subjectively) depravity, or (actively) malignity, or (passively) trouble: - evil, malice (-iousness), naughtiness, wickedness.

G2550.full: From a compound of G2556 and G2239; bad character, that is, (specifically) mischievousness: - malignity.

G2551.full: From a compound of G2556 nad G3056; to revile: - curse, speak evil of.

G2552.full: From a compound of G2256 and G3806; hardship: - suffering affliction.

G2553.firstSense: be afflicted, endure afflictions (hardness), suffer trouble
G2553.full: From the same as G2552; to undergo hardship: - be afflicted, endure afflictions (hardness), suffer trouble.

G2554.full: From G2555; to be a bad doer, that is, (objectively) to injure, or (generally) to sin: - do (-ing) evil.

G2555.full: From G2556 and G4160; a bad doer; (specifically) a criminal: - evil-doer, malefactor.

G2556.firstSense: bad, evil, harm, ill, noisome, wicked
G2556.full: Apparently a primary word; worthless (intrinsically such; whereas G4190 properly refers to effects), that is, (subjectively) depraved, or (objectively) injurious: - bad, evil, harm, ill, noisome, wicked.

G2557.full: From G2556 and the base of G2041; a wrong doer, that is, criminal: - evil-doer, malefactor.

G2558.full: From a presumed compound of G2556 and G2192; to maltreat: - which suffer adversity, torment.

G2559.firstSense: make evil affected, entreat evil, harm, hurt, vex
G2559.full: From G2556; to injure; figuratively to exasperate: - make evil affected, entreat evil, harm, hurt, vex.

G2560.firstSense: amiss, diseased, evil, grievously, miserably, sick, sore
G2560.full: Adverb from G2556; badly (physically or morally): - amiss, diseased, evil, grievously, miserably, sick, sore.

G2562.full: Feminine of G2563; a stalk of grain, that is, (collectively) stubble: - stubble.

G2563.full: Of uncertain affinity; a reed (the plant or its stem, or that of a similar plant); by implication a pen: - pen, reed.

G2564.full: Akin to the base of G2753; to "call" (properly aloud, but used in a variety of applications, directly or otherwise): - bid, call (forth), (whose, whose sur-) name (was [called]).

G2565.full: From the base of G2566 and G1636; a cultivated olive tree, that is, a domesticated or improved one: - good olive tree.

G2566.full: Neuter of the (irregular) compound of G2570; (adverbially) better than many: - very well.

G2567.full: From G2570 and G1320; a teacher of the right: - teacher of good things.

G2568.full: Plural of G2570 and G3040; Good Harbors, that is, Fairhaven, a bay of Crete: - fair havens.

G2569.full: From G2570 and G4160; to do well, that is, live virtuously: - well doing.

G2570.firstSense: X better, fair, good (-ly), honest, meet, well, worthy
G2570.full: Of uncertain affinity; properly beautiful, but chiefly (figuratively) good (literally or morally), that is, valuable or virtuous (for appearance or use, and thus distinguished from G18, which is properly intrinsic): - X better, fair, good (-ly), honest, meet, well, worthy.

G2571.full: From G2572; a cover, that is, veil: - vail.

G2572.full: Akin to G2813 and G2928; to cover up (literally or figuratively): - cover, hide.

G2573.full: Adverb from G2570; well (usually morally): - (in a) good (place), honestly, + recover, (full) well.

G2575.full: Probably from G2545; a furnace: - furnace.

G2576.full: For a compound of G2596 and the base of G3466; to shut down, that is, close the eyes: - close.

G2577.full: Apparently a primary verb; properly to toil, that is, (by implication) to tire (figuratively faint, sicken): - faint, sicken, be wearied.

G2578.full: Apparently a primary verb; to bend: - bow.

G2579.firstSense: and (also) if (so much as), if but, at the least, though, yet
G2579.full: kan kan From G2532 nad G1437; and (or even) if: - and (also) if (so much as), if but, at the least, though, yet.

G2580.full: Of Hebrew origin (compare [H7071]); Cana, a place in Palestine: - Cana.

G2581.firstSense: Canaanite [by mistake for a derivationfrom G5477]
G2581.full: Of Chaldee origin (compare [H7067]); zealous; Cananites, an epithet. (By mistake for a derivative from G5477): - Canaanite [by mistake for a derivationfrom G5477].

G2582.full: Of foreign origin; Candace, an Egyptian queen: - Candace.

G2583.full: Fromêá́íç kanē (a straight reed, that is, rod); a rule ("canon"), that is, (figuratively) a standard (of faith and practice); by implication a boundary, that is, (figuratively) a sphere (of activity): - line, rule.

G2584.full: Of Hebrew origin (probably [H3723] and [H5151]); Capernaum (that is, Caphanachum), a place in Palestine: - Capernaum.

G2585.full: From êá́ðçëïò kapēlos (a huckster); to retail, that is, (by implication) to adulterate (figuratively): - corrupt.

G2587.full: Of foreign origin; Cappadocia, a region of Asia Minor: - Cappadocia.

G2588.full: Prolonged from a primary êá́ñ kar (Latin cor, "heart"); the heart, that is, (figuratively) the thoughts or feelings (mind); also (by analogy) the middle: - (+ broken-) heart (-ed).

G2589.full: From G2588 and G1097; a heart knower: - which knowest the hearts.

G2590.full: Probably from the base of G726; fruit (as plucked), literally or figuratively: - fruit.

G2591.full: Perhaps for G2590; Carpus, probably a Christian: - Carpus.

G2592.full: From G2593; to be fertile (literally or figuratively): - be (bear, bring forth) fruit (-ful).

G2593.full: From G2590 and G5342; fruitbearing (figuratively): - fruitful.

G2594.full: From a derivative of G2904 (transposed); to be strong, that is, (figuratively) steadfast (patient): - endure.

G2595.full: From êá́ñöù karpho (to wither); a dry twig or straw: - mote.

G2596.firstSense: about, according as (to), after, against, (when they were) X alone, among, and, X apart…
G2596.full: A primary particle; (preposition) down (in place or time), in varied relations (according to the case [genitive, dative or accusative] with which it is joined): - about, according as (to), after, against, (when they were) X alone, among, and, X apart, (even, like) as (concerning, pertaining to, touching), X aside, at, before, beyond, by, to the charge of, [charita-] bly, concerning, + covered, [dai-] ly, down, every, (+ far more) exceeding, X more excellent, for, from . . . to, godly, in (-asmuch, divers, every, -to, respect of), . . . by, after the manner of, + by any means, beyond (out of) measure, X mightily, more, X natural, of (up-) on (X part), out (of every), over against, (+ your) X own, + particularly, so, through (-oughout, -oughout every), thus, (un-) to (-gether, -ward), X uttermost, where (-by), with. In composition it retains many of these applications, and frequently denotes opposition, distribution or intensity.

G2597.firstSense: come (get, go, step) down, descend, fall (down)
G2597.full: From G2596 and the base of G939; to descend (literally or figuratively): - come (get, go, step) down, descend, fall (down).

G2598.full: From G2596 and G906; to throw down: - cast down, lay.

G2599.full: From G2596 and G916; to impose upon: - burden

G2601.full: From G2596 and a derivative of the base of G939; to cause to go down, that is, precipitate: - bring (thrust) down.

G2602.full: From G2598; a deposition, that is, founding; figuratively conception: - conceive, foundation.

G2603.full: From G2596 and G1018 (in its original sense); to award the price against, that is, (figuratively) to defraud (of salvation): - beguile of reward.

G2604.full: From G2605; a proclaimer: - setter forth.

G2605.firstSense: declare, preach, shew, speak of, teach
G2605.full: From G2596 and the base of G32; to proclaim, promulgate: - declare, preach, shew, speak of, teach.

G2606.full: To laugh down, that is, deride: - laugh to scorn.

G2607.full: From G2596 and G1097; to note against, that is, find fault with: - blame, condemn.

G2608.full: From G2596 and the base of G4486; to rend in pieces, that is, crack apart: - break.

G2609.full: From G2596 and G71; to lead down; specifically to moor a vessel: - bring (down, forth), (bring to) land, touch.

G2610.full: From G2596 and G75; to struggle against, that is, (by implication) to overcome: - subdue.

G2611.full: From G2596 and G1210; to tie down, that is, bandage (a wound): - bind up.

G2612.full: From G2596 intensively and G1212; manifest: - far more evident.

G2613.full: From G2596 and a derivative of G1349; to adjudge against, that is, pronounce guilty: - condemn.

G2614.full: From G2596 and G1377; to hunt down, that is, search for: - follow after.

G2615.full: From G2596 and G1402; to enslave utterly: - bring into bondage.

G2616.full: From G2596 and a derivative of G1413; to exercise dominion against, that is, oppress: - oppress.

G2617.firstSense: confound, dishonour, (be a-, make a-) shame (-d)
G2617.full: From G2596 and G153; to shame down, that is, disgrace or (by implication) put to the blush: - confound, dishonour, (be a-, make a-) shame (-d).

G2618.full: From G2596 and G2545; to burn down (to the ground), that is, consume wholly: - burn (up, utterly).

G2619.full: From G2596 and G2572; to cover wholly, that is, veil: - cover, hide.

G2620.full: From G2596 and G2744; to exult against (that is, over): - boast (against), glory, rejoice against.

G2621.full: From G2596 and G2749; to lie down, that is, (by implication) be sick; specifically to recline at a meal: - keep, lie, sit at meat (down).

G2622.full: From G2596 and G2806; to break down, that is, divide: - break.

G2623.full: From G2596 and G2808; to shut down (in a dungeon), that is, incarcerate: - shut up.

G2624.full: From G2596 and a derivative of a compound of G2819 and G1325; to be a giver of lots to each, that is, (by implication) to apportion an estate: - divide by lot.

G2625.full: From G2596 and G2827; to recline down, that is, (specifically) to take a place at table: - (make) sit down (at meat).

G2626.full: From G2596 and the base of G2830; to dash (wash) down, that is, (by implication) to deluge: - overflow.

G2628.full: From G2596 and G190; to accompany closely: - follow (after).

G2629.full: From G2596 and G2875; to chop down, that is, mangle: - cut.

G2630.full: From G2596 and a derivative of G2911; to precipitate down: - cast down headlong.

G2631.full: From G2632; an adverse sentence (the verdict): - condemnation.

G2632.full: From G2596 and G2919; to judge against, that is, sentence: - condemn, damn.

G2633.full: From G2632; sentencing adversely (the act): - condemn (-ation).

G2634.firstSense: exercise dominion over (lordship), be lord over, overcome
G2634.full: From G2596 and G2961; to lord against, that is, control, subjugate: - exercise dominion over (lordship), be lord over, overcome.

G2635.full: From G2637; to be a traducer, that is, to slander: - speak against (evil of).

G2636.full: From G2637; defamation: - backbiting, evil speaking.

G2637.full: From G2596 and the base of G2980; talkative against, that is, a slanderer: - backbiter.

G2638.firstSense: apprehend, attain, come upon, comprehend, find, obtain, perceive, (over-) take
G2638.full: From G2596 and G1983; to take eagerly, that is, seize, possess, etc. (literally or figuratively): - apprehend, attain, come upon, comprehend, find, obtain, perceive, (over-) take.

G2639.full: From G2596 and G3004 (in its original meaning); to lay down, that is, (figuratively) to enrol: - take into the number.

G2640.full: From G2641; a remainder, that is, (by implication) a few: - remnant.

G2641.full: From G2596 and G3007; to leave down, that is, behind; by implication to abandon, have remaining: - forsake, leave, reserve.

G2642.full: From G2596 and G3034; to stone down, that is, to death: - stone.

G2643.full: From G2644; exchange (figuratively adjustment), that is, restoration to (the divine) favor: - atonement, reconciliation (-ing).

G2644.full: From G2596 and G236; to change mutually, that is, (figuratively) to compound a difference: - reconcile.

G2645.full: From G2596 and G3062; left down (behind), that is, remaining (plural the rest): - residue.

G2646.full: From G2647; properly a dissolution (breaking up of a journey), that is, (by implication) a lodging place: - guestchamber, inn.

G2647.firstSense: destroy, dissolve, be guest, lodge, come to nought, overthrow, throw down
G2647.full: From G2596 and G3089; to loosen down (disintegrate), that is, (by implication) to demolish (literally or figuratively); specifically (compare G2646) to halt for the night: - destroy, dissolve, be guest, lodge, come to nought, overthrow, throw down.

G2648.full: From G2596 and G3129; to learn thoroughly, that is, (by implication) to note carefully: - consider.

G2649.full: From G2596 and G3140; to testify against: - witness against.

G2650.full: From G2596 and G3306; to stay fully, that is, reside: - abide.

G2651.full: From G2596 and the accusative plural feminine of G3441 (with G5561 implied); according to sole places, that is, (adverbially) separately: - alone.

G2652.full: From G2596 (intensive) and G331; an imprecation: - curse.

G2653.full: From G2596 (intensive) and G332; to imprecate: - curse.

G2654.full: From G2596 and G355; to consume utterly: - consume.

G2655.full: From G2596 and íáñêá́ù narkaō (to be numb); to grow utterly torpid, that is, (by implication) slothful (figuratively expensive): - be burdensome (chargeable).

G2656.full: From G2596 and G3506; to nod down (towards), that is, (by analogy) to make signs to: - beckon.

G2657.full: From G2596 and G3539; to observe fully: - behold, consider, discover, perceive.

G2658.full: From G2596 and a derivative of G473; to meet against, that is, arrive at (literally or figuratively): - attain, come.

G2659.full: From G2660; a prickling (sensation, as of the limbs asleep), that is, (by implication [perhaps by some confusion with G3506 or even with G3571]) stupor (lethargy): - slumber.

G2660.full: From G2596 and G3572; to pierce thoroughly, that is, (figuratively) to agitate violently ("sting to the quick"): - prick.

G2661.full: From G2596 and G515; to deem entirely deserving: - (ac-) count worthy.

G2662.full: From G2596 and G3961; to trample down; figuratively to reject with disdain: - trample, tread (down, underfoot).

G2663.full: From G2664; reposing down, that is, (by Hebraism) abode: - rest.

G2664.full: From G2596 and G3973; to settle down, that is, (literally) to colonize, or (figuratively) to (cause to) desist: - cease, (give) rest (-rain).

G2665.full: From a compound of G2596 and a congener of G4072; something spread thoroughly, that is, (specifically) the door screen (to the Most Holy Place) in the Jewish Temple: - vail.

G2666.full: From G2596 and G4095; to drink down, that is, gulp entire (literally or figuratively): - devour, drown, swallow (up).

G2667.full: From G2596 and G4098; to fall down: - fall (down).

G2668.full: From G2596 and G4126; to sail down upon a place, that is, to land at: - arrive.

G2669.full: From G2596 and a derivative of G4192; to labor down, that is, wear with toil (figuratively harass): - oppress, vex.

G2670.full: From G2596 and a derivative of the same as G4195; to plunge down, that is, submerge: - drown, sink.

G2671.full: From G2596 (intensive) and G685; imprecation, execration: - curse (-d, -ing).

G2672.full: Middle voice from G2671; to execrate; by analogy to doom: - curse.

G2673.firstSense: abolish, cease, cumber, deliver, destroy, do away, become (make) of no (none, without)…
G2673.full: From G2596 and G691; to be (render) entirely idle (useless), literally or figuratively: - abolish, cease, cumber, deliver, destroy, do away, become (make) of no (none, without) effect, fail, loose, bring (come) to nought, put away (down), vanish away, make void.

G2674.full: From G2596 and G705; to reckon among: - number with.

G2675.firstSense: fit, frame, mend, (make) perfect (-ly join together), prepare, restore
G2675.full: From G2596 and a derivative of G739; to complete thoroughly, that is, repair (literally or figuratively) or adjust: - fit, frame, mend, (make) perfect (-ly join together), prepare, restore.

G2678.full: From G2596 and G4579; to sway downward, that is, make a signal: - beckon.

G2679.full: From G2596 and G4626; to undermine, that is, (by implication) destroy: - dig down, ruin.

G2680.full: From G2596 and a derivative of G4632; to prepare thoroughly (properly by external equipment; whereas G2090 refers rather to internal fitness); by implication to construct, create: - build, make, ordain, prepare.

G2681.full: From G2596 and G4637; to camp down, that is, haunt; figuratively to remain: - lodge, rest.

G2682.full: From G2681; an encamping, that is, (figuratively) a perch: - nest.

G2683.full: From G2596 and a derivative of G4639; to overshade, that is, cover: - shadow.

G2684.full: From G2685; to be a sentinel, that is, to inspect insidiously: - spy out.

G2685.full: From G2596 (intensive) and G4649 (in the sense of a watcher); a reconnoiterer: - spy.

G2686.full: Middle voice from G2596 and G4679; to be crafty against, that is, circumvent: - deal subtilly with.

G2687.full: From G2596 and G4724; to put down, that is, quell: - appease, quiet.

G2688.full: From G2525; properly a position or condition, that is, (subjectively) demeanor: - behaviour.

G2689.full: From G2687; a deposit, that is, (specifically) costume: - apparel.

G2690.full: From G2596 and G4762; to turn upside down, that is, upset: - overthrow.

G2691.full: From G2596 and G4763; to become voluptuous against: - begin to wax wanton against.

G2692.full: From G2690; an overturn ("catastrophe"), that is, demolition; figuratively apostasy: - overthrow, subverting.

G2693.full: From G2596 and G4766; to strew down, that is, (by implication) to prostrate (slay): - overthrow.

G2694.full: From G2596 and G4951; to drag down, that is, arrest judicially: - hale.

G2695.full: From G2596 and G4969; to kill down, that is, slaughter: - slay.

G2696.full: From G2596 and G4972; to seal closely: - seal.

G2697.full: From G2722; a holding down, that is, occupancy: - possession.

G2698.full: From G2596 and G5087; to place down, that is, deposit (literally or figuratively): - do, lay, shew.

G2699.full: From a compound of G2596 and ôǻìíù temnō (to cut); a cutting down (off), that is, mutilation (ironically): - concision. Compare G609.

G2700.full: From G2596 and a derivative of G5115; to shoot down with an arrow or other missile: - thrust through.

G2701.full: From G2596 and G5143; to run down, that is, hasten from a tower: - run down.

G2702.full: From G2596 and G5342 (including its alternate); to bear down, that is, (figuratively) overcome (with drowsiness); specifically to cast a vote: - fall, give, sink down.

G2703.full: From G2596 and G5343; to flee down (away): - flee.

G2704.full: From G2596 and G5351; to spoil entirely, that is, (literally) to destroy; or (figuratively) to deprave: - corrupt, utterly perish.

G2705.full: From G2596 and G5368; to kiss earnestly: - kiss.

G2706.full: From G2596 and G5426; to think against, that is, disesteem: - despise.

G2708.full: From G2596 and ÷ǻù cheō (to pour); to pour down (out): - pour.

G2709.full: From G2596 and ÷èù́í chthōn (the ground); subterranean, that is, infernal (belonging to the world of departed spirits): - under the earth.

G2710.full: From G2596 and G5530; to overuse, that is, misuse: - abuse.

G2711.full: From G2596 and G5594; to cool down (off), that is, refresh: - cool.

G2712.full: From G2596 (intensive) and G1497; utterly idolatrous: - wholly given to idolatry.

G2713.full: From G2596 and G1725; directly opposite: - before, over against.

G2714.firstSense: before (the presence of), in the sight of
G2714.full: From G2596 and G1799; directly in front of: - before (the presence of), in the sight of.

G2715.full: From G2596 and G1850; to have (wield) full privilege over: - exercise authority.

G2719.full: From G2596 and G2068 (including its alternate); to eat down, that is, devour (literally or figuratively): - devour.

G2721.full: From G2596 and G2186; to stand over against, that is, rush upon (assault): - make insurrection against.
