H335.full: ah'ee Perhaps from H370; where? hence how?: - how, what, whence, where, whether, which (way).

H336.full: Probably identical with H335 (through the idea of a query); not. (Job_22:30): - island (Job H22 : H30).

H338.full: Probably identical with H337 (through the idea of a doleful sound); a howler (used only in the plural), that is, any solitary wild creature: - wild beast of the islands.

H339.full: From H183; properly a habitable spot (as desirable); dry land, a coast, an island: - country, isle, island.

H340.full: aw-yab' A primitive root; to hate (as one of an opposite tribe or party); hence to be hostile: - be an enemy.

H341.full: Active participle of H340; hating; an adversary: - enemy, foe.

H343.full: ade From the same as H181 (in the sense of bending down); oppression; by implication misfortune, ruin: - calamity, destruction.

H344.full: ah-yaw' Perhaps from H337; the screamer, that is, a hawk: - kite, vulture.

H345.full: ah-yaw' The same as H344; Ajah, the name of two Israelites: - Aiah, Ajah.

H346.full: ah-yay' Prolonged from H335; where?: - where.

H347.full: From H340; hated (that is, persecuted); Ijob, the patriarch famous for his patience: - Job.

H348.full: ee-zeh'-bel From H336 and H2083; chaste, Izebel, the wife of king Ahab: - Jezebel.

H349.full: Prolonged from H335; how? or how!; also where: - how, what.

H350.full: From H336 and H3519; (there is) no glory, that is, inglorious; Ikabod, a son of Phineas: - I-chabod.

H351.full: Probably a variation for H349, but not as an interrogative; where: - where.

H352.firstSense: mighty (man), lintel, oak, post, ram, tree
H352.full: ah'-yil From the same as H193; properly strength; hence anything strong; specifically a chief (politically); also a ram (from his strength); a pilaster (as a strong support); an oak or other strong tree: - mighty (man), lintel, oak, post, ram, tree.

H353.full: A variation of H352; strength: - strength.

H354.full: ah-yawl' An intensive form of H352 (in the sense of ram); a stag or male deer: - hart.

H355.full: ah-yaw-law' Feminine of H354; a doe or female deer: - hind.

H356.full: From H352; oakgrove; Elon, the name of a place in Palestine, and also of one Hittite, two Israelite: - Elon.

H357.full: ah-yaw-lone' From H354; deerfield; Ajalon, the name of five places in Palestine: - Aijalon, Ajalon.

H358.full: ay-lone' bayth-khaw-nawn' From H356, H1004, and H2603; oakgrove of (the) house of favor; Elon of Bethchanan, a place in Palestine: - Elon-beth-hanan.

H359.full: ay-loth', ay-lath' From H352; trees or a grove (that is, palms); Eloth or Elath, a place on the Red Sea: - Elath, Eloth.

H360.full: Feminine of H353; power; by implication protection: - strength.

H361.full: Probably from H352; a pillar space (or colonnade), that is, a pale (or portico): - arch.

H362.full: ay-leem' Plural of H352; palm trees; Elim, a place in the Desert: - Elim.

H363.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H356; a tree: - tree.

H364.full: From H352 and H6290; oak of Paran; El Paran, a portion of the district of Paran: - El-paran.

H365.full: ay-yeh'-leth The same as H355; a doe: - hind, Aijeleth.

H366.full: From an unused root (meaning to frighten); frightful: - terrible.

H367.full: From the same as H366; fright; concretely an idol (as a bugbear): - dread. fear, horror, idol, terrible, terror.

H368.full: ay-meem' Plural of H367; terrors; Emim, an early Canaanitish (or Moabitish) tribe: - Emims.

H369.firstSense: else, except, fail [father-] less, be gone, in [-curable], neither, never, no (where),…
H369.full: ay'-yin As if from a primitive root meaning to be nothing or not exist; a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle: - else, except, fail [father-] less, be gone, in [-curable], neither, never, no (where), none, nor (any, thing), not, nothing, to nought, past, un [-searchable], well-nigh, without, Compare H370.

H370.full: ah-yin' Probably identical with H369 in the sense of query (compare H336); where? (only in connection with prepositional prefix, whence): - whence, where.

H371.full: een Apparently a shortened form of H369; but (like H370) interrogitive; is it not?: - not

H372.full: From H336 and H5828; helpless; Iezer, an Israelite: - Jeezer.

H373.full: Patronymic from H372; an Iezrite or descendant of Iezer: - Jezerite.

H374.full: Of Egyptian derivation; an ephah or measure for grain; hence a measure in general: - ephah, (divers) measure (-s).

H375.full: ay-fo' From H335 and H6311; what place?; also (of time) when?; or (of means) how?: - what manner, where.

H376.firstSense: also, another, any (man), a certain, + champion, consent, each, every (one), fellow, [f…
H376.full: eesh Contracted for H582 (or perhaps rather from an unused root meaning to be extant); a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation.) : - also, another, any (man), a certain, + champion, consent, each, every (one), fellow, [foot-, husband-] man, (good-, great, mighty) man, he, high (degree), him (that is), husband, man [-kind], + none, one, people, person, + steward, what (man) soever, whoso (-ever), worthy. Compare H802.

H377.full: eesh Denominative from H376; to be a man, that is, act in a manly way: - show (one) self a man.

H378.full: eesh-bo'-sheth From H376 and H1322; man of shame; IshBosheth, a son of King Saul: - Ish-bosheth.

H379.full: eesh-hode' From H376 and H1935; man of renown; Ishod, an Israelite: - Ishod.

H380.full: ee-shone' Diminutive from H376; the little man of the eye; the pupil or ball; hence the middle (of night): - apple [of the eye], black, obscure.

H381.full: eesh-khah'-yil, eesh-khah'ee From H376 and H2428; man of might; (The second form is by defective transcription used in 2Sa_23:20); as if from H376 and H2416; living man; Ishchail (or Ishchai), an Israelite: - a valiant man.

H382.full: From H376 and H2897; man of Tob; Ish-Tob, a place in Palestine: - Ish-tob.

H383.firstSense: art thou, can, do ye, have it be, there is (are), X we will not
H383.full: ee-thah'ee (Chaldee); corresponding to H3426; properly entity; used only as a particle of affirmation, there is: - art thou, can, do ye, have it be, there is (are), X we will not.

H384.full: Perhaps from H837 and H410; God has arrived; Ithiel, the name of an Israelite, also of a symbolic person: - Ithiel.

H385.full: From H339 and H8558; coast of the palm tree; Ithamar, a son of Aaron: - Ithamar.

H386.full: ay-thawn' From an unused root (meaning to continue); permanence; hence (concretely) permanent; specifically a chieftain: - hard, mighty, rough, strength, strong.

H387.full: ay-thawn' The same as H386; permanent; Ethan, the name of four Israelites: - Ethan.

H388.full: ay-thaw-neem' Plural of H386; always with the article; the permanent brooks; Ethanim, the name of a month: - Ethanim.

H389.firstSense: also, in any wise, at least, but, certainly, even, howbeit, nevertheless, notwithstandi…
H389.full: ak Akin to H403; a particle of affirmation, surely; hence (by limitation) only: - also, in any wise, at least, but, certainly, even, howbeit, nevertheless, notwithstanding, only, save, surely of a surety, truly, verily, + wherefore, yet (but).

H390.full: ak-kad' From an unused root probably meaning to strengthen; a fortress; Accad, a place in Babylon: - Accad.

H391.full: ak-zawb' From H3576; falsehood; by implication treachery: - liar, lie.

H392.full: ak-zeeb' From H391; deceitful (in the sense of a winter torrent which fails in summer); Akzib, the name of two places in Palestine: - Achzib.

H393.full: ak-zawr' From an unused root (apparently meaning to act harshly); violent; by implication deadly; also (in a good sense) brave: - cruel, fierce.

H396.full: Feminine from H398; something eatable, that is, food: - meat.

H397.full: aw-keesh' Of uncertain derivation; Akish, a Philistine king: - Achish.

H398.firstSense: X at all, burn up, consume, devour (-er, up), dine, eat (-er, up), feed (with), food, X…
H398.full: aw-kal' A primitive root; to eat (literally or figuratively): - X at all, burn up, consume, devour (-er, up), dine, eat (-er, up), feed (with), food, X freely, X in . . . wise (-deed, plenty), (lay) meat, X quite.

H399.full: ak-al' (Chaldee); corresponding to H398: - + accuse, devour, eat.

H400.firstSense: eating, food, meal [-time], meat, prey, victuals
H400.full: o'-kel From H398; food: - eating, food, meal [-time], meat, prey, victuals.

H401.full: Apparently from H398; devoured; Ucal, a fancy name: - Ucal.

H402.full: Feminine of H401; food: - consume, devour, eat, food, meat.

H403.firstSense: but, certainly, nevertheless, surely, truly, verily
H403.full: From H3559 (compare H3651); firmly; figuratively surely; also (adversely) but: - but, certainly, nevertheless, surely, truly, verily.

H404.full: aw-kaf' A primitive root; apparent meaning to curve (as with a burden); to urge: - crave.

H405.full: eh'-kef From H404; a load; by implication a stroke (others dignity): - hand.

H406.full: ik-kawr' From an unused root meaning to dig; a farmer: - husbandman, ploughman.

H407.full: ak-shawf' From H3784; fascination; Acshaph, a place in Palestine: - Achshaph.

H408.firstSense: nay, neither, + never, no, nor, not, nothing [worth], rather than
H408.full: al A negative particle (akin to H3808); not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job_24:25) as a noun, nothing: - nay, neither, + never, no, nor, not, nothing [worth], rather than.

H410.firstSense: God (god), X goodly, X great, idol, might (-y one), power, strong
H410.full: Shortened from H352; strength; as adjective mighty; especially the Almighty (but used also of any deity): - God (god), X goodly, X great, idol, might (-y one), power, strong. Compare names in "-el."

H411.full: A demonstrative particle (but only in a plural sense) these or those: - these, those, Compare H428.

H413.firstSense: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because (-fore, -side), both
H413.full: ale, el (Used only in the shortened constructive form (the second form)); a primitive particle, properly denoting motion towards, but occasionally used of a quiescent position, that is, near, with or among; often in general, to: - about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because (-fore, -side), both . . . and, by, concerning, for, from, X hath, in (-to), near, (out) of, over, through,to (-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).

H414.full: A variation of H424; oak; Ela, an Israelite: - Elah.

H415.full: From H410 and H430 and H3478; the mighty God of Jisrael; El Elohi Jisrael, the title given to a consecrated spot by Jacob: - El-elohe-israel.

H416.full: ale bayth-ale' From H410 and H1008; the God of Bethel; El-Bethel, the title given to a consecrated spot by Jacob: - El-beth-el.

H417.full: el-gaw-beesh' From H410 and H1378; hail (as if a great pearl): - great hail [-stones].

H418.full: al-goom-meem' By transposition for H484; sticks of algum wood: - algum [trees].

H419.full: el-dad' From H410 and H1780; God has loved; Eldad, an Israelite: - Eldad.

H420.full: From H410 and H3045; God of knowledge; Eldaah, a son of Midian: - Eldaah.

H421.full: A primitive root (rather identical with H422 through the idea of invocation); to bewail: - lament.

H422.full: A primitive root; properly to adjure, that is, (usually in a bad sense) imprecate: - adjure, curse, swear.

H423.full: From H422; an imprecation: - curse, cursing, execration, oath, swearing.

H424.full: Feminine of H352; an oak or other strong tree: - elm, oak, teil tree

H425.full: The same as H424; Elah, the name of an Edomite, or four Israelites, and also of a place in Palestine: - Elah.

H426.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H433; God: - God, god.

H427.full: al-law' A variation of H424: - oak.

H428.full: ale'-leh Prolonged from H411; these or those: - an- (the) other; one sort, so, some, such, them, these (same), they, this, those, thus, which, who (-m).

H430.firstSense: angels, X exceeding, God (gods) (-dess, -ly), X (very) great, judges, X mighty
H430.full: Plural of H433; gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative: - angels, X exceeding, God (gods) (-dess, -ly), X (very) great, judges, X mighty.

H431.full: (Chaldee); probably prolonged from H412; lo!: - behold.

H432.full: il-loo' Probably from H408; nay, that is, (softened) if: - but if, yea though.

H433.full: el-o'-ah, el-o'-ah (The second form is rare); probably prolonged (emphatically) from H410; a deity or the deity: - God, god. See H430.

H434.full: For H457; good for nothing: - thing of nought.

H435.full: Probably of foreign derivation; Elul, the sixth Jewish month: - Elul.

H436.full: Prolonged from H352; an oak or other strong tree: - plain. See also H356.

H437.full: al-lone' A variation of H436: - oak.

H438.full: al-lone' The same as H437; Allon, an Israelite, also a place in Palestine: - Allon.

H439.full: al-lone' baw-kooth' From H437 and a variation of H1068; oak of weeping; Allon-Bakuth, a monumental tree: - Allon-bachuth.

H440.full: Patronymic from H438; an Elonite or descendant (collectively) of Elon: - Elonites.

H441.firstSense: captain, duke, (chief) friend, governor, guide, ox
H441.full: al-loof', al-loof' From H502; familiar; a friend, also gentle; hence a bullock (as being tame; applied, although masculine, to a cow); and so a chieftain (as notable like neat cattle): - captain, duke, (chief) friend, governor, guide, ox.

H442.full: Of uncertain derivation; Alush, a place in the Desert: - Alush.

H443.full: el-zaw-bawd' From H410 and H2064; God has bestowed; Elzabad, the name of two Israelites: - Elzabad.

H444.full: aw-lakh' A primitive root; to muddle, that is, (figuratively and intransitively) to turn (morally) corrupt: - become filthy.

H445.full: el-khaw-nawn' From H410 and H2603; God (is) gracious; Elchanan, an Israelite: - Elkanan.

H446.full: From H410 and H1; God of (his) father; Eliab, the name of six Israelites: - Eliab.

H447.full: From H410 repeated; God of (his) God; Eliel, the name of nine Israelites: - Eliel.

H448.full: From H410 and H225; God of (his) consent; Eliathah, an Israelite: - Eliathah.

H449.full: From the same as H419; God of (his) love; Elidad, an Israelite: - Elidad.

H450.full: From H410 and H3045; God (is) knowing; Eljada, the name of two Israelites and of an Aramaean: - Eliada.

H451.full: al-yaw' From H422 (in the original sense of strength); the stout part, that is, the fat tail of the Oriental sheep: - rump.

H452.full: From H410 and H3050; God of Jehovah; Elijah, the name of the famous prophet and of two other Israelites: - Elijah, Eliah.

H453.full: From H410 and H1931; God of him; Elihu, the name of one of Job's friends, and of three Israelites: - Elihu.

H454.full: el-ye-ho-ay-nah'ee, el-yo-ay-nah'ee From H413 and H3068 and H5869; towards Jehovah (are) my eyes; Eljehoenai or Eljoenai, the name of seven Israelites: - Elihoenai, Elionai.

H455.full: el-yakh-baw' From H410 and H2244; God will hide; Eljachba, an Israelite: - Eliahbah.

H456.full: el-ee-kho'-ref From H410 and H2779; God of autumn; Elichoreph, an Israelite: - Elihoreph.

H457.firstSense: idol, no value, thing of nought
H457.full: Apparently from H408; good for nothing, by analogy vain or vanity; specifically an idol: - idol, no value, thing of nought.

H458.full: el-ee-meh'-lek From H410 and H4428; God of (the) king; Elimelek, an Israelite: - Elimelech.

H459.full: il-lane', il-lane' (Chaldee); prolonged from H412; these: - the, these.

H460.full: el-yaw-sawf' From H410 and H3254; God (is) gatherer; Eljasaph, the name of two Israelites: - Eliasaph.

H461.full: From H410 and H5828; God of help; Eliezer, the name of a Damascene and of ten Israelites: - Eliezer.

H462.full: Probably contracted for H454; Elienai, an Israelite: - Elienai.

H463.full: From H410 and H5971; God of (the) people; Eliam, an Israelite: - Eliam.

H464.full: el-ee-faz' From H410 and H6337; God of gold; Eliphaz, the name of one of Job's friends, and of a son of Esau: - Eliphaz.

H465.full: From H410 and H6419; God of judgment; Eliphal, an Israelite: - Eliphal.

H466.full: From H410 and H6395; God of his distinction; Eliphelehu, an Israelite: - Elipheleh.

H467.full: el-ee-feh'-let, el-peh'-let From H410 and H6405; God of deliverance; Eliphelet or Elpelet, the name of six Israelites: - Eliphalet, Eliphelet, Elpalet.

H468.full: From H410 and H6697; God of (the) rock; Elitsur, an Israelite: - Elizur.

H469.full: el-ee-tsaw-fawn', el-tsaw-fawn' From H410 and H6845; God of treasure; Elitsaphan or Eltsaphan, an Israelite: - Elizaphan, Elzaphan.

H470.full: From H410 and H6958; God of rejection; Elika, an Israelite: - Elika.

H471.full: el-yaw-keem' From H410 and H6965; God of raising; Eljakim, the name of four Israelites: - Eliakim.

H472.full: el-ee-sheh'-bah From H410 and H7651 (in the sense of H7650); God of (the) oath; Elisheba, the wife of Aaron: - Elisheba.

H473.full: Probably of foreign derivation; Elishah, a son of Javan: - Elishah.

H474.full: From H410 and H7769; God of supplication (or of riches); Elishua, a son of King David: - Elishua.

H475.full: el-yaw-sheeb' From H410 and H7725; God will restore; Eljashib, the name of six Israelites: - Eliashib.

H476.full: From H410 and H8085; God of hearing; Elishama, the name of seven Israelites: - Elishama.

H477.full: Contracted for H474; Elisha, the famous prophet: - Elisha.

H478.full: From H410 and H8199; God of judgment; Elishaphat, an Israelite: - Elishaphat.

H479.full: il-lake' (Chaldee); prolonged from H412; these: - these, those.

H480.full: al-le-lah'ee By reduplication from H421; alas!: - woe.

H481.firstSense: bind, be dumb, put to silence
H481.full: aw-lam' A primitive root; to tie fast; hence (of the mouth) to be tongue tied: - bind, be dumb, put to silence.

H482.full: ay'-lem From H481; silence (that is, mute justice): - congregation. Compare H3128.

H484.full: al-moog-gheem' Probably of foreign derivation (used thus only in the plural); almug (that is, probably sandalwood) sticks: - almug trees. Compare H418.

H485.full: Second form is masculine form; passive participle of H481; something bound; a sheaf: - sheaf.

H486.full: al-mo-dawd' Probably of foreign derivation; Almodad, a son of Joktan: - Almodad.

H487.full: al-lam-meh'-lek From H427 and H4428; oak of (the) king; Allammelek, a place in Palestine: - Alammelech.

H488.full: al-mawn' Prolonged from H481 in the sense of bereavement; discarded (as a divorced person): - forsaken.

H489.full: al-mone' From H481 as in H488; bereavement: - widowhood.

H490.full: al-maw-naw' Feminine of H488; a widow; also a desolate place: - desolate house (palace), widow.

H491.full: al-maw-nooth' Feminine of H488; concretely a widow; abstractly widowhood: - widow, widowhood.

H492.full: al-mo-nee' From H489 in the sense of concealment; some one (that is, so and so, without giving the name of the person or place): - one, and such.

H493.full: el-nah'-am From H410 and H5276; God (is his) delight; Elnaam, an Israelite: - Elnaam.

H494.full: el-naw-thawn' From H410 and H5414; God (is the) giver; Elnathan, the name of four Israelites: - Elnathan.

H495.full: el-law-sawr' Probably of foreign derivation; Ellasar, an early country of Asia: - Ellasar.

H496.full: From H410 and H5749; God has testified; Elad, an Israelite: - Elead.

H497.full: From H410 and H5710; God has decked; Eladah, an Israelite: - Eladah.

H498.full: el-oo-zah'ee From H410 and H5756 (in the sense of H5797); God (is) defensive; Eluzai, an Israelite: - Eluzai.

H499.full: From H410 and H5826; God (is) helper; Elazar, the name of seven Israelites: - Eleazar.

H500.full: From H410 and H5927; God (is) going up; Elale or Elaleh, a place east of the Jordan: - Elealeh.

H501.full: From H410 and H6213; God has made; Elasah, the name of four Israelites: - Elasah, Eleasah.

H502.full: aw-lof' A primitive root, to associate with; hence to learn (and causatively to teach): - learn, teach, utter.

H503.full: aw-laf' Denominative from H505; causatively to make a thousandfold: - bring forth thousands.

H504.full: eh'-lef From H502; a family; also (from the sense of yoking or taming) an ox or cow: - family, kine, oxen.

H505.full: eh'-lef Properly the same as H504; hence (an ox's head being the first letter of the alphabet, and this eventually used as a numeral) a thousand: - thousand.

H506.full: al-af', eh'-lef (Chaldee); corresponding to H505: - thousand.

H507.full: eh'-lef The same as H505; Eleph, a place in Palestine: - Eleph.

H508.full: el-pah'-al From H410 and H6466; God (is) act; Elpaal, an Israelite: - Elpaal.

H509.full: aw-lats' A primitive root; to press: - urge.

H510.full: al-koom' Probably from H408 and H6965; a non-rising (that is, resistlessness): - no rising up.

H511.full: el-kaw-naw' From H410 and H7069; God has obtained; Elkanah, the name of seven Israelites: - Elkanah.

H512.full: el-ko-shee' Patrial from a name of uncertain derivation; an Elkoshite or native of Elkosh: - Elkoshite.

H513.full: el-to-lad' Probably from H410 and a masculine form of H8435 (compare H8434); God (is) generator; Eltolad, a place in Palestine: - Eltolad.

H514.full: el-te-kay', el-te-kay' Of uncertain derivation; Eltekeh or Elteke, a place in Palestine: - Eltekeh.

H515.full: el-te-kone' From H410 and H8626; God (is) straight; Eltekon, a place in Palestine: - Eltekon.

H516.full: al tash-kayth' From H408 and H7843; Thou must not destroy; probably the opening words of a popular song: - Al-taschith.

H517.full: A primitive word; a mother (as the bond of the family); in a wide sense (both literally and figuratively); (like H1): - dam, mother, X parting.

H518.firstSense: (and, can-, doubtless, if, that) (not), + but, either, + except, + more (-over if, than…
H518.full: eem A primitive particle; used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogitive, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence as a negative, not: - (and, can-, doubtless, if, that) (not), + but, either, + except, + more (-over if, than), neither, nevertheless, nor, oh that, or, + save (only, -ing), seeing, since, sith, + surely (no more, none, not), though, + of a truth, + unless, + verily, when, whereas, whether, while, + yet.

H519.full: Apparently a primitive word; a maidservant or female slave: - (hand-) bondmaid (-woman,) maid (-servant).

H520.firstSense: cubit, + hundred [by exchange for H3967], measure, post
H520.full: am-maw' Prolonged from H517; properly a mother (that is, unit) of measure, or the forearm (below the elbow), that is, a cubit; also a door base (as a bond of the entrance): - cubit, + hundred [by exchange for H3967], measure, post.

H522.full: am-maw' The same as H520; Ammah, a hill in Palestine: - Ammah.

H523.full: oom-maw' From the same as H517; a collection, that is, community of persons: - nation, people.

H525.full: From H539, probably in the sense of training; skilled, that is, an architect (like H542): - one brought up.

H526.full: The same as H525; Amon, the name of three Israelites: - Amon.

H527.full: A variation for H1995; a throng of people: - multitude.

H528.full: Of Egyptian derivation; Amon (that is, Ammon or Amn), a deity of Egypt (used only as an adjunct of H4996): - multitude, populous.

H529.full: From H539; established, that is, (figuratively) trusty; also (abstractly) trustworthiness: - faith (-ful), truth.

H530.firstSense: faith (-ful, -ly, -ness, [man]), set office, stability, steady, truly, truth, verily
H530.full: Feminine of H529; literally firmness; figuratively security; moral fidelity: - faith (-ful, -ly, -ness, [man]), set office, stability, steady, truly, truth, verily.

H531.full: From H553; strong; Amots, an Israelite: - Amoz.

H532.full: An abbreviated for H526; Ami, an Israelite: - Ami.

H533.full: am-meets', am-meets' From H553; strong or (abstractly) strength: - courageous, mighty, strong (one).

H534.full: Apparently from H559 (in the sense of self exaltation); a summit (of a tree or mountain): - bough, branch.

H535.full: aw-mal' A primitive root; to droop; by implication to be sick, to mourn: - languish, be weak, wax feeble.

H538.full: From H517; gathering spot; Amam, a place in Palestine: - Amam.

H539.firstSense: hence assurance, believe, bring up, establish, + fail, be faithful (of long continuance…
H539.full: aw-man' A primitive root; properly to build up or support; to foster as a parent or nurse; figuratively to render (or be) firm or faithful, to trust or believe, to be permanent or quiet; morally to be true or certain; once (in Isa_30:21; by interchange for H541) to go to the right hand: - hence assurance, believe, bring up, establish, + fail, be faithful (of long continuance, stedfast, sure, surely, trusty, verified), nurse, (-ing father), (put), trust, turn to the right.

H540.full: am-an' (Chaldee); corresponding to H539: - believe, faithful, sure.

H541.full: aw-man' Denominative from H3225; to take the right hand road: - turn to the right. See H539.

H542.full: From H539 (in the sense of training); an expert: - cunning workman.

H543.full: From H539; sure; abstractly faithfulness; adverbially truly: - Amen, so be it, truth.

H545.full: om-naw' Feminine of H544 (in the specific sense of training); tutelage: - brought up.

H546.full: om-naw' Feminine of H544 (in its usual sense); adverbially surely: - indeed.

H547.full: o-me-naw' Feminine active participle of H544 (in the original sense of supporting); a column: - pillar.

H548.full: Feminine of H543; something fixed, that is, a covenant, an allowance: - certain portion, sure.

H549.full: The same as H548; Amanah, a mountain near Damascus: - Amana.

H550.full: am-nohn', am-ee-nohn' From H539; faithful; Amnon (or Aminon), a son of David: - Amnon.

H551.firstSense: indeed, no doubt, surely, (it is, of a) true (-ly, -th)
H551.full: om-nawm' Adverb from H544; verily: - indeed, no doubt, surely, (it is, of a) true (-ly, -th).

H552.full: An orthographical variation of H551: - in (very) deed; of a surety.

H553.firstSense: confirm, be courageous (of good courage, stedfastly minded, strong, stronger), establis…
H553.full: aw-mats' A primitive root; to be alert, physically (on foot) or mentally (in courage): - confirm, be courageous (of good courage, stedfastly minded, strong, stronger), establish, fortify, harden, increase, prevail, strengthen (self), make strong (obstinate, speed).

H554.full: Probably from H553; of a strong color, that is, red (others fleet): - bay.

H557.full: am-tsee' From H553; strong; Amtsi, an Israelite: - Amzi.

H558.full: am-ats-yaw', am-ats-yaw'-hoo From H553 and H3050; strength of Jah; Amatsjah, the name of four Israelites: - Amaziah.

H559.firstSense: answer, appoint, avouch, bid, boast self, call, certify, challenge, charge, + (at the,…
H559.full: aw-mar' A primitive root; to say (used with great latitude): - answer, appoint, avouch, bid, boast self, call, certify, challenge, charge, + (at the, give) command (ment), commune, consider, declare, demand, X desire, determine, X expressly, X indeed, X intend, name, X plainly, promise, publish, report, require, say, speak (against, of), X still, X suppose, talk, tell, term, X that is, X think, use [speech], utter, X verily, X yet.

H560.full: am-ar' (Chaldee); corresponding to H559: - command, declare, say, speak, tell.

H561.firstSense: answer, X appointed unto him, saying, speech, word
H561.full: ay'-mer From H559; something said: - answer, X appointed unto him, saying, speech, word.

H562.full: o'-mer The same as H561: - promise, speech, thing, word.

H563.full: im-mar' (Chaldee); perhaps from H560 (in the sense of bringing forth); a lamb: - lamb.

H564.full: im-mare' From H559; talkative; Immer, the name of five Israelites: - Immer.

H565.full: im-raw', em-raw' The second form is the feminine of H561, and meaning the same: - commandment, speech, word.

H566.full: im-ree' From H564; wordy; Imri, the name of two Israelites: - Imri.

H567.full: Probably a patronymic from an unused name derived from H559 in the sense of publicity, that is, prominence; thus a mountaineer; an Emorite, one of the Canaanitish tribes: - Amorite.

H568.full: am-ar-yaw', am-ar-yaw'-hoo From H559 and H3050; Jah has said (that is, promised); Amarjah, the name of nine Israelites: - Amariah.

H569.full: am-raw-fel' Of uncertain (perhaps foreign) derivation; Amraphel, a king of Shinar: - Amraphel.

H570.full: eh'-mesh Time past, that is, yesterday or last night: - former time, yesterday (-night).

H571.firstSense: assured (-ly), establishment, faithful, right, sure, true (-ly, -th), verity
H571.full: eh'-meth Contracted from H539; stability; figuratively certainty, truth, trustworthiness: - assured (-ly), establishment, faithful, right, sure, true (-ly, -th), verity.

H572.full: am-takh'-ath From H4969; properly something expansive, that is, a bag: - sack.

H573.full: am-it-tah'ee From H571; veracious; Amittai, an Israelite: - Amittai.

H574.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to that of H4975; well loined (that is, burly) or mighty: - terrible.

H575.full: Contracted from H370; where?; hence whither?, when?; also hither and thither: - + any (no) whither, now, where, whither (-soever).

H576.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H589; I: - I, as for me.

H577.full: Apparently contracted from H160 and H4994: oh now!: - I (me) beseech (pray) thee, O.

H578.full: A primitive root; to groan: - lament, mourn.

H579.firstSense: befall, deliver, happen, seek a quarrel
H579.full: A primitive root (perhaps rather identical with H578 through the idea of contraction in anguish); to approach; hence to meet in various senses: - befall, deliver, happen, seek a quarrel.

H581.full: in-noon', in-neen' (Chaldee); the second form is the feminine of the first form; corresponding to H1992; they: - X are, them, these.

H582.firstSense: another, X [blood-] thirsty, certain, chap [-man], divers, fellow, X in the flower of t…
H582.full: From H605; properly a mortal (and thus differeing from the more dignified H120); hence a man in general (singly or collectively). It is often unexpressed in the English Version, especially when used in apposition with another word: - another, X [blood-] thirsty, certain, chap [-man], divers, fellow, X in the flower of their age, husband, (certain, mortal) man, people, person, servant, some (X of them), + stranger, those, + their trade. It is often unexpressed in the Engl. version, especially when used in apposition with another word. Compare H376.

H583.full: The same as H582; Enosh, a son of Seth: - Enos.

H584.full: aw-nakh' A primitive root; to sigh: - groan, mourn, sigh.

H585.full: From H584; sighing: - groaning, mourn, sigh.

H586.full: an-akh'-naw, an-akh-naw' (Chaldee); corresponding to H587; we: - we.

H587.full: an-akh'-noo Apparently from H595; we: - ourselves, us, we.

H588.full: Probably from the same root as H5170; a gorge or narrow pass; Anacharath, a place in Palestine: - Anaharath.

H589.firstSense: I, (as for) me, mine, myself, we, X which, X who
H589.full: Contracted from H595; I: - I, (as for) me, mine, myself, we, X which, X who.

H590.full: on-ee' Probably from H479 (in the sense of conveyance); a ship or (collectively) a fleet: - galley, navy (of ships).

H591.full: on-ee-yaw' Feminine of H590; a ship: - ship ([-men]).

H593.full: From H578 and H5971; groaning of (the) people; Aniam, an Israelite: - Aniam.

H594.full: Probably from an unused root meaning to be narrow; according to most a plumb line, and to others a hook: - plumb-line.

H595.full: A primitive pronoun; I: - I, me, X which.

H596.full: aw-nan' A primitive root; to mourn, that is, complain: - complain.

H598.full: an-as' (Chaldee); corresponding to H597; figuratively to distress: - trouble.

H599.full: aw-naf' A primitive root; to breathe hard, that is, be enraged: - be angry (displeased).

H600.full: an-af' (Chaldee); corresponding to H639 (only in the plural as a singular); the face: - face, visage.

H601.full: From H599; an unclean bird, perhaps the parrot (from its irascibility): - heron.

H602.full: aw-nak' A primitive root; to shriek: - cry, groan.

H603.full: From H602; shrieking: - crying out, groaning, sighing.

H604.full: The same as H603; some kind of lizard, probably the gecko (from its wail): - ferret.

H605.full: aw-nash' A primitive root; to be frail, feeble, or (figuratively) melancholy: - desperate (-ly wicked), incurable, sick, woeful.

H606.full: en-awsh', en-ash' (Chaldee); corresponding to H582; a man: - man, + whosoever.

H607.full: an-taw' (Chaldee); corresponding to H859; thou: - as for thee, thou.

H608.full: an-toon' (Chaldee); plural of H607; ye: - ye.

H609.full: Of uncertain derivation; Asa, the name of a king and of a Levite: - Asa.

H610.full: From H5480; anointed, that is, an oil flask: - pot.

H612.full: From H631; a bond (especially manacles of a prisoner): - band, + prison.

H614.full: aw-seef', aw-seef' From H622; gathered, that is, (abstractly) a gathering in of crops: - ingathering.

H615.full: From H631; bound, that is, a captive: - (those which are) bound, prisoner.

H617.full: as-sere' The same as H616; prisoner; Assir, the name of two Israelites: - Assir.

H618.full: From an unused root meaning to heap together; a storehouse (only in the plural): - barn, storehouse.

H619.full: as-naw' Of uncertain derivation; Asnah, one of the Nethinim: - Asnah.

H620.full: os-nap-par' Of foreign derivation; Osnappar, an Assyrian king: - Asnapper.

H621.full: aw-se-nath' Of Egyptian derivation; Asenath, the wife of Joseph: - Asenath.

H622.firstSense: assemble, bring, consume, destroy, fetch, gather (in, together, up again), X generally,…
H622.full: aw-saf' A primitive root; to gather for any purpose; hence to receive, take away, that is, remove (destroy, leave behind, put up, restore, etc.): - assemble, bring, consume, destroy, fetch, gather (in, together, up again), X generally, get (him), lose, put all together, receive, recover [another from leprosy], (be) rereward, X surely, take (away, into, up), X utterly, withdraw.

H623.full: From H622; collector; Asaph, the name of three Israelites, and of the family of the first: - Asaph.

H624.full: Passive participle of H622; collected (only in the plural), that is, a collection (of offerings): - threshold, Asuppim.

H625.full: o'-sef From H622; a collection (of fruits): - gathering.

H626.full: From H622; a collection of people (only adverbially): - X together.

H627.full: Feminine of H624; a collection of (learned) men (only in the plural): - assembly.

H628.full: as-pes-oof' By reduplication from H624; gathered up together, that is, a promiscuous assemblage (of people): - mixt multitude.

H629.full: os-par-naw' (Chaldee); of Persian derivation; diligently: - fast, forthwith, speed (-ily)

H630.full: as-paw-thaw' Of Persian derivation; Aspatha, a son of Haman: - Aspatha.

H631.firstSense: bind, fast, gird, harness, hold, keep, make ready, order, prepare, prison (-er), put in…
H631.full: aw-sar' A primitive root; to yoke or hitch; by analogy to fasten in any sense, to join battle: - bind, fast, gird, harness, hold, keep, make ready, order, prepare, prison (-er), put in bonds, set in array, tie.

H632.full: es-awr', is-sawr' From H631; an obligation or vow (of abstinence): - binding, bond.

H633.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H632 in a legal sense; an interdict: - decree.

H634.full: ay-sar' chad-dohn' Of foreign derivation; Esarchaddon, an Assyrian king: - Esar-haddon.

H635.full: es-tare' Of Persian derivation; Ester, the Jewish heroine: - Esther.

H636.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H6086; a tree or wood: - timber, wood.

H637.firstSense: also, + although, and (furthermore, yet), but, even, + how much less (more, rather than…
H637.full: af A primitive particle; meaning accession (used as an adverb or conjugation); also or yea; adversatively though: - also, + although, and (furthermore, yet), but, even, + how much less (more, rather than), moreover, with, yea.

H639.firstSense: anger (-gry), + before, countenance, face, + forbearing, forehead, + [long-] suffering,…
H639.full: af From H599; properly the nose or nostril; hence the face, and occasionally a person; also (from the rapid breathing in passion) ire: - anger (-gry), + before, countenance, face, + forbearing, forehead, + [long-] suffering, nose, nostril, snout, X worthy, wrath.

H640.full: aw-fad' A primitive root (rather a denominative from H636); to gird on (the ephod): - bind, gird.

H641.full: The same as H646 shortened; Ephod, an Israelite: - Ephod.

H642.full: Feminine of H646; a girding on (of the ephod); hence generally a plating (of metal): - ephod, ornament.

H643.full: ap-peh'-den Apparently of foreign derivation; a pavilion or palace tent: - palace.

H644.full: A primitive root; to cook, especially to bake: - bake, (-r, [-meats]).

H645.full: From H6311; strictly a demonstrative particle, here; but used of time, now or then: - here, now, where?

H646.full: Second form is a rare form; probably of foreign derivation; a girdle; specifically the ephod or high priest's shoulder piece; also generally an image: - ephod.

H647.full: af-ee'-akh Perhaps from H6315; breeze; Aphiach, an Israelite: - Aphiah.

H648.full: aw-feel' From the same as H651 (in the sense of weakness); unripe: - not grown up.

H649.full: ap-pah'-yim Dual of H639; two nostrils; Appajim, an Israelite: - Appaim.

H650.firstSense: brook, channel, mighty, river, + scale, stream, strong piece
H650.full: aw-feek' From H622; properly containing, that is, a tube; also a bed or valley of a stream; also a strong thing or a hero: - brook, channel, mighty, river, + scale, stream, strong piece.

H651.full: aw-fale' From an unused root meaning to set as the sun; dusky: - very dark.

H652.full: o'-fel From the same as H651; dusk: - darkness, obscurity, privily.

H653.full: Feminine of H651; duskiness, figuratively misfortune; concretely concealment: - dark, darkness, gloominess, X thick.

H654.full: ef-lawl' From H6419; judge; Ephlal, an Israelite: - Ephlal.

H655.full: o'-fen From an unused root meaning to revolve; a turn, that is, a season: - + fitly.

H656.firstSense: be clean gone (at an end, brought to nought), fail
H656.full: A primitive root; to disappear, that is, cease: - be clean gone (at an end, brought to nought), fail.

H657.firstSense: ankle, but (only), end, howbeit, less than nothing, nevertheless (where), no, none (bes…
H657.full: eh'-fes From H656; cessation, that is, an end (especially of the earth); often used adverbially no further; also (like H6466) the ankle (in the dual), as being the extremity of the leg or foot: - ankle, but (only), end, howbeit, less than nothing, nevertheless (where), no, none (beside), not (any, -withstanding), thing of nought, save (-ing), there, uttermost part, want, without (cause).

H658.full: eh'-fes dam-meem' From H657 and the plural of H1818; boundary of blood drops; Ephes-Dammim, a place in Palestine: - Ephes-dammim.

H659.full: From an unused root probably meaning to breathe; properly a breath, that is, nothing: - of nought.

H660.full: ef-eh' From H659 (in the sense of hissing); an asp or other venomous serpent: - viper.

H661.full: aw-faf' A primitive root; to surround: - compassive

H662.full: aw-fak' A primitive root; to contain, that is, (reflexively) abstain: - force (oneself), restrain.

H663.full: From H662 (in the sense of strength); fortress; Aphek (or Aphik), the name of three places in Palestine: - Aphek, Aphik.

H664.full: Feminine of H663; fortress; Aphekah, a place in Palestine: - Aphekah.

H665.full: ay'-fer From an unused root meaning to bestrew; ashes: - ashes.

H666.full: From the same as H665 (in the sense of covering); a turban: - ashes.

H667.full: ef-ro'-akh From H6524 (in the sense of bursting the shell); the brood of a bird: - young (one).

H668.full: ap-pir-yone' Probably of Egyptian derivation; a palanquin: - chariot.

H669.full: ef-rah'-yim Dual of a masculine form of H672; double fruit; Ephrajim, a son of Joseph; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory: - Ephraim Ephraimites

H670.full: af-aw-re-sah' (Chaldee); of foreign origin (only in the plural); an Apharesite or inhabitant of an unknown region of Assyria: - Apharsite.

H671.full: af-ar-sek-ah'ee, af-ar-sath-kah'ee (Chaldee); of foreign origin (only in the plural); an Apharsekite or Apharsathkite, an unknown Assyrian tribe: - Apharsachites, Apharsathchites.

H672.full: ef-rawth', ef-raw'-thaw From H6509; fruitfulness; Ephrath, another name for Bethlehem; once used in Psa_132:6 perhaps for Ephraim; also of an Israelitish woman: - Ephrath, Ephratah.

H673.full: ef-rawth-ee' Patrial from H672; an Ephrathite or an Ephraimite: - Ephraimite, Ephrathite.

H674.full: ap-pe-thome' (Chaldee); of Persian origin; revenue; others at the last: - revenue.

H675.full: ets-bone', ets-bone' Of uncertain derivation; Etsbon, the name of two Israelites: - Ezbon.

H676.full: ets-bah' From the same as H6648 (in the sense of grasping); some thing to seize with, that is, a finger; by analogy a toe: - finger, toe.

H677.full: ets-bah' (Chaldee); corresponding to H676: - finger, toe.

H678.full: aw-tseel' From H680 (in its secondary sense of separation); an extremity (Isa_41:9), also a noble: - chief man, noble.

H679.full: ats-tseel' From H680 (in its primary sense of uniting); a joint of the hand (that is, knuckle); also (according to some) a partywall (Eze_41:8): - [arm] hole, great.

H680.full: aw-tsal' A primitive root; properly to join; used only as a denominative from H681; to separate; hence to select, refuse, contract: - keep, reserve, straiten, take.

H681.full: ay'-tsel From H680 (in the sense of joining); a side; (as a preposition) near: - at, (hard) by, (from) (beside), near (unto), toward, with. See also H1018.

H682.full: aw-tsale' From H680; noble; Atsel, the name of an Israelite, and of a place in Palestine: - Azal, Azel.

H683.full: ats-al-yaw'-hoo From H680 and H3050 prolonged; Jah has reserved; Atsaljah, an Israelite: - Azaliah.

H684.full: o'-tsem From an unused root probably meaning to be strong; strength (that is, strong); Otsem, the name of two Israelites: - Ozem.

H685.full: A variation from H6807; properly a step chain; by analogy a bracelet: - bracelet, chain.

H686.full: aw-tsar A primitive root; to store up: - (lay up in ) store, (make) treasure (-r).

H687.full: ay'-tser From H686; treasure; Etser, an Idumaean: - Ezer.

H688.full: ek-dawkh' From H6916; burning, that is, a carbuncle or other fiery gem: - carbuncle.

H689.full: ak-ko' Probably from H602; slender, that is, the ibex: - wild goat.

H690.full: Probably for H738; lion; Ara, an Israelite: - Ara.

H691.full: er-ale' Probably for H739; a hero (collectively): - valiant one.

H692.full: ar-ay-lee' From H691; heroic; Areli (or an Arelite, collectively), an Israelite and his descendants: - Areli, Arelites.

H693.full: aw-rab' A primitive root; to lurk: - (lie in) ambush (-ment), lay (lie in) wait.

H694.full: From H693; ambush; Arab, a place in Palestine: - Arab.

H695.full: eh'-reb From H693; ambuscade: - den, lie in wait.

H696.full: o'-reb The same as H695: - wait.

H697.full: ar-beh' From H7235; a locust (from its rapid increase): - grasshopper, locust.

H698.full: or-ob-aw' Feminine of H696 (only in the plural); ambuscades: - spoils.

H699.full: ar-oob-baw' Feminine participle passive of H693 (as if for lurking); a lattice; (by implication) a window, dove cot (because of the pigeon holes), chimney (with its apertures for smoke), sluice (with openings for water): - chimney, window.

H700.full: ar-oob-both Plural of H699; Arubboth, a place in Palestine: - Aruboth.

H701.full: ar-bee' Patrial from H694; an Arbite or native of Arab: - Arbite.

H702.full: The second form is the masculine form; from H7251; four: - four.

H704.full: ar-bah' The same as H702; Arba, one of the Anakim: - Arba.

H706.full: ar-bah-tah'-yim Dual of H702; fourfold: - fourfold.

H707.full: aw-rag' A primitive root; to plait or weave: - weaver (-r).

H708.full: eh'-reg From H707; a weaving; a braid; also a shuttle: - beam, weaver's shuttle.

H709.full: ar-gobe' From the same as H7263; stony; Argob, a district of Palestine: - Argob.

H710.full: arg-ev-awn' A variation for H713; purple: - purple.

H712.full: ar-gawz' Perhaps from H7264 (in the sense of being suspended); a box (as a pannier): - coffer.

H713.full: ar-gaw-mawn' Of foreign origin; purple (the color or the dyed stuff): - purple.

H714.full: ard From an unused root probably meaning to wander; fugitive; Ard, the name of two Israelites: - Ard.

H715.full: ar-dohn' From the same as H714; roaming; Ardon, an Israelite: - Ardon.

H716.full: ar-dee' Patronymic from H714; an Ardite (collectively) or descendant of Ard: - Ardites.

H717.full: A primitive root; to pluck: - gather, pluck.

H718.full: (Chaldee); probably akin to H431; lo!: - behold, lo.

H719.full: ar-vad' Probably from H7300; a refuge for the roving; Arvad, an island city of Palestine: - Arvad.

H720.full: An orthographical variation of H719; fugitive; Arod, an Israelite: - Arod.

H721.full: ar-vaw-dee' Patrial from H719; an Arvadite or citizen of Arvad: - Arvadite.

H722.full: Patronymic from H721; an Arodite or descendant of Arod: - Arodi, Arodites.

H723.full: From H717 (in the sense of feeding); a herding place for an animal: - stall.

H724.full: Feminine passive participle of H748 (in the sense of restoring to soundness); wholeness (literally or figuratively): - health, made up, perfected.

H725.full: A variation of H7316; height; Arumah, a place in Palestine: - Arumah.

H726.full: A clerical error for H130; an Edomite: - Syrian.

H727.full: From H717 (in the sense of gathering); a box: - ark, chest, coffin.

H728.full: ar-av-naw', ore-naw', ar-nee-yaw' All forms by orthographical variation for H711; Aravnah (or Arnijah or Ornah), a Jebusite: - Araunah.

H729.full: aw-raz' A primitive root; to be firm; used only in the passive participle as a denominative from H730; of cedar: - made of cedar.

H730.full: eh'-rez From H729; a cedar tree (from the tenacity of its roots): - cedar (tree).

H731.full: ar-zaw' Feminine of H730; cedar wainscoting: - cedar work.

H732.full: aw-rakh' A primitive root; to travel: - go, wayfaring (man).

H733.full: aw-rakh' From H732; wayfaring; Arach, the name of three Israelites: - Arah.

H734.firstSense: manner, path, race, rank, traveller, troop, [by-, high-] way
H734.full: o'-rakh From H732; a well trodden road (literally or figuratively); also a caravan: - manner, path, race, rank, traveller, troop, [by-, high-] way.

H735.full: o'-rakh (Chaldee); corresponding to H734; a road: - way.

H736.full: o-rekh-aw' Feminine active participle of H732; a caravan: - (travelling) company.

H737.full: Feminine passive participle of H732 (in the sense of appointing); a ration of food: - allowance, diet, dinner, victuals.

H738.full: ar-ee', ar-yay' From H717 (in the sense of violence); a lion: - (young) lion, + pierce [from the margin].

H739.full: From H738 and H410; lion of God, that is, heroic: - lionlike men.

H740.full: The same as H739; Ariel, a symbolical name for Jerusalem, also the name of an Israelite: - Ariel.

H741.full: ar-ee-ale' Either by transposition for H739 or more probable, an orthographical variation for H2025; the altar of the Temple: - altar.

H742.full: ar-ee-dah'-ee Of Persian origin; Aridai, a son of Haman: - Aridai.

H743.full: Of Persian origin; Aridatha, a son of Haman: - Aridatha.

H745.full: ar-yay' The same as H738; lion; Arjeh, an Israelite: - Arieh.

H746.full: Of foreign origin; Arjok, the name of two Babylonians: - Arioch.

H747.full: ar-ee-sah'-ee Of Persian origin; Arisai, a son of Haman: - Arisai.

H748.firstSense: defer, draw out, lengthen, (be, become, make, pro-) long, + (out-, over-) live, tarry (…
H748.full: aw-rak' A primitive root; to be (causatively make) long (literally or figuratively): - defer, draw out, lengthen, (be, become, make, pro-) long, + (out-, over-) live, tarry (long).

H749.full: ar-ak' (Chaldee); properly corresponding to H748, but used only in the sense of reaching to a given point; to suit: - be meet.

H750.full: From H748; long: - long [-suffering, -winged], patient, slow [to anger].

H751.full: eh'-rek From H748; length; Erek, a place in Babylon: - Erech.

H753.full: o'-rek From H748; length: - + for ever, length, long.

H754.full: ar-kaw', ar-kaw' (Chaldee); from H749; length: - lengthening, prolonged.

H755.full: ar-koo-baw' (Chaldee); from an unused root corresponding to H7392 (in the sense of bending the knee); the knee: - knee.

H756.full: ar-kev-ah'ee (Chaldee); patrial from H751; an Arkevite (collectively) or native of Erek: - Archevite.

H757.full: ar-kee' Patrial from another place (in Palestine) of similar name with H751; an Arkite or native of Erek: - Archi, Archite.

H758.full: From the same as H759; the highland; Aram or Syria, and its inhabitants; also the name of a son of Shem, a grandson of Nahor, and of an Israelite: - Aram, Mesopotamia, Syria, Syrians.

H759.full: ar-mone' From an unused root (meaning to be elevated); a citadel (from its height): - castle, palace. Compare H2038.

H760.full: ar-am' tso-baw' From H758 and H6678; Aram of Tsoba (or Coele-syria): - Aram-zobah.

H761.full: ar-am-mee' Patrial from H758; an Aramite or Aramaean: - Syrian, Aramitess.

H762.firstSense: in the Syrian language (tongue), in Syriack
H762.full: Feminine of H761; (only adverbially) in Aramaean: - in the Syrian language (tongue), in Syriack.

H763.full: ar-am' nah-har-ah'-yim From H758 and the dual of H5104; Aram of (the) two rivers (Euphrates and Tigris) or Mesopotamia: - Aham-naharaim, Mesopotamia.

H764.full: ar-mo-nee' From H759; palatial; Armoni, an Israelite: - Armoni.

H765.full: From H7442; stridulous; Aran, an Edomite: - Aran.

H766.full: o'-ren From the same as H765 (in the sense of strength); the ash tree (from its toughness): - ash.

H767.full: o'-ren The same as H766; Oren, an Israelite: - Oren.

H768.full: ar-neh'-beth Of uncertain derivation; the hare: - hare.

H769.full: ar-nohn', ar-nohn' From H7442; a brawling stream; the Arnon, a river east of the Jordan; also its territory: - Arnon.

H770.full: ar-nawn' Probably from the same as H769; noisy; Arnan, an Israelite: - Arnan.

H771.full: or-nawn' Probably from H766; strong; Ornan, a Jebusite: - Ornan. See H728.

H772.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H776; the earth; by implication (figuratively) low: - earth, inferior.

H773.full: arh-eeth' (Chaldee); feminine of H772; the bottom: - bottom.

H774.full: ar-pawd' From H7502; spread out; Arpad, a place in Syria: - Arpad, Arphad.

H775.full: ar-pak-shad' Probably of foreign origin; Arpakshad, a son of Noah; also the region settled by him: - Arphaxad.

H776.firstSense: X common, country, earth, field, ground, land, X nations, way, + wilderness, world
H776.full: eh'-rets From an unused root probably meaning to be firm; the earth (at large, or partitively a land): - X common, country, earth, field, ground, land, X nations, way, + wilderness, world.

H777.full: ar-tsaw' From H776; earthiness; Artsa, an Israelite: - Arza.

H778.full: ar-ak' (Chaldee); by transmutation for H772; the earth: - earth.

H779.full: aw-rar' A primitive root; to execrate: - X bitterly curse.

H780.full: Of foreign origin; Ararat (or rather Armenia): - Ararat, Armenia.

H781.full: A primitive root; to engage for matrimony: - betroth, espouse.

H782.full: ar-eh'-sheth From H781 (in the sense of desiring to possess); a longing for: - request.

H783.full: ar-takh-shash-taw', ar-takh-shasht' Of foreign origin; Artachshasta (or Artaxerxes), a title (rather than name) of several Persian kings: - Artaxerxes.

H784.full: aysh A primitive word; fire (literally or figuratively): - burning, fiery, fire, flaming, hot.

H786.full: eesh Identical (in origin and formation) with H784; entity; used only adverbially, there is or are: - are there, none can. Compare H3426.

H787.full: ohsh (Chaldee); corresponding (by transposition and abbreviation) to H803; a foundation: - foundation.

H788.full: ash-bale' Probably from the same as H7640; flowing; Ashbel, an Israelite: - Ashbel.

H789.full: ash-bay-lee' Patronymic from H788; an Ashbelite (collectively) or descendant of Ashbel: - Ashbelites.

H790.full: esh-bawn' Probably from the same as H7644; vigorous; Eshban, an Idumaean: - Eshban.

H791.full: ash-bay'-ah From H7650; adjurer; Asbea, an Israelite: - Ashbea.

H792.full: esh-bah'-al From H376 and H1168; man of Baal; Eshbaal (or Ishbosheth), a son of King Saul: - Eshbaal.

H793.full: eh'-shed From an unused root meaning to pour; an outpouring: - stream.

H794.full: Feminine of H793; a ravine: - springs.

H795.full: ash-dode' From H7703; ravager; Ashdod, a place in Palestine: - Ashdod.

H796.full: ash-do-dee' Patrial from H795; an Ashdodite (often collectively) or inhabitant of Ashdod: - Ashdodites, of Ashdod.

H797.full: ash-do-deeth' Feminine of H796; (only adverbially) in the language of Ashdod: - in the speech of Ashdod.

H798.full: ash-doth' hap-pis-gaw' From the plural of H794 and H6449 with the article interposed; ravines of the Pisgah; Ashdoth-Pisgah, a place east of the Jordan: - Ashdoth-pisgah.

H799.full: esh-dawth' From H784 and H1881; a fire law: - fiery law.

H800.full: esh-shaw' Feminine of H784; fire: - fire.

H801.full: ish-shaw' The same as H800, but used in a liturgical sense; properly a burnt offering; but occasionally of any sacrifice: - (offering, sacrifice), (made) by fire.

H802.firstSense: [adulter]ess, each, every, female, X many, + none, one, + together, wife, woman
H802.full: ish-shaw', naw-sheem' The first form is the feminine of H376 or H582; the second form is an irregular plural; a woman (used in the same wide sense as H582).: - [adulter]ess, each, every, female, X many, + none, one, + together, wife, woman. Often unexpressed in English.

H803.full: Feminine passive participle from an unused root meaning to found; foundation: - foundation.

H804.full: ash-shoor', ash-shoor' Apparently from H833 (in the sense of successful); Ashshur, the second son of Shem; also his descendants and the country occupied by them (that is, Assyria), its region and its empire: - Asshur, Assur, Assyria, Assyrians. See H838.

H805.full: ash-oo-ree', ash-shoo-ree' From a patrial word of the same form as H804; an Ashurite (collectively) or inhabitant of Ashur, a district in Palestine: - Asshurim, Ashurites.

H806.full: ash-khoor' Probably from H7835; black; Ashchur, an Israelite: - Ashur.

H807.full: Of foreign origin; Ashima, a deity of Hamath: - Ashima.

H808.full: aw-sheesh' From the same as H784 (in the sense of pressing down firmly; compare H803); a (ruined) foundation: - foundation.

H809.full: ash-ee-shaw' Feminine of H808; something closely pressed together, that is, a cake of raisins or other comfits: - flagon.

H810.full: eh'-shek From an unused root (probably meaning to bunch together); a testicle (as a lump): - stone.

H811.full: esh-kole', esh-kole' Probably prolonged from H810; a bunch of grapes or other fruit: - cluster (of grapes).

H812.full: esh-kole' The same as H811; Eshcol, the name of an Amorite, also of a valley in Palestine: - Eshcol.

H813.full: ash-ken-az' Of foreign origin; Ashkenaz, a Japhethite, also his descendants: - Ashkenaz.

H814.full: esh-cawr' For H7939; a gratuity: - gift, present.

H815.full: ay'-shel From a root of uncertain signification; a tamarisk tree; by extension a grove of any kind: - grove, tree.

H816.firstSense: X certainly, be (-come, made) desolate, destroy, X greatly, be (-come, found, hold) gui…
H816.full: aw-sham', aw-shame' A primitive root; to be guilty; by implication to be punished or perish: - X certainly, be (-come, made) desolate, destroy, X greatly, be (-come, found, hold) guilty, offend (acknowledge offence), trespassive

H817.full: From H816; guilt; by implication a fault; also a sin offering: - guiltiness, (offering for) sin, trespass (offering).

H818.full: From H816; guilty; hence presenting a sin offering: - one which is faulty, guilty.

H819.full: ash-maw' Feminine of H817; guiltiness, a fault, the presentation of a sin offering: - offend, sin, (cause of) trespass (-ing, offering).

H820.full: ash-mawn' Probably from H8081; a fat field: - desolate place.

H821.full: ash-moo-raw', ash-moo-raw', ash-mo'-reth (Feminine) from H8104; a night watch: - watch.

H822.full: esh-nawb' Apparently from an unused root (Probably meaning to leave interstices); a latticed window: - casement, lattice.

H823.full: ash-naw' Probably a variation for H3466; Ashnah, the name of two places in Palestine: - Ashnah.

H824.full: From H8172; support; Eshan, a place in Palestine: - Eshean.

H825.full: ash-shawf' From an unused root (probably meaning to lisp, that is, practice enchantment); a conjurer: - astrologer.

H827.full: ash-paw' Perhaps (feminine) from the same as H825 (in the sense of covering); a quiver or arrow case: - quiver.

H828.full: ash-pen-az' Of foreign origin; Ashpenaz, a Babylonian eunuch: - Ashpenaz.

H829.full: esh-pawr' Of uncertain derivation; a measured portion: - good piece (of flesh).

H830.full: ash-pohth', ash-pohth', shef-ohth' Plural of a noun of the same form as H827, from H8192 (in the sense of scraping); a heap of rubbish or filth: - dung (hill).

H831.full: ash-kel-one' Probably from H8254 in the sense of weighing place (that is, mart); Ashkelon, a place in Palestine: - Ashkelon, Askalon.

H832.full: esh-kel-o-nee' Patrial from H831; an Ashkelonite (collectively) or inhabitant of Ashkelon: - Eshkalonites.

H833.firstSense: (call, be) bless (-ed, happy), go, guide, lead, relieve
H833.full: aw-shar', aw-share' A primitive root; to be straight (used in the widest sense, especially to be level, right, happy); figuratively to go forward, be honest, prosper: - (call, be) bless (-ed, happy), go, guide, lead, relieve.

H834.firstSense: X after, X alike, as (soon as), because, X every, for, + forasmuch, + from whence, + ho…
H834.full: ash-er' A primitive relative pronoun (of every gender and number); who, which, what, that; also (as adverb and conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.: - X after, X alike, as (soon as), because, X every, for, + forasmuch, + from whence, + how (-soever), X if, (so) that ([thing] which, wherein), X though, + until, + whatsoever, when, where (+ -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, + whither (-soever), who (-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.

H835.full: eh'-sher From H833; happiness; only in masculine plural construction as interjection, how happy!: - blessed, happy.

H836.full: From H833; happy; Asher, a son of Jacob, and the tribe descended from him, with its territory; also a place in Palestine: - Asher.

H838.full: aw-shoor', ash-shoor' From H833 in the sense of going; a step: - going, step.

H839.full: Contracted for H8391; the cedar tree or some other light elastic wood: - Ashurite.

H840.full: By orthographical variation from H833 and H410; right of God; Asarelah, an Israelite: - Asareel.

H841.full: From the same as H840; right towards God; Asarelah, an Israelite: - Asarelah. Compare H3840.

H842.full: From H833; happy; asherah (or Astarte) a Phoenician goddess; also an image of the same: - grove. Compare H6253.

H843.full: Patronymic from H836; an Asherite (collectively) or descendant of Asher: - Asherites.

H844.full: An orthographical variation for H840; Asriel, the name of two Israelites: - Ashriel, Asriel.

H845.full: Patronymic from H844; an Asrielite (collectively) or descendant of Asriel: - Asrielites.

H846.full: oosh-ar-naw' (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H833; a wall (from its uprightness): - wall.

H847.full: esh-taw-ole', esh-taw-ole' Probably from H7592; intreaty; Eshtaol, a place in Palestine: - Eshtaol.

H848.full: esh-taw-oo-lee' Patrial from H847; an Eshtaolite (collectively) or inhabitant of Eshtaol: - Eshtaulites.

H849.full: esh-tad-dure' (Chaldee); from H7712 (in a bad sense); rebellion: - sedition.

H850.full: esh-tone' Probably from the same as H7764; restful; Eshton, an Israelite: - Eshton.

H851.full: esh-tem-o'-ah, esh-tem-o'-ah, esh-tem-o' From H8085 (in the sense of obedience); Eshtemoa or Eshtemoh, a place in Palestine: - Eshtemoa, Eshtemoh.

H852.full: awth (Chaldee); corresponding to H226; a portent: - sign.

H853.full: ayth Apparently contracted from H226 in the demonstrative sense of entity; properly self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely): - (As such unrepresented in English.)

H854.firstSense: against, among, before, by, for, from, in (-to), (out) of, with
H854.full: ayth Probably from H579; properly nearness (used only as a preposition or adverb), near; hence generally with, by, at, among, etc.: - against, among, before, by, for, from, in (-to), (out) of, with. Often with another preposition prefixed.

H855.full: ayth Of uncertain derivation; a hoe or other digging implement: - coulter, plowshare.

H856.full: eth-bah'-al From H854 and H1168; with Baal; Ethbaal, a Phoenician king: - Ethbaal.

H857.full: A primitive root (collateral to H225 contracted); to arrive: - (be-, things to) come (upon), bring.

H859.full: A primitive pronoun of the second person; thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you: - thee, thou, ye, you.

H860.full: Probably from the same as H386 (in the sense of patience); a female ass (from its docility): - (she) ass.

H861.full: at-toon' (Chaldee); probably corresponding to H784; probably a fireplace, that is, furnace: - furnace.

H862.full: at-tooke', at-teek' From H5423 in the sense of decreasing; a ledge or offset in a building: - gallery.

H863.full: it-tah'ee, ee-thah'ee From H854; near; Ittai or Ithai, the name of a Gittite and of an Israelite: - Ithai, Ittai.

H864.full: Of Egyptian derivation; Etham, a place in the Desert: - Etham.

H865.firstSense: + before (that) time, + heretofore, of late (old), + times past, yester[day]
H865.full: eth-mole', ith-mole', eth-mool' Probably from H853 or H854 and H4136; heretofore; definitely yesterday: - + before (that) time, + heretofore, of late (old), + times past, yester[day].

H866.full: eth-naw' From H8566; a present (as the price of harlotry): - reward.

H867.full: eth-nee' Perhaps from H866; munificence; Ethni, an Israelite: - Ethni.

H868.full: eth-nan' The same as H866; a gift (as the price of harlotry or idolatry): - hire, reward.

H869.full: eth-nan' The same as H868 in the sense of H867; Ethnan, an Israelite: - Ethnan.

H870.full: ath-ar' (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to that of H871; a place; (adverbially) after: - after, place.

H871.full: Plural from an unused root (probably meaning to step); places; Atharim, a place near Palestine: - spies.

H872.full: be-aw' From H935; an entrance to a building: - entry.

H874.full: baw-ar' A primitive root; to dig; by analogy to engrave; figuratively to explain: - declare, (make) plain (-ly).

H875.full: be-ayr' From H874; a pit; especially a well: - pit, well.

H876.full: be-ayr' The same as H875; Beer, a place in the Desert, also one in Palestine: - Beer.

H877.full: bore From H874; a cistern: - cistern.

H878.full: From H875; a well; Beera, an Israelite: - Beera.

H879.full: be-ayr' ay-leem' From H875 and the plural of H410; well of heroes; Beer-elim, a place in the Desert: - Beer-elim.

H880.full: be-ay-raw' The same as H878; Berrah, an Israelite: - Beerah.

H881.full: be-ay-rohth' Feminine plural of H875; wells; Beeroth, a place in Palestine: - Beeroth.

H882.full: be-ay-ree' From H875; fountained; Beeri, the name of a Hittite and of an Israelite: - Beeri.

H883.full: be-ayr' lakh-ah'ee ro-ee' From H875 and H2416 (with prefix) and H7208; well of a living (One) my Seer; Beer-lachai-roi, a place in the Desert: - Beer-lahai-roi.

H884.full: be-ayr' sheh'-bah From H875 and H7651 (in the sense of H7650); well of an oath; Beer Sheba, a place in Palestine: - Beer-shebah.

H885.firstSense: Beeroth of the children of Jaakan
H885.full: be-ay-roth' be-nay' yah-a-can' From the feminine plural of H875, and the plural contraction of H1121, and H3292; wells of (the) sons of Jaakan; Beeroth Bene-Jaakan, a place in the Desert: - Beeroth of the children of Jaakan.

H886.full: be-ay-ro-thee' Patrial from H881; a Beerothite or inhabitant of Beeroth: - Beerothite.

H887.firstSense: (make to) be abhorred (had in abomination, loathsome, odious), (cause a, make to) stink…
H887.full: baw-ash' A primitive root; to smell bad; figuratively to be offensive morally: - (make to) be abhorred (had in abomination, loathsome, odious), (cause a, make to) stink (-ing savour), X utterly.

H889.full: be-oshe' From H887; a stench: - stink.

H890.full: bosh-aw' Feminine of H889; stink weed or any other noxious or useless plant: - cockle.

H891.full: be-oo-sheem' Plural of H889; poison berries: - wild grapes.

H892.full: Feminine active participle of an unused root meaning to hollow out; something hollowed (as a gate), that is, the pupil of the eye: - apple [of the eye].

H893.full: Probably of foreign origin; Bebai, an Israelite: - Bebai.

H894.full: From H1101; confusion; Babel (that is, Babylon), including Babylonia and the Babylonian empire: - Babel, Babylon.

H896.full: (Chaldee); patrial from H895; a Babylonian: - Babylonia.

H897.full: bag bag A Persian word; food. For H957: - spoil [from the margin for H957.]

H898.firstSense: deal deceitfully (treacherously, unfaithfully), offend, transgress (-or), (depart), tre…
H898.full: A primitive root; to cover (with a garment); figuratively to act covertly; by implication to pillage: - deal deceitfully (treacherously, unfaithfully), offend, transgress (-or), (depart), treacherous (dealer, -ly, man), unfaithful (-ly, man), X very.

H899.firstSense: apparel, cloth (-es, -ing), garment, lap, rag, raiment, robe, X very [treacherously], v…
H899.full: From H898; a covering, that is, clothing; also treachery or pillage: - apparel, cloth (-es, -ing), garment, lap, rag, raiment, robe, X very [treacherously], vesture, wardrobe.

H900.full: bôgedôth bohg-ed-ohth Feminine plural active participle of H898; treacheries: - treacherous.

H902.full: Probably of foreign origin; Bigvai, an Israelite: - Bigvai.

H903.full: big-thaw' Of Persian derivation; Bigtha, a eunuch of Xerxes: - Bigtha.

H904.full: big-thawn', big-thaw'-naw Of similar derivation to H903; Bigthan or Bigthana, a eunuch of Xerxes: - Bigthan, Bigthana.

H905.firstSense: alone, apart, bar, besides, branch, by self, of each alike, except, only, part, staff,…
H905.full: bad bad From H909; properly separation; by implication a part of the body, branch of a tree, bar for carrying; figuratively chief of a city; especially (with prepositional prefix) as adverb, apart, only, besides: - alone, apart, bar, besides, branch, by self, of each alike, except, only, part, staff, strength.

H906.full: bad bad Perhaps from H909 (in the sense of divided fibres); flaxen thread or yarn; hence a linen garment: - linen.

H907.full: bad bad From H908; a brag or lie; also a liar: - liar, lie.

H908.full: A primitive root; (figuratively) to invent: - devise, feign.

H909.full: A primitive root; to divide, that is, (reflexively) be solitary: - alone.

H910.full: From H909; separate; adverbially separately: - alone, desolate, only, solitary.

H911.full: From H909; separation; Bedad, an Edomite: - Bedad.

H912.full: Probably shortened for H5662; servant of Jehovah; Bedejah, an Israelite: - Bedeiah.

H913.full: From H914; alloy (because removed by smelting); by analogy tin: - + plummet, tin.

H914.full: A primitive root; to divide (in various senses literally or figuratively, separate, distinguish, differ, select, etc.): - (make, put) difference, divide (asunder), (make) separate (self, -ation), sever (out), X utterly.

H916.full: Probably from H914; something in pieces, that is, bdellium, a (fragrant) gum (perhaps amber); others a pearl: - bdellium.

H917.full: Probably shortened for H5658; servile; Bedan, the name of two Israelite: - Bedan.

H918.full: A primitive root; to gap open; used only as a denominative from H919; to mend a breach: - repair.

H919.full: From H918; a gap or leak (in a building or a ship): - breach, + calker.

H920.full: Probably from H1856 with prepositional prefix; by stabbing, that is, assassin; Bidkar, an Israelite: - Bidkar.

H921.full: (Chaldee); corresponding (by transposition) to H6504: to scatter: - scatter.

H922.full: From an unused root (meaning to be empty); a vacuity, that is, (superficially) an undistinguishable ruin: - emptiness, void.

H923.full: From an unused root (probably meaning to glisten); white marble or perhaps alabaster: - red [marble].

H924.full: (Chaldee); from H927; a hurry; only adverbially hastily: - in haste.

H925.full: From an unused root (meaning to be bright); shining: - bright.

H926.firstSense: be (make) affrighted (afraid, amazed, dismayed, rash), (be, get, make) haste (-n, -y, -…
H926.full: A primitive root; to tremble inwardly (or palpitate), that is, (figuratively) be (causatively make) (suddenly) alarmed or agitated; by implication to hasten anxiously: - be (make) affrighted (afraid, amazed, dismayed, rash), (be, get, make) haste (-n, -y, -ily), (give) speedy (-ily), thrust out, trouble, vex.

H927.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H926; to terrify, hasten: - in haste, trouble.

H928.full: From H926; panic, destruction: - terror, trouble.

H929.full: From an unused root (probably meaning to be mute); properly a dumb beast; especially any large quadruped or animal (often collectively): - beast, cattle.

H930.full: In form a plural of H929, but really a singular of Egyptian derivation: a water ox, that is, the hippopotamus or Nile horse: - Behemoth.

H931.full: From an unused root apparently meaning to be thick; the thumb of the hand or great toe of the foot: - thumb, great toe.

H932.full: An orthographical variation of H931; thumb; Bohan, an Israelite: - Bohan.

H933.full: From an unused root meaning to be pale; white scurf: - freckled spot.

H934.full: Feminine active participle of the same as H925; a whitish spot on the skin: - bright spot.

H935.firstSense: abide, apply, attain, X be, befall, + besiege, bring (forth, in, into, to pass), call,…
H935.full: A primitive root; to go or come (in a wide variety of applications): - abide, apply, attain, X be, befall, + besiege, bring (forth, in, into, to pass), call, carry, X certainly, (cause, let, thing for) to come (against, in, out, upon, to pass), depart, X doubtless again, + eat, + employ, (cause to) enter (in, into, -tering, -trance, -try), be fallen, fetch, + follow, get, give, go (down, in, to war), grant, + have, X indeed, [in-]vade, lead, lift [up], mention, pull in, put, resort, run (down), send, set, X (well) stricken [in age], X surely, take (in), way.

H936.full: bûz booz A primitive root; to disrespect: - contemn, despise, X utterly.

H937.full: bûz booz From H936; disrespect: - contempt (-uously), despised, shamed.

H938.full: bûz booz The same as H937; Buz, the name of a son of Nahor, and of an Israelite: - Buz.

H939.full: Feminine passive participle of H936; something scorned; an object of contempt: - despised.

H940.full: Patronymic from H938; a Buzite or descendant of Buz: - Buzite.

H941.full: The same as H940, Buzi, an Israelite: - Buzi.

H942.full: Probably of Persian origin; Bavvai, an Israelite: - Bavai.

H943.full: bûk book A primitive root; to involve (literally or figuratively): - be entangled (perplexed).

H944.full: bûl bool For H2981; produce (of the earth, etc.): - food, stock.

H945.full: bûl bool The same as H944 (in the sense of rain); Bul, the eight Hebrew month: - Bul.

H946.full: From H995; discretion; Bunah, an Israelite: - Bunah.

H947.full: bûs boos A primitive root; to trample (literally or figuratively): - loath, tread (down, under [foot]), be polluted.

H948.full: bûts boots From an unused root (of the same form) meaning to bleach, that is, (intransitively) be white; probably cotton (of some sort): - fine (white) linen.

H949.full: From the same as H948; shining; Botsets, a rock near Michmash: - Bozez.

H950.full: Feminine passive participle of an unused root (meaning to be hollow); emptiness (as adjective): - empty.

H951.full: Properly active participle from H1239 as denominative from H1241; a cattletender: - herdman.

H952.full: bûr boor A primitive root; to bore, that is, (figuratively) examine: - declare.

H953.full: bôr bore From H952 (in the sense of H877); a pit hole (especially one used as a cistern or prison): - cistern, dungeon, fountain, pit, well.

H954.firstSense: (be, make, bring to, cause, put to, with, a-) shame (-d), be (put to) confounded (-fusi…
H954.full: bûsh boosh A primitive root; properly to pale, that is, by implication to be ashamed; also (by implication) to be disappointed, or delayed: - (be, make, bring to, cause, put to, with, a-) shame (-d), be (put to) confounded (-fusion), become dry, delay, be long.

H955.full: Feminine participle passive of H954; shame: - shame.

H956.full: bûth booth (Chaldee); apparently denominative from H1005; to lodge over night: - pass the night.

H957.full: baz baz From H962; plunder: - booty, prey, spoil (-ed).

H958.full: A primitive root; probably to cleave: - spoil.

H959.firstSense: despise, disdain, contemn (-ptible), + think to scorn, vile person
H959.full: A primitive root; to disesteem: - despise, disdain, contemn (-ptible), + think to scorn, vile person.

H961.full: Feminine of H957; booty: - prey, spoil.

H962.firstSense: catch, gather, (take) for a prey, rob (-ber), spoil, take (away, spoil), X utterly
H962.full: A primitive root; to plunder: - catch, gather, (take) for a prey, rob (-ber), spoil, take (away, spoil), X utterly.

H964.full: From H959 and H3050; contempts of Jah; Bizjothjah, a place in Palestine: - Bizjothjah.

H965.full: From an unused root meaning to lighten; a flash of lighting: - flash of lightning.

H966.full: From H965; lightning; Bezek, a place in Palestine: - Bezek.

H967.full: A primitive root; to disperse: - scatter.

H968.full: biz-thaw' Of Persian origin; Biztha, a eunuch of Xerxes: - Biztha.

H969.full: From H974; an assayer of metals: - tower.

H970.full: Participle passive of H977; properly selected, that is, a youth (often collectively): - (choice) young (man), chosen, X hole.

H971.full: Another form of H975; a watch tower of besiegers: - tower.

H972.full: From H977; select: - choose, chosen one, elect.

H973.firstSense: abhor, get hastily [from the margin for H926]
H973.full: A primitive root; to loathe. For H926: - abhor, get hastily [from the margin for H926].

H974.full: A primitive root; to test (especially metals); generally and figuratively to investigate: - examine, prove, tempt, try (trial).

H975.full: From H974 (in the sense of keeping a lookout); a watch tower: - tower.

H977.firstSense: acceptable, appoint, choose (choice), excellent, join, be rather, require
H977.full: A primitive root; properly to try, that is, (by implication) select: - acceptable, appoint, choose (choice), excellent, join, be rather, require.

H978.full: Patrial from H980 (by transposition) a Bacharumite or inhabitant of Bachurim: - Baharumite.

H979.full: Feminine plural of H970; also (masculine plural); youth (collectively and abstractly): - young men, youth.

H980.full: Masculine plural of H970; young men; Bachurim, a place in Palestine: - Bahurim.

H981.full: A primitive root; to babble; hence to vociferate angrily: - pronounce, speak (unadvisedly).

H982.firstSense: be bold (confident, secure, sure), careless (one, woman), put confidence, (make to) hop…
H982.full: A primitive root; properly to hie for refuge (but not so precipitately as H2620); figuratively to trust, be confident or sure: - be bold (confident, secure, sure), careless (one, woman), put confidence, (make to) hope, (put, make to) trust.

H983.firstSense: assurance, boldly, (without) care (-less), confidence, hope, safe (-ly, -ty), secure, s…
H983.full: From H982; properly a place of refuge; abstractly safety, both the fact (security) and the feeling (trust); often (adverbially with or without preposition) safely: - assurance, boldly, (without) care (-less), confidence, hope, safe (-ly, -ty), secure, surely.

H984.full: The same as H983; Betach, a place in Syria: - Betah.

H987.full: Feminine plural from H982; security: - secure.

H988.full: A primitive root; to desist from labor: - cease.

H989.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H988; to stop: - (cause, make to), cease, hinder.

H990.firstSense: belly, body, + as they be born, + within, womb
H990.full: From an unused root probably meaning to be hollow; the belly, especially the womb; also the bosom or body of anything: - belly, body, + as they be born, + within, womb.

H991.full: The same as H990; Beten, a place in Palestine: - Beten.

H992.full: From H990; (only in plural) a pistachio nut (from its form): - nut.

H993.full: Probably plural from H992; hollows; Betonim, a place in Palestine: - Betonim.

H994.full: bı̂y bee Perhaps from H1158 (in the sense of asking); properly a request; used only adverbially (always with "my Lord"); Oh that!; with leave, or if it please: - alas, O, oh.

H995.firstSense: attend, consider, be cunning, diligently, direct, discern, eloquent, feel, inform, inst…
H995.full: bı̂yn bene A primitive root; to separate mentally (or distinguish), that is, (generally) understand: - attend, consider, be cunning, diligently, direct, discern, eloquent, feel, inform, instruct, have intelligence, know, look well to, mark, perceive, be prudent, regard, (can) skill (-ful), teach, think, (cause, make to, get, give, have) understand (-ing), view, (deal) wise (-ly, man).

H996.full: bêyn bane (Sometimes in the plural masculine or feminine); properly the constructively contracted form of an otherwise unused noun from H995; a distinction; but used only as a preposition, between (repeated before each noun, often with other particles); also as a conjugation, either... or: - among, asunder, at, between (-twixt . . . and), + from (the widest), X in, out of, whether (it be... or), within.

H997.full: bêyn bane (Chaldee); corresponding to H996: - among, between.

H998.firstSense: knowledge, meaning, X perfectly, understanding, wisdom
H998.full: From H995; understanding: - knowledge, meaning, X perfectly, understanding, wisdom.

H1000.full: From the same as H948; an egg (from its whiteness): - egg.

H1001.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H1002; a palace: - palace.

H1002.full: Of foreign origin; a castle or palace: - palace.

H1004.firstSense: court, daughter, door, + dungeon, family, + forth of, X great as would contain, hangings
H1004.full: Probably from H1129 abbreviated; a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.): - court, daughter, door, + dungeon, family, + forth of, X great as would contain, hangings. home[born], [winter]house (-hold), inside(-ward), palace, place, + prison, + steward, + tablet, temple, web, + within (-out).

H1005.full: bayith bah-yith (Chaldee); corresponding to H1004: - house.

H1006.full: The same as H1004; Bajith, a place in Palestine: - Bajith.

H1007.full: bayth aw'-ven From H1004 and H205; house of vanity; Beth-Aven, a place in Palestine: - Beth-aven.

H1008.full: bayth-ale' From H1004 and H410; house of God; Beth-El, a place in Palestine: - Beth-el.

H1009.full: bayth ar-bale' From H1004 and H695 and H410; house of God's ambush; Beth Arbel, a place in Palestine: - Beth-Arbel.
