H1010.full: From H1004 and H1168 and H4583; The first form meaning house of Baal of (the) habitation of (apparently by transposition). The second form meaning house of habitation of (Baal); Beth-Baal-Meon, a palce in Palestine: - Beth-baal-meon. Compare H1186 and H1194.

H1011.full: bayth bir-ee' From H1004 and H1254; house of a creative one; Beth-Biri, a place in Palestine: - Beth-birei.

H1012.full: Probably from H1004 and H5679; house of (the) ford; Beth Barah, a place in Palestine: - Beth-barah.

H1013.full: From H1004 and H1447; house of (the) wall; Beth Gader, a place in Palestine: - Beth-gader.

H1014.full: From H1004 and the passive participle of H1576; house of (the) weaned; Beth-Gamul, a place East of the Jordan: - Beth-gamul.

H1015.full: From H1004 and the dual of H1690; house of (the) two fig cakes; Beth-Diblathajim, a place East of the Jordan: - Beth-diblathaim.

H1016.full: From H1004 and H1712; house of Dagon; Beth-Dagon, the name of two places in Palestine: - Beth-dagon.

H1017.full: Patrial from H1008 with the article interposed; a Bethelite, or inhabitant of Bethel: - Bethelite.

H1018.full: bayth haw-ay'-tsel From H1004 and H681 with the article interposed; house of the side; Beth-ha-Etsel, a place in Palestine: - Beth-ezel.

H1019.full: From H1004 and H1537 with the article interposed; house of the Gilgal (or rolling); Beth-hag-Gilgal, a place in Palestine: - Beth-gilgal.

H1020.full: From H1004 and the plural of H8451 with the article interposed; house of the deserts; Beth-ha-Jeshimoth, a town East of the Jordan: - Beth-jeshimoth.

H1021.full: From H1004 and H3754 with the article interposed; house of the vineyard; Beth-hak-Kerem, a place in Palestine: - Beth-haccerem.

H1022.full: Patrial from H1035 with the article inserted; a Beth lechemite, or native of Bethlechem: - Bethlehemite.

H1023.full: From H1004 and H4801 with the article interposed; house of the breadth; Beth-ham-Merchak, a place in Palestine: - place that was far off.

H1024.full: From H1004 and the plural of H4818 (with or without the article interposed); place of (the chariots; Beth-ham-Markaboth or Beth-Markaboth, a place in Palestine: - Beth-marcaboth.

H1025.full: From H1004 and H6010 with the article interposed; house of the valley; Beth-ha-Emek, a place in Palestine: - Beth-emek.

H1026.full: From H1004 and H6160 with the article interposed; house of the Desert; Beth-ha-Arabah, a place in Palestine: - Beth-arabah.

H1027.full: From H1004 and H7311 with the article interposed; house of the height; Beth-ha-Ram, a place East of the Jordan: - Beth-aram.

H1028.full: Probably for H1027; Beth-ha-ran, a place East of the Jordan: - Beth-haran.

H1029.full: From H1004 and H7848 with the article interposed; house of the acacia; Beth-hash-Shittah, a place in Palestine: - Beth-shittah.

H1030.full: Patrial from H1053 with the article inserted; a Beth shimshite, or inhabitant of Bethshemesh: - Bethshemite.

H1031.full: From H1004 and the same as H2295; house of a partridge; Beth-Choglah, a place in Palestine: - Beth-hoglah.

H1032.full: From H1004 and H2356; house of hollowness; Beth-Choron, the name of two adjoining places in Palestine: - Beth-horon.

H1033.full: bêyth kar bayth kar From H1004 and H3733; house of pasture; Beth-Car, a place in Palestine: - Beth-car.

H1034.full: bayth leb-aw-oth' From H1004 and the plural of H3833; house of lionesses; Beth-Lebaoth, a place in Palestine: - Beth-lebaoth. Compare H3822.

H1035.full: From H1004 and H3899; house of bread; Beth-Lechem, a place in Palestine: - Beth-lehem.

H1036.full: From H1004 and the feminine of H6083 (with preposition interposed); house to (that is, of) dust; Beth-le-Aphrah, a place in Palestine: - house of Aphrah.

H1037.full: bayth mil-lo, bayth mil-lo' From H1004 and H4407; house of (the) rampart; Beth-Millo, the name of two citadels: - house of Millo.

H1038.full: From H1004 and H4601; house of Maakah; Beth-Maakah, a place in Palestine: - Beth-maachah.

H1039.full: From H1004 and the feminine of H5246; house of (the) leopard; Beth-Nimrah, a place east of the Jordan: - Beth-nimrah. Compare H5247.

H1040.full: From H1004 and H5730; house of pleasure; Beth-Eden, a place in Syria: - Beth-eden.

H1041.full: From H1004 and H5820; house of Azmaveth, a place in Palestine: - Beth-az-maveth. Compare H5820.

H1042.full: From H1004 and a plural from H6030; house of replies; Beth-Anoth, a place in Palestine: - Beth-anoth.

H1043.full: An orthographical variation for H1042; Beth-Anath, a place in Palestine: - Beth-anath.

H1044.full: From H1004 and a derivative of H6123; house of (the) binding (for sheep shearing); Beth-Eked, a place in Palestine: - shearing-house.

H1045.full: From H1004 and H6252; house of Ashtoreths; Beth-Ashtaroth, a place in Palestine: - house of Ashtaroth. Compare H1203, H6252.

H1046.full: From H1004 and H6412; house of escape; Beth-Palet, a place in Palestine: - Beth-palet.

H1047.full: From H1004 and H6465; house of Peor; Beth-Peor, a place East of the Jordan: - Beth-peor.

H1048.full: From H1004 and a derivative from H6327; house of dispersion; Beth-Patstsets, a place in Palestine: - Beth-pazzez.

H1049.full: From H1004 and H6697; house of (the) rock; Beth-Tsur, a place in Palestine: - Beth-zur.

H1050.full: From H1004 and H7339; house of (the) street; Beth-Rechob, a place in Palestine: - Beth-rehob.

H1051.full: bayth raw-faw' From H1004 and H7497; house of (the) giant; Beth-Rapha, an Israelite: - Beth-rapha.

H1052.full: bayth she-awn', bayth shawn' From H1004 and H7599; house of ease; Beth-Shean or Beth-Shan, a place in Palestine: - Beth-shean, Beth-Shan.

H1053.full: From H1004 and H8121; house of (the) sun; Beth-Shemesh, a place in Palestine: - Beth-shemesh.

H1054.full: From H1004 and H8598; house of (the) apple; Beth-Tappuach, a place in Palestine: - Beth-tappuah.

H1055.full: Probably from H1004; a palace (that is, large house): - palace.

H1056.full: From H1058; weeping; Baca, a valley in Palestine: - Baca.

H1057.full: The same as H1056; the weeping tree (some gum distilling tree, perhaps the balsam): - mulberry tree.

H1058.firstSense: X at all, bewail, complain, make lamentation, X more, mourn, X sore, X with tears, weep
H1058.full: A primitive root; to weep; generally to bemoan: - X at all, bewail, complain, make lamentation, X more, mourn, X sore, X with tears, weep.

H1059.full: From H1058; a weeping: - X sore.

H1060.full: From H1069; firstborn; hence chief: - eldest (son), first-born (-ling).

H1061.full: From H1069; the first fruits of the crop: - first fruit (-ripe [figuratively), hasty fruit.

H1062.full: Feminine of H1060; the firstling of man or beast; abstractly primogeniture: - birthright, firstborn (-ling).

H1063.full: Feminine of H1061; the early fig: - firstripe (fruit).

H1064.full: Feminine of H1062; primogeniture; Bekorath, an Israelite: - Bechorath.

H1065.full: From H1058; a weeping; by analogy, a dripping: - overflowing, X sore, (continual) weeping, wept.

H1066.full: Plural active participle of H1058; (with the article) the weepers; Bokim, a place in Palestine: - Bochim.

H1067.full: Feminine from H1069; the eldest daughter: - firstborn.

H1069.firstSense: make firstborn, be firstling, bring forth first child (new fruit)
H1069.full: A primitive root; properly to burst the womb, that is, (causatively) bear or make early fruit (of woman or tree); also (as denominatively from H1061) to give the birthright: - make firstborn, be firstling, bring forth first child (new fruit).

H1070.full: From H1069 (in the sense of youth); a young camel: - dromedary.

H1071.full: The same as H1070; Beker, the name of two Israelites: - Becher.

H1072.full: Feminine of H1070; a young she camel: - dromedary.

H1073.full: By orthographical variation for H1063; a first ripe fig: - first-ripe.

H1074.full: From H1069; first born; Bokeru, an Israelite: - Bocheru.

H1075.full: From H1069; youthful; Bikri, an Israelite: - Bichri.

H1076.full: Patronymic from H1071; a Bakrite (collectively) or descendant of Beker: - Bachrites.

H1077.full: bal bal From H1086; properly a failure; by implication nothing; usually (adverbially) not at all; also lest: - lest, neither, no, none (that . . . ), not (any), nothing.

H1078.full: bêl bale By contraction for H1168; Bel, the Baal of the Babylonians: - Bel.

H1079.full: bâl bawl (Chaldee); from H1080; properly anxiety, that is, (by implication) the heart (as its seat): - heart.

H1080.full: bel-aw' (Chaldee); corresponding to H1086 (but used only in a mental sense); to afflict: - wear out.

H1081.full: bal-ad-awn' From H1078 and H113 (contracted); Bel (is his) lord; Baladan, the name of a Babylonian prince: - Baladan.

H1082.full: A primitive root; to break off or loose (in a favorable or unfavorable sense), that is, desist (from grief) or invade (with destruction): - comfort, (recover) strength(-en).

H1083.full: From H1082; desistance; Bilgah, the name of two Israelites: - Bilgah.

H1084.full: From H1082; desistant; Bilgai, an Israelite: - Bilgai.

H1085.full: Of uncertain derivation; Bildad, one of Job's friends: - Bildad.

H1086.firstSense: consume, enjoy long, become (make, wax) old, spend, waste
H1086.full: A primitive root; to fail; by implication to wear out, decay (causatively consume, spend): - consume, enjoy long, become (make, wax) old, spend, waste.

H1088.full: Feminine of H1087; failure; Balah, a place in Palestine: - Balah.

H1089.full: bâlah baw-lah A primitive root (rather by transposition for H926); to palpitate; hence (causatively) to terrify: - trouble.

H1090.full: From H1089; timid; Bilhah, the name of one of Jacob's concubines; also of a place in Palestine: - Bilhah.

H1091.full: From H1089; alarm; hence destruction: - terror, trouble.

H1092.full: From H1089; timid; Bilhan, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite: - Bilhan.

H1093.full: (Chaldee); from a root coresponding to H1086; excise (on articles consumed): - tribute.

H1094.full: bel-o', bel-o'ee From H1086; (only in plural construction) rags: - old.

H1095.full: bale-tesh-ats-tsar' Of foreign derivation; Belteshatstsar, the Babylonian name of Daniel: - Belteshazzar.

H1097.firstSense: corruption, ig[norantly], for lack of, where no
H1097.full: From H1086; properly failure, that is, nothing or destruction; usually (with preposition) without, not yet, because not, as long as, etc.: - corruption, ig[norantly], for lack of, where no . . . is, so that no, none, not, un[awares], without.

H1098.full: From H1101; mixed, that is, (specifically) feed (for cattle): - corn, fodder, provender.

H1099.full: From H1097 and H4100; (as indefinite) nothing whatever: - nothing.

H1100.full: From H1097 and H3276; without profit, worthlessness; by extension destruction, wickedness (often in connection with H376, H802, H1121, etc.): - Belial, evil, naughty, ungodly (men), wicked.

H1101.firstSense: anoint, confound, X fade, mingle, mix (self), give provender, temper
H1101.full: A primitive root; to overflow (specifically with oil); by implication to mix; also (denominative from H1098) to fodder: - anoint, confound, X fade, mingle, mix (self), give provender, temper.

H1102.full: A primitive root; to muzzle: - be held in.

H1103.full: A primitive root; to pinch sycamore figs (a process necessary to ripen them): - gatherer.

H1104.firstSense: cover, destroy, devour, eat up, be at end, spend up, swallow down (up)
H1104.full: A primitive root; to make away with (specifically by swallowing); generally to destroy: - cover, destroy, devour, eat up, be at end, spend up, swallow down (up).

H1105.firstSense: devouring, that which he hath swallowed up
H1105.full: From H1104; a gulp; figuratively destruction: - devouring, that which he hath swallowed up.

H1106.full: The same as H1105; Bela, the name of a place, also of an Edomite and of two Israelites: - Bela.

H1107.full: Constructive plural from H1077 and H5703; not till, that is, (as preposition or adverb) except, without, besides: - beside, not (in), save, without.

H1108.full: Patronymic from H1106; a Belaite (collectively) or descendant of Bela: - Belaites.

H1109.full: Probably from H1077 and H5971; not (of the) people, that is, foreigner; Bilam, a Mesopotamian prophet; also a place in Palestine: - Balaam, Bileam.

H1110.full: A primitive root; to annihilate: - (make) waste.

H1111.full: From H1110; waster; Balak, a Moabitish king: - Balak.

H1112.full: bale-shats-tsar', bale-shats-tsar' Of foreign origin (compare H1095); Belshatstsar, a Babylonian king: - Belshazzar.

H1114.full: Of uncertain derivation; Bilshan, an Israelite: - Bilshan.

H1115.firstSense: because un[satiable], beside, but, + continual, except, from, lest, neither, no more, n…
H1115.full: Constructive feminine of H1086 (equivalent to H1097); properly a failure of, that is, (used only as a negative particle, usually with prepositional prefix) not, except, without, unless, besides, because not, until, etc.: - because un[satiable], beside, but, + continual, except, from, lest, neither, no more, none, not, nothing, save, that no, without.

H1116.full: From an unused root (meaning to be high); an elevation: - height, high place, wave.

H1117.full: The same as H1116; Bamah, a place in Palestine: - Bamah. See also H1120.

H1118.full: Probably from H4107 with prepositional prefix; with pruning; Bimhal, an Israelite: - Bimhal.

H1119.full: Prolonged for prepositional prefix; in, with, by, etc.: - for, in, into, through.

H1120.full: Plural of H1116; heights; the second form is a more complete form of the first form; from the same and H1168; heights of Baal; Bamoth or Bamoth Baal, a place East of the Jordan: - Bamoth, Bamoth-baal.

H1121.full: bên bane From H1129; a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like H1, H251, etc.): - + afflicted, age, [Ahoh-] [Ammon-] [Hachmon-] [Lev-]ite, [anoint-]ed one, appointed to, (+) arrow, [Assyr-] [Babylon-] [Egypt-] [Grec-]ian, one born, bough, branch, breed, + (young) bullock, + (young) calf, X came up in, child, colt, X common, X corn, daughter, X of first, + firstborn, foal, + very fruitful, + postage, X in, + kid, + lamb, (+) man, meet, + mighty, + nephew, old, (+) people, + rebel, + robber, X servant born, X soldier, son, + spark, + steward, + stranger, X surely, them of, + tumultuous one, + valiant[-est], whelp, worthy, young (one), youth.

H1122.full: bên bane The same as H1121; Ben, an Israelite: - Ben.

H1123.full: bên bane (Chaldee); corresponding to H1121: - child, son, young.

H1124.full: ben-aw', ben-aw' (Chaldee); corresponding to H1129; to build: - build, make.

H1125.full: ben-ab-ee''-naw-dawb' From H1121 and H40; (the) son of Abinadab; Ben Abinadab, an Israelite: - the son of Abinadab.

H1126.full: ben-o-nee' From H1121 and H205; son of my sorrow; Ben Oni, the original name of Benjamin: - Ben-oni.

H1127.full: From H1121 and H1397; son of (the) hero; Ben Geber, an Israelite: - the son of Geber.

H1128.full: From H1121 and a derivative of H1856; son of piercing (or of a lance); Ben Deker, an Israelite: - the son of Dekar.

H1129.firstSense: (begin to) build (-er), obtain children, make, repair, set (up), X surely
H1129.full: A primitive root; to build (literally and figuratively): - (begin to) build (-er), obtain children, make, repair, set (up), X surely.

H1130.full: From H1121 and H1908; son of Hadad; Ben Hadad, the name of several Syrian kings: - Ben-hadad.

H1131.full: From H1129; built up; Binnui, an Israelite: - Binnui.

H1132.full: From H1121 and H2105; son of Zocheth; Ben Zocheth, an Israelite: - Ben-zoketh.

H1133.full: From H1121 and H2354; son of Chur; Ben Chur, an Israelite: - the son of Hur.

H1134.full: From H1121 and H2428; son of might; Ben Chail, an Israelite: - Ben-hail.

H1135.full: From H1121 and H2605; son of Chanan; Ben Chanan, an Israelite: - Ben-hanan.

H1136.full: From H1121 and H2617; son of kindness; Ben Chesed, an Israelite: - the son of Hesed.

H1137.full: From H1129; built; Bani, the name of five Israelites: - Bani.

H1138.full: From H1129; built; Bunni or Buni, an Israelite: - Bunni.

H1139.full: From the plural construction of H1121 and H1300; sons of lightning, Beneberak, a place in Palestine: - Bene-barak.

H1140.full: Feminine of H1129; a structure: - building.

H1141.full: From H1129 and H3050; Jah has built; Benajah, the name of twelve Israelites: - Benaiah.

H1142.full: From the plural of H1121 and H3292; sons of Yaakan, Bene Jaakan, a place in the Desert: - Bene-jaakan.

H1143.full: Dual of H996; a double interval, that is, the space between two armies: - + champion.

H1144.full: From H1121 and H3225; son of (the) right hand; Binjamin, youngest son of Jacob; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory: - Benjamin.

H1145.full: Multiple forms. Sometimes (with the article inserted); with H376 inserted (1Sa_9:1); son of a man of Jemini; or shorter (1Sa_9:4; Est_2:5); a man of Jemini; or (1Sa_20:1); more simply: a Jeminite; (plural patronymic from H1144; a Benjaminite, or descendant of Benjamin: - Benjamite, of Benjamin.

H1148.full: Probably from H1121 with pronominal suffix; our son; Beninu, an Israelite: - Beninu.

H1149.full: (Chaldee); of uncertain affinity; to be enraged: - be angry.

H1150.full: Of uncertain derivation; Bina or Binah, an Israelite: - Binea, Bineah.

H1151.full: From H1121 and H5971 with pronominal suffix; son of my people; Ben Ammi, a son of Lot: - Ben-ammi.

H1152.full: From H5475 and H3050 with prepositional prefix; in (the) counsel of Jehovah; Besodejah, an Israelite: - Besodeiah.

H1153.full: From H947; domineering; Besai, one of the Nethinim: - Besai.

H1154.full: From an unused root meaning to be sour; an immature grape: - unripe grape.

H1155.full: From the same as H1154: - sour grape.

H1156.firstSense: ask, desire, make [petition], pray, request, seek
H1156.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H1158; to seek or ask: - ask, desire, make [petition], pray, request, seek.

H1157.firstSense: about, at, by (means of), for, over, through, up (-on), within
H1157.full: From H5704 with prepositional prefix; in up to or over against; generally at, beside, among, behind, for, etc.: - about, at, by (means of), for, over, through, up (-on), within.

H1158.firstSense: cause, inquire, seek up, swell out, boil
H1158.full: A primitive root; to gush over, that is, to swell; (figuratively) to desire earnestly; by implication to ask: - cause, inquire, seek up, swell out, boil.

H1160.full: From H1197 (in the sense of burning); a lamp; Beor, the name of the father of an Edomitish king; also of that of Balaam: - Beor.

H1161.full: Masculine plural from H1204; alarms: - terrors.

H1162.full: From an unused root of uncertain meaning; Boaz, the ancestor of David; also the name of a pillar in front of the temple: - Boaz.

H1163.full: A primitive root; to trample down, that is, (figuratively) despise: - kick.

H1165.full: From H1197 (in the sense of eating): cattle: - beast, cattle.

H1166.firstSense: Beulah have dominion (over), be husband, marry (-ried, X wife)
H1166.full: A primitive root; to be master; hence (as denominative from H1167) to marry: - Beulah have dominion (over), be husband, marry (-ried, X wife).

H1167.firstSense: + archer, + babbler, + bird, captain, chief man, + confederate, + have to do, + dreamer…
H1167.full: From H1166; a master; hence a husband, or (figuratively) owner (often used with another noun in modifications of this latter sense: - + archer, + babbler, + bird, captain, chief man, + confederate, + have to do, + dreamer, those to whom it is due, + furious, those that are given to it, great, + hairy, he that hath it, have, + horseman, husband, lord, man, + married, master, person, + sworn, they of.

H1168.full: The same as H1167; Baal, a Phoenician deity: - Baal, [plural] Baalim.

H1170.full: From H1168 and H1285; Baal of (the) covenant; Baal Berith, a special deity of the Shechemites: - Baal-berith.

H1171.full: From H1168 and H1409; Baal of Fortune; Baal Gad, a place in Syria: - Baal-gad.

H1172.full: Feminine of H1167; a mistress: - that hath, mistress.

H1173.full: The same as H1172; Baalah, the name of three places in Palestine: - Baalah.

H1174.full: From H1167 and H1995; possessor of a multitude; Baal Hamon, a place in Palestine: - Baal-hamon.

H1175.firstSense: Bealoth, in Aloth [by mistake for a plural from H5927 with preposition prefix]
H1175.full: Plural of H1172; mistresses; Bealoth, a place in Palestine: - Bealoth, in Aloth [by mistake for a plural from H5927 with preposition prefix].

H1176.full: From H1168 and H2070; Baal of (the) Fly; Baal Zebub, a special deity of the Ekronites: - Baal-zebub.

H1177.full: From H1167 and H2608; possessor of grace; Baal Chanan, the name of an Edomite, also of an Israelite: - Baal-hanan.

H1178.full: From H1167 and a modification of H2691; possessor of a village; Baal Chatsor, a place in Palestine: - Baal-hazor.

H1179.full: From H1167 and H2768; possessor of Hermon; Baal Chermon, a place in Palestine: - Baal-hermon.

H1180.full: From H1167 with pronominal suffix; my master; Baali, a symbolical name of Jehovah: - Baali.

H1181.full: From the plural of H1168 and the plural of H1116; Baals of (the) heights; Baale Bamoth, a place East of the Jordan: - lords of the high places.

H1182.full: From H1168 and H3045; Baal has known; Beeljada, an Israelite: - Beeliada.

H1183.full: From H1167 and H3050; Jah (is) master; Bealjah, an Israelite: - Bealiah.

H1184.full: From the plural of H1167 and H3063; masters of Judah; Baale Jehudah, a place in Palestine: - Baale of Judah.

H1185.full: Probably from a derivative of H5965 with prepositional prefix; in exultation; Baalis, an Ammonitish king: - Baalis.

H1186.full: From H1168 and H4583; Baal of (the) habitation (of) (compare H1010); Baal Meon, a place East of the Jordan: - Baal-meon.

H1187.full: From H1168 and H6465; Baal of Peor; Baal Peor, a Moabitish deity: - Baal-peor.

H1188.full: From H1167 and the plural of H6556; possessor of breaches; Baal peratsim, a place in Palestine: - Baal-perazim.

H1189.full: From H1168 and H6828 (in the sense of cold) (according to others as Egyptian form of Typhon, the destroyer); Baal of winter; Baal Tsephon, a place in Egypt: - Baal-zephon.

H1190.full: From H1168 and H8031; Baal of Shalishah; Baal Shalishah, a place in Palestine: - Baal-shalisha.

H1191.full: A modification of H1172; mistresship; Baalath, a place in Palestine: - Baalath.

H1192.full: bah-al-ath' beh-ayr' From H1172 and H875; mistress of a well; Baalath Beer, a place in Palestine: - Baalath-beer.

H1193.full: From H1167 and H8558; possessor of (the) palm tree; Baal Tamar, a place in Palestine: - Baal-tamar.

H1194.full: Probably a contraction of H1010; Beon, a place East of the Jordan: - Beon.

H1195.full: The same as H1196; Baana, the name of four Israelites: - Baana, Baanah.

H1196.firstSense: Baanah, the name of four Isr: - Baanah
H1196.full: From a derivative of H6031 with prepositional prefix; in affliction: - Baanah, the name of four Isr: - Baanah.

H1197.firstSense: be brutish, bring (put, take) away, burn, (cause to) eat (up), feed, heat, kindle, set…
H1197.full: A primitive root; to kindle, that is, consume (by fire or by eating); also (as denominative from H1198) to be (become) brutish: - be brutish, bring (put, take) away, burn, (cause to) eat (up), feed, heat, kindle, set ([on fire]), waste.

H1198.full: From H1197; properly food (as consumed); that is, (be extension) of cattle brutishness; (concretely) stupid: - brutish (person), foolish.

H1199.full: From H1198; brutish; Baara, an Israelitish woman: - Baara.

H1201.full: From an unused root meaning to stink; offensiveness; Basha, a king of Israel: - Baasha.

H1202.full: From H6213 and H3050 with prepositional prefix; in (the) work of Jah; Baasejah, an Israelite: - Baaseiah.

H1203.full: From H6251 (as singular of H6252) with prepositional prefix; with Ashtoreth; Beeshterah, a place East of the Jordan: - Beeshterah.

H1204.full: A primitive root; to fear: - affright, be (make) afraid, terrify, trouble.

H1206.full: bôts botse Probably the same as H948; mud (as whitish clay): - mire.

H1207.full: Intensive from H1206; a swamp: - fen. mire (-ry place).

H1208.full: From H1219; inaccessible, that is, lofty: - vintage [by confusion with H1210].

H1209.full: Perhaps the same as H1153; Betsai, the name of two Israelites: - Bezai.

H1210.full: From H1219; clipped, that is, the grape crop: - vintage.

H1211.full: From an unused root apparently meaning to peel; an onion: - onion.

H1212.full: bets-al-ale' Probably from H6738 and H410 with prepositional prefix; in (the) shadow (that is, protection) of God; Betsalel; the name of two Israelites: - Bezaleel.

H1213.full: From the same as H1211; a peeling; Batsluth or Batslith; an Israelite: - Bazlith, Bazluth.

H1214.firstSense: (be) covet (-ous), cut (off), finish, fulfill, gain (greedily), get, be given to [covet…
H1214.full: A primitive root to break off, that is, (usually) plunder; figuratively to finish, or (intransitively) stop: - (be) covet (-ous), cut (off), finish, fulfill, gain (greedily), get, be given to [covetousness], greedy, perform, be wounded.

H1215.full: From H1214; plunder; by extension gain (usually unjust): - covetousness, (dishonest) gain, lucre, profit.

H1216.full: A primitive root; perhaps to swell up, that is, blister: - swell.

H1217.full: From H1216; dough (as swelling by fermentation): - dough, flour.

H1218.full: From H1216; a swell of ground; Botscath, a place in Palestine: - Bozcath, Boskath.

H1219.firstSense: cut off, (de-) fenced, fortify, (grape) gather (-er), mighty things, restrain, strong,…
H1219.full: A primitive root; to clip off; specifically (as denominative from H1210) to gather grapes; also to be isolated (that is, inaccessible by height or fortification): - cut off, (de-) fenced, fortify, (grape) gather (-er), mighty things, restrain, strong, wall (up), withhold.

H1220.full: From H1219; strictly a clipping, that is, gold (as dug out): - gold defence.

H1221.full: The same as H1220; an inaccessible spot; Betser, a place in Palestine: - Bezer.

H1222.full: Another form for H1220; gold: - gold.

H1223.full: Feminine from H1219; an enclosure, that is, sheepfold: - Bozrah.

H1224.full: The same as H1223; Botsrah, a place in Edom: - Bozrah.

H1225.full: Masculine intensive from H1219; a fortress: - stronghold.

H1226.full: Feminine intensive from H1219; restraint (of rain), that is, drought: - dearth, drought.

H1227.full: The same as H1228; Bakbuk, one of the Nethinim: - Bakbuk.

H1228.full: From H1238; a bottle (from the gurgling in emptying): - bottle, cruse.

H1229.full: From H1228 and H3050; emptying (that is, wasting) of Jah; Bakbukjah, an Israelite: - Bakbukiah.

H1230.full: Reduplicated from H1239; searcher; Bakbakkar, an Israelite: - Bakbakkar.

H1231.full: From H1238; wasteful; Bukki, the name of two Israelites: - Bukki.

H1232.full: From H1238 and H3050; wasting of Jah; Bukkijah, an Israelite: - Bukkiah.

H1233.full: From H1234; a fissure: - breach, cleft.

H1234.firstSense: make a breach, break forth (into, out, in pieces, through, up), be ready to burst, clea…
H1234.full: A primitive root; to cleave; generally to rend, break, rip or open: - make a breach, break forth (into, out, in pieces, through, up), be ready to burst, cleave (asunder), cut out, divide, hatch, rend (asunder), rip up, tear, win.

H1235.full: From H1234; a section (half) of a shekel, that is, a beka (a weight and a coin): - bekah, half a shekel.

H1237.full: From H1234; properly a split, that is, a wide level valley between mountains: - plain, valley.

H1238.firstSense: (make) empty (out), fail, X utterly, make void
H1238.full: A primitive root; to pour out, that is, to empty, figuratively to depopulate; by analogy to spread out (as a fruitful vine): - (make) empty (out), fail, X utterly, make void.

H1239.full: A primitive root; properly to plough, or (generally) break forth, that is, (figuratively) to inspect, admire, care for, consider: - (make) inquire (-ry), (make) search, seek out.

H1240.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H1239: - inquire, make search.

H1241.firstSense: beeve, bull (+ -ock), + calf, + cow, great [cattle], + heifer, herd, kine, ox
H1241.full: From H1239; a beeve or animal of the ox kind of either gender (as used for ploughing); collectively a herd: - beeve, bull (+ -ock), + calf, + cow, great [cattle], + heifer, herd, kine, ox.

H1242.full: From H1239; properly dawn (as the break of day); generally morning: - (+) day, early, morning, morrow.

H1243.full: Intensive from H1239; a looking after: - seek out.

H1244.full: From H1239; properly examination, that is, (by implication) punishment: - scourged.

H1245.firstSense: ask, beg, beseech, desire, enquire, get, make inquisition, procure, (make) request, req…
H1245.full: A primitive root; to search out (by any method; specifically in worship or prayer); by implication to strive after: - ask, beg, beseech, desire, enquire, get, make inquisition, procure, (make) request, require, seek (for).

H1247.full: bar bar (Chaldee); corresponding to H1121; a son, grandson, etc.: - X old, son.

H1248.full: bar bar Borrowed (as a title) from H1247; the heir (apparent to the throne): - son.

H1249.full: bar bar From H1305 (in its various senses); beloved; also pure, empty: - choice, clean, clear, pure.

H1250.full: bâr bar bawr, bar From H1305 (in the sense of winnowing); grain of any kind (even while standing in the field); by extension the open country: - corn, wheat.

H1251.full: bar bar (Chaldee); corresponding to H1250; a field: - field.

H1252.full: bôr bore From H1305; purity: - cleanness, pureness.

H1253.full: bôr bore The same as H1252; vegetable lye (from its cleansing); used as a soap for washing, or a flux for metals: - X never so, purely.

H1254.firstSense: choose, create (creator), cut down, dispatch, do, make (fat)
H1254.full: A primitive root; (absolutely) to create; (qualified) to cut down (a wood), select, feed (as formative processes): - choose, create (creator), cut down, dispatch, do, make (fat).

H1255.full: ber-o-dak' bal-ad-awn' A variation of H4757; Berodak Baladan, a Babylonian king: - Berodach-baladan.

H1256.full: ber-aw-yaw' From H1254 and H3050; Jah has created; Berajah, an Israelite: - Beraiah.

H1257.full: By reduplication from H1250; a fowl (as fattened on grain): - fowl.

H1258.full: bârad baw-rad A primitive root, to hail: - hail.

H1260.full: From H1258; hail; Bered, the name of a place south of Palestine, also of an Israelite: - Bered.

H1261.full: From H1258; spotted (as if with hail): - grisled.

H1262.full: A primitive root; to select; also (as denominative from H1250) to feed; also (as equivalent to H1305) to render clear (Ecc_3:18): - choose, (cause to) eat, manifest, (give) meat.

H1263.full: Passive participle from H1288; blessed; Baruk, the name of three Israelites: - Baruch.

H1264.full: Probably of foreign origin; damask (stuff of variegated thread): - rich apparel.

H1265.full: Of uncertain derivation; a cypress tree (perhaps); hence a lance or a musical instrument (as made of that wood): - fir (tree).

H1266.full: A variation of H1265; the cypress (or some elastic tree): - fir.

H1268.full: Probably from H1266; cypress or cypresslike; Berothah or Berothai, a place north of Palestine: - Berothah, Berothai.

H1269.full: Probably feminine plural from an unused root (apparently meaning to pierce); holes; Birzoth, an Israelite: - Birzavith [from the margin].

H1270.full: Perhaps from the root of H1269; iron (as cutting); by extension an iron implement: - (ax) head, iron.

H1271.full: From H1270; iron hearted; Barzillai, the name of three Israelites: - Barzillai.

H1272.full: A primitive root; to bolt, that is, figuratively to flee suddenly: - chase (away); drive away, fain, flee (away), put to flight, make haste, reach, run away, shoot.

H1273.full: By transposition for H978; a Barchumite, or native of Bachurim: - Barhumite.

H1275.full: Probably by contraction from H882; Beri, an Israelite: - Beri.

H1276.full: Of uncertain derivation; (only in the plural and with the article) the Berites, a place in Palestine: - Berites.

H1277.full: From H1254 (in the sense of H1262): fatted or plump: - fat ([fleshed], -ter), fed, firm, plenteous, rank.

H1278.full: ber-ee-aw' Feminine from H1254; a creation, that is, a novelty: - new thing.

H1280.full: From H1272; a bolt: - bar, fugitive.

H1281.full: From H1272; a fugitive, that is, the serpent (as fleeing), and the constellation by that name: - crooked, noble, piercing.

H1282.full: The same as H1281; Bariach, an Israelite: - Bariah.

H1283.full: Apparently from the feminine of H7451 with prepositional prefix; in trouble; Beriah, the name of four Israelites: - Beriah.

H1284.full: Patronymic from H1283; a Beriite (collectively) or descendant of Beriah: - Beerites.

H1285.full: From H1262 (in the sense of cutting (like H1254)); a compact (because made by passing between pieces of flesh): - confederacy, [con-]feder[-ate], covenant, league.

H1286.full: The same as H1285; Berith, a Schechemitish deity: - Berith.

H1287.full: Feminine of H1253; vegetable alkali: - sope.

H1288.firstSense: X abundantly, X altogether, X at all, blaspheme, bless, congratulate, curse, X greatly,…
H1288.full: A primitive root; to kneel; by implication to bless God (as an act of adoration), and (vice-versa) man (as a benefit); also (by euphemism) to curse (God or the king, as treason): - X abundantly, X altogether, X at all, blaspheme, bless, congratulate, curse, X greatly, X indeed, kneel (down), praise, salute, X still, thank.

H1292.full: baw-rak-ale' From H1288 and H410, God has blessed; Barakel, the father of one of Job's friends: - Barachel.

H1293.full: From H1288; benediction; by implication prosperity: - blessing, liberal, pool, present.

H1294.full: The same as H1293; Berakah, the name of an Israelite, and also of a valley in Palestine: - Berachah.

H1295.full: From H1288; a reservoir (at which camels kneel as a resting place): - (fish-) pool.

H1296.full: From H1290 and H3050; knee (that is, blessing) of Jah; Berekjah, the name of six Israelites: - Berachiah, Berechiah.

H1297.full: (Chaldee); perhaps from H7313 with prepositional prefix; properly highly, that is, surely; but used adversatively, however: - but, nevertheless, yet.

H1298.full: Of uncertain derivation; Bera, a Sodomitish king: - Bera.

H1299.full: A primitive root; to lighten (lightning): - cast forth.

H1300.full: From H1299; lightning; by analogy a gleam; concretely a flashing sword: - bright, glitter (-ing, sword), lightning.

H1301.full: The same as H1300; Barak, an Israelite: - Barak.

H1302.full: Of uncertain derivation; Barkos, one of the Nethimim: - Barkos.

H1303.full: From H1300; a thorn (perhaps as burning brightly): - brier.

H1304.full: From H1300; a gem (as flashing), perhaps the emerald: - carbuncle.

H1305.firstSense: make bright, choice, chosen, cleanse (be clean), clearly, polished, (shew self) pure (-…
H1305.full: A primitive root; to clarify (that is, brighten), examine, select: - make bright, choice, chosen, cleanse (be clean), clearly, polished, (shew self) pure (-ify), purge (out).

H1306.full: Probably from H7562 with prepositional prefix; with wickedness; Birsha, a king of Gomorrah: - Birsha.

H1307.full: Patrial from H1268; a Berothite, or inhabitant of Berothai: - Berothite.

H1308.full: From H1319; cheerful; Besor, a stream of Palestine: - Besor.

H1309.full: Feminine from H1319; glad tidings; by implication reward for good news: - reward for tidings.

H1310.firstSense: bake, boil, bring forth, is ripe, roast, seethe, sod (be sodden)
H1310.full: A primitive root; properly to boil up; hence to be done in cooking; figuratively to ripen: - bake, boil, bring forth, is ripe, roast, seethe, sod (be sodden).

H1311.full: From H1310; boiled: - X at all, sodden.

H1312.full: Of foreign derivation; Bishlam, a Persian: - Bishlam.

H1313.full: From an unused root meaning to be fragrant; (compare H5561) the balsam plant: - spice.

H1314.full: From the same as H1313; fragrance; by implication spicery; also the balsam plant: - smell, spice, sweet (odour).

H1315.full: Feminine of the second form of H1314; fragrance; Bosmath, the name of a wife of Esau, and of a dughter of Solomon: - Bashemath, Basmath.

H1316.full: Of uncertain derivation; Bashan (often with the article), a region East of the Jordan: - Bashan.

H1318.full: A primitive root; to trample down: - tread.

H1319.firstSense: messenger, preach, publish, shew forth, (bear, bring, carry, preach, good, tell good) t…
H1319.full: A primitive root; properly to be fresh, that is, full (rosy, figuratively cheerful); to announce (glad news): - messenger, preach, publish, shew forth, (bear, bring, carry, preach, good, tell good) tidings.

H1320.firstSense: body, [fat, lean] flesh [-ed], kin, [man-] kind, + nakedness, self, skin
H1320.full: From H1319; flesh (from its freshness); by extension body, person; also (by euphemism) the pudenda of a man: - body, [fat, lean] flesh [-ed], kin, [man-] kind, + nakedness, self, skin.

H1322.firstSense: ashamed, confusion, + greatly, (put to) shame (-ful thing)
H1322.full: From H954; shame (the feeling and the condition, as well as its cause); by implication (specifically) an idol: - ashamed, confusion, + greatly, (put to) shame (-ful thing).

H1323.firstSense: apple [of the eye], branch, company, daughter, X first, X old, + owl, town, village
H1323.full: bath bath From H1129 (as feminine of H1121); a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship, literally and figuratively): - apple [of the eye], branch, company, daughter, X first, X old, + owl, town, village.

H1324.full: bath bath Probably from the same as H1327; a bath or Hebrew measure (as a means of division) of liquids: - bath.

H1325.full: bath bath (Chaldee); corresponding to H1324: - bath.

H1326.full: Probably an orthographical variation for H1327; desolation: - waste.

H1327.full: Feminine from an unused root (meaning to break in pieces); desolation: - desolate.

H1328.full: beth-oo-ale' Apparently from the same as H1326 and H410; destroyed of God; Bethuel, the name of a nephew of Abraham, and of a place in Palestine: - Bethuel. Compare H1329.

H1329.full: For H1328; Bethul (that is, Bethuel), a place in Palestine: - Bethuel.

H1330.full: Feminine passive participle of an unused root meaning to separate; a virgin (from her privacy); sometimes (by continuation) a bride; also (figuratively) a city or state: - maid, virgin.

H1331.full: Masculine plural of the same as H1330; (collectively and abstractly) virginity; by implication and concretely the tokens of it: - X maid, virginity.

H1332.full: From H1323 and H3050; daughter (that is, worshipper) of Jah; Bithjah, an Egyptian woman: - Bithiah.

H1333.full: A primitive root; to cut in pieces: - thrust through.

H1334.full: A primitive root, to chop up: - divide.

H1335.full: From H1334; a section: - part, piece.

H1336.full: The same as H1335; Bether, a (craggy) place in Palestine: - Bether.

H1337.full: From H1323 and a masculine plural from H7227; the daughter (that is, city) of Rabbah: - Bath-rabbim.

H1338.full: From H1334; (with the article) the craggy spot; Bithron, a place East of the Jordan: - Bithron.

H1339.full: From H1323 and H7651 (in the sense of H7650); daughter of an oath; BathSheba, the mother of Solomon: - Bath-sheba.

H1340.full: From H1323 and H7771; daughter of wealth; Bath shua, the same as H1339: - Bath-shua.

H1342.firstSense: gloriously, grow up, increase, be risen, triumph
H1342.full: A primitive root; to mount up; hence in general to rise, (figuratively) be majestic: - gloriously, grow up, increase, be risen, triumph.

H1343.full: gay-eh' From H1342; lofty; figuratively arrogant: - proud.

H1345.full: From H1342 and H410; majesty of God; Geuel, an Israelite: - Geuel.

H1346.firstSense: excellency, haughtiness, highness, pride, proudly, swelling
H1346.full: gah-av-aw' From H1342; arrogance or majesty; by implication (concretely) ornament: - excellency, haughtiness, highness, pride, proudly, swelling.

H1347.firstSense: arrogancy, excellency (-lent), majesty, pomp, pride, proud, swelling
H1347.full: From H1342; the same as H1346: - arrogancy, excellency (-lent), majesty, pomp, pride, proud, swelling.

H1348.firstSense: excellent things, lifting up, majesty, pride, proudly, raging
H1348.full: From H1342; the same as H1346: - excellent things, lifting up, majesty, pride, proudly, raging.

H1350.firstSense: X in any wise, X at all, avenger, deliver, (do, perform the part of near, next) kinsfol…
H1350.full: gaw-al' A primitive root, to redeem (according to the Oriental law of kinship), that is, to be the next of kin (and as such to buy back a relative's property, marry his widow, etc.): - X in any wise, X at all, avenger, deliver, (do, perform the part of near, next) kinsfolk (-man), purchase, ransom, redeem (-er), revenger.

H1351.full: gaw-al' A primitive root, (rather identical with H1350, through the idea of freeing, that is, repudiating); to soil or (figuratively) desecrate: - defile, pollute, stain.

H1353.full: gheh-ool-law' Feminine passive participle of H1350; redemption (including the right and the object); by implication relationship: - kindred, redeem, redemption, right.

H1354.firstSense: back, body, boss, eminent (higher) place, [eye] brows, nave, ring
H1354.full: gab gab From an unused root meaning to hollow or curve; the back (as rounded (compare H1460 and H1479); by analogy the top or rim, a boss, a vault, arch of eye, bulwarks, etc.: - back, body, boss, eminent (higher) place, [eye] brows, nave, ring.

H1355.full: gab gab (Chaldee); corresponding to H1354: - back.

H1356.full: gêb gabe From H1461; a log (as cut out); also well or cistern (as dug): - beam, ditch, pit.

H1357.full: gêb gabe Probably from H1461 (compare H1462); a locust (from its cutting): - locust.

H1358.full: gôb gobe From a root corresponding to H1461; a pit (for wild animals) (as cut out): - den.

H1359.full: From H1461; pit; Gob, a place in Palestine: - Gob.

H1360.full: geh'-beh From an unused root meaning probably to collect; a reservoir; by analogy a marsh: - marsh, pit.

H1361.firstSense: exalt, be haughty, be (make) high (-er), lift up, mount up, be proud, raise up great he…
H1361.full: A primitive root; to soar, that is, be lofty; figuratively to be haughty: - exalt, be haughty, be (make) high (-er), lift up, mount up, be proud, raise up great height, upward.

H1362.full: From H1361; lofty (literally or figuratively): - high, proud.

H1363.firstSense: excellency, haughty, height, high, loftiness, pride
H1363.full: From H1361; elation, grandeur, arrogance: - excellency, haughty, height, high, loftiness, pride.

H1364.firstSense: haughty, height, high (-er), lofty, proud, X exceeding proudly
H1364.full: From H1361; elevated (or elated), powerful, arrogant: - haughty, height, high (-er), lofty, proud, X exceeding proudly.

H1366.firstSense: border, bound, coast, X great, landmark, limit, quarter, space
H1366.full: From H1379; properly a cord (as twisted), that is, (by implication) a boundary; by extension the territory inclosed: - border, bound, coast, X great, landmark, limit, quarter, space.

H1367.full: Feminine of H1366; a boundary, region: - border, bound, coast, landmark, place.

H1368.firstSense: champion, chief, X excel, giant, man, mighty (man, one), strong (man), valiant man
H1368.full: Intensive from the same as H1397; powerful; by implication warrior, tyrant: - champion, chief, X excel, giant, man, mighty (man, one), strong (man), valiant man.

H1369.firstSense: force, mastery, might, mighty (act, power), power, strength
H1369.full: Feminine passive participle from the same as H1368; force (literally or figuratively); by implication valor, victory: - force, mastery, might, mighty (act, power), power, strength.

H1371.full: From an unused root meaning to be high (in the forehead); bald in the forehead: - forehead bald.

H1372.full: From the same as H1371; baldness in the forehead; by analogy a bare spot on the right side of cloth: - bald forehead, X without.

H1373.full: From the same as H1354; collective: - Gabbai, an Isr: - Gabbai.

H1374.full: Plural of H1356; cisterns; Gebim, a place in Palestine: - Gebim.

H1375.full: From an unused root (meaning to be convex); a goblet; by analogy the calyx of a flower: - house, cup, pot.

H1377.full: Feminine of H1376; a mistress: - queen.

H1378.full: From an unused root (probably meaning to freeze); crystal (from its resemblance to ice): - pearl.

H1379.full: A primitive root; properly to twist as a rope; only (as a denominative from H1366) to bound (as by a line): - be border, set (bounds about).

H1380.full: From H1379 (in the sense of a chain of hills); a mountain; Gebal, a place in Phoenicia: - Gebal.

H1381.full: The same as H1380; Gebal, a region in Idumaea: - Gebal.

H1382.full: Patrial from H1380; a Gebalite, or inhabitant of Gebal: - Giblites, stone-squarer.

H1383.full: From H1379; a twisted chain or lace: - end.

H1384.full: From an unused root meaning to be arched or contracted; hunch backed: - crookbackt.

H1385.full: Feminine from the same as H1384; curdled milk: - cheese.

H1386.full: From the same as H1384; a hump or peak of hills: - high.

H1387.full: From the same as H1375, a hillock; Geba, a place in Palestine: - Gaba, Geba, Gibeah.

H1388.full: By permutation for H1389; a hill; Giba, a place in Palestine: - Gibeah.

H1389.full: Feminine from the same as H1387; a hillock: - hill, little hill.

H1390.full: The same as H1389; Gibah; the name of three places in Palestine: - Gibeah, the hill.

H1391.full: From the same as H1387; hilly; Gibon, a place in Palestine: - Gibeon.

H1392.full: Prolonged H1375; the calyx of a flower: - bolled.

H1393.full: Patrial from H1391; a Gibonite, or inhabitant of Gibon: - Gibeonite.

H1394.full: From the same as H1375; hilliness; Gibath: - Gibeath.

H1395.full: Patrial from H1390; a Gibathite, or inhabitant of Gibath: - Gibeathite.

H1396.firstSense: exceed, confirm, be great, be mighty, prevail, put to more [strength], strengthen, be s…
H1396.full: A primitive root; to be strong; by implication to prevail, act insolently: - exceed, confirm, be great, be mighty, prevail, put to more [strength], strengthen, be stronger, be valiant.

H1397.full: From H1396; properly a valiant man or warrior; generally a person simply: - every one, man, X mighty.

H1398.full: The same as H1397; Geber, the name of two Israelites: - Geber.

H1399.full: From H1396; the same as H1397; a person: - man.

H1401.full: (Chaldee); intensive of H1400; valiant, or warrior: - mighty.

H1402.full: Intensive of H1399; Gibbar, an Israelite: - Gibbar.

H1403.full: gab-ree-ale' From H1397 and H410; man of God; Gabriel, an archangel: - Gabriel.

H1404.full: Feminine of H1376; mistress: - lady, mistress.

H1405.full: Intensive of H1389; a hilly spot; Gibbethon, a place in Palestine: - Gibbethon.

H1406.firstSense: roof (of the house), (house) top (of the house)
H1406.full: gâg gawg Probably by reduplication from H1342; a roof; by analogy the top of an altar: - roof (of the house), (house) top (of the house).

H1407.full: gad gad From H1413 (in the sense of cutting); coriander seed (from its furrows): - coriander.

H1408.full: gad gad A variation of H1409; Fortune, a Babylonian deity: - that troop.

H1409.full: gâd gawd From H1464 (in the sense of distributing); fortune: - troop.

H1410.full: gâd gawd From H1464; Gad, a son of Jacob, including his tribe and its territory; also a prophet: - Gad.

H1411.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H1489; a treasurer: - treasurer.

H1412.full: By reduplication from H1413 (in the sense of cutting) cleft; Gudgodah, a place in the Desert: - Gudgodah.

H1413.firstSense: assemble (selves by troops), gather (selves together, self in troops), cut selves
H1413.full: A primitive root (compare H1461); to crowd; also to gash (as if by pressing into): - assemble (selves by troops), gather (selves together, self in troops), cut selves.

H1414.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H1413; to cut down: - hew down.

H1415.full: From an unused root (meaning to cut off); a border of a river (as cut into by the stream): - bank.

H1416.firstSense: army, band (of men), company, troop (of robbers)
H1416.full: From H1413; a crowd (especially of soldiers): - army, band (of men), company, troop (of robbers).

H1417.full: From H1413; a furrow (as cut): - furrow.

H1418.full: Feminine participle passive of H1413; an incision: - cutting.

H1419.firstSense: + aloud, elder (-est), + exceeding (-ly), + far, (man of) great (man, matter, thing, -e…
H1419.full: From H1431; great (in any sense); hence older; also insolent: - + aloud, elder (-est), + exceeding (-ly), + far, (man of) great (man, matter, thing, -er, -ness), high, long, loud, mighty, more, much, noble, proud thing, X sore, (´) very.

H1420.full: Feminine of H1419; greatness; (concretely) mighty acts: - dignity, great things (-ness), majesty.

H1422.full: Feminine passive participle of H1442; a revilement: - taunt.

H1423.full: From the same as H1415; a young goat (from browsing): - kid.

H1424.full: From H1409; fortunate; Gadi, an Israelite: - Gadi.

H1425.full: Patronymic from H1410; a Gadite (collectively) or descendant of Gad: - Gadites, children of Gad.

H1426.full: Intensive for H1424; Gaddi, an Israelite: - Gaddi.

H1427.full: gad-dee-ale' From H1409 and H410; fortune of God; Gaddiel, an Israelite: - Gaddiel.

H1428.full: The same as H1415; a river brink: - bank.

H1429.full: Feminine of H1423; a young female goat: - kid.

H1430.full: From an unused root (meaning to heap up); a stack of sheaves; by analogy a tomb: - shock (stack) (of corn), tomb.

H1431.firstSense: advance, boast, bring up, exceed, excellent, be (-come, do, give, make, wax), great (-e…
H1431.full: A primitive root; properly to twist (compare H1434), that is, to be (causatively make) large (in various senses, as in body, mind, estate or honor, also in pride): - advance, boast, bring up, exceed, excellent, be (-come, do, give, make, wax), great (-er, come to . . estate, + things), grow (up), increase, lift up, magnify (-ifical), be much set by, nourish (up), pass, promote, proudly [spoken], tower.

H1432.full: From H1431; large (literally or figuratively): - great, grew.

H1433.full: From H1431; magnitude (literally or figuratively): - greatness, stout (-ness).

H1434.full: From H1431 (in the sense of twisting); thread, that is, a tassel or festoon: - fringe, wreath.

H1435.full: From H1431; stout; Giddel, the name of one of the Nethinim, also of one of Solomon's servants: - Giddel.

H1436.full: From H1431 and H3050; Jah has become great; Gedaljah, the name of five Israelites: - Gedaliah.

H1437.full: From H1431; I have made great; Giddalti, an Israelite: - Giddalti.

H1438.firstSense: cut (asunder, in sunder, down, off), hew down
H1438.full: A primitive root; to fell a tree; generally to destroy anything: - cut (asunder, in sunder, down, off), hew down.

H1439.full: From H1438; feller (that is, warrior); Gidon, an Israelite: - Gideon.

H1440.full: From H1438; a cutting (that is, desolation); Gidom, a place in Palestine: - Gidom.

H1441.full: From H1438; warlike (compare H1439); Gidoni, an Israelite: - Gideoni.

H1442.full: A primitive root; to hack (with words), that is, revile: - blaspheme, reproach.

H1443.firstSense: close up, fence up, hedge, inclose, make up [a wall], mason, repairer
H1443.full: A primitive root; to wall in or around: - close up, fence up, hedge, inclose, make up [a wall], mason, repairer.

H1445.full: The same as H1444; Geder, a place in Palestine: - Geder.

H1446.full: From H1443; inclosure; Gedor, a place in Palestine; also the name of three Israelites: - Gedor.

H1447.full: From H1443; a circumvallation; by implication an inclosure: - fence, hedge, wall.

H1448.full: Feminine of H1447; inclosure (especially for flocks): - [sheep-]cote (fold) hedge, wall.

H1449.full: The same as H1448; (with the article) Gederah, a place in Palestine: - Gederah, hedges.

H1450.full: Plural of H1448; walls; Gederoth, a place in Palestine: - Gederoth.

H1451.full: Patrial from H1445; a Gederite, or inhabitant of Geder: - Gederite.

H1452.full: Patrial from H1449; a Gederathite, or inhabitant of Gederah: - Gederathite.

H1453.full: Dual of H1448; double wall; Gederothajim, a place in Palestine: - Gederothaim.

H1454.full: gêh gay Probably a clerical error for H2088; this: - this.

H1455.full: A primitive root; to remove (a bandage from a wound, that is, heal it): - cure.

H1457.full: A primitive root; to prostrate oneself: - cast self down, stretch self.

H1458.full: gav gav Another form for H1460; the back: - back.

H1459.full: gav gav (Chaldee); corresponding to H1460; the middle: - midst, same, there- (where-) in.

H1460.full: gêv gave From H1342 (corresponding to H1354); the back; by analogy the middle: - + among, back, body.

H1461.full: gûb goob A primitive root; to dig: - husbandman.

H1462.full: gôb gobe From H1461; the locust (from its grubbing as a larve): - grasshopper, X great.

H1463.full: gôg gohg Of uncertain derivation; Gog, the name of an Israelite, also of some northern nation: - Gog.

H1464.full: gûd goode A primitive root (akin to H1413); to crowd upon, that is, attack: - invade, overcome.

H1465.full: Feminine of H1460; the back, that is, (by extension) the person: - body.

H1466.full: The same as H1465; exaltation; (figuratively) arrogance: - lifting up, pride.

H1468.full: gûz gooz A primitive root (compare H1494); properly to shear off; but used only in the (figurative) sense of passing rapidly: - bring, cutoff.

H1469.full: From H1497; a nestling (as being comparatively nude of feathers): - young (pigeon).

H1470.full: Probably from H1468; a quarry (as a place of cutting stones); Gozan, a province of Assyria: - Gozan.

H1471.full: Apparently from the same root as H1465 (in the sense of massing); a foreign nation; hence a Gentile; also (figuratively) a troop of animals, or a flight of locusts: - Gentile, heathen, nation, people.

H1472.full: Prolonged for H1465; a body, whether alive or dead: - (dead) body, carcase, corpse.

H1473.full: Active participle feminine of H1540; exile; concretely and collectively, exiles: - (carried away), captive (-ity), removing.

H1474.full: From H1473; captive; Golan, a place East of the Jordan: - Golan.

H1475.full: Of uncertain derivation; a pit: - pit.

H1476.full: Probably from H1598; protected; Guni, the name of two Israelites: - Guni.

H1477.full: Patronymic from H1476; a Gunite (collectively with article prefixed) or descendant of Guni: - Gunites.

H1478.firstSense: die, be dead, give up the ghost, perish
H1478.full: A primitive root; to breathe out, that is, (by implication) expire: - die, be dead, give up the ghost, perish.

H1479.full: gûph goof A primitive root; properly to hollow or arch, that is, (figuratively) close; to shut: - shut.

H1480.full: From H1479; a corpse (as closed to sense): - body.

H1481.firstSense: abide, assemble, be afraid, dwell, fear, gather (together), inhabitant, remain, sojourn…
H1481.full: gûr goor A primitive root; properly to turn aside from the road (for a lodging or any other purpose), that is, sojourn (as a guest); also to shrink, fear (as in a strange place); also to gather for hostility (as afraid): - abide, assemble, be afraid, dwell, fear, gather (together), inhabitant, remain, sojourn, stand in awe, (be) stranger, X surely.

H1482.full: gûr gûr goor, goor Perhaps from H1481; a cub (as still abiding in the lair), especially of the lion: - whelp, young one.

H1483.full: gûr goor The same as H1482; Gur, a place in Palestine: - Gur.

H1485.full: From H1481 and H1168; dwelling of Baal; Gur Baal, a place in Arabia: - Gur-baal.

H1486.full: From an unused root meaning to be rough (as stone); properly a pebble, that is, a lot (small stones being used for that purpose); figuratively a portion or destiny (as if determined by lot): - lot.

H1487.full: gûsh gı̂ysh goosh, gheesh Of uncertainly derivation; a mass of earth: - clod.

H1488.full: gêz gaze From H1494; a fleece (as shorn); also mown grass: - fleece, mowing, mown grass.

H1491.full: A primitive root (akin to H1468); to cut off, that is, portion out: - take.

H1492.full: Feminine from H1494; a fleece: - fleece.

H1493.full: Patrial from the unused name of a place apparently in Palestine; a Gizonite or inhabitant of Gizoh: - Gizonite.

H1494.full: A primitive root (akin to H1468); to cut off; specifically to shear a flock, or shave the hair; figuratively to destroy an enemy: - cut off (down), poll, shave, ([sheep-]) shear (-er).

H1495.full: From H1494; shearer; Gazez, the name of two Israelites: - Gazez.

H1496.full: From H1491; something cut, that is, dressed stone: - hewed, hewn stone, wrought.

H1497.firstSense: catch, consume, exercise [robbery], pluck (off), rob, spoil, take away (by force, viole…
H1497.full: A primitive root; to pluck off; specifically to flay, strip or rob: - catch, consume, exercise [robbery], pluck (off), rob, spoil, take away (by force, violence), tear.

H1498.firstSense: robbery, thing taken away by violence
H1498.full: From H1497; robbery, or (concretely) plunder: - robbery, thing taken away by violence.

H1499.full: From H1497; plunder, that is, violence: - violence, violent preverting.

H1500.firstSense: that (he had robbed) [which he took violently away], spoil, violence
H1500.full: Feminine of H1498 and meaning the same: - that (he had robbed) [which he took violently away], spoil, violence.

H1501.full: From an unused root meaning to devour; a kind of locust: - palmer-worm.

H1502.firstSense: Gazzam, one of the Nethinim: - Gazzam
H1502.full: From the same as H1501; devourer: - Gazzam, one of the Nethinim: - Gazzam.

H1503.full: From an unused root meaning to cut down (trees); the trunk or stump of a tree (as felled or as planted): - stem, stock.

H1504.full: A primitive root; to cut down or off; (figuratively) to destroy, divide, exclude or decide: - cut down (off), decree, divide, snatch.

H1505.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H1504; to quarry; determine: - cut out, soothsayer.

H1506.full: From H1504; something cut off; a portion: - part, piece.

H1507.full: The same as H1506; Gezer, a place in Palestine: - Gazer, Gezer.

H1508.full: Feminine of H1506; the figure or person (as if cut out); also an inclosure (as separated): - polishing, separate place.

H1509.full: From H1504; a desert (as separated): - not inhabited.

H1510.full: (Chaldee); From H1505 (as H1504); a decree: - decree.

H1511.full: The first form is patrial from H1507; a Gezerite (collectively) or inhabitant of Gezer; but the second form is better (as in the text) by transposition and is patrial of H1630; a Girzite (collectively) or member of a native tribe in Palestine: - Gezrites.

H1512.full: Probably from H1518; the external abdomen, belly (as the source of the foetus (compare H1521)): - belly.

H1513.full: From an unused root meaning to glow or kindle; an ember: - (burning) coal.

H1514.full: From an unused root meaning to burn; flame; Gacham, a son of Nahor: - Gaham.

H1515.full: From an unused root meaning to hide; lurker; Gachar, one of the Nethinim: - Gahar.

H1516.full: gah'ee, gah'ee Probably (by transmutation) from the same root as H1466 (abbreviated); a gorge (from its lofty sides; hence narrow, but not a gully or winter torrent): - valley.

H1517.full: gı̂yd gheed Probably from H1464; a thong (as compressing); by analogy a tendon: - sinew.

H1518.firstSense: break forth, labor to bring forth, come forth, draw up, take out
H1518.full: A primitive root; to gush forth (as water), generally to issue: - break forth, labor to bring forth, come forth, draw up, take out.

H1519.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H1518; to rush forth: - strive.

H1520.full: From H1518; a fountain; Giach, a place in Palestine: - Giah.

H1521.full: From H1518; stream; Gichon, a river of Paradise; also a valley (or pool) near Jerusalem: - Gihon.

H1522.full: Apparently from H1516 and H2372; valley of a visionary; Gechazi, the servant of Elisha: - Gehazi.

H1523.firstSense: be glad, joy, be joyful, rejoice
H1523.full: gı̂yl gûl gheel, gool A primitive root; properly to spin around (under the influence of any violent emotion), that is, usually rejoice, or (as cringing) fear: - be glad, joy, be joyful, rejoice.

H1524.firstSense: X exceedingly, gladness, X greatly, joy, rejoice (-ing), sort
H1524.full: gı̂yl gheel From H1523; a revolution (of time, that is, an age); also joy: - X exceedingly, gladness, X greatly, joy, rejoice (-ing), sort.

H1525.full: Feminine of H1524; joy: - joy, rejoicing.

H1526.full: Patrial from H1542; a Gilonite or inhabitant of Giloh: - Gilonite.

H1527.full: Of uncertain derivation; Ginath, an Israelite: - Ginath.

H1528.full: gı̂yr gheer (Chaldee); corresponding to H1615; lime: - plaster.

H1529.full: From the same as H1487; lumpish; Geshan, an Israelite: - Geshan.

H1530.full: gal gal From H1556; something rolled, that is, a heap of stone or dung (plural ruins); by analogy a spring of water (plural waves): - billow, heap, spring, wave.

H1531.full: gôl gole From H1556; a cup for oil (as round): - bowl.

H1532.full: From an unused root meaning to shave; a barber: - barber.

H1533.full: From H1530 and H1158; fountain of ebullition; Gilboa, a mountain of Palestine: - Gilboa.

H1534.full: By reduplication from H1556; a wheel; by analogy a whirlwind; also dust (as whirled): - heaven, rolling thing, wheel.

H1535.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H1534; a wheel: - wheel.

H1537.full: The same as H1536 (with the article as a properly noun); Gilgal, the name of three places in Palestine: - Gilgal. See also H1019.

H1538.full: By reduplication from H1556; a skull (as round); by implication a head (in enumeration of persons): - head, every man, poll, skull.

H1539.full: From an unused root probably meaning to polish; the (human) skin (as smooth): - skin.

H1540.firstSense: + advertise, appear, bewray, bring, (carry, lead, go) captive (into captivity), depart,…
H1540.full: A primitive root; to denude (especially in a disgraceful sense); by implication to exile (captives being usually stripped); figuratively to reveal: - + advertise, appear, bewray, bring, (carry, lead, go) captive (into captivity), depart, disclose, discover, exile, be gone, open, X plainly, publish, remove, reveal, X shamelessly, shew, X surely, tell, uncover.

H1541.full: ghel-aw', ghel-aw' (Chaldee); corresponding to H1540: - bring over, carry away, reveal.

H1542.full: From H1540; open; Giloh, a place in Palestine: - Giloh.

H1543.full: Feminine from H1556; a fountain, bowl or globe (all as round): - bowl, pommel, spring.

H1544.full: From H1556; properly a log (as round); by implication an idol: - idol.

H1546.full: Feminine from H1540; captivity; concretely exiles (collectively): - (they that are carried away) captives (-ity.)

H1548.full: A primitive root; properly to be bald, that is, (causatively) to shave; figuratively to lay waste: - poll, shave (off).

H1549.full: From H1540; a tablet for writing (as bare); by analogy a mirror (as a plate): - glass, roll.

H1550.full: From H1556; a valve of a folding door (as turning); also a ring (as round): - folding, ring.

H1551.full: The same as H1550; a circle (with the article); Galil (as a special circuit) in the North of Palestine: - Galilee.

H1552.full: Feminine of H1550; a circuit or region: - border, coast, country.

H1553.full: Plural of H1552; circles; Geliloth, a place in Palestine: - Geliloth.

H1554.full: Plural of H1530; springs, Gallim, a place in Palestine: - Gal-lim.

H1555.full: Perhaps from H1540; exile; Goljath, a Philistine: - Goliath.

H1556.firstSense: commit, remove, roll (away, down, together), run down, seek occasion, trust, wallow
H1556.full: A primitive root; to roll (literally or figuratively): - commit, remove, roll (away, down, together), run down, seek occasion, trust, wallow.

H1557.full: From H1556; dung (as in balls): - dung.

H1558.full: From H1556; a circumstance (as rolled around); only used adverbially, on account of: - because of, for (sake).

H1559.full: From H1556, in the sense of H1560; great; Galal, the name of two Israelites: - Galal.

H1560.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H1556; weight or size (as if rolled): - great.

H1561.full: (Chaldee); A variation of H1557; dung (plural balls of dung): - dung.

H1562.full: From H1561; dungy; Gilalai, an Israelite: - Gilalai.

H1563.full: A primitive root; to fold: - wrap together.

H1564.full: From H1563; a wrapped (and unformed mass, that is, as the embryo): - substance yet being unperfect.

H1565.full: Probably by prolongation from H1563; sterile (as wrapped up too hard); figuratively desolate: - desolate, solitary.

H1566.full: A primitive root; to be obstinate: - (inter-) meddle (with).

H1567.full: From H1530 and H5707; heap of testimony; Galed, a memorial cairn East of the Jordan: - Galeed.

H1568.full: Probably from H1567; Gilad, a region East of the Jordan; also the name of three Israelites: - Gilead, Gileadite.

H1569.full: Patronymic from H1568; a Giladite or descendant of Gilad: - Gileadite.

H1570.full: A primitive root; probably to caper (as a goat): - appear.

H1571.firstSense: again, alike, also, (so much) as (soon), both (so)
H1571.full: gam gam By contraction from an unused root meaning to gather; properly assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correlation both... and: - again, alike, also, (so much) as (soon), both (so) . . . and, but, either . . . or, even, for all, (in) likewise (manner), moreover, nay . . . neither, one, then (-refore), though, what, with, yea.

H1572.full: A primitive root (literally or figuratively) to absorb: - swallow, drink.

H1573.full: go'-meh From H1572; properly an absorbent, that is, the bulrush (from its porosity); specifically the papyrus: - (bul-) rush.

H1574.full: From an unused root apparently meaning to grasp; properly a span: - cubit.

H1575.full: From the same as H1574; a warrior (as grasping weapons): - Grammadims.

H1576.firstSense: + as hast served, benefit, desert, deserving, that which he hath given, recompence, reward
H1576.full: From H1580; treatment, that is, an act (of good or ill); by implication service or requital: - + as hast served, benefit, desert, deserving, that which he hath given, recompence, reward.

H1577.full: Passive participle of H1580; rewarded; Gamul, an Israelite: - Gamul. See also H1014.

H1578.full: Feminine of H1576; meaning the same: - deed, recompence, such a reward.

H1579.full: Of uncertain derivation; Gimzo, a place in Palestine: - Gimzo.

H1580.firstSense: bestow on, deal bountifully, do (good), recompense, requite, reward, ripen, + serve, we…
H1580.full: A primitive root; to treat a person (well or ill), that is, benefit or requite; by implication (of toil) to ripen, that is, (specifically) to wean: - bestow on, deal bountifully, do (good), recompense, requite, reward, ripen, + serve, wean, yield.

H1581.full: Apparently from H1580 (in the sense of labor or burden bearing): - camel.

H1582.full: Probably from H1581; camel driver; Gemalli, an Israelite: - Gemalli.

H1583.full: gam-lee-ale' From H1580 and H410; reward of God; Gamliel, an Israelite: - Gamaliel.

H1584.firstSense: cease, come to an end, fail, perfect, perform
H1584.full: A primitive root; to end (in the sense of completion or failure): - cease, come to an end, fail, perfect, perform.

H1586.full: From H1584; completion; Gomer, the name of a son of Japheth and of his descendants; also of a Hebrewess: - Gomer.

H1587.full: From H1584 and H3050; Jah has perfected; Gemarjah, the name of two Israelites: - Gemariah.

H1588.full: gan gan From H1598; a garden (as fenced): - garden.

H1589.firstSense: carry away, X indeed, secretly bring, steal (away), get by stealth
H1589.full: A primitive root; to thieve (literally or figuratively); by implication to deceive: - carry away, X indeed, secretly bring, steal (away), get by stealth.

H1591.full: From H1589; stealing, that is, (concretely) something stolen: - theft.

H1592.full: From H1589; theft; Genubath, an Edomitish prince: - Genubath.

H1593.full: Feminine of H1588; a garden: - garden.

H1595.full: From an unused root meaning to store; treasure; by implication a coffer: - chest, treasury.

H1597.full: Prolonged from H1595; a treasury: - treasury.

H1598.full: A primitive root; to hedge about, that is, (generally) protect: - defend.

H1599.full: From H1598; gardener; Ginnethon or Ginnetho, an Israelite: - Ginnetho, Ginnethon.

H1600.full: A primitive root; to bellow (as cattle): - low.

H1601.full: Feminine active participle of H1600; lowing; Goah, a place near Jerusalem: - Goath.

H1602.firstSense: abhor, fail, lothe, vilely cast away
H1602.full: A primitive root; to detest; by implication to reject: - abhor, fail, lothe, vilely cast away.

H1603.full: From H1602; loathing; Gaal, an Israelite: - Gaal.

H1605.full: A primitive root; to chide: - corrupt, rebuke, reprove.

H1606.full: From H1605; a chiding: - rebuke (-ing), reproof.

H1607.full: A primitive root to agitate violently: - move, shake, toss, trouble.

H1608.full: From H1607; a quaking; Gaash, a hill in Palestine: - Gaash.

H1609.full: Of uncertain derivation; Gatam, an Edomite: - Gatam.

H1610.full: gaph gaf From an unused root meaning to arch; the back; by extension the body or self: - + highest places, himself.

H1611.full: gaph gaf (Chaldee); corresponding to H1610: - a wing: - wing.

H1612.full: From an unused root meaning to bend; a vine (as twining), especially the grape: - vine, tree.

H1613.full: From an unused root, probably meaning to house in; a kind of tree or wood (as used for building), apparently the cypress: - gopher.

H1614.full: Probably feminine of H1613; properly cypress resin; by analogy sulphur (as equally inflammable): - brimstone.

H1615.full: gir gheer Perhaps from H3564; lime (from being burned in a kiln): - chalk [-stone].

H1616.full: gêr gêyr gare, gare From H1481; properly a guest; by implication a foreigner: - alien, sojourner, stranger.

H1617.full: Perhaps from H1626; a grain; Gera, the name of six Israelites: - Gera.

H1618.full: From an unused root meaning to scratch; scurf (from itching): - scab, scurvy.

H1619.full: From the same as H1618; scabby; Gareb, the name of an Israelite, also of a hill near Jerusalem: - Gareb.

H1620.full: By reduplication from H1641; a berry (as if a pellet of rumination): - berry.

H1621.full: Feminine plural from H1641; the throat (as used in rumination): - neck.

H1622.full: Patrial from an unused name (of uncertain derivation); a Girgashite, one of the native tribes of Canaan: - Girgashite, Girgasite.

H1623.full: A primitive root; to abrade: - scrape.

H1624.full: A primitive root; properly to grate, that is, (figuratively) to anger: - contend, meddle, stir up, strive.

H1625.full: From H1641; the cud (as scraping the throat): - cud.

H1626.full: From H1641 (as in H1625); properly (like H1620) a kernel (round as if scraped), that is, a gerah or small weight (and coin): - gerah.

H1627.full: From H1641; the throat (compare H1621) (as roughened by swallowing): - X aloud, mouth, neck, throat.

H1629.full: A primitive root; to cut off: - cut off.

H1630.full: Plural of an unused noun from H1629 (compare H1511), cut up (that is, rocky); Gerizim, a mountain of Palestine: - Gerizim.

H1632.firstSense: man of great [as in the margin which reads H1419]
H1632.full: From the same as H1486; harsh: - man of great [as in the margin which reads H1419].

H1633.full: A primitive root; to be spare or skeleton like; used only as a denominative from H1634; (causatively) to bone, that is, denude (by extension craunch) the bones: - gnaw the bones, break.

H1634.full: From H1633; a bone (as the skeleton of the body); hence self, that is, (figuratively) very: - bone, strong, top.

H1635.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H1634; a bone: - bone.

H1636.full: From H1634; bony, that is, strong: - Garmite.

H1637.full: From an unused root meaning to smooth; a threshing floor (as made even); by analogy any open area: - (barn, corn, threshing-) floor, (threshing-, void) place.

H1638.full: A primitive root; to crush; also (intransitively and figuratively) to dissolve: - break.

H1639.firstSense: abate, clip, (di-) minish, do (take) away, keep back, restrain, make small, withdraw
H1639.full: A primitive root; to scrape off; by implication to shave, remove, lessen or withhold: - abate, clip, (di-) minish, do (take) away, keep back, restrain, make small, withdraw.

H1640.full: A primitive root; to bear off violently: - sweep away.

H1641.firstSense: catch, chew, X continuing, destroy, saw
H1641.full: A primitive root; to drag off roughly; by implication to bring up the cud (that is, ruminate); by analogy to saw: - catch, chew, X continuing, destroy, saw.

H1642.full: Probably from H1641; a rolling country; Gerar, a Philistine city: - Gerar.

H1643.full: From an unused root meaning to husk; a kernel (collectively), that is, grain: - beaten corn.

H1644.firstSense: cast up (out), divorced (woman), drive away (forth, out), expel, X surely put away, tro…
H1644.full: A primitive root; to drive out from a possession; especially to expatriate or divorce: - cast up (out), divorced (woman), drive away (forth, out), expel, X surely put away, trouble, thrust out.

H1645.full: From H1644; produce (as if expelled): - put forth.

H1646.full: Feminine passive participle of H1644; (abstractly) dispossession: - exaction.

H1647.full: For H1648; Gereshom, the name of four Israelites: - Gershom.

H1648.full: From H1644; a refugee; Gereshon or Gereshom, an Israelite: - Gershon, Gershom.

H1649.full: Patronymic from H1648; a Gereshonite or descendant of Gereshon: - Gershonite, sons of Gershon.

H1650.full: From an unused root (meaning to join); bridge; Geshur, a district of Syria: - Geshur, Geshurite.

H1651.full: Patrial from H1650; a Geshurite (also collectively) or inhabitant of Geshur: - Geshuri, Geshurites.

H1652.full: A primitive root; to shower violently: - (cause to) rain.

H1653.full: From H1652; a shower: - rain, shower.

H1654.full: The same as H1653; Geshem or Gashmu, an Arabian: - Geshem, Gashmu.

H1655.full: (Chaldee); apparently the same as H1653; used in a peculiar sense, the body (probably for the (figurative) idea of a hard rain): - body.

H1656.full: From H1652; equivalent to H1653: - rained upon.

H1657.full: Probably of Egyptian origin; Goshen, the residence of the Israelites in Egypt; also a place in Palestine: - Goshen.

H1658.full: ghish-paw' Of uncertain derivation; Gishpa, an Israelite: - Gispa.

H1659.full: A primitive root; apparently to feel about: - grope.

H1660.full: gath gath Probably from H5059 (in the sense of treading out grapes); a wine press (or vat for holding the grapes in pressing them): - (wine-) press (fat).

H1661.full: gath gath The same as H1660; Gath, a Philistine city: - Gath.

H1662.full: From H1660 and H2658 with the article inserted; wine press of (the) well; Gath Chepher, a place in Palestine: - Gath-kephr, Gittah-kephr.

H1663.full: Patrial from H1661; a Gittite or inhabitant of Gath: - Gittite.

H1664.full: Dual of H1660; double wine press; Gittajim, a place in Palestine: - Gittaim.

H1665.full: Feminine of H1663; a Gittite harp: - Gittith.

H1666.full: Of uncertain derivation; Gether, a son of Aram, and the region settled by him: - Gether.

H1667.full: From H1660 and H7416; wine press of (the) pomegranate; Gath Rimmon, a place in Palestine: - Gath-rimmon.

H1668.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H2088; this: - one . . . another, this.

H1669.full: daw-ab' A primitive root; to pine: - mourn, sorrow (-ful).

H1670.full: deh-aw-baw' From H1669; properly pining; by analogy fear: - sorrow.

H1672.firstSense: be afraid (careful, sorry), sorrow, take thought
H1672.full: daw-ag' A primitive root; be anxious: - be afraid (careful, sorry), sorrow, take thought.

H1673.full: Active participle of H1672; anxious; Doeg, an Edomite: - Doeg.

H1674.full: deh-aw-gaw' From H1672; anxiety: - care (-fulness), fear, heaviness, sorrow.

H1675.full: A primitive root; to dart, that is, fly rapidly: - fly.

H1676.full: From H1675; the kite (from its rapid flight): - vulture. See H7201.

H1677.full: dôb dôb dobe, dobe From H1680; the bear (as slow): - bear.

H1678.full: dôb dobe (Chaldee); corresponding to H1677: - bear.

H1679.full: do'-beh From an unused root (compare H1680) (probably meaning to be sluggish, that is, restful); quiet: - strength.

H1680.full: A primitive root (compare H1679); to move slowly, that is, glide: - cause to speak.

H1681.full: From H1680 (in the sense of furtive motion); slander: - defaming, evil report, infamy, slander.

H1682.full: From H1696 (in the sense of orderly motion); the bee (from its systematic instincts): - bee.

H1683.full: The same as H1682; Deborah, the name of two Hebrewesses: - Deborah.

H1684.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H2076; to sacrifice (an animal): - offer [sacrifice].

H1686.full: Both (in the plural only and) of uncertain derivation; probably some cheap vegetable, perhaps a bulbous root: - dove's dung.

H1687.full: From H1696 (apparently in the sense of oracle); the shrine or innermost part of the sanctuary: - oracle.

H1688.full: The second form used in Jos_13:26 (but see H3810); the same as H1687; Debir, the name of an Amoritish king and of two places in Palestine: - Debir.

H1689.full: Probably an orthographical error for H7247; Diblah, a place in Syria: - Diblath.

H1690.full: From an unused root (akin to H2082) probably meaning to press together; a cake of pressed figs: - cake (lump) of figs.

H1691.full: Dual from the masculine of H1690; two cakes; Diblajim, a symbolical name: - Diblaim.

H1692.firstSense: abide, fast, cleave (fast together), follow close (hard, after), be joined (together),…
H1692.full: A primitive root; properly to impinge, that is, cling or adhere; figuratively to catch by pursuit: - abide, fast, cleave (fast together), follow close (hard, after), be joined (together), keep (fast), overtake, pursue hard, stick, take.

H1693.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H1692; to stick to: - cleave.

H1694.full: From H1692; a joint; by implication solder: - joint, solder.

H1695.full: From H1692; adhering: - cleave, joining, stick closer.

H1696.firstSense: answer, appoint, bid, command, commune, declare, destroy, give, name, promise, pronounc…
H1696.full: A primitive root; perhaps properly to arrange; but used figuratively (of words) to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue: - answer, appoint, bid, command, commune, declare, destroy, give, name, promise, pronounce, rehearse, say, speak, be spokesman, subdue, talk, teach, tell, think, use [entreaties], utter, X well, X work.

H1697.firstSense: act, advice, affair, answer, X any such (thing), + because of, book, business, care, ca…
