H1697.full: From H1696; a word; by implication a matter (as spoken of) of thing; adverbially a cause: - act, advice, affair, answer, X any such (thing), + because of, book, business, care, case, cause, certain rate, + chronicles, commandment, X commune (-ication), + concern [-ing], + confer, counsel, + dearth, decree, deed, X disease, due, duty, effect, + eloquent, errand, [evil favoured-] ness, + glory, + harm, hurt, + iniquity, + judgment, language, + lying, manner, matter, message, [no] thing, oracle, X ought, X parts, + pertaining, + please, portion, + power, promise, provision, purpose, question, rate, reason, report, request, X (as hast) said, sake, saying, sentence, + sign, + so, some [uncleanness], somewhat to say, + song, speech, X spoken, talk, task, + that, X there done, thing (concerning), thought, + thus, tidings, what [-soever], + wherewith, which, word, work.

H1698.full: From H1696 (in the sense of destroying); a pestilence: - murrain, pestilence, plague.

H1699.full: The first form is from H1696 (in its original sense); a pasture (from its arrangement of the flock); translated fold or manner. The second form is for H1697; translated word: - fold, manner.

H1700.full: Feminine of H1697; a reason, suit or style: - cause, end, estate, order, regard.

H1702.full: Feminine active participle of H1696 in the sense of driving (compare H1699); a raft: - float.

H1703.full: Intensive from H1696; a word: - word.

H1704.full: From H1697; wordy; Dibri, an Israelite: - Dibri.

H1705.full: From H1697 (perhaps in the sense of H1699); Daberath, a place in Palestine: - Dabareh, Daberath.

H1706.full: From an unused root meaning to be gummy; honey (from its stickiness); by analogy syrup: - honey ([-comb]).

H1707.full: Intensive from the same as H1706; a sticky mass, that is, the hump of a camel: - hunch [of a camel].

H1708.full: The same as H1707; Dabbesheth, a place in Palestine: - Dabbesheth.

H1709.full: dawg, dawg From H1711; a fish (as prolific); or perhaps rather from H1672 (as timid); but still better from H1672 (in the sense of squirming, that is, moving by the vibratory action of the tail); a fish (often used collectively): - fish.

H1710.full: Feminine of H1709, and meaning the same: - fish.

H1711.full: A primitive root; to move rapidly; used only as a denominative from H1709; to spawn, that is, become numerous: - grow.

H1712.full: From H1709; the fish god; Dagon, a Philistine deity: - Dagon.

H1713.full: A primitive root; to flaunt, that is, raise a flag; figuratively to be conspicuous: - (set up, with) banners, chiefest.

H1714.full: From H1713; a flag: - banner, standard.

H1715.full: From H1711; properly increase, that is, grain: - corn ([floor]), wheat.

H1716.full: A primitive root; to brood over eggs or young: - gather, sit.

H1717.full: dad dad Apparently from the same as H1730; the breast (as the seat of love, or from its shape): - breast, teat.

H1718.full: A doubtful root; to walk gently: - go (softly, with).

H1719.full: Of uncertain derivation; Dedan, the name of two Cushites and of their territory. The second form used in Eze_25:13: - Dedan.

H1720.full: Plural of H1719 (as patrial); Dedanites, the descendants or inhabitants of Dedan: - Dedanim.

H1721.full: The second form is used by orthographical error in 1Ch_1:7. A plural of uncertain derivation; Dodanites, or descendants of a son of Javan: - Dodanim.

H1723.full: dah-hav-aw' (Chaldee); of uncertain derivation; Dahava, a people colonized in Samaria: - Dehavites.

H1724.full: A primitive root (compare H1740); to be dumb, that is, (figuratively) dumbfounded: - be astonished.

H1725.full: A primitive root; to curvet or move irregularly: - pranse.

H1726.full: By reduplication from H1725; a gallop: - pransing.

H1727.full: dûb doob A primitive root; to mope, that is, (figuratively) pine: - sorrow.

H1728.full: An orthographical variation of H1709 as a denominative (H1771); a fisherman: - fisher.

H1729.full: Feminine from the same as H1728; properly fishery, that is, a hook for fishing: - fish [hook].

H1730.full: dôd dôd dode, dode From an unused root meaning properly to boil, that is, (figuratively) to love; by implication a love token, lover, friend; specifically an uncle: - (well-) beloved, father's brother, love, uncle.

H1731.full: dûd dood From the same as H1730; a pot (for boiling); also (by resemblance of shape) a basket: - basket, caldron, kettle, (seething) pot.

H1732.full: From the same as H1730; loving; David, the youngest son of Jesse: - David.

H1733.full: Feminine of H1730; an aunt: - aunt, father's sister, uncle's wife.

H1734.full: From H1730; loving; Dodo, the name of three Israelites: - Dodo.

H1735.full: From H1730 and H3050; love of Jah; Dodavah, an Israelite: - Dodavah.

H1736.full: From H1731; a boiler or basket; also the mandrake (as aphrodisiac): - basket, mandrake.

H1737.full: Formed like H1736; amatory; Dodai, an Israelite: - Dodai.

H1738.full: A primitive root; to be sick (as if in menstruation): - infirmity.

H1739.firstSense: faint, menstruous cloth, she that is sick, having sickness
H1739.full: From H1738; sick (especially in menstruation): - faint, menstruous cloth, she that is sick, having sickness.

H1740.full: A primitive root; to thrust away; figuratively to cleanse: - cast out, purge, wash.

H1741.full: From H1739; sickness; figuratively loathing: - languishing, sorrowful.

H1742.full: From H1739; sick; figuratively troubled: - faint.

H1743.full: dûk dook A primitive root; to bruise in a mortar: - beat.

H1744.full: Of uncertain derivation; the hoopoe or else the grouse: - lapwing.

H1745.full: From an unused root meaning to be dumb (compare H1820); silence; figuratively death: - silence.

H1746.full: The same as H1745; Dumah, a tribe and region of Arabia: - Dumah.

H1747.full: From H1820; stillness; adverbially silently; abstractly quiet, trust: - silence, silent, waiteth.

H1748.full: From H1826; still; adverbially silently: - dumb, silent, quietly wait.

H1750.full: dûts doots A primitive root; to leap: - be turned.

H1751.full: dûq dook (Chaldee); corresponding to H1854; to crumble: - be broken to pieces.

H1752.full: dûr dure A primitive root; properly to gyrate (or move in a circle), that is, to remain: - dwell.

H1753.full: dûr dure (Chaldee); corresponding to H1752; to reside: - dwell.

H1754.full: dûr dure From H1752; a circle, ball or pile: - ball, turn, round about.

H1755.full: dôr dôr dore, dore From H1752; properly a revolution of time, that is, an age or generation; also a dwelling: - age, X evermore, generation, [n-]ever, posterity.

H1756.full: dore, dore From H1755; dwelling; Dor, a place in Palestine: - Dor.

H1757.full: (Chaldee); probably from H1753; circle or dwelling; Dura, a place in Babylon: - Dura.

H1758.firstSense: break, tear, thresh, tread out (down), at grass [Jer
H1758.full: dûsh dôsh dı̂ysh doosh, dosh, deesh A primitive root; to trample or thresh: - break, tear, thresh, tread out (down), at grass [Jer. H50 : H11, by mistake for H1877].

H1759.full: dûsh doosh (Chaldee); corresponding to H1758; to trample: - tread down.

H1760.firstSense: chase, drive away (on), overthrow, outcast, X sore, thrust, totter
H1760.full: A primitive root; to push down: - chase, drive away (on), overthrow, outcast, X sore, thrust, totter.

H1761.full: (Chaldee); from the equivalent of H1760; probably a musical instrument (as being struck): - instrument of music.

H1762.full: From H1760; a push, that is, (by implication) a fall: - falling.

H1763.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H2119; to slink, that is, (by implication) to fear, or (causatively) be formidable: - make afraid, dreadful, fear, terrible.

H1765.full: A primitive root; to urge, that is, hasten: - (be) haste (-ned), pressed on.

H1766.full: A primitive root; to press, that is, oppress: - thrust, vex.

H1767.firstSense: able, according to, after (ability), among, as (oft as), (more than) enough, from, in,…
H1767.full: day dahee Of uncertain derivation; enough (as noun or adverb), used chiefly with preposition in phrases: - able, according to, after (ability), among, as (oft as), (more than) enough, from, in, since, (much as is) sufficient (-ly), too much, very, when.

H1768.firstSense: X as, but, for (-asmuch +), + now, of, seeing, than, that, therefore, until, + what (-s…
H1768.full: dı̂y dee (Chaldee); apparently for H1668; that, used as relative, conjugational, and especially (with preposition) in adverbial phrases; also as a preposition of: - X as, but, for (-asmuch +), + now, of, seeing, than, that, therefore, until, + what (-soever), when, which, whom, whose.

H1769.firstSense: Dibon, the name of three places in Palestine - Dibon
H1769.full: From H1727; pining; Dibon, the name of three places in Palestine. Also, with H1410 added, Dibon-gad: - Dibon, the name of three places in Palestine - Dibon. [Also, with H1410 added, Dibon-gad.]

H1770.full: dı̂yg deeg Denominative from H1709; to fish: - fish.

H1772.full: Intensive from H1675; a falcon (from its rapid flight): - vulture.

H1774.full: As if from H1768 and H2091; of gold; Dizahab, a place in the Desert: - Dizahab.

H1775.full: Perhaps for H1769; Dimon, a place in Palestine: - Dimon.

H1776.full: Feminine of H1775; Dimonah, a place in Palestine: - Dimonah.

H1777.firstSense: contend, execute (judgment), judge, minister judgment, plead (the cause), at strife, st…
H1777.full: dı̂yn dûn deen, doon A primitive root (compare H113); to rule; by implication to judge (as umpire); also to strive (as at law): - contend, execute (judgment), judge, minister judgment, plead (the cause), at strife, strive.

H1778.full: dı̂yn deen (Chaldee); corresponding to H1777; to judge: - judge.

H1779.full: dı̂yn dûn deen, doon From H1777; judgment (the suit, justice, sentence or tribunal); by implication also strife: - cause, judgment, plea, strife.

H1780.full: dı̂yn deen (Chaldee); corresponding to H1779: - judgment.

H1781.full: From H1777; a judge or advocate: - judge.

H1783.full: Feminine of H1779; justice; Dinah, the daughter of Jacob: - Dinah.

H1784.full: (Chaldee); patrial from an uncertain primitive; a Dinaite or inhabitant of some unknown Assyrian province: - Dinaite.

H1785.full: From a root corresponding to H1751; a battering tower: - fort.

H1787.full: The same as H1788; Dishon, the name of two Edomites: - Dishon.

H1788.full: From H1758; the leaper, that is, an antelope: - pygarg.

H1789.full: Another form of H1787; Dishan, an Edomite: - Dishan, Dishon.

H1790.full: dak dak From an unused root (compare H1794); crushed, that is, (figuratively) injured: - afflicted, oppressed.

H1791.full: dêk dâk dake, dawk (Chaldee); prolonged from H1668; this: - the same, this.

H1792.firstSense: beat to pieces, break (in pieces), bruise, contrite, crush, destroy, humble, oppress, s…
H1792.full: A primitive root (compare H1794) to crumble; transitively to bruise (literally or figuratively): - beat to pieces, break (in pieces), bruise, contrite, crush, destroy, humble, oppress, smite.

H1793.full: dak-kaw' From H1792; crushed (literally powder, or figuratively contrite): - contrite, destruction.

H1794.full: A primitive root (compare H1790, H1792); to collapse (physically or mentally): - break (sore), contrite, crouch.

H1795.full: From H1794 like H1793; mutilated: - + wounded.

H1796.full: From H1794; a dashing of surf: - wave.

H1797.full: (Chaldee); prolonged from H1791; this: - same, that, this.

H1798.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H2145; properly a male, i. e of sheep: - ram.

H1799.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H2146; a register: - record.

H1800.full: dal dal From H1809; properly dangling, that is, (by implication) weak or thin: - lean, needy, poor (man), weaker.

H1801.full: A primitive root; to spring: - leap.

H1802.full: A primitive root (compare H1809); properly to dangle, that is, to let down a bucket (for drawing out water); figuratively to deliver: - draw (out), X enough, lift up.

H1803.full: From H1802; properly something dangling, that is, a loose thread or hair; figuratively indigent: - hair, pining sickness, poor (-est sort).

H1804.full: A primitive root; to roil water: - trouble.

H1805.full: From H1802; a pail or jar (for drawing water): - bucket.

H1806.full: From H1802 adn H3050; Jah has delivered; Delajah, the name of five Israelites: - Dalaiah, Delaiah.

H1807.full: From H1809; languishing: - Delilah, a Philistine woman: - Delilah.

H1808.full: From H1802; something dangling, that is, a bough: - branch.

H1809.firstSense: bring low, dry up, be emptied, be not equal, fail, be impoverished, be made thin
H1809.full: A primitive root (compare H1802); to slacken or be feeble; figuratively to be oppressed: - bring low, dry up, be emptied, be not equal, fail, be impoverished, be made thin.

H1810.full: Of uncertain derivation; Dilan, a place in Palestine: - Dilean.

H1811.full: A primitive root; to drip; by implication to weep: - drop through, melt, pour out.

H1813.full: From H1811; dripping; Dalphon, a son of Haman: - Dalphon.

H1814.firstSense: burning, chase, inflame, kindle, persecute (-or), pursue hotly
H1814.full: A primitive root; to flame (literally or figuratively): - burning, chase, inflame, kindle, persecute (-or), pursue hotly.

H1816.full: From H1814; a burning fever: - inflammation.

H1817.full: From H1802; something swinging, that is, the valve of a door: - door (two-leaved), gate, leaf, lid. [In Psa_141:3, dal, irreg.]

H1818.full: dâm dawm From H1826 (compare H119); blood (as that which when shed causes death) of man or an animal; by analogy the juice of the grape; figuratively (especially in the plural) bloodshed (that is, drops of blood): - blood (-y, -guiltiness, [-thirsty]), + innocent.

H1819.firstSense: compare, devise, (be) like (-n), mean, think, use similitudes
H1819.full: A primitive root; to compare; by implication to resemble, liken, consider: - compare, devise, (be) like (-n), mean, think, use similitudes.

H1820.firstSense: cease, be cut down (off), destroy, be brought to silence, be undone, X utterly
H1820.full: A primitive root; to be dumb or silent; hence to fail or perish; transitively to destroy: - cease, be cut down (off), destroy, be brought to silence, be undone, X utterly.

H1821.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H1819; to resemble: - be like.

H1822.full: From H1820; desolation; concretely desolate: - destroy.

H1823.full: From H1819; resemblance; concretely model, shape; adverbially like: - fashion, like (-ness, as), manner, similitude.

H1824.full: From H1820; quiet: - cutting off, rest, silence.

H1826.firstSense: cease, be cut down (off), forbear, hold peace, quiet self, rest, be silent, keep (put t…
H1826.full: A primitive root (compare H1724, H1820); to be dumb; by implication to be astonished, to stop; also to perish: - cease, be cut down (off), forbear, hold peace, quiet self, rest, be silent, keep (put to) silence, be (stand), still, tarry, wait.

H1827.full: Feminine from H1826; quiet: - calm, silence, still.

H1829.full: Feminine from the same as H1828; a dung heap; Dimnah, a place in Palestine: - Dimnah.

H1830.full: A primitive root; to weep: - X sore, weep.

H1831.full: From H1830; a tear; figuratively juice: - liquor.

H1833.full: By orthographical variation from H1834; damask (as a fabric of Damascus): - in Damascus.

H1834.full: Of foreign origin; Damascus, a city of Syria: - Damascus.

H1835.full: dân dawn From H1777; judge; Dan, one of the sons of Jacob; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory; likewise a place in Palestine colonized by them: - Dan.

H1836.firstSense: [afore-] time, + after this manner, here [-after], one
H1836.full: dên dane (Chaldee); an orthographical variation of H1791; this: - [afore-] time, + after this manner, here [-after], one . . . another, such, there [-fore], these, this (matter), + thus, where [-fore], which.

H1837.full: Of uncertain derivation; Dannah, a place in Palestine: - Dannah.

H1838.full: Of uncertain derivation; Dinhabah, an Edomitish town: - Dinhaban.

H1839.full: Patronymic from H1835; a Danite (often collectively) or descendant (or inhabitant) of Dan: - Danites, of Dan.

H1840.full: From H1835 and H410; judge of God; Daniel or Danijel, the name of two Israelites: - Daniel.

H1841.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H1840; Danijel, the Hebrew prophet: - Daniel.

H1842.full: From H1835 and (apparently) H3282; judge of purpose; Dan Jaan, a place in Palestine: - Dan-jaan.

H1845.full: From H3045 and H410; known of God; Deuel, an Israelite: - Deuel.

H1846.firstSense: be extinct, consumed, put out, quenched
H1846.full: A primitive root; to be extinguished; figuratively to expire or be dried up: - be extinct, consumed, put out, quenched.

H1847.full: From H3045; knowledge: - cunning, [ig-] norantly, know(-ledge), [un-] awares (wittingly).

H1848.full: From an unused root (meaning to push over); a stumbling block: - slanderest.

H1849.full: A primitive root; to knock; by analogy to press severely: - beat, knock, overdrive.

H1850.full: From H1849; a knock; Dophkah, a place in the Desert: - Dophkah.

H1851.firstSense: dwarf, lean [-fleshed], very little thing, small, thin
H1851.full: daq dak From H1854; crushed, that is, (by implication) small or thin: - dwarf, lean [-fleshed], very little thing, small, thin.

H1852.full: dôq doke From H1854; something crumbling, that is, fine (as a thin cloth): - curtain.

H1853.full: Of foreign origin; Diklah, a region of Arabia: - Diklah.

H1854.firstSense: beat in pieces (small), bruise, make dust, (into) X powder, (be, very) small, stamp (sm…
H1854.full: A primitive root (compare H1915); to crush (or intransitively) crumble: - beat in pieces (small), bruise, make dust, (into) X powder, (be, very) small, stamp (small).

H1855.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H1854; to crumble or (transitively) crush: - break to pieces.

H1856.full: A primitive root; to stab; by analogy to starve; figuratively to revile: - pierce, strike (thrust) through, wound.

H1857.full: From H1856; a stab; Deker, an Israelite: - Dekar.

H1858.full: dar dar Apparently from the same as H1865; properly a pearl (from its sheen as rapidly turned); by analogy pearl stone, that is, mother of pearl or alabaster: - X white.

H1859.full: dâr dawr (Chaldee); corresponding to H1755; an age: - generation.

H1860.full: From an unused root (meaning to repulse); an object of aversion: - abhorring, contempt.

H1861.full: Of uncertain derivation; a goad: - goad.

H1862.full: Apparently from H1858 and H1843; pearl of knowledge; Darda, an Israelite: - Darda.

H1863.full: Of uncertain derivation; a thorn: - thistle.

H1864.full: Of uncertain derivation; the south; poet, the south wind: - south.

H1865.full: From an unused root (meaning to move rapidly); freedom; hence spontaneity of outflow, and so clear: - liberty, pure.

H1866.full: The same as H1865, applied to a bird; the swift, a kind of swallow: - swallow.

H1867.full: Of Persian origin; Darejavesh, a title (rather than name) of several Persian kings: - Darius.

H1869.firstSense: archer, bend, come, draw, go (over), guide, lead (forth), thresh, tread (down), walk
H1869.full: A primitive root; to tread; by implication to walk; also to string a bow (by treading on it in bending): - archer, bend, come, draw, go (over), guide, lead (forth), thresh, tread (down), walk.

H1870.firstSense: along, away, because of, + by, conversation, custom, [east-] ward, journey, manner, pas…
H1870.full: From H1869; a road (as trodden); figuratively a course of life or mode of action, often adverbially: - along, away, because of, + by, conversation, custom, [east-] ward, journey, manner, passenger, through, toward, [high-] [path-] way [-side], whither [-soever].

H1871.full: Of Persian origin; a "drachma" or coin: - dram.

H1872.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H2220; an arm: - arm.

H1873.full: Probably contracted from H1862; Dara, an Israelite: - Dara.

H1874.full: Of uncertain derivation; Darkon, one of Solomon's servants: - Darkon.

H1875.firstSense: ask, X at all, care for, X diligently, inquire, make inquisition, [necro-] mancer, ques…
H1875.full: A primitive root; properly to tread or frequent; usually to follow (for pursuit or search); by implication to seek or ask; specifically to worship: - ask, X at all, care for, X diligently, inquire, make inquisition, [necro-] mancer, question, require, search, seek [for, out], X surely.

H1876.full: A primitive root; to sprout: - bring forth, spring.

H1877.full: deh'-sheh From H1876; a sprout; by analogy grass: - (tender) grass, green, (tender) herb.

H1878.firstSense: accept, anoint, take away the (receive) ashes (from), make (wax) fat
H1878.full: A primitive root; to be fat; transitively to fatten (or regard as fat); specifically to anoint; figuratively to satisfy; denominatively (from H1880) to remove (fat) ashes (of sacrifices): - accept, anoint, take away the (receive) ashes (from), make (wax) fat.

H1879.full: From H1878; fat; figuratively rich, fertile: - fat.

H1880.full: From H1878; the fat; abstractly fatness, that is, (figuratively) abundance; specifically the (fatty) ashes of sacrifices: - ashes, fatness.

H1881.full: dâth dawth Of uncertain (perhaps foreign) derivation; a royal edict or statute: - commandment, commission, decree, law, manner.

H1882.full: dâth dawth (Chaldee); corresponding to H1881; decree, law.

H1883.full: deh'-thay (Chaldee); corresponding to H1877: - tender grass.

H1884.full: (Chaldee); of Persian origin,; meaning one skilled in law; a judge: - counsellor.

H1885.full: Of uncertain derivation; Dathan, an Israelite: - Dathan.

H1886.full: Of uncertain derivation; Dothan, a place in Palestine: - Dothan.

H1887.full: A primitive particle; lo!: - behold, lo.

H1889.full: heh-awkh' From H1887 and H253; aha!: - ah, aha, ha.

H1890.full: By reduplication from H3051; gift (in sacrifice), that is, holocaust: - offering.

H1891.full: A primitive root; to be vain in act, word, or expectation; specifically to lead astray: - be (become, make) vain.

H1892.full: From H1891; emptiness or vanity; figuratively something transitory and unsatisfactory; often used as an adverb: - X altogether, vain, vanity.

H1893.full: The same as H1892; Hebel, the son of Adam: - Abel.

H1894.full: Only in plural, from an unused root meaning to be hard; ebony: - ebony.

H1895.full: A primitive root of uncertain (perhaps foreign) derivation; to be a horoscopist: - + (astro-) loger.

H1896.full: hay-gay', hay-gah'ee Probably of Persian origin; Hege or Hegai, a eunuch of Xerxes: - Hegai, Hege.

H1897.firstSense: imagine, meditate, mourn, mutter, roar, X sore, speak, study, talk, utter
H1897.full: A primitive root (compare H1901); to murmur (in pleasure or anger); by implication to ponder: - imagine, meditate, mourn, mutter, roar, X sore, speak, study, talk, utter.

H1898.full: A primitive root; to remove: - stay, take away.

H1899.full: From H1897; a muttering (in sighing, thought, or as thunder): - mourning, sound, tale.

H1901.full: From an unused root akin to H1897; properly a murmur, that is, complaint: - meditation, musing.

H1902.full: Intensive from H1897; a murmuring sound, that is, a musical notation (probably similar to the moder affettuoso to indicate solemnity of movement); by implication a machination: - device, Higgaion, meditation, solemn sound.

H1903.full: Of uncertain derivation; perhaps suitable or turning: - directly.

H1904.full: Of uncertain (perhaps foreign) derivation; Hagar, the mother of Ishmael: - Hagar.

H1905.full: hag-ree', hag-ree' Perhaps patronymic from H1904; a Hagrite or member of a certain Arabian clan: - Hagarene, Hagarite, Haggeri.

H1906.full: For H1959; a shout: - sounding again.

H1907.full: (Chaldee); probably of foreign origin; a vizier: - counsellor.

H1908.full: Probably of foreign origin (compare H111); Hadad, the name of an idol, and of several kings of Edom: - Hadad.

H1909.full: From H1908 and H5828; Hadad (is his) help; Hadadezer, a Syrian king: - Hadadezer. Compare H1928.

H1910.full: From H1908 and H7417; Hadad Rimmon, a place in Palestine: - Hadad-rimmon.

H1911.full: A primitive root (compare H3034); to stretch forth the hand: - put.

H1912.full: Of foreign origin; Hodu (that is, Hindustan): - India.

H1913.full: Probably of foreign derivation; Hadoram, a son of Joktan, and the tribe descended from him: - Hadoram.

H1914.full: Of uncertain derivation; Hiddai, an Israelite: - Hiddai.

H1915.full: A primitive root (compare H1854); to crush with the foot: - tread down.

H1916.full: From an unused root meaning to stamp upon; a foot stool: - [foot-] stool.

H1917.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to that of H1916; something stamped to pieces, that is, a bit: - piece.

H1918.full: Of uncertain derivation; the myrtle: - myrtle (tree).

H1919.full: Feminine of H1918; Hadassah (or Esther): - Hadassah.

H1920.full: A primitive root; to push away or down: - cast away (out), drive, expel, thrust (away).

H1921.firstSense: countenance, crooked place, glorious, honour, put forth
H1921.full: A primitive root; to swell up (literally or figuratively, actively or passively); by implication to favor or honour, be high or proud: - countenance, crooked place, glorious, honour, put forth.

H1922.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H1921; to magnify (figuratively): - glorify, honour.

H1924.full: The same as H1926; Hadar, an Edomite: - Hadar.

H1925.full: From H1921; honour; used (figuratively) for the capital city (Jerusalem): - glory.

H1926.firstSense: beauty, comeliness, excellency, glorious, glory, goodly, honour, majesty
H1926.full: From H1921; magnificence, that is, ornament or splendor: - beauty, comeliness, excellency, glorious, glory, goodly, honour, majesty.

H1927.full: Feminine of H1926; decoration: - beauty, honour.

H1928.full: From H1924 and H5828; Hadar (that is, Hadad, H1908) is his help; Hadarezer (that is, Hadadezer, H1909), a Syrian king: - Hadarezer.

H1929.full: hâhh haw A shortened form of H162; ah! expressing grief: - woe worth.

H1930.full: By permutation from H1929; oh!: - alas.

H1931.firstSense: he, as for her, him (-self), it, the same, she (herself), such, that (
H1931.full: The second form is the feminine beyond the Pentateuch; a primitive word, the third person pronoun singular, he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are: - he, as for her, him (-self), it, the same, she (herself), such, that (. . . it), these, they, this, those, which (is), who.

H1932.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H1931: - X are, it, this.

H1933.full: A primitive root (compare H183, H1961) supposed to mean properly to breathe; to be (in the sense of existence): - be, X have.

H1934.firstSense: be, become, + behold, + came (to pass), + cease, + cleave, + consider, + do, + give, +…
H1934.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H1933; to exist; used in a great variety of applications (especially in connection with other words): - be, become, + behold, + came (to pass), + cease, + cleave, + consider, + do, + give, + have + judge, + keep, + labour, + mingle (self), + put, + see, + seek, + set, + slay, + take heed, tremble, + walk, + would.

H1935.firstSense: beauty, comeliness, excellency, glorious, glory, goodly, honour, majesty
H1935.full: hôd hode From an unused root; grandeur (that is, an imposing form and appearance): - beauty, comeliness, excellency, glorious, glory, goodly, honour, majesty.

H1936.full: hôd hode The same as H1935; Hod, an Israelite: - Hod.

H1937.full: A form of H1938; Hodevah (or Hodevjah), an Israelite: - Hodevah.

H1938.full: From H1935 and H3050; majesty of Jah; Hodavjah, the name of three Israelites: - Hodaviah.

H1939.full: A form of H1938; Hodajvah, an Israelite: - Hodaiah.

H1940.full: A form for the feminine of H3064; a Jewess: - Hodiah.

H1941.full: A form of H1938; Hodijah, the name of three Israelites: - Hodijah.

H1942.firstSense: calamity, iniquity, mischief, mischievous (thing), naughtiness, naughty, noisome, perve…
H1942.full: From H1933 (in the sense of eagerly coveting and rushing upon; by implication of falling); desire; also ruin: - calamity, iniquity, mischief, mischievous (thing), naughtiness, naughty, noisome, perverse thing, substance, very wickedness.

H1943.full: Another form for H1942; ruin: - mischief.

H1944.full: Of uncertain derivation; Hoham, a Canaanitish king: - Hoham.

H1945.full: A prolonged form of H1930 (akin to H188); oh!: - ah, alas, ho, O, woe.

H1946.full: hûk hook (Chaldee); corresponding to H1981; to go; causatively to bring: - bring again, come, go (up).

H1947.full: Feminine active participle of H1984; folly: - madness.

H1948.full: From active participle of H1984; folly: - madness.

H1949.firstSense: destroy, move, make a noise, put, ring again
H1949.full: hûm hoom A primitive root (compare H2000); to make an uproar, or agitate greatly: - destroy, move, make a noise, put, ring again.

H1950.full: From H2000; raging; Homam, an Edomitish chieftain: - Homam. Compare H1967.

H1951.full: hûn hoon A primitive root; properly to be naught, that is, (figuratively) to be (causatively act) light: - be ready.

H1952.firstSense: enough, + for nought, riches, substance, wealth
H1952.full: hôn hone From the same as H1951 in the sense of H202; wealth; by implication enough: - enough, + for nought, riches, substance, wealth.

H1953.full: From H3068 and H8085; Jehovah has heard; Hoshama, an Israelite: - Hoshama.

H1954.full: From H3467; deliverer; Hoshea, the name of five Israelites: - Hosea, Hoshea, Oshea.

H1955.full: From H3467 and H3050; Jah has saved; Hoshajah, the name of two Israelites: - Hoshaiah.

H1956.full: From H3498; he has caused to remain; Hothir, an Israelite: - Hothir.

H1957.full: A primitive root (compare H2372); to dream: - sleep.

H1958.full: hı̂y he For H5092; lamentation: - woe.

H1959.full: From an unused root (meaning to shout); acclamation: - shout (-ing).

H1960.full: From the same as H1959; properly an acclaim, that is, a choir of singers: - thanksgiving.

H1961.firstSense: beacon, X altogether, be (-come, accomplished, committed, like), break, cause, come (to…
H1961.full: A primitive root (compare H1933); to exist, that is, be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary): - beacon, X altogether, be (-come, accomplished, committed, like), break, cause, come (to pass), continue, do, faint, fall, + follow, happen, X have, last, pertain, quit (one-) self, require, X use.

H1962.full: Another form for H1943; ruin: - calamity.

H1963.full: hêyk hake Another form for H349; how?: - how.

H1964.full: Probably from H3201 (in the sense of capacity); a large public building, such as a palace or temple: - palace, temple.

H1966.full: From H1984 (in the sense of brightness); the morning star: - lucifer.

H1967.full: Another form for H1950; Hemam, an Idumaean: - Hemam.

H1968.full: Probably from H530; faithful; Heman, the name of at least two Israelites: - Heman.

H1969.full: hı̂yn heen Probably of Egyptian, origin; a hin or liquid measure: - hin.

H1970.full: A primitive root; apparently to injure: - make self strange.

H1971.full: From H5234; respect, that is, partiality: - shew.

H1972.full: Probably denominative from H1973; to remove or be remote: - cast far off.

H1973.firstSense: back, beyond, (hence-) forward, hitherto, thenceforth, yonder
H1973.full: haw-leh-aw' From the primitive form of the article; to the distance, that is, far away; also (of time) thus far: - back, beyond, (hence-) forward, hitherto, thenceforth, yonder.

H1974.full: From H1984 (in the sense of rejoicing); a celebration of thanksgiving for harvest: - merry, praise.

H1975.full: From H1976; this or that: - side, that, this.

H1976.full: From the article (see H1973) and H2088; this very: - this.

H1977.full: Another form of H1976; that: - this.

H1978.full: From H1980; a walk, that is, (by implication) a step: - step.

H1979.full: Feminine of H1978; a walking; by implication a procession or march, a caravan: - company, going, walk, way.

H1980.firstSense: (all) along, apace, behave (self), come, (on) continually, be conversant, depart, + be…
H1980.full: Akin to H3212; a primitive root; to walk (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively): - (all) along, apace, behave (self), come, (on) continually, be conversant, depart, + be eased, enter, exercise (self), + follow, forth, forward, get, go (about, abroad, along, away, forward, on, out, up and down), + greater, grow, be wont to haunt, lead, march, X more and more, move (self), needs, on, pass (away), be at the point, quite, run (along), + send, speedily, spread, still, surely, + tale-bearer, + travel (-ler), walk (abroad, on, to and fro, up and down, to places), wander, wax, [way-] faring man, X be weak, whirl.

H1981.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H1980 (compare H1946); to walk: - walk.

H1982.full: From H1980; properly a journey, that is, (by implication) a wayfarer; also a flowing: - X dropped, traveller.

H1983.full: (Chaldee); from H1981; properly a journey, that is, (by implication) toll on goods at a road: - custom.

H1984.firstSense: (make) boast (self), celebrate, commend, (deal, make), fool (-ish, -ly), glory, give [l…
H1984.full: A primitive root; to be clear (originally of sound, but usually of color); to shine; hence to make a show; to boast; and thus to be (clamorously) foolish; to rave; causatively to celebrate; also to stultify: - (make) boast (self), celebrate, commend, (deal, make), fool (-ish, -ly), glory, give [light], be (make, feign self) mad (against), give in marriage, [sing, be worthy of] praise, rage, renowned, shine.

H1985.full: From H1984; praising (namely God); Hillel, an Israelite: - Hillel.

H1986.firstSense: beat (down), break (down), overcome, smite (with the hammer)
H1986.full: A primitive root; to strike down; by implication to hammer, stamp, conquer, disband: - beat (down), break (down), overcome, smite (with the hammer).

H1987.full: From H1986; smiter; Helem, the name of two Israelites: - Helem.

H1988.full: From the article (see H1973); hither: - here, hither (-[to]), thither.

H1989.full: From H1986; a hammer (or mallet): - hammer.

H1990.full: hâm hawm Of uncertainly derivation; Ham, a region of Palestine: - Ham.

H1991.full: hêm haym From H1993; abundance, that is, wealth: - any of theirs.

H1992.firstSense: it, like, X (how, so) many (soever, more as) they (be), (the) same, X so, X such, their…
H1992.full: Masculine plural from H1931; they (only used when emphatic): - it, like, X (how, so) many (soever, more as) they (be), (the) same, X so, X such, their, them, these, they, those, which, who, whom, withal, ye.

H1993.firstSense: clamorous, concourse, cry aloud, be disquieted, loud, mourn, be moved, make a noise, ra…
H1993.full: A primitive root (compare H1949); to make a loud sound (like English "hum"); by implication to be in great commotion or tumult, to rage, war, moan, clamor: - clamorous, concourse, cry aloud, be disquieted, loud, mourn, be moved, make a noise, rage, roar, sound, be troubled, make in tumult, tumultuous, be in an uproar.

H1994.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H1992; they: - X are, them, those.

H1995.firstSense: abundance, company, many, multitude, multiply, noise, riches, rumbling, sounding, store…
H1995.full: From H1993; a noise, tumult, crowd; also disquietude, wealth: - abundance, company, many, multitude, multiply, noise, riches, rumbling, sounding, store, tumult.

H1996.full: From H1995 and H1463; the multitude of Gog; the fanciful name of an emblematic place in Palestine: - Hamon-gog.

H1997.full: Feminine of H1995; multitude; Hamonah, the same as H1996: - Hamonah.

H1999.full: Feminine passive participle of an unused root meaning to rush (as rain with a windy roar); a sound: - speech, tumult.

H2000.firstSense: break, consume, crush, destroy, discomfit, trouble, vex
H2000.full: A primitive root (compare H1949, H1993); properly to put in commotion; by implication to disturb, drive, destroy: - break, consume, crush, destroy, discomfit, trouble, vex.

H2001.full: Of foreign derivation; Haman, a Persian vizier: - Haman.

H2002.full: (Chaldee); but the text is; of foreign origin; a necklace: - chain.

H2003.full: From an unused root apparently meaning to crackle; a dry twig or brushwood: - melting.

H2004.firstSense: X in, such like, (with) them, thereby, therein, (more than) they, wherein, in which, wh…
H2004.full: hên hane Feminine plural from H1931; they (only used when emphatic): - X in, such like, (with) them, thereby, therein, (more than) they, wherein, in which, whom, withal.

H2005.full: hên hane A primitive particle; lo! also (as expressing surprise) if: - behold, if, lo, though.

H2006.full: hên hane (Chaldee); corresponding to H2005; lo! also there, therefore, unless, less, whether, but, if: - (that) if, or, whether.

H2007.firstSense: X in, X such (and such things), their, (into) them, thence, therein, these, they (had),…
H2007.full: Prolonged for H2004; themselves (often used emphatically for the copula, also in indirect relation): - X in, X such (and such things), their, (into) them, thence, therein, these, they (had), on this side, those, wherein.

H2008.firstSense: here, hither [-to], now, on this (that) side, + since, this (that) way, thitherward, +…
H2008.full: From H2004; hither or thither (but used both of place and time): - here, hither [-to], now, on this (that) side, + since, this (that) way, thitherward, + thus far, to . . . fro, + yet.

H2009.full: Prolonged for H2005; lo!: - behold, lo, see.

H2010.full: From H5117; permission of rest, that is, quiet: - release.

H2011.full: Probably of foreign origin; Hinnom, apparently a Jebusite: - Hinnom.

H2012.full: Probably of foreigner derivation Hena, a place apparently in Mesopotamia: - Hena.

H2013.firstSense: hold peace (tongue), (keep) silence, be silent, still
H2013.full: A primitive root; to hush: - hold peace (tongue), (keep) silence, be silent, still.

H2015.firstSense: X become, change, come, be converted, give, make [a bed], overthrow (-turn), perverse,…
H2015.full: A primitive root; to turn about or over; by implication to change, overturn, return, pervert: - X become, change, come, be converted, give, make [a bed], overthrow (-turn), perverse, retire, tumble, turn (again, aside, back, to the contrary, every way).

H2016.full: From H2015; a turn, that is, the reverse: - contrary.

H2017.full: From H2015; an upset, that is, (abstractly) perversity: - turning of things upside down.

H2019.full: By reduplication from H2015; very perverse: - froward.

H2021.full: From an unused root meaning apparently to be sharp or strong; a weapon of war: - chariot.

H2022.full: har har A shortened form of H2042; a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively): - hill (country), mount (-ain), X promotion.

H2023.full: hôr hore Another form for H2022; mountain; Hor, the name of a peak in Idumaea and of one in Syria: - Hor.

H2024.full: Perhaps from H2022; mountainousness; Hara, a region of Media: - Hara.

H2025.full: har-ale' From H2022 and H410; mount of God; figuratively the altar of burnt offering: - altar. Compare H739.

H2026.firstSense: destroy, out of hand, kill, murder (-er), put to [death], make [slaughter], slay (-er),…
H2026.full: A primitive root; to smite with deadly intent: - destroy, out of hand, kill, murder (-er), put to [death], make [slaughter], slay (-er), X surely.

H2027.full: From H2026; slaughter: - be slain, slaughter.

H2029.firstSense: been, be with child, conceive, progenitor
H2029.full: A primitive root; to be (or become) pregnant, conceive (literally of figuratively): - been, be with child, conceive, progenitor.

H2030.firstSense: (be, woman) with child, conceive, X great
H2030.full: From H2029; pregnant: - (be, woman) with child, conceive, X great.

H2031.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H2029; a mental conception: - thought.

H2033.full: Another form for H2043; a Harorite or mountaineer: - Harorite.

H2036.full: From an unused root (meaning to tower up); high; Horam, a Canaanitish king: - Horam.

H2037.full: Passive participle of the same as H2036; high; Harum, an Israelite: - Harum.

H2038.full: From the same as H2036; a castle (from its height): - palace.

H2039.full: Perhaps from H2022; mountaineer; Haran, the name of two men: - Haran.

H2040.firstSense: beat down, break (down, through), destroy, overthrow, pluck down, pull down, ruin, thro…
H2040.full: A primitive root; to pull down or in pieces, break, destroy: - beat down, break (down, through), destroy, overthrow, pluck down, pull down, ruin, throw down, X utterly.

H2042.full: From an unused root meaning to loom up; a mountain: - hill, mount (-ain).

H2043.full: Apparently from H2042; a mountaineer: - Hararite.

H2044.full: Perhaps from the same as H2828; wealthy; Hashem, an Israelite: - Hashem.

H2045.full: From H8085; announcement: - to cause to hear.

H2046.full: From H5413; a melting: - is melted.

H2047.full: Probably of foreign origin; Hathak, a Persian eunuch: - Hatach.

H2048.full: A primitive root; to deride; by implication to cheat: - deal deceitfully, deceive, mock.

H2049.full: From H2048 (only in plural collectively); a derision: - mocker.

H2050.full: A primitive root; properly to break in upon, that is, to assail: - imagine mischief.

H2051.full: Perhaps for H5730; Vedan (or Aden), a place in Arabia: - Dan also.

H2052.full: Of uncertain derivation; Vaheb, a place in Moab: - what he did.

H2053.full: vâv vaw Probably a hook (the name of the sixth Hebrew letter): - hook.

H2054.full: Presumed to be from an unused root meaning to bear guilt; crime: - X strange.

H2055.full: vah-yez-aw'-thaw Of foreign origin; Vajezatha, a son of Haman: - Vajez-atha.

H2057.full: Perhaps for H6043; Vanjah, an Israelite: - Vaniah.

H2058.full: Probably from H3254; additional; Vophsi, an Israelite: - Vophsi.

H2059.full: Probably from H3461; weak; Vashni, an Israelite: - Vashni.

H2060.full: Of Persian origin; Vashti, the queen of Xerxes: - Vashti.

H2061.full: zeh-abe' From an unused root meaning to be yellow; a wolf: - wolf.

H2062.full: zeh-abe' The same as H2061; Zeeb, a Midianitish prince: - Zeeb.

H2063.firstSense: hereby (-in, -with), it, likewise, the one (other, same), she, so (much), such (deed),…
H2063.full: zothe' Irregular feminine of H2089; this (often used adverbially): - hereby (-in, -with), it, likewise, the one (other, same), she, so (much), such (deed), that, therefore, these, this (thing), thus.

H2064.full: A primitive root; to confer: - endure.

H2066.full: From H2064; giver; Zabad, the name of seven Israelites: - Zabad.

H2067.full: From H2065; giving; Zabdi, the name of four Israelites: - Zabdi.

H2068.full: zab-dee-ale' From H2065 and H410; gift of God; Zabdiel, the name of two Israelites: - Zabdiel.

H2069.full: From H2064 and H3050; Jah has given; Zebadjah, the name of nine Israelites: - Zebadiah.

H2070.full: From an unused root (meaning to flit); a fly (especially one of a stinging nature): - fly.

H2071.full: From H2054; given; Zabud, an Israelite: - Zabud.

H2072.full: A form of H2071; given; Zabbud, an Israelites: - Zabbud.

H2073.full: From H2082; a residence: - dwell in, dwelling, habitation.

H2074.full: From H2082; habitation; Zebulon, a son of Jacob; also his territory and tribe: - Zebulun.

H2075.full: Patronymic from H2074; a Zebulonite or descendant of Zebulun: - Zebulonite.

H2076.full: A primitive root; to slaughter an animal (usually in sacrifice): - kill, offer, (do) sacrifice, slay.

H2077.full: From H2076; properly a slaughter, that is, the flesh of an animal; by implication a sacrifice (the victim or the act): - offer (-ing), sacrifice.

H2078.full: The same as H2077; sacrifice; Zebach, a Midianitish prince: - Zebah.

H2079.full: Probably by orthography error for H2140; Zabbai (or Zaccai), an Israelite: - Zabbai.

H2080.full: Feminine from H2064; giving; Zebidah, an Israelitess: - Zebudah.

H2081.full: zeb-ee-naw' From an unused root (meaning to purchase); gainfulness; Zebina, an Israelite: - Zebina.

H2082.full: A primitive root; apparently properly to inclose, that is, to reside: - dwell with.

H2083.full: The same as H2074; dwelling; Zebul, an Israelite: - Zebul. Compare H2073.

H2084.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to the root of H2081; to acquire by purchase: - gain.

H2085.full: zâg zawg From an unused root probably meaning to inclose; the skin of a grape: - husk.

H2087.full: From H2102; arrogance: - presumptuously, pride, proud (man).

H2088.firstSense: he, X hence, X here, it (-self), X now, X of him, the one
H2088.full: zeh zeh A primitive word; the masculine demonstrative pronoun, this or that: - he, X hence, X here, it (-self), X now, X of him, the one . . . the other, X than the other, (X out of) the (self) same, such (an one) that, these, this (hath, man), on this side . . . on that side, X thus, very, which. Compare H2063, H2090, H2097, H2098.

H2089.full: zeh zeh By permutation for H7716; a sheep: - lamb.

H2090.firstSense: as well as another, it, this, that, thus and thus
H2090.full: zôh zo For H2088; this or that: - as well as another, it, this, that, thus and thus.

H2091.full: From an unused root meaning to shimmer; gold; figuratively something gold colored (that is, yellow), as oil, a clear sky: - gold (-en), fair weather.

H2092.full: A primitive root; to be rancid, that is, (transitively) to loathe: - abhor.

H2093.full: From H2092; loathing; Zaham, an Israelite: - Zaham.

H2094.full: A primitive root; to gleam; figuratively to enlighten (by caution): - admonish, shine, teach, (give) warn (-ing).

H2095.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H2094; (passively) be admonished: - take heed.

H2097.full: For H2088; this or that: - that, this.

H2098.firstSense: that this, X wherein, which, whom
H2098.full: For H2088; this or that: - that this, X wherein, which, whom.

H2099.full: Probably from an unused root meaning to be prominent; properly brightness (compare H2111), that is, (figuratively) the month of flowers; Ziv (corresponding to Ijar or May): - Zif.

H2100.firstSense: flow, gush out, have a (running) issue, pine away, run
H2100.full: zûb zoob A primitive root; to flow freely (as water), that is, (specifically) to have a (sexual) flux; figuratively to waste away; also to overflow: - flow, gush out, have a (running) issue, pine away, run.

H2101.full: zôb zobe From H2100; a seminal or menstrual flux: - issue.

H2102.firstSense: be proud, deal proudly, presume, (come) presumptuously, sod
H2102.full: zûd zı̂yd zood, zeed A primitive root; to seethe; figuratively to be insolent: - be proud, deal proudly, presume, (come) presumptuously, sod.

H2103.full: zûd zood (Chaldee); corresponding to H2102; to be proud: - in pride.

H2104.full: Plural probably from the same as H2123; prominent; Zuzites, an aboriginal tribe of Palestine: - Zuzims.

H2105.full: Of uncertain origin; Zocheth, an Israelite: - Zoheth.

H2106.full: Apparently from the same root as H2099 (in the sense of prominence); an angle (as projecting), that is, (by implication) a corner column (or anta): - corner (stone).

H2107.full: zûl zool A primitive root (compare H2151); probably to shake out, that is, (by implication) to scatter profusely; figuratively to treat lightly: - lavish, despise.

H2108.full: From H2107; properly scattering, that is, removal; used adverbially except: - beside, but, only, save.

H2109.full: zûn zoon A primitive root; perhaps properly to be plump, that is, (transitively) to nourish: - feed.

H2110.full: zûn zoon (Chaldee); corresponding to H2109: - feed.

H2111.full: A primitive root; properly to shake off, that is, (figuratively) to agitate (as with fear): - move, tremble, vex.

H2112.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H2111; to shake (with fear): - tremble.

H2113.full: From H2111; agitation, fear: - be removed, trouble, vexation. Compare H2189.

H2114.firstSense: (come from) another (man, place), fanner, go away, (e-) strange (-r, thing, woman)
H2114.full: zûr zoor A primitive root; to turn aside (especially for lodging); hence to be a foreigner, strange, profane; specifically (active participle) to commit adultery: - (come from) another (man, place), fanner, go away, (e-) strange (-r, thing, woman).

H2115.full: zûr zoor A primitive root (compare H6695); to press together, tighten: - close, crush, thrust together.

H2116.full: From H2115; trodden on: - that which is crushed.

H2117.full: Probably from the root of H2123; prominent; Zaza, an Israelite: - Zaza.

H2118.full: A primitive root; to shove or displace: - loose.

H2119.full: A primitive root; to crawl; by implication to fear: - be afraid, serpent, worm.

H2120.full: Feminine active participle of H2119; crawling (that is, serpent); Zocheleth, a boundary stone in Palestine: - Zoheleth.

H2121.full: From H2102; boiling of water, that is, wave: - proud.

H2122.full: zı̂yv zeev (Chaldee); corresponding to H2099; (figuratively) cheerfulness: - brightness, countenance.

H2123.full: zı̂yz zeez From an unused root apparently meaning to be conspicuous; fulness of the breast; also a moving creature: - abundance, wild beast.

H2124.full: Apparently from the same as H2123; prominence; Ziza, the name of two Israelites: - Ziza.

H2125.full: Another form for H2124; Zizah, an Israelite: - Zizah.

H2126.full: From H2109; well fed; or perhaps an orthographical error for H2124; Zina, an Israelite: - Zina.

H2127.full: From H2111; agitation; Zia, an Israelite: - Zia.

H2128.full: zı̂yph zeef From the same as H2203; flowing; Ziph, the name of a place in Palestine; also of an Israelite: - Ziph.

H2129.full: Feminine of H2128; a flowing; Ziphah, an Israelite: - Ziphah.

H2130.full: Patrial from H2128; a Ziphite or inhabitant of Ziph: - Ziphim, Ziphite.

H2131.full: From H2187; properly what leaps forth, that is, flash of fire, or a burning arrow; also (from the original sense of the root) a bond: - chain, fetter, firebrand, spark.

H2132.full: Probably from an unused root (akin to H2099); an olive (as yielding illuminating oil), the tree, the branch or the berry: - olive (tree, -yard), Olivet.

H2133.full: From H2132; olive grove; Zethan, an Israelite: - Zethan.

H2134.full: zak zak From H2141; clear: - clean, pure.

H2135.firstSense: be (make) clean, cleanse, be clear, count pure
H2135.full: A primitive root (compare H2141); to be translucent; figuratively to be innocent: - be (make) clean, cleanse, be clear, count pure.

H2136.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H2135; purity: - innocency.

H2137.full: From H2135; properly transparency, that is, glass: - crystal.

H2138.full: Properly passive participle of H2142; but used for H2145; a male (of man or animals): - males, men-children.

H2139.full: From H2142; mindful; Zakkur, the name of seven Israelites: - Zaccur, Zacchur.

H2140.full: From H2141; pure; Zakkai, an Israelite: - Zaccai.

H2141.full: A primitive root (compare H2135); to be transparent or clean (physically or morally): - be (make) clean, be pure (-r).

H2142.firstSense: X burn [incense], X earnestly, be male, (make) mention (of), be mindful, recount, recor…
H2142.full: A primitive root; properly to mark (so as to be recognized), that is, to remember; by implication to mention; also (as denominative from H2145) to be male: - X burn [incense], X earnestly, be male, (make) mention (of), be mindful, recount, record (-er), remember, make to be remembered, bring (call, come, keep, put) to (in) remembrance, X still, think on, X well.

H2143.full: From H2142; a memento, abstractly recollection (rarely if ever); by implication commemoration: - memorial, memory, remembrance, scent.

H2144.full: The same as H2143; Zeker, an Israelite: - Zeker.

H2145.full: From H2142; properly remembered, that is, a male (of man or animals, as being the most noteworthy sex): - X him, male, man (child, -kind).

H2146.full: From H2142; a memento (or memorable thing, day or writing): - memorial, record.

H2147.full: From H2142; memorable; Zicri, the name of twelve Israelites: - Zichri.

H2148.full: From H2142 and H3050; Jah has remembered; Zecarjah, the name of twenty nine Israelites: - Zachariah, Zechariah.

H2149.full: From H2151; properly a shaking, that is, perhaps a tempest: - vilest.

H2150.full: By reduplication from H2151; tremulous, that is, a twig: - sprig.

H2151.full: A primitive root (compare H2107); to shake (as in the wind), that is, to quake; figuratively to be loose morally, worthless or prodigal: - blow down, glutton, riotous (eater), vile.

H2152.full: From H2196; a glow (of wind or anger); also a famine (as consuming): - horrible, horror, terrible.

H2153.full: zilpâh zil-paw From an unused root apparently meaning to trickle, as myrrh; fragrant dropping; Zilpah, Leah's maid: - Zilpah.

H2154.firstSense: heinous crime, lewd (-ly, -ness), mischief, purpose, thought, wicked (device, mind, -ness)
H2154.full: From H2161; a plan, especially a bad one: - heinous crime, lewd (-ly, -ness), mischief, purpose, thought, wicked (device, mind, -ness).

H2155.full: The same as H2154; Zimmah, the name of two Israelites: - Zimmah.

H2156.full: (Feminine) and (masculine): from H2168; a twig (as pruned): - vine, branch, slip.

H2157.full: From H2161; intriguing; a Zamzumite, or native tribe of Palestine: - Zamzummim.

H2158.full: (Feminine): from H2167; a song to be accompanied with instrumental music: - psalm (-ist), singing, song.

H2159.full: From H2168; a twig (as pruned): - branch.

H2160.full: Feminine of H2158; song; Zemirah, an Israelite: - Zemira.

H2161.firstSense: consider, devise, imagine, plot, purpose, think (evil)
H2161.full: A primitive root; to plan, usually in a bad sense: - consider, devise, imagine, plot, purpose, think (evil).

H2162.full: From H2161; a plot: - wicked device.

H2163.full: A primitive root; to fix (a time): - appoint.

H2164.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H2163; to agree (on a time and place): - prepare.

H2165.full: From H2163; an appointed occasion: - season, time.

H2166.full: (Chaldee); from H2165; the same as H2165: - season, time.

H2167.firstSense: give praise, sing forth praises, psalms
H2167.full: A primitive root (perhaps identical with H2168 through the idea of striking with the fingers); properly to touch the strings or parts of a musical instrument, that is, play upon it; to make music, accompanied by the voice; hence to celebrate in song and music: - give praise, sing forth praises, psalms.

H2168.full: A primitive root (compare H2167, H5568, H6785); to trim (a vine): - prune.

H2169.full: Apparently from H2167 or H2168; a gazelle (from its lightly touching the ground): - chamois.

H2170.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H2167; instrumental music: - musick.

H2171.full: (Chaldee); from the same as H2170; an instrumental musician: - singer.

H2172.full: From H2167; a musical piece or song to be accompanied by an instrument: - melody, psalm.

H2173.full: From H2168; pruned (that is, choice) fruit: - best fruit.

H2174.full: From H2167; musical; Zimri, the name of five Israelites, and of an Arabian tribe: - Zimri.

H2175.full: From H2167; musical; Zimran, a son of Abraham by Keturah: - Zimran.

H2176.full: From H2167; instrumental music; by implication praise: - song.

H2177.firstSense: divers kinds, X all manner of store
H2177.full: zan zan From H2109; properly nourished (or fully developed), that is, a form or sort: - divers kinds, X all manner of store.

H2178.full: zan zan (Chaldee); corresponding to H2177; sort: - kind.

H2179.full: A primitive root meaning to wag; used only as a denominative from H2180; to curtail, that is, cut off the rear: - smite the hindmost.

H2180.full: From H2179 (in the original sense of flapping); the tail (literally or figuratively): - tail.

H2181.firstSense: (cause to) commit fornication, X continually, X great, (be an, play the) harlot, (cause…
H2181.full: A primitive root (highly fed and therefore wanton); to commit adultery (usually of the female, and less often of simple forniciation, rarely of involuntary ravishment); figuratively to commit idolatry (the Jewish people being regarded as the spouse of Jehovah): - (cause to) commit fornication, X continually, X great, (be an, play the) harlot, (cause to be, play the) whore, (commit, fall to) whoredom, (cause to) go a-whoring, whorish.

H2182.full: From H2186; rejected; Zanoach, the name of two places in Palestine: - Zanoah.

H2183.full: From H2181; adultery; figuratively idolatry: - whoredom.

H2184.full: From H2181; adultery, that is, (figuratively) infidelity, idolatry: - whoredom.

H2185.full: Regarded by some as if from H2109 or an unused root, and applied to military equipments; but evidently the feminine plural active participle of H2181; harlots: - armour.

H2186.full: A primitive root meaning to push aside, that is, reject, forsake, fail: - cast away (off), remove far away (off).

H2187.full: A primitive root; properly to draw together the feet (as an animal about to dart upon its prey), that is, to spring forward: - leap.

H2188.full: From H2111 (in the sense of H3154); perspiration: - sweat.

H2189.full: By transposition for H2113; agitation, maltreatment: - X removed, trouble.

H2190.full: From H2111; disquiet; Zaavan, an Idumaean: - Zaavan.

H2191.full: From an unused root (akin (by permutation) to H6819), meaning to dwindle; small: - little.

H2193.full: A primitive root; to extinguish: - be extinct.

H2194.full: A primitive root; properly to foam at the mouth, that is, to be enraged: - abhor, abominable, (be) angry, defy, (have) indignation.

H2195.full: From H2194; strictly froth at the mouth, that is, (figuratively) fury (especially of God's displeasure with sin): - angry, indignation, rage.

H2196.firstSense: fret, sad, worse liking, be wroth
H2196.full: A primitive root; properly to boil up, that is, (figuratively) to be peevish or angry: - fret, sad, worse liking, be wroth.

H2197.full: From H2196; anger: - indignation, rage (-ing), wrath.

H2199.firstSense: assemble, call (together), (make a) cry (out), come with such a company, gather (togeth…
H2199.full: A primitive root; to shriek (from anguish or danger); by analogy (as a herald) to announce or convene publicly: - assemble, call (together), (make a) cry (out), come with such a company, gather (together), cause to be proclaimed.

H2200.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H2199; to make an outcry: - cry.

H2201.full: (Feminine): from H2199; a shriek or outcry: - cry (-ing).

H2202.full: From an unused root (meaning to be fragrant); Ziphron, a place in Palestine: - Ziphron.

H2203.full: From an unused root (meaning to liquify); asphalt (from its tendency to soften in the sun): - pitch.

H2204.full: A primitive root; to be old: - aged man, be (wax) old (man).

H2205.firstSense: aged, ancient (man), elder (-est), old (man, men and
H2205.full: From H2204; old: - aged, ancient (man), elder (-est), old (man, men and . . . women), senator.

H2206.full: From H2204; the beard (as indicating age): - beard.

H2208.full: Properly passive participle of H2204 (used only in the plural as a noun); old age: - old age.

H2209.full: Feminine of H2205; old age: - old (age).

H2210.full: A primitive root; to lift, that is, (figuratively) comfort: - raise (up).

H2211.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H2210; to hang, that is, impale: - set up.

H2212.firstSense: fine, pour down, purge, purify, refine
H2212.full: A primitive root; to strain, (figuratively) extract, clarify: - fine, pour down, purge, purify, refine.

H2213.full: zêr zare From H2237 (in the sense of scattering); a chaplet (as spread around the top), that is, (specifically) a border moulding: - crown.

H2214.full: From H2114 (in the sense of estrangement) (compare H2219); disgust: - loathsome.

H2215.full: A primitive root; to flow away: - wax warm.

H2216.full: From H2215 and H894; descended of (that is, from) Babylon, that is, born there; Zerubbabel, an Israelite: - Zerubbabel.

H2218.full: From an unused root meaning to be exuberant in growth; lined with shrubbery; Zered, a brook East of the Dead Sea: - Zared, Zered.

H2219.firstSense: cast away, compass, disperse, fan, scatter (away), spread, strew, winnow
H2219.full: A primitive root (compare H2114); to toss about; by implication to diffuse, winnow: - cast away, compass, disperse, fan, scatter (away), spread, strew, winnow.

H2220.firstSense: arm, + help, mighty, power, shoulder, strength
H2220.full: From H2232; the arm (as stretched out), or (of animals) the foreleg; figuratively force: - arm, + help, mighty, power, shoulder, strength.

H2221.full: From H2232; something sown, that is, a plant: - sowing, thing that is sown.

H2222.full: By reduplication from an unused root meaning to flow; a pouring rain: - water.

H2223.full: By reduplication from H2115; properly tightly girt, that is, probably a racer, or some fleet animal (as being slender in the waist): - + greyhound.

H2224.firstSense: arise, rise (up), as soon as it is up
H2224.full: A primitive root; properly to irradiate (or shoot forth beams), that is, to rise (as the sun); specifically to appear (as a symptom of leprosy): - arise, rise (up), as soon as it is up.

H2225.full: From H2224; a rising of light: - rising.

H2226.full: The same as H2225; Zerach, the name of three Israelites, also of an Idumaean and an Ethiopian prince: - Zarah, Zerah.

H2227.full: Patronymic from H2226; a Zarchite or descendant of Zerach: - Zarchite.

H2228.full: From H2225 and H3050; Jah has risen; Zerachjah, the name of two Israelites: - Zerahiah.

H2229.firstSense: carry away as with a flood, pour out
H2229.full: A primitive root; to gush (as water): - carry away as with a flood, pour out.

H2230.full: From H2229; a gush of water: - flood, overflowing, shower, storm, tempest.

H2231.full: Feminine of H2230; a gushing of fluid (semen): - issue.

H2232.firstSense: bear, conceive seed, set with, sow (-er), yield
H2232.full: A primitive root; to sow; figuratively to disseminate, plant, fructify: - bear, conceive seed, set with, sow (-er), yield.

H2233.firstSense: X carnally, child, fruitful, seed (-time), sowing-time
H2233.full: From H2232; seed; figuratively fruit, plant, sowing time, posterity: - X carnally, child, fruitful, seed (-time), sowing-time.

H2235.full: From H2232; something sown (only in the plural), that is, a vegetable (as food): - pulse.

H2236.firstSense: be here and there, scatter, sprinkle, strew
H2236.full: A primitive root; to sprinkle (fluid or solid particles): - be here and there, scatter, sprinkle, strew.

H2237.full: A primitive root (compare H2114); perhaps to diffuse, that is, (specifically) to sneeze: - sneeze.

H2238.full: Of Persian origin; Zeresh, Haman's wife: - Zeresh.

H2239.full: From H2219; the spread of the fingers, that is, a span: - span.

H2240.full: zat-too' Of uncertain derivation; Zattu, an Israelite: - Zattu.

H2241.full: Apparently a variation for H2133; Zetham, an Israelite: - Zetham.

H2242.full: Of Persian origin; Zethar, a eunuch of Xerxes: - Zethar.

H2243.full: chôb khobe By contraction from H2245; properly a cherisher, that is, the bosom: - bosom.

H2244.full: A primitive root (compare H2245); to secrete: - X held, hide (self), do secretly.

H2245.full: A primitive root (compare H2244, H2247); properly to hide (as in the bosom), that is, to cherish (with affection): - love.

H2246.full: From H2245; cherished; Chobab, father in law of Moses: - Hobab.

H2247.full: A primitive root (compare H2245); to secrete: - hide (self).

H2248.full: (Chaldee); from H2255; properly overthrown, that is, (morally) crime: - hurt.

H2249.full: From H2266; united; Chabor, a river of Assyria: - Habor.

H2250.full: From H2266; properly bound (with stripes), that is, a weal (or black and blue mark itself): - blueness, bruise, hurt, stripe, wound.

H2251.full: A primitive root; to knock out or off: - beat (off, out), thresh.

H2252.full: From H2247 and H3050; Jah has hidden; Chabajah, an Israelite: - Habaiah.

H2254.firstSense: X at all, band, bring forth, (deal) corrupt (-ly) destroy, offend, lay to (take a) pled…
H2254.full: A primitive root; to wind tightly (as a rope), that is, to bind; specifically by a pledge; figuratively to pervert, destroy; also to writhe in pain (especially of parturition): - X at all, band, bring forth, (deal) corrupt (-ly) destroy, offend, lay to (take a) pledge, spoil, travail, X very, withhold.

H2255.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H2254; to ruin: - destroy, hurt.

H2256.firstSense: band, coast, company, cord, country, destruction, line, lot, pain, pang, portion, regio…
H2256.full: From H2254; a rope (as twisted), especially a measuring line; by implication a district or inheritance (as measured); or a noose (as of cords); figuratively a company (as if tied together); also a throe (especially of parturition); also ruin: - band, coast, company, cord, country, destruction, line, lot, pain, pang, portion, region, rope, snare, sorrow, tackling.

H2257.full: (Chaldee); from H2255; harm (personal or pecuniary): - damage, hurt.

H2258.full: From H2254; a pawn (as security for debt): - pledge.

H2259.full: Active participle from H2254 (in the sense of handling ropes); a sailor: - pilot, shipmaster.

H2260.full: From H2254 (in the sense of furnished with ropes); a mast: - mast.

H2261.full: Of uncertain derivation; probably meadow saffron: - rose.

H2262.full: Of uncertain derivation; Chabatstsanjah, a Rechabite: - Habazaniah.

H2263.full: A primitive root; to clasp (the hands or in embrace): - embrace, fold.

H2264.full: From H2263; a clasping of the hands (in idleness): - fold.

H2265.full: By reduplication from H2263; embrace; Chabakkuk, the prophet: - Habakkuk.

H2266.firstSense: charm (-er), be compact, couple (together), have fellowship with, heap up, join (self,…
H2266.full: A primitive root; to join (literally or figuratively); specifically (by means of spells) to fascinate: - charm (-er), be compact, couple (together), have fellowship with, heap up, join (self, together), league.

H2267.full: From H2266; a society; also a spell: - + charmer (-ing), company, enchantment, X wide.

H2268.full: The same as H2267; community; Cheber, the name of a Kenite and of three Israelites: - Heber.

H2269.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H2266; an associate: - companion, fellow.

H2270.full: From H2266; an associate: - companion, fellow, knit together.

H2272.full: By reduplication from H2266; a streak (like a line), as on the tiger: - spot.

H2273.full: (Chaldee); feminine of H2269; an associate: - other.

H2275.full: From H2267; seat of association; Chebron, a place in Palestine, also the name of two Israelites: - Hebron.

H2276.full: Patronymic from H2275; Chebronite (collectively), an inhabitant of Chebron: - Hebronites.

H2277.full: Patronymic from H2268; a Chebrite (collectively) or descendant of Cheber: - Heberites.

H2278.full: Feminine of H2270; a consort: - companion.

H2279.full: Feminine active participle of H2266; a joint: - which coupleth, coupling.

H2280.firstSense: bind (up), gird about, govern, healer, put, saddle, wrap about
H2280.full: A primitive root; to wrap firmly (especially a turban, compress, or saddle); figuratively to stop, to rule: - bind (up), gird about, govern, healer, put, saddle, wrap about.

H2281.full: From an unused root probably meaning to cook (compare H4227); something fried, probably a griddle cake: - pan.

H2282.full: chag châg khag, khawg A festival, or a victim therefor: - (solemn) feast (day), sacrifice, solemnity.

H2283.full: From an unused root meaning to revolve (compare H2287); properly vertigo, that is, (figuratively) fear: - terror.

H2284.full: Of uncertain derivation; a locust: - locust.

H2285.full: The same as H2284; locust; Chagab, one of the Nethinim: - Hagab.

H2286.full: Feminine of H2285; locust; Chagaba or Chagabah, one of the Nethinim: - Hagaba, Hagabah.

H2287.firstSense: celebrate, dance, (keep, hold) a (solemn) feast (holiday), reel to and fro
H2287.full: A primitive root (compare H2283, H2328); properly to move in a circle, that is, (specifically) to march in a sacred procession, to observe a festival; by implication to be giddy: - celebrate, dance, (keep, hold) a (solemn) feast (holiday), reel to and fro.

H2288.full: From an unused root meaning to take refuge; a rift in rocks: - cleft.

H2290.full: From H2296; a belt (for the waist): - apron, armour, gird (-le).

H2291.full: From H2287; festive; Chaggi, an Israelite; also (patronymically) a Chaggite, or descendant of the same: - Haggi, Haggites.

H2292.full: From H2282; festive; Chaggai, a Hebrew prophet: - Haggai.

H2293.full: From H2282 and H3050; festival of Jah; Chaggijah, an Israelite: - Haggiah.

H2294.full: Feminine of H2291; festive; Chaggith, a wife of David: - Haggith.

H2295.full: Of uncertain derivation; probably a partridge; Choglah, an Israelitess: - Hoglah. See also H1031.

H2296.firstSense: be able to put on, be afraid, appointed, gird, restrain, X on every side
H2296.full: A primitive root; to gird on (as a belt, armor, etc.): - be able to put on, be afraid, appointed, gird, restrain, X on every side.

H2297.full: chad khad Abridged from H259; one: - one.

H2298.full: chad khad (Chaldee); corresponding to H2297; as cardinal one; as article single; as ordinal first; adverbially at once: - a, first, one, together.

H2299.full: chad khad From H2300; sharp: - sharp.

H2300.full: A primitive root; to be (causatively make) sharp or (figuratively) severe: - be fierce, sharpen.

H2301.full: From H2300; fierce; Chadad, an Ishmaelite: - Hadad.

H2302.full: A primitive root; to rejoice: - make glad, be joined, rejoice.

H2306.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H2373; a breast: - breast.

H2307.full: From H2300; a peak; Chadid, a place in Palestine: - Hadid.

H2308.firstSense: cease, end, fail, forbear, forsake, leave (off), let alone, rest, be unoccupied, want
H2308.full: A primitive root; properly to be flabby, that is, (by implication) desist; (figuratively) be lacking or idle: - cease, end, fail, forbear, forsake, leave (off), let alone, rest, be unoccupied, want.

H2309.full: From H2308; rest, that is, the state of the dead: - world.

H2310.full: From H2308; vacant, that is, ceasing or destitute: - he that forbeareth, frail, rejected.

H2311.full: From H2309; idle; Chadlai, an Israelite: - Hadlai.

H2312.full: From an unused root meaning to sting; a prickly plant: - brier, thorn.

H2313.full: Probably of foreign origin; the Chiddekel (or Tigris) river: - Hiddekel.

H2314.full: A primitive root; properly to inclose (as a room), that is, (by analogy) to beset (as in a siege): - enter a privy chamber.

H2315.firstSense: ([bed] inner) chamber, innermost (-ward) part, parlour, + south, X within
H2315.full: From H2314; an apartment (usually literally): - ([bed] inner) chamber, innermost (-ward) part, parlour, + south, X within.

H2316.full: Another form for H2315; chamber; Chadar, an Ishmaelite: - Hadar.

H2317.full: Of uncertain derivation; Chadrak, a Syrian deity: - Hadrach.

H2318.full: A primitive root; to be new; causatively to rebuild: - renew, repair.

H2319.full: From H2318; new: - fresh, new thing.

H2320.full: From H2318; the new moon; by implication a month: - month (-ly), new moon.

H2321.full: The same as H2320; Chodesh, an Israelitess: - Hodesh.

H2322.full: Feminine of H2319; new; Chadashah, a place in Palestine: - Hadashah.

H2324.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H2331; to show: - shew.

H2325.full: A primitive root; properly perhaps to tie, that is, (figuratively and reflexively) to owe, or (by implication) to forfeit: - make endanger.

H2326.full: chôb khobe From H2235; debt: - debtor.

H2327.full: Feminine active participle of H2247; hiding place; Chobah, a place in Syria: - Hobah.

H2328.full: chûg khoog A primitive root (compare H2287); to describe a circle: - compassive

H2329.full: chûg khoog From H2328; a circle: - circle, circuit, compassive

H2330.full: chûd khood A primitive root; properly to tie a knot, that is, (figuratively) to propound a riddle: - put forth.

H2331.full: A primitive root; (compare H2324, H2421); properly to live; by implication (intensively) to declare or show: - show.

H2332.full: Causative from H2331; lifegiver; Chavvah (or Eve), the first woman: - Eve.

H2333.full: Properly the same as H2332 (lifegiving, that is, living place); by implication an encampment or village: - (small) town.

H2334.full: From the plural of H2333 and a modification of H3265; hamlets of Jair, a region of Palestine: - [Bashan-] Havoth-jair.

H2335.full: From H2374; visionary; Chozai, an Israelite: - the seers.

H2336.full: From an unused root apparently meaning to pierce; a thorn; by analogy a ring for the nose: - bramble, thistle, thorn.

H2337.full: Perhaps the same as H2336; a dell or crevice (as if pierced in the earth): - thicket.

H2338.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to the root of H2339, perhaps as a denominative; to string together, that is, (figuratively) to repair: - join.

H2339.full: From an unused root probably meaning to sew; a string; by implication a measuring tape: - cord, fillet, line, thread.

H2340.full: Perhaps from H2333; a villager; a Chivvite, one of the aboriginal tribes of Palestine: - Hivite.

H2341.full: Probably from H2342; circular; Chavilah, the name of two or three eastern regions; also perhaps of two men: - Havilah.

H2342.firstSense: bear, (make to) bring forth, (make to) calve, dance, drive away, fall grievously (with…
H2342.full: chûl chı̂yl khool, kheel A primitive root; properly to twist or whirl (in a circular or spiral manner), that is, (specifically) to dance, to writhe in pain (especially of parturition) or fear; figuratively to wait, to pervert: - bear, (make to) bring forth, (make to) calve, dance, drive away, fall grievously (with pain), fear, form, great, grieve, (be) grievous, hope, look, make, be in pain, be much (sore) pained, rest, shake, shapen, (be) sorrow (-ful), stay, tarry, travail (with pain), tremble, trust, wait carefully (patiently), be wounded.

H2343.full: chûl khool From H2342; a circle; Chul, a son of Aram; also the region settled by him: - Hul.

H2344.full: chôl khole From H2342; sand (as round or whirling particles): - sand.

H2345.full: chûm khoom From an unused root meaning to be warm, that is, (by implication) sunburnt or swarthy (blackish): - brown.

H2346.full: Feminine active participle of an unused root apparently meaning to join; a wall of protection: - wall, walled.

H2347.full: chûs khoos A primitive root; properly to cover, that is, (figuratively) to compassionate: - pity, regard, spare.

H2348.firstSense: coast [of the sea], haven, shore, [sea-] side
H2348.full: chôph khofe From an unused root meaning to cover; a cove (as a sheltered bay): - coast [of the sea], haven, shore, [sea-] side.

H2349.full: From the same as H2348; protection; Chupham, an Israelite: - Hupham.

H2350.full: Patronymic from H2349; a Chuphamite or descendant of Chupham: - Huphamites.

H2351.firstSense: abroad, field, forth, highway, more, out (-side, -ward), street, without
H2351.full: chûts chûts khoots, khoots (Both forms feminine in the plural); from an unused root meaning to sever; properly separate by a wall, that is, outside, outdoors: - abroad, field, forth, highway, more, out (-side, -ward), street, without.

H2352.full: chûr chûr khoor, khoor From an unused root probably meaning to bore; the crevice of a serpent; the cell of a prison: - hole.

H2353.full: chûr khoor From H2357; white linen: - white.

H2354.full: chûr khoor The same as H2353 or H2352; Chur, the name of four Israelites and one Midianite: - Hur.

H2355.full: chôr khore The same as H2353; white linen: - network. Compare H2715.

H2356.full: chôr chôr khore, khore The same as H2352; a cavity, socket, den: - cave, hole.

H2357.full: A primitive root; to blanch (as with shame): - wax pale.

H2358.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H2357; white: - white.

H2359.full: Probably from H2353; linen worker; Churi, an Israelite: - Huri.

H2360.full: Probably an orthographical variation for H2359; Churai, an Israelite: - Hurai.

H2361.full: Probably from H2353; whiteness, that is, noble; Churam, the name of an Israelite and two Syrians: - Huram. Compare H2438.

H2362.full: Apparently from H2357 (in the sense of H2352); cavernous; Chavran, a region East of the Jordan: - Hauran.

H2363.full: chûsh koosh A primitive root; to hurry; figuratively to be eager with excitement or enjoyment: - (make) haste (-n), ready.

H2364.full: From H2363; haste; Chushah, an Israelite: - Hushah.

H2365.full: From H2363; hasty; Chushai, an Israelite: - Hushai.

H2366.full: Plural from H2363; hasters; Chushim, the name of three Israelites: - Hushim.

H2367.full: From H2363; hastily; Chusham, an Idumaean: - Husham.

H2368.full: From H2856; a signature ring: - seal, signet.

H2369.full: The same as H2368; seal; Chotham, the name of two Israelites: - Hotham, Hothan.

H2370.firstSense: behold, have [a dream], see, be wont
H2370.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H2372; to gaze upon; mentally to dream, be usual (that is, seem): - behold, have [a dream], see, be wont.

H2371.full: From H2372 and H410; God has seen; Chazael, a king of Syria: - Hazael.

H2372.full: châzâh khaw-zaw A primitive root; to gaze at; mentally to perceive, contemplate (with pleasure); specifically to have a vision of: - behold, look, prophesy, provide, see.

H2373.full: From H2372; the breast (as most seen in front): - breast.

H2374.firstSense: agreement, prophet, see that, seer, [star-] gazer
H2374.full: Active participle of H2372; a beholder in vision; also a compact (as looked upon with approval): - agreement, prophet, see that, seer, [star-] gazer.

H2375.full: From H2372; seer; Chazo, a nephew of Abraham: - Hazo.

H2376.full: (Chaldee); from H2370; a sight: - look, vision.

H2377.full: From H2372; a sight (mentally), that is, a dream, revelation, or oracle: - vision.

H2380.full: From H2372; a look; hence (figuratively) striking appearance, revelation or (by implication) compact: - agreement, notable (one), vision.

H2381.full: From H2371 and H410; seen of God; Chaziel, a Levite: - Haziel.

H2382.full: From H2372 and H3050; Jah has seen; Chazajah, an Israelite: - Hazaiah.

H2383.full: From H2372; vision; Chezjon, a Syrian: - Hezion.

H2384.full: From H2372; a revelation, especially by dream: - vision.

H2385.full: From an unused root meaning to glare; a flash of lightning: - bright cloud, lightning.

H2386.full: From an unused root probably meaning to inclose; a hog (perhaps as penned): - boar, swine.

H2387.full: From the same as H2386; perhaps protected; Chezir, the name of two Israelites: - Hezir.

H2388.firstSense: aid, amend, X calker, catch, cleave, confirm, be constant, constrain, continue, be of g…
H2388.full: A primitive root; to fasten upon; hence to seize, be strong (figuratively courageous, causatively strengthen, cure, help, repair, fortify), obstinate; to bind, restrain, conquer: - aid, amend, X calker, catch, cleave, confirm, be constant, constrain, continue, be of good (take) courage (-ous, -ly), encourage (self), be established, fasten, force, fortify, make hard, harden, help, (lay) hold (fast), lean, maintain, play the man, mend, become (wax) mighty, prevail, be recovered, repair, retain, seize, be (wax) sore, strengten (self), be stout, be (make, shew, wax) strong (-er), be sure, take (hold), be urgent, behave self valiantly, withstand.

H2389.firstSense: harder, hottest, + impudent, loud, mighty, sore, stiff [-hearted], strong (-er)
H2389.full: From H2388; strong (usually in a bad sense, hard, bold, violent): - harder, hottest, + impudent, loud, mighty, sore, stiff [-hearted], strong (-er).
