H2390.full: From H2388; powerful: - X wax louder- stronger.

H2393.full: Feminine of H2391; prevailing power: - strength (-en self), (was) strong.

H2394.full: Feminine of H2392; vehemence (usually in a bad sense): - force, mightily, repair, sharply.

H2395.full: From H2388; strong; Chizki, an Israelite: - Hezeki.

H2396.full: chizqı̂yâh chizqı̂yâhû yechizqı̂yâh yechizqı̂yâhû khiz-kee-yaw', khiz-kee-yaw'-hoo, yekh-iz-kee-yaw', yekh-iz-kee-yaw'-hoo From H2388 and H3050; strengthened of Jah; Chizkijah, a king of Judah, also the name of two other Israelites: - Hezekiah, Hizkiah, Hizkijah. Compare H3169.

H2397.full: From the same as H2336; a ring for the nose (or lips): - bracelet, chain, hook.

H2398.firstSense: bear the blame, cleanse, commit [sin], by fault, harm he hath done, loss, miss, (make)…
H2398.full: A primitive root; properly to miss; hence (figuratively and generally) to sin; by inference to forfeit, lack, expiate, repent, (causatively) lead astray, condemn: - bear the blame, cleanse, commit [sin], by fault, harm he hath done, loss, miss, (make) offend (-er), offer for sin, purge, purify (self), make reconciliation, (cause, make) sin (-ful, -ness), trespassive

H2399.firstSense: fault, X grievously, offence, (punishment of) sin
H2399.full: From H2398; a crime or its penalty: - fault, X grievously, offence, (punishment of) sin.

H2400.full: Intensive from H2398; a criminal, or one accounted guilty: - offender, sinful, sinner.

H2401.full: Feminine of H2399; an offence, or a sacrifice for it: - sin (offering), sinful.

H2402.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H2401; an offence, and the penalty or sacrifice for it: - sin (offering).

H2403.firstSense: punishment (of sin), purifying (-fication for sin), sin (-ner, offering)
H2403.full: From H2398; an offence (sometimes habitual sinfulness), and its penalty, occasion, sacrifice, or expiation; also (concretely) an offender: - punishment (of sin), purifying (-fication for sin), sin (-ner, offering).

H2404.full: A primitive root; to chop or carve wood: - cut down, hew (-er), polish.

H2405.full: Feminine passive participle of H2404; properly a carving; hence a tapestry (as figured): - carved.

H2406.full: Of uncertain derivation; wheat, whether the grain or the plant: - wheat (-en).

H2407.full: From an unused root of uncertain signification; Chattush, the name of four or five Israelites: - Hattush.

H2408.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H2398; an offence: - sin.

H2409.full: (Chaldee); from the same as H2408; an expiation: - sin offering.

H2410.full: From an unused root apparently meaning to dig out; explorer; Chatita, a temple porter: - Hatita.

H2411.full: From an unused root apparently meaning to wave; fluctuating; Chattil, one of Solomon's servants: - Hattil.

H2412.full: From H2414; robber; Chatipha, one of the Nethinim: - Hatipha.

H2413.full: A primitive root; to stop: - refrain.

H2414.full: A primitive root; to clutch; hence to seize as a prisoner: - catch.

H2415.full: From an unused root of uncertain signification; a twig: - rod.

H2416.firstSense: + age, alive, appetite, (wild) beast, company, congregation, life (-time), live (-ly),…
H2416.full: From H2421; alive; hence raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively: - + age, alive, appetite, (wild) beast, company, congregation, life (-time), live (-ly), living (creature, thing), maintenance, + merry, multitude, + (be) old, quick, raw, running, springing, troop.

H2417.full: (Chaldee); from H2418; alive; also (as noun in plural) life: - life, that liveth, living.

H2418.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H2421; to live: - live, keep alive.

H2419.full: khee-ale' From H2416 and H410; living of God; Chiel, an Israelite: - Hiel.

H2420.firstSense: dark saying (sentence, speech), hard question, proverb, riddle
H2420.full: From H2330; a puzzle; hence a trick, conundrum, sententious maxim: - dark saying (sentence, speech), hard question, proverb, riddle.

H2421.firstSense: keep (leave, make) alive, X certainly, give (promise) life, (let, suffer to) live, nour…
H2421.full: A prim root (compare H2331, H2424); to live, whether literally or figuratively; causatively to revive: - keep (leave, make) alive, X certainly, give (promise) life, (let, suffer to) live, nourish up, preserve (alive), quicken, recover, repair, restore (to life), revive, (X God) save (alive, life, lives), X surely, be whole.

H2423.full: khay-vaw' (Chaldee); from H2418; an animal: - beast.

H2425.full: A primitive root (compare H2421); to live; causatively to revive: - live, save life.

H2426.firstSense: army, bulwark, host, + poor, rampart, trench, wall
H2426.full: chêyl chêl khale, khale A collateral form of H2428; an army; also (by analogy) an intrenchment: - army, bulwark, host, + poor, rampart, trench, wall.

H2427.full: From H2342; a throe (especially of childbirth): - pain, pang, sorrow.

H2428.firstSense: able, activity, (+) army, band of men (soldiers), company, (great) forces, goods, host,…
H2428.full: From H2342; probably a force, whether of men, means or other resources; an army, wealth, virtue, valor, strength: - able, activity, (+) army, band of men (soldiers), company, (great) forces, goods, host, might, power, riches, strength, strong, substance, train, (+) valiant (-ly), valour, virtuous (-ly), war, worthy (-ily).

H2429.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H2428; an army, or strength: - aloud, army, X most [mighty], power.

H2430.full: Feminine of H2428; an intrenchment: - bulwark.

H2431.full: khay-lawm', khay-lawm' From H2428; fortress; Chelam, a place East of Palestine: - Helam.

H2432.full: chı̂ylên khee-lane From H2428; fortress; Chilen, a place in Palestine: - Hilen.

H2433.full: chı̂yn kheen Another form of H2580; beauty: - comely.

H2434.full: Another form for H2351; a wall: - wall.

H2435.full: From H2434; properly the (outer) wall side; hence exterior; figuratively secular (as opposed to sacred): - outer, outward, utter, without.

H2436.full: chêyq chêq chôq khake, khake, khoke From an unused root, apparently meaning to inclose; the bosom (literally or figuratively): - bosom, bottom, lap, midst, within.

H2437.full: From H2357 in the sense of splendor; Chirah, an Adullamite: - Hirah.

H2438.full: Another form of H2361; Chiram or Chirom, the name of two Tyrians: - Hiram, Huram.

H2439.full: chı̂ysh kheesh Another form of H2363; to hurry: - make haste.

H2440.full: chı̂ysh kheesh From H2439; properly a hurry; hence (adverbially) quickly: - soon.

H2441.full: chêk khake Probably from H2496 in the sense of tasting; properly the palate or inside of the mouth; hence the mouth itself (as the organ of speech, taste and kissing): - (roof of the) mouth, taste.

H2442.full: A primitive root (apparently akin to H2707 through the idea of piercing); properly to adhere to; hence to await: - long, tarry, wait.

H2443.full: Probably from H2442; a hook (as adhering): - angle, hook.

H2444.full: From the same as H2447; dark; Chakilah, a hill in Palestine: - Hachilah.

H2445.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H2449; wise, that is, a Magian: - wise.

H2446.full: From the base of H2447 and H3050; darkness of Jah; Chakaljah, an Israelite: - Hachaliah.

H2447.full: By reduplication from an unused root apparently meaning to be dark; darkly flashing (only of the eyes); in a good sense, brilliant (as stimulated by wine): - red.

H2448.full: From H2447; flash (of the eyes); in a bad sense, blearedness: - redness.

H2449.firstSense: X exceeding, teach wisdom, be (make self, shew self) wise, deal (never so) wisely, make…
H2449.full: A primitive root, to be wise (in mind, word or act): - X exceeding, teach wisdom, be (make self, shew self) wise, deal (never so) wisely, make wiser.

H2450.full: From H2449; wise, (that is, intelligent, skilful or artful): - cunning (man), subtil, ([un-]), wise ([hearted], man).

H2451.full: From H2449; wisdom (in a good sense): - skillful, wisdom, wisely, wit.

H2453.full: From H2449; skilful; Chakmoni, an Israelite: - Hachmoni, Hachmonite.

H2454.full: Collateral forms of H2451; wisdom: - wisdom, every wise [woman].

H2455.full: chôl khole From H2490; properly exposed; hence profane: - common, profane (place), unholy.

H2456.full: A primitive root (compare H2470); to be sick: - be diseased.

H2457.full: khel-aw' From H2456; properly disease; hence rust: - scum.

H2458.full: khel-aw' The same as H2457; Chelah, an Israelitess: - Helah.

H2459.firstSense: X best, fat (-ness), X finest, grease, marrow
H2459.full: From an unused root meaning to be fat; fat, whether literally or figuratively; hence the richest or choice part: - X best, fat (-ness), X finest, grease, marrow.

H2460.full: The same as H2459; fatness; Cheleb, an Israelite: - Heleb.

H2461.full: From the same as H2459; milk (as the richness of kine): - + cheese, milk, sucking,

H2462.full: Feminine of H2459; fertility: Chelbah, a place in Palestine: - Helbah.

H2463.full: From H2459; fruitful; Chelbon, a place in Syria: - Helbon.

H2464.full: From H2459; galbanam, an odorous gum (as if fatty): - galbanum.

H2465.full: From an unused root apparently meaning to glide swiftly; life (as a fleeting portion of time); hence the world (as transient): - age, short time, world.

H2466.full: The same as H2465; cheled, an Israelite: - Heled.

H2467.full: From the same as H2465; a weasel (from its gliding motion): - weasel.

H2468.full: Feminine of H2467; Chuldah, an Israelitess: - Huldah.

H2469.full: From H2466; worldliness; Cheldai, the name of two Israelites: - Heldai.

H2470.firstSense: beseech, (be) diseased, (put to) grief, be grieved, (be) grievous, infirmity, intreat,…
H2470.full: A primitive root (compare H2342, H2490); properly to be rubbed or worn; hence (figuratively) to be weak, sick, afflicted; or (causatively) to grieve, make sick; also to stroke (in flattering), entreat: - beseech, (be) diseased, (put to) grief, be grieved, (be) grievous, infirmity, intreat, lay to, put to pain, X pray, make prayer, be (fall, make) sick, sore, be sorry, make suit (X supplication), woman in travail, be (become) weak, be wounded.

H2471.full: From H2490; a cake (as usually punctured): - cake.

H2473.full: Probably from H2344; sandy; Cholon, the name of two places in Palestine: - Holon.

H2475.full: From H2498; properly surviving; by implication (collectively) orphans: - X destruction.

H2476.full: Feminine passive participle of H2522; defeat: - being overcome.

H2477.full: Probably of foreign origin; Chalach, a region of Assyria: - Halah.

H2478.full: By reduplication from H2342; contorted; Chalchul, a place in Palestine: - Halhul.

H2479.full: Feminine from the same as H2478; writhing (in childbirth); by implication terror: - (great, much) pain.

H2480.full: A primitive root; to snatch at: - catch.

H2481.full: From H2470; a trinket (as polished): - jewel, ornament.

H2482.full: The same as H2481; Chali, a place in Palestine: - Hali.

H2483.full: From H2470; malady, anxiety, calamity: - disease, grief, (is) sick (-ness).

H2484.full: Feminine of H2481; a trinket: - jewel.

H2485.full: From H2490; a flute (as perforated): - pipe.

H2486.full: A directive from H2490; literally for a profaned thing; used (interjectionally) far be it!: - be far, (X God) forbid.

H2489.full: khay-lek-aw', khay-lek-aw' Apparently from an unused root probably meaning to be dark or (figuratively) unhappy; a wretch, that is, unfortunate: - poor.

H2490.firstSense: begin (X men began), defile, X break, defile, X eat (as common things), X first, X gath…
H2490.full: A primitive root (compare H2470); properly to bore, that is, (by implication) to wound, to dissolve; figuratively to profane (a person, place or thing), to break (one's word), to begin (as if by an opening-wedge); denominatively (from H2485) to play (the flute): - begin (X men began), defile, X break, defile, X eat (as common things), X first, X gather the grape thereof, X take inheritance, pipe, player on instruments, pollute, (cast as) profane (self), prostitute, slay (slain), sorrow, stain, wound.

H2491.firstSense: kill, profane, slain (man), X slew, (deadly) wounded
H2491.full: From H2490; pierced (especially to death); figuratively polluted: - kill, profane, slain (man), X slew, (deadly) wounded.

H2492.firstSense: (cause to) dream (-er), be in good liking, recover
H2492.full: A primitive root; properly to bind firmly, that is, (by implication) to be (causatively to make) plump; also (through the figurative sense of dumbness) to dream: - (cause to) dream (-er), be in good liking, recover.

H2493.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H2492; a dream: - dream.

H2494.full: From H2492; a dream; Chelem, an Israelite: - Helem. Compare H2469.

H2495.full: From H2492 (in the sense of insipidity); probably purslain: - egg.

H2496.full: Probably from H2492 (in the sense of hardness); flint: - flint (-y), rock.

H2497.full: From H2428; strong; Chelon, an Israelite: - Helon

H2498.firstSense: abolish, alter change, cut off, go on forward, grow up, be over, pass (away, on, throug…
H2498.full: A primitive root; properly to slide by, that is, (by implication) to hasten away, pass on, spring up, pierce or change: - abolish, alter change, cut off, go on forward, grow up, be over, pass (away, on, through), renew, sprout, strike through.

H2499.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H2498; to pass on (of time): - pass.

H2500.full: From H2498; properly exchange; hence (as preposition) instead of: - X for.

H2501.full: The same as H2500; change; Cheleph, a place in Palestine: - Heleph.

H2502.firstSense: arm (self), (go, ready) armed (X man, soldier), deliver, draw out, make fat, loose, (re…
H2502.full: A primitive root; to pull off; hence (intensively) to strip, (reflexively) to depart; by implication to deliver, equip (for fight); present, strengthen: - arm (self), (go, ready) armed (X man, soldier), deliver, draw out, make fat, loose, (ready) prepared, put off, take away, withdraw self.

H2503.full: From H2502; perhaps strength; Chelets, the name of two Israelites: - Helez.

H2504.full: From H2502 (in the sense of strength); only in the dual; the loins (as the seat of vigor): - loins, reins.

H2505.firstSense: deal, distribute, divide, flatter, give, (have, im-) part (-ner), take away a portion,…
H2505.full: A primitive root; to be smooth (figuratively); by implication (as smooth stones were used for lots) to apportion or separate: - deal, distribute, divide, flatter, give, (have, im-) part (-ner), take away a portion, receive, separate self, (be) smooth (-er).

H2506.firstSense: flattery, inheritance, part, X partake, portion
H2506.full: From H2505; properly smoothness (of the tongue); also an allotment: - flattery, inheritance, part, X partake, portion.

H2507.full: The same as H2506; portion; Chelek, an Israelite: - Helek.

H2508.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H2505; a part: - portion.

H2509.full: From H2505; smooth (especially of tongue): - flattering, smooth.

H2510.full: The same as H2500; bare; Chalak, a mountain of Idumaea: - Halak.

H2513.firstSense: field, flattering (-ry), ground, parcel, part, piece of land ([ground]), plat, portion,…
H2513.full: Feminine of H2506; properly smoothness; figuratively flattery; also an allotment: - field, flattering (-ry), ground, parcel, part, piece of land ([ground]), plat, portion, slippery place, smooth (thing).

H2515.full: chălûqqâh khal-ook-kaw Feminine of H2512; a distribution: - division.

H2516.full: Patronymic from H2507; a Chelkite or descendant of Chelek: - Helkites.

H2517.full: From H2505; apportioned; Chelkai, an Israelite: - Helkai.

H2518.full: From H2506 and H3050; portion of Jah; Chilhijah, the name of eight Israelites: - Hilkiah.

H2519.full: By reduplication from H2505; properly something very smooth; that is, a treacherous spot; figuratively blandishment: - flattery, slippery.

H2520.full: A form of H2513; smoothness; Chelkath, a place in Palestine: - Helkath.

H2521.full: From H2520 and the plural of H6697; with the article inserted; smoothness of the rocks; Chelkath Hatstsurim, a place in Palestine: - Helkath-hazzurim.

H2522.full: A primitive root; to prostrate; by implication to overthrow, decay: - discomfit, waste away, weaken.

H2524.full: châm khawm From the same as H2346; a father in law (as in affinity): - father in law.

H2525.full: châm khawm From H2552; hot: - hot, warm.

H2526.full: châm khawm The same as H2525; hot (from the tropical habitat); Cham, a son of Noah; also (as a patronymic) his descendants or their country: - Ham.

H2527.full: chôm khome From H2552; heat: - heat, to be hot (warm).

H2529.full: khem-aw', khay-maw' From the same root as H2346; curdled milk or cheese: - butter.

H2530.firstSense: beauty, greatly beloved, covet, delectable thing, ( X great) delight, desire, goodly, l…
H2530.full: A primitive root; to delight in: - beauty, greatly beloved, covet, delectable thing, ( X great) delight, desire, goodly, lust, (be) pleasant (thing), precious (thing).

H2531.full: A primitive root; to delight in: - desirable, pleasant.

H2532.full: Feminine of H2531; delight: - desire, goodly, pleasant, precious.

H2533.full: From H2531; pleasant; Chemdan, an Idumaean: - Hemdan.

H2534.firstSense: anger, bottles, hot displeasure, furious (-ly, -ry), heat, indignation, poison, rage, w…
H2534.full: From H3179; heat; figuratively anger, poison (from its fever): - anger, bottles, hot displeasure, furious (-ly, -ry), heat, indignation, poison, rage, wrath (-ful). See H2529.

H2535.full: From H2525; heat; by implication the sun: - heat, sun.

H2536.full: kham-moo-ale' From H2535 and H410; anger of God; Chammuel, an Israelite: - Hamuel.

H2537.full: From H2524 and H2919; father in law of dew; Chamutal or Chamital, an Israelitess: - Hamutal.

H2538.full: From H2550; pitied; Chamul, an Israelite: - Hamul.

H2539.full: Patronymic from H2538; a Chamulite (collectively) or descendant of Chamul: - Hamulites.

H2540.full: From H2552; warm spring; Chammon, the name of two places in Palestine: - Hammon.

H2541.full: From H2556; properly violent; by implication a robber: - oppressed.

H2542.full: From H2559; a wrapping, that is, drawers: - joints.

H2543.full: From H2560; a male ass (from its dun red): - (he) ass.

H2544.full: The same as H2543; ass; Chamor, a Canaanite: - Hamor.

H2545.full: Feminine of H2524; a mother in law: - mother in law.

H2546.full: From an unused root probably meaning to lie low; a lizard (as creeping): - snail.

H2547.full: Feminine of H2546; low; Chumtah, a place in Palestine: - Humtah.

H2548.full: From H2556; seasoned, that is, salt provender: - clean.

H2549.full: Ordinal from H2568; fifth; also a fifth: - fifth (part).

H2550.full: A primitive root; to commiserate; by implication to spare: - have compassion, (have) pity, spare.

H2552.firstSense: enflame self, get (have) heat, be (wax) hot, (be, wax) warm (self, at)
H2552.full: A primitive root; to be hot (literally or figuratively): - enflame self, get (have) heat, be (wax) hot, (be, wax) warm (self, at).

H2553.full: From H2535; a sun pillar: - idol, image.

H2554.firstSense: make bare, shake off, violate, do violence, take away violently, wrong, imagine wrongfully
H2554.full: A primitive root; to be violent; by implication to maltreat: - make bare, shake off, violate, do violence, take away violently, wrong, imagine wrongfully.

H2555.firstSense: cruel (-ty), damage, false, injustice, X oppressor, unrighteous, violence (against, don…
H2555.full: From H2554; violence; by implication wrong; by metonymy unjust gain: - cruel (-ty), damage, false, injustice, X oppressor, unrighteous, violence (against, done), violent (dealing), wrong.

H2556.full: A primitive root; to be pungent; that is, in taste (sour, that is, literally fermented, or figuratively harsh), in color (dazzling): - cruel (man), dyed, be grieved, leavened.

H2557.full: From H2556; ferment, (figuratively) extortion: - leaven, leavened (bread).

H2559.full: A primitive root; properly to enwrap; hence to depart (that is, turn about): - go about, withdraw self.

H2560.full: A primitive root; properly to boil up; hence to ferment (with scum); to glow (with redness); as denominative (from H2564) to smear with pitch: - daub, foul, be red, trouble.

H2561.full: From H2560; wine (as fermenting): - X pure, red wine.

H2563.firstSense: clay, heap, homer, mire, motion, mortar
H2563.full: From H2560; properly a bubbling up, that is, of water, a wave; of earth, mire or clay (cement); also a heap; hence a chomer or dry measure: - clay, heap, homer, mire, motion, mortar.

H2564.full: From H2560; bitumen (as rising to the surface): - slime (-pit).

H2565.full: From H2560 (compare H2563); a heap: - heap.

H2566.full: From H2560; red; Chamran, an Idumaean: - Amran.

H2567.full: A denominative from H2568; to tax a fifth: - take up the fifth part.

H2568.full: A primitive numeral; five: - fif [-teen], fifth, five (X apiece).

H2569.full: From H2567; a fifth tax: - fifth part.

H2570.full: From an unused root probably meaning to be stout; the abdomen (as obese): - fifth [rib].

H2571.full: Passive participle of the same as H2570; staunch, that is, able bodied soldiers: - armed (men), harnessed.

H2573.full: From the same as H2346; a skin bottle (as tied up): - bottle.

H2574.full: From the same as H2346; walled; Chamath, a place in Syria: - Hamath, Hemath.

H2575.full: A variation for the first part of H2576; hot springs; Chammath, a place in Palestine: - Hammath.

H2576.full: kham-moth' dore From the plural of H2535 and H1756; hot springs of Dor; Chammath Dor, a place in Palestine: - Hamath-Dor.

H2577.full: Patrial from H2574; a Chamathite or native of Chamath: - Hamathite.

H2578.full: From H2574 and H6678; Chamath of Tsobah; Chamath Tsobah; probably the same as H2574: - Hamath-Zobah.

H2579.full: From H2574 and H7237; Chamath of Rabbah; Chamath Rabbah, probably the same as H2574.

H2580.full: chên khane From H2603; graciousness, that is, subjectively (kindness, favor) or objectively (beauty): - favour, grace (-ious), pleasant, precious, [well-] favoured.

H2581.full: chên khane The same as H2580; grace; Chen, a figurative name for an Israelite: - Hen.

H2582.full: Probably from H2580 and H1908; favor of Hadad; Chenadad, an Israelite: - Henadad.

H2583.firstSense: abide (in tents), camp, dwell, encamp, grow to an end, lie, pitch (tent), rest in tent
H2583.full: A primitive root (compare H2603); properly to incline; by implication to decline (of the slanting rays of evening); specifically to pitch a tent; generally to encamp (for abode or siege): - abide (in tents), camp, dwell, encamp, grow to an end, lie, pitch (tent), rest in tent.

H2584.full: From H2603; favored; Channah, an Israelitess: - Hannah.

H2585.full: From H2596; initiated; Chanok, an antediluvian patriarch: - Enoch.

H2586.full: From H2603; favored; Chanun, the name of an Ammonite and of two Israelites: - Hanun.

H2588.full: From H2583; properly a vault or cell (with an arch); by implication a prison: - cabin.

H2589.full: From H2603 (in the sense of prayer); supplication: - be gracious, intreated.

H2590.full: A primitive root; to spice; by implication to embalm; also to ripen: - embalm, put forth.

H2591.full: khint-taw' (Chaldee); corresponding to H2406; wheat: - wheat.

H2592.full: khan-nee-ale' From H2603 and H410; favor of God; Channiel, the name of two Israelites: - Hanniel.

H2593.full: From H2396; initiated; that is, practised: - trained.

H2595.full: From H2583; a lance (for thrusting, like pitching a tent): - javelin, spear.

H2596.full: A primitive root; properly to narrow (compare H2614); figuratively to initiate or discipline: - dedicate, train up.

H2598.full: From H2596; initiation, that is, consecration: - dedicating (-tion).

H2599.full: Patronymic from H2585; a Chanokite (collectively) or descendant of Chanok: - Hanochites.

H2600.firstSense: without a cause (cost, wages), causeless, to cost nothing, free (-ly), innocent, for no…
H2600.full: From H2580; gratis, that is, devoid of cost, reason or advantage: - without a cause (cost, wages), causeless, to cost nothing, free (-ly), innocent, for nothing (nought), in vain.

H2601.full: khan-am-ale' Probably by orthographical variation for H2606; Chanamel, an Israelite: - Hanameel.

H2602.full: Of uncertain derivation; perhaps the aphis or plant louse: - frost.

H2603.firstSense: beseech, X fair, (be, find, shew) favour (-able), be (deal, give, grant (gracious (-ly)…
H2603.full: A primitive root (compare H2583); properly to bend or stoop in kindness to an inferior; to favor, bestow; causatively to implore (that is, move to favor by petition): - beseech, X fair, (be, find, shew) favour (-able), be (deal, give, grant (gracious (-ly), intreat, (be) merciful, have (shew) mercy (on, upon), have pity upon, pray, make supplication, X very.

H2604.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H2603; to favor or (causatively) to entreat: - shew mercy, make supplication.

H2605.full: From H2603; favor; Chanan, the name of seven Israelites: - Canan.

H2606.full: khan-an-ale' From H2603 and H410; God has favored; Chananel, probably an Israelite, from whom a tower of Jerusalem was named: - Hananeel.

H2607.full: From H2603; gracious; Chanani, the name of six Israelites: - Hanani.

H2608.full: From H2603 and H3050; Jah has favored; Chananjah, the name of thirteen Israelites: - Hananiah.

H2609.full: Of Egyptian derivation; Chanes, a place in Egypt: - Hanes.

H2610.firstSense: corrupt, defile, X greatly, pollute, profane
H2610.full: A primitive root; to soil, especially in a moral sense: - corrupt, defile, X greatly, pollute, profane.

H2611.full: From H2610; soiled (that is, with sin), impious: - hypocrite (-ical).

H2612.full: From H2610; moral filth, that is, wickedness: - hypocrisy.

H2614.full: A primitive root (compare H2596); to be narrow; by implication to throttle, or (reflexively) to choke oneself to death (by a rope): - hang self, strangle.

H2615.full: Probably from H2603; favored; Channathon, a place in Palestine: - Hannathon.

H2616.firstSense: shew self merciful, put to shame
H2616.full: A primitive root; properly perhaps to bow (the neck only (compare H2603) in courtesy to an equal), that is, to be kind; also (by euphemism (compare H1288), but rarely) to reprove: - shew self merciful, put to shame.

H2617.firstSense: favour, good deed (-liness, -ness), kindly, (loving-) kindness, merciful (kindness), me…
H2617.full: From H2616; kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opprobrium) reproof, or (subjectively) beauty: - favour, good deed (-liness, -ness), kindly, (loving-) kindness, merciful (kindness), mercy, pity, reproach, wicked thing.

H2618.full: The same as H2617; favor; Chesed, an Israelite: - Hesed.

H2619.full: From H2617 and H3050; Jah has favored; Chasadjah, an Israelite: - Hasadiah.

H2620.full: A primitive root; to flee for protection (compare H982); figuratively to confide in: - have hope, make refuge, (put) trust.

H2621.full: From H2620; hopeful; Chosah, an Israelite: - Hosah.

H2623.firstSense: godly (man), good, holy (one), merciful, saint, [un-] godly
H2623.full: From H2616; properly kind, that is, (religiously) pious (a saint): - godly (man), good, holy (one), merciful, saint, [un-] godly.

H2624.full: Feminine of H2623; the kind (maternal) bird, that is, a stork: - X feather, stork.

H2625.full: From H2628; the ravager, that is, a locust: - caterpillar.

H2626.full: From H2630; properly firm, that is, (by implication) mighty: - strong.

H2627.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H2637; deficient: - wanting.

H2628.full: A primitive root; to eat off: - consume.

H2629.full: A primitive root; to muzzle; by analogy to stop the nose: - muzzle, stop.

H2630.full: A primitive root; properly to (be) compact; by implication to hoard: - lay up.

H2631.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H2630; to hold in occupancy: - possess.

H2633.full: From H2630; wealth: - riches, strength, treasure.

H2635.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to that of H2636; a clod: - clay.

H2636.full: Reduplicated from an unused root meaning apparently to peel; a shred or scale: - round thing.

H2637.firstSense: be abated, bereave, decrease, (cause to) fail, (have) lack, make lower, want
H2637.full: A primitive root; to lack; by implication to fail, want, lessen: - be abated, bereave, decrease, (cause to) fail, (have) lack, make lower, want.

H2638.firstSense: destitute, fail, lack, have need, void, want
H2638.full: From H2637; lacking; hence without: - destitute, fail, lack, have need, void, want.

H2639.full: From H2637; lack; hence destitution: - poverty, want.

H2640.full: From H2637; poverty: - in want of.

H2641.full: From H2637; want: - Chasrah, an Isr: - Hasrah.

H2643.full: chaph khaf From H2653 (in the moral sense of covered from soil); pure: - innocent.

H2644.full: khaw-faw' An orthographical variation of H2645; properly to cover, that is, (in a sinister sense) to act covertly: - do secretly.

H2645.full: A primitive root (compare H2644, H2653); to cover; by implication to veil, to incase, protect: - ceil, cover, overlay.

H2646.full: From H2645; a canopy: - chamber, closet, defence.

H2647.full: The same as H2646; Chuppah, an Israelite: - Huppah.

H2648.full: A primitive root; properly to start up suddenly, that is, (by implication) to hasten away, to fear: - (make) haste (away), tremble.

H2650.full: Plural of H2646 (compare H2349); Chuppim, an Israelite: - Huppim.

H2651.full: From an unused root of uncertain signification; a fist (only in the dual): - fists, (both) hands, hand [-full].

H2652.full: From H2651; perhaps pugilist; Chophni, an Israelite: - Hophni.

H2653.full: A primitive root (compare H2645, H3182); to cover (in protection): - cover.

H2654.firstSense: X any at all, (have, take) delight, desire, favour, like, move, be (well) pleased, have…
H2654.full: A primitive root; properly to incline to; by implication (literally but rarely) to bend; figuratively to be pleased with, desire: - X any at all, (have, take) delight, desire, favour, like, move, be (well) pleased, have pleasure, will, would.

H2655.firstSense: delight in, desire, favour, please, have pleasure, whosoever would, willing, wish
H2655.full: From H2654; pleased with: - delight in, desire, favour, please, have pleasure, whosoever would, willing, wish.

H2656.firstSense: acceptable, delight (-some), desire, things desired, matter, pleasant (-ure), purpose,…
H2656.full: From H2654; pleasure; hence (abstractly) desire; concretely a valuable thing; hence (by extension) a matter (as something in mind): - acceptable, delight (-some), desire, things desired, matter, pleasant (-ure), purpose, willingly.

H2657.full: From H2656 with suffixes; my delight (is) in her; Cheptsibah, a fanciful name for Palestine: - Hephzi-bah.

H2658.full: A primitive root; properly to pry into; by implication to delve, to explore: - dig, paw, search out, seek.

H2659.firstSense: be ashamed, be confounded, be brought to confusion (unto shame), come (be put to) shame…
H2659.full: A primitive root (perhaps rather the same as H2658 through the idea of detection): to blush; figuratively to be ashamed, disappointed; causatively to shame, reproach: - be ashamed, be confounded, be brought to confusion (unto shame), come (be put to) shame, bring reproach.

H2660.full: From H2658 or H2659; a pit or shame; Chepher, a place in Palestine; also the name of three Israelites: - Hepher.

H2661.full: From H2658; a hole; only in connection with H6512, which ought rather to be joined as one word (shown as second form; by reduplication from H2658; a burrower, that is, probably a rat): - + mole.

H2662.full: Patronymic from H2660; a Chephrite (collectively) or descendant of Chepher: - Hepherites.

H2663.full: Dual of H2660; double pit; Chapharajim, a place in Palestine: - Haphraim.

H2664.firstSense: change, (make) diligent (search), disguise self, hide, search (for, out)
H2664.full: A primitive root; to seek; causatively to conceal oneself (that is, let be sought), or mask: - change, (make) diligent (search), disguise self, hide, search (for, out).

H2665.full: From H2664; something covert, that is, a trick: - search.

H2666.full: A primitive root; to spread loose, figuratively to manumit: - be free.

H2667.full: From H2666; something spread loosely, that is, a carpet: - precious.

H2669.full: From H2666; prostration by sickness (with H1004, a hospital): - several.

H2670.full: From H2666; exempt (from bondage, tax or care): - free, liberty.

H2671.firstSense: + archer, arrow, dart, shaft, staff, wound
H2671.full: chêts khayts From H2686; properly a piercer, that is, an arrow; by implication a wound; figuratively (of God) thunder bolt; (by interchange for H6086) the shaft of a spear: - + archer, arrow, dart, shaft, staff, wound.

H2672.firstSense: cut, dig, divide, grave, hew (out, -er), make, mason
H2672.full: A primitive root; to cut or carve (wood, stone or other material); by implication to hew, split, square, quarry, engrave: - cut, dig, divide, grave, hew (out, -er), make, mason.

H2673.firstSense: divide, X live out half, reach to the midst, part
H2673.full: A primitive root (compare H2686); to cut or split in two; to halve: - divide, X live out half, reach to the midst, part.

H2674.full: A collective form of H2691; village; Chatsor, the name (thus simply) of two places in Palestine and of one in Arabia: - Hazor.

H2675.full: From H2674 and a Chaldaizing form of the feminine of H2319 (compare H2323); new Chatsor, a place in Palestine: - Hazor, Hadattah [as if two places].

H2676.full: From H2673; the middle (of the night): - mid [-night].

H2677.firstSense: half, middle, mid [-night], midst, part, two parts
H2677.full: From H2673; the half or middle: - half, middle, mid [-night], midst, part, two parts.

H2678.full: Prolonged from H2671; an arrow: - arrow.

H2679.full: From H2677 and the plural of H4496, with the article interposed; midst of the resting places; Chatsi ham-Menuchoth, an Israelite: - half of the Manahethites.

H2680.full: Patronymic from H2679; a Chatsi ham-Menachtite or descendant of Chatsi ham-menuchoth: - half of the Manahethites.

H2681.full: A collateral form of H2691; a court or abode: - court.

H2682.full: Perhaps originally the same as H2681, from the greenness of a courtyard; grass; also a leek (collectively): - grass, hay, herb, leek.

H2683.full: From an unused root meaning to hold firmly; the bosom (as comprised between the arms): - bosom.

H2684.full: A collateral form of H2683, and meaning the same: - arm, lap.

H2685.full: (Chaldee); a primitive root; properly to shear or cut close; figuratively to be severe: - hasty, be urgent.

H2686.firstSense: archer, X bands, cut off in the midst
H2686.full: A primitive root (compare H2673); properly to chop into, pierce or sever; hence to curtail, to distribute (into ranks); as denominative from H2671; to shoot an arrow: - archer, X bands, cut off in the midst.

H2687.full: From H2686; properly something cutting; hence gravel (as grit); also (like H2671) an arrow: - arrow, gravel (stone).

H2688.full: From H2686 and H8558; division (that is, perhaps row) of (the palm tree; Chatsetson tamar, a place in Palestine: - Hazezon-tamar.

H2689.full: By reduplication from H2690; a trumpet (from its sundered or quavering note): - trumpet (-er).

H2690.full: A primitive root; properly to surround with a stockade, and thus separate from the open country; but used only in the reduplicated form (the second and third forms; to trumpet, that is, blow on that instrument): - blow, sound, trumpeter.

H2691.full: From H2690 in its original sense; a yard (as inclosed by a fence); also a hamlet (as similarly surrounded with walls): - court, tower, village.

H2692.full: khats-ar' ad-dawr' From H269 and H146: (the) village of Addar; Chatsar Addar, a place in Palestine: - Hazar-addar.

H2693.full: From H2691 and a feminine of H1408; (the) village of (female) Fortune; Chatsar Gaddah, a place in Palestine: - Hazar-gaddah.

H2694.full: From H2691 and H8484 with the article interposed; village of the middle; Chatsar-hat-Tikon, a place in Palestine: - Hazar-hatticon.

H2695.full: By an orthographical variation for H2696; inclosure; Chetsro, an Israelite: - Hezro, Hezrai.

H2696.full: From H2691; courtyard; Chetsron, the name of a place in Palestine; also fo two Israelites: - Hezron.

H2697.full: Patron from H2696; a Chetsronite or (collectively) descendant of Chetsron: - Hezronites.

H2698.full: Feminine plural of H2691; yards; Chatseroth, a place in Palestine: - Hazeroth.

H2699.full: Plural masculine of H2691; yards; Chatserim, a place in Palestine: - Hazerim.

H2700.full: From H2691 and H4194; village of death; Chatsarmaveth, a place in Arabia: - Hazarmaveth.

H2701.full: From H2691 and H5484; village of cavalry; Chatsar Susah, a place in Palestine: - Hazar-susah.

H2702.full: From H2691 and the plural of H5483; village of horses; Chatsar Susim, a place in Palestine: - Hazar-susim.

H2703.full: From H2691 and a derivative of H5869; village of springs; Chatsar Enon, a place in Palestine: - Hazar-enon.

H2704.full: From H2691 and the same as H5881; village of springs; Chatsar Enan, a place in Palestine: - Hazar-enan.

H2705.full: From H2691 and H7776; village of (the) fox; Chatsar Shual, a place in Palestine: - Hazar-shual.

H2706.firstSense: appointed, bound, commandment, convenient, custom, decree (-d), due, law, measure, X ne…
H2706.full: chôq khoke From H2710; an enactment; hence an appointment (of time, space, quantity, labor or usage): - appointed, bound, commandment, convenient, custom, decree (-d), due, law, measure, X necessary, ordinance (-nary), portion, set time, statute, task.

H2707.firstSense: carved work, portrayed, set a print
H2707.full: A primitive root; to carve; by implication to delineate; also to intrench: - carved work, portrayed, set a print.

H2708.firstSense: appointed, custom, manner, ordinance, site, statute
H2708.full: Feminine of H2706, and meaning substantially the same: - appointed, custom, manner, ordinance, site, statute.

H2709.full: From an unused root probably meaning to bend; crooked; Chakupha, one of the Nethinim: - Hakupha.

H2710.firstSense: appoint, decree, governor, grave, lawgiver, note, pourtray, print, set
H2710.full: A primitive root; properly to hack, that is, engrave (Jdg_5:14, to be a scribe simply); by implication to enact (laws being cut in stone or metal tablets in primitive times) or (generally) prescribe: - appoint, decree, governor, grave, lawgiver, note, pourtray, print, set.

H2711.full: From H2710; an enactment, a resolution: - decree, thought.

H2712.full: From H2710; appointed; Chukkok or Chukok, a place in Palestine: - Hukkok, Hukok.

H2713.firstSense: find out, (make) search (out), seek (out), sound, try
H2713.full: A primitive root; properly to penetrate; hence to examine intimately: - find out, (make) search (out), seek (out), sound, try.

H2714.full: From H2713; examination, enumeration, deliberation: - finding out, number, [un-] search (-able, -ed out, -ing).

H2715.full: chôr chôr khore, khore From H2787; properly white or pure (from the cleansing or shining power of fire (compare H2751); hence (figuratively) noble (in rank): - noble.

H2716.full: kheh'-reh, khar-ee' From an unused (and vulger) root probably meaning to evacuate the bowels; excrement: - dung. Also ` chary, khar-ee.

H2717.firstSense: decay, (be) desolate, destroy (-er), (be) dry (up), slay, X surely, (lay, lie, make) waste
H2717.full: A primitive root; to parch (through drought), that is, (by analogy) to desolate, destroy, kill: - decay, (be) desolate, destroy (-er), (be) dry (up), slay, X surely, (lay, lie, make) waste.

H2718.full: (Chaldee); a root corresponding to H2717; to demolish: - destroy.

H2719.firstSense: axe, dagger, knife, mattock, sword, tool
H2719.full: From H2717; drought; also a cutting instrument (from its destructive effect), as a knife, sword, or other sharp implement: - axe, dagger, knife, mattock, sword, tool.

H2720.full: From H2717; parched or ruined: - desolate, dry, waste.

H2721.firstSense: desolation, drought, dry, heat, X utterly, waste
H2721.full: A collateral form of H2719; drought or desolation: - desolation, drought, dry, heat, X utterly, waste.

H2722.full: From H2717; desolate; Choreb, a (generic) name for the Sinaitic mountains: - Horeb.

H2723.full: Feminine of H2721; properly drought, that is, (by implication) a desolation: - decayed place, desolate (place, -tion), destruction, (laid) waste (place).

H2724.full: Feminine of H2720; a desert: - dry (ground, land).

H2726.full: khar-bo-naw', khar-bo-naw' Of Persian origin; a eunuch of Xerxes: - Harbona, Harbonah.

H2727.full: A primitive root; properly to leap suddenly, that is, (by implication) to be dismayed: - be afraid.

H2728.full: From H2727; the leaping insect, that is, a locust: - beetle.

H2729.firstSense: be (make) afraid, be careful, discomfit, fray (away), quake, tremble
H2729.full: A primitive root; to shudder with terror; hence to fear; also to hasten (with anxiety): - be (make) afraid, be careful, discomfit, fray (away), quake, tremble.

H2730.full: From H2729; fearful; also reverential: - afraid, trembling.

H2731.firstSense: care, X exceedingly, fear, quaking, trembling
H2731.full: Feminine of H2730; fear, anxiety: - care, X exceedingly, fear, quaking, trembling.

H2732.full: The same as H2731; Charadah, a place in the Desert: - Haradah.

H2733.full: Patrial from a derivative of H2729 (compare H5878); a Charodite, or inhabitant of Charod: - Harodite.

H2734.firstSense: be angry, burn, be displeased, X earnestly, fret self, grieve, be (wax) hot, be incense…
H2734.full: A primitive root (compare H2787); to glow or grow warm; figuratively (usually) to blaze up, of anger, zeal, jealousy: - be angry, burn, be displeased, X earnestly, fret self, grieve, be (wax) hot, be incensed, kindle, X very, be wroth. See H8474.

H2735.full: From H2356 and a collateral (masculine) form of H1412, with the article interposed; hole of the cleft; Chor hag Gidgad, a place in the Desert: - Hor-hagidgad.

H2736.full: From H2734 and H3050; fearing Jah; Charhajah, an Israelite: - Harhaiah.

H2737.full: From an unused root meaning to perforate; properly pierced, that is, a bead of pearl, gems or jewels (as strung): - chain.

H2738.full: Apparently passive participle of an unused root probably meaning to be prickly; properly pointed, that is, a bramble or other thorny weed: - nettle.

H2739.full: From passive participle of H2763 and H639; snubnosed; Charumaph, an Israelite: - Harumaph.

H2740.full: From H2734; a burning of anger: - sore displeasure, fierce (-ness), fury, (fierce) wrath (-ful).

H2741.full: A patrial from (probably) a collateral form of H2756; a Charuphite or inhabitant of Charuph (or Chariph): - Haruphite.

H2742.firstSense: decision, diligent, (fine) gold, pointed things, sharp, threshing instrument, wall
H2742.full: Passive participle of H2782; properly incised or (active) incisive; hence (as noun masculine or feminine) a trench (as dug), gold (as mined), a threshing sledge (having sharp teeth); (figuratively) determination; also eager: - decision, diligent, (fine) gold, pointed things, sharp, threshing instrument, wall.

H2743.full: The same as H2742; earnest; Charuts, an Israelite: - Haruz.

H2744.full: A fuller form of H2746; inflammation; Charchur, one of the Nethinim: - Harhur.

H2745.full: From the same as H2775; perhaps shining; Charchas, an Israelite: - Harbas.

H2746.full: From H2787; fever (as hot): - extreme burning.

H2747.full: From a primitive root meaning to engrave; a chisel or graver; also a style for writing: - graving tool, pen.

H2748.full: From the same as H2747; a horoscopist (as drawing magical lines or circles): - magician.

H2750.full: From H2734; a burning (that is, intense) anger: - fierce, X great, heat.

H2751.full: From the same as H2353; white bread: - white.

H2752.full: From H2356; cave dweller or troglodyte; a Chorite or aboriginal Idumaean: - Horims, Horites.

H2753.full: The same as H2752; Chori, the name of two men: - Hori.

H2754.full: From the same as H2747; properly cut out (or hollow), that is, (by implication) a pocket: - bag, crisping pin.

H2755.full: khar-ay'-yo-neem', khar-aw-yone' From the plural of H2716 and the plural of H3123; excrements of doves (or perhaps rather the plural of a single word, the second form; of similar or uncertain derivation); probably a kind of vegetable: - doves' dung.

H2756.full: From H2778; autumnal; the name of two Israelites: - Hariph.

H2757.full: From H2782; properly incisure or (passive) incised (compare H2742); hence a threshing sledge (with sharp teeth); also a slice (as cut): - + cheese, harrow.

H2758.full: From H2790; ploughing or its season: - earing (time), ground.

H2759.full: From H2790 in the sense of silence; quiet, that is, sultry (as noun feminine the sirocco or hot east wind): - vehement.

H2760.full: A primitive root; to braid (that is, to entangle or snare) or catch (game) in a net: - roast.

H2761.full: (Chaldee); a root probably allied to the equivalent of H2787; to scorch: - singe.

H2762.full: From H2760; properly a net, that is, (by analogy) lattice: - lattice.

H2763.firstSense: make accursed, consecrate, (utterly) destroy, devote, forfeit, have a flat nose, utterl…
H2763.full: A primitive root; to seclude; specifically (by a ban) to devote to religious uses (especially destruction); physically and reflexively to be blunt as to the nose: - make accursed, consecrate, (utterly) destroy, devote, forfeit, have a flat nose, utterly (slay, make away).

H2764.firstSense: (ac-)curse (-d, -d thing), dedicated thing, things which should have been utterly destr…
H2764.full: From H2763; physically (as shutting in) a net (either literally or figuratively); usually a doomed object; abstractly extermination: - (ac-)curse (-d, -d thing), dedicated thing, things which should have been utterly destroyed, (appointed to) utter destruction, devoted (thing), net.

H2765.full: From H2763; devoted; Chorem, a place in Palestine: - Horem.

H2766.full: From H2763; snubnosed; Charim, an Israelite: - Harim.

H2767.full: From H2763; devoted; Chormah, a place in Palestine: - Hormah.

H2768.full: From H2763; abrupt; Chermon, a mount of Palestine: - Hermon.

H2769.full: Plural of H2768; Hermons, that is, its peaks: - the Hermonites.

H2770.full: From H2763; a sickle (as cutting): - sickle.

H2771.full: From H2787; parched; Charan, the name of a man and also of a place: - Haran.

H2772.full: Patrial from H2773; a Choronite or inhabitant of Choronaim: - Horonite.

H2773.full: Dual of a derivative from H2356; double cave town; Choronajim, a place in Moab: - Horonaim.

H2774.full: Of uncertain derivation; Charnepher, an Israelite: - Harnepher.

H2775.full: From an unused root meaning to scrape; the itch; also (perhaps from the mediating idea of H2777) the sun: - itch, sun.

H2776.full: The same as H2775; shining; Cheres, a mount in Palestine: - Heres.

H2777.full: From H2775 (Apparently in the sense of a red tile used for scraping); a potsherd, that is, (by implication) a pottery; the name of a gate at Jerusalem: - east.

H2778.firstSense: betroth, blaspheme, defy, jeopard, rail, reproach, upbraid
H2778.full: A primitive root; to pull off, that is, (by implication) to expose (as by stripping); specifically to betroth (as if a surrender); figuratively to carp at, that is, defame; denominatively (from H2779) to spend the winter: - betroth, blaspheme, defy, jeopard, rail, reproach, upbraid.

H2779.full: From H2778; properly the crop gathered, that is, (by implication) the autumn (and winter) season; figuratively ripeness of age: - cold, winter ([-house]), youth.

H2780.full: From H2778; reproachful; an Israelite: - Hareph.

H2781.full: From H2778; contumely, disgrace, the pudenda: - rebuke, reproach (-fully), shame.

H2782.firstSense: bestir self, decide, decree, determine, maim, move
H2782.full: A prim root; properly to point sharply, that is, (literally) to wound; figuratively to be alert, to decide: - bestir self, decide, decree, determine, maim, move.

H2783.full: (Chaldee) from a root corresponding to H2782 in the sense of vigor; the loin (as the seat of strength): - loin.

H2784.full: Of uncertain derivation; a fetter; figuratively a pain: - band.

H2785.full: From H2782; a sour grape (as sharp in taste): - kernel.

H2786.full: châraq khaw-rak A primitive root; to grate the teeth: - gnash.

H2787.full: A primitive root; to glow, that is, literally (to melt, burn, dry up) or figuratively (to show or incite passion): - be angry, burn, dry, kindle.

H2789.full: A collateral form mediating between H2775 and H2791; a piece of pottery: - earth (-en), (pot-) sherd, + stone.

H2790.firstSense: X altogether, cease, conceal, be deaf, devise, ear, graven, imagine, leave off speaking…
H2790.full: A primitive root; to scratch, that is, (by implication) to engrave, plough; hence (from the use of tools) to fabricate (of any material); figuratively to devise (in a bad sense); hence (from the idea of secrecy) to be silent, to let alone; hence (by implication) to be deaf (as an accompaniment of dumbness): - X altogether, cease, conceal, be deaf, devise, ear, graven, imagine, leave off speaking, hold peace, plow (-er, -man), be quiet, rest, practise secretly, keep silence, be silent, speak not a word, be still, hold tongue, worker.

H2791.full: From H2790; magical craft; also silence: - cunning, secretly.

H2792.full: The same as H2791; Cheresh, a Levite: - Cheresh, a Levite: - Heresh.

H2793.full: From H2790; a forest (perhaps as furnishing the material for fabric): - bough, forest, shroud, wood.

H2794.full: Active participle of H2790; a fabricator or mechanic: - artificer.

H2795.full: chêrêsh khay-rashe From H2790; deaf (whether literal or spiritual): - deaf.

H2796.firstSense: artificer, (+) carpenter, craftsman, engraver, maker, + mason, skilful, (+) smith, work…
H2796.full: From H2790; a fabricator of any material: - artificer, (+) carpenter, craftsman, engraver, maker, + mason, skilful, (+) smith, worker, workman, such as wrought.

H2797.full: khar-shaw' From H2792; magician; Charsha, one of the Nethinim: - Harsha.

H2798.full: Plural of H2796; mechanics, the name of a valley in Jerusalem: - Charashim, craftsmen.

H2799.full: From H2790; mechanical work: - carving, cutting.

H2800.full: The same as H2799; Charosheth, a place in Palestine: - Harosheth.

H2801.full: A primitive root; to engrave: - graven.

H2802.full: From H2801 (but equivalent to H2793); forest; Chereth, a thicket in Palestine: - Hereth.

H2803.firstSense: (make) account (of), conceive, consider, count, cunning (man, work, workman), devise, e…
H2803.full: A primitive root; properly to plait or interpenetrate, that is, (literally) to weave or (generally) to fabricate; figuratively to plot or contrive (usually in a malicious sense); hence (from the mental effort) to think, regard, value, compute: - (make) account (of), conceive, consider, count, cunning (man, work, workman), devise, esteem, find out, forecast, hold, imagine, impute, invent, be like, mean, purpose, reckon (-ing be made), regard, think.

H2804.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H2803; to regard: - repute.

H2805.full: From H2803; a belt or strap (as being interlaced): - curious girdle.

H2806.full: From H2803 and H1777; considerate judge; Chasbaddanah, an Israelite: - Hasbadana.

H2807.full: From H2803; estimation; Chashubah, an Israelite: - Hashubah.

H2808.full: From H2803; properly contrivance; by implication intelligence: - account, device, reason.

H2809.full: The same as H2808; Cheshbon, a place East of the Jordan: - Heshbon.

H2810.full: From H2803; a contrivance, that is, actual (a warlike machine) or mental (a machination): - engine, invention.

H2811.full: From H2803 and H3050; Jah has regarded; Chashabjah, the name of nine Israelites: - Hashabiah.

H2812.full: Feminine of H2808; inventiveness; Chashnah, an Israelite: - Hashabnah.

H2813.full: From H2808 and H3050; thought of Jah; Chashabnejah, the name of two Israelites: - Hashabniah.

H2814.firstSense: hold peace, keep silence, be silent, (be) still
H2814.full: A primitive root; to hush or keep quiet: - hold peace, keep silence, be silent, (be) still.

H2815.full: From H2803; intelligent; Chashshub, the name of two or three Israelites: - Hashub, Hasshub.

H2816.full: (Chaldee) from a root corresponding to H2821; the dark: - darkness.

H2817.full: From H2834; nakedness; Chasupha, one of the Nethinim: - Hashupha, Hasupha.

H2818.full: (Chaldee); a collateral root to one corresponding to H2363 in the sense of readiness; to be necessary (from the idea of convenience) or (transitively) to need: - careful, have need of.

H2819.full: From a root corresponding to H2818; necessity: - be needful.

H2820.firstSense: assuage, X darken, forbear, hinder, hold back, keep (back), punish, refrain, reserve, s…
H2820.full: A prim root; to restrain or (reflexively) refrain; by implication to refuse, spare, preserve; also (by interchange with H2821) to observe: - assuage, X darken, forbear, hinder, hold back, keep (back), punish, refrain, reserve, spare, withhold.

H2821.firstSense: be black, be (make) dark, darken, cause darkness, be dim, hide
H2821.full: A primitive root; to be dark (as withholding light); transitively to darken: - be black, be (make) dark, darken, cause darkness, be dim, hide.

H2822.full: From H2821; the dark; hence (literally) darkness; figuratively misery, destruction, death, ignorance, sorrow, wickedness: - dark (-ness), night, obscurity.

H2823.full: From H2821; dark (figuratively that is, obscure): - mean.

H2825.full: From H2821; darkness; figuratively misery: - darkness.

H2826.full: A primitive root; to make (intransitively be) unsteady, that is, weak: - feeble.

H2827.full: (Chaldee) a root corresponding to H2826; to weaken, that is, crush: - subdue.

H2828.full: From the same as H2831; enriched; Chashum, the name of two or three Israelites: - Hashum.

H2829.full: The same as H2831; opulent; Cheshmon, a place in Palestine: - Heshmon.

H2830.full: Of uncertain derivation; probably bronze or polished spectrum metal: - amber.

H2831.full: From an unused root (probably meaning firm or capacious in resources); apparently wealthy: - princes.

H2832.full: Feminine of H2831; fertile; Chasmonah, a place in the Desert: - Hashmonah.

H2833.full: From an unused root probably meaning to contain or sparkle; perhaps a pocket (as holding the Urim and Thummim), or rich (as containing gems), used only of the gorget of the highpriest: - breastplate.

H2834.firstSense: make bare, clean, discover, draw out, take, uncover
H2834.full: A primitive root; to strip off, that is, generally to make naked (for exertion or in disgrace), to drain away or bail up (a liquid): - make bare, clean, discover, draw out, take, uncover.

H2835.full: From H2834; properly drawn off, that is, separated; hence a small company (as divided from the rest): - little flock.

H2836.firstSense: have a delight, (have a) desire, fillet, long, set (in) love
H2836.full: A primitive root; to cling, that is, join (figuratively) to love, delight in; elliptically (or by interchange for H2820) to deliver: - have a delight, (have a) desire, fillet, long, set (in) love.

H2838.full: Passive participle of H2836; attached, that is, a fence rail or rod connecting the posts or pillars: - fillet.

H2839.full: From H2836; conjoined, that is, a wheel spoke or rod connecting the hub with the rim: - felloe.

H2840.full: From an unused root meaning to bind together; combined, that is, the nave or hub of a wheel (as holding the spokes together): - spoke.

H2841.full: From the same as H2840; properly a combination or gathering, that is, of watery clouds: - dark.

H2842.full: By variation for H7179; dry grass: - chaff.

H2843.full: Patronymic from H2364; a Chushathite or descendant of Chushah: - Hushathite.

H2844.full: chath khath From H2865; concretely crushed; also afraid; abstractly terror: - broken, dismayed, dread, fear.

H2845.full: chêth khayth From H2865; terror; Cheth, an aboriginal Canaanite: - Heth.

H2846.full: A primitive root; to lay hold of; especially to pick up fire: - heap, take (away).

H2848.full: From H2853; swathed, that is, a bandage: - roller.

H2850.full: Patronymic from H2845; a Chittite, or descendant of Cheth: - Hittite, Hittites.

H2852.full: A primitive root; properly to cut off, that is, (figuratively) to decree: - determine.

H2853.full: A primitive root; to swathe: - X at all, swaddle.

H2854.full: From H2853; a swathing cloth (figuratively): - swaddling band.

H2855.full: From H2853; enswathed; Chethlon, a place in Palestine: - Hethlon.

H2856.firstSense: make an end, mark, seal (up), stop
H2856.full: A primitive root; to close up; especially to seal: - make an end, mark, seal (up), stop.

H2857.full: (Chaldee); a root corresponding to H2856; to seal: - seal.

H2858.full: chôthemeth kho-the-meth Feminine active participle of H2856; a seal: - signet.

H2859.firstSense: join in affinity, father in law, make marriages, mother in law, son in law
H2859.full: A primitive root; to give (a daughter) away in marriage; hence (generally) to contract affinity by marriage: - join in affinity, father in law, make marriages, mother in law, son in law.

H2860.full: From H2859; a relative by marriage (especially through the bride); figuratively a circumcised child (as a species of religious espousal): - bridegroom, husband, son in law.

H2862.full: A primitive root; to clutch: - take away.

H2863.full: From H2862; properly rapine; figuratively robbery: - prey.

H2864.full: A primitive root; to force a passage, as by burglary; figuratively with oars: - dig (through), row.

H2865.firstSense: abolish, affright, be (make) afraid, amaze, beat down, discourage, (cause to) dismay, g…
H2865.full: A primitive root; properly to prostrate; hence to break down, either (literally) by violence, or (figuratively) by confusion and fear: - abolish, affright, be (make) afraid, amaze, beat down, discourage, (cause to) dismay, go down, scare, terrify.

H2867.full: The same as H2866; Chathath, an Israelite: - Hathath.

H2868.full: (Chaldee); a primitive root; to rejoice: - be glad.

H2869.full: (Chaldee); from H2868; the same as H2896; good: - fine, good.

H2870.full: From H2895 and H410; pleasing (to) God; Tabeel, the name of a Syrian and of a Persian: - Tabeal, Tabeel.

H2871.full: Passive participle of H2881; properly dyed, that is, a turban (probably as of colored stuff): - dyed attire.

H2872.full: From an unused root meaning to pile up; properly accumulated; that is, (by implication) a summit: - middle, midst.

H2873.full: A primitive root; to slaughter (animals or men): - kill, (make) slaughter, slay.

H2874.firstSense: X beast, slaughter, X slay, X sore
H2874.full: From H2873; properly something slaughtered; hence a beast (or meat, as butchered); abstractly butchery (or concretely a place of slaughter): - X beast, slaughter, X slay, X sore.

H2875.full: The same as H2874; massacre; Tebach, the name of a Mesopotamian and of an Israelite: - Tebah.

H2876.full: From H2873; properly a butcher; hence a lifeguardsman (because acting as executioner); also a cook (as usually slaughtering the animal for food): - cook, guard.

H2877.full: (Chaldee); the same as H2876; a lifeguardsman: - guard.

H2878.full: Feminine of H2874 and meaning the same: - flesh, slaughter.

H2879.full: Feminine of H2876; a female cook: - cook.

H2880.full: From H2878; slaughter; Tibchath, a place in Syria: - Tibhath.

H2881.full: A primitive root; to dip: - dip, plunge.

H2882.full: From H2881 and H3050; Jah has dipped; Tebaljah, an Israelite: - Tebaliah.

H2883.full: A primitive root; to sink: - drown, fasten, settle, sink.

H2884.full: Plural of H2885; rings; Tabbaoth, one of the Nethinim: - Tabbaoth.

H2885.full: From H2883; properly a seal (as sunk into the wax), that is, signet (for sealing); hence (generically) a ring of any kind: - ring.

H2886.full: From H2895 and H7417; pleasing (to) Rimmon; Tabrimmon, a Syrian: - Tabrimmon.

H2887.full: Probably of foreign derivation; Tebeth, the tenth Hebrew month: - Tebeth.

H2888.full: Of uncertain derivation; Tabbath, a place East of the Jordan: - Tabbath.

H2889.full: From H2891; pure (in a physical, chemical, ceremonial or moral sense): - clean, fair, pure (-ness).

H2891.firstSense: be (make, make self, pronounce) clean, cleanse (self), purge, purify (-ier, self)
H2891.full: A primitive root; properly to be bright; that is, (by implication) to be pure (physically sound, clear, unadulterated; Levitically uncontaminated; morally innocent or holy): - be (make, make self, pronounce) clean, cleanse (self), purge, purify (-ier, self).

H2892.full: From H2891; literally brightness; ceremonially purification: - clearness, glory, purifying.

H2893.full: Feminine of H2892; ceremonial purification; moral purity: - X is cleansed, cleansing, purification (-fying).

H2894.full: A primitive root; to sweep away: - sweep.

H2895.firstSense: be (do) better, cheer, be (do, seem) good, (make), goodly, X please, (be, do, go, play)…
H2895.full: A primitive root, to be (transitively do or make) good (or well) in the widest sense: - be (do) better, cheer, be (do, seem) good, (make), goodly, X please, (be, do, go, play) well.

H2896.firstSense: beautiful, best, better, bountiful, cheerful, at ease, X fair (word), (be in) favour, f…
H2896.full: From H2895; good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well): - beautiful, best, better, bountiful, cheerful, at ease, X fair (word), (be in) favour, fine, glad, good (deed, -lier, liest, -ly, -ness, -s), graciously, joyful, kindly, kindness, liketh (best), loving, merry, X most, pleasant, + pleaseth, pleasure, precious, prosperity, ready, sweet, wealth, welfare, (be) well ([-favoured]).

H2897.full: The same as H2896; good; Tob, a region apparently East of the Jordan: - Tob.

H2898.firstSense: fair, gladness, good (-ness, thing, -s), joy, go well with
H2898.full: From H2895; good (as a noun), in the widest sense, especially goodness (superlatively concrete, the best), beauty, gladness, welfare: - fair, gladness, good (-ness, thing, -s), joy, go well with.

H2899.full: From H2896 and H138; pleasing (to) Adonijah; Tob-Adonijah, an Israelite: - Tob-adonijah.

H2900.full: From H2896 and H3050; goodness of Jehovah; Tobijah, the name of three Israelites and of one Samaritan: - Tobiah, Tobijah.

H2901.full: A primitive root; to spin: - spin.

H2902.full: A primitive root; to smear, especially with lime: - daub, overlay, plaister, smut.

H2903.full: From an unused root meaning to go around or bind; a fillet for the forehead: - frontlet.

H2904.firstSense: carry away, (utterly) cast (down, forth, out), send out
H2904.full: A primitive root; to pitch over or reel; hence (transitively) to cast down or out: - carry away, (utterly) cast (down, forth, out), send out.

H2905.full: From an unused root meaning to range in a regular manner; a row; hence a wall: - row.

H2906.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H6697; a rock or hill: - mountain.

H2907.full: A primitive root; to pounce as a bird of prey: - haste.

H2908.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H2901; hunger (as twisting): - fasting.

H2909.full: A primitive root; to stretch a bow, as an archer: - [bow-] shot.

H2910.full: From H2909 (or H2902) in the sense of overlaying; (in the plural only) the kidneys (as being covered); hence (figuratively) the inmost thought: - inward parts.

H2911.full: From H2912; a hand mill; hence a millstone: - to grind.

H2912.full: A primitive root; to grind meal; hence to be a concubine (that being their employment): - grind (-er).

H2913.full: From H2912; a hand mill; hence (figuratively) chewing: - grinding.

H2914.full: From an unused root meaning to burn; a boil or ulcer (from the inflammation), especially a tumor in the anus or pudenda (the piles): - emerod.

H2915.full: From (the equivalent of) H2902; mortar or plaster: - daubing.

H2916.full: From an unused root meaning apparently to be sticky (rather perhaps a denominative from H2894, through the idea of dirt to be swept away); mud or clay; figuratively calamity: - clay, dirt, mire.

H2917.full: (Chaldee); perhaps by interchange for a word corresponding to H2916; clay: - miry.

H2918.full: Feminine of (an equivalent to) H2905; a wall; hence a fortress or a hamlet: - (goodly) castle, habitation, palace, row.

H2919.full: ṭal tal From H2926; dew (as covering vegetation): - dew.

H2920.full: ṭal tal (Chaldee); the same as H2919: - dew.

H2921.full: A primitive root; properly to cover with pieces; that is, (by implication) to spot or variegate (as tapestry): - clouted, with divers colours, spotted.

H2922.full: Apparently from H2921 in the (original) sense of covering (for protection); a lamb (compare H2924): - lamb.

H2923.full: From the plural of H2922; lambs; Telaim, a place in Palestine: - Telaim.

H2924.full: By variation for H2922; a lamb: - lamb.

H2925.full: From H2904; overthrow or rejection: - captivity.

H2926.full: A primitive root; properly to strew over, that is, (by implication) to cover in or plate (with beams): - cover.

H2927.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H2926; to cover with shade: - have a shadow.

H2928.full: From an unused root meaning to break up or treat violently; oppression; Telem, the name of a place in Idumaea, also of a temple doorkeeper: - Telem.

H2929.full: From the same as H2728; oppressive; Talmon, a temple doorkeeper: - Talmon.

H2930.firstSense: defile (self), pollute (self), be (make, make self, pronounce) unclean, X utterly
H2930.full: A primitive root; to be foul, especially in a ceremonial or moral sense (contaminated): - defile (self), pollute (self), be (make, make self, pronounce) unclean, X utterly.

H2931.full: From H2930; foul in a religious sense: - defiled, + infamous, polluted (-tion), unclean.

H2932.full: From H2930; religious impurity: - filthiness, unclean (-ness).

H2933.full: A collateral form of H2930; to be impure in a religious sense: - be defiled, be reputed vile.

H2934.full: A primitive root; to hide (by covering over): - hide, lay privily, in secret.

H2935.full: teh'-neh From an unused root probably meaning to weave; a basket (of interlaced osiers): - basket.

H2936.full: A primitive root; to soil: - defile.

H2937.full: A primitive root; to wander; causatively to lead astray: - seduce.

H2938.full: A primitive root; to taste; figuratively to perceive: - X but, perceive, taste.

H2939.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H2938; to taste; causatively to feed: - make to eat, feed.

H2940.firstSense: advice, behaviour, decree, discretion, judgment, reason, taste, understanding
H2940.full: From H2938; properly a taste, that is, (figuratively) perception; by implication intelligence; transitively a mandate: - advice, behaviour, decree, discretion, judgment, reason, taste, understanding.

H2941.firstSense: account, X to be commanded, commandment, matter
H2941.full: (Chaldee); from H2939; properly a taste, that is, (as in H2940) a judicial sentence: - account, X to be commanded, commandment, matter.

H2942.firstSense: + chancellor, + command, commandment, decree, + regard, taste, wisdom
H2942.full: (Chaldee); from H2939, and equivalent to H2941; properly flavor; figuratively judgment (both subjectively and objectively); hence account (both subjectively and objectively): - + chancellor, + command, commandment, decree, + regard, taste, wisdom.

H2943.full: A primitive root; to load a beast: - lade.

H2944.full: A primitive root; to stab: - thrust through.

H2945.full: ṭaph taf From H2952 (perhaps referring to the tripping gait of children); a family (mostly used collectively in the singular): - (little) children (ones), families.

H2946.full: A primitive root; to flatten out or extend (as a tent); figuratively to nurse a child (as promotive of growth); or perhaps a denominative from H2947, from dandling on the palms: - span, swaddle.

H2947.full: From H2946; a spread of the hand, that is, a palm breadth (not "span" of the fingers); architecturally a corbel (as a supporting palm): - coping, hand-breadth.

H2948.full: From H2946 (the same as H2947): - hand-breadth (broad).

H2950.full: A primitive root; properly to stick on as a patch; figuratively to impute falsely: - forge (-r), sew up.

H2951.full: Of foreign derivation; a military governor: - captain.

H2952.full: A primitive root; apparently to trip (with short steps) coquettishly: - mince.

H2953.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H6852, and meaning the same as H6856; a finger nail; also a hoof or claw: - nail.

H2954.full: A primitive root; properly apparently to be thick; figuratively to be stupid: - be fat.

H2955.full: Probably from H5197; a dropping (of ointment); Taphath, an Israelitess: - Taphath.

H2956.full: A primitive root; to drive on; figuratively to follow close: - continual.

H2957.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H2956; to expel: - drive.

H2958.full: A variation of H2962; not yet: - before.

H2959.full: A primitive root; to overburden: - weary.

H2960.full: From H2959; a burden: - cumbrance, trouble.

H2961.full: From an unused root apparently meaning to be moist; properly dripping; hence fresh (that is, recently made such): - new, putrefying.

H2962.full: From an unused root apparently meaning to interrupt or suspend; properly non-occurrence; used adverbially not yet or before: - before, ere, not yet.

H2963.firstSense: catch, X without doubt, feed, ravin, rend in pieces, X surely, tear (in pieces)
H2963.full: A primitive root; to pluck off or pull to pieces; causatively to supply with food (as in morsels): - catch, X without doubt, feed, ravin, rend in pieces, X surely, tear (in pieces).

H2964.full: From H2963; something torn, that is, a fragment, for example a fresh leaf, prey, food: - leaf, meat, prey, spoil.

H2965.full: From H2963; recently torn off, that is, fresh: - pluckt off.

H2966.firstSense: ravin, (that which was) torn (of beasts, in pieces)
H2966.full: Feminine (collectively) of H2964; prey, that is, flocks devoured by animals: - ravin, (that which was) torn (of beasts, in pieces).

H2967.full: (Chaldee); from a name of foreign derivation; a Tarpelite (collectively) or inhabitant of Tarpel, a place in Assyria: - Tarpelites.

H2968.full: yaw-ab' A primitive root; to desire: - long.

H2969.full: A primitive root; to be suitable: - appertain.

H2970.full: yah-az-an-yaw', yah-az-an-yaw'-hoo From H238 and H3050; heard of Jah; Jaazanjah, the name of four Israelites: - Jaazaniah. Compare H3153.

H2971.full: From H215; enlightener; Jair, the name of four Israelites: - Jair.

H2972.full: yaw-ee-ree' Patronymic from H2971; a Jairite or descendant of Jair: - Jairite.

H2973.full: yaw-al' A primitive root; properly to be slack, that is, (figuratively) to be foolish: - dote, be (become, do) foolish (-ly).

H2974.firstSense: assay, begin, be content, please, take upon, X willingly, would
H2974.full: yaw-al' A primitive root (probably rather the same as H2973 through the idea of mental weakness); properly to yield, especially assent; hence (positively) to undertake as an act of volition: - assay, begin, be content, please, take upon, X willingly, would.

H2975.full: yeh-ore' Of Egyptian origin; a channel, for example a fosse, canal, shaft; specifically the Nile, as the one river of Egypt, including its collateral trenches; also the Tigris, as the main river of Assyria: - brook, flood, river, stream.

H2976.firstSense: (cause to) despair, one that is desperate, be no hope
H2976.full: yaw-ash' A primitive root; to desist, that is, (figuratively) to despond: - (cause to) despair, one that is desperate, be no hope.

H2977.full: From the same root as H803 and H3050; founded of Jah; Joshijah, the name of two Israelites: - Josiah.

H2978.full: yeh-ee-thone' From H857; an entry: - entrance.

H2979.full: yeh-aw-ther-ah'ee From the same as H871; stepping; Jeatherai, an Israelite: - Jeaterai.

H2980.full: yâbab yaw-bab A primitive root; to bawl: - cry out.

H2981.full: From H2986; produce, that is, a crop or (figuratively) wealth: - fruit, increase.

H2982.full: From H947; trodden, that is, threshing place; Jebus, the aboriginal name of Jerusalem: - Jebus.

H2983.full: Patrial from H2982; a Jebusite or inhabitant of Jebus: - Jebusite(-s).

H2984.full: From H977; choice; Jibchar, an Israelite: - Ibhar.

H2985.full: From H995; intelligent; Jabin, the name of two Canaanitish kings: - Jabin.

H2986.full: A primitive root; properly to flow; causatively to bring (especially with pomp): - bring (forth), carry, lead (forth).

H2987.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H2986; to bring: - bring, carry.

H2988.full: From H2986; a stream: - [water-] course, stream.

H2989.full: The same as H2988; Jabal, an antediluvian: - Jabal.

H2990.full: From H2986; having running sores: - wen.

H2991.full: From H1104 and H5971; devouring people; Jibleam, a place in Palestine: - Ibleam.

H2992.firstSense: perform the duty of a husband's brother, marry
H2992.full: A primitive root of doubtful meaning; used only as a denominative from H2993; to marry a (deceased) brother's widow: - perform the duty of a husband's brother, marry.

H2993.full: From (the original of) H2992; a brother-in-law: - husband'sbrother.

H2994.full: Feminine participle of H2992; a sister-in-law: - brother's wife, sister in law.

H2995.full: yab-neh-ale' From H1129 and H410; built of God; Jabneel, the name of two places in Palestine: - Jabneel.

H2996.full: From H1129; a building; Jabneh, a place in Palestine: - Jabneh.

H2997.full: From H1129 and H3050; built of Jah; Jibnejah, an Israelite: - Ibneiah.

H2998.full: From H1129 and H3050; building of Jah; Jibnijah, an Israelite: - Ibnijah.

H2999.full: Probably from H1238; pouring forth; Jabbok, a river East of the Jordan: - Jabbok.

H3000.full: From H1288 and H3050; blessed of Jah; Jeberekjah, an Israelite: - Jeberechiah.

H3001.firstSense: be ashamed, clean, be confounded, (make) dry (up), (do) shame (-fully), X utterly, with…
H3001.full: A primitive root; to be ashamed, confused or disappointed; also (as failing) to dry up (as water) or wither (as herbage): - be ashamed, clean, be confounded, (make) dry (up), (do) shame (-fully), X utterly, wither (away).

H3003.full: The same as H3002. (Also, often with the addition of H1568, i.e. Jabesh of Gilad); Jabesh, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine: - Jabesh ([-Gilead]).

H3004.full: From H3001; dry ground: - dry (ground, land).

H3005.full: From the same as H1314; fragrant; Jibsam, an Israelite: - Jibsam.

H3006.full: A variation of H3004; dry ground: - dry land.

H3007.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H3006; dry land: - earth.

H3008.full: yig-awl' From H1350; avenger; Jigal, the name of three Israelite: - Igal, Igeal.

H3009.full: A primitive root; to dig or plough: - husbandman.

H3010.full: From H3009; a ploughed field: - field.

H3011.full: Feminine from H1361; hillock; Jogbehah, a place East of the Jordan: - Jogbehah.

H3012.full: From H1431 and H3050; magnified of Jah; Jigdaljah, an Israelite: - Igdaliah.

H3013.firstSense: afflict, cause grief, grieve, sorrowful, vex
H3013.full: A primitive root; to grieve: - afflict, cause grief, grieve, sorrowful, vex.

H3014.full: A primitive root (probably rather the same as H3013 through the common idea of dissatisfaction); to push away: - be removed.

H3017.full: Probably from H1481; a lodging; Jagur, a place in Palestine: - Jagur.

H3018.full: From H3021; toil; hence a work, produce, property (as the result of labor): - labour, work.

H3020.full: From H1540; exiled; Jogli, an Israelite: - Jogli.

H3021.full: A primitive root; properly to gasp; hence to be exhausted, to tire, to toil: - faint, (make to) labour, (be) weary.

H3022.full: From H3021; earnings (as the product of toil): - that which he laboured for.

H3023.full: From H3021; tired; hence (transitively) tiresome: - full of labour, weary.

H3025.full: A primitive root; to fear: - be afraid, fear.

H3026.full: yegar' sah-had-oo-thaw' (Chaldee); from a word derived from an unused root (meaning to gather) and a derivative of a root corresponding to H7717; heap of the testimony; Jegar-Sahadutha, a cairn East of the Jordan: - Jegar-Sahadutha.

H3027.firstSense: (+ be) able, X about, + armholes, at, axletree, because of, beside, border, X bounty, +…
H3027.full: yâd yawd A primitive word; a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.), in distinction from H3709, the closed one); used (as noun, adverb, etc.) in a great variety of applications, both literally and figuratively, both proximate and remote: - (+ be) able, X about, + armholes, at, axletree, because of, beside, border, X bounty, + broad, [broken-] handed, X by, charge, coast, + consecrate, + creditor, custody, debt, dominion, X enough, + fellowship, force, X from, hand [-staves, -y work], X he, himself, X in, labour, + large, ledge, [left-] handed, means, X mine, ministry, near, X of, X order, ordinance, X our, parts, pain, power, X presumptuously, service, side, sore, state, stay, draw with strength, stroke, + swear, terror, X thee, X by them, X them-selves, X thine own, X thou, through, X throwing, + thumb, times, X to, X under, X us, X wait on, [way-] side, where, + wide, X with (him, me, you), work, + yield, X your-selves.

H3028.full: yad yad (Chaldee); corresponding to H3027: - hand, power.

H3029.full: yed-aw' (Chaldee); corresponding to H3034; to praise: - (give) thank (-s).

H3030.full: yid-al-aw' Of uncertain derivation Jidalah, a place in Palestine: - Idalah.

H3031.full: From the same as H1706; perhaps honeyed; Jidbash, an Israelite: - Idbash.

H3032.full: A primitive root; properly to handle (compare H3034), that is, to throw, for example lots: - cast.

H3033.full: From H3039; properly affection; concretely a darling object: - dearly beloved.

H3034.full: A primitive root; used only as denominative from H3027; literally to use (that is, hold out) the hand; physically to throw (a stone, an arrow) at or away; especially to revere or worship (with extended hands); intensively to bemoan (by wringing the hands): - cast (out), (make) confess (-ion), praise, shoot, (give) thank (-ful, -s, -sgiving).

H3035.full: From H3034; praised; Jiddo, an Israelite: - Iddo.

H3036.full: From H3034; thankful; Jadon, an Israelite: - Jadon.

H3037.full: From H3045; knowing; Jaddua, the name of two Israelite: - Jaddua.

H3038.full: Probably from H3034; laudatory; Jeduthun, an Israelite: - Jeduthun.

H3039.full: From the same as H1730; loved: - amiable, (well-) beloved, loves.

H3040.full: Feminine of H3039; beloved; Jedidah, an Israelitess: - Jedidah.

H3041.full: From H3089 and H3050; beloved of Jah; Jedidejah, a name of Solomon: - Jedidiah.

H3042.full: From H3034 and H3050; praised of Jah; Jedajah, the name of two Israelites: - Jedaiah.

H3043.full: From H3045 and H410; knowing God; Jediael, the name of three Israelites: - Jediael.

H3044.full: From H1811; tearful; Jidlaph, a Mesopotamian: - Jidlaph.

H3045.firstSense: acknowledge, acquaintance (-ted with), advise, answer, appoint, assuredly, be aware, [u…
