H3045.full: A primitive root; to know (properly to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively instruction, designation, punishment, etc.): - acknowledge, acquaintance (-ted with), advise, answer, appoint, assuredly, be aware, [un-] awares, can [-not], certainly, for a certainty, comprehend, consider, X could they, cunning, declare, be diligent, (can, cause to) discern, discover, endued with, familiar friend, famous, feel, can have, be [ig-] norant, instruct, kinsfolk, kinsman, (cause to, let, make) know, (come to give, have, take) knowledge, have [knowledge], (be, make, make to be, make self) known, + be learned, + lie by man, mark, perceive, privy to, X prognosticator, regard, have respect, skilful, shew, can (man of) skill, be sure, of a surety, teach, (can) tell, understand, have [understanding], X will be, wist, wit, wot.

H3046.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H3045: - certify, know, make known, teach.

H3047.full: From H3045; knowing; Jada, an Israelite: - Jada.

H3048.full: From H3045 and H3050; Jah has known; Jedajah, the name of two Israelites: - Jedaiah.

H3049.full: From H3045; properly a knowing one; specifically a conjurer; (by implication) a ghost: - wizard.

H3050.full: yâhh yaw Contracted for H3068, and meaning the same; Jah, the sacred name: - Jah, the Lord, most vehement. Cp. names in "-iah," "-jah."

H3051.firstSense: ascribe, bring, come on, give, go, set, take
H3051.full: A primitive root; to give (whether literally or figuratively); generally to put; imperatively (reflexively) come: - ascribe, bring, come on, give, go, set, take.

H3052.firstSense: deliver, give, lay, + prolong, pay, yield
H3052.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H3051: - deliver, give, lay, + prolong, pay, yield.

H3053.full: From H3051; properly what is given (by Providence), that is, a lot: - burden.

H3054.full: Denominative from a form corresponding to H3061; to Judaize, that is, become Jewish: - become Jews.

H3055.full: A briefer form of one corresponding to H3061; Jehud, a place in Palestine: - Jehud.

H3056.full: Perhaps from a form corresponding to H3061; Judaistic; Jehdai, an Israelite: - Jehdai.

H3057.full: Feminine of H3064; Jehudijah, a Jewess: - Jehudijah.

H3058.full: From H3068 and H1931; Jehovah (is) He; Jehu, the name of five Israelites: - Jehu.

H3059.full: yeh-ho-aw-khawz' From H3068 and H270; Jehovah seized; Jehoachaz, the name of three Israelites: - Jehoahaz. Compare H3099.

H3060.full: yeh-ho-awsh' From H3068 and (perhaps) H784; Jehovah fired; Jehoash, the name of two Israelite kings: - Jehoash Compare H3101.

H3061.full: (Chaldee); contracted from a form. corresponding to H3063; properly Judah, hence Judaea: - Jewry, Judah, Judea.

H3062.full: (Chaldee); patrial from H3061; a Jehudaite (or Judaite), that is, Jew: - Jew.

H3063.full: From H3034; celebrated; Jehudah (or Judah), the name of five Israelites; also of the tribe descended from the first, and of its territory: - Judah.

H3064.full: Patronymic from H3063; a Jehudite (that is, Judaite or Jew), or descendant of Jehudah (that is, Judah): - Jew.

H3065.full: The same as H3064; Jehudi, an Israelite: - Jehudi.

H3066.full: Feminine of H3064; the Jewish (used adverbially) language: - in the Jews' language.

H3067.full: The same as H3066; Jewess; Jehudith, a Canaanitess: - Judith.

H3068.full: From H1961; (the) self Existent or eternal; Jehovah, Jewish national name of God: - Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050, H3069.

H3069.full: A variation of H3068 (used after H136, and pronounced by Jews as H430, in order to prevent the repetition of the same sound, since they elsewhere pronounce H3068 as H136): - God.

H3070.full: yeh-ho-vaw' yir-eh' From H3068 and H7200; Jehovah will see (to it); Jehovah-Jireh, a symbolical name for Mt. Moriah: - Jehovah-jireh.

H3071.full: From H3068 and H5251 with pronominal suffix.; Jehovah (is) my banner; Jehovah-Nissi, a symbolical name of an altar in the Desert: - Jehovah-nissi.

H3072.full: From H3068 and H6664 with pronominal suffix.; Jehovah (is) our right; Jehovah-Tsidkenu, a symbolical epithet of the Messiah and of Jerusalem: - the Lord our righteousness.

H3073.full: From H3068 and H7965; Jehovah (is) peace; Jehovah-Shalom, a symbolical name of an altar in Palestine: - Jehovah-shalom.

H3074.full: From H3068 and H8038 with directive enclitic; Jehovah (is) thither; Jehovah-Shammah, a symbolical title of Jerusalem: - Jehovah-shammah.

H3075.full: From H3068 and H2064; Jehovah-endowed; Jehozabad, the name of three Israelites: - Jehozabad. Compare H3107.

H3076.full: From H3068 and H2603; Jehovah-favored; Jehochanan, the name of eight Israelites: - Jehohanan, Johanan. Compare H3110.

H3077.full: From H3068 and H3045; Jehovah-known; Jehojada, the name of three Israelites: - Jehoiada. Compare H3111.

H3078.full: From H3068 and H3559; Jehovah will establish; Jehojakin, a Jewish king: - Jehoiachin. Compare H3112.

H3079.full: From H3068 abbreviated and H6965; Jehovah will raise; Jehojakim, a Jewish king: - Jehoiakim. Compare H3113.

H3080.full: From H3068 and H7378; Jehovah will contend; Jehojarib, the name of two Israelites: - Jehoiarib. Compare H3114.

H3081.full: From H3201; potent; Jehukal, an Israelite: - Jehucal. Compare H3116.

H3082.full: From H3068 and H5068; Jehovah-largessed; Jehonadab, the name of an Israelite and of an Arab: - Jehonadab, Jonadab. Compare H3122.

H3083.full: From H3068 and H5414; Jehovah-given; Jehonathan, the name of four Israelites: - Jonathan. Compare H3129.

H3084.full: A fuller form of H3130; Jehoseph (that is, Joseph), a son of Jacob: - Joseph.

H3085.full: From H3068 and H5710; Jehovah-adorned; Jehoaddah, an Israelite: - Jehoada.

H3086.full: From H3068 and H5727; Jehovah-pleased; Jehoaddin or Jehoaddan, an Israelitess: - Jehoaddan.

H3087.full: From H3068 and H6663; Jehovah-righted; Jehotsadak, an Israelite: - Jehozadek, Josedech. Compare H3136.

H3088.full: From H3068 and H7311; Jehovah-raised; Jehoram, the name of a Syrian and of three Israelites: - Jehoram, Joram. Compare H3141.

H3089.full: From H3068 and H7650; Jehovah-sworn; Jehosheba, an Israelitess: - Jehosheba. Compare H3090.

H3090.full: A form of H3089; Jehoshabath, an Israelitess: - Jehoshabeath.

H3091.full: From H3068 and H3467; Jehovah-saved; Jehoshua (that is, Joshua), the Jewish leader: - Jehoshua, Jehoshuah, Joshua. Compare H1954, H3442.

H3092.full: From H3068 and H8199; Jehovah-judged; Jehoshaphat, the name of six Israelites; also of a valley near Jerusalem : - Jehoshaphat. Compare H3146.

H3093.full: Probably from the same as H2022; elated; hence arrogant: - haughty, proud.

H3094.full: yeh-hal-lel-ale' From H1984 and H410; praising God; Jehallelel, the name of two Israelites: - Jehaleleel, Jehalelel.

H3095.full: From H1986 (in the sense of hardness); a precious stone, probably onyx: - diamond.

H3096.full: From an unused root meaning to stamp; perhaps threshing floor; Jahats or Jahtsah, a place East of the Jordan: - Jahaz, Jahazah, Jahzah.

H3097.full: From H3068 and H1; Jehovah-fathered; Joab, the name of three Israelites: - Joab.

H3098.full: From H3068 and H251; Jehovah-brothered; Joach, the name of four Israelites: - Joah.

H3099.full: A form of H3059; Joachaz, the name of two Israelites: - Jehoahaz, Joahaz.

H3100.full: From H3068 and H410; Jehovah (is his) God; Joel, the name of twelve Israelites: - Joel.

H3101.full: A form of H3060; Joash, the name of six Israelites: - Joash.

H3102.full: yôb yobe Perhaps a form of H3103, but more probably by erroneous transcription for H3437; Job, an Israelite: - Job.

H3103.full: From H2980; howler; Jobab, the name of two Israelites and of three foreigners: - Jobab.

H3104.full: Apparently from H2986; the blast of a horn (from its continuous sound); specifically the signal of the silver trumpets; hence the instrument itself and the festival thus introduced: - jubile, ram's horn, trumpet.

H3106.full: From H2986; stream; Jubal, an antediluvian: - Jubal.

H3107.full: A form of H3075; Jozabad, the name of ten Israelites: - Josabad, Jozabad.

H3108.full: From H3068 and H2142; Jehovah-remembered; Jozacar, an Israelite: - Jozacar.

H3109.full: Probably from H3068 and a variation of H2421; Jehovah-revived; Jocha, the name of two Israelites: - Joha.

H3110.full: A form of H3076; Jochanan, the name of nine Israelites: - Johanan.

H3111.full: A form of H3077; Jojada, the name of two Israelites: - Jehoiada, Joiada.

H3112.full: A form of H3078; Jojakin, an Israelite king: - Jehoiachin.

H3113.full: A form of H3079; Jojakim, an Israelite: - Joiakim. Compare H3137.

H3114.full: A form of H3080; Jojarib, the name of four Israelites: - Joiarib.

H3115.full: From H3068 contracted and H3513; Jehovah-gloried; Jokebed, the mother of Moses: - Jochebed.

H3116.full: A form of H3081; Jukal, an Israelite: - Jucal.

H3117.firstSense: age, + always, + chronicles, continually (-ance), daily, ([birth-], each, to) day, (now…
H3117.full: yôm yome From an unused root meaning to be hot; a day (as the warm hours), whether literally (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figuratively (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverbially): - age, + always, + chronicles, continually (-ance), daily, ([birth-], each, to) day, (now a, two) days (agone), + elder, X end, + evening, + (for) ever (-lasting, -more), X full, life, as (so) long as (. . . live), (even) now, + old, + outlived, + perpetually, presently, + remaineth, X required, season, X since, space, then, (process of) time, + as at other times, + in trouble, weather, (as) when, (a, the, within a) while (that), X whole (+ age), (full) year (-ly), + younger.

H3118.full: yôm yome (Chaldee); corresponding to H3117; a day: - day (by day), time.

H3119.full: From H3117; daily: - daily, (by, in the) day (-time).

H3120.full: Probably from the same as H3196; effervescing (that is, hot and active); Javan, the name of a son of Joktan, and of the race (Ionians, that is, Greeks) descended from him, with their territory; also of a place in Arabia: - Javan.

H3121.full: From the same as H3196; properly dregs (as effervescing); hence mud: - mire, miry.

H3122.full: A form of H3082; Jonadab, the name of an Israelite and of a Rechabite: - Jonadab.

H3123.full: Probably from the same as H3196; a dove (apparently from the warmth of their mating): - dove, pigeon.

H3124.full: The same as H3123; Jonah, an Israelite: - Jonah.

H3125.full: Patronymic from H3121; a Jevanite, or descendant of Javan: - Grecian.

H3126.full: Active participle of H3243; a sucker; hence a twig (of a tree felled and sprouting): - tender plant.

H3127.full: Feminine of H3126; a sprout: - (tender) branch, young twig.

H3128.full: yo-nath' ay'-lem rekh-o-keem' From H3123 and H482 and the plural of H7350; dove of (the) silence (that is, dumb Israel) of (that is, among) distances (that is, strangers); the title of a ditty (used for a name of its melody): - Jonath-elem-rechokim.

H3129.full: A form of H3083; Jonathan, the name of ten Israelites: - Jonathan.

H3130.full: Future of H3254; let him add (or perhaps simply active participle adding); Joseph, the name of seven Israelites: - Joseph. Compare H3084.

H3131.full: From active participle of H3254 and H3050; Jah (is) adding; Josiphjah, an Israelite: - Josiphiah.

H3132.full: Perhaps feminine active participle of H3276; furthermore; Joelah, an Israelite: - Joelah.

H3133.full: Apparently active participle of H3259; appointer; Joed, an Israelite: - Joed.

H3134.full: From H3068 and H5828; Jehovah (is his) help; Joezer, an Israelite: - Joezer.

H3135.full: From H3068 and H5789; Jehovah-hastened; Joash, the name of two Israelites: - Joash.

H3136.full: A form of H3087; Jotsadak, an Israelite: - Jozadak.

H3137.full: A form of H3113; Jokim, an Israelite: - Jokim.

H3138.full: Active participle of H3384; sprinkling; hence a sprinkling (or autumnal showers): - first rain, former [rain].

H3139.full: From H3384; rainy; Jorah, an Israelite: - Jorah.

H3140.full: From H3384; rainy; Jorai, an Israelite: - Jorai.

H3141.full: A form of H3088; Joram, the name of three Israelites and one Syrian: - Joram.

H3142.full: From H7725 and H2617; kindness will be returned; Jushab-Chesed, an Israelites: - Jushab-heshed.

H3143.full: From H3427 and H3050; Jehovah will cause to dwell; Joshibjah, an Israelite: - Josibiah.

H3144.full: Probably a form of H3145; Joshah, an Israelite: - Joshah.

H3145.full: From H3068 and H7737; Jehovah-set; Joshavjah, an Israelite: - Joshaviah. Compare H3144.

H3146.full: A form of H3092; Joshaphat, an Israelite: - Joshaphat.

H3147.full: From H3068 and H8535; Jehovah (is) perfect; Jotham, the name of three Israelites: - Jotham.

H3148.full: Active participle of H8498; properly redundant; hence over and above, as adjective, noun, adverb or conjugation: - better, more (-over), over, profit.

H3149.full: yez-av-ale' From an unused root (meaning to sprinkle) and H410; sprinkled of God; Jezavel, an Israelite: - Jeziel [from the margin].

H3150.full: From the same as the first part of H3149 and H3050; sprinkled of Jah; Jizzijah, an Israelite: - Jeziah.

H3151.full: From the same as H2123; he will make prominent; Jaziz, an Israelite: - Jaziz.

H3152.full: yiz-lee-aw' Perhaps from an unused root (meaning to draw up); he will draw out; Jizliah, an Israelite: - Jezliah.

H3153.full: Probably for H2970; Jezanjah, an Israelite: - Jezaniah.

H3154.full: From an unused root mean to ooze; sweat, that is, (by implication) a sweating dress: - any thing that causeth sweat.

H3155.full: A variation for H250; a Jizrach (that is, Ezrachite or Zarchite) or descendant of Zerach: - Izrahite.

H3156.full: From H2224 and H3050; Jah will shine; Jizrachjah, the name of two Israelites: - Izrahiah, Jezrahiah.

H3157.full: yiz-reh-ale' From H2232 and H410; God will sow; Jizreel, the name of two places in Palestine and of two Israelites: - Jezreel.

H3158.full: yiz-reh-ay-lee' Patronymic from H3157; a Jizreelite or native of Jizreel: - Jezreelite.

H3159.full: yiz-reh-ay-leeth' Feminine of H3158; a Jezreelitess: - Jezreelitess.

H3160.full: From H2247; hidden; Jechubbah, an Israelite: - Jehubbah.

H3161.full: A primitive root; to be (or become) one: - join, unite.

H3162.firstSense: alike, at all (once), both, likewise, only, (al-) together, withal
H3162.full: From H3161; properly a unit, that is, (adverbially) unitedly: - alike, at all (once), both, likewise, only, (al-) together, withal.

H3163.full: From H3162 with pronominal suffix; his unity, that is, (adverbially) together; Jachdo, an Israelite: - Jahdo.

H3164.full: yakh-dee-ale' From H3162 and H410; unity of God; Jachdiel, an Israelite: - Jahdiel.

H3165.full: From H3162 and H3050; unity of Jah; Jechdijah, the name of two Israelites: - Jehdeiah.

H3166.full: yakh-az-ee-ale' From H2372 and H410; beheld of God; Jachaziel, the name of five Israelites: - Jahaziel, Jahziel.

H3167.full: From H2371 and H3050; Jah will behold; Jachzejah, an Israelite: - Jahaziah.

H3168.full: yekh-ez-kale' From H2388 and H410; God will strengthen; Jechezkel, the name of two Israelites: - Ezekiel, Jehezekel.

H3169.full: From H3388 and H3050; strengthened of Jah; Jechizkijah, the name of five Israelites: - Hezekiah, Jehizkiah. Compare H2396.

H3170.full: From the same as H2386; perhaps protection; Jachzerah, an Israelite: - Jahzerah.

H3171.full: yekh-ee-ale', yekh-av-ale' From H2421 and H410; God will live; Jechiel (or Jechavel), the name of eight Israelites: - Jehiel.

H3172.full: yekh-ee-ay-lee' Patronymic from H3171; a Jechielite or descendant of Jechiel: - Jehieli.

H3173.full: From H3161; properly united, that is, sole; by implication beloved; also lonely; (feminine) the life (as not to be replace): - darling, desolate, only (child, son), solitary.

H3174.full: From H2421 and H3050; Jah will live; Jechijah, an Israelite: - Jehiah.

H3176.firstSense: (cause to, have, make to) hope, be pained, stay, tarry, trust, wait
H3176.full: A primitive root; to wait; by implication to be patient, hope: - (cause to, have, make to) hope, be pained, stay, tarry, trust, wait.

H3177.full: yakh-leh-ale' From H3176 and H410; expectant of God; Jachleel, an Israelite: - Jahleel.

H3178.full: yakh-leh-ay-lee' Patronymic from H3177; a Jachleelite or descendant of Jachleel: - Jahleelites.

H3179.firstSense: get heat, be hot, conceive, be warm
H3179.full: A primitive root; Probably to be hot; figuratively to conceive: - get heat, be hot, conceive, be warm.

H3180.full: From H2560; a kind of deer (from the color; compare H2548): - fallow deer.

H3181.full: Probably from H3179; hot; Jachmai, an Israelite: - Jahmai.

H3182.full: From an unused root meaning to take off the shoes; unsandalled: - barefoot, being unshod.

H3183.full: yakh-tseh-ale' From H2673 and H410; God will allot; Jachtseel, an Israelite: - Jahzeel. Compare H3185.

H3184.full: yakh-tseh-ay-lee' Patronymic from H3183; a Jachtseelite (collectively) or descendant of Jachtseel: - Jahzeelites.

H3185.full: yakh-tsee-ale' From H2673 and H410; allotted of God; Jachtsiel, an Israelite: - Jahziel. Compare H3183.

H3186.full: A primitive root; to delay: - tarry longer.

H3187.firstSense: (number after, number throughout the) genealogy (to be reckoned), be reckoned by geneal…
H3187.full: A primitive root; to sprout; used only as denominative from H3188; to enroll by pedigree: - (number after, number throughout the) genealogy (to be reckoned), be reckoned by genealogies.

H3188.full: From H3187; a pedigree or family list (as growing spontaneously): - genealogy.

H3189.full: From H3161; unity; Jachath, the name of four Israelites: - Jahath.

H3190.firstSense: be accepted, amend, use aright, benefit, be (make) better, seem best, make cheerful, be…
H3190.full: A primitive root; to be (causatively) make well, literally (sound, beautiful) or figuratively (happy, successful, right): - be accepted, amend, use aright, benefit, be (make) better, seem best, make cheerful, be comely, + be content, diligent (-ly), dress, earnestly, find favour, give, be glad, do (be, make) good ([-ness]), be (make) merry, please (+ well), shew more [kindness], skilfully, X very small, surely, make sweet, thoroughly, tire, trim, very, be (can, deal, entreat, go, have) well [said, seen ].

H3192.full: From H3190; pleasantness; Jotbah, a place in Palestine: - Jotbah.

H3193.full: From H3192; Jotbathah, a place in the Desert: - Jotbath, Jotbathah.

H3194.full: From H5186; extended; Juttah (or Jutah), a place in Palestine: - Juttah.

H3195.full: Probably from the same as H2905; encircled (that is, inclosed); Jetur, a son of Ishmael: - Jetur.

H3196.full: From an unused root meaning to effervesce; wine (as fermented); by implication intoxication: - banqueting, wine, wine [-bibber].

H3197.full: yak yak By erroneous transcription for H3027; a hand or side: - [way-] side.

H3198.firstSense: appoint, argue, chasten, convince, correct (-ion), daysman, dispute, judge, maintain, p…
H3198.full: A primitive root; to be right (that is, correct); reciprocally to argue; causatively to decide, justify or convict: - appoint, argue, chasten, convince, correct (-ion), daysman, dispute, judge, maintain, plead, reason (together), rebuke, reprove (-r), surely, in any wise.

H3199.full: From H3559; he (or it) will establish; Jakin, the name of three Israelites and of a temple pillar: - Jachin.

H3200.full: Patronymic from H3199; a Jakinite (collectively) or descendant of Jakin: - Jachinites.

H3201.firstSense: be able, any at all (ways), attain, can (away with, [-not]), could, endure, might, over…
H3201.full: A primitive root; to be able, literally (can, could) or morally (may, might): - be able, any at all (ways), attain, can (away with, [-not]), could, endure, might, overcome, have power, prevail, still, suffer.

H3202.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H3201: - be able, can, couldest, prevail.

H3203.full: From H3201 and H3050; Jah will enable; Jekoljah or Jekiljah, an Israelitess: - Jecholiah, Jecoliah.

H3204.full: From H3559 and H3050; Jah will establish; Jekonjah, a Jewish king: - Jeconiah. Compare H3659.

H3205.firstSense: bear, beget, birth ([-day]), born, (make to) bring forth (children, young), bring up, c…
H3205.full: A primitive root; to bear young; causatively to beget; medically to act as midwife; specifically to show lineage: - bear, beget, birth ([-day]), born, (make to) bring forth (children, young), bring up, calve, child, come, be delivered (of a child), time of delivery, gender, hatch, labour, (do the office of a) midwife, declare pedigrees, be the son of, (woman in, woman that) travail (-eth, -ing woman).

H3206.firstSense: boy, child, fruit, son, young man (one)
H3206.full: From H3205; something born, that is, a lad or offspring: - boy, child, fruit, son, young man (one).

H3207.full: Feminine of H3206; a lass: - damsel, girl.

H3208.full: Abstract from H3206; boyhood (or girlhood): - childhood, youth.

H3210.full: From H3885; lodging; Jalon, an Israelite: - Jalon.

H3211.full: From H3205; born: - ([home-]) born, child, son.

H3212.firstSense: X again, away, bear, bring, carry (away), come (away), depart, flow, + follow (-ing), g…
H3212.full: A primitive root (compare H1980); to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively to carry (in various senses): - X again, away, bear, bring, carry (away), come (away), depart, flow, + follow (-ing), get (away, hence, him), (cause to, make) go (away, -ing, -ne, one's way, out), grow, lead (forth), let down, march, prosper, + pursue, cause to run, spread, take away ([-journey]), vanish, (cause to) walk (-ing), wax, X be weak.

H3213.full: A primitive root; to howl (with a wailing tone) or yell (with a boisterous one): - (make to) howl, be howling.

H3215.full: Feminine of H3214; a howling: - howling.

H3216.full: A primitive root; to blurt or utter inconsiderately: - devour.

H3217.full: From an unused root apparently meaning to stick or scrape; scurf or tetter: - scabbed.

H3218.full: From an unused root meaning to lick up; a devourer; specifically the young locust: - cankerworm, caterpillar.

H3219.full: From H3950; a travelling pouch (as if for gleanings): - scrip.

H3220.full: yâm yawm From an unused root meaning to roar; a sea (as breaking in noisy surf) or large body of water; specifically (with the article) the Mediterranean; sometimes a large river, or an artificial basin; locally, the west, or (rarely) the south: - sea (X -faring man, [-shore]), south, west (-ern, side, -ward).

H3221.full: yâm yawm (Chaldee); corresponding to H3220: - sea.

H3222.full: yêm yame From the same as H3117; a warm spring: - mule.

H3223.full: yem-oo-ale' From H3117 and H410; day of God; Jemuel, an Israelite: - Jemuel.

H3224.full: Perhaps from the same as H3117; properly warm, that is, affectionate; hence dove (compare H3123); Jemimah, one of Job's daughters: - Jemimah.

H3225.full: From H3231; the right hand or side (leg, eye) of a person or other object (as the stronger and more dexterous); locally, the south: - + left-handed, right (hand, side), south.

H3226.full: The same as H3225; Jamin, the name of three Israelites: - Jamin. See also H1144.

H3228.full: Patronymic from H3226; a Jeminite (collectively) or descendant of Jamin: - Jaminites. See also H1145.

H3229.full: yeem-law', yim-law' From H4390; full; Jimla or Jimlah, an Israelite: - Imla, Imlah.

H3230.full: From H4427; he will make king; Jamlek, an Israelite: - Jamlech.

H3231.firstSense: go (turn) to (on, use) the right hand
H3231.full: A primitive root; to be (physically) right (that is, firm); but used only as denominative from H3225 and transitively, to be right handed or take the right hand side: - go (turn) to (on, use) the right hand.

H3232.full: From H3231; prosperity (as betokened by the right hand); Jimnah, the name of two Israelites; also (with the article) of the posterity of one of them: - Imna, Imnah, Jimnah, Jimnites.

H3233.full: From H3231; right (that is, at the right hand): - (on the) right (hand).

H3234.full: From H4513; he will restrain; Jimna, an Israelite: - Imna.

H3235.full: A primitive root; to exchange; by implication to change places: - boast selves, change.

H3236.full: Probably from H3235; interchange; Jimrah, an Israelite: - Imrah.

H3237.full: A primitive root; to touch: - feel.

H3238.firstSense: destroy, (thrust out by) oppress (-ing, -ion, -or), proud, vex, do violence
H3238.full: A primitive root; to rage or be violent; by implication to suppress, to maltreat: - destroy, (thrust out by) oppress (-ing, -ion, -or), proud, vex, do violence.

H3239.full: From H3240; quiet; Janoach or Janochah, a place in Palestine: - Janoah, Janohah.

H3240.firstSense: bestow, cast down, lay (down, up), leave (off), let alone (remain), pacify, place, put,…
H3240.full: A primitive root; to deposit; by implication to allow to stay. (The Hiphil forms with the dagesh are here referred to, in accordance with the older grammarians; but if any distinction of the kind is to be made, these should rather be referred to H5117, and the others here): - bestow, cast down, lay (down, up), leave (off), let alone (remain), pacify, place, put, set (down), suffer, withdraw, withhold. (The Hiphil forms with the dagesh are here referred to, in accordance with the older grammarians; but if any distinction of the kind is to be made, these should rather be referred to H5117, and the others here.)

H3241.full: From H5123; asleep; Janim, a place in Palestine: - Janum [from the margin].

H3242.full: From H3243; a sucker or sapling: - young twig.

H3243.firstSense: milch, nurse (-ing mother), give, make to) suck (-ing child, -ling)
H3243.full: A primitive root; to suck; causatively to give milk: - milch, nurse (-ing mother), give, make to) suck (-ing child, -ling).

H3244.full: Apparently from H4398; an unclean (aquatic) bird; probably the heron (perhaps from its blowing cry, or because the night heron is meant (compare H5399)): - (great) owl.

H3245.firstSense: appoint, take counsel, establish, (lay the, lay for a) found (-ation), instruct, lay, o…
H3245.full: A primitive root; to set (literally or figuratively); intensively to found; reflexively to sit down together, that is, settle, consult: - appoint, take counsel, establish, (lay the, lay for a) found (-ation), instruct, lay, ordain, set, X sure.

H3246.full: From H3245; a foundation (figuratively that is, beginning): - X began.

H3247.full: From H3245; a foundation (literally or figuratively): - bottom, foundation, repairing.

H3248.full: Feminine of H3246; a foundation: - foundation.

H3249.full: From H5493; departing: - they that depart.

H3251.full: A primitive root; to pour (intransitively): - be poured.

H3252.full: From an unused root meaning to watch; observant; Jiskah, sister of Lot: - Iscah.

H3253.full: From H5564 and H3050; Jah will sustain; Jismakjah, an Israelite: - Ismachiah.

H3254.firstSense: add, X again, X any more, X cease, X come more, + conceive again, continue, exceed, X f…
H3254.full: A primitive root; to add or augment (often adverbially to continue to do a thing): - add, X again, X any more, X cease, X come more, + conceive again, continue, exceed, X further, X gather together, get more, give moreover, X henceforth, increase (more and more), join, X longer (bring, do, make, much, put), X (the, much, yet) more (and more), proceed (further), prolong, put, be [strong-] er, X yet, yield.

H3256.firstSense: bind, chasten, chastise, correct, instruct, punish, reform, reprove, sore, teach
H3256.full: A primitive root; to chastise, literally (with blows) or figuratively (with words); hence to instruct: - bind, chasten, chastise, correct, instruct, punish, reform, reprove, sore, teach.

H3258.full: From an unused root probably meaning to grieve; sorrowful; Jabets, the name of an Israelite, and also of a place in Palestine: - Jabez.

H3259.firstSense: agree, (make an) appoint (-ment, a time), assemble (selves), betroth, gather (selves, t…
H3259.full: A primitive root; to fix upon (by agreement or appointment); by implication to meet (at a stated time), to summon (to trial), to direct (in a certain quarter or position), to engage (for marriage): - agree, (make an) appoint (-ment, a time), assemble (selves), betroth, gather (selves, together), meet (together), set (a time).

H3260.full: From H3259; appointed; Jedi, an Israelite: - Iddo [from the margin] See H3035.

H3261.full: A primitive root; apparently to brush aside: - sweep away.

H3262.full: From H3261 and H410; carried away of God; Jeuel, the name of four Israelites: - Jehiel, Jeiel, Jeuel. Comp H3273.

H3263.full: From H5779; counsellor; Jeuts, an Israelite: - Jeuz.

H3264.full: A variation of H3298; a forest: - wood.

H3265.full: Apparently passive participle of the same as H3293; wooded; Jaur, an Israelite: - Jair [from the margin].

H3266.full: From H5789; hasty; Jeush, the name of an Edomite and of four Israelites: - Jehush, Jeush. Compare H3274.

H3267.full: A primitive root; to be bold or obstinate: - fierce.

H3268.full: From H3267 and H410; emboldened of God; Jaziel, an Israelite: - Jaaziel.

H3269.full: From H3267 and H3050; emboldened of Jah; Jaaziah, an Israelite: - Jaaziah.

H3270.full: From H5826; helpful; Jaazer or Jazer, a place East of the Jordan: - Jaazer, Jazer.

H3271.full: A primitive root; to clothe: - cover.

H3272.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to to H3289; to counsel; reflexively to consult: - counsellor, consult together.

H3273.full: From H3261 and H410; carried away of God; Jeiel, the name of six Israelites: - Jeiel, Jehiel. Compare H3262.

H3274.full: From H5789; hasty; Jeish, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite: - Jeush [from the margin]. Compare H3266.

H3275.full: From the same as H5912; troublesome; Jakan, an Israelite: - Jachan.

H3276.firstSense: X at all, set forward, can do good, (be, have) profit (-able)
H3276.full: A primitive root; properly to ascend; figuratively to be valuable (objective useful, subjective benefited): - X at all, set forward, can do good, (be, have) profit (-able).

H3277.full: From H3276; an ibex (as climbing): - wild goat.

H3278.full: The same as H3277; Jael, a Canaanite: - Jael.

H3279.full: The same as H3280 or direct from H3276; Jaala or Jaalah, one of the Nethinim: - Jaala, Jaalah.

H3281.full: From H5956; occult; Jalam, an Edomite: - Jalam.

H3282.firstSense: because (that), forasmuch (+ as), seeing then, + that, + whereas, + why
H3282.full: From an unused root meaning to pay attention; properly heed; by implication purpose (sake or account); used adverbially to indicate the reason or cause: - because (that), forasmuch (+ as), seeing then, + that, + whereas, + why.

H3283.full: From the same as H3282; the ostrich (probably from its answering cry): - ostrich.

H3284.full: Feminine of H3283, and meaning the same: - + owl.

H3285.full: From the same as H3283; responsive; Jaanai, an Israelite: - Jaanai.

H3286.full: A primitive root; to tire (as if from wearisome flight): - faint, cause to fly, (be) weary (self).

H3287.full: From H3286; fatigued; figuratively exhausted: - faint, weary.

H3288.full: From H3286; fatigue (adverbially utterly exhausted): - swiftly.

H3289.firstSense: advertise, take advice, advise (well), consult, (give take) counsel (-lor), determine,…
H3289.full: A primitive root; to advise; reflexively to deliberate or resolve: - advertise, take advice, advise (well), consult, (give take) counsel (-lor), determine, devise, guide, purpose.

H3290.full: From H6117; heel catcher (that is, supplanter); Jaakob, the Israelitish patriarch: - Jacob.

H3291.full: From H3290; Jaakobah, an Israelite: - Jaakobah.

H3292.full: From the same as H6130; Jaakan, an Idumaean: - Jaakan. Compare H1142.

H3293.full: From an unused root probably meaning to thicken with verdure; a copse of bushes; hence a forest; hence honey in the comb (as hived in trees): - [honey-] comb, forest, wood.

H3294.full: A form of H3295; Jarah, an Israelite: - Jarah.

H3295.full: Feminine of H3293, and meaning the same: - [honey-] comb, forest.

H3296.full: From the plural of H3293 and the masculine plural participle active of H707; woods of weavers; Jaare-Oregim, an Israelite: - Jaare-oregim.

H3297.full: Plural of H3293; forests; Jearim, a place in Palestine: - Jearim. Compare H7157.

H3298.full: From an unused root or uncertain signification and H3050; Jaareshjah, an Israelite: - Jaresiah.

H3299.full: From H6213; they will do; Jaasu, an Israelite: - Jaasau.

H3300.full: From H6213 and H410; made of God; Jaasiel, an Israelite: - Jaasiel, Jasiel.

H3301.full: From H6299 and H3050; Jah will liberate; Jiphdejah, an Israelite: - Iphedeiah.

H3302.firstSense: be beautiful, be (make self) fair (-r), deck
H3302.full: A primitive root; properly to be bright, that is, (by implication) beautiful: - be beautiful, be (make self) fair (-r), deck.

H3303.firstSense: + beautiful, beauty, comely, fair (-est, one), + goodly, pleasant, well
H3303.full: From H3302; beautiful (literally of figuratively): - + beautiful, beauty, comely, fair (-est, one), + goodly, pleasant, well.

H3304.full: From H3302 by reduplication; very beautiful: - very fair.

H3305.full: From H3302; beautiful; Japho, a place in Palestine: - Japha, Joppa.

H3306.full: A primitive root; properly to breathe hard, that is, (by implication) to sigh: - bewail self.

H3307.full: From H3306; properly puffing, that is, (figuratively) meditating: - such as breathe out.

H3309.full: From H3313; bright; Japhia, the name of a Canaanite, an Israelite, and a place in Palestine: - Japhia.

H3310.full: From H6403; he will deliver; Japhlet, an Israelite: - Japhlet.

H3311.full: Patronymic from H3310; a Japhletite or descendant of Japhlet: - Japhleti.

H3312.full: From H6437; he will be prepared; Jephunneh, the name of two Israelites: - Jephunneh.

H3313.firstSense: be light, shew, self, (cause to) shine (forth)
H3313.full: A primitive root; to shine: - be light, shew, self, (cause to) shine (forth).

H3314.full: From H3313; splendor or (figuratively) beauty: - brightness.

H3315.full: From H6601; expansion; Jepheth, a son of Noah; also his posterity: - Japheth.

H3316.full: From H6605; he will open; Jiphtach, an Israelite; also a place in Palestine: - Jephthah, Jiphtah.

H3317.full: yif-tach-ale' From H6605 and H410; God will open; Jiphtach-el, a place in Palestine: - Jiphthah-el.

H3318.firstSense: X after, appear, X assuredly, bear out, X begotten, break out, bring forth (out, up), c…
H3318.full: A primitive root; to go (causatively bring) out, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively, direct and proximate: - X after, appear, X assuredly, bear out, X begotten, break out, bring forth (out, up), carry out, come (abroad, out, thereat, without), + be condemned, depart (-ing, -ure), draw forth, in the end, escape, exact, fail, fall (out), fetch forth (out), get away (forth, hence, out), (able to, cause to, let) go abroad (forth, on, out), going out, grow, have forth (out), issue out, lay (lie) out, lead out, pluck out, proceed, pull out, put away, be risen, X scarce, send with commandment, shoot forth, spread, spring out, stand out, X still, X surely, take forth (out), at any time, X to [and fro], utter.

H3320.firstSense: present selves, remaining, resort, set (selves), (be able to, can, with-) stand (fast,…
H3320.full: A primitive root; to place (any thing so as to stay); reflexively to station, offer, continue: - present selves, remaining, resort, set (selves), (be able to, can, with-) stand (fast, forth, -ing, still, up).

H3321.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H3320; to be firm; hence to speak surely: - truth.

H3322.firstSense: establish, leave, make, present, put, set, stay
H3322.full: A primitive root; to place permanently: - establish, leave, make, present, put, set, stay.

H3323.full: From H6671; oil (as producing light); figuratively anointing: - + anointed, oil.

H3324.full: The same as H3323; Jitshar, an Israelite: - Izhar.

H3325.full: Patronymic from H3324; a Jitsharite or descendant of Jitshar: - Izeharites, Izharites.

H3326.full: Passive participle of H3331; spread, that is, a bed; (architecturally) an extension, that is, wing or lean to (a single story or collection): - bed, chamber, couch.

H3327.full: From H6711; laughter (that is, mockery); Jitschak (or Isaac), son of Abraham: - Isaac. Compare H3446.

H3328.full: From the same as H6713; he will shine; Jitschar, an Israelite: - and Zehoar [from the margin].

H3329.full: yaw-tsee' From H3318; issue, that is, offspring: - those that came forth.

H3330.full: (Chaldee); from H3321; fixed, sure; concretely certainty: - certain (-ty), true, truth.

H3331.full: A primitive root; to strew as a surface: - make [one's] bed, X lie, spread.

H3332.firstSense: cast, cleave fast, be (as) firm, grow, be hard, lay out, molten, overflow, pour (out),…
H3332.full: A primitive root; properly to pour out (transitively or intransitively); by implication to melt or cast as metal; by extension to place firmly, to stiffen or grow hard: - cast, cleave fast, be (as) firm, grow, be hard, lay out, molten, overflow, pour (out), run out, set down, stedfast.

H3333.full: Passive participle feminine of H3332; poured out, that is, run into a mould: - when it was cast.

H3334.firstSense: be distressed, be narrow, be straitened (in straits), be vexed
H3334.full: A primitive root; to press (intransitively), that is, be narrow; figuratively be in distress: - be distressed, be narrow, be straitened (in straits), be vexed.

H3335.firstSense: X earthen, fashion, form, frame, make (-r), potter, purpose
H3335.full: probably identical with H3334 (through the squeezing into shape); (compare H3331); to mould into a form; especially as a potter; figuratively to determine (that is, form a resolution): - X earthen, fashion, form, frame, make (-r), potter, purpose.

H3336.firstSense: frame, thing framed, imagination, mind, work
H3336.full: From H3335; a form; figuratively conception (that is, purpose): - frame, thing framed, imagination, mind, work.

H3337.full: The same as H3336; Jetser, an Israelite: - Jezer.

H3338.full: Passive participle of H3335; structure, that is, limb or part: - member.

H3339.full: From H3335; formative; Jitsri, an Israelite: - Isri.

H3340.full: Patronymic from H3337; a Jitsrite (collectively) or descendant of Jetser: - Jezerites.

H3341.firstSense: burn (up), be desolate, set (on) fire ([fire]), kindle
H3341.full: A primitive root; to burn or set on fire; figuratively to desolate: - burn (up), be desolate, set (on) fire ([fire]), kindle.

H3342.full: From unused root meaning to excavate; a trough (as dug out); specifically a wine vat (whether the lower one, into which the juice drains; or the upper, in which the grapes are crushed): - fats, presses, press-fat, wine (-press).

H3343.full: yek-ab-tseh-ale' From H6908 and H410; God will gather; Jekabtseel, a place in Palestine: - Jekabzeel. Compare H6909.

H3344.firstSense: (be) burn (-ing), X from the hearth, kindle
H3344.full: A primitive root; to burn: - (be) burn (-ing), X from the hearth, kindle.

H3346.full: yek-ay-daw' (Chaldee); from H3345; a conflagration: - burning.

H3347.full: From H3344 and H5971; burning of (the) people; Jokdeam, a place in Palestine: - Jokdeam.

H3348.full: From an unused root probably meaning to obey; obedient; Jakeh, a symbolical name (for Solomon): - Jakeh.

H3349.full: From the same as H3348; obedience: - gathering, to obey.

H3351.full: From H6965; properly standing (extant), that is, by implication a living thing: - (living) substance.

H3352.full: From H3369; properly entangling; hence a snarer: - fowler.

H3353.full: Passive participle of H3369; properly entangled, that is, by implication (intransitively) a snare, or (transitively) a snarer: - fowler, snare.

H3354.full: yek-ooth-ee'-ale From the same as H3348 and H410; obedience of God; Jekuthiel, an Israelite: - Jekuthiel.

H3355.full: From H6994; he will be made little; Joktan, an Arabian patriarch: - Joktan.

H3356.full: From H6965; he will raise; Jakim, the name of two Israelites: - Jakim. Compare H3079.

H3359.full: From H6965 and H3050; Jah will rise; Jekamjah, the name of two Israelites: - Jekamiah. Compare H3079.

H3360.full: From H6965 and H5971; (the) people will rise; Jekamam, an Israelite: - Jekameam. Compare H3079, H3361.

H3361.full: From H6965 and H5971; (the) people will be raised; Jokmeam, a place in Palestine: - Jokmeam. Compare H3360, H3362.

H3362.full: From H6969 and H5971; (the) people will be lamented; Jokneam, a place in Palestine: - Jokneam.

H3363.firstSense: be alienated, depart, hang (up), be out of joint
H3363.full: A primitive root; properly to sever oneself, that is, (by implication) to be dislocated; figuratively to abandon; causatively to impale (and thus allow to drop to pieces by rotting): - be alienated, depart, hang (up), be out of joint.

H3364.full: A primitive root; to awake (intransitively): - (be) awake (-d).

H3365.firstSense: be (make) precious, be prized, be set by, withdraw
H3365.full: A primitive root; properly apparently to be heavy, that is, (figuratively) valuable; causatively to make rare (figuratively to inhibit): - be (make) precious, be prized, be set by, withdraw.

H3366.full: From H3365; value, that is, (concretely) wealth; abstractly costliness, dignity: - honour, precious (things), price.

H3368.firstSense: brightness, clear, costly, excellent, fat, honourable women, precious, reputation
H3368.full: From H3365; valuable (objectively or subjectively): - brightness, clear, costly, excellent, fat, honourable women, precious, reputation.

H3369.full: A primitive root; to ensnare (literally or figuratively): - fowler (lay a) snare.

H3370.full: From H3369; insidious; Jokshan, an Arabian patriarch: - Jokshan.

H3371.full: yok-theh-ale' Probably from the same as H3348 and H410; veneration of God (compare H3354); Joktheel, the name of a place in Palestine, and of one in Idumaea: - Joktheel.

H3372.firstSense: affright, be (make) afraid, dread (-ful), (put in) fear (-ful, -fully, -ing)
H3372.full: A primitive root; to fear; morally to revere; causatively to frighten: - affright, be (make) afraid, dread (-ful), (put in) fear (-ful, -fully, -ing). (be had in) reverence (-end), X see, terrible (act, -ness, thing).

H3373.full: From H3372; fearing; morally reverent: - afraid, fear (-ful).

H3374.full: yir-aw' Feminine of H3373; fear (also used as infinitive); morally reverence: - X dreadful, X exceedingly, fear (-fulness).

H3375.full: yir-ohn' From H3372; fearfulness; Jiron, a place in Palestine: - Iron.

H3376.full: yir-ee-yaw' From H3373 and H3050; fearful of Jah; Jirijah, an Israelite: - Irijah.

H3377.full: From H7378; he will contend; Jareb, a symbolical name for Assyria: - Jareb. Compare H3402.

H3378.full: From H7378 and H1168; Baal will contend; Jerubbaal, a symbolical name of Gideon: - Jerubbaal.

H3379.full: From H7378 and H5971; (the) people will contend; Jarobam, the name of two Israelite kings: - Jeroboam.

H3380.full: From H7378 and H1322; shame (that is, the idol) will contend; Jerubbesheth, a symbolical name for Gideon: - Jerubbesheth.

H3381.firstSense: X abundantly, bring down, carry down, cast down, (cause to) come (-ing) down, fall (dow…
H3381.full: A primitive root; to descend (literally to go downwards; or conventionally to a lower region, as the shore, a boundary, the enemy, etc.; or figuratively to fall); causatively to bring down (in all the above applications): - X abundantly, bring down, carry down, cast down, (cause to) come (-ing) down, fall (down), get down, go (-ing) down (-ward), hang down, X indeed, let down, light (down), put down (off), (cause to, let) run down, sink, subdue, take down.

H3382.full: From H3381; a descent; Jered, the name of an antediluvian, and of an Israelite: - Jared.

H3383.full: From H3381; a descender; Jarden, the principal river of Palestine: - Jordan.

H3384.firstSense: (+) archer, cast, direct, inform, instruct, lay, shew, shoot, teach (-er, -ing), through
H3384.full: A primitive root; properly to flow as water (that is, to rain); transitively to lay or throw (especially an arrow, that is, to shoot); figuratively to point out (as if by aiming the finger), to teach: - (+) archer, cast, direct, inform, instruct, lay, shew, shoot, teach (-er, -ing), through.

H3385.full: yer-oo-ale' From H3384 and H410; founded of God; Jeruel, a place in Palestine: - Jeruel

H3386.full: Perhaps denominative from H3394; (born at the) new moon; Jaroach, an Israelite: - Jaroah.

H3387.full: From H3417; green, that is, an herb: - green thing.

H3388.full: yer-oo-shaw', yer-oo-shaw' Feminine passive participle of H3423; possessed; Jerusha or Jerushah, an Israelitess: - Jerusha, Jerushah.

H3389.full: A dual (in allusion to its two main hills (the true pointing, at least of the former reading, seems to be that of H3390)); probably from (the passive participle of) H3384 and H7999; founded peaceful; Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine: - Jerusalem.

H3391.full: From an unused root of uncertain signification; a lunation, that is, month: - month, moon.

H3392.full: The same as H3391; Jerach, an Arabian patriarch: - Jerah.

H3393.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H3391; a month: - month.

H3394.full: From the same as H3391; the moon: - moon.

H3395.full: From H7355; compassionate; Jerocham, the name of seven or eight Israelites: - Jeroham.

H3396.full: yer-akh-meh-ale' From H7355 and H410; God will compassionate; Jerachmeel, the name of three Israelites: - Jerahmeel.

H3397.full: yer-akh-meh-ay-lee' Patronymic from H3396; a Jerachmeelite or descendant of Jerachmeel: - Jerahmeelites.

H3398.full: Probably of Egyptian origin; Jarcha, an Egyptian: - Jarha.

H3399.full: A primitive root; to precipitate or hurl (rush) headlong; (intransitively) to be rash: - be perverse, turn over.

H3400.full: yer-ee-ale' From H3384 and H410; thrown of God; Jeriel, an Israelite: - Jeriel. Compare H3385.

H3401.full: From H7378; literally he will contend; properly adjectively contentious; used as noun, an adversary: - that contend (-eth), that strive.

H3402.full: The same as H3401; Jarib, the name of three Israelites: - Jarib.

H3403.full: From H3401; contentious; Jeribai, an Israelite: - Jeribai.

H3404.full: From H3384 and H3050; Jah will throw; Jerijah, an Israelite: - Jeriah, Jerijah.

H3405.full: Perhaps from H3394; its month; or else from H7306; fragrant; Jericho or Jerecho, a place in Palestine: - Jericho.

H3406.firstSense: Jeremoth, Jerimoth, and Ramoth [from the margin]
H3406.full: Feminine plural from H7311; elevations; Jerimoth or Jeremoth, the name of twelve Israelites: - Jeremoth, Jerimoth, and Ramoth [from the margin].

H3407.full: From H3415; a hanging (as tremulous): - curtain.

H3408.full: Plural of H3407; curtains; Jerioth, an Israelitess: - Jerioth.

H3409.firstSense: X body, loins, shaft, side, thigh
H3409.full: From an unused root meaning to be soft; the thigh (from its fleshy softness); by euphemism the generative parts; figuratively a shank, flank, side: - X body, loins, shaft, side, thigh.

H3410.full: yar-kaw' (Chaldee); corresponding to H3411; a thigh: - thigh.

H3411.full: Feminine of H3409; properly the flank; but used only figuratively, the rear or recess: - border, coast, part, quarter, side.

H3412.full: From H7311; elevation; Jarmuth, the name of two places in Palestine: - Jarmuth.

H3413.full: From H7311; elevated; Jeremai, an Israelite: - Jeremai.

H3414.full: From H7311 and H3050; Jah will rise; Jirmejah, the name of eight or nine Israelites: - Jeremiah.

H3415.full: A primitive root; properly to be broken up (with any violent action), that is, (figuratively) to fear: - be grievous [only Isa_15:4; the rest belong to H7489].

H3416.full: yir-peh-ale' From H7495 and H410; God will heal; Jirpeel, a place in Palestine: - Irpeel.

H3417.full: A primitive root; to spit: - X but, spit.

H3418.full: From H3417 (in the sense of vacuity of color); properly pallor, that is, hence the yellowish green of young and sickly vegetation; concretely verdure, that is, grass or vegetation: - grass, green (thing).

H3419.full: From the same as H3418; properly green; concretely a vegetable: - green, herbs.

H3420.full: From H3418; paleness, whether of persons (from fright), or of plants (from drought): - mildew, paleness.

H3421.full: From H7324 and H5971; people will be poured forth; Jorkeam, a place in Palestine: - Jorkeam.

H3422.full: From the same as H3418; yellowishness: - greenish, yellow.

H3423.firstSense: cast out, consume, destroy, disinherit, dispossess, drive (-ing) out, enjoy, expel, X w…
H3423.full: A primitive root; to occupy (be driving out previous tenants, and possessing in their place); by implication to seize, to rob, to inherit; also to expel, to impoverish, to ruin: - cast out, consume, destroy, disinherit, dispossess, drive (-ing) out, enjoy, expel, X without fail, (give to, leave for) inherit (-ance, -or), + magistrate, be (make) poor, come to poverty, (give to, make to) possess, get (have) in (take) possession, seize upon, succeed, X utterly.

H3425.full: From H2423; something occupied; a conquest; also a patrimony: - heritage, inheritance, possession.

H3426.firstSense: (there) are, (he, it, shall, there, there may, there shall, there should) be, thou do,…
H3426.full: yêsh yaysh Perhaps from an unused root meaning to stand out, or exist; entity; used adverbially or as a copula for the substantive verb (H1961); there is or are (or any other form of the verb to be, as may suit the connection): - (there) are, (he, it, shall, there, there may, there shall, there should) be, thou do, had, hast, (which) hath, (I, shalt, that) have, (he, it, there) is, substance, it (there) was, (there) were, ye will, thou wilt, wouldest.

H3427.firstSense: (make to) abide (-ing), continue, (cause to, make to) dwell (-ing), ease self, endure,…
H3427.full: A primitive root; properly to sit down (specifically as judge, in ambush, in quiet); by implication to dwell, to remain; causatively to settle, to marry: - (make to) abide (-ing), continue, (cause to, make to) dwell (-ing), ease self, endure, establish, X fail, habitation, haunt, (make to) inhabit (-ant), make to keep [house], lurking, X marry (-ing), (bring again to) place, remain, return, seat, set (-tle), (down-) sit (-down, still, -ting down, -ting [place] -uate), take, tarry.

H3428.full: yeh-sheb-awb' From H3427 and H1; seat of (his) father; Jeshebab, an Israelite: - Jeshebeab.

H3429.full: From the active participle of H3427 and H7674, with a preposition and the article interposed; sitting in the seat; Josheb-bash-Shebeht, an Israelite: - that sat in the seat.

H3430.full: From H3427 and H5011, with a pronominal suffix and a preposition interposed; his dwelling (is) in Nob; Jishbo-be-Nob, a Philistine: - Ishbi-benob [from the margin].

H3431.full: From H7623; he will praise; Jishbach, an Israelite: - Ishbah.

H3432.full: Patronymic from H3437; a Jashubite, or descendant of Jashub: - Jashubites.

H3433.full: Shown as the first form; from H7725 and H3899; returner of bread; Jashubi-Lechem, an Israelite; but probably the text should be pointed (as in the second form) and rendered (they were) inhabitants of Lechem, that is, of Bethlehem (by contraction): - Jashubi-lehem. [Probably the text should be pointed Yoshebey Lechem, yo-sheh-bay leh-khem, and rendered "(they were) inhabitants of Lechem," That is,of Bethlehem (by contraction). Compare H3902.]

H3434.full: From H7725 and H5971; people will return; Jashobam, the name of two or three Israelites: - Jashobeam.

H3435.full: From an unused root corresponding to H7662; he will leave; Jishbak, a son of Abraham: - Ishbak.

H3436.full: From H3427 and H7186; a hard seat; Joshbekashah, an Israelite: - Joshbekashah.

H3437.full: From H7725; he will return; Jashub, the name of two Israelites: - Jashub.

H3438.full: From H7737; he will level; Jishvah, an Israelite: - Ishvah, Isvah.

H3439.full: From the same as H3445 and H3050; Jah will empty; Jeshochajah, an Israelite: - Jeshoaiah.

H3440.full: From H7737; level; Jishvi, the name of two Israelites: - Ishuai, Ishvi, Isui, Jesui.

H3441.full: Patronymic from H3440; a Jishvite (collectively) or descendant of Jishvi: - Jesuites.

H3442.full: For H3091; he will save; Jeshua, the name of two Israelites, also of a place in Palestine: - Jeshua.

H3444.firstSense: deliverance, health, help (-ing), salvation, save, saving (health), welfare
H3444.full: Feminine passive participle of H3467; something saved, that is, (abstractly) deliverance; hence aid, victory, prosperity: - deliverance, health, help (-ing), salvation, save, saving (health), welfare.

H3445.full: From an unused root meaning to gape (as the empty stomach); hunger: - casting down.

H3446.full: From H7831; he will laugh; Jischak, the heir of Abraham: - Isaac. Compare H3327.

H3447.full: A primitive root; to extend: - hold out.

H3448.full: yee-shah'ee, ee-shah'ee From the same as H3426; extant; Jishai, David's father: - Jesse.

H3449.full: From H5383 and H3050; Jah will lend; Jishshijah, the name of five Israelites: - Ishiah, Isshiah, Ishijah, Jesiah.

H3450.full: yes-eem-aw-ale' From H7760 and H410; God will place; Jesimael, an Israelite: - Jesimiel.

H3451.full: From H3456; desolation: - let death seize [from the margin].

H3452.full: From H3456; a desolation: - desert, Jeshimon, solitary, wilderness.

H3453.full: From H3486; an old man: - (very) aged (man), ancient, very old.

H3454.full: From H3453; aged; Jeshishai, an Israelite: - Jeshishai.

H3455.full: A primitive root; to place; intransitively to be placed: - be put (set).

H3456.full: A primitive root; to lie waste: - be desolate.

H3457.full: yish-maw' From H3456; desolate; Jishma, an Israelite: - Ishma.

H3458.full: From H8085 and H410; God will hear; Jishmael, the name of Abraham's oldest son, and of five Israelites: - Ishmael.

H3459.full: Patronymic from H3458; a Jishmaelite or descendant of Jishmael: - Ishmaelite.

H3460.full: From H8085 and H3050; Jah will hear; Jishmajah, the name of two Israelites: - Ishmaiah.

H3461.full: From H8104; preservative; Jishmerai, an Israelite: - Ishmerai.

H3462.full: A primitive root; properly to be slack or languid, that is, (by implication) sleep (figuratively to die); also to grow old, stale or inveterate: - old (store), remain long, (make to) sleep.

H3463.full: From H3462; sleepy: - asleep, (one out of) sleep (-eth, -ing), slept.

H3464.full: The same as H3463; Jashen, an Israelite: - Jashen.

H3466.full: Feminine of H3465; Jeshanah, a place in Palestine: - Jeshanah.

H3467.firstSense: X at all, avenging, defend, deliver (-er), help, preserve, rescue, be safe, bring (havi…
H3467.full: A primitive root; properly to be open, wide or free, that is, (by implication) to be safe; causatively to free or succor: - X at all, avenging, defend, deliver (-er), help, preserve, rescue, be safe, bring (having) salvation, save (-iour), get victory.

H3468.full: From H3467; liberty, deliverance, prosperity: - safety, salvation, saving.

H3469.full: From H3467; saving; Jishi, the name of four Israelites: - Ishi.

H3470.full: From H3467 and H3050; Jah has saved; Jeshajah, the name of seven Israelites: - Isaiah, Jesaiah, Jeshaiah.

H3471.full: From an unused root meaning to polish; a gem supposed to be jasper (from the resemblance in name): - jasper.

H3472.full: Perhaps from H8192; he will scratch; Jishpah, an Israelite: - Ispah.

H3473.full: Probably from the same as H8227; he will hide; Jishpan, an Israelite: - Ishpan.

H3474.firstSense: direct, fit, seem good (meet), + please (well), be (esteem, go) right (on), bring (look…
H3474.full: A primitive root; to be straight or even; figuratively to be (causatively to make) right, pleasant, prosperous: - direct, fit, seem good (meet), + please (well), be (esteem, go) right (on), bring (look, make, take the) straight (way), be upright (-ly).

H3475.full: From H3474; the right; Jesher, an Israelite: - Jesher.

H3476.full: From H3474; the right: - equity, meet, right, upright (-ness).

H3477.firstSense: convenient, equity, Jasher, just, meet (-est), + pleased well right (-eous), straight,…
H3477.full: From H3474; straight (literally or figuratively): - convenient, equity, Jasher, just, meet (-est), + pleased well right (-eous), straight, (most) upright (-ly, -ness).

H3478.full: From H8280 and H410; he will rule as God; Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity: - Israel.

H3480.full: yes-ar-ale'-aw By variation from H3477 and H410 with directive enclitic; right towards God; Jesarelah, an Israelite: - Jesharelah. Compare H841

H3481.full: yish-reh-ay-lee' Patronymic from H3478; a Jisreelite or descendant of Jisrael: - of Israel, Israelite.

H3482.full: yis-reh-ay-leeth' Feminine of H3481; a Jisreelitess or female descendant of Jisrael: - Israelitish.

H3484.full: From H3474; upright; Jeshurun, a symbolical name for Israel: - Jeshurun.

H3485.full: From H5375 and H7939; he will bring a reward; Jissaskar, a son of Jacob: - Issachar.

H3486.full: From an unused root meaning to blanch; gray haired, that is, an aged man: - stoop for age.

H3487.full: yath yath (Chaldee); corresponding to H853; a sign of the object of a verb: - + whom.

H3488.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H3427; to sit or dwell: - dwell, (be) set, sit.

H3489.full: From an unused root meaning to pin through or fast; a peg: - nail, paddle, pin, stake.

H3490.full: From an unused root meaning to be lonely; a bereaved person: - fatherless (child), orphan.

H3491.full: Passive participle of H3498; properly what is left, that is, (by implication) a gleaning: - range.

H3492.full: From H3498; redundant; Jattir, a place in Palestine: - Jattir.

H3493.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H3492; preeminent; adverbially very: - exceeding (-ly), excellent.

H3494.full: Probably from H8518; it will hang, that is, high; Jithlah, a place in Palestine: - Jethlah.

H3495.full: From the same as H3490; orphanage; Jithmah, an Israelite: - Ithmah.

H3496.full: yath-nee-ale' From an unused root meaning to endure, and H410; continued of God; Jathniel, an Israelite: - Jathniel.

H3497.full: From the same as H8577; extensive; Jithnan, a place in Palestine: - Ithnan.

H3498.firstSense: excel, leave (a remnant), left behind, too much, make plenteous, preserve, (be, let) re…
H3498.full: A primitive root; to jut over or exceed; by implication to excel; (intransitively) to remain or be left; causatively to leave, cause to abound, preserve: - excel, leave (a remnant), left behind, too much, make plenteous, preserve, (be, let) remain (-der, -ing, -nant), reserve, residue, rest.

H3499.firstSense: + abundant, cord, exceeding, excellency (-ent), what they leave, that hath left, plenti…
H3499.full: Properly an overhanging, that is, (by implication) an excess, superiority, remainder; also a small rope (as hanging free): - + abundant, cord, exceeding, excellency (-ent), what they leave, that hath left, plentifully, remnant, residue, rest, string, with.

H3500.full: The same as H3499 Jether, the name of five or six Israelites and of one Midianite: - Jether, Jethro. Compare H3503.

H3501.full: yith-raw' By variation for H3502; Jithra, an Israelite (or Ishmaelite): - Ithra.

H3502.full: Feminine of H3499; properly excellence, that is, (by implication) wealth: - abundance, riches.

H3503.full: From H3499 with pronominal suffix; his excellence; Jethro, Moses' father in law: - Jethro. Compare H3500.

H3504.full: From H3498; preeminence, gain: - better, excellency (-leth), profit (-able).

H3505.full: Patronymic from H3500; a Jithrite or descendant of Jether: - Ithrite.

H3506.full: From H3498; excellent; Jithran, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite: - Ithran.

H3507.full: From H3499 and H5971; excellence of people; Jithream, a son of David: - Ithream.

H3508.full: Feminine active participle of H3498; the lobe or flap of the liver (as if redundant or outhanging): - caul.

H3509.full: Of uncertain derivation; Jetheth, an Edomite: - Jetheth.

H3510.firstSense: grieving, mar, have pain, make sad (sore), (be) sorrowful
H3510.full: kaw-ab' A primitive root; properly to feel pain; by implication to grieve; figuratively to spoil: - grieving, mar, have pain, make sad (sore), (be) sorrowful.

H3511.full: keh-abe' From H3510; suffering (physical or mental), adversity: - grief, pain, sorrow.

H3512.full: A primitive root; to despond; causatively to deject: - broken, be grieved, make sad.

H3513.firstSense: abounding with, more grievously afflict, boast, be chargeable, X be dim, glorify, be (m…
H3513.full: A primitive root; to be heavy, that is, in a bad sense (burdensome, severe, dull) or in a good sense (numerous, rich, honorable); causatively to make weighty (in the same two senses): - abounding with, more grievously afflict, boast, be chargeable, X be dim, glorify, be (make) glorious (things), glory, (very) great, be grievous, harden, be (make) heavy, be heavier, lay heavily, (bring to, come to, do, get, be had in) honour (self), (be) honourable (man), lade, X more be laid, make self many, nobles, prevail, promote (to honour), be rich, be (go) sore, stop.

H3514.full: From H3513; weight, multitude, vehemence: - grievousness, heavy, great number.

H3515.firstSense: (so) great, grievous, hard (-ened), (too) heavy (-ier), laden, much, slow, sore, thick
H3515.full: From H3513; heavy; figuratively in a good sense (numerous) or in a bad sense (severe, difficult, stupid): - (so) great, grievous, hard (-ened), (too) heavy (-ier), laden, much, slow, sore, thick.

H3516.full: The same as H3515; the liver (as the heaviest of the viscera): - liver.

H3517.full: Feminine of H3515; difficulty: - X heavily.

H3518.full: A primitive root; to expire or (causatively) to extinguish (fire, light, anger): - go (put) out, quench.

H3519.full: From H3513; properly weight; but only figuratively in a good sense, splendor or copiousness: - glorious (-ly), glory, honour (-able).

H3520.full: Irregular feminine passive participle of H3513; weightiness; that is, magnificence, wealth: - carriage, all glorious, stately.

H3521.full: From the same as H3525 in the sense of limitation; sterile; Cabul, the name of two places in Palestine: - Cabul.

H3522.full: From an unused root meaning to heap up; hilly; Cabbon, a place in Palestine: - Cabbon.

H3523.full: kebı̂yr keb-eer From H3527 in the original sense of plaiting; a matrass (of intertwined materials): - pillow.

H3524.firstSense: + feeble, mighty, most, much, strong, valiant
H3524.full: From H3727; vast, whether in extent (figuratively of power, mighty; of time, aged), or in number, many: - + feeble, mighty, most, much, strong, valiant.

H3525.full: From an unused root meaning to twine or braid together; a fetter: - fetter.

H3526.full: A primitive root; to trample; hence to wash (properly by stamping with the feet), whether literally (including the fulling process) or figuratively: - fuller, wash (-ing).

H3527.full: A primitive root; properly to plait together, that is, (figuratively) to augment (especially in number or quantity, to accumulate): - in abundance, multiply.

H3528.full: From H3527; properly extent of time, that is, a great while; hence long ago, formerly, hitherto: - already, (seeing that which), now.

H3529.full: The same as H3528; length; Kebar, a river of Mesopotamia: - Chebar. Compare H2249.

H3530.full: Feminine of H3528; properly length, that is, a measure (of uncertain dimension): - X little.

H3531.full: From H3527 in its original sense; a sieve (as netted): - sieve.

H3532.full: From an unused root meaning to dominate; a ram (just old enough to butt): - lamb, sheep.

H3533.firstSense: bring into bondage, force, keep under, subdue, bring into subjection
H3533.full: A primitive root; to tread down; hence negatively to disregard; positively to conquer, subjugate, violate: - bring into bondage, force, keep under, subdue, bring into subjection.

H3534.full: From H3533; a footstool (as trodden upon): - footstool.

H3535.full: Feminine of H3532; a ewe: - (ewe) lamb.

H3536.full: From H3533; a smelting furnace (as reducing metals): - furnace.

H3537.full: kad kad From an unused root meaning to deepen; properly a pail; but generally of earthenware; a jar for domestic purposes: - barrel, pitcher.

H3538.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H3576; false: - lying.

H3539.full: From the same as H3537 in the sense of striking fire from a metal forged; a sparkling gem, probably the ruby: - agate.

H3540.full: Of foreign origin; Kedorlaomer, an early Persian king: - Chedorlaomer.

H3541.firstSense: also, here, + hitherto, like, on the other side, so (and much), such, on that manner, (…
H3541.full: kôh ko From the prefix K and H1931; properly like this, that is, by implication (of manner) thus (or so); also (of place) here (or hither); or (of time) now: - also, here, + hitherto, like, on the other side, so (and much), such, on that manner, (on) this (manner, side, way, way and that way), + mean while, yonder.

H3542.full: kâh kaw (Chaldee); corresponding to H3541: - hitherto.

H3543.firstSense: darken, be dim, fail, faint, restrain, X utterly
H3543.full: A primitive root; to be weak, that is, (figuratively) to despond (causatively rebuke), or (of light, the eye) to grow dull: - darken, be dim, fail, faint, restrain, X utterly.

H3544.firstSense: somewhat dark, darkish, wax dim, heaviness, smoking
H3544.full: From H3543; feeble, obscure: - somewhat dark, darkish, wax dim, heaviness, smoking.

H3545.full: Feminine of H3544; properly a weakening; figuratively alleviation, that is, cure: - healing.

H3546.full: (Chaldee); a root corresponding to H3201 and H3557; to be able: - be able, could.

H3547.firstSense: deck, be (do the office of a, execute the, minister in the) priest ('s office)
H3547.full: A primitive root, apparently meaning to mediate in religious services; but used only as denominative from H3548; to officiate as a priest; figuratively to put on regalia: - deck, be (do the office of a, execute the, minister in the) priest ('s office).

H3548.firstSense: chief ruler, X own, priest, prince, principal officer
H3548.full: Active participle of H3547; literally one officiating, a priest; also (by courtesy) an acting priest (although a layman): - chief ruler, X own, priest, prince, principal officer.

H3550.full: From H3547; priesthood: - priesthood, priest's office.

H3551.full: kav kav (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H3854 in the sense of piercing; a window (as a perforation): - window.

H3552.full: kûb koob Of foreign derivation; Kub, a country near Egypt: - Chub.

H3553.full: From an unused root meaning to be high or rounded; a helmet (as arched): - helmet. Compare H6959.

H3554.full: A primitive root; properly to prick or penetrate; hence to blister (as smarting or eating into): - burn.

H3556.full: Probably from the same as H3522 (in the sense of rolling) or H3554 (in the sense of blazing); a star (as round or as shining); figuratively a prince: - star ([-gazer]).

H3557.firstSense: (be able to, can) abide, bear, comprehend, contain, feed, forbearing, guide, hold (-ing…
H3557.full: kûl kool A primitive root; properly to keep in; hence to measure; figuratively to maintain (in various senses): - (be able to, can) abide, bear, comprehend, contain, feed, forbearing, guide, hold (-ing in), nourish (-er), be present, make provision, receive, sustain, provide sustenance (victuals).

H3558.full: From an unused root meaning to store away; a jewel (probably gold beads): - tablet.

H3559.firstSense: certain (-ty), confirm, direct, faithfulness, fashion, fasten, firm, be fitted, be fixe…
H3559.full: kûn koon A primitive root; properly to be erect (that is, stand perpendicular);. hence (causatively) to set up, in a great variety of applications, whether literal (establish, fix, prepare, apply), or figurative (appoint, render sure, proper or prosperous): - certain (-ty), confirm, direct, faithfulness, fashion, fasten, firm, be fitted, be fixed, frame, be meet, ordain, order, perfect, (make) preparation, prepare (self), provide, make provision, (be, make) ready, right, set (aright, fast, forth), be stable, (e-) stablish, stand, tarry, X very deed.

H3560.full: kûn koon Probably from H3559; established; Kun, a place in Syria: - Chun.

H3561.full: From H3559; something prepared, that is, a sacrificial wafer: - cake.

H3562.full: From H3559 and H3050; Jah has sustained; Conanjah, the name of two Israelites: - Conaniah, Cononiah. Compare H3663.

H3563.full: kôs koce From an unused root meaning to hold together; a cup (as a container), often figuratively a lot (as if a potion); also some unclean bird, probably an owl (perhaps from the cup like cavity of its eye): - cup, (small) owl. Compare H3599.

H3564.full: kûr koor From an unused root meaning properly to dig through; a pot or furnace (as if excavated): - furnace. Compare H3600.

H3565.full: From H3564 and H6227; furnace of smoke; Cor-Ashan, a place in Palestine: - Chor-ashan.

H3566.full: From the Persian; Koresh (or Cyrus), the Persian king: - Cyrus.

H3568.full: kûsh koosh Probably of foreign origin; Cush (or Ethiopia), the name of a son of Ham, and of his territory; also of an Israelite: - Chush, Cush, Ethiopia.

H3569.full: Patronymic from H3568; a Cushite, or descendant of Cush: - Cushi, Cushite, Ethiopian (-s).

H3570.full: The same as H3569; Cushi, the name of two Israelites: - Cushi.

H3571.full: Feminine of H3569; a Cushite woman: - Ethiopian.

H3572.full: Perhaps from H3568; Cushan, a region of Arabia: - Cushan.

H3573.full: Apparently from H3572 and the dual of H7564; Cushan of double wickedness; Cushan-Rishathajim, a Mesopotamian king: - Chushan-rishathayim.

H3574.full: From H3787; prosperity; in plural freedom: - X chain.

H3575.full: Of foreign origin; Cuth or Cuthah, a province of Assyria: - Cuth.

H3576.firstSense: fail, (be found a, make a) liar, lie, lying, be in vain
H3576.full: A primitive root; to lie (that is, deceive), literally or figuratively: - fail, (be found a, make a) liar, lie, lying, be in vain.

H3577.firstSense: deceitful, false, leasing, + liar, lie, lying
H3577.full: From H3576; falsehood; literally (untruth) or figuratively (idol): - deceitful, false, leasing, + liar, lie, lying.

H3578.full: ko-zeb-aw' From H3576; fallacious; Cozeba, a place in Palestine: - Choseba.

H3579.full: From H3576; false; Cozbi, a Midianitess: - Cozbi.

H3580.full: From H3576; falsified; Kezib, a place in Palestine: - Chezib.

H3581.firstSense: ability, able, chameleon, force, fruits, might, power (-ful), strength, substance, wealth
H3581.full: From an unused root meaning to be firm; vigor, literally (force, in a good or a bad sense) or figuratively (capacity, means, produce); also (from its hardiness) a large lizard: - ability, able, chameleon, force, fruits, might, power (-ful), strength, substance, wealth.

H3582.full: A primitive root; to secrete, by act or word; hence (intensively) to destroy: - conceal, cut down (off), desolate, hide.

H3583.full: A primitive root; to paint (with stibium): - paint.

H3584.firstSense: deceive, deny, dissemble, fail, deal falsely, be found liars, (be-) lie, lying, submit…
H3584.full: A primitive root; to be untrue, in word (to lie, feign, disown) or deed (to disappoint, fail, cringe): - deceive, deny, dissemble, fail, deal falsely, be found liars, (be-) lie, lying, submit selves.

H3585.full: From H3584; literally a failure of flesh, that is, emaciation; figuratively hypocrisy: - leanness, lies, lying.

H3587.full: kı̂y kee From H3554; a brand or scar: - burning.

H3588.firstSense: and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured [-ly], + but, certainly, doubtless, +…
H3588.full: kı̂y kee A primitive particle (the full form of the prepositional prefix) indicating causal relations of all kinds, antecedent or consequent; (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjugation or adverb; often largely modified by other particles annexed: - and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured [-ly], + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, who, yea, yet,

H3589.full: kı̂yd keed From a primitive root meaning to strike; a crushing; figuratively calamity: - destruction.

H3590.full: From the same as H3589 (compare H3539); properly something struck off, that is, a spark (as struck): - spark.

H3591.full: From the same as H3589; properly something to strike with, that is, a dart (perhaps smaller than H2595): - lance, shield, spear, target.

H3592.full: The same as H3591; Kidon, a place in Palestine: - Chidon.

H3593.full: Of uncertain derivation; perhaps tumult: - battle.

H3594.full: From H3559; properly a statue, that is, idol; but used (by euphemism) for some heathen deity (perhaps corresponding to Priapus or Baal-peor): - Chiun.

H3595.full: From the same as H3564; properly something round (as excavated or bored), that is, a chafing dish for coals or a caldron for cooking; hence (from similarity of form) a washbowl; also (for the same reason) a pulpit or platform: - hearth, laver, pan, scaffold.

H3596.full: From H3557 in the sense of withholding; niggardly: - churl.

H3597.full: From an unused root meaning to clap or strike with noise; a club or sledge hammer: - hammer.

H3598.full: From the same as H3558; a cluster of stars, that is, the Pleiades: - Pleiades, seven stars.

H3599.full: kı̂ys keece A form for H3563; a cup; also a bag for money or weights: - bag, cup, purse.

H3600.full: kı̂yr keer A form for H3564 (only in the dual); a cooking range (consisting of two parallel stones, across which the boiler is set): - ranges for pots.

H3601.full: From H3787; literally a director, that is, the spindle or shank of a distaff (H6418) by which it is twirled: - spindle.

H3602.firstSense: after that (this) manner, this matter, (even) so, in such a case, thus
H3602.full: From H3541; just so, referring to the previous or following context: - after that (this) manner, this matter, (even) so, in such a case, thus.

H3603.full: From H3769; a circle, that is, (by implication) a circumjacent tract or region, especially the Ghor or valley of the Jordan; also a (round) loaf; also a talent (or large (round) coin): - loaf, morsel, piece, plain, talent.

H3604.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H3603; a talent: - talent.

H3605.firstSense: (in) all (manner, [ye]), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), h…
H3605.full: ëּåì ëּìo kôl kôl kole, kole From H3634; properly the whole; hence all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense): - (in) all (manner, [ye]), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, [no-] thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso (-ever).

H3606.firstSense: all, any, + (forasmuch) as, + be- (for this) cause, every, + no (manner, -ne), + there…
H3606.full: kôl kole (Chaldee); corresponding to H3605: - all, any, + (forasmuch) as, + be- (for this) cause, every, + no (manner, -ne), + there (where) -fore, + though, what (where, who) -soever, (the) whole.

H3607.firstSense: finish, forbid, keep (back), refrain, restrain, retain, shut up, be stayed, withhold
H3607.full: A primitive root; to restrict, by act (hold back or in) or word (prohibit): - finish, forbid, keep (back), refrain, restrain, retain, shut up, be stayed, withhold.

H3608.full: keh'-leh From H3607; a prison: - prison. Compare H3610, H3628.

H3609.full: kil-awb' Apparently from H3607 and H1; restraint of (his) father; Kilab, an Israelite: - Chileab.

H3610.full: kil-ah'-yim Dual of H3608 in the original sense of separation; two heterogeneities: - divers seeds (-e kinds), mingled (seed).

H3611.full: From an unused root meaning to yelp, or else to attack; a dog; hence (by euphemism) a male prostitute: - dog.

H3612.full: Perhaps a form of H3611, or else from the same root in the sense of forcible; Caleb, the name of three Israelites: - Caleb.

H3613.full: kaw-labe' ef-raw'-thaw From H3612 and H672; Caleb-Ephrathah, a place in Egypt (if the text is correct): - Caleb-ephrathah.

H3614.full: The first form is probably by erroneous transcription for the second form; patronymic from H3612; a Calebite or descendant of Caleb: - of the house of Caleb.

H3615.firstSense: accomplish, cease, consume (away), determine, destroy (utterly), be (when
H3615.full: A primitive root; to end, whether intransitively (to cease, be finished, perish) or transitively (to complete, prepare, consume): - accomplish, cease, consume (away), determine, destroy (utterly), be (when . . . were) done, (be an) end (of), expire, (cause to) fail, faint, finish, fulfil, X fully, X have, leave (off), long, bring to pass, wholly reap, make clean riddance, spend, quite take away, waste.

H3617.firstSense: altogether, (be, utterly) consume (-d), consummation (-ption), was determined, (full, u…
H3617.full: From H3615; a completion; adverbially completely; also destruction: - altogether, (be, utterly) consume (-d), consummation (-ption), was determined, (full, utter) end, riddance.

H3618.full: From H3634; a bride (as if perfect); hence a son's wife: - bride, daughter-in-law, spouse.

H3619.full: From the same as H3611; a bird trap (as furnished with a clapstick or treadle to spring it); hence a basket (as resembling a wicker cage): - basket, cage.

H3620.full: The same as H3619; Kelub, the name of two Israelites: - Chelub.

H3621.full: A form of H3612; Kelubai, an Israelite: - Chelubai.

H3622.full: From H3615; completed; Keluhai, an Israelite: - Chelluh.

H3623.full: Denominative passive participle from H3618; bridehood (only in the plural): - espousal.

H3624.full: From an unused root meaning to be complete; maturity: - full (old) age.

H3625.full: The same as H3624; Kelach, a place in Assyria: - Calah.

H3626.full: From H3605 and H2374; every seer; Col-Cho-zeh, an Israelite: - Col-hozeh.

H3627.firstSense: armour ([-bearer]), artillery, bag, carriage, + furnish, furniture, instrument, jewel,…
H3627.full: From H3615; something prepared, that is, any apparatus (as an implement, utensil, dress, vessel or weapon): - armour ([-bearer]), artillery, bag, carriage, + furnish, furniture, instrument, jewel, that is made of, X one from another, that which pertaineth, pot, + psaltery, sack, stuff, thing, tool, vessel, ware, weapon, + whatsoever.

H3628.full: kel-ee', kel-oo' From H3607 (compare H3608); a prison: - prison.

H3629.full: Feminine of H3627 (only in the plural); a kidney (as an essential organ); figuratively the mind (as the interior self): - kidneys, reins.

H3630.full: A form of H3631; Kiljon, an Israelite: - Chilion.

H3631.full: From H3615; pining, destruction: - consumption, failing.

H3632.firstSense: all, every whit, flame, perfect (-ion), utterly, whole burnt offering (sacrifice), wholly
H3632.full: From H3634; complete; as noun, the whole (specifically a sacrifice entirely consumed); as adverb fully: - all, every whit, flame, perfect (-ion), utterly, whole burnt offering (sacrifice), wholly.

H3633.full: From H3557; sustenance; Calcol, an Israelite: - Calcol, Chalcol.

H3634.full: A primitive root; to complete: - (make) perfect.

H3635.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H3634; to complete: - finish, make (set) up.

H3636.full: From H3634; complete; Kelal, an Israelite: - Chelal.

H3637.firstSense: be (make) ashamed, blush, be confounded, be put to confusion, hurt, reproach, (do, put…
H3637.full: A primitive root; properly to wound; but only figuratively, to taunt or insult: - be (make) ashamed, blush, be confounded, be put to confusion, hurt, reproach, (do, put to) shame.
