H3638.full: Of foreign derivation; Kilmad, a place apparently in the Assyrian empire: - Chilmad.

H3639.full: From H3637; disgrace: - confusion, dishonour, reproach, shame.

H3641.full: Of foreign derivation; Calneh or Calno, a place in the Assyrian empire: - Calneh, Calno. Compare H3656.

H3642.full: A primitive root; to pine after: - long.

H3643.full: From H3642; pining; Kimham, an Israelite: - Chimham.

H3644.firstSense: according to, (such) as (it were, well as), in comparison of, like (as, to, unto), thus…
H3644.full: A form of the prefix K, but used separately (compare H3651); as, thus, so: - according to, (such) as (it were, well as), in comparison of, like (as, to, unto), thus, when, worth.

H3645.full: From an unused root meaning to subdue; the powerful; Kemosh, the god of the Moabites: - Chemosh.

H3646.full: From an unused root meaning to store up or preserve; "cummin" (from its use as a condiment): - cummin.

H3647.full: A primitive root; to store away, that is, (figuratively) in the memory: - lay up in store.

H3648.full: A primitive root; properly to intertwine or contract, that is, (by implication) to shrivel (as with heat); figuratively to be deeply affected with passion (love or pity): - be black, be kindled, yearn.

H3649.full: From H3648; properly an ascetic (as if shrunk with self maceration), that is, an idolatrous priest (only in plural): - Chemarims, (idolatrous) priests.

H3650.full: Reduplicated from H3648; obscuration (as if from shrinkage of light), that is, an eclipse (only in plural): - black-ness.

H3651.full: kên kane From H3559; properly set upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) just; but usually (as adverb or conjugation) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles): - + after that (this, -ward, -wards), as . . . as, + [for-] asmuch as yet, + be (for which) cause, + following, howbeit, in (the) like (manner, -wise), X the more, right, (even) so, state, straightway, such (thing), surely, + there (where) -fore, this, thus, true, well, X you.

H3652.full: kên kane (Chaldee); corresponding to H3651; so: - thus.

H3653.firstSense: base, estate, foot, office, place, well
H3653.full: kên kane The same as H3651, used as a noun; a stand, that is, pedestal or station: - base, estate, foot, office, place, well.

H3654.full: kên kane From H3661 in the sense of fastening; a gnat (from infixing its sting; used only in plural (and irregularly in Exo_8:17, Exo_8:18; Heb_13:14): - lice, X manner.

H3655.full: A primitive root; to address by an additional name; hence, to eulogize: - give flattering titles, surname (himself).

H3656.full: For H3641; Canneh, a place in Assyria: - Canneh

H3657.full: From H3661; a plant (as set): - X vineyard.

H3658.full: From an unused root meaning to twang; a harp: - harp.

H3659.full: For H3204; Conjah, an Israelite king: - Coniah.

H3660.full: ken-ay-maw' (Chaldee); corresponding to H3644; so or thus: - so, (in) this manner (sort), thus.

H3661.full: A primitive root; to set out, that is, plant: - X vineyard.

H3662.full: From H3661; planted; Kenani, an Israelite: - Chenani.

H3663.full: From H3661 and H3050; Jah has planted; Kenanjah, an Israelite: - Chenaniah.

H3664.full: A primitive root; to collect; hence, to enfold: - gather (together), heap up, wrap self.

H3665.firstSense: bring down (low), into subjection, under, humble (self), subdue
H3665.full: A primitive root; properly to bend the knee; hence to humiliate, vanquish: - bring down (low), into subjection, under, humble (self), subdue.

H3666.full: From H3665 in the sense of folding (compare H3664); a package: - wares.

H3667.full: From H3665; humiliated; Kenaan, a son of Ham; also the country inhabited by him: - Canaan, merchant, traffick.

H3668.full: Feminine of H3667; Kenaanah, the name of two Israelites: - Chenaanah.

H3669.full: Patrial from H3667; a Kenaanite or inhabitant of Kenaan; by implication a pedlar (the Cananites standing for their neighbors the Ishmaelites, who conducted mercantile caravans): - Canaanite, merchant, trafficker.

H3670.full: A primitive root; properly to project laterally, that is, probably (reflexively) to withdraw: - be removed.

H3671.firstSense: + bird, border, corner, end, feather [-ed], X flying, + (one an-) other, overspreading,…
H3671.full: From H3670; an edge or extremity; specifically (of a bird or army) a wing, (of a garment or bed clothing) a flap, (of the earth) a quarter, (of a building) a pinnacle: - + bird, border, corner, end, feather [-ed], X flying, + (one an-) other, overspreading, X quarters, skirt, X sort, uttermost part, wing ([-ed]).

H3672.full: Respectively plural and singular feminine from the same as H3658; perhaps harp shaped; Kinneroth or Kinnereth, a place in Palestine: - Chinnereth, Chinneroth, Cinneroth.

H3673.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H3664; to assemble: - gather together.

H3674.full: From H3655; a colleague (as having the same title): - companion.

H3676.full: kês kace Apparently a contraction for H3678, but probably by erroneous transcription for H5251: - sworn.

H3677.full: keh'-seh, keh'-seh Apparently from H3680; properly fulness or the full moon, that is, its festival: - (time) appointed.

H3678.full: kis-say', kis-say' From H3680; properly covered, that is, a throne (as canopied): - seat, stool, throne.

H3680.firstSense: clad self, close, clothe, conceal, cover (self), (flee to) hide, overwhelm
H3680.full: A primitive root; properly to plump, that is, fill up hollows; by implication to cover (for clothing or secrecy): - clad self, close, clothe, conceal, cover (self), (flee to) hide, overwhelm. Compare H3780.

H3681.full: Passive participle of H3680; properly covered, that is, (as noun) a covering: - covering.

H3682.full: From H3680; a cover (garment); figuratively a veiling: - covering, raiment, vesture.

H3683.full: A primitive root; to cut off: - cut down (up).

H3684.full: From H3688; properly fat, that is, (figuratively) stupid or silly: - fool (-ish).

H3685.full: The same as H3684; any notable constellation; specifically Orion (as if a burly one): - constellation, Orion.

H3686.full: The same as H3684; Kesil, a place in Palestine: - Chesil.

H3688.full: A primitive root; properly to be fat, that is, (figuratively) silly: - be foolish.

H3689.full: From H3688; properly fatness, that is, by implication (literally) the loin (as the seat of the leaf fat) or (generally) the viscera; also (figuratively) silliness or (in a good sense) trust: - confidence, flank, folly, hope, loin.

H3690.full: Feminine of H3689; in a good sense, trust; in a bad one, silliness: - confidence, folly.

H3691.full: Probably of foreign origin; Kisleu, the ninth Hebrew month: - Chisleu.

H3692.full: From H3688; hopeful; Kislon, an Israelite: - Chislon.

H3693.full: From H3688; fertile; Kesalon, a place in Palestine: - Chesalon.

H3694.full: Feminine plural of passive participle of H3688; fattened, Kesulloth, a place in Palestine: - Chesulloth.

H3695.full: A plural probably of foreign derivation; Casluchim, a people cognate to the Egyptian: - Casluhim.

H3696.full: From the feminine plural of H3689 and H8396; flanks of Tabor; Kisloth Tabor, a place in Palestine: - Chisloth-tabor.

H3697.full: A primitive root; to shear: - X only, poll. Compare H3765.

H3698.full: From H3697; spelt (from its bristliness as if just shorn): - fitches, rie.

H3699.full: A primitive root; to estimate: - make count.

H3700.full: A primitive root; properly to become pale, that is, (by implication) to pine after; also to fear: - [have] desire, be greedy, long, sore.

H3701.full: From H3700; silver (from its pale color); by implication money: - money, price, silver (-ling).

H3703.full: kaw-sif-yaw' Perhaps from H3701; silvery; Casiphja, a place in Babylon: - Casiphia.

H3704.full: From H3680; a cushion or pillow (as covering a seat or bed): - pillow.

H3706.full: (Chaldee); feminine of H3705; thus (only in the formula "and so forth"): - at such a time.

H3707.firstSense: be angry, be grieved, take indignation, provoke (to anger, unto wrath), have sorrow, ve…
H3707.full: A primitive root; to trouble; by implication to grieve, rage, be indignant: - be angry, be grieved, take indignation, provoke (to anger, unto wrath), have sorrow, vex, be wroth.

H3708.firstSense: anger, angry, grief, indignation, provocation, provoking, X sore, sorrow, spite, wrath
H3708.full: From H3707; vexation: - anger, angry, grief, indignation, provocation, provoking, X sore, sorrow, spite, wrath.

H3709.firstSense: branch, + foot, hand ([-ful], -dle, [-led]), hollow, middle, palm, paw, power, sole, spoon
H3709.full: kaph kaf From H3721; the hollow hand or palm (so of the paw of an animal, of the sole, and even of the bowl of a dish or sling, the handle of a bolt, the leaves of a palm tree); figuratively power: - branch, + foot, hand ([-ful], -dle, [-led]), hollow, middle, palm, paw, power, sole, spoon.

H3710.full: kêph kafe From H3721; a hollow rock: - rock.

H3711.full: A primitive root; properly to bend, that is, (figuratively) to tame or subdue: - pacify.

H3712.full: Feminine of H3709; a leaf of a palm tree: - branch.

H3713.full: From H3722; properly a cover, that is, (by implication) a tankard (or covered goblet); also white frost (as covering the ground): - bason, hoar (-y) frost.

H3714.full: From an unused root meaning to connect; a girder: - beam.

H3715.full: From H3722; a village (as covered in by walls); also a young lion (perhaps as covered with a mane): - (young) lion, village. Compare H3723.

H3716.full: Feminine of H3715; the village (always with the article); Kephirah, a place in Palestine: - Chephirah.

H3717.full: A primitive root; to fold together; figuratively to repeat: - double.

H3719.full: A primitive root; to bend: - bend.

H3720.full: From H3719; hunger (as making to stoop with emptiness and pain): - famine.

H3721.full: A primitive root; to curve: - bow down (self).

H3722.firstSense: appease, make (an) atonement, cleanse, disannul, forgive, be merciful, pacify, pardon,…
H3722.full: A primitive root; to cover (specifically with bitumen); figuratively to expiate or condone, to placate or cancel: - appease, make (an) atonement, cleanse, disannul, forgive, be merciful, pacify, pardon, to pitch, purge (away), put off, (make) reconcile (-liation).

H3723.full: From H3722; a village (as protected by walls): - village. Compare H3715.

H3724.firstSense: bribe, camphire, pitch, ransom, satisfaction, sum of money, village
H3724.full: From H3722; properly a cover, that is, (literally) a village (as covered in); (specifically) bitumen (as used for coating), and the henna plant (as used for dyeing); figuratively a redemption price: - bribe, camphire, pitch, ransom, satisfaction, sum of money, village.

H3725.full: From H3722; expiation (only in plural): - atonement.

H3726.full: From H3723 and H5984, with the article interposed; village of the Ammonite; Kefarha Ammoni, a place in Palestine: - Chefar-haamonai.

H3727.full: From H3722; a lid (used only of the cover of the sacred Ark): - mercy seat.

H3728.full: A primitive root; to tread down; figuratively to humiliate: - cover.

H3729.full: (Chaldee); a root of uncertain correspondence; to fetter: - bind.

H3730.full: Probably from an unused root meaning to encircle; a chaplet; but used only in an architectonic sense, that is, the capital of a column, or a wreath like button or disk on the candelabrum: - knop, (upper) lintel.

H3731.full: Apparently the same as H3730; Caphtor (that is, a wreath shaped island), the original seat of the Philistines: - Caphtor.

H3732.full: Patrial from H3731; a Caphtorite (collectively) or native of Caphtor: - Caphthorim, Caphtorim (-s).

H3733.full: kar kar From H3769 in the sense of plumpness; a ram (as full grown and fat), including a battering ram (as butting); hence a meadow (as for sheep); also a pad or camel's saddle (as puffed out): - captain, furniture, lamb, (large) pasture, ram. See also H1033, H3746.

H3734.full: kôr kore From the same as H3564; properly a deep round vessel, that is, (specifically) a cor or measure for things dry. Chaldee the same: - cor, measure. Chaldee the same.

H3735.full: (Chaldee); probably corresponding to H3738 in the sense of piercing (figuratively); to grieve: - be grieved.

H3736.full: From the same as H3525; to gird or clothe: - clothed.

H3737.full: kar-bel-aw' (Chaldee); from a verb corresponding to that of H3736; a mantle: - hat.

H3738.full: A primitive root; properly to dig; figuratively to plot; generally to bore or open: - dig, X make (a banquet), open.

H3739.full: Usually assigned as a primitive root, but probably only a special application of H3738 (through the common idea of planning implied in a bargain); to purchase: - buy, prepare.

H3741.full: Feminine of H3733; a meadow: - cottage.

H3742.full: Of uncertain derivation; a cherub or imaginary figure: - cherub, [plural] cherubims.

H3743.full: The same as H3742; Kerub, a place in Babylon: - Cherub.

H3745.full: (Chaldee); probably of Greek origin [H2784]; to proclaim: - make a proclamation.

H3746.full: Perhaps an abridged plural of H3733 in the sense of leader (of the flock); a life guardsman: - captains, Cherethites [from the margin].

H3747.full: From H3772; a cut; Kerith, a brook of Palestine: - Cherith.

H3748.full: From H3772; a cutting (of the matrimonial bond), that is, divorce: - divorce (-ment).

H3749.full: Expanded from the same as H3522; a rim or top margin: - compassive

H3750.full: Probably of foreign origin; the crocus: - saffron.

H3751.full: Of foreign derivation; Karkemish, a place in Syria: - Carchemish.

H3752.full: Of Persian origin; Karkas, a eunuch of Xerxes: - Carcas.

H3753.full: From H3769; a dromedary (from its rapid motion as if dancing): - swift beast.

H3754.full: From an unused root of uncertain meaning; a garden or vineyard: - vines, (increase of the) vineyard (-s), vintage. See also H1021.

H3755.firstSense: vine dresser [as one or two words]
H3755.full: Active participle of an imaginary denominative from H3754; a vinedresser; as one or two words: - vine dresser [as one or two words].

H3756.full: From H3754; gardener; Karmi, the name of three Israelites: - Carmi.

H3757.full: Patronymic from H3756; a Karmite or descendant of Karmi: - Carmites.

H3758.full: Probably of foreign origin; carmine, a deep red: - crimson.

H3759.firstSense: full (green) ears (of corn), fruitful field (place), plentiful (field)
H3759.full: From H3754; a planted field (garden, orchard, vineyard or park); by implication garden produce: - full (green) ears (of corn), fruitful field (place), plentiful (field).

H3760.full: The same as H3759; Karmel, the name of a hill and of a town in Palestine: - Carmel, fruitful (plentiful) field, (place).

H3761.full: Patronymic from H3760; a Karmelite or inhabitant of Karmel (the town): - Carmelite.

H3762.full: Feminine of H3761; a Karmelitess or female inhabitant of Karmel: - Carmelitess.

H3763.full: Of uncertain derivation; Keran, an aboriginal Idumaean: - Cheran.

H3764.full: kor-say' (Chaldee); corresponding to H3678; a throne: - throne.

H3765.full: From H3697; to lay waste: - waste.

H3766.firstSense: bow (down, self), bring down (low), cast down, couch, fall, feeble, kneeling, sink, smi…
H3766.full: A primitive root; to bend the knee; by implication to sink, to prostrate: - bow (down, self), bring down (low), cast down, couch, fall, feeble, kneeling, sink, smite (stoop) down, subdue, X very.

H3767.full: From H3766; the leg (from the knee to the ankle) of men or locusts (only in the dual): - leg.

H3768.full: Of foreign origin; byssus or fine vegetable wool: - green.

H3769.full: A primitive root; to dance (that is, whirl): - dance (-ing).

H3770.full: By variation from H7164; the paunch or belly (as swelling out): - belly.

H3771.full: kar-shen-aw' Of foreign origin; Karshena, a courtier of Xerxes: - Carshena.

H3772.firstSense: be chewed, be con- [feder-] ate, covenant, cut (down, off), destroy, fail, feller, be f…
H3772.full: A primitive root; to cut (off, down or asunder); by implication to destroy or consume; specifically to covenant (that is, make an alliance or bargain, originally by cutting flesh and passing between the pieces): - be chewed, be con- [feder-] ate, covenant, cut (down, off), destroy, fail, feller, be freed, hew (down), make a league ([covenant]), X lose, perish, X utterly, X want.

H3773.full: Passive participle feminine of H3772; something cut, that is, a hewn timber: - beam.

H3774.full: Probably from H3772 in the sense of executioner; a Kerethite or life guardsman (compare H3876), (only collectively in the singular as plural): - Cherethims, Cherethites.

H3775.full: Apparently by transposition for H3532; a young sheep: - lamb, sheep.

H3776.full: Feminine of H3775; a young ewe: - lamb.

H3777.full: From an unused root of uncertain meaning; Kesed, a relative of Abraham: - Chesed.

H3778.full: (Occasionally shown as the second form with enclitic; meaning towards the Kasdites); patronymic from H3777 (only in the plural); a Kasdite, or descendant of Kesed; by implication a Chaldaean (as if so descended); also an astrologer (as if proverbial of that people): - into Chaldea), patronymicallyn. from H3777 (only in the plural); a Kasdite; or descendant of Kesed; by implication a Chaldan (as if so descended); also an astrologer (as if proverbial of that people): - Chaldeans, Chaldees, inhabitants of Chaldea.

H3779.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H3778; a Chaldaean or inhabitant of Chaldaea; by implication a Magian or professional astrologer: - Chaldean.

H3780.full: A primitive root; to grow fat (that is, be covered with flesh): - be covered. Compare H3680.

H3781.full: From H3782; properly a feller, that is, an axe: - ax.

H3782.firstSense: bereave [from the margin], cast down, be decayed, (cause to) fail, (cause, make to) fal…
H3782.full: A primitive root; to totter or waver (through weakness of the legs, especially the ankle); by implication to falter, stumble, faint or fall: - bereave [from the margin], cast down, be decayed, (cause to) fail, (cause, make to) fall (down, -ing), feeble, be (the) ruin (-ed, of), (be) overthrown, (cause to) stumble, X utterly, be weak.

H3783.full: From H3782; properly a tottering, that is, ruin: - fall.

H3784.full: A primitive root; properly to whisper a spell, that is, to inchant or practise magic: - sorcerer, (use) witch (-craft).

H3787.full: A primitive root properly to be straight or right; by implication to be acceptable; also to succeed or proser: - direct, be right, prosper.

H3788.full: From H3787; success, advantage: - equity, good, right.

H3789.full: A primitive root; to grave; by implication to write (describe, inscribe, prescribe, subscribe): - describe, record, prescribe, subscribe, write (-ing, -ten).

H3791.full: From H3789; something written, that is, a writing, record or book: - register, scripture, writing.

H3793.full: From H3789; a letter or other mark branded on the skin: - X any [mark].

H3794.full: Patrial from an unused name denoting Cyprus (only in the plural); a Kittite or Cypriote; hence an islander in general, that is, the Greeks or Romans on the shores opposite Palestine: - Chittim, Kittim.

H3795.full: From H3807; beaten, that is, pure (oil): - beaten.

H3796.full: From an unused root meaning to compact; a wall (as gathering inmates): - wall.

H3798.full: From H3796 and H376; wall of a man; Kithlish, a place in Palestine: - Kithlish.

H3799.full: A primitive root; properly to carve or engrave, that is, (by implication) to inscribe indelibly: - mark.

H3800.full: From H3799; properly something carved out, that is, ore; hence gold (pure as originally mined): - ([most] fine, pure) gold (-en wedge).

H3801.full: From an unused root meaning to cover (compare H3802); a shirt: - coat, garment, robe.

H3802.full: From an unused root meaning to clothe; the shoulder (proper, that is, upper end of the arm; as being the spot where the garments hang); figuratively side piece or lateral projection or anything: - arm, corner, shoulder (-piece), side, undersetter.

H3803.firstSense: beset round, compass about, be crowned inclose round, suffer
H3803.full: A primitive root; to enclose; hence (in a friendly sense) to crown, (in a hostile one) to besiege; also to wait (as restraining oneself): - beset round, compass about, be crowned inclose round, suffer.

H3804.full: From H3803; properly a circlet, that is, a diadem: - crown.

H3805.full: Feminine active participle of H3803; the capital of a column: - chapiter.

H3806.full: A primitive root; to butt or pound: - bray.

H3807.firstSense: beat (down, to pieces), break in pieces, crushed, destroy, discomfit, smite, stamp
H3807.full: A primitive root; to bruise or violently strike: - beat (down, to pieces), break in pieces, crushed, destroy, discomfit, smite, stamp.

H3808.firstSense: X before, + or else, ere, + except, ig [-norant], much, less, nay, neither, never, no (…
H3808.full: lo; a primitive particle; not (the simple or abstract negation); by implication no; often used with other particles: - X before, + or else, ere, + except, ig [-norant], much, less, nay, neither, never, no ([-ne], -r, [-thing]), (X as though . . . , [can-], for) not (out of), of nought, otherwise, out of, + surely, + as truly as, + of a truth, + verily, for want, + whether, without.

H3809.firstSense: or even, neither, no (-ne, -r), ([can-]) not, as nothing, without
H3809.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H3808: - or even, neither, no (-ne, -r), ([can-]) not, as nothing, without.

H3810.full: (1,2) lo deb-ar', lid-beer', lo-deb-ar' From H3808 and H1699; pastureless; lo Debar, a place in Palestine: - Debir, Lo-debar.
H3810.pronunciation: lô' debar lô debar lidbir lôdebar

H3811.full: A primitive root; to tire; (figuratively) to be (or make) disgusted: - faint, grieve, lothe, (be, make) weary (selves).

H3812.full: From H3811; weary; Leah, a wife of Jacob: - Leah.

H3813.full: A primitive root; to muffle: - cover.

H3814.full: From H3813 (or perhaps for active participle of H3874); properly muffled, that is, silently: - softly.

H3815.full: From the prepositional prefix and H410; (belonging) to God; Lael an Israelite: - Lael.

H3816.full: leh-ome', leh-ome' From an unused root meaning to gather; a community: - nation, people.

H3817.full: leh-oom-meem' Plural of H3816; communities; Leum mim, an Arabian: - Leummim.

H3818.full: From H3808 and H5971 with pronominal suffix, not my people; lo Ammi, the symbolical name of a son of Hosea: - Lo-ammi.

H3819.full: From H3808 and H7355; not pitied; lo Ruchamah, the symbolical name of a son of Hosea: - Lo-ruhamah.

H3820.firstSense: + care for, comfortably, consent, X considered, courag [-eous], friend [-ly], ([broken-…
H3820.full: lêb labe A form of H3824; the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything: - + care for, comfortably, consent, X considered, courag [-eous], friend [-ly], ([broken-], [hard-], [merry-], [stiff-], [stout-], double) heart ([-ed]), X heed, X I, kindly, midst, mind (-ed), X regard ([-ed)], X themselves, X unawares, understanding, X well, willingly, wisdom.

H3821.full: lêb labe (Chaldee); corresponding to H3820: - heart.

H3822.full: leb-aw-oth' Plural of H3833; lionesses; Lebaoth, a place in Palestine: - Lebaoth. See also H1034.

H3823.full: A primitive root; properly to be enclosed (as if with fat); by implication (as denominative from H3824) to unheart, that is, (in a good sense) transport (with love), or (in a bad sense) stultify; also (as denominative from H3834) to make cakes: - make cakes, ravish, be wise.

H3824.firstSense: + bethink themselves, breast, comfortably, courage, ([faint], [tender-] heart([-ed]), m…
H3824.full: From H3823; the heart (as the most interior organ); used also like H3820: - + bethink themselves, breast, comfortably, courage, ([faint], [tender-] heart([-ed]), midst, mind, X unawares, understanding.

H3826.full: Feminine of H3820; the heart: - heart.

H3828.full: From H3826; frankincense (from its whiteness or perhaps that of its smoke): - (frank-) incense.

H3829.full: The same as H3828; Lebonah, a place in Palestine: - Lebonah.

H3830.firstSense: apparel, clothed with, clothing, garment, raiment, vestment, vesture
H3830.full: From H3847; a garment (literally or figuratively); by implication (euphemistically) a wife: - apparel, clothed with, clothing, garment, raiment, vestment, vesture.

H3832.full: A primitive root; to overthrow; intransitively to fall: - fall.

H3833.full: law-bee' leb-ee-yaw' leb-aw-eem' (-oth') From an unused root meaning to roar; a lion (properly a lioness as the fiercer (although not a roarer; compare H738)): - (great, old, stout) lion, lioness, young [lion].

H3834.full: From H3823 in its original sense of fatness (or perhaps of folding); a cake (either as fried or turned): - cake.

H3835.full: A primitive root; to be (or become) white; also (as denominative from H3843) to make bricks: - make brick, be (made, make) white (-r).

H3837.full: The same as H3836; Laban, a Mesopotamian; also a place in the Desert: - Laban.

H3838.full: leb-aw-naw', leb-aw-naw' The same as H3842; Lebana or Lebanah, one of the Nethinim: - Lebana, Lebanah.

H3839.full: From H3835; some sort of whitish tree, perhaps the storax: - poplar.

H3840.full: From H3835; properly whiteness, that is, (by implication) transparency: - paved.

H3841.full: The same as H3839; Libnah, a place in the Desert and one in Palestine: - Libnah.

H3842.full: From H3835; properly (the) white, that is, the moon: - moon. See also H3838.

H3843.full: From H3835; a brick (from the whiteness of the clay): - (altar of) brick, tile.

H3844.full: From H3825; (the) white mountain (from its snow); Lebanon, a mountain range in Palestine: - Lebanon.

H3845.full: From H3835; white; Libni, an Israelite: - Libni.

H3846.full: Patronymic from H3845; a Libnite or descendant of Libni (collectively): - Libnites.

H3847.firstSense: (in) apparel, arm, array (self), clothe (self), come upon, put (on, upon), wear
H3847.full: A primitive root; properly wrap around, that is, (by implication) to put on a garment or clothe (oneself, or another), literally or figuratively: - (in) apparel, arm, array (self), clothe (self), come upon, put (on, upon), wear.

H3849.full: lôg lohg From an unused root apparently meaning to deepen or hollow (like H3537); a log or measure for liquids: - log [of oil].

H3850.full: lôd lode From an unused root of uncertain signification; Lod, a place in Palestine: - Lod.

H3851.full: From an unused root meaning to gleam, a flash; figuratively a sharply polished blade or point of a weapon: - blade, bright, flame, glittering.

H3852.full: Feminine of H3851, and meaning the same: - flame (-ming), head [of a spear].

H3853.full: Plural of H3851; flames; Lehabim, a son of Mizrain, and his descendents: - Lehabim.

H3854.full: From an unused root meaning to be eager; intense mental application: - study.

H3855.full: From an unused root meaning to glow (compare H3851) or else to be earnest (compare H3854); Lahad, an Israelite: - Lahad.

H3856.full: A primitive root meaning properly to burn, that is, (by implication) to be rabid (figuratively insane); also (from the exhaustion of frenzy) to languish: - faint, mad.

H3857.firstSense: burn (up), set on fire, flaming, kindle
H3857.full: A primitive root; properly to lick, that is, (by implication) to blaze: - burn (up), set on fire, flaming, kindle.

H3858.full: From H3857; a blaze; also (from the idea of enwrapping) magic (as covert): - flaming, enchantment.

H3859.full: A primitive root; properly to burn in, that is, (figuratively) to rankle: - wound.

H3860.full: From the prefixed preposition meaning to or for and H2005; for if; hence therefore. for them by mistake for prepositional suffix: - for them [by mistake for prepositionsuffix].

H3861.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H3860; therefore; also except: - but, except, save, therefore, wherefore.

H3862.full: Probably from an unused root meaning to gather; an assembly: - company.

H3863.firstSense: if (haply), peradventure, I pray thee, though, I would, would God (that)
H3863.full: A conditional particle; if; by implication (interjectionally as a wish) would that!: - if (haply), peradventure, I pray thee, though, I would, would God (that).

H3864.full: Patrial from a name probably derived from an unused root meaning to thirst, that is, a dry region; apparently a Libyan or inhabitant of interior Africa (only in plural): - Lubim (-s), Libyans.

H3865.full: lûd lood Probably of foreign derivation; Lud, the name of two nations: - Lud, Lydia.

H3866.full: Patrial from H3865; a Ludite or inhabitant of Lud (ony in plural): - Ludim, Lydians.

H3867.firstSense: abide with, borrow (-er), cleave, join (self), lend (-er)
H3867.full: A primitive root; properly to twine, that is, (by implication) to unite, to remain; also to borrow (as a form of obligation) or (causatively) to lend: - abide with, borrow (-er), cleave, join (self), lend (-er).

H3868.full: lûz looz A primitive root; to turn aside (compare H3867, H3874 and H3885), that is, (literally) to depart, (figuratively) be perverse: - depart, froward, perverse (-ness).

H3869.full: lûz looz Probably of foreign origin; some kind of nut tree, perhaps the almond: - hazel.

H3870.full: lûz looz Probably from H3869 (as growing there); Luz, the name of two places in Palestine: - Luz.

H3871.full: From a primitive root; probably meaning to glisten; a tablet (as polished), of stone, wood or metal: - board, plate, table.

H3872.full: From the same as H3871; floored; Luchith, a place East of the Jordan: - Luhith.

H3873.full: Active participle of H3907; (the) enchanter; Lochesh, an Israelite: - Hallohesh, Haloshesh [includ. the article]

H3874.full: A primitive root; to wrap up: - cast, wrap.

H3876.full: The same as H3875; Lot, Abraham's nephew: - Lot.

H3877.full: From H3875; covering, Lotan, an Idumaean: - Lotan.

H3878.full: From H3867; attached; Levi, a son of Jacob: - Levi. See also H3879, H3881.

H3880.full: From H3867; something attached, that is, a wreath: - ornament.

H3881.full: Patronymic from H3878; a Leviite or descendant of Levi: - Levite.

H3882.full: From H3867; a wreathed animal, that is, a serpent (especially the crocodile or some other large sea monster); figuratively the constellation of the dragon; also as a symbol of Babylon: - leviathan, mourning.

H3883.full: lûl lool From an unused root meaning to fold back; a spiral step: - winding stair. Compare H3924.

H3884.full: From H3863 and H3808; if not: - except, had not, if (. . . not), unless, were it not that.

H3885.firstSense: abide (all night), continue, dwell, endure, grudge, be left, lie all night, (cause to)…
H3885.full: lûn lı̂yn loon, leen A primitive root; to stop (usually over night); by implication to stay permanently; hence (in a bad sense) to be obstinate (especially in words, to complain): - abide (all night), continue, dwell, endure, grudge, be left, lie all night, (cause to) lodge (all night, in, -ing, this night), (make to) murmur, remain, tarry (all night, that night).

H3886.full: A primitive root; to gulp; figuratively to be rash: - swallow down (up).

H3887.firstSense: ambassador, have in derision, interpreter, make a mock, mocker, scorn (-er, -ful), teacher
H3887.full: lûts loots A primitive root; properly to make mouths at, that is, to scoff; hence (from the effort to pronounce a foreign language) to interpret, or (generally) intercede: - ambassador, have in derision, interpreter, make a mock, mocker, scorn (-er, -ful), teacher.

H3888.full: lûsh loosh A primitive root; to knead: - knead.

H3889.full: lûsh loosh From H3888; kneading; Lush, a place in Palestine: - Laish [from the margin]. Compare H3919.

H3890.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H3867; properly adhesion, that is, (as preposition) with: - X thee.

H3892.full: lach lakh From an unused root meaning to be new; fresh, that is, unused or undried: - green, moist.

H3893.full: From the same as H3892; freshness, that is, vigor: - natural force.

H3894.full: Passive participle of H3898; properly eaten, that is, food; also flesh, that is, body: - while . . . is eating, flesh.

H3895.full: From an unused root meaning to be soft; the cheek (from its fleshiness); hence the jaw bone: - cheek (bone), jaw (bone).

H3896.full: A form of H3895; Lechi, a place in Palestine: - Lehi. Compare also H7437.

H3897.full: A primitive root; to lick: - lick (up).

H3898.firstSense: devour, eat, X ever, fight (-ing), overcome, prevail, (make) war (-ring)
H3898.full: A primitive root; to feed on; figuratively to consume; by implication to battle (as destruction): - devour, eat, X ever, fight (-ing), overcome, prevail, (make) war (-ring).

H3899.firstSense: ([shew-]) bread, X eat, food, fruit, loaf, meat, victuals
H3899.full: From H3898; food (for man or beast), especially bread, or grain (for making it): - ([shew-]) bread, X eat, food, fruit, loaf, meat, victuals. See also H1036.

H3902.full: From H3899; foodful; Lachmi, an Israelite; or rather probably a brief form (or perhaps an erroneous transcription) for H1022: - Lahmi. See also H3433.

H3903.full: From H3899; food like; Lachmam or Lachmas, a place in Palestine: - Lahmam.

H3904.full: (Chaldee); from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a concubine: - concubine.

H3905.firstSense: afflict, crush, force, hold fast, oppress (-or), thrust self
H3905.full: A primitive root; properly to press, that is, (figuratively) to distress: - afflict, crush, force, hold fast, oppress (-or), thrust self.

H3907.full: A primitive root; to whisper; by implication to mumble a spell (as a magician): - charmer, whisper (together).

H3908.full: From H3907; properly a whisper, that is, by implication (in a good sense) a private prayer, (in a bad one) an incantation; concretely an amulet: - charmed, earring, enchantment, orator, prayer.

H3909.full: A form of H3814 or else partly from H3874; properly covered, that is, secret; by implication incantation; also secrecy or (adverbially) covertly: - enchantment, privily, secretly, softly.

H3910.full: Probably from H3874; a gum (from its sticky nature), probably ladanum: - myrrh.

H3911.full: From an unused root meaning to hide; a kind of lizard (from its covert habits): - lizard.

H3912.full: Masculine plural of passive participle of H3913; hammered (that is, oppressed) ones; Letushim, an Arabian tribe: - Letushim.

H3913.full: A primitive root; properly to hammer out (an edge), that is, to sharpen: - instructer, sharp (-en), whet.

H3914.full: A form of H3880; a wreath: - addition.

H3915.full: From the same as H3883; properly a twist (away of the light), that is, night; figuratively adversity: - ([mid-]) night (season).

H3917.full: From H3915; a night spectre: - screech owl.

H3918.full: From H3888 in the sense of crushing; a lion (from his destructive blows): - (old) lion.

H3919.full: The same as H3918; Laish, the name of two places in Palestine: - Laish. Compare H3889.

H3920.firstSense: X at all, catch (self), be frozen, be holden, stick together, take
H3920.full: A primitive root; to catch (in a net, trap or pit); generally to capture or occupy; also to choose (by lot); figuratively to cohere: - X at all, catch (self), be frozen, be holden, stick together, take.

H3921.full: From H3920; something to capture with, that is, a noose: - being taken.

H3922.full: From H3212; a journey; lekah, a place in Palestine: - Lecah.

H3923.full: From an unused root of uncertain meaning; Lakish, a place in Palestine: - Lachish.

H3924.full: From the same as H3883; a loop: - loop.

H3925.firstSense: [un-] accustomed, X diligently, expert, instruct, learn, skilful, teach (-er, -ing)
H3925.full: A primitive root; properly to goad, that is, (by implication) to teach (the rod being an Oriental incentive): - [un-] accustomed, X diligently, expert, instruct, learn, skilful, teach (-er, -ing).

H3926.full: A prolonged and separable form of the prefixed preposition; to or for: - at, for, to, upon.

H3927.full: lem-oo-ale', lem-o-ale' From H3926 and H410; (belonging) to God; Lemuel or Lemoel, a symbolical name of Solomon: - Lemuel.

H3928.full: From H3925; instructed: - accustomed, disciple, learned, taught, used.

H3929.full: From an unused root of uncertain meaning; Lemek, the name of two antediluvian patriarchs: - Lamech.

H3931.full: A primitive root; to deride: - mock.

H3932.firstSense: have in derision, laugh (to scorn), mock (on), stammering
H3932.full: A primitive root; to deride; by implication (as if imitating a foreigner) to speak unintelligibly: - have in derision, laugh (to scorn), mock (on), stammering.

H3933.full: From H3932; derision, scoffing: - derision, scorn (-ing).

H3934.full: From H3932; a buffoon; also a foreigner: - mocker, stammering.

H3935.full: From an unused root of uncertain meaning; Ladah, an Israelite: - Laadah.

H3936.full: From the same as H3935; Ladan, the name of two Israelites: - Laadan.

H3937.full: A primitive root; to speak in a foreign tongue: - strange language.

H3938.full: A primitive root; to swallow greedily; causatively to feed: - feed.

H3939.full: From an unused root supposed to mean to curse; wormwood (regarded as poisonous, and therefore accursed): - hemlock, wormwood.

H3940.full: From an unused root probably meaning to shine; a flambeau, lamp or flame: - (fire-) brand, (burning) lamp, lightning, torch.

H3941.full: Feminine plural of H3940; Lappidoth, the husband of Deborah: - Lappidoth.

H3942.full: From the prefixed preposition (to or for) and H6440; anterior: - before.

H3943.full: A primitive root; properly to bend, that is, (by implication) to clasp; also (reflexively) to turn around or aside: - take hold, turn aside (self).

H3945.full: A primitive root; to deride: - scorn.

H3946.full: From an unused root thought to mean to stop up by a barricade; perhaps fortification; Lakkum, a place in Palestine: - Lakum.

H3947.firstSense: accept, bring, buy, carry away, drawn, fetch, get, infold, X many, mingle, place, recei…
H3947.full: A primitive root; to take (in the widest variety of applications): - accept, bring, buy, carry away, drawn, fetch, get, infold, X many, mingle, place, receive (-ing), reserve, seize, send for, take (away, -ing, up), use, win.

H3948.full: From H3947; properly something received, that is, (mentally) instruction (whether on the part of the teacher or hearer); also (in an active and sinister sense) inveiglement: - doctrine, learning, fair speech.

H3949.full: From H3947; learned; Likchi, an Israelite: - Likhi.

H3950.full: A primitive root; properly to pick up, that is, (generally) to gather; specifically to glean: - gather (up), glean.

H3952.full: A primitive root; to lick or lap: - lap, lick.

H3953.full: A primitive root; to gather the after crop: - gather.

H3954.full: From H3953; the after crop: - latter growth.

H3955.full: From an unused root of uncertain meaning; apparently juice, that is, (figuratively) vigor; also a sweet or fat cake: - fresh, moisture.

H3956.firstSense: + babbler, bay, + evil speaker, language, talker, tongue, wedge
H3956.full: From H3960; the tongue (of man or animals), used literally (as the instrument of licking, eating, or speech), and figuratively (speech, an ingot, a fork of flame, a cove of water): - + babbler, bay, + evil speaker, language, talker, tongue, wedge.

H3957.full: From an unused root of uncertain meaning; a room in a building (whether for storage, eating, or lodging): - chamber, parlour. Compare H5393.

H3958.full: From an unused root of uncertain meaning; a gem, perhaps the jacinth: - ligure.

H3959.full: The same as H3958; Leshem, a place in Palestine: - Leshem.

H3960.full: A primitive root; properly to lick; but used only as a denominative from H3956; to wag the tongue, that is, to calumniate: - accuse, slander.

H3961.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H3956; speech, that is, a nation: - language.

H3962.full: From an unused root thought to mean to break through; a boiling spring; Lesha, a place probably East of the Jordan: - Lasha.

H3963.full: From an unused root of uncertain meaning; a measure for things dry: - half homer.

H3964.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H4100; (as indefinite) that: - + what.

H3965.full: mah-ab-ooce' From H75; a granary: - storehouse.

H3966.firstSense: diligently, especially, exceeding (-ly), far, fast, good, great (-ly), X louder and lou…
H3966.full: meh-ode' From the same as H181; properly vehemence, that is, (with or without preposition) vehemently; by implication wholly, speedily, etc. (often with other words as an intensive or superlative; especially when repeated): - diligently, especially, exceeding (-ly), far, fast, good, great (-ly), X louder and louder, might (-ily, -y), (so) much, quickly, (so) sore, utterly, very (+ much, sore), well.

H3967.full: Probably a primitive numeral; a hundred; also as a multiplicative and a fraction: - hundred ([-fold], -th), + sixscore.

H3968.full: The same as H3967; Meah, a tower in Jerusalem: - Meah.

H3970.full: mah-av-ah'ee From H183; a desire: - desire.

H3971.full: moom, moom As if passive participle from an unused root probably meaning to stain; a blemish (physical or moral): - blemish, blot, spot.

H3972.firstSense: fault, + no (-ught), ought, somewhat, any ([no-]) thing
H3972.full: meh-oo'-maw Apparently a form of H3971; properly a speck or point, that is, (by implication) something; with negative nothing: - fault, + no (-ught), ought, somewhat, any ([no-]) thing.

H3974.full: From H215; properly a luminous body or luminary, that is, (abstractly) light (as an element); figuratively brightness, that is, cheerfulness; specifically a chandelier: - bright, light.

H3975.full: meh-oo-raw' Feminine passive participle of H215; something lighted, that is, an aperture; by implication a crevice or hole of a serpent: - den.

H3976.full: From H239; (only in the dual) a pair of scales: - balances.

H3978.full: mah-ak-awl' From H398; an eatable (including provender, flesh and fruit): - food, fruit, ([bake-]) meat (-s), victual.

H3979.full: mah-ak-eh'-leth From H398; something to eat with, that is, a knife: - knife.

H3980.full: mah-ak-o'-leth From H398; something eaten (by fire), that is, fuel: - fuel.

H3981.full: mah-am-awts' From H553; strength, that is, (plural) resources: - force.

H3982.full: mah-am-ar' From H559; something (authoritatively) said, that is, an edict: - commandment, decree.

H3983.full: may-mar' (Chaldee); corresponding to H3982: - appointment, word.

H3984.full: mawn (Chaldee); probably from a root corresponding to H579 in the sense of an inclosure by sides; a utensil: - vessel.

H3985.full: A primitive root; to refuse: - refuse, X utterly.

H3988.firstSense: abhor, cast away (off), contemn, despise, disdain, (become) loathe (-some), melt away,…
H3988.full: maw-as' A primitive root; to spurn; also (intransitively) to disappear: - abhor, cast away (off), contemn, despise, disdain, (become) loathe (-some), melt away, refuse, reject, reprobate, X utterly, vile person.

H3989.full: mah-af-eh' From H644; something baked, that is, a batch: - baken

H3990.full: mah-af-ale' From the same as H651; something opaque: - darkness.

H3991.full: mah-af-ay-leh-yaw' Prolonged feminine of H3990; opaqueness: - darkness.

H3992.full: maw-ar' A primitive root; to be bitter or (causatively) to embitter, that is, be painful: - fretting, picking.

H3993.firstSense: lie in ambush, ambushment, lurking place, lying in wait
H3993.full: mah-ar-awb' From H693; an ambuscade: - lie in ambush, ambushment, lurking place, lying in wait.

H3994.full: meh-ay-raw' From H779; an execration: - curse.

H3995.full: From H914; a separation, that is, (concretely) a separate place: - separate.

H3996.firstSense: by which came, as cometh, in coming, as men enter into, entering, entrance into, entry,…
H3996.full: From H935; an entrance (the place or the act); specifically (with or without H8121) sunset or the west; also (adverbially with preposition) towards: - by which came, as cometh, in coming, as men enter into, entering, entrance into, entry, where goeth, going down, + westward. Compare H4126.

H3997.full: meb-o-aw' Feminine of H3996; a haven: - entry.

H3999.full: From H2986 in the sense of flowing; a deluge: - flood.

H4001.full: From H947; a trampling: - treading (trodden) down (under foot).

H4002.full: From H5042; a fountain: - fountain, spring.

H4003.full: From the same as H950; emptiness: - void.

H4004.full: From H977; select, that is, well fortified: - choice.

H4005.full: From H977; select, that is, best: - choice (-st), chosen.

H4006.full: The same as H4005; Mibchar, an Israelite: - Mibhar.

H4007.full: From H5027; something expected, that is, (abstractly) expectation: - expectation.

H4008.full: From H981; a rash utterance (hasty vow): - (that which . . . ) uttered (out of).

H4009.full: From H982; properly a refuge, that is, (objectively) security, or (subjectively) assurance: - confidence, hope, sure, trust.

H4010.full: From H1082; desistance (or rather desolation): - comfort self.

H4012.full: From H1129; built up; Mebunnai, an Israelite: - Mebunnai.

H4013.full: From H1219; a fortification, castle, or fortified city; figuratively a defender: - (de-, most) fenced, fortress, (most) strong (hold).

H4014.full: The same as H4013; Mibtsar, an Idumaean: - Mibzar.

H4017.full: From the same as H1314; fragrant; Mibsam, the name of an Ishmaelite and of an Israelite: - Mibsam.

H4018.full: From H1310; a cooking hearth: - boiling-place.

H4019.full: From the same as H1378; stiffening; Magbish, an Israelite, or a place in Palestine: - Magbish.

H4021.full: From the same as H1389; a cap (as hemispherical): - bonnet.

H4022.full: From an unused root properly meaning to be eminent; properly a distinguished thing; hence something valuable, as a product or fruit: - pleasant, precious fruit (thing).

H4023.full: From H1413; rendezvous; Megiddon or Megiddo, a place in Palestine: - Megiddo, Megiddon.

H4024.full: Probably of Egyptian origin; Migdol, a place in Egypt: - Migdol, tower.

H4025.full: mag-dee-ale' From H4022 and H410; preciousness of God; Magdiel, an Idumaean: - Magdiel.

H4026.full: From H1431; a tower (from its size or height); by analogy a rostrum; figuratively a (pyramidal) bed of flowers: - castle, flower, pulpit, tower. Compare the names following.

H4027.full: mig-dal-ale' From H4026 and H410; tower of God; Migdal-El, a place in Palestine: - Migdal-el.

H4028.full: From H4026 and H1408; tower of Fortune; Migdal-Gad, a place in Palestine: - Migdal-gad.

H4029.full: From H4026 and H5739; tower of a flock; Migdal-Eder, a place in Palestine: - Migdal-eder, tower of the flock.

H4030.full: From the same as H4022; preciousness, that is, a gem: - precious thing, present.

H4031.full: From H1463; Magog, a son of Japheth; also a barbarous northern region: - Magog.

H4032.full: From H1481 in the sense of fearing; a fright (objectively or subjectively): - fear, terror. Compare H4036.

H4033.firstSense: dwelling, pilgrimage, where sojourn, be a stranger
H4033.full: From H1481 in the sense of lodging; a temporary abode; by extension a permanent residence: - dwelling, pilgrimage, where sojourn, be a stranger. Compare H4032.

H4035.full: Feminine of H4032 or of H4033; a fright; also a granary: - barn, fear.

H4036.full: From H4032 and H5439 with the preposition inserted; affright from around; Magor-mis-Sabib, a symbolical name of Pashur: - Magor-missabib.

H4037.full: From H1504; a cutting implement, that is, a blade: - axe.

H4038.full: From an unused root meaning to reap; a sickle: - sickle.

H4039.full: From H1556; a roll: - roll, volume.

H4041.full: From the same as H1571; properly accumulation, that is, impulse or direction: - sup up.

H4042.full: A denominative from H4043; properly to shield; encompass with; figuratively to rescue, to hand safely over (that is, surrender): - deliver.

H4043.firstSense: X armed, buckler, defence, ruler, + scale, shield
H4043.full: From H1598; a shield (that is, the small one or buckler); figuratively a protector; also the scaly hide of the crocodile: - X armed, buckler, defence, ruler, + scale, shield.

H4044.full: From H4042; a covering (in a bad sense), that is, blindness or obduracy: - sorrow. See also H4043.

H4045.full: From H1605; reproof (that is, curse): - rebuke.

H4046.full: From H5062; a pestilence; by analogy defeat: - (X be) plague (-d), slaughter, stroke.

H4047.full: Apparently from H1479 or H5062 and H6211; exterminator of (the) moth; Magpiash, an Israelite: - Magpiash.

H4048.full: A primitive root; to yield up; intensively to precipitate: - cast down, terror.

H4049.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H4048; to overthrow: - destroy.

H4050.full: From H1641; a saw: - axe, saw.

H4051.full: From H4048; precipice; Migron, a place in Palestine: - Migron.

H4052.full: From H1639; a ledge or offset: - narrowed rest.

H4053.full: From H1640; something thrown off (by the spade), that is, a clod: - clod.

H4054.full: From H1644; a suburb (that is, open country whither flocks are driven for pasture); hence the area around a building, or the margin of the sea: - cast out, suburb.

H4055.firstSense: armour, clothes, garment, judgment, measure, raiment, stature
H4055.full: mad mêd mad, made From H4058; properly extent, that is, height; also a measure; by implication a vesture (as measured); also a carpet: - armour, clothes, garment, judgment, measure, raiment, stature.

H4056.full: (Chaldee); from H1648; a sacrificial altar: - altar.

H4057.full: From H1696 in the sense of driving; a pasture (that is, open field, whither cattle are driven); by implication a desert; also speech (including its organs): - desert, south, speech, wilderness.

H4058.full: A primitive root; properly to stretch; by implication to measure (as if by stretching a line); figuratively to be extended: - measure, mete, stretch self.

H4060.firstSense: garment, measure (-ing, meteyard, piece, size, (great) stature, tribute, wide
H4060.full: Feminine of H4055; properly extension, that is, height or breadth; also a measure (including its standard); hence a portion (as measured) or a vestment; specifically tribute (as measured): - garment, measure (-ing, meteyard, piece, size, (great) stature, tribute, wide.

H4061.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H4060; tribute in money: - toll, tribute.

H4062.full: Perhaps from the equivalent of H1722; gold making, that is, exactress: - golden city.

H4063.full: From an unused root meaning to stretch; properly extent, that is, measure; by implication a dress (as measured): - garment.

H4065.full: From H5080; seduction: - cause of banishment.

H4066.full: From H1777; a contest or quarrel: - brawling, contention (-ous), discord, strife. Compare H4079, H4090.

H4067.full: From the same as H4063; extensiveness, that is, height: - stature.

H4068.full: The same as H4067; Madon, a place in Palestine: - Madon.

H4069.full: From H4100 and the passive participle of H3045; what (is) known?; that is, (by implication), (adverbially) why?: - how, wherefore, why.

H4071.full: From H1752 in the sense of accumulation; a pile of fuel: - pile (for fire).

H4073.full: From H1765; a push, that is, ruin: - overthrow.

H4074.full: Of foreign derivation; Madai, a country of central Asia: - Madai, Medes, Media.

H4075.full: Patrial from H4074; a Madian or native of Madai: - Mede.

H4078.full: From H4100 and H1767; what (is) enough, that is, sufficiently: - sufficiently.

H4079.full: A variation for H4066: - brawling, contention (-ous).

H4080.full: The same as H4079; Midjan, a son of Abraham; also his country and (collectively) his descendants: - Midian, Midianite.

H4082.full: From H1777; properly a judgeship, that is, jurisdiction; by implication a district (as ruled by a judge); generally a region: - ( X every) province.

H4084.full: Patronymic or patrial from H4080; a Midjanite or descendant (native) of Midjan: - Midianite. Compare H4092.

H4086.full: From the same as H1828; dunghill; Madmen, a place in Palestine: - Madmen.

H4087.full: Feminine from the same as H1828; a dunghill: - dunghill.

H4088.full: The same as H4087; Madmenah, a place in Palestine: - Madmenah.

H4089.full: A variation for H4087; Madmannah, a place in Palestine: - Madmannah.

H4090.full: A form of H4066: - discord, strife.

H4091.full: The same as H4090; Medan, a son of Abraham: - Medan.

H4093.full: From H3045; intelligence or consciousness: - knowledge, science, thought.

H4095.full: From an unused root meaning to step; properly a step; by implication a steep or inaccessible place: - stair, steep place.

H4096.full: From H1869; a treading, that is, a place for stepping on: - [foot-] breadth.

H4097.full: From H1875; properly an investigation, that is, (by implication) a treatise or elaborate compilation: - story.

H4098.full: From H1758; a threshing, that is, (concretely and figuratively) down trodden people: - threshing.

H4099.full: med-aw-thaw' Of Persian origin; Medatha, the father of Haman. (Including the article.): - Hammedatha [includ. the article.]

H4100.firstSense: how (long, oft, [-soever]), [no-] thing, what (end, good, purpose, thing), whereby (-fo…
H4100.full: mâh mah mâ ma meh maw, mah, maw, mah, meh A primitive particle; properly interrogitive what? (including how?, why? and when?); but also exclamations like what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjugational sneses: - how (long, oft, [-soever]), [no-] thing, what (end, good, purpose, thing), whereby (-fore, -in, -to, -with), (for) why.

H4101.firstSense: how great (mighty), that which, what (-soever), why
H4101.full: mâh maw (Chaldee); corresponding to H4100: - how great (mighty), that which, what (-soever), why.

H4102.full: Apparently a denominative from H4100; properly to question or hesitate, that is, (by implication) to be reluctant: - delay, linger, stay selves, tarry.

H4103.firstSense: destruction, discomfiture, trouble, tumult, vexation, vexed
H4103.full: From H1949; confusion or uproar: - destruction, discomfiture, trouble, tumult, vexation, vexed.

H4104.full: Of Persian origin; Mehuman, a eunuch of Xerxes: - Mehuman.

H4105.full: meh-hay-tab-ale' From H3190 (augmented) and H410; bettered of God; Mehetabel, the name of an Edomitish man and woman: - Mehetabeel, Mehetabel.

H4106.full: From H4116; quick; hence skilful: - diligent, hasty, ready.

H4107.full: A primitive root; properly to cut down or reduce, that is, by implication to adulterate: - mixed.

H4108.full: From H1980; a walking (plural collectively), that is, access: - place to walk.

H4109.full: From H1980; a walk, that is, a passage or a distance: - journey, walk.

H4111.full: mah-hal-al-ale' From H4110 and H410; praise of God; Mahalalel, the name of an antediluvian patriarch and of an Israelite: - Mahalaleel.

H4112.full: From H1986; a blow: - stripe, stroke.

H4113.full: From an unused root of uncertain meaning; perhaps an abyss: - deep pit.

H4114.full: From H2015; a destruction: - when . . . overthrew, overthrow (-n).

H4115.full: From H2015; a wrench, that is, the stocks: - prison, stocks.

H4116.firstSense: be carried headlong, fearful, (cause to make, in, make) haste (-n, -ily, (be) hasty, (f…
H4116.full: A primitive root; properly to be liquid or flow easily, that is, (by implication); to hurry (in a good or bad sense); often used (with another verb) adverbially promptly: - be carried headlong, fearful, (cause to make, in, make) haste (-n, -ily, (be) hasty, (fetch, make ready) X quickly, rash, X shortly, (be so) X soon, make speed, X speedily, X straightway, X suddenly, swift.

H4117.full: A primitive root (perhaps rather the same as H4116 through the idea of readiness in assent); to bargain (for a wife), that is, to wed: - endow, X surely.

H4118.firstSense: hasteth, hastily, at once, quickly, soon, speedily, suddenly
H4118.full: From H4116; properly hurrying; hence (adverbially) in a hurry: - hasteth, hastily, at once, quickly, soon, speedily, suddenly.

H4119.full: From H4117; a price (for a wife): - dowry.

H4120.firstSense: hastily, quickly, shortly, soon, make (with) speed (-ily), swiftly
H4120.full: Feminine of H4118; properly a hurry; hence (adverbially) promptly: - hastily, quickly, shortly, soon, make (with) speed (-ily), swiftly.

H4121.full: From H4116; hasty; Maharai, an Israelite: - Maharai.

H4122.full: From H4118 and H7998 and H2363 and H957; hasting (as he (the enemy) to the) booty, swift (to the) prey; Maher-Shalal Chash-Baz; the symbolical name of the son of Isaiah: - Maher-shalal-hash-baz.

H4124.full: From a prolonged form of the prepositional prefix "m-" and H1; from (her (the mother's)) father; Moab, an incestuous son of Lot; also his territory and descendants: - Moab.

H4125.full: Patronymic from H4124; a Moabite or Moabitess, that is, a descendant from Moab: - (woman) of Moab, Moabite (-ish, -ss).

H4126.full: By transposition for H3996; an entrance: - coming.

H4127.firstSense: consume, dissolve, (be) faint (-hearted), melt (away), make soft
H4127.full: mûg moog A primitive root; to melt, that is, literally (to soften, flow down, disappear), or figuratively (to fear, faint): - consume, dissolve, (be) faint (-hearted), melt (away), make soft.

H4128.full: mûd mood A primitive root; to shake: - measure.

H4131.firstSense: be carried, cast, be out of course, be fallen in decay, X exceedingly, fall (-ing down)…
H4131.full: A primitive root; to waver; by implication to slip, shake, fall: - be carried, cast, be out of course, be fallen in decay, X exceedingly, fall (-ing down), be (re-) moved, be ready shake, slide, slip.

H4132.full: From H4131; a wavering, that is, fall; by implication a pole (as shaking); hence a yoke (as essentially a bent pole): - bar, be moved, staff, yoke.

H4133.full: Feminine of H4132; a pole; by implication an ox bow; hence a yoke (either literally or figuratively): - bands, heavy, staves, yoke.

H4134.full: mûk mook A primitive root; to become thin, that is, (figuratively) be impoverished: - be (waxen) poor (-er).

H4135.firstSense: circumcise (-ing, selves), cut down (in pieces), destroy, X must needs
H4135.full: mûl mool A primitive root; to cut short, that is, curtail (specifically the prepuce, that is, to circumcise); by implication to blunt; figuratively to destroy: - circumcise (-ing, selves), cut down (in pieces), destroy, X must needs.

H4136.firstSense: (over) against, before, [fore-] front, from, [God-] ward, toward, with
H4136.full: mool, mole, mole, mool From H4135; properly abrupt, that is, a precipice; by implication the front; used only adverbially (with prepositional prefix) opposite: - (over) against, before, [fore-] front, from, [God-] ward, toward, with.

H4137.full: From H3205; birth; Moladah, a place in Palestine: - Moladah.

H4138.full: From H3205; nativity (plural birth place); by implication lineage, native country; also offspring, family: - begotten, born, issue, kindred, native (-ity).

H4140.full: môlı̂yd mo-leed From H3205; genitor; Molid, an Israelite: - Molid.

H4141.full: From H5437; a turn, that is, circuit (of a building): - winding about.

H4142.firstSense: being changed, inclosed, be set, turning
H4142.full: Feminine of H4141; a reversal, that is, the backside (of a gem), fold (of a double leaved door), transmutation (of a name): - being changed, inclosed, be set, turning.

H4145.full: Feminine of H4143; a foundation; figuratively an appointment: - foundation, grounded. Compare H4328.

H4146.full: Feminine of H4144; a foundation: - foundation.

H4147.full: From H3256; properly chastisement, that is, (by implication) a halter; figuratively restraint: - band, bond.

H4148.firstSense: bond, chastening ([-eth]), chastisement, check, correction, discipline, doctrine, instr…
H4148.full: From H3256; properly chastisement; figuratively reproof, warning or instruction; also restraint: - bond, chastening ([-eth]), chastisement, check, correction, discipline, doctrine, instruction, rebuke.

H4149.full: Feminine of H4147; correction or corrections; Moserah or Moseroth, a place in the Desert: - Mosera, Moseroth.

H4150.firstSense: appointed (sign, time), (place of, solemn) assembly, congregation, (set, solemn) feast,…
H4150.full: From H3259; properly an appointment, that is, a fixed time or season; specifically a festival; conventionally a year; by implication, an assembly (as convened for a definite purpose); technically the congregation; by extension, the place of meeting; also a signal (as appointed beforehand): - appointed (sign, time), (place of, solemn) assembly, congregation, (set, solemn) feast, (appointed, due) season, solemn (-ity), synagogue, (set) time (appointed).

H4151.full: From H3259; properly an assembly (as in H4150); figuratively a troop: - appointed time.

H4152.full: From H3259; an appointed place, that is, asylum: - appointed.

H4153.full: From H4151 and H3050; assembly of Jah; Moadjah, an Israelite: - Moadiah. Compare H4573.

H4154.full: Feminine passive participle of H4571; properly made to slip, that is, dislocated: - out of joint.

H4155.full: From H5774; properly covered, that is, dark; abstractly obscurity, that is, distress: - dimness.

H4156.full: From H3289; a purpose: - counsel, device.

H4157.full: From H5781; pressure, that is, (figuratively) distress: - affliction.

H4158.full: From H3313; illuminative; Mophaath or Mephaath, a place in Palestine: - Mephaath.

H4159.full: From H3302 in the sense of conspicuousness; a miracle; by implication a token or omen: - miracle, sign, wonder (-ed at).

H4160.full: mûts moots A primitive root; to press, that is, (figuratively) to oppress: - extortioner.

H4161.firstSense: brought out, bud, that which came out, east, going forth, goings out, that which (thing…
H4161.full: From H3318; a going forth, that is, (the act) an egress, or (the place) an exit; hence a source or product; specifically dawn, the rising of the sun (the East), exportation, utterance, a gate, a fountain, a mine, a meadow (as producing grass): - brought out, bud, that which came out, east, going forth, goings out, that which (thing that) is gone out, outgoing, proceeded out, spring, vein, [water-] course [springs].

H4162.full: The same as H4161; Motsa, the name of two Israelites: - Moza.

H4163.full: Feminine of H4161; a family descent; also a sewer (compare H6675): - draught house; going forth.

H4164.full: From H3332; narrowness; figuratively distress: - anguish, is straitened, straitness.

H4165.full: From H5694; properly fusion, that is, literally a casting (of metal); figuratively a mass (of clay): - casting, hardness.

H4166.full: From H3332; properly something poured out, that is, a casting (of metal); by implication a tube (as cast): - when it was cast, pipe.

H4167.full: mûq mook A primitive root; to jeer, that is, (intensively) blaspheme: - be corrupt.

H4168.full: From H3344; a fire or fuel; abstractly a conflagration: - burning, hearth.

H4170.full: From H3369; a noose (for catching animals), (literally or figuratively); by implication a hook (for the nose): - be ensnared, gin, (is) snare (-d), trap.

H4171.full: mûr moor A primitive root; to alter; by implication to barter, to dispose of: - X at all, (ex-) change, remove.

H4172.firstSense: dread, (that ought to be) fear (-ed), terribleness, terror
H4172.full: From H3372; fear; by implication a fearful thing or deed: - dread, (that ought to be) fear (-ed), terribleness, terror.

H4173.full: From an unused root meaning to triturate; a threshing sledge: - threshing instrument.

H4174.firstSense: going down, steep place, thin work
H4174.full: From H3381; a descent; architecturally an ornamental appendage, perhaps a festoon: - going down, steep place, thin work.

H4175.full: From H3384; an archer; also teacher or teaching; also the early rain (see H3138): - (early) rain.

H4176.full: The same as H4175; Moreh, a Canaanite; also a hill (perhaps named from him): - Moreh.

H4177.full: From H4171 in the sense of shearing; a razor: - razor.

H4178.full: From H3399; obstinate, that is, independent: - peeled.

H4179.full: From H7200 and H3050; seen of Jah; Morijah, a hill in Palestine: - Moriah.

H4180.full: From H3423; a possession; figuratively delight: - possession, thought.

H4181.full: Feminine of H4180; a possession: - heritage, inheritance, possession.

H4182.full: From H3423 and H1661; possession of Gath; Moresheth-Gath, a place in Palestine: - Moresheth-gath.

H4183.full: Patrial from H4182; a Morashtite or inhabitant of Moresheth Gath: - Morashthite.

H4184.full: mûsh moosh A primitive root; to touch: - feel, handle.

H4185.firstSense: cease, depart, go back, remove, take away
H4185.full: mûsh moosh A primitive root (perhaps rather the same as H4184 through the idea of receding by contact); to withdraw (both literally and figuratively, whether intransitively or transitively): - cease, depart, go back, remove, take away.

H4186.firstSense: assembly, dwell in, dwelling (-place), wherein (that) dwelt (in), inhabited place, seat…
H4186.full: From H3427; a seat; figuratively a site; abstractly a session; by extension an abode (the place or the time); by implication population: - assembly, dwell in, dwelling (-place), wherein (that) dwelt (in), inhabited place, seat, sitting, situation, sojourning.

H4187.full: From H4184; sensitive; Mushi, a Levite: - Mushi.

H4188.full: Patronymic from H4187; a Mushite (collectively) or descendant of Mushi: - Mushites.

H4189.full: Active participle feminine of H4900; something drawing, that is, (figuratively) a cord: - band.

H4191.firstSense: X at all, X crying, (be) dead (body, man, one), (put to, worthy of) death, destroy (-er…
H4191.full: mûth mooth A primitive root; to die (literally or figuratively); causatively to kill: - X at all, X crying, (be) dead (body, man, one), (put to, worthy of) death, destroy (-er), (cause to, be like to, must) die, kill, necro [-mancer], X must needs, slay, X surely, X very suddenly, X in [no] wise.

H4192.full: From H4191 and H1121 with the preposition and article interposed; "to die for the son", probably the title of a popular song: - death, Muthlabben.

H4193.full: môth mohth (Chaldee); corresponding to H4194; death: - death.

H4194.full: From H4191; death (natural or violent); concretely the dead, their place or state (hades); figuratively pestilence, ruin: - (be) dead ([-ly]), death, die (-d).

H4195.full: From H3498; literally gain; figuratively superiority: - plenteousness, preeminence, profit.

H4197.full: From an unused root meaning to mingle (water with wine); tempered wine: - liquor.

H4198.full: From an unused root meaning to suck out; exhausted: - burnt.

H4199.full: Probably from an unused root meaning to faint with fear; terror; Mizzah, an Edomite: - Mizzah.

H4200.full: Probably from an unused root meaning to gather in; a granary: - garner.

H4201.full: From the same as H2123; a door post (as prominent): - (door, side) post.

H4204.full: From H2114 in the sense of turning aside from truth; treachery, that is, a plot: - wound.

H4205.full: From H2115 in the sense of binding up; a bandage, that is, remedy; hence a sore (as needing a compress): - bound up, wound.

H4206.full: From H2118; a belt (as movable): - girdle, strength.

H4207.full: From an unused root meaning to draw up; a fork: - fleshhook.

H4208.full: Apparently from H5140 in the sense of raining; a constellation, that is, Zodiacal sign (perhaps as affecting the weather): - planet. Compare H4216.

H4209.firstSense: (wicked) device, discretion, intent, witty invention, lewdness, mischievous (device), t…
H4209.full: From H2161; a plan, usually evil (machination), sometimes good (sagacity): - (wicked) device, discretion, intent, witty invention, lewdness, mischievous (device), thought, wickedly.

H4210.full: From H2167; properly instrumental music; by implication a poem set to notes: - psalm.

H4211.full: From H2168; a pruning knife: - pruning-hook.

H4212.full: From H2168; a tweezer (only in the plural): - snuffers.

H4213.full: From the same as H2191; fewness; by implication as superlative diminutiveness: - few, X very.

H4214.full: From H2219; a winnowing shovel (as scattering the chaff): - fan.

H4215.full: Apparently from H2219; properly a scatterer, that is, the north wind (as dispersing clouds; only in plural): - north.

H4216.full: Apparently from H5144 in the sense of distinction; some noted constellation (only in the plural), perhaps collectively the zodiac: - Mazzoroth. Compare H4208.

H4217.full: From H2224; sunrise, that is, the east: - east (side, -ward), (sun-) rising (of the sun).

H4218.full: From H2232; a planted field: - thing sown.

H4219.full: From H2236; a bowl (as if for sprinkling): - bason, bowl.

H4220.full: From H4229 in the sense of greasing; fat; figuratively rich: - fatling (one).

H4221.full: From the same as H4220; fat, that is, marrow: - marrow.

H4222.full: A primitive root; to rub or strike the hands together (in exultation): - clap.

H4223.full: mekh-aw' (Chaldee); corresponding to H4222; to strike in pieces; also to arrest; specifically to impale: - hang, smite, stay.

H4224.full: makh-ab-ay', makh-b-o' From H2244; a refuge: - hiding (lurking) place.

H4225.full: From H2266; a junction, that is, seam or sewed piece: - coupling.

H4226.full: From H2266; a joiner, that is, brace or cramp: - coupling, joining.

H4227.full: From the same as H2281; a pan for baking in: - pan.

H4229.firstSense: abolish, blot out, destroy, full of marrow, put out, reach unto, X utterly, wipe (away,…
H4229.full: A primitive root; properly to stroke or rub; by implication to erase; also to smooth (as if with oil), that is, grease or make fat; also to touch, that is, reach to: - abolish, blot out, destroy, full of marrow, put out, reach unto, X utterly, wipe (away, out).

H4230.full: From H2328; an instrument for marking a circle, that is, compasses: - compassive

H4231.full: From an unused root meaning to enclose; a harbor (as shut in by the shore): - haven.

H4232.full: mekh-oo-yaw-ale', mekh-ee-yaw-ale' From H4229 and H410; smitten of God; Mechujael or Mechijael, an antediluvian patriarch: - Mehujael.

H4233.full: Apparently a patrial, but from an unknown place (in the plural only for a singular); a Machavite or inhabitant of some place named Machaveh: - Mahavite.

H4235.full: The same as H4234; dancing; Machol, an Israelite: - Mahol.

H4238.full: makh-az-ee-oth' Feminine plural from H2372; visions; Machazioth, an Israelite: - Mahazioth.

H4239.full: From H4229; a stroke, that is, battering ram: - engines.

H4240.full: mekh-ee-daw' From H2330; junction; Mechida, one of the Nethinim: - Mehida.

H4241.firstSense: preserve life, quick, recover selves, reviving, sustenance, victuals
H4241.full: From H2421; preservation of life; hence sustenance; also the live flesh, that is, the quick: - preserve life, quick, recover selves, reviving, sustenance, victuals.

H4242.full: From an unused root meaning to buy; price, payment, wages: - gain, hire, price, sold, worth.

H4243.full: The same as H4242; price; Mechir, an Israelite: - Mehir.

H4244.full: From H2470; sickness; Machlah, the name apparently of two Israelitesses: - Mahlah.

H4245.full: From H2470; sickness: - disease, infirmity, sickness.

H4246.full: Feminine of H4234; a dance: - company, dances (-cing).

H4247.full: From H2490; a cavern (as if excavated): - cave.

H4248.full: From H2470; sick; Machlon, an Israelite: - Mahlon.

H4249.full: From H2470; sick; Machli, the name of two Israelites: - Mahli.

H4250.full: Patronymic from H4249; a Machlite or (collectively) descendant of Machli: - Mahlites.

H4252.full: From H2498; a (sacrificial) knife (as gliding through the flesh): - knife.

H4253.full: From H2498; a ringlet of hair (as gliding over each other): - lock.

H4254.firstSense: changeable suit of apparel, change of raiment
H4254.full: From H2502; a mantle (as easily drawn off): - changeable suit of apparel, change of raiment.

H4255.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H4256; a section (of the Levites): - course.

H4256.full: From H2505; a section (of Levites, people or soldiers): - company, course, division, portion. See also H5555.

H4257.full: From H2470; sickness; machalath, probably the title (initial word) of a popular song: - Mahalath.

H4258.full: The smae as H4257; sickness; Machalath, the name of an Ishmaelitess and of an Israelitess: - Mahalath.

H4259.full: Patrial from H65; a Mecholathite or inhabitant of Abel Mecholah: - Mecholathite.

H4260.full: makh-am-aw-aw' A denominative from H2529; something buttery (that is, unctuous and pleasant), as (figuratively) flattery: - X than butter.

H4261.full: From H2530; delightful; hence a delight, that is, object of affection or desire: - beloved, desire, goodly, lovely, pleasant (thing).

H4262.full: From H2530; desired; hence a valuable: - pleasant thing.

H4263.full: From H2550; properly sympathy; (by paronomasia with H4261) delight: - pitieth.

H4264.firstSense: army, band, battle, camp, company, drove, host, tents
H4264.full: From H2583; an encampment (of travellers or troops); hence an army, whether literally (of soldiers) or figuratively (of dancers, angels, cattle, locusts, stars; or even the sacred courts): - army, band, battle, camp, company, drove, host, tents.

H4265.full: From H4264 and H1835; camp of Dan; Machaneh-Dan, a place in Palestine: - Mahaneh-dan.

H4266.full: Dual of H4264; double camp; Machanajim, a place in Palestine: - Mahanaim.

H4268.full: From H2620; a shelter (literally or figuratively): - hope, (place of) refuge, shelter, trust.

H4270.firstSense: lack, need, penury, poor, poverty, want
H4270.full: From H2637; deficiency; hence impoverishment: - lack, need, penury, poor, poverty, want.

H4271.full: From H4268 and H3050; refuge of (that is, in) Jah; Machsejah, an Israelite: - Maaseiah.

H4272.firstSense: dip, pierce (through), smite (through), strike through, wound
H4272.full: A primitive root; to dash asunder; by implication to crush, smash or violently plunge; figuratively to subdue or destroy: - dip, pierce (through), smite (through), strike through, wound.

H4274.full: From H2672; properly a hewing; concretely a quarry: - hewed (-n).

H4276.full: From H2673; a halving or the middle: - half (so much), mid [-day].

H4277.full: A primitive root; to crush: - smite off.

H4278.full: From H2713; properly scrutinized, that is, (by implication) a recess: - deep place.

H4279.full: Probably from H309; properly deferred, that is, the morrow; usually (adverbially) tomorrow; indefinitely hereafter: - time to come, tomorrow.

H4280.full: makh-ar-aw-aw' From the same as H2716; a sink: - draught house.

H4281.full: From H2790; probably a pick axe: - mattock.

H4282.full: From H2790; probably a hoe: - share.

H4283.full: Feminine from the same as H4279; the morrow or (adverbially) tomorrow: - morrow, next day.

H4284.firstSense: cunning (work), curious work, device (-sed), imagination, invented, means, purpose, tho…
H4284.full: From H2803; a contrivance, that is, (concretely) a texture, machine, or (abstractly) intention, plan (whether bad, a plot; or good, advice): - cunning (work), curious work, device (-sed), imagination, invented, means, purpose, thought.

H4285.full: From H2821; darkness; concretely a dark place: - dark (-ness, place).

H4286.full: From H2834; a peeling: - made appear.

H4287.full: Probably from H4229; erasure; Machath, the name of two Israelites: - Mahath.

H4288.full: From H2846; properly a dissolution; concretely a ruin, or (abstractly) consternation: - destruction, dismaying, ruin, terror.

H4289.full: The same as H4288 in the sense of removal; a pan for live coals: - censer, firepan, snuffdish.

H4290.full: From H2864; a burglary; figuratively unexpected examination: - breaking up, secret search.

H4291.full: (Chaldee); apparently corresponding to H4672 in the intransitive sense of being found present; to arrive, extend or happen: - come, reach.

H4292.full: Apparently a denominative from H2916; a broom (as removing dirt (compare English 'to dust', that is, remove dust)): - besom.

H4294.full: From H5186; a branch (as extending); figuratively a tribe; also a rod, whether for chastising (figuratively correction), ruling (a sceptre), throwing (a lance), or walking (a staff; figuratively a support of life, for example bread): - rod, staff, tribe.

H4295.firstSense: beneath, down (-ward), less, very low, under (-neath)
H4295.full: From H5786 with directive enclitic appended; downward, below or beneath; often adverbially with or without prefixes: - beneath, down (-ward), less, very low, under (-neath).

H4296.full: From H5186; a bed (as extended) for sleeping or eating; by analogy a sofa, litter or bier: - bed ([-chamber]), bier.

H4297.full: From H5186; a stretching, that is, distortion (figuratively iniquity): - perverseness.

H4300.full: From H2904 in the sense of hammering out; an iron bar (as forged): - bar.

H4301.full: From H2934; a secret storehouse; hence a secreted valuable (buried); generally money: - hidden, riches, (hid) treasure (-s).

H4302.full: From H5193; something planted, that is, the place (a garden or vineyard), or the thing (a plant, figuratively of men); by implication the act, planting: - plant (-ation, -ing).

H4303.full: From H2938; a delicacy: - dainty (meat), savoury meat.

H4304.full: From H2946; a wide cloak (for a woman): - vail, wimple.

H4305.full: A primitive root; to rain: - (cause to) rain (upon).

H4307.full: From H5201; a jail (as a guard house); also an aim (as being closely watched): - mark, prison.

H4308.full: From H2956; propulsive; Matred, an Edomitess: - Matred.

H4309.full: From H4305; rainy; Matri, an Israelite: - Matri.

H4310.firstSense: any (man), X he, X him, + O that! what, which, who (-m, -se, -soever), + would to God
H4310.full: mı̂y me An interrogitive pronoun of persons, as H4100 is of things, who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things); also (indefinitely) whoever; often used in oblique construction with prefix or suffix: - any (man), X he, X him, + O that! what, which, who (-m, -se, -soever), + would to God.

H4311.full: may-deb-aw' From H4325 and H1679; water of quiet; Medeba, a place in Palestine.

H4312.full: From H3032 in the sense of loving; affectionate; Medad, an Israelite: - Medad.

H4313.full: From H4325 and H3420 with the article interposed; water of the yellowness; Me-haj-Jarkon, a place in Palestine: - Me-jarkon.

H4314.full: From H4325 and H2091, water of gold; Me-Zahab, an Edomite: - Mezahab.

H4315.full: From H3190; the best part: - best.

H4316.full: A variation for H4318; Mica, the name of two Israelites: - Micha.

H4317.full: From H4310 and (the prefixed derivation from) H3588 and H410; who (is) like God?; Mikael, the name of an archangel and of nine Israelites: - Michael.

H4318.full: An abbreviation of H4320; Micah, the name of seven Israelites: - Micah, Micaiah, Michah.

H4319.full: A contraction for H4321; Mikehu, an Israelitish prophet: - Micaiah (2Ch_18:8).

H4320.full: From H4310 and (the prefixed derivation from) H3588 and H3050; who (is) like Jah?; Micajah, the name of two Israelites: - Micah, Michaiah. Compare H4318.

H4321.full: Abbreviated for H4322; Mikajah, the name of three Israelites: - Micah, Micaiah, Michaiah.

H4322.full: For H4320; Mikajah, the name of an Israelite and an Israelitess: - Michaiah.

H4323.full: From H3201; properly a container, that is, a streamlet: - brook.

H4324.full: Apparently the same as H4323; rivulet; Mikal, Saul's daughter: - Michal.
