H4325.full: Dual of a primitive noun (but used in a singular sense); water; figuratively juice; by euphemism urine, semen: - + piss, wasting, water (-ing, [-course, -flood, -spring]).

H4326.full: A form for H4509; Mijamin, the name of three Israelites: - Miamin, Mijamin.

H4327.full: mı̂yn meen From an unused root meaning to portion out; a sort, that is, species: - kind. Compare H4480.

H4328.full: Properly feminine passive participle of H3245; something founded, that is, a foundation: - foundation.

H4329.full: From H5526; a portico (as covered): - covert.

H4330.full: mı̂yts meets From H4160; pressure: - churning, forcing, wringing.

H4331.full: may-shaw' From H4185; departure; Mesha, a place in Arabia; also an Israelite: - Mesha.

H4332.full: From H4310 and H410 with the abbreviation inceptively relative (see H834) interposed; who (is) what God (is)?; Mishael, the name of three Israelites: - Mishael.

H4333.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H4332; Mishael, an Israelite: - Mishael.

H4334.firstSense: equity, even place, plain, right (-eously), (made) straight, uprightness
H4334.full: From H3474; a level, that is, a plain (often used (with the article prefixed) as a proper name of certain districts); figuratively concord; also straightness, that is, (figuratively) justice (sometimes adverbially justly): - equity, even place, plain, right (-eously), (made) straight, uprightness.

H4335.full: Borrowed from H4336; Meshak, an Israelite: - Meshak.

H4336.full: (Chaldee); of foreign origin and doubtful signification; Meshak, the Babylonian name of H4333: - Meshak.

H4337.full: From H3467; safety; Mesha, an Israelite: - Mesha.

H4338.full: A variation for H4337; safety; Mesha, a Moabite: - Mesha.

H4339.firstSense: agreement, aright, that are equal, equity, (things that are) right (-eously, things), s…
H4339.full: From H3474; evenness, that is, (figuratively) prosperity or concord; also straightness, that is, (figuratively) rectitude (only in plural with singular sense; often adverbially): - agreement, aright, that are equal, equity, (things that are) right (-eously, things), sweetly, upright (-ly, -ness).

H4340.full: From H3498; a cord (of a tent), (compare H3499) or the string (of a bow): - cord, string.

H4341.full: mak-obe', mak-obe', mak-o-baw' From H3510; anguish or (figuratively) affliction: - grief, pain, sorrow.

H4342.full: Transitive participle of H3527; plenty: - abundance.

H4343.full: mak-bay-naw' From the same as H3522; knoll; Macbena, a place in Palestine settled by him: - Machbenah.

H4344.full: Patrial from H4343; a Macbannite or native of Macbena: - Machbanai.

H4345.full: makbêr mak-bare From H3527 in the sense of covering (compare H3531); a grate: - grate.

H4346.full: From H3527 in the sense of covering; a cloth (as netted (compare H4345)): - thick cloth.

H4347.firstSense: beaten, blow, plague, slaughter, smote, X sore, stripe, stroke, wound ([-ed])
H4347.full: (Plural only) from H5221; a blow (in 2Ch_2:10, of the flail); by implication a wound; figuratively carnage, also pestilence: - beaten, blow, plague, slaughter, smote, X sore, stripe, stroke, wound ([-ed]).

H4348.full: From H3554; a burn: - that burneth, burning.

H4349.full: From H3559; properly a fixture, that is, a basis; generally a place, especially as an abode: - foundation, habitation, (dwelling-, settled) place.

H4350.full: Feminine of H4349; a pedestal, also a spot: - base.

H4351.full: From the same as H3564 in the sense of digging; origin (as if a mine): - birth, habitation, nativity.

H4352.full: Probably from H4134; pining; Maki, an Israelite: - Machi.

H4353.full: From H4376; salesman; Makir, an Israelite: - Machir.

H4354.full: Patronymic from H4353; a Makirite or descendant of Makir: - of Machir.

H4355.full: A primitive root; to tumble (in ruins); figuratively to perish: - be brought low, decay.

H4356.full: mik-law-aw', mik-law' From H3607; a pen (for flocks): - ([sheep-]) fold. Compare H4357.

H4357.full: From H3615; completion (in plural concretely and adverbially wholly): - perfect. Compare H4356.

H4358.full: From H3634; perfection (that is, concretely adverbial splendidly): - most gorgeously, all sorts.

H4360.full: From H3634; something perfect, that is, a splendid garment: - all sorts.

H4362.full: From the same as H3646 in the sense of hiding; treasure (as hidden): - treasure.

H4363.full: From H3647; hidden; Mikmas or Mikmash, a place in Palestine: - Mikmas, Mikmash.

H4364.full: From H3648 in the sense of blackening by heat; a (hunter's) net (as dark from concealment): - net.

H4365.full: Feminine of H4364; a (fisher's) net: - drag, net.

H4366.full: Apparently from an unused root meaning to hide; concealment; Mikmethath, a place in Palestine: - Michmethath.

H4367.full: From H4100 and H5068 with a particle interposed; what (is) like (a) liberal (man)?; Maknadbai, an Israelite: - Machnadebai.

H4368.full: The same as H4350; a base; Mekonah, a place in Palestine: - Mekonah.

H4369.full: The same as H4350; a spot: - base.

H4370.full: From H3647 in the sense of hiding; (only in dual) drawers (from concealing the private parts): - breeches.

H4371.full: Probably from an unused root meaning to enumerate; an assessment (as based upon a census): - tribute.

H4372.full: From H3680; a covering, that is, weather boarding: - covering.

H4373.full: Feminine of H4371; an enumeration; by implication a valuation: - number, worth.

H4374.firstSense: clothing, to cover, that which covereth
H4374.full: From H3680; a covering, that is, garment; specifically a coverlet (for a bed), an awning (from the sun); also the omentum (as covering the intestines): - clothing, to cover, that which covereth.

H4375.full: From H3717; a fold; Makpelah, a place in Palestine: - Machpelah.

H4376.full: A primitive root; to sell, literally (as merchandise, a daughter in marriage, into slavery), or figuratively (to surrender): - X at all, sell (away, -er, self).

H4377.full: From H4376; merchandise; also value: - pay, price, ware.

H4379.full: From H3738; a pit (for salt): - [salt-] pit.

H4380.full: Probably from the same as H3564 in the sense of stabbing; a sword: - habitation.

H4381.full: From H4376; salesman; Mikri, an Israelite: - Michri.

H4382.full: Patrial from an unused name (the same as H4380) of a place in Palestine; a Mekerathite, or inhabitant of Mekerah: - Mecherathite.

H4383.firstSense: caused to fall, offence, X [no-] thing offered, ruin, stumbling-block
H4383.full: Masculine from H3782; a stumblingblock, literally or figuratively (obstacle, enticement (specifically an idol), scruple): - caused to fall, offence, X [no-] thing offered, ruin, stumbling-block.

H4384.full: Feminine from H3782; a stumblingblock, but only figuratively (fall, enticement (idol)): - ruin, stumbling-block.

H4385.full: From H3789; a thing written, the characters, or a document (letter, copy, edict, poem): - writing.

H4387.full: From H3799; an engraving, that is, (technically) a poem: - Michtam.

H4388.full: From H3806; a mortar; by analogy a socket (of a tooth): - hollow place, mortar.

H4389.full: The same as H4388; dell; the Maktesh, a place in Jerusalem: - Maktesh.

H4390.firstSense: accomplish, confirm, + consecrate, be at an end, be expired, be fenced, fill, fulfil, (…
H4390.full: A primitive root, to fill or (intransitively) be full of, in a wide application (literally and figuratively): - accomplish, confirm, + consecrate, be at an end, be expired, be fenced, fill, fulfil, (be, become, X draw, give in, go) fully (-ly, -ly set, tale), [over-] flow, fulness, furnish, gather (selves, together), presume, replenish, satisfy, set, space, take a [hand-] full, + have wholly.

H4391.full: mel-aw' (Chaldee); corresponding to H4390; to fill: - fill, be full.

H4392.firstSense: X she that was with child, fill (-ed, -ed with), full (-ly), multitude, as is worth
H4392.full: From H4390; full (literally or figuratively) or filling (literally); also (concretely) fulness; adverbially fully: - X she that was with child, fill (-ed, -ed with), full (-ly), multitude, as is worth.

H4393.firstSense: X all along, X all that is (there-) in, fill, (X that whereof
H4393.full: mel-o', mel-o', mel-o' From H4390; fulness (literally or figuratively): - X all along, X all that is (there-) in, fill, (X that whereof . . . was) full, fulness, [hand-] full, multitude.

H4394.full: mil-loo' From H4390; a fulfilling (only in plural), that is, (literally) a setting (of gems), or (technically) consecration (also concretely a dedicatory sacrifice): - consecration, be set.

H4395.full: mel-ay-aw' Feminine of H4392; something fulfilled, that is, abundance (of produce): - (first of ripe) fruit, fulness.

H4396.full: mil-loo-aw' Feminine of H4394; a filling, that is, setting (of gems): - inclosing, setting.

H4397.full: mal-awk' From an unused root meaning to despatch as a deputy; a messenger; specifically of God, that is, an angel (also a prophet, priest or teacher): - ambassador, angel, king, messenger.

H4398.full: mal-ak' (Chaldee); corresponding to H4397; an angel: - angel.

H4399.firstSense: business, + cattle, + industrious, occupation, (+ -pied), + officer, thing (made), use,…
H4399.full: mel-aw-kaw' From the same as H4397; properly deputyship, that is, ministry; generally employment (never servile) or work (abstractly or concretely); also property (as the result of labor): - business, + cattle, + industrious, occupation, (+ -pied), + officer, thing (made), use, (manner of) work ([-man], -manship).

H4400.full: mal-ak-ooth' From the same as H4397; a message: - message.

H4401.full: mal-aw-kee' From the same as H4397; ministrative; Malaki, a prophet: - Malachi.

H4402.full: mil-layth' From H4390; fulness, that is, (concretely) a plump socket (of the eye): - X fitly.

H4403.full: From H3847; a garment, or (collectively) clothing: - apparel, raiment, vestment.

H4405.firstSense: + answer, by-word, matter, any thing (what) to say, to speak (-ing), speak, talking, word
H4405.full: From H4448 (plural masculine as if from the second form); a word; collectively a discourse; figuratively a topic: - + answer, by-word, matter, any thing (what) to say, to speak (-ing), speak, talking, word.

H4406.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H4405; a word, command, discourse, or subject: - commandment, matter, thing, word.

H4407.full: mil-lo', mil-lo' From H4390; a rampart (as filled in), that is, the citadel: - Millo. See also H1037.

H4408.full: From H4414; sea purslain (from its saltness): - mallows.

H4409.full: From H4427; regnant; Malluk, the name of five Israelites: - Malluch, Melichu [from the margin].

H4410.full: Feminine passive participle of H4427; something ruled, that is, a realm: - kingdom, king's, X royal.

H4411.full: From H3885; a lodgment, that is, caravanserai or encampment: - inn, place where . . . lodge, lodging (place).

H4412.full: Feminine from H3885; a hut, a hammock: - cottage, lodge.

H4413.full: Apparently from H4448; I have talked (that is, loquacious); Mallothi, an Israelite: - Mallothi, an Isr: - Mallothi.

H4414.firstSense: X at all, salt, season, temper together, vanish away
H4414.full: A primitive root; properly to rub to pieces or pulverize; intransitively to disappear as dust; also (as denominative from H4417) to salt whether internally (to season with salt) or externally (to rub with salt): - X at all, salt, season, temper together, vanish away.

H4415.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H4414; to eat salt, that is, (generally) subsist: - + have maintenance.

H4417.full: From H4414; properly powder, that is, (specifically) salt (as easily pulverized and dissolved): - salt ([-pit]).

H4418.full: From H4414 in its original sense; a rag or old garment: - rotten rag.

H4419.full: From H4414 in its secondary sense; a sailor (as following 'the salt'): - mariner.

H4420.full: From H4414 (in its denominative sense); properly salted (that is, land (H776 being understood)), that is, a desert: - barren land (-ness), salt [land].

H4421.full: From H3898 (in the sense of fighting); a battle (that is, the engagement); generally war (that is, warfare): - battle, fight, (-ing), war ([-rior]).

H4422.firstSense: deliver (self), escape, lay, leap out, let alone, let go, preserve, save, X speedily, X…
H4422.full: A primitive root; properly to be smooth, that is, (by implication) to escape (as if by slipperiness); causatively to release or rescue; specifically to bring forth young, emit sparks: - deliver (self), escape, lay, leap out, let alone, let go, preserve, save, X speedily, X surely.

H4423.full: From H4422, cement (from its plastic smoothness): - clay.

H4424.full: From H4423 and H3050; (whom) Jah has delivered; Melatjah, a Gibeonite: - Melatiah.

H4425.full: From H4449 (in the sense of cropping (compare H4135)); a head of grain (as cut off): - ear.

H4426.full: From H3887; an aphorism; also a satire: - interpretation, taunting.

H4427.firstSense: consult, X indeed, be (make, set a, set up) king, be (make) queen, (begin to, make to)…
H4427.full: A primitive root; to reign; inceptively to ascend the throne; causatively to induct into royalty; hence (by implication) to take counsel: - consult, X indeed, be (make, set a, set up) king, be (make) queen, (begin to, make to) reign (-ing), rule, X surely.

H4428.full: From H4427; a king: - king, royal.

H4429.full: The same as H4428; king; Melek, the name of two Israelites. Hammelech is by including the article: - Melech, Hammelech [by includ. the article.

H4430.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H4428; a king: - king, royal.

H4431.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H4427 in the sense of consultation; advice: - counsel.

H4432.full: From H4427; Molek (that is, king), the chief deity of the Ammonites: - Molech. Compare H4445.

H4433.full: mal-kaw' (Chaldee); corresponding to H4436; a queen: - queen.

H4435.full: A form of H4436; queen; Milcah, the name of a Hebrewess and of an Israelite: - Milcah.

H4436.full: Feminine of H4428; a queen: - queen.

H4437.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H4438; dominion (abstractly or concretely): - kingdom, kingly, realm, reign.

H4438.full: From H4427; a rule; concretely a dominion: - empire, kingdom, realm, reign, royal.

H4439.full: mal-kee-ale' From H4428 and H410; king of (that is, appointed by) God; Malkiel, an Israelite: - Malchiel.

H4440.full: mal-kee-ay-lee' Patronymic from H4439; a Malkielite or descendant of Malkiel: - Malchielite.

H4441.full: From H4428 and H3050; king of (that is, appointed by) Jah; Malkijah, the name of ten Israelites: - Malchiah, Malchijah.

H4442.full: From H4428 and H6664; king of right; Malki-Tsedek, an early king in Palestine: - Melchizedek.

H4443.full: From H4428 and H7311; king of a high one (that is, of exaltation); Malkiram, an Israelite: - Malchiram.

H4444.full: From H4428 and H7769; king of wealth; Malkishua, an Israelite: - Malchishua.

H4445.full: From H4428 for H4432; Malcam or Milcom, the national idol of the Ammonites: - Malcham, Milcom.

H4447.full: Feminine active participle of H4427; queen; Moleketh, an Israelitess, (including the article): - Hammoleketh [includ. the article.]

H4448.full: A primitive root; to speak (mostly poetical) or say: - say, speak, utter.

H4449.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H4448; to speak: - say, speak (-ing).

H4450.full: From H4448; talkative; Milalai, an Israelite: - Milalai.

H4451.full: From H3925; a goad for oxen: - goad.

H4452.full: A primitive root; to be smooth, that is, (figuratively) pleasant: - be sweet.

H4453.full: Of Persian derivation; the butler or other oficer in the Babylonian court: - Melzar.

H4454.full: A primitive root; to crack a joint; by implication to wring the neck of a fowl (without separating it): - wring off.

H4455.full: From H3947; transitively (in dual) the jaws (as taking food); intransitively spoil (and captives), (as taken): - booty, jaws, prey.

H4456.full: From H3953; the spring rain (compare H3954); figuratively eloquence: - latter rain.

H4457.full: From H3947; (only in dual) tweezers: - snuffers, tongs.

H4458.full: From an unused root meaning to spread out; a wardrobe (that is, room where clothing is spread): - vestry.

H4459.full: Transposition for H4973; a grinder, that is, back tooth: - great tooth.

H4460.full: From H4048 (in the sense of depositing); a granary: - barn.

H4462.full: Of Persian derivation; Memucan or Momucan, a Persian satrap: - Memucan.

H4463.full: From H4191; a mortal disease; concretely a corpse: - death.

H4464.full: From an unused root mian. to alienate; a mongrel, that is, born of a Jewish father and a heathen mother: - bastard.

H4465.firstSense: X ought, (that which cometh of) sale, that which
H4465.full: From H4376; merchandise; abstractly a selling: - X ought, (that which cometh of) sale, that which . . . sold, ware.

H4466.full: Feminine of H4465; a sale: - + sold as.

H4467.full: From H4427; dominion, that is, (abstractly) the estate (rule) or (concretely) the country (realm): - kingdom, king's, reign, royal.

H4468.full: A form of H4467 and equivalent to it: - kingdom, reign.

H4469.full: From H4537; mixture, that is, (specifically) wine mixed (with water or spices): - drink-offering, mixed wine.

H4470.full: From an unused root meaning to grieve; sorrow: - bitterness.

H4471.full: mam-ray' From H4754 (in the sense of vigor); lusty; Mamre, an Amorite: - Mamre.

H4472.full: From H4843; a bitterness, that is, (figuratively) calamity: - bitterness.

H4473.full: From H4886, in the sense of expansion; outspread (that is, with outstretched wings): - anointed.

H4474.full: From H4910; a ruler or (abstractly) rule: - dominion, that ruled.

H4475.full: Feminine of H4474; rule; also (concretely in plural) a realm or a ruler: - dominion, government, power, to rule.

H4476.full: From the same as H4943; a possession: - breeding.

H4477.full: From H4985; something sweet (literally or figuratively): - (most) sweet.

H4478.full: mân mawn From H4100; literally a whatness (so to speak), that is, manna (so called from the question about it): - manna.

H4479.full: mân mawn (Chaldee); from H4101; who or what (properly interrogitive, hence also indefinite and relative): - what, who (-msoever, + so).

H4480.firstSense: above, after, among, at, because of, by (reason of), from (among), in, X neither, X nor…
H4480.full: For H4482; properly a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses: - above, after, among, at, because of, by (reason of), from (among), in, X neither, X nor, (out) of, over, since, X then, through, X whether, with.

H4481.firstSense: according, after, + because, + before, by, for, from, X him, X more than, (out) of, par…
H4481.full: min min (Chaldee); corresponding to H4480: - according, after, + because, + before, by, for, from, X him, X more than, (out) of, part, since, X these, to, upon, + when.

H4482.full: mên mane From an unused rot meaning to apportion; a part; hence a musical chord (as parted into strings): - in [the same] (Psa. H68 : H23), stringed instrument (Psa. H150 : H4), whereby (Psa. H45 : H8 [defective plural]).

H4483.full: men-aw', men-aw' (Chaldee); corresponding to H4487; to count, appoint: - number, ordain, set.

H4484.full: men-ay' (Chaldee); passive participle of H4483; numbered: - Mene.

H4486.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H4093; wisdom or intelligence: - knowledge, reason, understanding.

H4487.firstSense: appoint, count, number, prepare, set, tell
H4487.full: A primitive root; properly to weigh out; by implication to allot or constitute officially; also to enumerate or enroll: - appoint, count, number, prepare, set, tell.

H4488.full: From H4487; properly a fixed weight or measured amount, that is, (technically) a maneh or mina: - maneh, pound.

H4489.full: From H4487; properly something weighed out, that is, (figuratively) a portion of time, that is, an instance: - time.

H4490.firstSense: such things as belonged, part, portion
H4490.full: From H4487; properly something weighed out, that is, (generally) a division; specifically (of food) a ration; also a lot: - such things as belonged, part, portion.

H4491.full: From H5090; the driving (of a chariot): - driving.

H4492.full: From H5102; properly a channel or fissure, that is, (by implication) a cavern: - den.

H4493.full: From H5110; a nodding or toss (of the head in derision): - shaking.

H4494.full: From H5117; quiet, that is, (concretely) a settled spot, or (figuratively) a home: - (place of) rest.

H4495.full: The same as H4494; rest; Manoach, an Israelite: - Manoah.

H4496.firstSense: comfortable, ease, quiet, rest (-ing place), still
H4496.full: Feminine of H4495; repose or (adverbially) peacefully; figuratively consolation (specifically matrimony); hence (concretely) an abode: - comfortable, ease, quiet, rest (-ing place), still.

H4497.full: From H5125; a continuator, that is, heir: - son.

H4498.firstSense: X apace, escape, way to flee, flight, refuge
H4498.full: From H5127; a retreat (literally or figuratively); abstractly a fleeing: - X apace, escape, way to flee, flight, refuge.

H4499.full: Feminine of H4498; retreat: - fleeing, flight.

H4500.full: From H5214; a yoke (properly for ploughing), that is, the frame of a loom: - beam.

H4501.full: Feminine of H4500 (in the original sense of H5216); a chandelier: - candlestick.

H4503.full: From an unused root meaning to apportion, that is, bestow; a donation; euphemistically tribute; specifically a sacrificial offering (usually bloodless and voluntary): - gift, oblation, (meat) offering, present, sacrifice.

H4504.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H4503; a sacrificial offering: - oblation, meat offering.

H4505.full: From H5162; comforter; Menachem, an Israelite: - Menahem.

H4506.full: From H5117; rest; Manachath, the name of an Edomite and of a place in Moab: - Manahath.

H4507.full: From H4487; the Apportioner, that is, Fate (as an idol): - number.

H4508.full: Of foreign derivation; Minni, an Armenian province: - Minni.

H4509.full: From H4480 and H3225; from (the) right hand; Minjamin, the name of two Israelites: - Miniamin. Compare H4326.

H4511.full: From the same as H4482; enumeration; Minnith, a place East of the Jordan: - Minnith.

H4512.full: From H5239; completion, that is, (in produce) wealth: - perfection.

H4513.full: A primitive root; to debar (negatively or positively) from benefit or injury: - deny, keep (back), refrain, restrain, withhold.

H4517.full: From H5128; a sistrum (so called from its rattling sound): - cornet.

H4518.full: From H5352; a sacrificial basin (for holding blood): - bowl.

H4519.full: From H5382; causing to forget; Menashsheh, a grandson of jacob, also the tribe descendant from him, and its territory: - Manasseh.

H4520.full: From H4519; a Menashshite or descendant of Menashsheh: - of Manasseh, Manassites.

H4521.full: From H4487; an allotment (by courtesy, law or providence): - portion.

H4522.full: mas mis mas, mees From H4549; properly a burden (as causing to faint), that is, a tax in the form of forced labor: - discomfited, levy, task [-master], tribute (-tary).

H4523.full: mâs mawce From H4549; fainting, that is, (figuratively) disconsolate: - is afflicted.

H4524.firstSense: that compass about, (place) round about, at table
H4524.full: From H5437; a divan (as enclosing the room); abstractly (adverbially) around: - that compass about, (place) round about, at table.

H4525.full: From H5462; a fastener, that is, (of a person) a smith, (of a thing) a prison: - prison, smith.

H4526.full: From H5462; something enclosing, that is, a margin (of a region, of a panel); concretely a stronghold: - border, close place, hole.

H4528.full: From the same as H5468; a colonnade or internal portico (from its rows of pillars): - porch.

H4529.firstSense: make to consume away, (make to) melt, water
H4529.full: A primitive root; to dissolve: - make to consume away, (make to) melt, water.

H4530.full: From H4549 (in the sense of flowing); abundance, that is, (adverbially) liberally: - tribute.

H4531.full: From H5254; a testing, of men (judicial) or of God (querulous): - temptation, trial.

H4532.full: The same as H4531; Massah, a place in the Desert: - Massah.

H4533.full: Apparently from an unused root meaning to cover; a veil: - vail.

H4534.full: For H4881; a hedge: - thorn hedge.

H4535.full: From H5255 in the sense of staving off; a cordon, (adverbially) or (as a) military barrier: - broken down.

H4537.full: A primitive root; to mix, especially wine (with spices): - mingle.

H4538.full: From H4537; a mixture, that is, of wine with spices: - mixture.

H4539.full: From H5526; a cover, that is, veil: - covering, curtain, hanging.

H4540.full: From H5526; a covering, that is, garniture: - covering.

H4541.full: From H5258; properly a pouring over, that is, fusion of metal (especially a cast image); by implication a libation, that is, league; concretely a coverlet (as if poured out): - covering, molten (image), vail.

H4543.full: By transposition from H3664; a magazine: - store(-house), treasure.

H4545.full: From H5259 in the sense of spreading out; something expanded, that is, the warp in a loom (as stretched out to receive the woof): - web.

H4546.full: From H5549; a thoroughfare (as turnpiked), literally or figuratively; specifically a viaduct, a staircase: - causeway, course, highway, path, terrace.

H4547.full: From H5549; a thoroughfare (as turnpiked): - highway.

H4548.full: From H5568; a peg (as bristling from the surface): - nail.

H4549.firstSense: discourage, faint, be loosed, melt (away), refuse, X utterly
H4549.full: A primitive root; to liquefy; figuratively to waste (with disease), to faint (with fatigue, fear or grief): - discourage, faint, be loosed, melt (away), refuse, X utterly.

H4550.full: massa‛ mas-sah From H5265; a departure (from striking the tents), that is, march (not necessarily a single day's travel); by implication a station (or point of departure): - journey (-ing).

H4551.full: From H5265 in the sense of projecting; a missile (spear or arrow); also a quarry (whence stones are, as it were, ejected): - before it was brought, darticle

H4552.full: From H5582; a balustrade (for stairs): - pillar.

H4553.full: From H5594; a lamentation: - lamentation, one mourneth, mourning, wailing.

H4554.full: mis-po' From an unused root meaning to collect; fodder: - provender.

H4555.full: From H5596; a veil (as spread out): - kerchief.

H4556.full: From H5596; scurf (as spreading over the surface): - scab.

H4557.firstSense: + abundance, account, X all, X few, [in-] finite, (certain) number (-ed), tale, telling…
H4557.full: From H5608; a number, definitely (arithmetical) or indefinitely (large, innumerable; small, a few); also (abstractly) narration: - + abundance, account, X all, X few, [in-] finite, (certain) number (-ed), tale, telling, + time.

H4558.full: The same as H4457; number; Mispar, an Israelite: - Mizpar. Compare H4559.

H4559.full: Feminine of H4457; enumeration; Mispereth, an Israelite: - Mispereth. Compare H4458.

H4560.full: A primitive root; to sunder, that is, (transitively) set apart, or (reflexively) apostatize: - commit, deliver.

H4564.full: From H5641; properly a hider, that is, (abstractly) a hiding, that is, aversion: - hid.

H4565.full: From H5641; properly a concealer, that is, a covert: - secret (-ly, place).

H4567.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H4566; an act: - work.

H4568.full: From H5666; properly compact (part of soil), that is, loam: - clay.

H4569.full: From H5674; a crossing place (of a river, a ford; of a mountain, a pass); abstractly a transit, that is, (figuratively) overwhelming: - ford, place where . . . pass, passage.

H4570.full: From the same as H5696; a track (literally or figuratively); also a rampart (as circular): - going, path, trench, way([-side]).

H4571.full: A primitive root; to waver: - make to shake, slide, slip.

H4572.full: From H5710; ornamental; Maadai, an Israelite: - Maadai.

H4573.full: From H5710 and H3050; ornament of Jah; Maadjah, an Israelite: - Maadiah. Compare H4153.

H4574.full: From H5727; a delicacy or (abstractly) pleasure (adverbially cheerfully): - dainty, delicately, delight.

H4575.full: By transposition from H6029; a bond, that is, group: - influence.

H4577.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H4578; only in plural the bowels: - belly.

H4578.full: From an unused root probably meaning to be soft; used only in plural the intestines, or (collectively) the abdomen, figuratively sympathy; by implication a vest; by extension the stomach, the uterus (or of men, the seat of generation), the heart (figuratively): - belly, bowels, X heart, womb.

H4579.full: Feminine of H4578; the belly, that is, (figuratively) interior: - gravel.

H4580.full: From H5746; a cake of bread (with H3934 a table buffoon, that is, parasite): - cake, feast.

H4581.firstSense: force, fort (-ress), rock, strength (-en), (X most) strong (hold)
H4581.full: From H5810; a fortified place; figuratively a defence: - force, fort (-ress), rock, strength (-en), (X most) strong (hold).

H4582.full: From H4600; oppressed; Maok, a Philistine: - Maoch.

H4583.full: From the same as H5772; an abode, of God (the Tabernacle or the Temple), men (their home) or animals (their lair); hence a retreat (asylum): - den, dwelling ([-]) place), habitation.

H4584.full: The same as H4583; a residence; Maon, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine: - Maon, Maonites. Compare H1010, H4586.

H4585.full: Feminine of H4583, and meaning the same: - den, habitation, (dwelling) place, refuge.

H4586.full: Probably patrial from H4584; a Meunite, or inhabitant of Maon (only in plural): - Mehunim (-s), Meunim.

H4587.full: Plural of H4585; habitative; Meonothai, an Israelite: - Meonothai.

H4588.full: From H5774 in the sense of covering with shade (compare H4155); darkness: - dimness.

H4589.full: From H5783; nakedness, that is, (in plural) the pudenda: - nakedness.

H4590.full: Probably from H5756 (in the sense of protection) and H3050; rescue of Jah; Maazjah, the name of two Israelites: - Maaziah.

H4591.firstSense: suffer to decrease, diminish, (be, X borrow a, give, make) few (in number, -ness), gath…
H4591.full: A primitive root; properly to pare off, that is, lessen; intransitively to be (or causatively to make) small or few (or figuratively ineffective): - suffer to decrease, diminish, (be, X borrow a, give, make) few (in number, -ness), gather least (little), be (seem) little, (X give the) less, be minished, bring to nothing.

H4592.firstSense: almost, (some, very) few (-er, -est), lightly, little (while), (very) small (matter, th…
H4592.full: From H4591; a little or few (often adverbial or comparative): - almost, (some, very) few (-er, -est), lightly, little (while), (very) small (matter, thing), some, soon, X very.

H4593.full: Passive adjective of H4591; thinned (as to the edge), that is, sharp: - wrapped up.

H4596.full: From H5753; a pile of rubbish (as contorted), that is, a ruin (compare H5856): - heap.

H4597.full: Probably from H4578; sympathetic; Maai, an Israelite: - Maai.

H4598.full: From H4603 in the sense of covering; a robe (that is, upper and outer garment): - cloke, coat, mantle, robe.

H4599.full: From H5869 (as a denominative in the sense of a spring); a fountain (also collectively), figuratively a source (of satisfaction): - fountain, spring, well.

H4600.full: A primitive root; to press, that is, to pierce, emasculate, handle: - bruised, stuck, be pressed.

H4601.full: From H4600; depression; Maakah (or Maakath), the name of a place in Syria, also of a Mesopotamian, of three Israelites, and of four Israelitesses and one Syrian woman: - Maachah, Maachathites. See also H1038.

H4602.full: Patrial from H4601; a Maakathite, or inhabitant of Maakah: - Maachathite.

H4603.full: A primitive root; properly to cover up; used only figuratively to act covertly, that is, treacherously: - transgress, (commit, do a) tresspass (-ing).

H4604.firstSense: falsehood, grievously, sore, transgression, trespass, X very
H4604.full: From H4608; treachery, that is, sin: - falsehood, grievously, sore, transgression, trespass, X very.

H4605.firstSense: above, exceeding (-ly), forward, on (X very) high, over, up (-on, -ward), very
H4605.full: From H5927; properly the upper part, used only adverbially with prefix upward, above, overhead, from the top, etc.: - above, exceeding (-ly), forward, on (X very) high, over, up (-on, -ward), very.

H4606.full: (Chaldee); from H5954; (only in plural as singular) the setting (of the sun): - going down.

H4607.full: From H5927; a raising (of the hands): - lifting up.

H4608.firstSense: ascent, before, chiefest, cliff, that goeth up, going up, hill, mounting up, stairs
H4608.full: From H5927; an elevation, that is, (concretely) acclivity or platform; abstractly (the relation or state) a rise or (figuratively) priority: - ascent, before, chiefest, cliff, that goeth up, going up, hill, mounting up, stairs.

H4609.firstSense: things that come up, (high) degree, deal, go up, stair, step, story
H4609.full: Feminine of H4608; elevation, that is, the act (literally a journey to a higher place, figuratively a thought arising), or (concretely) the condition (literally a step or grade mark, figuratively a superiority of station); specifically a climactic progression (in certain Psalms): - things that come up, (high) degree, deal, go up, stair, step, story.

H4610.firstSense: Maaleh-accrabim, the ascent (going up) of Akrabbim
H4610.full: From H4608 and (the plural of) H6137; Steep of Scorpions, a place in the Desert: - Maaleh-accrabim, the ascent (going up) of Akrabbim.

H4611.full: From H5953; an act (good or bad): - doing, endeavour, invention, work.

H4612.full: From H5975; (figuratively) a position: - attendance, office, place, state.

H4613.full: From H5975; literally a foothold: - standing.

H4615.full: From H6009; a deep: - deep, depth.

H4616.firstSense: because of, to the end (intent) that, for (to,
H4616.full: From H6030; properly heed, that is, purpose; used only adverbially, on account of (as a motive or an aim), teleologically in order that: - because of, to the end (intent) that, for (to, . . . 's sake), + lest, that, to.

H4617.full: From H6030; a reply (favorable or contradictory): - answer, X himself.

H4618.full: From H6031, in the sense of depression or tilling; a furrow: - + acre, furrow.

H4619.full: From H6095; closure; Maats, an Israelite: - Maaz.

H4621.full: From an unused root meaning to hew; an axe: - ax, tongs.

H4622.full: From H6113; objectively a hindrance: - restraint.

H4624.full: From an unused root meaning to repress; a parapet: - battlement.

H4625.full: From H6140; a crook (in a road): - crooked thing.

H4626.full: From H6168; a nude place, that is, (literally) the pudenda, or (figuratively) a vacant space: - nakedness, proportion.

H4627.full: From H6148, in the sense of trading; traffic; by implication mercantile goods: - market, merchandise.

H4628.full: From H6150, in the sense of shading; the west (as the region of the evening sun): - west.

H4629.full: From H6168; a nude place, that is, a common: - meadows.

H4630.full: Feminine of H4629; an open spot: - army [from the margin].

H4631.full: From H5783; a cavern (as dark): - cave, den, hole.

H4632.full: The same as H4631; cave; Mearah, a place in Palestine: - Mearah.

H4633.full: From H6168; an arrangement, that is, (figuratively) mental disposition: - preparation.

H4634.firstSense: army, fight, be set in order, ordered place, rank, row
H4634.full: Feminine of H4633; an arrangement; concretely a pile; specifically a military array: - army, fight, be set in order, ordered place, rank, row.

H4635.full: From H6186; an arrangement, that is, (concretely) a pile (of loaves): - row, shewbread.

H4636.full: From H6191, in the sense of stripping; bare: - naked.

H4638.full: A form of H4630; waste; Maarath, a place in Palestine: - Maarath.

H4639.firstSense: act, art, + bakemeat, business, deed, do (-ing), labour, thing made, ware of making, oc…
H4639.full: From H6213; an action (good or bad); generally a transaction; abstractly activity; by implication a product (specifically a poem) or (generally) property: - act, art, + bakemeat, business, deed, do (-ing), labour, thing made, ware of making, occupation, thing offered, operation, possession, X well, ([handy-, needle-, net-]) work, (-ing, -manship), wrought.

H4640.full: From H6213; operative; Maasai, an Israelite: - Maasiai.

H4641.full: From H4639 and H3050; work of Jah; Maasejah, the name of sixteen Israelites: - Masseiah.

H4642.full: From H6231; oppression: - oppression, X oppressor.

H4643.full: From H6240; a tenth; especially a tithe: - tenth (part), tithe (-ing).

H4644.full: môph mofe Of Egyptian origin; Moph, the capital of Lower Egypt: - Memphis. Compare H5297.

H4645.full: From H6293; an object of attack: - mark.

H4646.full: From H5301; a breathing out (of life), that is, expiring: - giving up.

H4647.full: From H5301; the bellows (that is, blower) of a forge: - bellows.

H4648.full: Probably from H6284 and H1322; dispeller of shame (that is, of Baal); Mephibosheth, the name of two Israelites: - Mephibosheth.

H4649.full: A plural apparently from H5130; wavings; Muppim, an Israelite: - Muppim. Compare H8206.

H4650.full: From H6327; a breaker, that is, mallet: - maul.

H4651.full: From H5307; a falling off, that is, chaff; also something pendulous, that is, a flap: - flake, refuse.

H4652.full: mif-law-aw' From H6381; a miracle: - wondrous work.

H4654.full: From H5307; something fallen, that is, a ruin: - ruin (-ous).

H4656.full: From H6426; a terror, that is, an idol: - idol.

H4657.full: From an unused root meaning to balance; a poising: - balancing.

H4658.full: From H5307; fall, that is, decadence; concretely a ruin; specifically a carcase: - carcase, fall, ruin.

H4660.full: From H5310; a smiting to pieces: - slaughter.

H4661.full: From H5310; a smiter, that is, a war club: - battle ax.

H4662.full: From H6485; an appointment, that is, mandate; concretely a designated spot; specifically a census: - appointed place, commandment, number.

H4663.full: The same as H4662; assignment; Miphkad, the name of a gate in Jerusalem: - Miphkad.

H4664.full: From H6555; a break (in the shore), that is, a haven: - breach.

H4665.full: From H6561; properly a fracture, that is, joint (vertebra) of the neck: - neck.

H4666.full: From H6566; an expansion: - that which . . . spreadest forth, spreading.

H4667.full: From H6585; a stride, that is, (by euphemism) the crotch: - buttocks.

H4668.full: From H6605; an opener, that is, a key: - key.

H4669.full: From H6605; an aperture, that is, (figuratively) utterance: - opening.

H4670.full: From the same as H6620; a stretcher, that is, a sill: - threshold.

H4671.full: môts môts motes, motes From H4160; chaff (as pressed out, that is, winnowed or (rather) threshed loose): - chaff.

H4672.firstSense: + be able, befall, being, catch, X certainly (cause to) come (on, to, to hand), deliver…
H4672.full: A primitive root; properly to come forth to, that is, appear or exist; transitively to attain, that is, find or acquire; figuratively to occur, meet or be present: - + be able, befall, being, catch, X certainly (cause to) come (on, to, to hand), deliver, be enough (cause to) find (-ing, occasion, out), get (hold upon), X have (here), be here, hit, be left, light (up-) on, meet (with), X occasion serve, (be) present, ready, speed, suffice, take hold on.

H4673.full: From H5324; a fixed spot; figuratively an office, a military post: - garrison, station, place where . . . stood.

H4674.full: From H5324; a station, that is, military post: - mount.

H4675.full: Feminine of H4673; a military guard: - army, garrison.

H4676.full: Feminine (causative) participle of H5324; something stationed, that is, a column or (memorial stone); by analogy an idol: - garrison, (standing) image, pillar.

H4677.full: Apparently from H4672 and H3050; found of Jah; Metsobajah, a place in Palestine: - Mesobaite.

H4678.full: From H5324; something stationary, that is, a monumental stone; also the stock of a tree: - pillar, substance.

H4679.full: From H6679; a fastness (as a covert of ambush): - castle, fort, (strong) hold, munition.

H4680.full: A primitive root; to suck out; by implication to drain, to squeeze out: - suck, wring (out).

H4681.full: Active participle feminine of H4680; drained; Motsah, a place in Palestine: - Mozah.

H4682.full: From H4711 in the sense of greedily devouring for sweetness; properly sweetness; concretely sweet (that is, not soured or bittered with yeast); specifically an unfermented cake or loaf, or (elliptically) the festival of Passover (because no leaven was then used): - unleavened (bread, cake), without leaven.

H4683.full: From H5327; a quarrel: - contention, debate, strife.

H4684.full: From H6670; a whinnying (through impatience for battle or lust): - neighing.

H4685.full: From H6679; a net (for capturing animals or fishes); also (by interchange for H4679) a fastness or (besieging) tower: - bulwark, hold, munition, net, snare.

H4686.firstSense: castle, defence, fort (-ress), (strong) hold, be hunted, net, snare, strong place
H4686.full: From H4685; a net, or (abstractly) capture; also a fastness: - castle, defence, fort (-ress), (strong) hold, be hunted, net, snare, strong place.

H4687.full: From H6680; a command, whether human or divine (collectively the Law): - (which was) commanded (-ment), law, ordinance, precept.

H4688.full: From the same as H6683; a deep place (of water or mud): - bottom, deep, depth.

H4689.full: From H6693; a narrow place, that is, (abstractly and figuratively) confinement or disability: - anguish, distress, straitness.

H4690.full: From H6693; something narrow, that is, a column or hill top: - pillar, situate.

H4691.full: Feminine of H4690; narrowness, that is, (figuratively) trouble: - anguish, distress.

H4692.firstSense: besieged, bulwark, defence, fenced, fortress, siege, strong (hold), tower
H4692.full: From H6696; something hemming in, that is, (objectively) a mound (of besiegers), (abstractly) a siege, (figuratively) distress; or (subjectively) a fastness: - besieged, bulwark, defence, fenced, fortress, siege, strong (hold), tower.

H4693.full: The same as H4692 in the sense of a limit; Egypt (as the border of Palestine): - besieged places, defence, fortified.

H4694.full: Feminine of H4692; a hemming in, that is, (objectively) a mound (of siege), or (subjectively) a rampart (of protection), (abstractly) fortification: - fenced (city,) fort, munition, strong hold.

H4695.full: From H5327; a quarrel: - that contended.

H4696.full: From an unused root meaning to be clear, that is, conspicuous; the forehead (as open and prominent): - brow, forehead, + impudent.

H4697.full: From the same as H4696; a shin piece of armor (as prominent), only plural: - greaves.

H4698.full: From H6750; a tinkler, that is, a bell: - bell.

H4700.full: From H6750; (only dual) double tinklers, that is, cymbals: - cymbals.

H4701.full: From H6801; a tiara, that is, official turban (of a king or high priest): - diadem, mitre.

H4703.full: From H6805; a step; figuratively companionship: - going, step.

H4704.full: Feminine of H4705; properly littleness; concretely diminutive: - little.

H4705.full: From H6819; petty (in size or number); adverbially a short (time): - little one, (while), small.

H4706.full: The same as H4705; Mitsar, a peak of Lebanon: - Mizar.

H4707.full: From H6822; an observatory, especially for military purposes: - watch tower.

H4708.full: The same as H4707; Mitspeh, the name of five places in Palestine: - Mizpeh, watch tower. Compare H4709.

H4709.full: Feminine of H4708; Mitspah, the name of two places in Palestine. (This seems rather to be only an orthographical variation of H4708 when 'in pause'.): - Mitspah. [This seems rather to be only an orthographical variationof H4708 when "in pause".]

H4710.full: From H6845; a secret (place or thing, perhaps treasure): - hidden thing.

H4711.full: A primitive root; to suck: - milk.

H4712.full: From H6896; something tight, that is, (figuratively) trouble: - distress, pain, strait.

H4713.full: From H4714; a Mitsrite, or inhabitant of Mitsrajim: - Egyptian, of Egypt.

H4714.full: Dual of H4693; Mitsrajim, that is, Upper and Lower Egypt: - Egypt, Egyptians, Mizraim.

H4715.full: From H6884; a crucible: - fining pot.

H4716.full: maq mak From H4743; properly a melting, that is, putridity: - rottenness, stink.

H4717.full: From H5344; properly a perforatrix, that is, a hammer (as piercing): - hammer.

H4718.full: From H5344; properly a perforator, that is, a hammer (as piercing); also (intransitively) a perforation, that is, a quarry: - hammer, hole.

H4719.full: From the same as H5348 in the denominative sense of herding (compare H5349); fold; Makkedah, a place in Palestine: - Makkedah.

H4720.firstSense: chapel, hallowed part, holy place, sanctuary
H4720.full: From H6942; a consecrated thing or place, especially a palace, sanctuary (whether of Jehovah or of idols) or asylum: - chapel, hallowed part, holy place, sanctuary.

H4722.full: Plural of H4721 (feminine); assemblies; Makheloth, a place in the Desert: - Makheloth.

H4723.firstSense: abiding, gathering together, hope, linen yarn, plenty [of water], pool
H4723.full: mik-veh', mik-vay', mik-vay' From H6960; something waited for, that is, confidence (objectively or subjectively); also a collection, that is, (of water) a pond, or (of men and horses) a caravan or drove: - abiding, gathering together, hope, linen yarn, plenty [of water], pool.

H4724.full: Feminine of H4723; a collection, that is, (of water) a reservoir: - ditch.

H4725.firstSense: country, X home, X open, place, room, space, X whither [-soever]
H4725.full: From H6965; properly a standing, that is, a spot; but used widely of a locality (generally or specifically); also (figuratively) of a condition (of body or mind): - country, X home, X open, place, room, space, X whither [-soever].

H4726.full: From H6979; properly something dug, that is, a (generally) source (of water, even when naturally flowing; also of tears, blood (by euphemism of the female pudenda); figuratively of happiness, wisdom, progeny): - fountain, issue, spring, well (-spring).

H4728.full: From H3947; something received, that is, merchandise (purchased): - ware.

H4729.full: From H6999; something to fume (incense) on, that is, a hearth place: - to burn . . . upon.

H4730.full: Feminine of H4729; something to fume (incense) in, that is, a coal pan: - censer.

H4731.full: From an unused root meaning apparently to germinate; a shoot, that is, stick (with leaves on, or for walking, striking, guiding, divining): - rod, ([hand-]) staff.

H4732.full: Plural of (feminine) H4731; rods; Mikloth, a place in the Desert: - Mikloth.

H4733.full: From H7038 in the sense of taking in; an asylum (as a receptacle): - refuge.

H4734.full: From H7049; a sculpture (probably in bass relief): - carved (figure), carving, graving.

H4735.firstSense: cattle, flock, herd, possession, purchase, substance
H4735.full: From H7069; something bought, that is, property, but only live stock; abstractly acquisition: - cattle, flock, herd, possession, purchase, substance.

H4736.firstSense: (he that is) bought, possession, piece, purchase
H4736.full: Feminine of H4735; properly a buying, that is, acquisition; concretely a piece of property (land or living); also the sum paid: - (he that is) bought, possession, piece, purchase.

H4737.full: From H4735 and H3050; possession of Jah; Miknejah, an Israelite: - Mikneiah.

H4739.full: From H7112; end; Makats, a place in Palestine: - Makaz.

H4740.full: From H7106 in the denominative sense of bending; an angle or recess: - corner, turning.

H4741.full: From H7106; a scraper, that is, a carving chisel: - plane.

H4742.full: From H7106 in the denominative sense of bending; an angle: - corner.

H4743.firstSense: consume away, be corrupt, dissolve, pine away
H4743.full: A primitive root; to melt; figuratively to flow, dwindle, vanish: - consume away, be corrupt, dissolve, pine away.

H4744.full: mik-raw' From H7121; something called out, that is, a public meeting (the act, the persons, or the palce); also a rehearsal: - assembly, calling, convocation, reading.

H4745.firstSense: something befallen, befalleth, chance, event, hap (-peneth)
H4745.full: From H7136; something met with, that is, an accident or fortune: - something befallen, befalleth, chance, event, hap (-peneth).

H4746.full: From H7136; properly something meeting, that is, a frame (of timbers): - building.

H4747.full: From the same as H7119; a cooling off: - X summer.

H4748.full: From H7185 in the sense of knotting up round and hard; something turned (rounded), that is, a curl (of tresses): - X well [set] hair.

H4749.firstSense: beaten (out of one piece, work), upright, whole piece
H4749.full: Feminine of H4748; rounded work, that is, moulded by hammering (repousse): - beaten (out of one piece, work), upright, whole piece.

H4750.full: Denominative from H7180; literally a cucumbered field, that is, a cucumber patch: - garden of cucumbers.

H4751.firstSense: + angry, bitter (-ly, -ness), chafed, discontented, X great, heavy
H4751.full: From H4843; bitter (literally or figuratively); also (as noun) bitterness, or (adverbially) bitterly: - + angry, bitter (-ly, -ness), chafed, discontented, X great, heavy.

H4752.full: mar mar From H4843 in its original sense of distillation; a drop: - drop.

H4753.full: môr môr more, more From H4843; myrrh (as distilling in drops, and also as bitter): - myrrh.

H4754.full: A primitive root; to rebel; hence (through the idea of maltreating) to whip, that is, lash (self with wings, as the ostrich in running): - be filthy, lift up self.

H4755.full: For H4751 feminine; bitter; Mara, a symbolical name of Naomi: - Mara.

H4756.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H4754 in the sense of domineering; a master: - lord, Lord.

H4757.full: mer-o-dak' bal-aw-dawn' Of foreign derivation; Merodak-Baladan, a Babylonian king: - Merodach-baladan. Compare H4781.

H4758.firstSense: X apparently, appearance (-reth), X as soon as beautiful (-ly), countenance, fair, favo…
H4758.full: mar-eh' From H7200; a view (the act of seeing); also an appearance (the thing seen), whether (real) a shape (especially if handsome, comeliness; often plural the looks), or (mental) a vision: - X apparently, appearance (-reth), X as soon as beautiful (-ly), countenance, fair, favoured, form, goodly, to look (up) on (to), look [-eth], pattern, to see, seem, sight, visage, vision.

H4759.full: mar-aw' Feminine of H4758; a vision; also (causatively) a mirror: - looking glass, vision.

H4760.full: Apparently feminine passive causative participle of H7200; something conspicuous, that is, the craw of a bird (from its prominence): - crop.

H4761.full: mar-aw-shaw' Denominative from H7218; properly headship, that is, (plural for collective) dominion: - principality.

H4762.full: mar-ay-shaw', mar-ay-shaw' Formed like H4761; summit; Mareshah, the name of two Israelites and of a place in Palestine: - Mareshah.

H4763.full: mer-ah-ash-aw' Formed like H4761; properly a headpiece, that is, (plural for adverb) at (or as) the head rest (or pillow): - bolster, head, pillow. Compare H4772.

H4764.full: From H7231; increase; Merab, a daughter of Saul: - Merab.

H4765.full: From H7234; a coverlet: - covering of tapestry.

H4766.full: From H7235; properly increasing; as noun, greatness, or (adverbially) greatly: - great, increase.

H4767.full: From H7235; abundance, that is, a great quantity: - much.

H4768.full: From H7235; a multitude; also offspring; specifically interest (on capital): - greatest part, greatness, increase, multitude.

H4769.firstSense: couching place, place to lie down
H4769.full: From H7257; a reclining place, that is, fold (for flocks): - couching place, place to lie down.

H4770.full: From an unused root meaning to tie up; a stall (for cattle): - X fat (-ted), stall.

H4771.full: From H7280; a resting place: - rest.

H4772.full: Denominative from H7272; (plural for collective) a foot piece, that is, (adverbially) at the foot, or (directly) the foot itself: - feet. Compare H4763.

H4773.full: From H7275; a stone heap: - sling.

H4775.full: A primitive root; to rebel: - rebel (-lious).

H4776.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H4775; rebellion: - rebellion.

H4778.full: The same as H4777; Mered, an Israelite: - Mered.

H4779.full: (Chaldee); from the same as H4776; rebellious: - rebellious.

H4781.full: Of foreign derivation; Merodak, a Babylonian idol: - Merodach. Compare H4757.

H4782.full: Of foreign derivation; Mordecai, an Israelite: - Mordecai.

H4784.firstSense: bitter, change, be disobedient, disobey, grievously, provocation, provoke (-ing), (be)…
H4784.full: A primitive root; to be (causatively make) bitter (or unpleasant); (figuratively) to rebel (or resist; causatively to provoke): - bitter, change, be disobedient, disobey, grievously, provocation, provoke (-ing), (be) rebel (against, -lious).

H4785.full: The same as H4751 feminine; bitter; Marah, a place in the Desert: - Marah.

H4786.full: From H4843; bitterness, that is, (figuratively) trouble: - grief.

H4787.full: A form of H4786; trouble: - bitterness.

H4788.full: From H7300 in the sense of maltreatment; an outcast; (abstractly) destitution: - cast out, misery.

H4789.full: Of uncertain derivation; Meroz, a place in Palestine: - Meroz.

H4790.full: From H4799; bruised, that is, emasculated: - broken.

H4791.firstSense: (far) above, dignity, haughty, height, (most, on) high (one, place), loftily, upward
H4791.full: From H7311; altitude, that is, concretely (an elevated place), abstractly (elevation), fig (elation), or adverbial (aloft): - (far) above, dignity, haughty, height, (most, on) high (one, place), loftily, upward.

H4792.full: Formed like H4791; height; Merom, a lake in Palestine: - Merom.

H4793.full: From H7323; a run (the trial of speed): - race.

H4794.full: Feminine of H4793; a race (the act), whether the manner or the progress: - course, running. Compare H4835.

H4795.full: From H4838; properly rubbed; but used abstractly, a rubbing (with perfumery): - purification.

H4796.full: Plural of H4751 feminine; bitter springs; Maroth, a place in Palestine: - Maroth.

H4797.full: From an unused root meaning to scream; a cry, that is, (of joy), a revel: - banquet.

H4798.full: Formed like H4797; a cry, that is, (of grief) a lamentation: - mourning.

H4799.full: A primitive root; properly to soften by rubbing or pressure; hence (medicinally) to apply as an emollient: - lay for a plaister.

H4800.full: From H7337; enlargement, either literally (an open space, usually in a good sense), or figuratively (liberty): - breadth, large place (room).

H4801.full: From H7368; remoteness, that is, (concretely) a distant place; often (adverbially) from afar: - (a, dwell in, very) far (country, off). See also H1023.

H4802.full: From H7370; a stew pan: - fryingpan.

H4803.firstSense: bright, furbish, (have his) hair (be) fallen off, peeled, pluck off (hair
H4803.full: A primitive root; to polish; by implication to make bald (the head), to gall (the shoulder); also, to sharpen: - bright, furbish, (have his) hair (be) fallen off, peeled, pluck off (hair.)

H4804.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H4803; to pull off: - be plucked.

H4805.full: From H4784; bitterness, that is, (figuratively) rebellion; concretely bitter, or rebellious: - bitter, (most) rebel (-ion, -lious).

H4806.full: mer-ee' From H4754 in the sense of grossness, through the idea of domineering (compare H4756); stall fed; often (as noun) a beeve: - fat (fed) beast (cattle, -ling).

H4807.full: From H7378 and H1168; quarreller of Baal; Merib-Baal, an epithet of Gideon: - Merib-baal. Compare H4810.

H4809.full: The same as H4808; Meribah, the name of two places in the Desert: - Meribah.

H4810.full: From H4805 and H1168; rebellion of (that is, against) Baal; Meri-Baal, an epithet of Gideon: - Meri-baal. Compare H4807.

H4811.full: From H4784; rebellion; Merajah, an Israelite: - Meraiah. Compare H3236.

H4812.full: Plural of H4811; rebellious; Merajoth, the name of two Israelites: - Meraioth.

H4813.full: From H4805; rebelliously; Mirjam, the name of two Israelitesses: - Miriam.

H4814.full: From H4843; bitterness, that is, (figuratively) grief: - bitterness.

H4815.full: From H4843; bitter, that is, poisonous: - bitter.

H4816.full: Perhaps from H7401; softness, that is, (figuratively) fear: - faintness.

H4817.full: From H7392; a chariot; also a seat (in a vehicle): - chariot, covering, saddle.

H4818.full: Feminine of H4817; a chariot: - chariot. See also H1024.

H4820.firstSense: craft, deceit (-ful, -fully), false, feigned, guile, subtilly, treachery
H4820.full: From H7411 in the sense of deceiving; fraud: - craft, deceit (-ful, -fully), false, feigned, guile, subtilly, treachery.

H4821.full: The same as H4820; Mirmah, an Israelite: - Mirma.

H4822.full: Plural from H7311; heights; Meremoth, the name of two Israelites: - Meremoth.

H4823.full: From H7429; abasement (the act or the thing): - tread (down) -ing, (to be) trodden (down) under foot.

H4824.full: Patrial from an unused noun; a Meronothite, or inhabitant of some (otherwise unknown) Meronoth: - Meronothite.

H4825.full: Of foreign derivation; Meres, a Persian: - Meres.

H4826.full: mar-sen-aw' Of foreign derivation; Marsena, a Persian: - Marsena.

H4827.full: From H7489; used as (abstraction) noun, wickedness: - do mischief.

H4828.full: From H7462 in the sense of companionship; a friend: - companion, friend.

H4829.full: From H7462 in the sense of feeding; pasture (the palce or the act); also the haunt of wild animals: - feeding place, pasture.

H4830.full: From H7462 in the sense of feeding; pasturage; concretely a flock: - flock, pasture.

H4831.full: From H7477; perhaps earthquake; Maralah, a place in Palestine: - Maralah.

H4832.firstSense: ([in-]) cure (-able), healing (-lth), remedy, sound, wholesome, yielding
H4832.full: mar-pay' From H7495; properly curative, that is, literally (concretely) a medicine, or (abstractly) a cure; figuratively (concretely) deliverance, or (abstractly) placidity: - ([in-]) cure (-able), healing (-lth), remedy, sound, wholesome, yielding.

H4833.full: From H7515; muddled water: - that which . . . have fouled.

H4834.full: A primitive root; properly to press, that is, (figuratively) to be pungent or vehement; to irritate: - embolden, be forcible, grievous, sore.

H4835.full: From H7533; oppression: - violence. See also H4794.

H4838.full: A primitive root; to polish; by implication to sharpen; also to rinse: - bright, furbish, scour.

H4839.full: From H4838; soup (as if a rinsing): - broth. See also H6564.

H4840.full: From H7543; a spicy herb: - X sweet.

H4841.full: Feminine of H4840; abstractly a seasoning (with spicery); concretely an unguent kettle (for preparing spiced oil): - pot of ointment, X well.

H4842.firstSense: prepared by the apothecaries' art, compound, ointment
H4842.full: From H7543; an aromatic unguent; also an unguent pot: - prepared by the apothecaries' art, compound, ointment.

H4843.firstSense: (be, be in, deal, have, make) bitter (-ly, -ness), be moved with choler, (be, have sore…
H4843.full: A primitive root; properly to trickle (see H4752); but used only as a denominative from H4751; to be (causatively make) bitter (literally or figuratively): - (be, be in, deal, have, make) bitter (-ly, -ness), be moved with choler, (be, have sorely, it) grieved (-eth), provoke, vex.

H4844.full: From H4843; a bitter herb: - bitter (-ness).

H4845.full: From H4843; bile (from its bitterness): - gall.

H4846.full: From H4843; properly bitterness; concretely a bitter thing; specifically bile; also venom (of a serpent): - bitter (thing), gall.

H4847.full: From H4843; bitter; Merari, an Israelite: - Merari. See also H4848.

H4848.full: From H4847; a Merarite (collectively), or descendant of Merari: - Merarites.

H4849.full: From H7561; a female wicked doer: - wicked woman.

H4850.full: Dual of H4751 feminine; double bitterness; Merathajim, an epithet of Babylon: - Merathaim.

H4851.full: mash mash Of foreign derivation; Mash, a son of Aram, and the people descendant from him: - Mash.

H4852.full: Of foreign derivation; Mesha, a place in Arabia: - Mesha.

H4853.firstSense: burden, carry away, prophecy, X they set, song, tribute
H4853.full: From H5375; a burden; specifically tribute, or (abstractly) porterage; figuratively an utterance, chiefly a doom, especially singing; mental, desire: - burden, carry away, prophecy, X they set, song, tribute.

H4854.full: The same as H4853; burden; Massa, a son of Ishmael: - Massa.

H4855.full: mash-shaw' From H5383; a loan; by implication interest on a debt: - exaction, usury.

H4856.full: From H5375; partiality (as a lifting up): - respect.

H4857.full: mash-awb' From H7579; a trough for cattle to drink from: - place of drawing water.

H4858.full: From H5375; a conflagration (from the rising of smoke): - burden.

H4859.full: mash-shaw-aw' Feminine of H4855; a loan: - X any [-thing], debt.

H4861.full: mish-awl' From H7592; request; Mishal, a place in Palestine: - Mishal, Misheal. Compare H4913.

H4862.full: mish-aw-law' From H7592; a request: - desire, petition.

H4863.full: mish-eh'-reth From H7604 in the original sense of swelling; a kneading trough (in which the dough rises): - kneading trough, store.

H4864.firstSense: burden, collection, sign of fire, (great) flame, gift, lifting up, mess, oblation, reward
H4864.full: mas-ayth' From H5375; properly (abstractly) a raising (as of the hands in prayer), or rising (of flame); figuratively an utterance; concretely a beacon (as raised); a present (as taken), mess, or tribute; figuratively a reproach (as a burden): - burden, collection, sign of fire, (great) flame, gift, lifting up, mess, oblation, reward.

H4865.full: From H7660; a brocade; by analogy a (reticulated) setting of a gem: - ouch, wrought.

H4866.full: From H7665; the orifice of the womb (from which the foetus breaks forth): - birth, breaking forth.

H4867.full: From H7665; a breaker (of the sea): - billow, wave.

H4868.full: From H7673; cessation, that is, destruction: - sabbath.

H4869.full: From H7682; properly a cliff (or other lofty or inaccessible place); abstractly altitude; figuratively a refuge; misgab; a place in Moab: - defence, high fort (tower), refuge. H4869; Misgab, a place in Moab: - Misgab.

H4871.full: A primitive root; to pull out (literally or figuratively): - draw (out).

H4872.full: From H4871; drawing out (of the water), that is, rescued; Mosheh, the Israelitish lawgiver: - Moses.

H4875.full: mesh-o-aw', mesh-o-aw' From the same as H7722; (a) ruin, abstractly (the act) or concretely (the wreck): - desolation, waste.

H4876.full: mash-shoo-aw', mash-shoo-aw' For H4875; ruin: - desolation, destruction.

H4877.full: From H7725; returned; Meshobab, an Israelite: - Meshobab.

H4878.full: From H7725; apostasy: - backsliding, turning away.

H4879.full: From an unused root meaning to stray; mistake: - error.

H4882.full: From an unused root meaning to plunder; spoliation: - spoil.

H4883.full: From an unused root meaning to rasp; a saw: - saw.

H4884.full: From an unused root meaning apparently to divide; a measure (for liquids): - measure.

H4885.full: From H7797; delight, concretely (the cause or object) or abstractly (the feeling): - joy, mirth, rejoice.

H4886.full: A primitive root; to rub with oil, that is, to anoint; by implication to consecrate; also to paint: - anoint, paint.

H4887.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H4886; oil: - oil.

H4888.full: From H4886; unction (the act); by implication a consecratory gift: - (to be) anointed (-ing), ointment.

H4889.firstSense: corruption, (to) destroy (-ing), destruction, trap, X utterly
H4889.full: From H7843; destructive, that is, (as noun) destruction, literally (specifically a snare) or figuratively (corruption): - corruption, (to) destroy (-ing), destruction, trap, X utterly.

H4890.full: From H7831; a laughing stock: - scorn.

H4891.full: From H7836 in the sense of day breaking; dawn: - morning.

H4894.full: From H7849; a spreading place: - (to) spread (forth, -ing, upon).

H4895.full: From the same as H7850; enmity: - hatred.

H4897.full: From H4871; silk (as drawn from the cocoon): - silk.

H4898.full: mesh-ay-zab-ale' From an equivalent to H7804 and H410; delivered of God; Meshezabel, an Israelite: - Meshezabeel.

H4899.full: From H4886; anointed; usually a consecrated person (as a king, priest, or saint); specifically the Messiah: - anointed, Messiah.

H4900.firstSense: draw (along, out), continue, defer, extend, forbear, X give, handle, make (pro-, sound)…
H4900.full: A primitive root; to draw, used in a great variety of applications (including to sow, to sound, to prolong, to develop, to march, to remove, to delay, to be tall, etc.): - draw (along, out), continue, defer, extend, forbear, X give, handle, make (pro-, sound) long, X sow, scatter, stretch out.

H4901.full: From H4900; a sowing; also a possession: - precious, price.

H4902.full: The same in form as H4901, but probably of foreign derivation; Meshek, a son of Japheth, and the people descendant from him: - Mesech, Meshech.

H4903.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H4904; a bed: - bed.

H4904.full: From H7901; a bed (figuratively a bier); abstractly sleep; by euphemism carnal intercourse: - bed ([-chamber]), couch, lieth (lying) with.

H4905.full: From H7919; instructive, that is, a didactic poem: - Maschil.

H4906.full: From the same as H7906; a figure (carved on stone, the wall, or any object); figuratively imagination: - conceit, image (-ry), picture, X wish.

H4908.full: From H7931; a residence (including a shepherd's hut, the lair of animals, figuratively the grave; also the Temple); specifically the Tabernacle (properly its wooden walls): - dwelleth, dwelling (place), habitation, tabernacle, tent.

H4909.full: From H7936; wages or a reward: - reward, wages.

H4910.firstSense: (have, make to have) dominion, governor, X indeed, reign, (bear, cause to, have) rule (…
H4910.full: A primitive root; to rule: - (have, make to have) dominion, governor, X indeed, reign, (bear, cause to, have) rule (-ing, -r), have power.

H4911.firstSense: be (-come) like, compare, use (as a) proverb, speak (in proverbs), utter
H4911.full: Denominative from H4912; to liken, that is, (transitively) to use figurative language (an allegory, adage, song or the like); intransitively to resemble: - be (-come) like, compare, use (as a) proverb, speak (in proverbs), utter.

H4912.full: Apparently from H4910 in some original sense of superiority in mental action; properly a pithy maxim, usually of a metaphorical nature; hence a simile (as an adage, poem, discourse): - byword, like, parable, proverb.

H4913.full: From H4861; Mashal, a place in Palestine: - Mashal.

H4915.full: (1) from H4910; empire; (2) from H4911; a parallel: - dominion, like.

H4916.firstSense: to lay, to put, sending (forth), to set
H4916.full: From H7971; a sending out, that is, (abstractly) presentation (favorable), or seizure (unfavorable); also (concretely) a place of dismissal, or a business to be discharged: - to lay, to put, sending (forth), to set.

H4917.full: Feminine of H4916; a mission, that is, (abstractly and favorable) release, or (concretely and unfavorable) an army: - discharge, sending.

H4918.full: From H7999; allied; Meshullam, the name of seventeen Israelites: - Meshullam.

H4919.full: Plural from H7999; reconciliations; Meshillemoth, an Israelite: - Meshillemoth, an Isr: - Meshillemoth. Compare H4921.

H4920.full: From H7999 and H3050; ally of Jah; Meshelemjah, an Israelite: - Meshelemiah.

H4921.full: From H7999; reconciliation; Meshillemith, an Israelite: - Meshillemith. Compare H4919.

H4922.full: Feminine of H4918; Meshullemeth, an Israelitess: - Meshullemeth.

H4923.full: From H8074; a waste or amazement: - astonishment, desolate.

H4924.full: From H8080; fat, that is, (literally and abstractly) fatness; but usually (figuratively and concretely) a rich dish, a fertile field, a robust man: - fat (one, -ness, -test, -test place).

H4925.full: From H8080; fatness; Mashmannah, an Israelite: - Mishmannah.

H4927.full: The same as H4926; Mishma, the name of a son of Ishmael, and of an Israelite: - Mishma.

H4928.full: Feminine of H4926; audience, that is, the royal court; also obedience, that is, (concretely) a subject: - bidding, guard, obey.

H4929.firstSense: diligence, guard, office, prison, ward, watch
H4929.full: From H8104; a guard (the man, the post, or the prison); figuratively a deposit; also (as observed) a usage (abstractly), or an example (concretely): - diligence, guard, office, prison, ward, watch.

H4930.full: For H4548 feminine; a peg: - nail.

H4931.firstSense: charge, keep, to be kept, office, ordinance, safeguard, ward, watch
H4931.full: Feminine of H4929; watch, that is, the act (custody) or (concretely) the sentry, the post; objectively preservation, or (concretely) safe; figuratively observance, that is, (abstractly) duty, or (objectively) a usage or party: - charge, keep, to be kept, office, ordinance, safeguard, ward, watch.

H4932.firstSense: college, copy, double, fatlings, next, second (order), twice as much
H4932.full: From H8138; properly a repetition, that is, a duplicate (copy of a document), or a double (in amount); by implication a second (in order, rank, age, quality or location): - college, copy, double, fatlings, next, second (order), twice as much.

H4934.full: From the same as H8168; a hollow, that is, a narrow passage: - path.

H4935.full: Probably from H8159; inspection: - to supple.

H4936.full: Apparently from H8159; inspection; Misham, an Israelite: - Misham.

H4937.full: From H8172; a support (concretely), that is, (figuratively) a protector or sustenance: - stay.

H4938.full: Feminine of H4937; support (abstractly), that is, (figuratively) sustenance or (concretely) a walking stick: - staff.

H4940.full: From H8192 (compare H8198); a family, that is, circle of relatives; figuratively a class (of persons), a species (of animals) or sort (of things); by extension a tribe or people: - family, kind (-red).

H4941.firstSense: + adversary, ceremony, charge, X crime, custom, desert, determination, discretion, disp…
H4941.full: From H8199; properly a verdict (favorable or unfavorable) pronounced judicially, especially a sentence or formal decree (human or (particularly) divine law, individual or collectively), including the act, the place, the suit, the crime, and the penalty; abstractly justice, including a particular right, or privilege (statutory or customary), or even a style: - + adversary, ceremony, charge, X crime, custom, desert, determination, discretion, disposing, due, fashion, form, to be judged, judgment, just (-ice, -ly), (manner of) law (-ful), manner, measure, (due) order, ordinance, right, sentence, usest, X worthy, + wrong.

H4942.full: From H8192; a stall for cattle (only dual): - burden, sheepfold.

H4943.full: From an unused root meaning to hold; possession: - + steward.

H4944.full: From H8264; a traversing, that is, rapid motion: - running to and fro.

H4945.firstSense: butler (-ship), cupbearer, drink (-ing), fat pasture, watered
H4945.full: From H8248; properly causing to drink, that is, a butler; by implication (intransitively) drink (itself); figuratively a well watered region: - butler (-ship), cupbearer, drink (-ing), fat pasture, watered.

H4947.full: From H8259 in its original sense of overhanging; a lintel: - lintel, upper door post.

H4948.full: From H8254; weight (numerically estimated); hence, weighing (the act): - (full) weight.

H4949.full: Feminine of H4948 or H4947; a weight, that is, a plummet (with line attached): - plummet.

H4950.full: From H8257; a settling place (of water), that is, a pond: - deep.

H4952.full: From H8281 in the sense of loosening; maceration, that is, steeped juice: - liquor.

H4953.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H8319; a (musical) pipe (from its whistling sound): - flute.

H4954.full: Patrial from an unused noun from an unused root; probably meaning to stretch out; extension; a Mishraite, or inhabitant (collectively) of Mishra: - Mishraites.

H4955.full: From H8313; combustion, that is, cremation (of a corpse), or calcination (of lime): - burning.

H4956.full: From the plural of H4955 and H4325; burnings of water; Misrephoth-Majim, a place in Palestine: - Misrephoth-mayim.

H4957.full: A form for H7796 used denominatively; vineyard; Masrekah, a place in Idumaea: - Masrekah.

H4958.full: Apparently from an unused root meaning to perforate, that is, hollow out; a pan: - pan.

H4959.full: A primitive root; to feel of; by implication to grope: - feel, grope, search.

H4960.full: From H8354; drink; by implication drinking (the act); also (by implication), a banquet or (generally) feast: - banquet, drank, drink, feast ([-ed], -ing).

H4961.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H4960; a banquet: - banquet.

H4962.firstSense: + few, X friends, men, persons, X small
H4962.full: math math From the same as H4970; properly an adult (as of full length); by implication a man (only in the plural): - + few, X friends, men, persons, X small.

H4963.full: Denominative from H8401; straw in the heap: - straw.

H4964.full: From an unused root meaning to curb; a bit: - bit, bridle.

H4965.full: meh'-theg haw-am-maw' From H4964 and H520 with the article interposed; bit of the metropolis; Metheg-ha-Ammah, an epithet of Gath: - Metheg-ammah.

H4967.full: meth-oo-shaw-ale' From H4962 and H410, with the relative interposed; man who (is) of God; Methushael, an antediluvian patriarch: - Methusael.

H4968.full: From H4962 and H7973; man of a dart; Methushelach, an antediluvian patriarch: - Methuselah.

H4969.full: A primitive root; to stretch out: - spread out.

H4970.full: From an unused root meaning to extend; properly extent (of time); but used only adverbially (especially with other particles prefixed), when (either relative or interrogitive): - long, when.

H4971.full: From H8505 in the transferred sense of measuring; proportion (in size, number or ingredients): - composition, measure, state, tale.

H4972.full: mat-tel-aw-aw' From H4100 and H8518; what a trouble!: - what a weariness.

H4973.full: Contracted from H3216; properly a biter, that is, a tooth: - cheek (jaw) tooth, jaw.

H4974.full: From H8552; wholesomeness; also (adverbially) completely. (men is by reading H4962.): - men [by reading H4962], soundness.

H4975.full: From an unused root meaning to be slender; properly the waist or small of the back; only in plural the loins: - + greyhound, loins, side.

H4976.full: From H5414; a present: - gift, to give, reward.

H4977.full: The same as H4976; Mattan, the name of a priest of Baal, and of an Israelite: - Mattan.

H4979.full: Feminine of H4976; a present; specifically (in a good sense) a sacrificial offering, (in a bad sense) a bribe: - gift.

H4980.full: The same as H4979; Mattanah, a place in the Desert: - Mattanah.

H4981.full: Probably patrial from an unused noun meaning slenderness; a Mithnite, or inhabitant of Methen: - Mithnite.

H4982.full: From H4976; liberal; Mattenai, the name of three Israelites: - Mattenai.

H4983.full: From H4976 and H3050; gift of Jah; Mattanjah, the name of ten Israelites: - Mattaniah.

H4984.full: mith-nas-say' From H5375; (used as abstraction) supreme exaltation: - exalted.

H4985.full: A primitive root; to suck, by implication to relish, or (intransitively) be sweet: - be (made, X take) sweet.

H4986.full: From H4985; figuratively pleasantness (of discourse): - sweetness.

H4988.full: From H4985; a dainty, that is, (generally) food: - feed sweetly.

H4989.full: Feminine of H4987; sweetness; Mithkah, a place in the Desert: - Mithcah.

H4990.full: Of Persian origin; Mithredath, the name of two Persians: - Mithredath.

H4991.full: Feminine of H4976 abbreviated; a present: - gift, reward.

H4992.full: For H4993; gift of Jah; Mattattah, an Israelite: - Mattathah.

H4993.full: From H4991 and H3050; gift of Jah; Mattithjah, the name of four Israelites: - Mattithiah.

H4994.firstSense: I beseech (pray) thee (you), go to, now, oh
H4994.full: A primitive particle of incitement and entreaty, which may usually be rendered I pray, now or then; added mostly to verbs (in the imperative or future), or to interjections, occasionally to an adverb or conjugation: - I beseech (pray) thee (you), go to, now, oh.

H4995.full: Apparently from H5106 in the sense of harshness from refusal; properly tough, that is, uncooked (flesh): - raw.

H4996.full: Of Egyptian origin; no (that is, Thebes), the capital of Upper Egypt: - No. Compare H528.

H4997.full: From an unused root of uncertain signification; a (skin or leather) bag (for fluids): - bottle.

H4998.full: A primitive root; properly to be at home, that is, (by implication) to be pleasant (or suitable), that is, beautiful: - be beautiful, become, be comely.

H4999.full: From H4998; a home; figuratively a pasture: - habitation, house, pasture, pleasant place.

H5000.full: naw-veh' From H4998 or H5116; suitable, or beautiful: - becometh, comely, seemly.

H5001.full: naw-am' A primitive root; properly to whisper, that is, (by implication) to utter as an oracle: - say.

H5002.full: nah-oom' From H5001; an oracle: - (hath) said, saith.

H5003.firstSense: adulterer (-ess), commit (-ing) adultery, woman that breaketh wedlock
H5003.full: naw-af' A primitive root; to commit adultery; figuratively to apostatize: - adulterer (-ess), commit (-ing) adultery, woman that breaketh wedlock.

H5006.firstSense: abhor, (give occasion to) blaspheme, contemn, despise, flourish, X great, provoke
H5006.full: naw-ats' A primitive root; to scorn; or (Ecc_12:5) by interchange for H5132, to bloom: - abhor, (give occasion to) blaspheme, contemn, despise, flourish, X great, provoke.

H5007.full: neh-aw-tsaw', neh-aw-tsaw' From H5006; scorn: - blasphemy.

H5008.full: naw-ak' A primitive root; to groan: - groan.

H5009.full: neh-aw-kaw' From H5008; a groan: - groaning.

H5010.full: naw-ar' A primitive root; to reject: - abhor, make void.

H5011.full: nôb nobe The same as H5108; fruit; Nob, a place in Palestine: - Nob.

H5012.full: A primitive root; to prophesy, that is, speak (or sing) by inspiration (in prediction or simple discourse): - prophesy (-ing) make self a prophet.

H5014.full: A primitive root; to pierce; to be hollow, or (figuratively) foolish: - hollow, vain.

H5015.full: Probably of foreign derivation; Nebo, the name of a Babylonian deity, also of a mountain in Moab, and of a place in Palestine: - Nebo.

H5016.full: neb-oo-aw' From H5012; a prediction (spoken or written): - prophecy.

H5017.full: neb-oo-aw' (Chaldee); corresponding to H5016; inspired teaching: - prophesying.

H5018.full: neb-oo-zar-ad-awn' Of foreign origin; Nebuzaradan, a Babylonian general: - Nebuzaradan.

H5019.full: nebûkadne'tstsar nebûkadre'tstsar nebûkadre'tsôr neb-oo-kad-nets-tsar', neb-oo-kad-rets-tsar', neb-oo-kad-tsore Of foreign derivation; Nebukadnetstsar (or retstsar, or retstsor), king of Babylon: - Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuchadrezzar.

H5021.full: Of foreign derivation; Nebushazban, Nebuchadnezzar's chief eunuch: - Nebushazban.

H5022.full: Feminine plural from the same as H5011; fruits; Naboth, an Israelite: - Naboth.

H5023.full: (Chaldee); of uncertain derivation; a largess: - reward.

H5024.full: nâbach naw-bakh A primitive root; to bark (as a dog): - bark.

H5025.full: From H5024; a bark; Nobach, the name of an Israelite and of a place East of the Jordan: - Nobah.

H5026.full: Of foreign origin; Nibchaz, a deity of the Avites: - Nibhaz.
