H5027.firstSense: (cause to) behold, consider, look (down), regard, have respect, see
H5027.full: A primitive root; to scan, that is, look intently at; by implication to regard with pleasure, favor or care: - (cause to) behold, consider, look (down), regard, have respect, see.

H5028.full: From H5027; regard; Nebat, the father of Jeroboam (the first): - Nebat.

H5029.full: neb-ee' (Chaldee); corresponding to H5030; a prophet: - prophet.

H5030.full: From H5012; a prophet or (generally) inspired man: - prophecy, that prophesy, prophet.

H5031.full: neb-ee-yaw' Feminine of H5030; a prophetess or (generally) inspired woman; by implication a poetess; by association a prophet's wife: - prophetess.

H5032.full: Feminine plural from H5107; fruitfulnesses; Nebajoth, a son of Ishmael, and the country settled by him: - Nebaioth, Nebajoth.

H5033.full: From an unused root meaning to burst forth; a fountain: - spring.

H5034.firstSense: disgrace, dishonour, lightly esteem, fade (away, -ing), fall (down, -ling, off), do foo…
H5034.full: A primitive root; to wilt; generally to fall away, fail, faint; figuratively to be foolish or (morally) wicked; causatively to despise, disgrace: - disgrace, dishonour, lightly esteem, fade (away, -ing), fall (down, -ling, off), do foolishly, come to nought, X surely, make vile, wither.

H5035.full: From H5034; a skin bag for liquids (from collapsing when empty); hence, a vase (as similar in shape when full); also a lyre (as having a body of like form): - bottle, pitcher, psaltery, vessel, viol.

H5036.full: From H5034; stupid; wicked (especially impious): - fool (-ish, -ish man, -ish woman), vile person.

H5037.full: The same as H5036; dolt; Nabal, an Israelite: - Nabal.

H5038.firstSense: (dead) body, (dead) carcase, dead of itself, which died, (beast) that (which) dieth of…
H5038.full: From H5034; a flabby thing, that is, a carcase or carrion (human or bestial, often collective); figuratively an idol: - (dead) body, (dead) carcase, dead of itself, which died, (beast) that (which) dieth of itself.

H5039.full: Feminine of H5036; foolishness, that is, (morally) wickedness; concretely a crime; by extension punishment: - folly, vile, villany.

H5040.full: From H5036; properly disgrace, that is, the (female) pudenda: - lewdness.

H5041.full: Apparently from H5036 and H3909; foolish secrecy; Neballat, a place in Palestine: - Neballat.

H5042.firstSense: belch out, flowing, pour out, send forth, utter (abundantly)
H5042.full: A primitive root; to gush forth; figuratively to utter (good or bad words); specifically to emit (a foul odor): - belch out, flowing, pour out, send forth, utter (abundantly).

H5043.full: neb-reh-shaw' (Chaldee); from an unused root meaning to shine; a light; plural (collectively) a chandelier: - candlestick.

H5044.full: Of uncertain derivation; Nibshan, a place in Palestine: - Nibshan.

H5045.full: From an unused root meaning to be parched; the south (from its drought); specifically the negeb or southern district of Judah, occasionally, Egypt (as south to Palestine): - south (country, side, -ward).

H5046.firstSense: bewray, X certainly, certify, declare (-ing), denounce, expound, X fully, messenger, pl…
H5046.full: A primitive root; properly to front, that is, stand boldly out opposite; by implication (causatively), to manifest; figuratively to announce (always by word of mouth to one present); specifically to expose, predict, explain, praise: - bewray, X certainly, certify, declare (-ing), denounce, expound, X fully, messenger, plainly, profess, rehearse, report, shew (forth), speak, X surely, tell, utter.

H5047.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5046; to flow (through the idea of clearing the way): - issue.

H5048.firstSense: about, (over) against, X aloof, X far (off), X from, over, presence, X other side, sigh…
H5048.full: From H5046; a front, that is, part opposite; specifically a counterpart, or mate; usually (adverbially, especially with preposition) over against or before: - about, (over) against, X aloof, X far (off), X from, over, presence, X other side, sight, X to view.

H5050.full: A primitive root; to glitter; causatively to illuminate: - (en-) lighten, (cause to) shine.

H5051.full: From H5050; brilliancy (literally or figuratively): - bright (-ness), light, (clear) shining.

H5052.full: The same as H5051; Nogah, a son of David: - Nogah.

H5055.full: A primitive root; to but with the horns; figuratively to war against: - gore, push (down, -ing).

H5056.full: From H5055; butting, that is, vicious: - used (wont) to push.

H5057.firstSense: captain, chief, excellent thing, (chief) governor, leader, noble, prince, (chief) ruler
H5057.full: From H5046; a commander (as occupying the front), civil, military or religious; generally (abstract plural), honorable themes: - captain, chief, excellent thing, (chief) governor, leader, noble, prince, (chief) ruler.

H5058.full: From H5059; properly instrumental music; by implication a stringed instrument; by extension a poem set to music; specifically an epigram: - stringed instrument, musick, Neginoth [plural], song.

H5059.firstSense: player on instruments, sing to the stringed instruments, melody, ministrel, play (-er
H5059.full: A primitive root; prop to thrum, that is, beat a tune with the fingers; especially to play on a stringed instrument; hence (generally) to make music: - player on instruments, sing to the stringed instruments, melody, ministrel, play (-er. -ing).

H5060.firstSense: beat, (X be able to) bring (down), cast, come (nigh), draw near (nigh), get up, happen,…
H5060.full: A primitive root; properly to touch, that is, lay the hand upon (for any purpose; euphemistically, to lie with a woman); by implication to reach (figuratively to arrive, acquire); violently, to strike (punish, defeat, destroy, etc.): - beat, (X be able to) bring (down), cast, come (nigh), draw near (nigh), get up, happen, join, near, plague, reach (up), smite, strike, touch.

H5061.firstSense: plague, sore, stricken, stripe, stroke, wound
H5061.full: From H5060; a blow (figuratively infliction); also (by implication) a spot (concretely a leprous person or dress): - plague, sore, stricken, stripe, stroke, wound.

H5062.firstSense: beat, dash, hurt, plague, slay, smite (down), strike, stumble, X surely, put to the worse
H5062.full: A primitive root; to push, gore, defeat, stub (the toe), inflict (a disease): - beat, dash, hurt, plague, slay, smite (down), strike, stumble, X surely, put to the worse.

H5063.full: From H5062; a trip (of the foot); figuratively an infliction (of disease): - plague, stumbling.

H5064.firstSense: fall, flow away, pour down (out), run, shed, split, trickle down
H5064.full: A primitive root; to flow; figuratively to stretch out; causatively to pour out or down; figuratively to deliver over: - fall, flow away, pour down (out), run, shed, split, trickle down.

H5065.firstSense: distress, driver, exact (-or), oppress (-or), X raiser of taxes, taskmaster
H5065.full: A primitive root; to drive (an animal, a workman, a debtor, an army); by implication to tax, harass, tyrannize: - distress, driver, exact (-or), oppress (-or), X raiser of taxes, taskmaster.

H5066.firstSense: (make to) approach (nigh), bring (forth, hither, near), (cause to) come (higher, near,…
H5066.full: A primitive root; to be or come (causatively bring) near (for any purpose); euphemistically to lie with a woman; as an enemy, to attack; religiously to worship; causatively to present; figuratively to adduce an argument; by reversal, to stand back: - (make to) approach (nigh), bring (forth, hither, near), (cause to) come (higher, near, nigh), give place, go hard (up), (be, draw, go) near (nigh), offer, overtake, present, put, stand.

H5067.full: nêd nade From H5110 in the sense of piling up; a mound, that is, wave: - heap.

H5068.firstSense: offer freely, be (give, make, offer self) willing (-ly)
H5068.full: A primitive root; to impel; hence to volunteer (as a soldier), to present spontaneously: - offer freely, be (give, make, offer self) willing (-ly).

H5069.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5068; be (or give) liberal (liberally): - (be minded of . . . own) freewill (offering), offer freely (willingly).

H5070.full: From H5068; liberal; Nadab, the name of four Israelites: - Nadab.

H5071.firstSense: free (-will) offering, freely, plentiful, voluntary (-ily, offering), willing (-ly, off…
H5071.full: From H5068; properly (abstractly) spontaneity, or (adjectively) spontaneous; also (concretely) a spontaneous or (by inference, in plural) abundant gift: - free (-will) offering, freely, plentiful, voluntary (-ily, offering), willing (-ly, offering).

H5072.full: From H5068 and H3050; largess of Jah; Nedabjah, an Israelite: - Nedabiah.

H5073.full: (Chaldee); from a rot meaning to stick; a layer (of building materials): - row.

H5074.firstSense: chase (away), X could not, depart, flee (X apace, away), (re-) move, thrust away, wande…
H5074.full: A primitive root; properly to wave to and fro (rarely to flap up and down); figuratively to rove, flee, or (causatively) to drive away: - chase (away), X could not, depart, flee (X apace, away), (re-) move, thrust away, wander (abroad, -er, -ing).

H5075.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5074; to depart: - go from.

H5076.full: Passive participle of H5074; properly tossed; abstractly a rolling (on the bed): - tossing to and fro.

H5077.firstSense: cast out, drive, put far away
H5077.full: A primitive root; properly to toss; figuratively to exclude, that is, banish, postpone, prohibit: - cast out, drive, put far away.

H5078.full: From H5077 in the sense of freely flinging money; a bounty (for prostitution): - gifts.

H5079.firstSense: X far, filthiness, X flowers, menstruous (woman), put apart, X removed (woman), separat…
H5079.full: From H5074; properly rejection; by implication impurity, especially personal (menstruation) or moral (idolatry, incest): - X far, filthiness, X flowers, menstruous (woman), put apart, X removed (woman), separation, set apart, unclean (-ness, thing, with filthiness).

H5080.firstSense: banish, bring, cast down (out), chase, compel, draw away, drive (away, out, quite), fet…
H5080.full: A primitive root; to push off; used in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (to expel, mislead, strike, inflict, etc.): - banish, bring, cast down (out), chase, compel, draw away, drive (away, out, quite), fetch a stroke, force, go away, outcast, thrust away (out), withdraw.

H5081.full: From H5068; properly voluntary, that is, generous; hence, magnanimous; as noun, a grandee (sometimes a tyrant): - free, liberal (things), noble, prince, willing ([hearted]).

H5082.full: Feminine of H5081; properly nobility, that is, reputation: - soul.

H5083.full: Probably from an unused root meaning to give; a present (for prostitution): - gift.

H5084.full: Of uncertain derivation; a sheath (of a sword): - sheath.

H5085.full: (Chaldee); from the same as H5084; a sheath; figuratively the body (as the receptacle of the soul): - body.

H5086.firstSense: drive (away, to and fro), thrust down, shaken, tossed to and fro
H5086.full: A primitive root; to shove asunder, that is, disperse: - drive (away, to and fro), thrust down, shaken, tossed to and fro.

H5087.full: A primitive root; to promise (positively, to do or give something to God): - (make a) vow.

H5088.full: From H5087; a promise (to God); also (concretely) a thing promised: - vow ([-ed]).

H5089.full: From an unused root meaning to lament; lamentation: - wailing.

H5090.firstSense: acquaint, bring (away), carry away, drive (away), lead (away, forth), (be) guide, lead…
H5090.full: A primitive root; to drive forth (a person, an animal or chariot), that is, lead, carry away; reflexively to proceed (that is, impel or guide oneself); also (from the panting induced by effort), to sigh: - acquaint, bring (away), carry away, drive (away), lead (away, forth), (be) guide, lead (away, forth).

H5091.full: A primitive root; to groan, that is, bewail; hence (through the idea of crying aloud) to assemble (as if on proclamation): - lament, wail.

H5092.full: From H5091; an elegy: - lamentation, wailing.

H5094.full: (Chaldee); from the same as H5105; illumination, that is, (figuratively) wisdom: - light.

H5095.full: A primitive root; properly to run with a sparkle, that is, flow; hence (transitively) to conduct, and (by inference) to protect, sustain: - carry, feed, guide, lead (gently, on).

H5096.full: The same as H5097; Nahalal or Nahalol, a place in Palestine: - Nahalal, Nahallal, Nahalol.

H5098.full: A primitive root; to growl: - mourn, roar (-ing).

H5100.full: Feminine of H5099; snarling: - disquietness, roaring.

H5101.full: A primitive root; to bray (as an ass), scream (from hunger): - bray.

H5102.full: A primitive root; to sparkle, that is, (figuratively) be cheerful; hence (from the sheen of a running stream) to flow, that is, (figuratively) assemble: - flow (together), be lightened.

H5103.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H5102; a river, especially the Euphrates: - river, stream.

H5104.full: From H5102; a stream (including the sea; especially the Nile, Euphrates, etc.); figuratively, prosperity: - flood, river.

H5105.full: From H5102 in its original sense; daylight: - light.

H5106.firstSense: break, disallow, discourage, make of none effect
H5106.full: A primitive root; to refuse, forbid, dissuade, or neutralize: - break, disallow, discourage, make of none effect.

H5107.full: nûb noob A primitive root; to germinate, that is, (figuratively) to (causatively make) flourish; also (of words), to utter: - bring forth (fruit), make cheerful, increase.

H5108.full: ðéá ðåáo nôb nêyb nobe, nabe From H5107; produce, literally or figuratively: - fruit.

H5109.full: From H5108; fruitful; Nobai, an Israelite: - Nebai [from the margin].

H5110.firstSense: bemoan, flee, get, mourn, make to move, take pity, remove, shake, skip for joy, be sorr…
H5110.full: nûd nood A primitive root; to nod, that is, waver; figuratively to wander, flee, disappear; also (from shaking the head in sympathy), to console, deplore, or (from tossing the head in scorn) taunt: - bemoan, flee, get, mourn, make to move, take pity, remove, shake, skip for joy, be sorry, vagabond, way, wandering.

H5111.full: nûd nood (Chaldee); corresponding to H5116; to flee: - get away.

H5112.full: nôd nôd node, node From H5110; exile: - wandering.

H5113.full: nôd node The same as H5112; vagrancy; Nod, the land of Cain: - Nod.

H5114.full: From H5068; noble; Nodab, an Arab tribe: - Nodab.

H5115.firstSense: keep at home, prepare an habitation
H5115.full: A primitive root; to rest (as at home); causatively (through the implied idea of beauty (compare H5116)), to celebrate (with praises): - keep at home, prepare an habitation.

H5116.firstSense: comely, dwelling (place), fold, habitation, pleasant place, sheepcote, stable, tarried
H5116.full: From H5115; (adjective) at home; hence (by implication of satisfaction) lovely; also (noun) a home, of God (temple), men (residence), flocks (pasture), or wild animals (den): - comely, dwelling (place), fold, habitation, pleasant place, sheepcote, stable, tarried.

H5117.firstSense: cease, be confederate, lay, let down, (be) quiet, remain, (cause to, be at, give, have,…
H5117.full: A primitive root; to rest, that is, settle down; used in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively, intransitively, transitively and causatively (to dwell, stay, let fall, place, let alone, withdraw, give comfort, etc.): - cease, be confederate, lay, let down, (be) quiet, remain, (cause to, be at, give, have, make to) rest, set down. Compare H3241.

H5119.full: Feminine of H5118; quietude; Nochah, an Israelite: - Nohah.

H5121.full: From H5115; residence; Navith, a place in Palestine: - Naioth [from the margin].

H5122.full: (Chaldee); from an unused root probably meaning to be foul; a sink: - dunghill.

H5123.full: nûm noom A primitive root; to slumber (from drowsiness): - sleep, slumber.

H5125.full: nûn noon A primitive root; to resprout, that is, propagate by shoots; figuratively, to be perpetual: - be continued.

H5126.full: nûn nôn noon, nohn From H5125; perpetuity; Nun or Non, the father of Joshua: - Non, Nun.

H5127.firstSense: X abate, away, be displayed, (make to) flee (away, -ing), put to flight, X hide, lift u…
H5127.full: nûs noos A primitive root; to flit, that is, vanish away (subside, escape; causatively chase, impel, deliver): - X abate, away, be displayed, (make to) flee (away, -ing), put to flight, X hide, lift up a standard.

H5128.firstSense: continually, fugitive, X make to [go] up and down, be gone away, (be) move (-able, -d),…
H5128.full: A primitive root; to waver, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (as subjoined): - continually, fugitive, X make to [go] up and down, be gone away, (be) move (-able, -d), be promoted, reel, remove, scatter, set, shake, sift, stagger, to and fro, be vagabond, wag, (make) wander (up and down).

H5129.full: From H3259 and H3050; convened of Jah; Noadjah, the name of an Israelite, and a false prophetess: - Noadiah.

H5130.firstSense: lift up, move, offer, perfume, send, shake, sift, strike, wave
H5130.full: nûph noof A primitive root; to quiver (that is, vibrate up and down, or rock to and fro); used in a great variety of applications (including sprinkling, beckoning, rubbing, bastinadoing, sawing, waving, etc.): - lift up, move, offer, perfume, send, shake, sift, strike, wave.

H5131.full: nôph nofe From H5130; elevation: - situation. Compare H5297.

H5132.full: nûts noots A primitive root; properly to flash; hence, to blossom (from the brilliancy of color); also, to fly away (from the quickness of motion): - flee away, bud (forth).

H5133.full: Feminine active participle of H5327 in the sense of flying; a pinion (or wing feather); often (collectively) plumage: - feather (-s), ostrich.

H5134.full: nûq nook A primitive root; to suckle: - nurse.

H5135.full: nûr noor (Chaldee); from an unused root (corresponding to that of H5216) meaning to shine; fire: - fiery, fire.

H5136.full: nûsh noosh A primitive root; to be sick, that is, (figuratively) distressed: - be full of heaviness.

H5137.full: A primitive root; to spirt, that is, besprinkle (especially in expiation): - sprinkle.

H5138.full: From H2102; something boiled, that is, soup: - pottage.

H5139.firstSense: Nazarite [by a false alliteration with Nazareth], separate (-d), vine undressed
H5139.full: From H5144; separate, that is, consecrated (as prince, a Nazirite); hence (figuratively from the latter) an unpruned vine (like an unshorn Nazirite). (The translation, Nazarite, is by a false alliteration with Nazareth.): - Nazarite [by a false alliteration with Nazareth], separate (-d), vine undressed.

H5140.firstSense: distil, drop, flood, (cause to) flow (-ing), gush out, melt, pour (down), running water…
H5140.full: A primitive root; to drip, or shed by trickling: - distil, drop, flood, (cause to) flow (-ing), gush out, melt, pour (down), running water, stream.

H5141.full: From an unused root of uncertain meaning; a nose ring: - earring, jewel.

H5142.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to the root of H5143; to suffer (causatively inflict) loss: - have (en-) damage, hurt (-ful).

H5143.full: From an unused root meaning to injure; loss: - damage.

H5144.full: A primitive root; to hold aloof, that is, (intransitively) abstain (from food and drink, from impurity, and even from divine worship (that is, apostatize)); specifically to set apart (to sacred purposes), that is, devote: - consecrate, separate (-ing, self).

H5145.full: From H5144; properly something set apart, that is, (abstractly) dedication (of a priest or Nazirite); hence (concretely) unshorn locks; also (by implication) a chaplet (especially of royalty): - consecration, crown, hair, separation.

H5146.full: The same as H5118; rest; Noach, the patriarch of the flood: - Noah.

H5147.full: From H2247; occult; Nachbi, an Israelite: - Nakbi.

H5148.firstSense: bestow, bring, govern, guide, lead (forth), put, straiten
H5148.full: A primitive root; to guide; by implication to transport (into exile, or as colonists): - bestow, bring, govern, guide, lead (forth), put, straiten.

H5149.full: From H5162; comforted; Nechum, an Israelite: - Nehum.

H5150.full: From H5162; properly consoled; abstractly solace: - comfort (-able), repenting.

H5151.full: From H5162; comfortable; Nachum, an Israelitish prophet: - Nahum.

H5152.full: From the same as H5170; snorer; Nachor, the name of the grandfather and a brother of Abraham: - Nahor.

H5153.full: Apparently passive participle of H5172 (perhaps in the sense of ringing, that is, bell metal; or from the red color of the throat of a serpent (H5175, as denominative) when hissing); coppery, that is, (figuratively) hard: - of brass.

H5154.full: Feminine of H5153; copper: - brass, steel. Compare H5176.

H5155.full: Probably denominative from H2485; a flute: - [plural] Nehiloth.

H5156.full: From the same as H5170; a nostril: - [dual] nostrils.

H5157.firstSense: divide, have ([inheritance]), take as an heritage, (cause to, give to, make to) inherit…
H5157.full: A primitive root; to inherit (as a (figurative) mode of descent), or (generally) to occupy; causatively to bequeath, or (generally) distribute, instate: - divide, have ([inheritance]), take as an heritage, (cause to, give to, make to) inherit, (distribute for, divide [for, for an, by], give for, have, leave for, take [for]) inheritance, (have in, cause to be made to) possess (-ion).

H5158.full: From H5157 in its original sense; a stream, especially a winter torrent; (by implication) a (narrow) valley (in which a brook runs); also a shaft (of a mine): - brook, flood, river, stream, valley.

H5159.full: From H5157 (in its usual sense); properly something inherited, that is, (abstractly) occupancy, or (concretely) an heirloom; generally an estate, patrimony or portion: - heritage, to inherit, inheritance, possession. Compare H5158.

H5160.full: nakh-al-ee-ale' From H5158 and H410; valley of God; Nachaliel, a place in the Desert: - Nahaliel.

H5161.full: Apparently a patronymic from an unused name (apparently passive participle of H2492); dreamed; a Nechelamite, or descendant of Nechlam: - Nehelamite.

H5162.full: A primitive root; properly to sigh, that is, breathe strongly; by implication to be sorry, that is, (in a favorable sense) to pity, console or (reflexively) rue; or (unfavorably) to avenge (oneself): - comfort (self), ease [one's self], repent (-er, -ing, self).

H5163.full: From H5162; consolation; Nacham, an Israelite: - Naham.

H5164.full: From H5162; ruefulness, that is, desistance: - repentance.

H5166.full: From H5162 and H3050; consolation of Jah; Nechemjah, the name of three Israelites: - Nehemiah.

H5167.full: From H5162; consolatory; Nachamani, an Israelite: - Nahamani.

H5169.full: A primitive root; to be urgent: - require haste.

H5170.full: From an unused root meaning to snort or snore; a snorting: - nostrils, snorting.

H5171.full: From the same as H5170; snorer; Nacharai or Nachrai, an Israelite: - Naharai, Nahari.

H5172.firstSense: X certainly, divine, enchanter, (use) X enchantment, learn by experience, X indeed, dil…
H5172.full: A primitive root; properly to hiss, that is, whisper a (magic) spell; generally to prognosticate: - X certainly, divine, enchanter, (use) X enchantment, learn by experience, X indeed, diligently observe.

H5173.full: From H5172; an incantation or augury: - enchantment.

H5175.full: From H5172; a snake (from its hiss): - serpent.

H5176.full: The same as H5175; Nachash, the name of two persons apparently non Israelites: - Nahash.

H5177.full: From H5172; enchanter; Nachshon, an Israelite: - Naashon, Nahshon.

H5178.firstSense: brasen, brass, chain, copper, fetter (of brass), filthiness, steel
H5178.full: For H5154; copper; hence, something made of that metal, that is, coin, a fetter; figuratively base (as compared with gold or silver): - brasen, brass, chain, copper, fetter (of brass), filthiness, steel.

H5179.full: nekh-oosh-taw' From H5178; copper; Nechushta, an Israelitess: - Nehushta.

H5180.full: From H5178; something made of copper, that is, the copper serpent of the Desert: - Nehushtan.

H5181.firstSense: be broken, (cause to) come down, enter, go down, press sore, settle, stick fast
H5181.full: A primitive root; to sink, that is, descend; causatively, to press or lead down: - be broken, (cause to) come down, enter, go down, press sore, settle, stick fast.

H5182.firstSense: carry, come down, depose, lay up, place
H5182.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5181; to descend; causatively, to bring away, deposit, depose: - carry, come down, depose, lay up, place.

H5183.firstSense: lighting down, quiet (-ness), to rest, be set on
H5183.full: From H5182; a descent, that is, imposition, unfavorable (punishment) or favorable (food); also (intransitively; perhaps from H5117), restfulness: - lighting down, quiet (-ness), to rest, be set on.

H5184.full: The same as H5183; quiet; Nachath, the name of an Edomite and of two Israelites: - Nahath.

H5186.firstSense: + afternoon, apply, bow (down, -ing), carry aside, decline, deliver, extend, go down, b…
H5186.full: A primitive root; to stretch or spread out; by implication to bend away (including moral deflection); used in a great variety of applications: - + afternoon, apply, bow (down, -ing), carry aside, decline, deliver, extend, go down, be gone, incline, intend, lay, let down, offer, outstretched, overthrown, pervert, pitch, prolong, put away, shew, spread (out), stretch (forth, out), take (aside), turn (aside, away), wrest, cause to yield.

H5188.full: From H5197; a pendant for the ears (especially of pearls): - chain, collar.

H5189.full: From H5203; a tendril (as an offshoot): - battlement, branch, plant.

H5190.full: A primitive root; to lift; by implication to impose: - bear, offer, take up.

H5191.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5190; to raise: - take up.

H5193.full: A primitive root; properly to strike in, that is, fix; specifically to plant (literally or figuratively): - fastened, plant (-er).

H5194.full: From H5193; a plant; collectively, a plantation; abstractly, a planting: - plant.

H5196.full: Plural of H5194; Netaim, a place in Palestine: - plants.

H5197.full: A primitive root; to ooze, that is, distil gradually; by implication to fall in drops; figuratively to speak by inspiration: - drop (-ping), prophesy (-et).

H5198.full: From H5197; a drop; specifically, an aromatic gum (probably stacte): - drop, stacte.

H5199.full: From H5197; distillation; Netophah, a place in Palestine: - Netophah.

H5200.full: Patronymic from H5199; a Netophathite, or inhabitant of Netophah: - Netophathite.

H5201.full: A primitive root; to guard; figuratively, to cherish (anger): - bear grudge, keep (-er), reserve.

H5202.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5201; to retain: - keep.

H5203.firstSense: cast off, drawn, let fall, forsake, join [battle], leave (off), lie still, loose, sprea…
H5203.full: A primitive root; properly to pound, that is, smite; by implication (as if beating out, and thus expanding) to disperse; also, to thrust off, down, out or upon (including reject, let alone, permit, remit, etc.): - cast off, drawn, let fall, forsake, join [battle], leave (off), lie still, loose, spread (self) abroad, stretch out, suffer.

H5204.full: nı̂y nee A doubtful word; apparently from H5091; lamentation: - wailing.

H5205.full: nı̂yd need From H5110; motion (of the lips in speech): - moving.

H5206.full: Feminine of H5205; removal, that is, exile: - removed.

H5207.full: From H5117; properly restful, that is, pleasant; abstractly delight: - sweet (odour).

H5208.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5207; pleasure: - sweet odour (savour).

H5209.full: nı̂yn neen From H5125; progeny: - son.

H5210.full: Of foreign origin; Nineveh, the capital of Assyria: - Nineveh.

H5211.full: ðéño nı̂ys neece From H5127; fugitive: - that fleeth.

H5212.full: Probably of foreign origin; Nisan, the first month of the Jewish sacred year: - Nisan.

H5214.full: nı̂yr neer A root probably identical with that of H5216, through the idea of the gleam of a fresh furrow; to till the soil: - break up.

H5215.full: nı̂yr nir neer, neer From H5214; properly ploughing, that is, (concretely) freshly ploughed land: - fallow ground, ploughing, tillage.

H5216.full: From a primitive root (see H5214 and H5135) properly meaning to glisten; a lamp (that is, the burner) or light (literally or figuratively): - candle, lamp, light.

H5217.full: A primitive root; to smite, that is, drive away: - be viler.

H5218.full: From H5217; smitten, that is, (figuratively) afflicted: - broken, stricken, wounded.

H5219.full: nek-ohth' From H5218; properly a smiting, that is, (concretely) an aromatic gum (perhaps styrax), (as powdered): - spicery (-ces).

H5220.full: From an unused root meaning to propagate; offspring: - nephew, son's son.

H5221.firstSense: beat, cast forth, clap, give [wounds], X go forward, X indeed, kill, make [slaughter],…
H5221.full: A primitive root; to strike (lightly or severely, literally or figuratively): - beat, cast forth, clap, give [wounds], X go forward, X indeed, kill, make [slaughter], murderer, punish, slaughter, slay (-er, -ing), smite (-r, -ing), strike, be stricken, (give) stripes, X surely, wound.

H5222.full: From H5221; a smiter, that is, (figuratively) traducer: - abject.

H5223.full: smitten, that is, (literally) maimed, or (figuratively) dejected: - contrite, lame.

H5224.full: Probably of Egyptian origin; Neko an Egyptian king: - Necho. Compare H6549.

H5225.full: From H3559; prepared; Nakon, probably an Israelite: - Nachon.

H5226.full: From an unused root meaning to be straightforward; properly the fore part; used adverbially, opposite: - before, over against.

H5227.full: From the same as H5226; properly, the front part; used adverbially (especially with a preposition), opposite, in front of, forward, in behalf of: - (over) against, before, direct [-ly], for, right (on).

H5228.full: From the same as H5226; straightforward, that is, (figuratively), equitable, correct, or (abstractly), integrity: - plain, right, uprightness.

H5229.full: Feminine of H5228; properly straight forwardness, that is, (figuratively) integrity, or (concretely) a truth: - equity, right (thing), uprightness.

H5230.full: A primitive root; to defraud, that is, act treacherously: - beguile, conspire, deceiver, deal subtilly.

H5233.full: From an unused root meaning to accumulate; treasure: - riches, wealth.

H5234.firstSense: acknowledge, X could, deliver, discern, dissemble, estrange, feign self to be another,…
H5234.full: A primitive root; properly to scrutinize, that is, look intently at; hence (with recognition implied), to acknowledge, be acquainted with, care for, respect, revere, or (with suspicion implied), to disregard, ignore, be strange toward, reject, resign, dissimulate (as if ignorant or disowning): - acknowledge, X could, deliver, discern, dissemble, estrange, feign self to be another, know, take knowledge (notice), perceive, regard, (have) respect, behave (make) self strange (-ly).

H5235.full: From H5234; something strange, that is, unexpected calamity: - strange.

H5236.full: From H5234; foreign, or (concretely) a foreigner, or (abstractly) heathendom: - alien, strange (+ -er).

H5237.full: From H5235 (second form); strange, in a variety of degrees and applications (foreign, non-relative, adulterous, different, wonderful): - alien, foreigner, outlandish, strange (-r, woman).

H5238.full: Probably for H5219; spicery, that is, (generally) valuables: - precious things.

H5239.full: Apparently a primitive root; to complete: - make an end.

H5241.full: nem-oo-ale' Apparently for H3223; Nemuel, the name of two Israelites: - Nemuel.

H5242.full: From H5241; a Nemuelite, or descendant of Nemuel: - Nemuelite.

H5243.full: A primitive root; to become clipped or (specifically) circumcised: - (branch to) be cut down (off), circumcise.

H5244.full: Feminine from H5243; an ant (probably from its almost bisected form): - ant.

H5246.full: From an unused root meaning properly to filtrate, that is, be limpid (compare H5247 and H5249); and thus to spot or stain as if by dripping; a leopard (from its stripes): - leopard.

H5247.full: From the same as H5246; clear water; Nimrah, a place East of the Jordan: - Nimrah. See also H1039, H5249.

H5248.full: Probably of foreign origin; Nimrod, a son of Cush: - Nimrod.

H5249.full: Plural of a masculine corresponding to H5247; clear waters; Nimrim, a place East of the Jordan: - Nimrim. Compare H1039.

H5250.full: Probably from H4871; extricated; Nimshi, the (grand-) father of Jehu: - Nimshi.

H5251.full: nês nace From H5264; a flag; also a sail; by implication a flagstaff; generally a signal; figuratively a token: - banner, pole, sail, (en-) sign, standard.

H5252.full: Feminine participle passive of H5437; properly an environment, that is, circumstance or turn of affairs: - cause.

H5253.firstSense: departing away, remove, take (hold), turn away
H5253.full: A primitive root; to retreat: - departing away, remove, take (hold), turn away.

H5254.full: A primitive root; to test; by implication to attempt: - adventure, assay, prove, tempt, try.

H5255.full: A primitive root; to tear away: - destroy, pluck, root.

H5257.full: From H5258; properly something poured out, that is, a libation; also a molten image; by implication a prince (as anointed): - drink offering, duke, prince (-ipal).

H5258.firstSense: cover, melt, offer, (cause to) pour (out), set (up)
H5258.full: A primitive root; to pour out, especially a libation, or to cast (metal); by analogy to anoint a king: - cover, melt, offer, (cause to) pour (out), set (up).

H5259.full: A primitive root (probably identical with H5258 through the idea of fusion); to interweave, that is, (figuratively) to overspread: - that is spread.

H5260.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5258; to pour out a libation: - offer.

H5261.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5262; a libation: - drink offering.

H5262.full: From H5258; a libation; also a cast idol: - cover, drink offering, molten image.

H5263.full: A primitive root; to wane, that is, be sick.

H5264.firstSense: lift up as an ensign, standard bearer
H5264.full: A primitive root; to gleam from afar, that is, to be conspicuous as a signal; or rather perhaps a denominative from H5251 (and identical with H5263, through the idea of a flag as fluttering in the wind); to raise a beacon: - lift up as an ensign, standard bearer.

H5265.firstSense: cause to blow, bring, get, (make to) go (away, forth, forward, onward, out), (take) jou…
H5265.full: A primitive root; properly to pull up, especially the tent pins, that is, start on a journey: - cause to blow, bring, get, (make to) go (away, forth, forward, onward, out), (take) journey, march, remove, set aside (forward), X still, be on his (go their) way.

H5266.full: A primitive root; to go up: - ascend.

H5268.full: Of foreign origin; Nisrok, a Babylonian idol: - Nisroch.

H5269.full: From H5128; motion; Neah, a place in Palestine: - Neah.

H5270.full: From H5128; movement; Noah, an Israelitess: - Noah.

H5271.full: Properly passive participle from H5288 as denominative; (only in plural collectively or emphatically) youth, the state (juvenility) or the persons (young people): - childhood, youth.

H5272.full: From H5128 and H410; moved of God; Neiel, a place in Palestine: - Neiel.

H5273.full: From H5276; delightful (objectively or subjectively, literally or figuratively): - pleasant (-ure), sweet.

H5274.firstSense: bolt, inclose, lock, shod, shut up
H5274.full: A primitive root; properly to fasten up, that is, with a bar or cord; hence (denominatively from H5275), to sandal, that is, furnish with slippers: - bolt, inclose, lock, shod, shut up.

H5275.full: From H5274; properly a sandal tongue; by extension a sandal or slipper (sometimes as a symbol of occupancy, a refusal to marry, or of something valueless): - dryshod, (pair of) shoe ([-latchet], -s).

H5276.firstSense: pass in beauty, be delight, be pleasant, be sweet
H5276.full: A primitive root; to be agreeable (literally or figuratively): - pass in beauty, be delight, be pleasant, be sweet.

H5277.full: From H5276; pleasure; Naam, an Israelite: - Naam.

H5278.full: From H5276; agreeableness, that is, delight, suitableness, splendor or grace: - beauty, pleasant (-ness).

H5279.full: Feminine of H5277; pleasantness; Naamah, the name of an antediluvian woman, of an Ammonitess, and of a place in Palestine: - Naamah.

H5280.full: Patronymic from H5283; a Naamanite, or descendant of Naaman (collectively): - Naamites.

H5281.full: From H5278; pleasant; Noomi, an Israelitess: - Naomi.

H5282.full: From H5276; pleasantness (plural as concrete): - pleasant.

H5283.full: The same as H5282; Naaman, the name of an Israelite and of a Damascene: - Naaman.

H5284.full: Patrial from a place corresponding in nmae (but not identical) with H5279; a Naamathite, or inhabitant of Naamah: - Naamathite

H5285.full: From an unused root meaning to prick; probably a brier; by implication a thicket of thorny bushes: - thorn.

H5286.full: A primitive root; to growl: - yell.

H5287.firstSense: shake (off, out, self), overthrow, toss up and down
H5287.full: A primitive root (probably identical with H5286, through the idea of the rustling of mane, which usually accompanies the lion's roar); to tumble about: - shake (off, out, self), overthrow, toss up and down.

H5288.firstSense: babe, boy, child, damsel [from the margin], lad, servant, young (man)
H5288.full: From H5287; (concretely) a boy (as active), from the age of infancy to adolescence; by implication a servant; also (by interchange of sex), a girl (of similar latitude in age): - babe, boy, child, damsel [from the margin], lad, servant, young (man).

H5289.full: From H5287 in its derived sense of tossing about; a wanderer: - young one.

H5290.full: From H5287; (abstractly) boyhood (compare H5288): - child, youth.

H5291.full: Feminine of H5288; a girl (from infancy to adolescence): - damsel, maid (-en), young (woman).

H5292.full: The same as H5291; Naarah, the name of an Israelitess, and of a place in Palestine: - Naarah, Naarath.

H5293.full: From H5288; youthful; Naarai, an Israelite: - Naarai.

H5294.full: From H5288 and H3050; servant of Jah; Nearjah, the name of two Israelites: - Neariah.

H5295.full: From H5288; juvenile; Naaran, a place in Palestine: - Naaran.

H5296.full: From H5287; something shaken out, that is, tow (as the refuse of flax): - tow.

H5297.full: nôph nofe A variation of H4644; Noph, the capital of Upper Egypt: - Noph.

H5298.full: From an unused root probably meaning to spring forth; a sprout; Nepheg, the name of two Israelites: - Nepheg.

H5299.full: From H5130 in the sense of lifting; a height; also a sieve: - border, coast, region, sieve.

H5300.full: For H5304; Nephushesim, a Temple Servant: - Nephisesim [from the margin].

H5301.firstSense: blow, breath, give up, cause to lose [life], seething, snuff
H5301.full: A primitive root; to puff, in various applications (literally, to inflate, blow hard, scatter, kindle, expire; figuratively, to disesteem): - blow, breath, give up, cause to lose [life], seething, snuff.

H5302.full: From H5301; a gust; Nophach, a place in Moab: - Nophah.

H5303.full: From H5307; properly, a feller, that is, a bully or tyrant: - giant.

H5304.full: Plural from an unused root meaning to scatter; expansions; Nephisim, a Temple Servant: - Nephusim [from the margin].

H5305.full: From H5314; refreshed; Naphish, a son of Ishmael, and his posterity: - Naphish.

H5306.full: From an unused root meaning to glisten; shining; a gem, probably the garnet: - emerald.

H5307.firstSense: be accepted, cast (down, self, [lots], out), cease, die, divide (by lot), (let) fail, (…
H5307.full: A primitive root; to fall, in a great variety of applications (intransitively or causatively, literally or figuratively): - be accepted, cast (down, self, [lots], out), cease, die, divide (by lot), (let) fail, (cause to, let, make, ready to) fall (away, down, -en, -ing), fell (-ing), fugitive, have [inheritamce], inferior, be judged [by mistake for H6419], lay (along), (cause to) lie down, light (down), be (X hast) lost, lying, overthrow, overwhelm, perish, present (-ed, -ing), (make to) rot, slay, smite out, X surely, throw down.

H5308.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5307: - fall (down), have occasion.

H5309.full: From H5307; something fallen, that is, an abortion: - untimely birth.

H5310.firstSense: be beaten in sunder, break (in pieces), broken, dash (in pieces), cause to be discharge…
H5310.full: A primitive root; to dash to pieces, or scatter: - be beaten in sunder, break (in pieces), broken, dash (in pieces), cause to be discharged, dispersed, be overspread, scatter.

H5311.full: From H5310; a storm (as dispersing): - scattering.

H5312.full: (Chaldee); a primitive root; to issue; causatively, to bring out: - come (go, take) forth (out).

H5313.full: nif-kaw' (Chaldee); from H5312; an outgo, that is, expense: - expense.

H5314.full: A primitive root; to breathe; passively, to be breathed upon, that is, (figuratively) refreshed (as if by a current of air): - (be) refresh selves (-ed).

H5315.firstSense: any, appetite, beast, body, breath, creature, X dead (-ly), desire, X [dis-] contented,…
H5315.full: From H5314; properly a breathing creature, that is, animal or (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental): - any, appetite, beast, body, breath, creature, X dead (-ly), desire, X [dis-] contented, X fish, ghost, + greedy, he, heart (-y), (hath, X jeopardy of) life (X in jeopardy), lust, man, me, mind, mortality, one, own, person, pleasure, (her-, him-, my-, thy-) self, them (your) -selves, + slay, soul, + tablet, they, thing, (X she) will, X would have it.

H5317.full: From H5130 in the sense of shaking to pieces; a dripping that is, of honey (from the comb): - honeycomb.

H5318.full: From H6605; opened, that is, a spring; Nephtoach, a place in Palestine: - Neptoah.

H5319.full: From H6617; properly wrestled; but used (in the plural) transitively, a struggle: - wrestling.

H5320.full: Plural of foreign origin; Naphtuchim, an Egyptian tribe: - Naptuhim.

H5321.full: From H6617; my wrestling; Naphtali, a son of Jacob, with the tribe descended from him, and its territory: - Naphtali.

H5322.full: nêts nayts From H5340; a flower (from its brilliancy); also a hawk (from its flashing speed): - blossom, hawk.

H5323.full: A primitive root; to go away: - flee.

H5324.firstSense: appointed, deputy, erect, establish, X Huzzah [by mistake for a proper name], lay, offi…
H5324.full: A primitive root; to station, in various applications (literally or figuratively): - appointed, deputy, erect, establish, X Huzzah [by mistake for a proper name], lay, officer, pillar, present, rear up, set (over, up), settle, sharpen, stablish, (make to) stand (-ing, still, up, upright), best state.

H5325.full: Passive participle of H5324; fixed, that is, a handle: - haft.

H5326.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H5324; fixedness, that is, firmness: - strength.

H5327.full: A primitive root; properly to go forth, that is, (by implication) to be expelled, and (consequently) desolate; causatively to lay waste; also (specifically), to quarrel: - be laid waste, ruinous, strive (together).

H5328.full: Feminine of H5322; a blossom: - flower.

H5329.firstSense: excel, chief musician (singer), oversee (-r), set forward
H5329.full: A primitive root; properly to glitter from afar, that is, to be eminent (as a superintendent, especially of the Temple services and its music); also (as denominative from H5331), to be permanent: - excel, chief musician (singer), oversee (-r), set forward.

H5330.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5329; to become chief: - be preferred.

H5331.firstSense: alway (-s), constantly, end, (+ n-) ever (more), perpetual, strength, victory
H5331.full: From H5329; properly a goal, that is, the bright object at a distance travelled towards; hence (figuratively), splendor, or (subjectively) truthfulness, or (objectively) confidence; but usually (adverbially), continually (that is, to the most distant point of view): - alway (-s), constantly, end, (+ n-) ever (more), perpetual, strength, victory.

H5332.full: Probably identical with H5331, through the idea of brilliancy of color; juice of the grape (as blood red): - blood, strength.

H5333.full: From H5324; something stationary, that is, a prefect, a military post, a statue: - garrison, officer, pillar.

H5334.full: The same as H5333; station; Netsib, a place in Palestine: - Nezib.

H5335.full: From H5329; conspicuous; Netsiach, a Temple Servant: - Neziah.

H5336.full: From H5341; properly conservative; but used passively, delivered: - preserved.

H5337.firstSense: X at all, defend, deliver (self), escape, X without fail, part, pluck, preserve, recove…
H5337.full: A primitive root; to snatch away, whether in a good or a bad sense: - X at all, defend, deliver (self), escape, X without fail, part, pluck, preserve, recover, rescue, rid, save, spoil, strip, X surely, take (out).

H5338.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5337; to extricate: - deliver, rescue.

H5340.full: A primitive root; to glare, that is, be bright colored: - sparkle.

H5341.firstSense: besieged, hidden thing, keep (-er, -ing), monument, observe, preserve (-r), subtil, wat…
H5341.full: A primitive root; to guard, in a good sense (to protect, maintain, obey, etc.) or a bad one (to conceal, etc.): - besieged, hidden thing, keep (-er, -ing), monument, observe, preserve (-r), subtil, watcher (-man).

H5342.full: From H5341 in the sense of greenness as a striking color; a shoot; figuratively, a descendant: - branch.

H5343.full: nek-ay' (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H5352; clean: - pure.

H5344.firstSense: appoint, blaspheme, bore, curse, express, with holes, name, pierce, strike through
H5344.full: A primitive root; to puncture, literally (to perforate, with more or less violence) or figuratively (to specify, designate, libel): - appoint, blaspheme, bore, curse, express, with holes, name, pierce, strike through.

H5346.full: The same as H5345; dell; Nekeb, a place in Palestine: - Nekeb.

H5347.full: From H5344; female (from the sexual form): - female, woman.

H5348.full: From an unused root meaning to mark (by puncturing or branding); spotted: - speckled.

H5349.full: Active participle from the same as H5348; a spotter (of sheep or cattle), that is, the owner or tender (who thus marks them): - herdman, sheepmaster.

H5350.full: From the same as H5348; a crumb (as broken to spots); also a biscuit (as pricked): - cracknel, mouldy.

H5351.full: Feminine of H5348; a boss: - stud.

H5352.firstSense: acquit X at all, X altogether, be blameless, cleanse, (be) clear (-ing), cut off, be de…
H5352.full: A primitive root; to be (or make) clean (literally or figuratively); by implication (in an adverse sense) to be bare, that is, extirpated: - acquit X at all, X altogether, be blameless, cleanse, (be) clear (-ing), cut off, be desolate, be free, be (hold) guiltless, be (hold) innocent, X by no means, be quit, be (leave) unpunished, X utterly, X wholly.

H5353.full: nek-o-daw' Feminine of H5348 (in the figuratively sense of marked); distinction; Nekoda, a Temple Servant: - Nekoda.

H5354.full: A primitive root; to loathe: - weary.

H5355.firstSense: blameless, clean, clear, exempted, free, guiltless, innocent, quit
H5355.full: From H5352; innocent: - blameless, clean, clear, exempted, free, guiltless, innocent, quit.

H5356.full: From H5352; clearness (literally or figuratively): - cleanness, innocency.

H5357.full: From an unused root meaning to bore; a cleft: - hole.

H5358.firstSense: avenge (-r, self), punish, revenge (self), X surely, take vengeance
H5358.full: A primitive root; to grudge, that is, avenge or punish: - avenge (-r, self), punish, revenge (self), X surely, take vengeance.

H5359.full: From H5358; revenge: - + avenged, quarrel, vengeance.

H5360.full: Feminine of H5359; avengement, whether the act or the passion: - + avenge, revenge (-ing), vengeance.

H5361.full: A primitive root; to feel aversion: - be alienated.

H5362.firstSense: compass (about, -ing), cut down, destroy, go round (about), inclose, round
H5362.full: A primitive root; to strike with more or less violence (beat, fell, corrode); by implication (of attack) to knock together, that is, surround or circulate: - compass (about, -ing), cut down, destroy, go round (about), inclose, round.

H5363.full: From H5362; a threshing (of olives): - shaking.

H5364.full: From H5362; probably a rope (as encircling): - rent.

H5365.firstSense: dig, pick out, pierce, put (thrust) out
H5365.full: A primitive root; to bore (penetrate, quarry): - dig, pick out, pierce, put (thrust) out.

H5366.full: From H5365; a fissure: - cleft, clift.

H5367.full: A primitive root; to entrap (with a noose), literally or figuratively: - catch. (lay a) snare.

H5368.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5367; but used in the sense of H5362; to knock: - smote.

H5369.full: nêr nare The same as H5216; lamp; Ner, an Israelite: - Ner.

H5370.full: Of foreign origin; Nergal, a Cuthite deity: - Nergal.

H5371.full: nare-gal' shar-eh'-tser From H5370 and H8272; Nergal-Sharetser, the name of two Babylonians: - Nergal-sharezer.

H5372.full: From an unused root meaning to roll to pieces; a slanderer: - talebearer, whisperer.

H5373.full: nêrd nayrd Of foreign origin; nard, an aromatic: - spikenard.

H5374.full: From H5216 and H3050; light of Jah; Nerijah, an Israelite: - Neriah.

H5375.firstSense: accept, advance, arise, (able to, [armour], suffer to) bear (-er, up), bring (forth), b…
H5375.full: A primitive root; to lift, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively, absolutely and relatively: - accept, advance, arise, (able to, [armour], suffer to) bear (-er, up), bring (forth), burn, carry (away), cast, contain, desire, ease, exact, exalt (self), extol, fetch, forgive, furnish, further, give, go on, help, high, hold up, honourable (+ man), lade, lay, lift (self) up, lofty, marry, magnify, X needs, obtain, pardon, raise (up), receive, regard, respect, set (up), spare, stir up, + swear, take (away, up), X utterly, wear, yield.

H5376.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5375: - carry away, make insurrection, take.

H5377.firstSense: beguile, deceive, X greatly, X utterly
H5377.full: A primitive root; to lead astray, that is, (mentally) to delude, or (morally) to seduce: - beguile, deceive, X greatly, X utterly.

H5378.firstSense: X debt, exact, give of usury
H5378.full: A primitive root (perhaps identical with H5377, through the idea of imposition); to lend on interest; by implication to dun for debt: - X debt, exact, give of usury.

H5379.full: Passive participle feminine of H5375; something taken, that is, a present: - gift.

H5380.full: A primitive root; to blow; by implication to disperse: - (cause to) blow, drive away.

H5381.firstSense: ability, be able, attain (unto), (be able to, can) get, lay at, put, reach, remove, wax…
H5381.full: A primitive root; to reach (literally or figuratively): - ability, be able, attain (unto), (be able to, can) get, lay at, put, reach, remove, wax rich, X surely, (over-) take (hold of, on, upon).

H5382.full: A primitive root; to forget; figuratively, to neglect; causatively, to remit, remove: - forget, deprive, exact.

H5383.firstSense: creditor, exact, extortioner, lend, usurer, lend on (taker of) usury
H5383.full: A primitive root (rather identical with H5382, in the sense of H5378); to lend or (by reciprocity) borrow on security or interest: - creditor, exact, extortioner, lend, usurer, lend on (taker of) usury.

H5384.full: From H5382, in the snese of failure; rheumatic or crippled (from the incident to Jacob): - which shrank.

H5385.full: Feminine passive participle of H5375; something borne, that is, a load: - carriage.

H5387.firstSense: captain, chief, cloud, governor, prince, ruler, vapour
H5387.full: From H5375; properly an exalted one, that is, a king or sheik; also a rising mist: - captain, chief, cloud, governor, prince, ruler, vapour.

H5389.full: (Chaldee); irregular plural feminine of H606: - women.

H5391.full: A primitive root; to strike with a sting (as a serpent); figuratively, to oppress with interest on a loan: - bite, lend upon usury.

H5392.full: From H5391; interest on a debt: - usury.

H5394.firstSense: cast (out), drive, loose, put off (out), slip
H5394.full: A primitive root; to pluck off, that is, divest, eject, or drop: - cast (out), drive, loose, put off (out), slip.

H5395.full: A primitive root; properly to blow away, that is, destroy: - destroy.

H5396.full: nish-maw' (Chaldee); corresponding to H5397; vital breath: - breath.

H5397.full: From H5395; a puff, that is, wind, angry or vital breath, divine inspiration, intellect or (concretely) an animal: - blast, (that) breath (-eth), inspiration, soul, spirit.

H5398.full: A primitive root; to breeze, that is, blow up fresh (as the wind): - blow.

H5399.firstSense: dark, dawning of the day (morning), night, twilight
H5399.full: From H5398; properly a breeze, that is, (by implication) dusk (when the evening breeze prevails): - dark, dawning of the day (morning), night, twilight.

H5400.full: A primitive root; to catch fire: - burn, kindle.

H5401.full: A primitive root (identical with H5400, through the idea of fastening up; compare H2388 and H2836); to kiss, literally or figuratively (touch); also (as a mode of attachment), to equip with weapons: - armed (men), rule, kiss, that touched.

H5402.firstSense: armed men, armour (-y), battle, harness, weapon
H5402.full: From H5401; military equipment, that is, (collectively) arms (offensive or defensive), or (concretely) an arsenal: - armed men, armour (-y), battle, harness, weapon.

H5403.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5404; an eagle: - eagle.

H5404.full: From an unused root meaning to lacerate; the eagle (or other large bird of prey): - eagle.

H5405.full: A primitive root; properly to eliminate, that is, (intransitively) to dry up: - fail.

H5406.full: Probably of Persian origin; an epistle: - letter.

H5408.firstSense: cut (in pieces), divide, hew in pieces
H5408.full: A primitive root; to dismember: - cut (in pieces), divide, hew in pieces.

H5409.full: From H5408; a fragment: - part, piece.

H5410.full: From an unused root meaning to tramp; a (beaten) track: - path ([-way]), X travel [-er], way.

H5411.full: The second form is the proper form, as passive participle; from H5414; one given, that is, (in the plural only) the Nethinim, or Temple Servants (as given up to that duty): - Nethinims.

H5413.full: A primitive root; to flow forth (literally or figuratively); by implication to liquefy: - drop, gather (together), melt, pour (forth, out).

H5414.firstSense: add, apply, appoint, ascribe, assign, X avenge, X be ([healed]), bestow, bring (forth,…
H5414.full: A primitive root; to give, used with great latitude of application (put, make, etc.): - add, apply, appoint, ascribe, assign, X avenge, X be ([healed]), bestow, bring (forth, hither), cast, cause, charge, come, commit consider, count, + cry, deliver (up), direct, distribute do, X doubtless, X without fail, fasten, frame, X get, give (forth, over, up), grant, hang (up), X have, X indeed, lay (unto charge, up), (give) leave, lend, let (out), + lie, lift up, make, + O that, occupy, offer, ordain, pay, perform, place, pour, print, X pull, put (forth), recompense, render, requite, restore, send (out), set (forth), shew, shoot forth (up). + sing, + slander, strike, [sub-] mit, suffer, X surely, X take, thrust, trade, turn, utter, + weep, X willingly, + withdraw, + would (to) God, yield.

H5415.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5414; give: - bestow, give, pay.

H5416.full: From H5414; given; Nathan, the name of five Israelites: - Nathan.

H5417.full: neth-an-ale' From H5414 and H410; given of God; Nethanel, the name of ten Israelites: - Nethaneel.

H5418.full: From H5414 and H3050; given of Jah; Nethanjah, the name of four Israelites: - Nethaniah.

H5419.full: From H5414 and H4428; given of (the) king; Nethan-Melek, an Israelite: - Nathan-melech.

H5420.full: A primitive root; to tear up: - mar.

H5421.full: For H5422; to tear out: - break.

H5422.firstSense: beat down, break down (out), cast down, destroy, overthrow, pull down, throw down
H5422.full: A primitive root; to tear down: - beat down, break down (out), cast down, destroy, overthrow, pull down, throw down.

H5423.firstSense: break (off), burst, draw (away), lift up, pluck (away, off), pull (out), root out
H5423.full: A primitive root; to tear off: - break (off), burst, draw (away), lift up, pluck (away, off), pull (out), root out.

H5425.firstSense: drive asunder, leap, (let) loose, X make, move, undo
H5425.full: A primitive root; to jump, that is, be violently agitated; causatively, to terrify, shake off, untie: - drive asunder, leap, (let) loose, X make, move, undo.

H5427.full: From H5425; mineral potash (so called from effervescing with acid): - nitre.

H5428.firstSense: destroy, forsake, pluck (out, up, by the roots), pull up, root out (up), X utterly
H5428.full: A primitive root; to tear away: - destroy, forsake, pluck (out, up, by the roots), pull up, root out (up), X utterly.

H5429.full: seh-aw' From an unused root meaning to define; a seah, or certain measure (as determinative) for grain: - measure.

H5430.full: seh-own' From H5431; perhaps a military boot (as a protection from mud): - battle.

H5431.full: saw-an' A primitive root; to be miry; used only as denominative from H5430; to shoe, that is, (active participle) a soldier shod: - warrior.

H5432.full: sah-seh-aw' For H5429; measurement, that is, moderation: - measure.

H5433.full: A primitive root; to quaff to satiety, that is, become tipsy: - drunkard, fill self, Sabean, [wine-] bibber.

H5434.full: seb-aw' Of foreign origin; Seba, a son of Cush, and the country settled by him: - Seba.

H5435.full: so'-beh From H5433; potation, concretely (wine), or abstractly (carousal): - drink, drunken, wine.

H5436.full: seb-aw-ee' Patrial from H5434; a Sebaite, or inhabitant of Seba: - Sabean.

H5437.firstSense: bring, cast, fetch, lead, make, walk, X whirl, X round about, be about on every side, a…
H5437.full: A primitive root; to revolve, surround or border; used in various applications, literally and figuratively: - bring, cast, fetch, lead, make, walk, X whirl, X round about, be about on every side, apply, avoid, beset (about), besiege, bring again, carry (about), change, cause to come about, X circuit, (fetch a) compass (about, round), drive, environ, X on every side, beset (close, come, compass, go, stand) round about, remove, return, set, sit down, turn (self) (about, aside, away, back).

H5438.full: From H5437; a (providential) turn (of affairs): - cause.

H5439.firstSense: (place, round) about, circuit, compass, on every side
H5439.full: From H5437; (as noun) a circle, neighbor, or environs; but chiefly (as adverb, with or without preposition) around: - (place, round) about, circuit, compass, on every side.

H5440.full: A primitive root; to entwine: - fold together, wrap.

H5443.full: sab-bek-aw', sab-bek-aw' (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H5440; a lyre: - sackbut.

H5444.full: From H5440; copse like; Sibbecai, an Israelite: - Sibbecai, Sibbechai.

H5445.firstSense: bear, be a burden, carry, strong to labour
H5445.full: A primitive root; to carry (literally or figuratively), or (reflexively) be burdensome; specifically to be gravid: - bear, be a burden, carry, strong to labour.

H5446.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5445; to erect: - strongly laid.

H5447.full: From H5445; a load (literally or figuratively): - burden, charge.

H5449.full: From H5445; a porter: - (to bear, bearer of) burden (s).

H5451.full: For H7641; an ear of grain: - Sibboleth.

H5452.full: (Chaldee); a primitive root; to bear in mind, that is, hope: - think.

H5453.full: Dual from a root corresponding to H5452; double hope; Sibrajim, a place in Syria: - Sibraim.

H5454.full: sab-taw', sab-taw' Probably of foreign derivation; Sabta or Sabtah, the name of a son of Cush, and the country occupied by his posterity: - Sabta, Sabtah.

H5455.full: sab-tek-aw' Probably of foreign derivation; Sabteca, the name of a son of Cush, and the region settled by him: - Sabtecha, Sabtechah.

H5456.full: A primitive root; to prostrate oneself (in homage): - fall down.

H5458.full: From H5462; properly shut up, that is, the breast (as inclosing the heart); also gold (as generally shut up safely): - caul, gold.

H5459.full: Feminine passive participle of an unused root meaning to shut up; wealth (as closely shut up): - jewel, peculiar (treasure), proper good, special.

H5461.full: From an unused root meaning to superintend; a proefect of a province: - prince, ruler.

H5462.firstSense: close up, deliver (up), give over (up), inclose, X pure, repair, shut (in, self, out, u…
H5462.full: A primitive root; to shut up; figuratively to surrender: - close up, deliver (up), give over (up), inclose, X pure, repair, shut (in, self, out, up, up together), stop, X straitly.

H5464.full: Probably from H5462 in the sense of sweeping away; a pouring rain: - very rainy.

H5465.full: sad sad From an unused root meaning to estop; the stocks: - stocks.

H5466.full: From an unused root meaning to envelop; a wrapper, that is, shirt: - fine linen, sheet.

H5467.full: From an unused root meaning to scorch; burnt (that is, volcanic or bituminous) district; Sedom, a place near the Dead Sea: - Sodom.

H5468.full: From an unused root meaning to arrange; order: - order.

H5469.full: From an unused root meaning to be round; roundness: - round.

H5470.full: From the same as H5469; a dungeon (as surrounded by walls): - prison.

H5471.full: Of foreign derivation; so, an Egyptian king: - So.

H5472.firstSense: backslider, drive, go back, turn (away, back)
H5472.full: sûg soog A primitive root; properly to flinch, that is, (by implication) to go back, literally (to retreat) or figuratively (to apostatize): - backslider, drive, go back, turn (away, back).

H5473.full: sûg soog A primitive root (probably rather identical with H5472 through the idea of shrinking from a hedge; compare H7735); to hem in, that is, bind: - set about.

H5474.full: From H5462; an inclosure, that is, cage (for an animal): - ward.

H5475.full: sôd sode From H3245; a session, that is, company of persons (in close deliberation); by implication intimacy, consultation, a secret: - assembly, counsel, inward, secret (counsel).

H5476.full: From H5475; a confidant; Sodi, an Israelite: - Sodi.

H5477.full: From an unused root meaning to wipe away; sweeping; Suach, an Israelite: - Suah.

H5478.full: From the same as H5477; something swept away, that is, filth: - torn.

H5479.full: From H7750; roving; Sotai, one of the Nethinim: - Sotai.

H5480.full: sûk sook A primitive root; properly to smear over (with oil), that is, anoint: - anoint (self), X at all.

H5481.full: (1,2) soom-po-neh-yaw', see-fo-neh-yaw' (Chaldee); Of Greek origin [H4858]; a bagpipe (with a double pipe): - dulcimer.

H5482.full: Of Egyptian derivation; Seven, a place in Upper Egypt: - Syene.

H5483.full: sûs sûs soos, soos From an unused root meaning to skip (properly for joy); a horse (as leaping); also a swallow (from its rapid flight): - crane, horse ([-back, -hoof]). Compare H6571.

H5484.full: Feminine of H5483; a mare: - company of horses.

H5485.full: From H5483; horse like; Susi, an Israelite: - Susi.

H5486.firstSense: consume, have an end, perish, X be utterly
H5486.full: sûph soof A primitive root; to snatch away, that is, terminate: - consume, have an end, perish, X be utterly.

H5487.full: sûph soof (Chaldee); corresponding to H5486; to come to an end: - consumme, fulfil.

H5488.full: sûph soof Probably of Egyptian origin; a reed, especially the papyrus: - flag. Red [sea], weed. Compare H5489.

H5489.full: sûph soof For H5488 (by ellipsis of H3220); the Reed (Sea): - Red sea.

H5490.full: sôph sofe From H5486; a termination: - conclusion, end, hinder part.

H5491.full: sôph sofe (Chaldee); corresponding to H5490: - end.

H5492.firstSense: Red Sea, storm, tempest, whirlwind, Red sea
H5492.full: From H5486; a hurricane: - Red Sea, storm, tempest, whirlwind, Red sea.

H5493.firstSense: be [-head], bring, call back, decline, depart, eschew, get [you], go (aside), X grievou…
H5493.full: A primitive root; to turn off (literally or figuratively): - be [-head], bring, call back, decline, depart, eschew, get [you], go (aside), X grievous, lay away (by), leave undone, be past, pluck away, put (away, down), rebel, remove (to and fro), revolt, X be sour, take (away, off), turn (aside, away, in), withdraw, be without.

H5494.full: sûr soor Probably passive participle of H5493; turned off, that is, deteriorated: - degenerate.

H5495.full: sûr soor The same as H5494; Sur, a gate of the Temple: - Sur.

H5496.firstSense: entice, move, persuade, provoke, remove, set on, stir up, take away
H5496.full: sûth sooth Perhaps denominative from H7898; properly to prick, that is, (figuratively) stimulate; by implication to seduce: - entice, move, persuade, provoke, remove, set on, stir up, take away.

H5497.full: sûth sooth Probably from the same root as H4533; covering, that is, clothing: - clothes.

H5498.full: A primitive root; to trail along: - draw (out), tear.

H5499.full: From H5498; a rag: - cast clout.

H5500.full: A primitive root; to sweep away: - scrape.

H5501.full: From H5500; refuse (as swept off): - offscouring.

H5502.full: A primitive root; to scrape off: - sweep (away).

H5503.firstSense: go about, merchant (-man), occupy with, pant, trade, traffick
H5503.full: A primitive root; to travel round (specifically as a pedlar); intensively to palpitate: - go about, merchant (-man), occupy with, pant, trade, traffick.

H5505.full: From H5503; an emporium; abstractly profit (from trade): - mart, merchandise.

H5507.full: Properly active participle feminine of H5503; something surrounding the person, that is, a shield: - buckler.

H5508.full: Similar to H5507; probably a (black) tile (or tessara) for laying borders with: - black marble.

H5509.full: ñåּâ ñéâo sı̂yg sûg seeg, soog From H5472 in the sense of refuse; scoria: - dross.

H5510.full: Probably of Persian origin; Sivan, the third Hebrew month: - Sivan.

H5511.full: From the same as H5477; tempestuous; Sichon, an Amoritish king: - Sihon.

H5512.full: sı̂yn seen Of uncertain derivation; Sin, the name of an Egyptian town and (probably) desert adjoining: - Sin.

H5513.full: From an otherwise unknown name of a man; a Sinite, or descendant of one of the sons of Canaan: - Sinite.

H5514.full: Of uncertain derivation; Sinai, a mountain of Arabia: - Sinai.

H5515.full: Plural of an otherwise unknown name; Sinim, a distant Oriental region: - Sinim.

H5516.full: see-ser-aw' Of uncertain derivation; Sisera, the name of a Canaanitish king and of one of the Nethinim: - Sisera.

H5517.full: From an unused root meaning to converse; congregation; Sia, or Siaha, one of the Nethinim: - Sia, Siaha.

H5518.full: From a primitive root meaning to boil up; a pot; also a thorn (as springing up rapidly); by implication a hook: - caldron, fishhook, pan, ([wash-]) pot, thorn.

H5519.full: sâk sawk From H5526; properly a thicket of men, that is, a crowd: - multitude.

H5520.full: sôk soke From H5526; a hut (as of entwined boughs); also a lair: - covert, den, pavilion, tabernacle.

H5521.firstSense: booth, cottage, covert, pavilion, tabernacle, tent
H5521.full: Feminine of H5520; a hut or lair: - booth, cottage, covert, pavilion, tabernacle, tent.

H5522.full: Feminine of H5519; an (idolatrous) booth: - tabernacle.

H5523.full: Plural of H5521; booths; Succoth, the name of a place in Egypt and of three in Palestine: - Succoth.

H5524.full: From H5523 and the (irregular) plural of H1323; booths of (the) daughters; brothels, that is, idolatrous tents for impure purposes: - Succoth-benoth.

H5525.full: Patrial from an unknown name (perhaps H5520); a Sukkite, or inhabitant of some place near Egypt (that is, hut dwellers): - Sukkiims.

H5526.firstSense: cover, defence, defend, hedge in, join together, set, shut up
H5526.full: A primitive root; properly to entwine as a screen; by implication to fence in, cover over, (figuratively) protect: - cover, defence, defend, hedge in, join together, set, shut up.

H5527.full: From H5526; inclosure; Secacah, a place in Palestine: - Secacah.

H5528.firstSense: do (make, play the, turn into) fool (-ish, -ishly, -ishness)
H5528.full: For H3688; to be silly: - do (make, play the, turn into) fool (-ish, -ishly, -ishness).

H5529.full: From H5528; silliness; concretely and collectively, dolts: - folly.

H5532.firstSense: acquaint (self), be advantage, X ever, (be, [un-]) profit (-able), treasure, be wont
H5532.full: A primitive root; to be familiar with; by implication to minister to, be serviceable to, be customary: - acquaint (self), be advantage, X ever, (be, [un-]) profit (-able), treasure, be wont.

H5533.full: Probably a denominative from H7915; properly to cut, that is, damage; also to grow (causatively make) poor: - endanger, impoverish.

H5534.full: A primitive root; to shut up; by implication to surrender: - stop, give over. See also H5462; H7936.

H5535.full: A primitive root; to be silent; by implication to observe quietly: - take heed.

H5536.full: sal sal From H5549; properly a willow twig (as pendulous), that is, an osier; but only as woven into a basket: - basket.

H5537.full: A primitive root; to suspend in a balance, that is, weigh: - compare.

H5538.full: sil-law' From H5549; an embankment; Silla, a place in Jerusalem: - Silla.

H5539.full: A primitive root; probably to leap (with joy), that is, exult: - harden self.

H5540.full: From H5539; exultation; Seled, an Israelite: - Seled.

H5541.full: A primitive root; to hang up, that is, weigh, or (figuratively) contemn: - tread down (under foot), value.

H5542.full: From H5541; suspension (of music), that is, pause: - Selah.

H5543.full: sal-loo', sal-loo', saw-loo', sal-lah'ee From H5541; weighed; Sallu or Sallai, the name of two Israelites: - Sallai, Sallu, Salu.

H5544.full: From H5541; a prickle (as if pendulous): - brier, thorn.

H5545.full: A primitive root; to forgive: - forgive, pardon, spare.

H5546.full: From H5545; placable: - ready to forgive.

H5548.full: From an unused root meaning to walk; walking; Salcah, a place East of the Jordan: - Salcah, Salchah.

H5549.firstSense: cast up, exalt (self), extol, make plain, raise up
H5549.full: A primitive root; to mound up (especially a turnpike); figuratively to exalt; reflexively to oppose (as by a dam): - cast up, exalt (self), extol, make plain, raise up.

H5550.full: Active participle feminine of H5549, but used passively; a military mound, that is, rampart of besiegers: - bank, mount.

H5551.full: From H5549; a stair case: - ladder.

H5552.full: From H5541; a twig (as pendulous): - basket.

H5553.full: From an unused root meaning to be lofty; a craggy rock, literally or figuratively (a fortress): - (ragged) rock, stone (-ny), strong hold.

H5554.full: The same as H5553; Sela, the rock city of Idumaea: - rock, Sela (-h).

H5555.full: From H5553 and the plural of H4256 with the article interposed; rock of the divisions; Sela ham Machlekoth, a place in Palestine: - Sela-hammalekoth.

H5556.full: Apparently from the same as H5553 in the sense of crushing as with a rock, that is, consuming; a kind of locust (from its destructiveness): - bald locust.

H5557.full: A primitive root; properly to wrench, that is, (figuratively) to subvert: - overthrow, pervert.

H5558.full: From H5557; distortion, that is, (figuratively) viciousness: - perverseness.

H5559.full: (Chaldee); a primitive root; to ascend: - come (up).

H5560.full: From an unused root meaning to strip; flour (as chipped off): - (fine) flour, meal.

H5561.full: sam sam From an unused root meaning to smell sweet; an aroma: - sweet (spice).

H5562.full: Of foreign origin; Samgar-Nebo, a Babylonian general: - Samgar-nebo.

H5563.full: Of uncertain derivation; a vine blossom; used also adverbially abloom: - tender grape.

H5564.firstSense: bear up, establish, (up-) hold, lay, lean, lie hard, put, rest self, set self, stand fa…
H5564.full: A primitive root; to prop (literally or figuratively); reflexively to lean upon or take hold of (in a favorable or unfavorable sense): - bear up, establish, (up-) hold, lay, lean, lie hard, put, rest self, set self, stand fast, stay (self), sustain.

H5565.full: From H5564 and H3050; supported of Jah; Semakjah, an Israelite: - Semachiah.

H5566.full: From an unused root meaning to resemble; a likeness: - figure, idol, image.

H5567.full: A primitive root; to designate: - appointed.

H5568.full: A primitive root; to be erect, that is, bristle as hair: - stand up, tremble.

H5569.full: From H5568; bristling, that is, shaggy: - rough.

H5570.full: sen-aw-aw' From an unused root meaning to prick; thorny; Senaah, a place in Palestine: - Senaah, Hassenaah [with the article.

H5571.full: Of foreign origin; Sanballat, a Persian satrap of Samaria: - Sanballat.

H5572.full: From an unused root meaning to prick; a bramble: - bush.

H5573.full: The same as H5572; thorn; Seneh, a crag in Palestine: - Seneh.

H5574.full: sen-oo-aw', sen-oo-aw' From the same as H5570; pointed; (used with the article as a proper name) Senuah, the name of two Israelites. (Hasenuah includes the article.): - Hasenuah [includ. the article, Senuah.

H5575.full: Of uncertain derivation; (in plural) blindness: - blindness.

H5576.full: Of foreign origin; Sancherib, an Assyrian king: - Sennacherib.

H5577.full: From an unused root meaning to be pointed; a twig (as tapering): - bough.

H5578.full: Feminine of a form of H5577; a bough; Sansannah, a place in Palestine: - Sansannah.

H5579.full: Of uncertain derivation; a fin (collectively): - fins.

H5580.full: sâs sawce From the same as H5483; a moth (from the agility of the fly): - moth.

H5581.full: Of uncertain derivation; Sismai, an Israelite: - Sisamai.

H5582.firstSense: comfort, establish, hold up, refresh self, strengthen, be upholden
H5582.full: A primitive root; to support (mostly figuratively): - comfort, establish, hold up, refresh self, strengthen, be upholden.

H5583.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5582; to aid: - helping.

H5584.full: A primitive root; to rush: - storm.

H5585.full: From H5586; a fissure (of rocks); also a bough (as subdivided): - (outmost), branch, clift, top.

H5586.full: A primitive root; properly to divide up; but used only as denominative from H5585, to disbranch (a tree): - top.

H5587.full: From H5586; divided (in mind), that is, (abstractly) a sentiment: - opinion.

H5588.full: From H5586; divided (in mind), that is, (concretely) a skeptic: - thought.

H5589.full: Feminine of H5585; a twig: - bough. Compare H5634.

H5590.firstSense: be (toss with) tempest (-uous), be sore troubled, come out as a (drive with the, scatte…
H5590.full: A primitive root; to rush upon; by implication to toss (transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively): - be (toss with) tempest (-uous), be sore troubled, come out as a (drive with the, scatter with a) whirlwind.

H5591.full: From H5590; a hurricane: - storm (-y), tempest, whirlwind.

H5592.firstSense: bason, bowl, cup, door (post), gate, post, threshold
H5592.full: saph saf From H5605, in its original sense of containing; a vestibule (as a limit); also a dish (for holding blood or wine): - bason, bowl, cup, door (post), gate, post, threshold.

H5593.full: saph saf The same as H5592; Saph, a Philistine: - Saph. Compare H5598.

H5594.full: A primitive root; properly to tear the hair and beat the breasts (as Orientals do in grief); generally to lament; by implication to wail: - lament, mourn (-er), wail.

H5595.firstSense: add, augment, consume, destroy, heap, join, perish, put
H5595.full: A primitive root; properly to scrape (literally to shave; but usually figuratively) together (that is, to accumulate or increase) or away (that is, to scatter, remove or ruin; intransitively to perish): - add, augment, consume, destroy, heap, join, perish, put.

H5596.firstSense: abiding, gather together, cleave, put, smite with a scab
H5596.full: A primitive root; properly to scrape out, but in certain peculiar senses (of removal or association): - abiding, gather together, cleave, put, smite with a scab.

H5597.full: From H5596; the mange (as making the hair fall off): - scab.

H5598.full: From H5592; bason like; Sippai, a Philistine: - Sippai. Compare H5593.

H5599.firstSense: (such) things as (which) grow (of themselves), which groweth of its own accord (itself)
H5599.full: From H5596; something (spontaneously) falling off, that is, a self sown crop; figuratively a freshet: - (such) things as (which) grow (of themselves), which groweth of its own accord (itself).

H5600.full: From H5603; a (sea going) vessel (as ceiled with a deck): - ship.

H5601.full: From H5608; a gem (perhaps as used for scratching other substances), probably the sapphire: - sapphire.

H5602.full: From an unused root meaning to depress; a basin (as deepened out): - bowl, dish.

H5603.full: A primitive root; to hide by covering; specifically to roof (passive participle as noun, a roof) or wainscot; figuratively to reserve: - cieled, cover, seated.

H5605.full: A primitive root; properly to snatch away, that is, terminate; but used only as denominative from H5592 (in the sense of a vestibule), to wait at the threshold: - be a doorkeeper.

H5606.full: A primitive root; to clap the hands (in token of compact, derision, grief, indignation or punishment); by implication of satisfaction, to be enough; by implication of excess, to vomit: - clap, smite, strike, suffice, wallow.

H5607.full: From H5606; chastisement; also satiety: - stroke, sufficiency.

H5608.firstSense: commune, (ac-) count, declare, number, + penknife, reckon, scribe, shew forth, speak, t…
H5608.full: A primitive root; properly to score with a mark as a tally or record, that is, (by implication) to inscribe, and also to enumerate; intensively to recount, that is, celebrate: - commune, (ac-) count, declare, number, + penknife, reckon, scribe, shew forth, speak, talk, tell (out), writer.

H5609.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H5608; a book: - book, roll.

H5611.full: The same as H5610; Sephar, a place in Arabia: - Sephar.

H5612.firstSense: bill, book, evidence, X learn [-ed] (-ing), letter, register, scroll
H5612.full: From H5608; properly writing (the art or a document); by implication a book: - bill, book, evidence, X learn [-ed] (-ing), letter, register, scroll.

H5613.full: (Chaldee); from the same as H5609; a scribe (secular or sacred): - scribe.

H5614.full: Of foreign derivation; Sepharad, a region of Assyria: - Sepharad.

H5616.full: Patrial from H5617; a Sepharvite or inhabitant of Sepharvain: - Sepharvite.

H5617.full: Of foreign derivation; Sepharvajim or Sepharim, a place in Assyria: - Sepharvaim.

H5618.full: Feminine active participle of H5608; a scribe (properly female); Sophereth, a temple servant: - Sophereth.

H5619.firstSense: (cast, gather out, throw) stone (-s), X surely
H5619.full: A primitive root; properly to be weighty; but used only in the sense of lapidation or its contrary (as if a delapidation): - (cast, gather out, throw) stone (-s), X surely.
