H5620.full: sar sar From H5637 contracted; peevish: - heavy, sad.

H5621.full: From an unused root meaning to sting; a thistle: - brier.

H5622.full: (Chaldee); of uncertain derivation; a cloak: - coat.

H5623.full: Of foreign derivation; Sargon, an Assyrian king: - Sargon.

H5624.full: From a primitive root meaning to tremble; trembling; Sered, an Israelite: - Sered.

H5625.full: Patronymic from H5624; a Seredite (collectively) or descendant of Sered: - Sardites.

H5626.full: From H5493; departure; Sirah, a cistern so called: - Sirah. See also H5518.

H5627.firstSense: X continual, rebellion, revolt ([-ed]), turn away, wrong
H5627.full: From H5493; apostasy, crime; figuratively remission: - X continual, rebellion, revolt ([-ed]), turn away, wrong.

H5628.firstSense: exceeding, hand, spread, stretch self, banish
H5628.full: A primitive root; to extend (even to excess): - exceeding, hand, spread, stretch self, banish.

H5630.full: For H8302; a coat of mail: - brigandine.

H5631.full: From an unused root meaning to castrate; a eunuch; by implication valet (especially of the female apartments), and thus a minister of state: - chamberlain, eunuch, officer. Compare H7249.

H5632.full: (Chaldee); of foreign origin; an emir: - president.

H5633.full: From an unused root of uncertain meaning; an axle; figuratively a peer: - lord, plate.

H5635.full: A primitive root; to cremate, that is, to be (near) of kin (such being privileged to kindle the pyre): - burn.

H5636.full: From H5635; a nettle (as stinging like a burn): - brier.

H5637.firstSense: X away, backsliding, rebellious, revolter (-ing), slide back, stubborn, withdrew
H5637.full: A primitive root; to turn away, that is, (morally) be refractory: - X away, backsliding, rebellious, revolter (-ing), slide back, stubborn, withdrew.

H5638.full: From an unused root meaning to hide; winter (as the dark season): - winter.

H5639.full: From H5641; hidden; Sethur, an Israelite: - Sethur.

H5640.firstSense: closed up, hidden, secret, shut out (up), stop
H5640.full: A primitive root; to stop up; by implication to repair; figuratively to keep secret: - closed up, hidden, secret, shut out (up), stop.

H5641.firstSense: be absent, keep close, conceal, hide (self), (keep) secret, X surely
H5641.full: A primitive root; to hide (by covering), literally or figuratively: - be absent, keep close, conceal, hide (self), (keep) secret, X surely.

H5642.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5641; to conceal; figuratively to demolish: - destroy, secret thing.

H5643.firstSense: backbiting, covering, covert, X disguise [-th], hiding place, privily, protection, secr…
H5643.full: From H5641; a cover (in a good or a bad, a literal or a figurative sense): - backbiting, covering, covert, X disguise [-th], hiding place, privily, protection, secret (-ly, place).

H5644.full: From H5643; protective; Sithri, an Israelite: - Zithri.

H5645.full: Masculine and feminine; from H5743; properly an envelope, that is, darkness (or density, 2Ch_4:17); specifically a (scud) cloud; also a copse: - clay, (thick) cloud, X thick, thicket. Compare H5672.

H5646.full: From an unused root meaning to cover; properly equivalent to H5645; but used only as an architectural term, an architrave (as shading the pillars): - thick (beam, plant).

H5647.firstSense: X be, keep in bondage, be bondmen, bond-service, compel, do, dress, ear, execute, + hus…
H5647.full: A primitive root; to work (in any sense); by implication to serve, till, (causatively) enslave, etc.: - X be, keep in bondage, be bondmen, bond-service, compel, do, dress, ear, execute, + husbandman, keep, labour (-ing man), bring to pass, (cause to, make to) serve (-ing, self), (be, become) servant (-s), do (use) service, till (-er), transgress [from margin], (set a) work, be wrought, worshipper.

H5648.firstSense: X cut, do, execute, go on, make, move, work
H5648.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5647; to do, make, prepare, keep, etc.: - X cut, do, execute, go on, make, move, work.

H5650.full: From H5647; a servant: - X bondage, bondman, [bond-] servant, (man-) servant.

H5651.full: The same as H5650; Ebed, the name of two Israelites: - Ebed.

H5653.full: From H5647; work; Abda, the name of two Israelites: - Abda.

H5654.full: From the active participle of H5647 and H123; worker of Edom; Obed-Edom, the name of five Israelites: - Obed-edom.

H5655.full: ab-deh-ale' From H5647 and H410; serving God; Abdeel, an Israelite: - Abdeel. Compare H5661.

H5656.firstSense: act, bondage, + bondservant, effect, labour, ministering (-try), office, service (-ile,…
H5656.full: From H5647; work of any kind: - act, bondage, + bondservant, effect, labour, ministering (-try), office, service (-ile, -itude), tillage, use, work, X wrought.

H5657.full: Passive participle of H5647; something wrought, that is, (concretely) service: - household, store of servants.

H5658.full: From H5647; servitude; Abdon, the name of a place in Palestine and of four Israelites: - Abdon. Compare H5683.

H5660.full: From H5647; serviceable; Abdi, the name of two Israelites: - Abdi.

H5661.full: From H5650 and H410; servant of God; Abdiel, an Israelite: - Abdiel. Compare H5655.

H5662.full: Active participle of H5647 and H3050; serving Jah; Obadjah, the name of thirteen Israelites: - Obadiah.

H5663.full: From H5650 and H4428; servant of a king; Ebed-Melek, a eunuch of king Zedekeah: - Ebed-melech.

H5664.full: The same as H5665; Abed-Nego, the Babylonian name of one of Daniel's companions: - Abed-nego.

H5665.full: (Chaldee); of foreign origin; Abed-Nego, the name of Azariah: - Abed-nego.

H5666.full: A primitive root; to be dense: - be (grow) thick (-er).

H5668.full: Passive participle of H5674; properly crossed, that is, (abstractly) transit; used only adverbially on account of, in order that: - because of, for (. . . 's sake), (intent) that, to.

H5669.full: The same as H5668; passed, that is, kept over; used only of stored grain: - old corn.

H5670.firstSense: borrow, break [ranks], fetch [a pledge], lend, X surely
H5670.full: A primitive root; to pawn; causatively to lend (on security); figuratively to entangle: - borrow, break [ranks], fetch [a pledge], lend, X surely.

H5671.full: From H5670; something pledged, that is, (collectively) pawned goods. (thick clay is by a false etym.): - thick clay [by a false etymology].

H5672.full: From H5666; density, that is, depth or width: - thick (-ness). Compare H5645.

H5673.full: (Chaldee); from H5648; labor or business: - affairs, service, work.

H5674.firstSense: alienate, alter, X at all, beyond, bring (over, through), carry over, (over-) come (on,…
H5674.full: A primitive root; to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literally or figuratively; transitively, intransitively, intensively or causatively); specifically to cover (in copulation): - alienate, alter, X at all, beyond, bring (over, through), carry over, (over-) come (on, over), conduct (over), convey over, current, deliver, do away, enter, escape, fail, gender, get over, (make) go (away, beyond, by, forth, his way, in, on, over, through), have away (more), lay, meddle, overrun, make partition, (cause to, give, make to, over) pass (-age, along, away, beyond, by, -enger, on, out, over, through), (cause to, make) + proclaim (-amation), perish, provoke to anger, put away, rage, + raiser of taxes, remove, send over, set apart, + shave, cause to (make) sound, X speedily, X sweet smelling, take (away), (make to) transgress (-or), translate, turn away, [way-] faring man, be wrath.

H5675.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5676: - beyond, this side.

H5676.firstSense: X against, beyond, by, X from, over, passage, quarter, (other, this) side, straight
H5676.full: From H5674; properly a region across; but used only adverbially (with or without a preposition) on the opposite side (especially of the Jordan; usually meaning the east): - X against, beyond, by, X from, over, passage, quarter, (other, this) side, straight.

H5677.full: The same as H5676; Eber, the name of two patriarchs and four Israelites: - Eber, Heber.

H5678.full: Feminine of H5676; an outburst of passion: - anger, rage, wrath.

H5679.full: From H5674; a crossing place: - ferry, plain [from the margin].

H5680.full: Patronymic from H5677; an Eberite (that is, Hebrew) or descendant of Eber: - Hebrew (-ess, woman).

H5681.full: The same as H5680; Ibri, an Israelite: - Ibri.

H5682.full: Plural of H5676; regions beyond; Abarim, a place in Palestine: - Abarim, passages.

H5683.full: From H5676; transitional; Ebron, a place in Palestine. (Perhaps a clerical error for H5658.): - Hebron. Perhaps a clerical error for H5658.

H5684.full: Feminine of H5683; Ebronah, a place in the Desert: - Ebronah.

H5685.full: A primitive root; to dry up: - be rotten.

H5686.full: A primitive root; to interlace, that is, (figuratively) to pervert: - wrap up.

H5687.full: From H5686; intwined, that is, dense: - thick.

H5688.firstSense: band, cord, rope, thick bough (branch), wreathen (chain)
H5688.full: The same as H5687; something intwined, that is, a string, wreath or foliage: - band, cord, rope, thick bough (branch), wreathen (chain).

H5689.full: A primitive root; to breathe after, that is, to love (sensually): - dote, lover.

H5690.full: From H5689; love (concretely), that is, amative words: - much love, very lovely.

H5691.full: From H5689; love (abstractly), that is, amorousness: - inordinate love.

H5692.full: From H5746; an ashcake (as round): - cake (upon the hearth).

H5693.full: Passive participle (but with active sense) of an unused root meaning to twitter; probably the swallow: - swallow.

H5694.full: From the same as H5696; something round, that is, a ring (for the ears): - earring.

H5695.full: From the same as H5696; a (male) calf (as frisking round), especially one nearly grown (that is, a steer): - bullock, calf.

H5696.full: From an unused root meaning to revolve, circular: - round.

H5697.full: Feminine of H5695; a (female) calf, especially one nearly grown (that is, a heifer): - calf, cow, heifer.

H5698.full: The same as H5697; Eglah, a wife of David: - Eglah.

H5699.full: From the same as H5696; something revolving, that is, a wheeled vehicle: - cart, chariot, wagon.

H5700.full: From H5695; vituline; Eglon, the name of a place in Palestine and of a Moabitish king: - Eglon.

H5701.full: A primitive root; to be sad: - grieve.

H5702.full: A primitive root; to debar, that is, from marriage: - stay.

H5703.firstSense: eternity, ever (-lasting, -more), old, perpetually, + world without end
H5703.full: From H5710; properly a (peremptory) terminus, that is, (by implication) duration, in the sense of perpetuity (substantially as a noun, either with or without a preposition): - eternity, ever (-lasting, -more), old, perpetually, + world without end.

H5704.firstSense: against, and, as, at, before, by (that), even (to), for (-asmuch as), [hither-] to, + h…
H5704.full: Properly the same as H5703 (used as a preposition, adverb or conjugation; especially with a preposition); as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with): - against, and, as, at, before, by (that), even (to), for (-asmuch as), [hither-] to, + how long, into, as long (much) as, (so) that, till, toward, until, when, while, (+ as) yet.

H5705.firstSense: X and, at, for, [hither-] to, on, till, (un-) to, until, within
H5705.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5704: - X and, at, for, [hither-] to, on, till, (un-) to, until, within.

H5706.full: The same as H5703 in the sense of the aim of an attack; booty: - prey.

H5707.full: From H5749 contracted; concretely a witness; abstractly testimony; specifically a recorder, that is, prince: - witness.

H5708.full: From an unused root meaning to set a period (compare H5710 and H5749); the menstrual flux (as periodical); by implication (in plural) soiling: - filthy.

H5709.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5710: - alter, depart, pass (away), remove, take (away).

H5710.firstSense: adorn, deck (self), pass by, take away
H5710.full: A primitive root; to advance, that is, pass on or continue; causatively to remove; specifically to bedeck (that is, bring an ornament upon): - adorn, deck (self), pass by, take away.

H5711.full: From H5710; ornament; Adah, the name of two women: - Adah.

H5712.firstSense: assembly, company, congregation, multitude, people, swarm
H5712.full: Feminine of H5707 in the original sense of fixture; a stated assemblage (specifically a concourse, or generally a family or crowd): - assembly, company, congregation, multitude, people, swarm. Compare H5713.

H5713.full: Feminine of H5707 in its technical sense; testimony: - testimony, witness. Compare H5712.

H5714.full: From H5710; timely; Iddo (or Iddi), the name of five Israelites: - Iddo. Compare H3035, H3260.

H5715.full: Feminine of H5707; testimony: - testimony, witness.

H5716.full: From H5710 in the sense of trappings; finery; generally an outfit; specifically a headstall: - X excellent, mouth, ornament.

H5717.full: From H5716 and H410; ornament of God; Adiel, the name of three Israelites: - Adiel.

H5718.full: From H5710 and H3050; Jah has adorned; Adajah, the name of eight Israelites: - Adaiah.

H5719.full: From H5727; voluptuous: - given to pleasures.

H5720.full: The same as H5719; Adin, the name of two Israelites: - Adin.

H5721.full: From H5719; effeminacy; Adina, an Israelite: - Adina.

H5722.full: Probably from H5719 in the original sense of slender (that is, a spear); his spear: - Adino.

H5723.full: Dual of a feminine of H5706; double prey; Adithajim, a place in Palestine: - Adithaim.

H5724.full: Probably from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Adlai, an Israelite: - Adlai.

H5725.full: Probably from the passive participle of the same as H5724; Adullam, a place in Palestine: - Adullam.

H5726.full: Patrial from H5725; an Adullamite or native of Adullam: - Adullamite.

H5727.full: A primitive root; to be soft or pleasant; figuratively and reflexively to live voluptuously: - delight self.

H5728.full: From H5704 and H2004; till now: - yet.

H5729.full: From H5727; pleasure; Eden, a place in Mesopotamia: - Eden.

H5730.full: From H5727; pleasure: - delicate, delight, pleasure. See also H1040.

H5731.full: The same as H5730 (masculine); Eden, the region of Adam's home: - Eden.

H5732.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to that of H5708; a set time; technically a year: - time.

H5733.full: From H5727; pleasure; Adna, the name of two Israelites: - Adna.

H5734.full: From H5727; pleasure; Adnah, the name of two Israelites: - Adnah.

H5735.full: From H5712; festival; Adadah, a place in Palestine: - Adadah.

H5736.firstSense: be more, odd number, be (have) over (and above), overplus, remain
H5736.full: A primitive root; to be (causatively have) redundant: - be more, odd number, be (have) over (and above), overplus, remain.

H5737.full: A primitive root; to arrange, as a battle, a vineyard (to hoe); hence to muster, and so to miss (or find wanting): - dig, fail, keep (rank), lack.

H5738.full: From H5737; an arrangement (that is, drove); Eder, an Israelite: - Ader.

H5739.full: From H5737; an arrangement, that is, muster (of animals): - drove, flock, herd.

H5740.full: The same as H5739; Eder, the name of an Israelite and of two places in Palestine: - Edar, Eder.

H5741.full: From H5739 and H410; flock of God; Adriel, an Israelite: - Adriel.

H5742.full: From an unused root of uncertain meaning; a lentil: - lentile.

H5743.full: A primitive root; to be dense or dark, that is, to becloud: - cover with a cloud.

H5744.full: Active participle of H5647; serving; Obed, the name of five Israelites: - Obed.

H5745.full: Of foreign derivation; Obal, a son of Joktan: - Obal.

H5746.full: A primitive root; properly to gyrate; but used only as denominative from H5692, to bake (round cakes on the hearth): - bake.

H5747.full: Probably from H5746; round; Og, a king of Bashan: - Og.

H5748.full: From H5689 in the original sense of breathing; a reed instrument of music: - organ.

H5749.firstSense: admonish, charge, earnestly, lift up, protest, call (take) to record, relieve, rob, sol…
H5749.full: A primitive root; to duplicate or repeat; by implication to protest, testify (as by reiteration); intensively to encompass, restore (as a sort of reduplication): - admonish, charge, earnestly, lift up, protest, call (take) to record, relieve, rob, solemnly, stand upright, testify, give warning, (bear, call to, give, take to) witness.

H5750.firstSense: again, X all life long, at all, besides, but, else, further (-more), henceforth, (any)…
H5750.full: From H5749; properly iteration or continuance; used only adverbially (with or without preposition), again, repeatedly, still, more: - again, X all life long, at all, besides, but, else, further (-more), henceforth, (any) longer, (any) more (-over), X once, since, (be) still, when, (good, the) while (having being), (as, because, whether, while) yet (within).

H5752.full: From H5749; reiteration; Oded, the name of two Israelites: - Oded.

H5753.firstSense: do amiss, bow down, make crooked, commit iniquity, pervert, (do) perverse (-ly), troubl…
H5753.full: A primitive root; to crook, literally or figuratively: - do amiss, bow down, make crooked, commit iniquity, pervert, (do) perverse (-ly), trouble, X turn, do wickedly, do wrong.

H5754.full: Intensive from H5753 abbreviated; overthrow: - X overturn.

H5755.full: For H5754; Ivvah or Avva, a region of Assyria: - Ava, Ivah.

H5756.full: A primitive root; to be strong; causatively to strengthen, that is, (figuratively) to save (by flight): - gather (self, self to flee), retire.

H5757.full: Patrial from H5755; an Avvite or native of Avvah (only plural): - Avims, Avites.

H5758.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H5753; perverseness: - iniquity.

H5759.full: From H5764; a babe: - young child, little one.

H5761.full: Plural of H5757; Avvim (as inhabited by Avvites), a place in Palestine (with the article prefixed): - Avim.

H5762.full: From H5753; ruin; Avvith (or Avvoth), a place in Palestine: - Avith.

H5763.full: A primitive root; to suckle, that is, give milk: - milch, (ewe great) with young.

H5764.full: From H5763; a babe: - sucking child, infant.

H5765.full: A primitive root; to distort (morally): - deal unjustly, unrighteous.

H5766.full: From H5765; (moral) evil: - iniquity, perverseness, unjust (-ly), unrighteousness (-ly), wicked (-ness).

H5767.full: Intensive from H5765; evil (morally): - unjust, unrighteous, wicked.

H5768.full: From H5763; a suckling: - babe, (young) child, infant, little one.

H5769.firstSense: always (-s), ancient (time), any more, continuance, eternal, (for, [n-]) ever (-lasting…
H5769.full: From H5956; properly concealed, that is, the vanishing point; generally time out of mind (past or future), that is, (practically) eternity; frequentative adverbially (especially with prepositional prefix) always: - always (-s), ancient (time), any more, continuance, eternal, (for, [n-]) ever (-lasting, -more, of old), lasting, long (time), (of) old (time), perpetual, at any time, (beginning of the) world (+ without end). Compare H5331, H5703.

H5770.full: Denominative from H5869; to watch (with jealousy): - eye.

H5771.firstSense: fault, iniquity, mischief, punishment (of iniquity), sin
H5771.full: From H5753; perversity, that is, (moral) evil: - fault, iniquity, mischief, punishment (of iniquity), sin.

H5772.full: From an unused root apparently meaning to dwell together; (sexual) cohabitation: - duty of marriage.

H5774.firstSense: brandish, be (wax) faint, flee away, fly (away - ), X set, shine forth, weary
H5774.full: A primitive root; to cover (with wings or obscurity); hence (as denominative from H5775) to fly; also (by implication of dimness) to faint (from the darkness of swooning): - brandish, be (wax) faint, flee away, fly (away - ), X set, shine forth, weary.

H5775.full: From H5774; a bird (as covered with feathers, or rather as covering with wings), often collective: - bird, that flieth, flying, fowl.

H5777.full: Feminine participle active of H6080; lead (from its dusty color): - lead.

H5778.full: From H5775; birdlike; Ephai, an Israelite: - Ephai [from margin].

H5779.full: A primitive root; to consult: - take advice ([counsel] together).

H5780.full: Apparently from H5779; consultation; Uts, a son of Aram, also a Seirite, and the regions settled by them: - Uz.

H5781.full: A primitive root; to pack: - be pressed.

H5782.firstSense: (a-) wake (-n, up), lift up (self), X master, raise (up), stir up (self)
H5782.full: A primitive root (rather identical with H5783 through the idea of opening the eyes); to wake (literally or figuratively): - (a-) wake (-n, up), lift up (self), X master, raise (up), stir up (self).

H5783.full: A primitive root; to (be) bare: - be made naked.

H5785.full: From H5783; skin (as naked); by implication hide, leather: - hide, leather, skin.

H5786.full: A primitive root (rather denominative from H5785 through the idea of a film over the eyes); to blind: - blind, put out. See also H5895.

H5787.full: Intensive from H5786; blind (literally or figuratively): - blind (men, people).

H5789.full: A primitive root; to hasten: - assemble self.

H5790.full: From H5789; to hasten, that is, succor: - speak in season.

H5791.firstSense: bow self, (make) crooked, falsifying, overthrow, deal perversely, pervert, subvert, tur…
H5791.full: A primitive root; to wrest: - bow self, (make) crooked, falsifying, overthrow, deal perversely, pervert, subvert, turn upside down.

H5793.full: From H5790; succoring; Uthai, the name of two Israelites: - Uthai.

H5794.firstSense: fierce, + greedy, mighty, power, roughly, strong
H5794.full: From H5810; strong, vehement, harsh: - fierce, + greedy, mighty, power, roughly, strong.

H5795.full: From H5810; a she goat (as strong), but masculine in plural (which also is used elliptically for goats' hair): - (she) goat, kid.

H5797.firstSense: boldness, loud, might, power, strength, strong
H5797.full: From H5810; strength in various applications (force, security, majesty, praise): - boldness, loud, might, power, strength, strong.

H5798.full: Feminine of H5797; strength; Uzza or Uzzah, the name of five Israelites: - Uzza, Uzzah.

H5799.full: From H5795 and H235; goat of departure; the scapegoat: - scapegoat.

H5800.firstSense: commit self, fail, forsake, fortify, help, leave (destitute, off), refuse, X surely
H5800.full: A primitive root; to loosen, that is, relinquish, permit, etc.: - commit self, fail, forsake, fortify, help, leave (destitute, off), refuse, X surely.

H5801.full: From H5800 in the sense of letting go (for a price, that is, selling); trade, that is, the palce (mart) or the payment (revenue): - fair, ware.

H5802.full: From H5794 and the root of H950; stern depopulator; Azbuk, an Israelite: - Azbuk.

H5803.full: From H5794 and H1409; stern troop; Azgad, an Israelite: - Azgad.

H5804.full: Feminine of H5794; strong; Azzah, a place in Palestine: - Azzah, Gaza.

H5805.full: Feminine passive participle of H5800; desertion (of inhabitants): - forsaking.

H5806.full: The same as H5805; Azubah, the name of two Israelitesses: - Azubah.

H5808.full: From H5810; forcible; collectively and concretely an army: - power, strong.

H5809.full: From H5826; helpful; Azzur, the name of three Israelites: - Azur, Azzur.

H5810.firstSense: harden, impudent, prevail, strengthen (self), be strong
H5810.full: A primitive root; to be stout (literally or figuratively): - harden, impudent, prevail, strengthen (self), be strong.

H5811.full: From H5810; strong; Azaz, an Israelite: - Azaz.

H5812.full: From H5810 and H3050; Jah has strengthened; Azazjah, the name of three Israelites: - Azaziah.

H5813.full: From H5810; forceful; Uzzi, the name of six Israelites: - Uzzi.

H5814.full: Perhaps for H5818; Uzzija, an Israelite: - Uzzia.

H5815.full: From H5756 and H410; strengthened of God; Aziel, an Israelite: - Aziel. Compare H3268.

H5816.full: From H5797 and H410; strength of God; Uzziel, the name of six Israelites: - Uzziel.

H5817.full: Patronymic from H5816; an Uzzielite (collectively) or descendant of Uzziel: - Uzzielites.

H5818.full: From H5797 and H3050; strength of Jah; Uzzijah, the name of five Israelites: - Uzziah.

H5819.full: From H5756; strengthfulness; Aziza, an Israelite: - Aziza.

H5820.full: From H5794 and H4194; strong one of death; Azmaveth, the name of three Israelites and of a place in Palestine: - Azmaveth. See also H1041.

H5821.full: From H5794; strong one; Azzan, an Israelite: - Azzan.

H5822.full: Probably feminine of H5797; probably the sea eagle (from its strength): - ospray.

H5823.full: A primitive root; to grub over: - fence about.

H5824.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H5823; a signet ring (as engraved): - signet.

H5825.full: From H5823; tilled; Azekah, a place in Palestine: - Azekah.

H5826.full: A primitive root; to surround, that is, protect or aid: - help, succour.

H5827.full: From H5826; help; Ezer, the name of two Israelites: - Ezer. Compare H5829.

H5829.full: The same as H5828; Ezer, the name of four Israelites: - Ezer. Compare H5827.

H5830.full: A variation of H5833; Ezra, an Israelite: - Ezra.

H5831.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5830; Ezra, an Israelite: - Ezra.

H5832.full: From H5826 and H410; God has helped; Azarel, the name of five Israelites: - Azarael, Azareel.

H5834.full: The same as H5833; Ezrah, an Israelite: - Ezrah.

H5835.full: From H5826 in its original meaning of surrounding; an inclosure; also a border: - court, settle.

H5836.full: From H5828; helpful; Ezri, an Israelite: - Ezri.

H5837.full: From H5828 and H410; help of God; Azriel, the name of three Israelites: - Azriel.

H5838.full: From H5826 and H3050; Jah has helped; Azarjah, the name of nineteen Israelites: - Azariah.

H5839.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5838; Azarjah, one of Daniel's companions: - Azariah.

H5840.full: From H5828 and active participle of H6965; help of an enemy; Azrikam, the name of four Israelites: - Azrikam.

H5841.full: Patrial from H5804; an Azzathite or inhabitant of Azzah: - Gazathite, Gazite.

H5842.full: From H5860 (contracted) in the sense of swooping, that is, side long stroke; a stylus or marking stick: - pen.

H5844.firstSense: array, self, be clad, (put a) cover (-ing, self), fill, put on, X surely, turn aside
H5844.full: A primitive root; to wrap, that is, cover, veil, clothe or roll: - array, self, be clad, (put a) cover (-ing, self), fill, put on, X surely, turn aside.

H5845.full: From an unused root meaning apparently to contain; a receptacle (for milk, that is, pail; figuratively breast): - breast.

H5846.full: From an unused root meaning to sneeze; sneezing: - sneezing.

H5847.full: Of uncertain derivation; a bat: - bat.

H5848.firstSense: cover (over), fail, faint, feebler, hide self, be overwhelmed, swoon
H5848.full: A primitive root; to shroud, that is, clothe (whether transitively or reflexively); hence (from the idea of darkness) to languish: - cover (over), fail, faint, feebler, hide self, be overwhelmed, swoon.

H5849.full: A primitive root; to encircle (for attack or protection); especially to crown (literally or figuratively): - compass, crown.

H5851.full: The same as H5850; Atarah, an Israelitess: - Atarah.

H5852.full: Plural of H5850; Ataroth, the name (thus simply) of two places in Palestine: - Ataroth.

H5853.full: From the same as H5852 and H146; crowns of Addar; Atroth-Addar, a place in Palestine: - Ataroth-adar (-addar).

H5854.full: From the same as H5852 and H1004 and H3097; crowns of the house of Joab; Atroth-beth-Joab, a place in Palestine: - Ataroth the house of Joab.

H5855.full: From the same as H5852 and a name otherwise unused (being from the same as H8226) meaning hidden; crowns of Shophan; Atroth-Shophan, a place in Palestine: - Atroth, Shophan [as if two places].

H5856.full: From H5753; a ruin (as if overturned): - heap.

H5857.full: For H5856; Ai, Aja or Ajath, a place in Palestine: - Ai, Aija, Aijath, Hai.

H5858.full: Perhaps from an unused root probably meaning to be bald; bare; Ebal, a mountain of Palestine: - Ebal.

H5859.full: From H5856; ruin; Ijon, a place in Palestine: - Ijon.

H5860.full: A primitive root; to swoop down upon (literally or figuratively): - fly, rail.

H5861.full: From H5860; a hawk or other bird of prey: - bird, fowl, ravenous (bird).

H5862.full: From H5861; hawk ground; Etam, a place in Palestine: - Etam.

H5863.full: From the plural of H5856 and the plural of the active participle of H5674 with the article interposed; ruins of the passers; Ije-ha-Abarim, a place near Palestine: - Ije-abarim.

H5864.full: Plural of H5856; ruins; Ijim, a place in the Desert: - Iim.

H5866.full: From H5927; elevated; Ilai, an Israelite: - Ilai.

H5867.full: Probably from H5956; hidden, that is, distant; Elam, a son of Shem, and his descendants, with their country; also of six Israelites: - Elam.

H5868.full: Of doubtful origin and authenticity; probably meaning strength: - mighty.

H5869.firstSense: affliction, outward appearance, + before, + think best, colour, conceit, + be content,…
H5869.full: Probably a primitive word; an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy a fountain (as the eye of the landscape): - affliction, outward appearance, + before, + think best, colour, conceit, + be content, countenance, + displease, eye ([-brow], [-d], -sight), face, + favour, fountain, furrow [from the margin], X him, + humble, knowledge, look, (+ well), X me, open (-ly), + (not) please, presence, + regard, resemblance, sight, X thee, X them, + think, X us, well, X you (-rselves).

H5870.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5869; an eye: - eye.

H5871.full: The same as H5869; fountain; Ajin, the name (thus simply) of two places in Palestine: - Ain.

H5872.full: From H5869 and H1423; fountain of a kid; En-Gedi, a place in Palestine: - En-gedi.

H5873.full: From H5869 and the plural of H1588; fountain of gardens; En-Gannim, a place in Palestine: - En-gannim.

H5874.full: From H5869 and H1755; fountain of dwelling; En-Dor, a place in Palestine: - En-dor.

H5875.full: From H5869 and the active participle of H7121; fountain of One calling; En-hak-Kore, a place near Palestine: - En-hakhore.

H5876.full: From H5869 and the feminine of a derivative from H2300; fountain of sharpness; En-Chaddah, a place in Palestine: - En-haddah.

H5877.full: From H5869 and the same as H2674; fountain of a village; En-Chatsor, a place in Palestine: - En-hazor.

H5878.full: From H5869 and a derivative of H2729; fountain of trembling; En-Charod, a place in Palestine: - well of Harod.

H5879.full: Dual of H5869; double fountain; Enajim or Enam, a place in Palestine: - Enaim, openly (Gen. H38 : H21).

H5880.full: From H5869 and H4941; fountain of judgment; En-Mishpat, a place near Palestine: - En-mishpat.

H5881.full: From H5869; having eyes; Enan, an Israelite: - Enan. Compare H2704.

H5882.full: From H5869 and the dual of H5695; fountain of two calves; En-Eglajim, a place in Palestine: - En-eglaim.

H5883.full: From H5869 and the active participle of H7270; fountain of a traveller; En-Rogel, a place near Jerusalem: - En-rogel.

H5884.full: From H5869 and H7416; fountain of a pomegranate; En-Rimmon, a place in Palestine: - En-rimmon.

H5885.full: From H5869 and H8121; fountain of the sun; En-Shemesh, a place in Palestine: - En-Shemesh.

H5886.full: From H5869 and the plural of H8565; fountain of jackals; En-Tannim, a pool near Jerusalem: - dragon well.

H5887.full: From H5869 and H8598; fountain of an apple tree; En-Tappuach, a place in Palestine: - En-tappuah.

H5888.full: A primitive root; to languish: - be wearied.

H5889.full: From H5888; languid: - faint, thirsty, weary.

H5890.full: Feminine from H5774; obscurity (as if from covering): - darkness.

H5891.full: The same as H5890; Ephah, the name of a son of Midian, and of the region settled by him; also of an Israelite and of an Israelitess: - Ephah.

H5892.firstSense: Ai [from margin], city, court [from margin], town
H5892.full: From H5782 a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post): - Ai [from margin], city, court [from margin], town.

H5893.full: The same as H5892; Ir, an Israelite: - Ir.

H5894.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H5782; a watcher, that is, an angel (as guardian): - watcher.

H5895.full: From H5782 in the sense of raising (that is, bearing a burden); properly a young ass (as just broken to a load); hence an ass colt: - (ass) colt, foal, young ass.

H5896.full: From H5782; wakefulness; Ira, the name of three Israelites: - Ira.

H5897.full: From the same as H6166; fugitive; Irad, an antediluvian: - Irad.

H5898.full: From H5892 and H4417 with the article of substance interposed; city of (the) salt; Ir-ham-Melach, a place near Palestine: - the city of salt.

H5899.full: From H5892 and the plural of H8558 with the article interposed; city of the palmtrees; Ir-hat-Temarim, a place in Palestine: - the city of palmtrees.

H5900.full: From H5892; a citizen; Iru, an Israelite: - Iru.

H5901.full: From H5892; urbane; Iri, an Israelite: - Iri.

H5902.full: From H5892; citywise; Iram, an Idumaean: - Iram.

H5904.full: From H5892 and H5175; city of a serpent; Ir-Nachash, a place in Palestine: - Ir-nahash.

H5905.full: From H5892 and H8121; city of the sun; Ir-Shemesh, a place in Palestine: - Ir-shemesh.

H5906.full: From H5789; the constellation of the Great Bear (perhaps from its migration through the heavens): - Arcturus.

H5907.full: Probably for H5909; Akbor, the name of an Idumaean and two Israelites: - Achbor.

H5908.full: Probably from an unused root in the literal sense of entangling; a spider (as weaving a network): - spider.

H5909.full: Probably from the same as H5908 in the secondary sense of attacking; a mouse (as nibbling): - mouse.

H5910.full: Apparently from an unused root meaning to hem in; Akko (from its situation on a bay): - Accho.

H5911.full: From H5916; troubled; Akor, the name of a place in Palestine: - Achor.

H5912.full: From an unused root meaning to trouble; troublesome; Akan, an Israelite: - Achan. Compare H5917.

H5913.full: A primitive root; properly to tie, specifically with fetters; but used only as denominative from H5914; to put on anklets: - make a tinkling ornament.

H5914.full: From H5913; a fetter; hence an anklet: - stocks, tinkling ornament.

H5915.full: Feminine of H5914; anklet; Aksah, an Israelitess: - Achsah.

H5916.full: A primitive root; properly to roil water; figuratively to disturb or afflict: - trouble, stir.

H5917.full: From H5916; troublesome; Akar, an Israelite: - Achar. Compare H5912.

H5918.full: From H5916; muddler; Okran, an Israelite: - Ocran.

H5919.full: Probably from an unused root meaning to coil; an asp (from lurking coiled up): - adder.

H5920.full: From H5927; properly the top; specifically the Highest (that is, God); also (adverbially) aloft, to Jehovah: - above, high, most High.

H5921.firstSense: above, according to (-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, X as, at, because of, besid…
H5921.full: Properly the same as H5920 used as a preposition (in the singular or plural, often with prefix, or as conjugation with a particle following); above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications: - above, according to (-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, X as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, X both and, by (reason of), X had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through (-out), to, touching, X with.

H5922.firstSense: about, against, concerning, for, [there-] fore, from, in, X more, of, (there-, up-) on,…
H5922.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5921: - about, against, concerning, for, [there-] fore, from, in, X more, of, (there-, up-) on, (in-) to, + why with.

H5923.full: From H5953; a yoke (as imposed on the neck), literally or figuratively: - yoke.

H5925.full: Feminine of H5923; burden; Ulla, an Israelite: - Ulla.

H5926.full: From an unused root meaning to stutter; stuttering: - stammerer.

H5927.full: A primitive root; to ascend, intransitively (be high) or active (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literally and figuratively: - arise (up). (cause to) ascend up, at once, break [the day] (up), bring (up), (cause to) burn, carry up, cast up, + shew, climb (up), (cause to, make to) come (up), cut off, dawn, depart, exalt, excel, fall, fetch up, get up, (make to) go (away, up), grow (over), increase, lay, leap, levy, lift (self) up, light, [make] up, X mention, mount up, offer, make to pay, + perfect, prefer, put (on), raise, recover, restore, (make to) rise (up), scale, set (up), shoot forth (up), (begin to) spring (up), stir up, take away (up), work.

H5928.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5930; a holocaust: - burnt offering.

H5929.full: From H5927; a leaf (as coming up on a tree); collectively foliage: - branch, leaf.

H5930.firstSense: ascent, burnt offering (sacrifice), go up to
H5930.full: Feminine active participle of H5927; a step or (collectively stairs, as ascending); usually a holocaust (as going up in smoke): - ascent, burnt offering (sacrifice), go up to. See also H5766.

H5931.full: (Chaldee); feminine from a root corresponding to H5927; a pretext (as arising artificially): - occasion.

H5933.full: The same as H5932; Alvah or Aljah, an Idumaean: - Aliah, Alvah.

H5934.full: Passive participle of H5956 in the denominative sense of H5958; (only in plural as abstraction) adolescence; figuratively vigor: - youth.

H5935.full: From H5927; lofty; Alvan or Aljan, an Idumaean: - Alian, Alvan.

H5936.full: Feminine passive participle of an unused root meaning to suck; the leech: - horse-leech.

H5937.full: A primitive root; to jump for joy, that is, exult: - be joyful, rejoice, triumph.

H5939.full: Feminine from an unused root meaning to cover; dusk: - dark, twilight.

H5940.full: From H5927; a pestle (as lifted): - pestle.

H5941.full: From H5927; lofty; Eli, an Israelitish high priest: - Eli.

H5942.full: From H5927; high, that is, comparatively: - upper.

H5943.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5942; supreme (that is, God): - (most) high.

H5944.firstSense: ascent, (upper) chamber, going up, loft, parlour
H5944.full: Feminine from H5927; something lofty, that is, a stair way; also a second story room (or even one on the roof); figuratively the sky: - ascent, (upper) chamber, going up, loft, parlour.

H5945.full: From H5927; an elevation, that is, (adjectively) lofty (comparatively); as title, the Supreme: - (Most, on) high (-er, -est), upper (-most).

H5946.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5945; the supreme: - Most high.

H5948.full: From H5953 in the sense of completing; probably a crucible (as working over the metal): - furnace.

H5949.firstSense: act (-ion), deed, doing, invention, occasion, work
H5949.full: From H5953 in the sense of effecting; an exploit (of God), or a performance (of man, often in a bad sense); by implication an opportunity: - act (-ion), deed, doing, invention, occasion, work.

H5952.full: From H5927; a second story room: - chamber. Compare H5944.

H5953.firstSense: abuse, affect, X child, defile, do, glean, mock, practise, throughly, work (wonderfully)
H5953.full: A primitive root; to effect thoroughly; specifically to glean (also figuratively); by implication (in a bad sense) to overdo, that is, maltreat, be saucy to, pain, impose (also literally): - abuse, affect, X child, defile, do, glean, mock, practise, throughly, work (wonderfully).

H5954.firstSense: bring in, come in, go in
H5954.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5953 (in the sense of thrusting oneself in), to enter; causatively to introduce: - bring in, come in, go in.

H5955.full: Feminine active participle of H5953; only in plural gleanings; by extension gleaning time: - (gleaning) (of the) grapes,grapegleanings.

H5956.firstSense: X any ways, blind, dissembler, hide (self), secret (thing)
H5956.full: A primitive root; to veil from sight, that is, conceal (literally or figuratively): - X any ways, blind, dissembler, hide (self), secret (thing).

H5957.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5769; remote time, that is, the future or past indefinitely; often adverbially forever: - for([n-]) ever (lasting), old.

H5958.full: From H5956; properly something kept out of sight (compare H5959), that is, a lad: - young man, stripling.

H5959.full: Feminine of H5958; a lass (as veiled or private): - damsel, maid, virgin.

H5960.full: From H5956; hidden; Almon, a place in Palestine: - See also H5963.

H5961.full: Plural of H5959; properly girls, that is, the soprano or female voice, perhaps falsetto: - Alamoth.

H5962.full: (Chaldee); patrial from a name corresponding to H5867 contracted; an Elamite or inhabitant of Elam: - Elamite.

H5963.full: From the same as H5960 and the dual of H1690 (compare H1015) with enclitic of direction; Almon towards Diblathajim; Almon Diblathajemah, a place in Moab: - Almon-diblathaim.

H5964.full: From H5956; a covering; Alemeth, the name of a place in Palestine and two Israelites: - Alameth, Alemeth.

H5965.full: A primitive root; to leap for joy, that is, exult, wave joyously: - X peacock, rejoice, solace self.

H5966.full: A primitive root; to sip up: - suck up.

H5967.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H6763; a rib: - rib.

H5968.full: A primitive root; to veil or cover; figuratively to be languid: - faint, overlaid, wrap self.

H5969.full: From H5968; an envelope, that is, (figuratively) mourning: - fainted.

H5970.full: A primitive root; to jump for joy, that is, exult: - be joyful, rejoice, triumph.

H5971.full: From H6004; a people (as a congregated unit); specifically a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively a flock: - folk, men, nation, people.

H5973.firstSense: accompanying, against, and, as (X long as), before, beside, by (reason of), for all, fr…
H5973.full: From H6004; adverb or preposition, with (that is, in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English): - accompanying, against, and, as (X long as), before, beside, by (reason of), for all, from (among, between), in, like, more than, of, (un-) to, with (-al).

H5974.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5973: - by, from, like, to (-ward), with.

H5975.firstSense: abide (behind), appoint, arise, cease, confirm, continue, dwell, be employed, endure, e…
H5975.full: A primitive root; to stand, in various relations (literally and figuratively, intransitively and transitively): - abide (behind), appoint, arise, cease, confirm, continue, dwell, be employed, endure, establish, leave, make, ordain, be [over], place, (be) present (self), raise up, remain, repair, + serve, set (forth, over, -tle, up), (make to, make to be at a, with-) stand (by, fast, firm, still, up), (be at a) stay (up), tarry.

H5976.full: From H4571; to shake: - be at a stand.

H5977.full: From H5975; a spot (as being fixed): - place, (+ where) stood, upright.

H5978.firstSense: against, by, from, in, + me, + mine, of, + that I take, unto, upon, with (-n)
H5978.full: Prolonged for H5973; along with: - against, by, from, in, + me, + mine, of, + that I take, unto, upon, with (-n).

H5979.full: From H5975; a station, that is, domicile: - standing.

H5980.firstSense: (over) against, at, beside, hard by, in points
H5980.full: From H6004; conjunction, that is, society; mostly adverbial or prepositional (with prepositional prefix), near, beside, along with: - (over) against, at, beside, hard by, in points.

H5981.full: The same as H5980; association; Ummah, a place in Palestine: - Ummah.

H5982.full: From H5975; a column (as standing); also a stand, that is, platform: - X apiece, pillar.

H5983.full: From H5971; tribal, that is, inbred; Ammon, a son of Lot; also his posterity and their country: - Ammon, Ammonites.

H5984.full: Patronymic from H5983; an Ammonite or (adjectively) Ammonitish: - Ammonite (-s).

H5985.full: Feminine of H5984; an Ammonitess: - Ammonite (-ss).

H5986.full: From H6006; burdensome; Amos, an Israelitish prophet: - Amos.

H5987.full: From H6009; deep; Amok, an Israelite: - Amok.

H5988.full: From H5971 and H410; people of God; Ammiel, the name of three or four Israelites: - Ammiel.

H5989.full: From H5971 and H1935; people of splendor; Ammihud, the name of three Israelites: - Ammihud.

H5990.full: From H5971 and H2064; people of endowment; Ammizabad, an Israelite: - Ammizabad.

H5991.full: From H5971 and H2353; people of nobility; Ammichur, a Syrian prince: - Ammihud [from the margin].

H5992.full: From H5971 and H5068; people of liberality; Amminadab, the name of four Israelites: - Amminadab.

H5993.full: From H5971 and H5081; my people (is) liberal; Amminadib, probably an Israelite: - Amminadib.

H5994.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H6012; profound, that is, unsearchable: - deep.

H5995.full: From H6014; a bunch of grain: - handful, sheaf.

H5996.full: From H5971 and H7706; people of (the) Almighty; Ammishaddai, an Israelite: - Ammishaddai.

H5997.full: From a primitive root meaning to associate; companionship; hence (concretely) a comrade or kindred man: - another, fellow, neighbour.

H5998.full: A primitive root; to toil, that is, work severely and with irksomeness: - [take] labour (in).

H5999.firstSense: grievance (-vousness), iniquity, labour, mischief, miserable (-sery), pain (-ful), perv…
H5999.full: From H5998; toil, that is, wearing effort; hence worry, whether of body or mind: - grievance (-vousness), iniquity, labour, mischief, miserable (-sery), pain (-ful), perverseness, sorrow, toil, travail, trouble, wearisome, wickedness.

H6000.full: The same as H5999; Amal, an Israelite: - Amal.

H6001.firstSense: that laboureth, that is a misery, had taken [labour], wicked, workman
H6001.full: From H5998; toiling; concretely a laborer; figuratively sorrowful: - that laboureth, that is a misery, had taken [labour], wicked, workman.

H6002.full: Probably of foreign origin; Amalek, a descendant of Esau; also his posterity and their country: - Amalek.

H6003.full: Patronymic from H6002; an Amalekite (or collectively the Amalekites) or descendant of Amalek: - Amalekite (-s).

H6004.full: A primitive root; to associate; by implication to overshadow (by huddling together): - become dim, hide.

H6005.full: From H5973 and H410 with suffix pronoun inserted; with us (is) God; Immanuel, a name of Isaiah's son: - Immanuel.

H6006.firstSense: be borne, (heavy) burden (self), lade, load, put
H6006.full: A primitive root; to load, that is, impose a burden (or figuratively infliction): - be borne, (heavy) burden (self), lade, load, put.

H6007.full: From H6006 and H3050; Jah has loaded; Amasjah, an Israelite: - Amasiah.

H6008.full: From H5971 and H5703; people of time; Amad, a place in Palestine: - Amad.

H6009.firstSense: (be, have, make, seek) deep (-ly), depth, be profound
H6009.full: A primitive root; to be (causatively make) deep (literally or figuratively): - (be, have, make, seek) deep (-ly), depth, be profound.

H6010.firstSense: dale, vale, valley [often used as a part of proper names]
H6010.full: From H6009; a vale (that is, broad depression).: - dale, vale, valley [often used as a part of proper names]. See also H1025.

H6012.full: From H6009; deep (literally or figuratively): - deeper, depth, strange.

H6013.full: From H6009; deep (literally or figuratively): - (X exceeding) deep (thing)

H6014.full: A primitive root; properly apparently to heap; figuratively to chastise (as if piling blows); specifically (as denominative from H6016) to gather grain: - bind sheaves, make merchandise of.

H6016.full: From H6014; properly a heap, that is, a sheaf; also an omer, as a dry measure: - omer, sheaf.

H6017.full: From H6014; a (ruined) heap; Amorah, a place in Palestine: - Gomorrah.

H6018.full: From H6014; heaping; Omri, an Israelite: - Omri.

H6019.full: Probably from H5971 and H7311; high people; Amram, the name of two Israelites: - Amram.

H6020.full: Patronymic from H6019; an Amramite or descendant of Amram: - Amramite.

H6021.full: From H6006; burden; Amasa, the name of two Israelites: - Amasa.

H6022.full: From H6006; burdensome; Amasai, the name of three Israelites: - Amasai.

H6023.full: Probably form H6006; burdensome; Amashsay, an Israelite: - Amashai.

H6024.full: From the same as H6025; fruit; Anab, a place in Palestine: - Anab.

H6025.full: From an unused root probably meaning to bear fruit; a grape: - (ripe) grape, wine.

H6026.full: A primitive root; to be soft or pliable, that is, (figuratively) effeminate or luxurious: - delicate (-ness), (have) delight (self), sport self.

H6029.full: A primitive root; ot lace fast: - bind, tie.

H6030.firstSense: give account, afflict [by mistake for H6031], (cause to, give) answer, bring low [by mi…
H6030.full: A primitive root; properly to eye or (generally) to heed, that is, pay attention; by implication to respond; by extension to begin to speak; specifically to sing, shout, testify, announce: - give account, afflict [by mistake for H6031], (cause to, give) answer, bring low [by mistake for H6031], cry, hear, Leannoth, lift up, say, X scholar, (give a) shout, sing (together by course), speak, testify, utter, (bear) witness. See also H1042, H1043.

H6031.firstSense: abase self, afflict (-ion, self), answer [by mistake for H6030], chasten self, deal har…
H6031.full: A primitive root (possibly rather identical with H6030 through the idea of looking down or browbeating); to depress literally or figuratively, transitively or intransitively (in various applications). (sing is by mistake for H6030.): - abase self, afflict (-ion, self), answer [by mistake for H6030], chasten self, deal hardly with, defile, exercise, force, gentleness, humble (self), hurt, ravish, sing [by mistake for H6030], speak [by mistake for H6030], submit self, weaken, X in any wise.

H6034.full: Probably form H6030; an answer; Anah, the name of two Edomites and one Edomitess: - Anah.

H6035.full: The second form is by intermixture with H6041; from H6031; depressed (figuratively), in mind (gentle) or circumstances (needy, especially saintly): - humble, lowly, meek, poor`. Compare H6041.

H6036.full: Passive participle from the same as H6025; borne (as fruit); Anub, an Israelite: - Anub.

H6037.full: Feminine of H6035; mildness (royal); also (concretely) oppressed: - gentleness, meekness.

H6038.full: From H6035; condescension, human and subjective (modesty), or divine and objective (clemency): - gentleness, humility, meekness.

H6040.full: From H6031; depression, that is, misery: - afflicted (-ion), trouble.

H6041.full: From H6031; depressed, in mind or circumstances (practically the same as H6035 subjectively and H6041 objectively): - afflicted, humble`, lowly`, needy, poor.

H6042.full: From H6031; afflicted; Unni, the name of two Israelites: - Unni.

H6043.full: From H6030; Jah has answered; Anajah, the name of two Israelites: - Anaiah.

H6044.full: For the plural of H5869; fountains; Anim, a place in Palestine: - Anim.

H6045.full: From H6031; ado, that is, (generally) employment or (specifically) an affair: - business, travail.

H6046.full: From the dual of H5869; two fountains; Anem, a place in Palestine: - Anem.

H6047.full: As if plural of some Egyptian word; Anamim, a son of Mizraim and his descendants, with their country: - Anamim.

H6048.full: Of foreign origin; Anammelek, an Assyrian deity: - Anammelech.

H6049.firstSense: X bring, enchanter, Meonemin, observe (-r of) times, soothsayer, sorcerer
H6049.full: A primitive root; to cover; used only as denominative from H6051, to cloud over; figuratively to act covertly, that is, practise magic: - X bring, enchanter, Meonemin, observe (-r of) times, soothsayer, sorcerer.

H6051.full: From H6049; a cloud (as covering the sky), that is, the nimbus or thunder cloud: - cloud (-y).

H6052.full: The same as H6051; cloud; Anan, an Israelite: - Anan.

H6054.full: From H6051; cloudy; Anani, an Israelite: - Anani.

H6055.full: From H6049 and H3050; Jah has covered; Ananjah, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine: - Ananiah.

H6057.full: From an unused root meaning to cover; a twig (as covering the limbs): - bough, branch.

H6058.full: From the same as H6057; branching: - full of branches.

H6059.firstSense: compass about as a chain, furnish, liberally
H6059.full: A primitive root; properly to choke; used only as denominative from H6060, to collar, that is, adorn with a necklace; figuratively to fit out with supplies: - compass about as a chain, furnish, liberally.

H6060.full: From H6059; a necklace (as if strangling): - chain.

H6061.full: The same as H6060; Anak, a Canaanite: - Anak.

H6062.full: Patronymic from H6061; an Anakite or descendant of Anak: - Anakim.

H6063.full: Probably for H5288; Aner, an Amorite, also a place in Palestine: - Aner.

H6064.full: A primitive root; properly to urge; by implication to inflict a penalty, specifically to fine: - amerce, condemn, punish, X surely.

H6065.full: H1 (Chaldee); coresp. to H6066; a mulct: - confiscation.

H6066.full: From H6064; a fine: - punishment, tribute.

H6067.full: From H6030; answer; Anath, an Israelite: - Anath.

H6068.full: Plural of H6067; Anathoth, the name of two Israelites, also of a place in Palestine: - Anathoth.

H6069.full: Patrial from H6068; an Antothite or inhabitant of Anathoth: - of Anathoth, Anethothite, Anetothite, Antothite.

H6070.full: From the same as H6068 and H3050; answers of Jah; Anthothijah, an Israelite: - Antothijah.

H6071.full: From H6072; must or fresh grape juice (as just trodden out): - juice, new (sweet) wine.

H6072.full: A primitive root; to squeeze out juice; figuratively to trample: - tread down.

H6073.full: From an unused root meaning to cover; a bough (as covering the tree): - branch.

H6074.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H6073; a twig; bough, that is, (collectively) foliage: - leaves.

H6075.full: A primitive root; to swell; figuratively be elated: - be lifted up, presume.

H6076.full: From H6075; a turior; also a mound, that is, fortress: - emerod, fort, strong hold, tower.

H6077.full: The same as H6076; Ophel, a ridge in Jerusalem: - Ophel.

H6078.full: From an unused noun (denoting a place in Palestine; from an unused root of uncertain meaning); an Ophnite (collectively) or inhabitant of Ophen: - Ophni.

H6079.full: From H5774; an eyelash (as fluttering); figuratively morning ray: - dawning, eye-lid.

H6080.full: A primitive root; meaning either to be gray or perhaps rather to pulverize; used only as denominative from H6083, to be dust: - cast [dust].

H6081.full: Probably a variation of H6082; gazelle; Epher, the name of an Arabian and of two Israelites: - Epher.

H6082.full: From H6080; a fawn (from the dusty color): - young roe [hart].

H6083.firstSense: ashes, dust, earth, ground, morter, powder, rubbish
H6083.full: From H6080; dust (as powdered or gray); hence clay, earth, mud: - ashes, dust, earth, ground, morter, powder, rubbish.

H6084.full: Feminine of H6082; female fawn; Ophrah, the name of an Israelite and of two places in Palestine: - Ophrah.

H6085.full: From the same as H6081; fawn like; Ephron, the name of a Canaanite and of two places in Palestine: - Ephron, Ephrain [from the margin].

H6086.firstSense: + carpenter, gallows, helve, + pine, plank, staff, stalk, stick, stock, timber, tree, wood
H6086.full: From H6095; a tree (from its firmness); hence wood (plural sticks): - + carpenter, gallows, helve, + pine, plank, staff, stalk, stick, stock, timber, tree, wood.

H6087.firstSense: displease, grieve, hurt, make, be sorry, vex, worship, wrest
H6087.full: A primitive root; properly to carve, that is, fabricate or fashion; hence (in a bad sense) to worry, pain or anger: - displease, grieve, hurt, make, be sorry, vex, worship, wrest.

H6088.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H6087; to afflict: - lamentable.

H6089.full: From H6087; an earthen vessel; usually (painful) toil; also a pang (whether of body or mind): - grievous, idol, labor, sorrow.

H6090.full: A variation of H6089; an idol (as fashioned); also pain (bodily or mental): - idol, sorrow, X wicked.

H6091.full: From H6087; an (idolatrous) image: - idol, image.

H6093.full: From H6087; worrisomeness, that is, labor or pain: - sorrow, toil.

H6094.full: From H6087; an idol; also a pain or wound: - sorrow, wound.

H6095.full: A primitive root; properly to fasten (or make firm), that is, to close (the eyes): - shut.

H6096.full: From H6095; the spine (as giving firmness to the body): - back bone.

H6098.full: From H3289; advice; by implication plan; also prudence: - advice, advisement, counsel ([-lor]), purpose.

H6099.full: Passive participle of H6105; powerful (specifically a paw); by implication numerous: - + feeble, great, mighty, must, strong.

H6100.full: From H6096 and H1397; backbone like of a man; Etsjon-Geber, a place on the Red Sea: - Ezion-gaber, Ezion-geber.

H6101.full: A primitive root; to lean idly, that is, to be indolent or slack: - be slothful.

H6103.full: Feminine of H6102; (as abstraction) indolence: - slothfulness.

H6105.firstSense: break the bones, close, be great, be increased, be (wax) mighty (-ier), be more, shut,…
H6105.full: A primitive root; to bind fast, that is, close (the eyes); intransitively to be (causatively make) powerful or numerous; denominatively (from H6106) to crunch the bones: - break the bones, close, be great, be increased, be (wax) mighty (-ier), be more, shut, be (-come, make) strong (-er).

H6106.firstSense: body, bone, X life, (self-) same, strength, X very
H6106.full: From H6105; a bone (as strong); by extension the body; figuratively the substance, that is, (as pronoun) selfsame: - body, bone, X life, (self-) same, strength, X very.

H6107.full: The same as H6106; bone; Etsem, a place in Palestine: - Azem, Ezem.

H6108.full: From H6105; power; hence body: - might, strong, substance.

H6109.full: Feminine of H6108; powerfulness; by extension numerousness: - abundance, strength.

H6110.full: Feminine of H6099; a bulwark, that is, (figuratively) argument: - strong.

H6111.full: From H6107; bone like; Atsmon, a place near Palestine: - Azmon.

H6112.full: From an unused root meaning to be sharp or strong; a spear: - Eznite [from the margin].

H6113.firstSense: X be able, close up, detain, fast, keep (self close, still), prevail, recover, refrain,…
H6113.full: A primitive root; to inclose; by analogy to hold back; also to maintain, rule, assemble: - X be able, close up, detain, fast, keep (self close, still), prevail, recover, refrain, X reign, restrain, retain, shut (up), slack, stay, stop, withhold (self).

H6115.full: From H6113; closure; also constraint: - X barren, oppression, X prison.

H6116.full: From H6113; an assembly, especially on a festival or holiday: - (solemn) assembly (meeting).

H6117.firstSense: take by the heel, stay, supplant, X utterly
H6117.full: A primitive root; properly to swell out or up; used only as denominative from H6119, to seize by the heel; figuratively to circumvent (as if tripping up the heels); also to restrain (as if holding by the heel): - take by the heel, stay, supplant, X utterly.

H6118.firstSense: X because, by, end, for, if, reward
H6118.full: From H6117 in the sense of H6119; a heel, that is, (figuratively) the last of anything (used adverbially for ever); also result, that is, compensation; and so (adverbially with preposition or relatively) on account of: - X because, by, end, for, if, reward.

H6119.firstSense: heel, [horse-] hoof, last, lier in wait [by mistake for H6120], (foot-) step
H6119.full: From H6117; a heel (as protuberant); hence a track; figuratively the rear (of an army). (lier in wait is by mistake for H6120.): - heel, [horse-] hoof, last, lier in wait [by mistake for H6120], (foot-) step.

H6120.full: From H6117 in its denominative sense; a lier in wait. (heel is by mistake for H6119.): - heel [by mistake for H6119].

H6121.full: From H6117; in the original sense, a knoll (as swelling up); in the denominative sense (transitively) fraudulent or (intransitively) tracked: - crooked, deceitful, polluted.

H6122.full: Feminine of an unused form from H6117 meaning a trick; trickery: - subtilty.

H6123.full: A primitive root; to tie with thongs: - bind.

H6124.full: From H6123; striped (with bands): - ring straked.

H6126.full: From H6117; insidious; Akkub, the name of five Israelites: - Akkub.

H6127.full: A primitive root; to wrest: - wrong.

H6128.full: From H6127; winding: - by [-way], crooked way.

H6130.full: From an unused root meaning to twist; tortuous; Akan, an Idumaean: - Akan. Compare H3292.

H6131.firstSense: dig down, hough, pluck up, root up
H6131.full: A primitive root; to pluck up (especially by the roots); specifically to hamstring; figuratively to exterminate: - dig down, hough, pluck up, root up.

H6132.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H6131: - pluck up by the roots.

H6133.full: From H6131; figuratively a transplanted person, that is, naturalized citizen: - stock.

H6134.full: The same as H6133; Eker, an Israelite: - Eker.

H6135.full: From H6131; sterile (as if extirpated in the generative organs): - (X male or female) barren (woman).

H6137.full: Of uncertain derivation; a scorpion; figuratively a scourge or knotted whip: - scorpion.

H6138.full: From H6131; eradication; Ekron, a place in Palestine: - Ekron.

H6139.full: Patrial from H6138; an Ekronite or inhabitant of Ekron: - Ekronite.

H6140.full: A primitive root; to knot or distort; figuratively to pervert (act or declare perverse): - make crooked, (prove, that is) perverse (-rt).

H6141.full: From H6140; distorted; hence false: - crooked, froward, perverse.

H6142.full: The same as H6141; perverse; Ikkesh, an Israelite: - Ikkesh.

H6144.full: The same as H5892; a city; Ar, a place in Moab: - Ar.

H6145.full: From H5782; a foe (as watchful for mischief): - enemy.

H6147.full: From H5782; watchful; Er, the name of two Israelites: - Er.

H6148.firstSense: engage, (inter-) meddle (with), mingle (self), mortgage, occupy, give pledges, be (-com…
H6148.full: A primitive root; to braid, that is, intermix; technically to traffic (as if by barter); also to give or be security (as a kind of exchange): - engage, (inter-) meddle (with), mingle (self), mortgage, occupy, give pledges, be (-come, put in) surety, undertake.

H6149.firstSense: be pleasant (-ing), take pleasure in, be sweet
H6149.full: A primitive root (rather identical with H6148 through the idea of close association); to be agreeable: - be pleasant (-ing), take pleasure in, be sweet.

H6150.full: A primitive root (rather identical with H6148 through the idea of covering with a texture); to grow dusky at sundown: - be darkened, (toward) evening.

H6151.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H6148; to commingle: - mingle (self), mix.

H6152.full: From H6150 in the figuratively sense of sterility; Arab (that is, Arabia), a country East of Palestine: - Arabia.

H6153.full: From H6150; dusk: - + day, even (-ing, tide), night.

H6154.full: The second form used in 1Ki_10:15 with the article prefixed); from H6148; the web (or transverse threads of cloth); also a mixture, (or mongrel race): - Arabia, mingled people, mixed (multitude), woof.

H6155.full: From H6148; a willow (from the use of osiers as wattles): - willow.

H6157.full: From H6148; a mosquito (from its swarming): - divers sorts or flies, swarm.

H6158.full: From H6150; a raven (from its dusky hue): - raven.

H6159.full: The same as H6158; Oreb, the name of a Midianite and of a cliff near the Jordan: - Oreb.

H6160.firstSense: Arabah, champaign, desert, evening, heaven, plain, wilderness
H6160.full: From H6150 (in the sense of sterility); a desert; especially (with the article prefixed) the (generally) sterile valley of the Jordan and its continuation to the Red Sea: - Arabah, champaign, desert, evening, heaven, plain, wilderness. See also H1026.

H6161.full: Feminine passive participle of H6048 in the sense of a bargain or exchange; something given as security, that is, (literally) a token (of safety) or (metaphorically) a bondsman: - pledge, surety.

H6162.full: From H6148 (in the sense of exchange); a pawn (given as security): - pledge.

H6163.full: Patrial from H6152; an Arabian or inhabitant of Arab (that is, Arabia): - Arabian.

H6164.full: Patrial from H1026; an Arbathite or inhabitant of (Beth-) Arabah: - Arbathite.

H6165.full: A primitive root; to long for: - cry, pant.

H6166.full: From an unused root meaning to sequester itself; fugitive; Arad, the name of a place near Palestine, also of a Canaanite and an Israelite: - Arad.

H6167.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H6171; an onager: - wild ass.

H6168.firstSense: leave destitute, discover, empty, make naked, pour (out), rase, spread self, uncover
H6168.full: A primitive root; to be (causatively make) bare; hence to empty, pour out, demolish: - leave destitute, discover, empty, make naked, pour (out), rase, spread self, uncover.

H6169.full: Feminine from H6168; a naked (that is, level) plot: - paper reed.

H6170.full: Feminine passive participle of H6165; something piled up (as if (figuratively) raised by mental aspiration), that is, a parterre: - bed, furrow.

H6171.full: From the same as H6166; an onager (from his lonesome habits): - wild ass.

H6172.full: From H6168; nudity, literally (especially the pudenda) or figuratively (disgrace, blemish): - nakedness, shame, unclean (-ness).

H6173.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H6172; nakedness, that is, (figuratively) impoverishment: - dishonour.

H6174.full: From H6191 (in its original sense); nude, either partially or totally: - naked.

H6175.full: Passive participle of H6191; cunning (usually in a bad sense): - crafty, prudent, subtil.

H6176.full: From H6209 reduplicated; a juniper (from its nudity of situation): - heath.

H6177.full: The same as H6176; nudity of situation; Aroer, the name of three places in or near Palestine: - Aroer.

H6178.full: Passive participle of H6206; feared, that is, (concretely) a horrible place or chasm: - cliffs.

H6179.full: From H5782; watchful; Eri, an Israelite: - Eri.

H6180.full: Patronymic of H6179; an Erite (collectively) or descendant of Eri: - Erites.

H6181.full: For H6172; nudity: - bare, naked, X quite.

H6182.full: From an unused root meaning to comminute; meal: - dough.

H6183.full: From H6201; the sky (as drooping at the horizon): - heaven.

H6184.firstSense: mighty, oppressor, in great power, strong, terrible, violent
H6184.full: From H6206; fearful, that is, powerful or tyrannical: - mighty, oppressor, in great power, strong, terrible, violent.

H6185.full: From H6209; bare, that is, destitute (of children): - childless.

H6186.firstSense: put (set) (the battle, self) in array, compare, direct, equal, esteem, estimate, expert…
H6186.full: A primitive root; to set in a row, that is, arrange, put in order (in a very wide variety of applications): - put (set) (the battle, self) in array, compare, direct, equal, esteem, estimate, expert [in war], furnish, handle, join [battle], ordain, (lay, put, reckon up, set) (in) order, prepare, tax, value.

H6187.firstSense: equal, estimation, (things that are set in) order, price, proportion, X set at, suit, t…
H6187.full: From H6186; a pile, equipment, estimate: - equal, estimation, (things that are set in) order, price, proportion, X set at, suit, taxation, X valuest.

H6188.firstSense: count uncircumcised, foreskin to be uncovered
H6188.full: A primitive root; properly to strip; but used only as denominative from H6189; to expose or remove the prepuce, whether literally (to go naked) or figuratively (to refrain from using): - count uncircumcised, foreskin to be uncovered.

H6189.full: From H6188; properly exposed, that is, projecting loose (as to the prepuce); used only technically uncircumcised (that is, still having the prepuce uncurtailed): - uncircumcised (person).

H6190.full: Feminine of H6189; the prepuce: - foreskin, + uncircumcised.

H6191.firstSense: X very, beware, take crafty [counsel], be prudent, deal subtilly
H6191.full: A primitive root; properly to be (or make) bare; but used only in the derived sense (through the idea perhaps of smoothness) bo be cunning (usually in a bad sense): - X very, beware, take crafty [counsel], be prudent, deal subtilly.

H6192.full: A primitive root; to pile up: - gather together.

H6194.full: From H6192; a heap; specifically a sheaf: - heap (of corn), sheaf.

H6195.full: Feminine of H6193; trickery; or (in a good sense) discretion: - guile, prudence, subtilty, wilily, wisdom.

H6196.full: Probably from H6191; the plane tree (from its smooth and shed bark): - chestnut tree.

H6197.full: Probably from H5782; watchful; Eran, an Israelite: - Eran.

H6198.full: Patronymic from H6197; an Eranite or descendant (collectively) of Eran: - Eranites.

H6199.full: From H6209; naked, that is, (figuratively) poor: - destitute. See also H6176.

H6200.full: Patronymic from H6177; an Aroerite or inhabitant of Aroer: - Aroerite.

H6201.full: A primitive root; to droop; hence to drip: - drop (down).

H6202.firstSense: that is beheaded, break down, break (cut off, strike off) neck
H6202.full: A primitive root (rather identical with H6201 through the idea of sloping); properly to bend downward; but used only as a denominative from H6203, to break the neck; hence (figuratively) to destroy: - that is beheaded, break down, break (cut off, strike off) neck.

H6203.full: From H6202; the nape or back of the neck (as declining); hence the back generally (whether literally or figuratively): - back ([stiff-]) neck ([-ed]).

H6204.full: Feminine of H6203; mane; Orpah, a Moabitess: - Orpah.

H6205.full: Probably from H6201; gloom (as of a lowering sky): - (gross, thick) dark (cloud, -ness).

H6206.firstSense: be affrighted (afraid, dread, feared, terrified), break, dread, fear, oppress, prevail,…
H6206.full: A primitive root; to awe or (intransitively) to dread; hence to harass: - be affrighted (afraid, dread, feared, terrified), break, dread, fear, oppress, prevail, shake terribly.

H6207.full: A primitive root; to gnaw, that is, (figuratively) eat (by hyberbole); also (participle) a pain: - fleeing, sinew.

H6208.full: Patrial from an unused name meaning a tush; an Arkite or inhabitant of Erek: - Arkite.

H6209.firstSense: make bare, break, raise up [perhaps by clerical error for raze], X utterly
H6209.full: A primitive root; to bare; figuratively to demolish: - make bare, break, raise up [perhaps by clerical error for raze], X utterly.

H6210.full: From an unused root meaning perhaps to arch; a couch (properly with a canopy): - bed (-stead), couch.

H6211.full: From H6244; a moth: - moth. (The second form is Chaldee, from H6212 and is translated grass)

H6212.full: From an unused root meaning to glisten (or be green); grass (or any tender shoot): - grass, herb.

H6213.firstSense: accomplish, advance, appoint, apt, be at, become, bear, bestow, bring forth, bruise, be…
H6213.full: A primitive root; to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application: - accomplish, advance, appoint, apt, be at, become, bear, bestow, bring forth, bruise, be busy, X certainly, have the charge of, commit, deal (with), deck, + displease, do, (ready) dress (-ed), (put in) execute (-ion), exercise, fashion, + feast, [fight-] ing man, + finish, fit, fly, follow, fulfil, furnish, gather, get, go about, govern, grant, great, + hinder, hold ([a feast]), X indeed, + be industrious, + journey, keep, labour, maintain, make, be meet, observe, be occupied, offer, + officer, pare, bring (come) to pass, perform, practise, prepare, procure, provide, put, requite, X sacrifice, serve, set, shew, X sin, spend, X surely, take, X thoroughly, trim, X very, + vex, be [warr-] ior, work (-man), yield, use.

H6214.full: From H6213 and H410; God has made; Asahel, the name of four Israelites: - Asahel.

H6215.full: Apparently a form of the passive participle of H6213 in the original sense of handling; rough (that is, sensibly felt); Esav, a son of Isaac, including his posterity: - Esau.

H6216.full: From H6231; oppressive (as noun, a tyrant): - oppressor.

H6217.full: Passive participle of H6231; used in plural masculine as abstraction tyranny: - oppressed (-ion). [Doubtful.]

H6218.full: From H6235; ten; by abbreviation ten strings, and so a decachord: - (instrument of) ten (strings, -th).

H6219.full: From H6245; shining, that is, polished: - bright.

H6220.full: ash-vawth'For H6219; bright; Ashvath, an Israelite: - Ashvath.

H6221.full: From H6213 and H410; made of God; Asiel, an Israelite: - Asiel.

H6222.full: From H6213 and H3050; Jah has made; Asajah, the name of three or four Israelites: - Asaiah.

H6223.full: From H6238; rich, whether literally or figuratively (noble): - rich (man)

H6224.full: From H6235; tenth; by abbreviation tenth month or (feminine) part: - tenth (participle).

H6225.full: A primitive root; to smoke, whether literally or figuratively: - be angry (be on a) smoke.

H6227.full: From H6225; smoke, literally or figuratively (vapor, dust, anger): - smoke (-ing).

H6228.full: The same as H6227; Ashan, a place in Palestine: - Ashan.

H6229.full: A primitive root (identical with H6231); to press upon, that is, quarrel: - strive with.

H6231.firstSense: get deceitfully, deceive, defraud, drink up, (use) oppress ([-ion], -or), do violence (…
H6231.full: A primitive root (compare H6229); to press upon, that is, oopress, defraud, violate, overflow: - get deceitfully, deceive, defraud, drink up, (use) oppress ([-ion], -or), do violence (wrong).

H6232.full: From H6231; oppression; Eshek, an Israelite: - Eshek.

H6233.full: From H6231; injury, fraud, (subjectively) distress, (concretely) unjust gain: - cruelly, extortion, oppression, thing [deceitfully gotten].

H6235.full: From H6237; ten (as an accumulation to the extent of the digits): - ten, [fif-, seven-] teen.

H6236.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H6235; ten: - ten, + twelve.

H6237.firstSense: X surely, give (take) the tenth, (have, take) tithe (-ing, -s), X truly
H6237.full: A primitive root (identical with H6238); to accumulate; but used only as denominative from H6235; to tithe, that is, take or give a tenth: - X surely, give (take) the tenth, (have, take) tithe (-ing, -s), X truly.

H6238.firstSense: be (-come, en-, make, make self, wax) rich, make [H1 Kings H22 : H48 margin]
H6238.full: A primitive root; properly to accumulate; chiefly (specifically) to grow (causatively make) rich: - be (-come, en-, make, make self, wax) rich, make [H1 Kings H22 : H48 margin]. See H6240.

H6239.full: From H6238; wealth: - X far [richer], riches.

H6240.firstSense: [eigh-, fif-, four-, nine-, seven-, six-, thir-] teen (-th), + eleven (-th), + sixscore…
H6240.full: For H6235; ten (only in combination), that is, the "teens"; also (ordinal) a "teenth": - [eigh-, fif-, four-, nine-, seven-, six-, thir-] teen (-th), + eleven (-th), + sixscore thousand, + twelve (-th).

H6241.full: From H6235; (fractional) a tenth part: - tenth deal.

H6242.full: From H6235; twenty; also (ordinal) twentieth: - [six-] score, twenty (-ieth).

H6244.full: A primitive root; probably to shrink, that is, fail: - be consumed.

H6245.full: A primitive root; probably to be sleek, that is, glossy; hence (through the idea of polishing) to excogitate (as if forming in the mind): - shine, think.

H6246.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H6245; to purpose: - think.

H6249.full: Apparently masculine plural construction of H6247 in the sense of an after thought; (used only in connection with H6240 in lieu of H259) eleven or (ordinal) eleventh: - + eleven (-th).

H6252.full: Plural of H6251; Ashtaroth, the name of a Sidonian deity, and of a place East of the Jordan: - Ashtaroth, Astaroth. See also H1045, H6253, H6255.

H6253.full: Probably for H6251; Ashtoreth, the Phoenician goddess of love (and increase): - Ashtoreth.

H6254.full: Patrial from H6252; an Ashterathite or inhabitant of Ashtaroth: - Ashterathite.

H6255.full: From H6252 and the dual of H7161; Ashtaroth of (the) double horns (a symbol of the deity); Ashteroth Karnaim, a place East of the Jordan: - Ashtoreth Karnaim.

H6256.firstSense: + after, [al-] ways, X certain, + continually, + evening, long, (due) season, so [long]…
H6256.full: From H5703; time, especially (adverbially with preposition) now, when, etc.: - + after, [al-] ways, X certain, + continually, + evening, long, (due) season, so [long] as, [even-, evening-, noon-] tide, ([meal-], what) time, when.

H6257.firstSense: make fit, be ready to become
H6257.full: A primitive root; to prepare: - make fit, be ready to become.

H6258.firstSense: henceforth, now, straightway, this time, whereas
H6258.full: From H6256; at this time, whether adverbial, conjugational or expletive: - henceforth, now, straightway, this time, whereas.

H6259.full: Passive participle of H6257; prepared: - ready, treasures.

H6260.full: From H6257; prepared, that is, full grown; spoken only (in plural) of he goats, or (figuratively) leaders of the people: - chief one, (he) goat, ram.

H6262.full: From H6261; Attai, the name of three Israelites: - Attai.

H6264.firstSense: things that shall come, ready, treasures
H6264.full: From H6257; prepared; by implication skilful; feminine plural the future; also treasure: - things that shall come, ready, treasures.

H6265.full: From H5790 and H3050; Jah has helped; Athajah, an Israelite: - Athaiah.

H6266.full: From H6275; properly antique, that is, venerable or splendid: - durable.

H6267.full: From H6275; removed, that is, weaned; also antique: - ancient, drawn.

H6269.full: From an unused root meaning to sojourn; lodging; Athak, a place in Palestine: - Athach.

H6270.full: From an unused root meaning to compress; constringent; Athlai, an Israelite: - Athlai.

H6271.full: From the same as H6270 and H3050; Jah has constrained; Athaljah, the name of an Israelitess and two Israelites: - Athaliah.

H6272.full: A primitive root; probably to glow, that is, (figuratively) be desolated: - be darkened.

H6273.full: From an unused root meaning to force; forcible; Othni, an Israelite: - Othni.

H6274.full: From the same as H6273 and H410; force of God; Othniel, an Israelite: - Othniel.

H6275.firstSense: copy out, leave off, become (wax) old, remove
H6275.full: A primitive root; to remove (intransitively or transitively); figuratively to grow old; specifically to transcribe: - copy out, leave off, become (wax) old, remove.

H6276.full: From H6275; antique, that is, valued: - durable.

H6277.full: From H6275 in the sense of license; impudent: - arrogancy, grievous (hard) things, stiff.

H6278.full: From H6256 and H7011; time of a judge; Eth-Katsin, a place in Palestine. (Formed by including the directive enclitic.): - Ittah-kazin [by includ. directive enclitic].

H6279.full: A primitive root (rather denominative from H6281); to burn incense in worship, that is, intercede (reciprocally listen to prayer): - intreat, (make) pray (-er).

H6280.full: A primitive root; to be (causatively make) abundant: - deceitful, multiply.

H6281.full: From H6280; abundance; Ether, a place in Palestine: - Ether.

H6282.full: From H6280; incense (as increasing to a volume of smoke); hence (from H6279) a worshipper: - suppliant, thick.

H6284.full: A primitive root; to puff, that is, blow away: - scatter into corners.

H6285.full: Feminine of H6311; properly mouth in a figurative sense, that is, direction, region, extremity: - corner, end, quarter, side.

H6286.firstSense: beautify, boast self, go over the boughs, glorify (self), glory, vaunt self
