H6286.full: paw-ar' A primitive root; to gleam, that is, (causatively) embellish; figuratively to boast; also to explain (that is, make clear) oneself; denominatively from H6288, to shake a tree: - beautify, boast self, go over the boughs, glorify (self), glory, vaunt self.

H6287.full: peh-ayr' From H6286; an embellishment, that is, fancy head dress: - beauty, bonnet, goodly, ornament, tire.

H6288.full: From H6286; properly ornamentation, that is, (plural) foliage (including the limbs) as bright green: - bough, branch, sprig.

H6289.full: From H6286; properly illuminated, that is, a glow; as noun, a flush (of anxiety): - blackness.

H6290.full: From H6286; ornamental; Paran, a desert of Arabia: - Paran.

H6291.full: pag pag From an unused root meaning to be torpid, that is, crude; an unripe fig: - green fig.

H6292.full: From an unused root meaning to stink; properly fetid, that is, (figuratively) unclean (ceremonially): - abominable (-tion, thing).

H6293.firstSense: come (betwixt), cause to entreat, fall (upon), make intercession, intercessor, intreat,…
H6293.full: A primitive root; to impinge, by accident or violence, or (figuratively) by importunity: - come (betwixt), cause to entreat, fall (upon), make intercession, intercessor, intreat, lay, light [upon], meet (together), pray, reach, run.

H6295.full: From H6294 and H410; accident of God; Pagiel, an Israelite: - Pagiel.

H6296.full: A primitive root; to relax, that is, become exhausted: - be faint.

H6297.full: From H6296; a carcase (as limp), whether of man or beast; figuratively an idolatrous image: - carcase, corpse, dead body.

H6298.full: A primitive root; to come in contact with, whether by accident or violence; figuratively to concur: - meet (with, together).

H6299.firstSense: X at all, deliver, X by any means, ransom, (that are to be, let be) redeem (-ed), rescu…
H6299.full: A primitive root; to sever, that is, ransom; generally to release, preserve: - X at all, deliver, X by any means, ransom, (that are to be, let be) redeem (-ed), rescue, X surely.

H6300.full: ped-ah-ale' From H6299 and H410; God has ransomed; Pedahel, an Israelite: - Pedahel.

H6301.full: From H6299 and H6697; a rock (that is, God) has ransomed; Pedahtsur, an Israelite: - Pedahzur.

H6302.full: Passive participle of H6299; ransomed (and so occuring under H6299); as abstraction (in plural masculine) a ransom: - (that are) to be (that were) redeemed.

H6303.full: From H6299; ransom; Padon, one of the Nethinim: - Padon.

H6304.full: From H6929; distinction; also deliverance: - division, redeem, redemption.

H6305.full: From H6299 and H3050; Jah has ransomed; Pedajah, the name of six Israelites: - Pedaiah.

H6306.full: From H6299; a ransom: - ransom, that were redeemed, redemption.

H6307.full: pad-dawn', pad-dan' ar-awm' From an unused root meaning to extend; a plateau; or the second form which is from the same and H758; the table land of Aram; Paddan or Paddan-Aram, a region of Syria: - Padan, Padan-aram.

H6308.full: A primitive root; to retrieve: - deliver.

H6309.full: From an unused root meaning to be greasy; suet: - fat.

H6310.firstSense: accord (-ing as, -ing to), after, appointment, assent, collar, command (-ment), X eat,…
H6310.full: peh peh From H6284; the mouth (as the means of blowing), whether literally or figuratively (particularly speech); specifically edge, portion or side; adverbially (with preposition) according to: - accord (-ing as, -ing to), after, appointment, assent, collar, command (-ment), X eat, edge, end, entry, + file, hole, X in, mind, mouth, part, portion, X (should) say (-ing), sentence, skirt, sound, speech, X spoken, talk, tenor, X to, + two-edged, wish, word.

H6311.firstSense: here, hither, the one (other, this, that) side
H6311.full: Probably from a primitive inseparable particle ôּ p (the second form; of demonstrative force) and H1931; this place (French, icil), that is, here or hence: - here, hither, the one (other, this, that) side.

H6312.full: From H6284; a blast; Puah or Puvvah, the name of two Israelites: - Phuvah, Pua, Puah.

H6313.firstSense: cease, be feeble, faint, be slacked
H6313.full: pûg poog A primitive root; to be sluggish: - cease, be feeble, faint, be slacked.

H6315.firstSense: blow (upon), break, puff, bring into a snare, speak, utter
H6315.full: A primitive root; to puff, that is, blow with the breath or air; hence to fan (as a breeze), to utter, to kindle (a fire), to scoff: - blow (upon), break, puff, bring into a snare, speak, utter.

H6316.full: Of foreign origin; Put, a son of Ham, also the name of his descendants or thier region, and of a Persian tribe: - Phut, Put.

H6317.full: From an unused root (probably meaning to disparage) and H410; contempt of God; Putiel, an Israelite: - Putiel.

H6318.full: Of Egyptian derivation; Potiphar, an Egyptian: - Potiphar.

H6319.full: Of Egyptian derivation; Poti-Phera, an Egyptian: - Poti-pherah.

H6320.full: pûk pook From an unused root meaning to paint; dye (specifically stibium for the eyes): - fair colours, glistering, paint [-ed] (-ing).

H6321.full: pôl pole From an unused root meaning to be thick; a bean (a plump): - beans.

H6322.full: pûl pool Of foreign origin; Pul, the name of an Assyrian king and of an Ethiopian tribe: - Pul.

H6323.full: pûn poon A primitive root meaning to turn, that is, be perplexed: - be distracted.

H6324.full: Patronymic from an unused name meaning a turn; a Punite (collectively) or descendant of an unknown Pun: - Punites.

H6325.full: From H6323; perplexity; Punon, a place in the Desert: - Punon.

H6326.full: From an unused root meaning to glitter; brilliancy; Puah, an Israelitess: - Puah.

H6327.firstSense: break (dash, shake) in (to) pieces, cast (abroad), disperse (selves), drive, retire, sc…
H6327.full: pûts poots A primitive root; to dash in pieces, literally or figuratively (especially to disperse): - break (dash, shake) in (to) pieces, cast (abroad), disperse (selves), drive, retire, scatter (abroad), spread abroad.

H6328.full: pûq pook A primitive root; to waver: - stumble, move.

H6329.firstSense: afford, draw out, further, get, obtain
H6329.full: pûq pook A primitive root (rather identical with H6328 through the idea of dropping out; compare H5312); to issue, that is, furnish; causatively to secure; figuratively to succeed: - afford, draw out, further, get, obtain.

H6330.full: From H6328; a stumbling block: - grief.

H6331.firstSense: break, bring to nought, X utterly take
H6331.full: pûr poor A primitive root; to crush: - break, bring to nought, X utterly take.

H6332.full: From H6331; a lot (as by means of a broken piece): - Pur, Purim.

H6333.full: From H6331; a wine press (as crushing the grapes): - winepress.

H6334.full: Of Persian origin; Poratha, a son of Haman: - Poratha.

H6335.firstSense: grow up, be grown fat, spread selves, be scattered
H6335.full: pûsh poosh A primitive root; to spread; figuratively act proudly: - grow up, be grown fat, spread selves, be scattered.

H6336.full: Patronymic from an unused name meaning a hinge; a Puthite (collectively) or descendant of an unknown Puth. (As if from H6312.): - Puhites [as if from H6312].

H6337.full: pâz pawz From H6388; pure (gold); hence gold itself (as refined): - fine (pure) gold.

H6338.full: A primitive root; to refine (gold): - best [gold].

H6339.full: A primitive root (rather identical with H6338); to solidify (as if by refining); also to spring (as if separating the limbs): - leap, be made strong.

H6340.full: A primitive root; to scatter, whether in enmity or bounty: - disperse, scatter (abroad).

H6341.full: pach pakh From H6351; a (metallic) sheet (as pounded thin); also a spring net (as spread out like a lamina): - gin, (thin) plate, snare.

H6342.firstSense: be afraid, stand in awe, (be in) fear, make to shake
H6342.full: A primitive root; to be startled (by a sudden alarm); hence to fear in general: - be afraid, stand in awe, (be in) fear, make to shake.

H6343.full: From H6342; a (sudden) alarm (properly the object feared, by implication the feeling): - dread (-ful), fear, (thing) great [fear, -ly feared], terror.

H6344.full: The same as H6343; a testicle (as a cause of shame akin to fear): - stone.

H6345.full: Feminine of H6343; alarm (that is, awe): - fear.

H6346.full: Of foreign origin; a prefect (of a city or small district): - captain, deputy, governor.

H6348.full: A primitive root; to bubble up or froth (as boiling water), that is, (figuratively) to be unimportant: - light.

H6349.full: From H6348; ebullition, that is, froth (figuratively lust): - unstable.

H6351.full: A primitive root; to batter out; but used only as denominative from H6341, to spread a net: - be snared.

H6352.full: Perhaps from an unused root probably meaning to be black; a coal, whether charred or live: - coals.

H6353.full: (Chaldee); from an unused root probably meaning to fashion; a potter: - potter.

H6354.full: Probably from an unused root apparently meaning to dig; a pit, especially for catching animals: - hole, pit, snare.

H6355.full: pakh'-ath mo-awb' From H6354 and H4124; pit of Moab; Pachath Moab, an Israelite: - Pahath-moab.

H6356.full: From the same as H6354; a hole (by mildew in a garment): - fret inward.

H6357.full: Of foreign derivation; a gem, probably the topaz: - topaz.

H6358.full: Passive participle of H6362; opened, that is, (as noun) a bud: - open.

H6359.full: From H6362; open, that is, unoccupied: - free.

H6360.full: Intensive from an unused root meaning to pound; a hammer: - hammer.

H6361.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to that of H6260; a gown (as if hammered out wide): - hose.

H6362.firstSense: dismiss, free, let (shoot) out, slip away
H6362.full: A primitive root; to cleave or burst through, that is, (causatively) to emit, whether literally or figuratively (gape): - dismiss, free, let (shoot) out, slip away.

H6363.full: From H6362; a fissure, that is, (concretely) firstling (as opening the matrix): - firstling, openeth, such as open.

H6364.full: Of Egyptian origin; Pi-Beseth, a place in Egypt: - Pi-beseth.

H6365.full: pı̂yd peed From an unused root probably meaning to pierce; (figuratively) misfortune: - destruction, ruin.

H6366.full: Feminine of H6310; an edge: - (two-) edge (-d).

H6367.full: From H6310 and the feminine plural of a noun (from the same root as H2356), with the article interposed; mouth of the gorges; Pi-ha-Chiroth, a place in Egypt. (Found in Num_14:19 without the "pi".): - Pi-hahiroth. [In Num. H14 : H19 without Pi-.]

H6368.full: From H6315; a powder (as easily puffed away), that is, ashes or dust: - ashes.

H6369.full: Apparently from H6310 and H3605; mouth of all; Picol, a Phillistine: - Phichol.

H6370.full: Of uncertain derivation; a concubine; also (masculine) a paramour: - concubine, paramour.

H6371.full: Probably from an unused root meaning to be plump; obesity: - collops.

H6372.full: Apparently from H6310 and a variation of H5175; mouth of a serpent; Pinechas, the name of three Israelites: - Phinehas.

H6373.full: Probably the same as H6325; Pinon, an Idumaean: - Pinon.

H6374.full: For H6366; an edge or tooth: - tooth, X two-edged

H6375.full: pı̂yq peek From H6329; a tottering: - smite together.

H6376.full: From H6335; dispersive; Pishon, a river of Eden: - Pison.

H6377.full: Probably from the same as H6596; expansive; Pithon, an Israelite: - Pithon.

H6378.full: pak pak From H6379; a flask (from which a liquid may flow): - box, vial.

H6379.full: A primitive root; to pour: - run out.

H6380.full: From the active participle (of the same form as the first word) feminine of an unused root (meaning to entrap) and plural of H6643; trap of gazelles; Pokereth Tsebajim, one of the servants of Solomon: - Pochereth of Zebaim.

H6381.full: A primitive root; properly perhaps to separate, that is, distinguish (literally or figuratively); by implication to be (causatively make) great, difficult, wonderful: - accomplish, (arise . . . too, be too) hard, hidden, things too high, (be, do, do a, shew) marvelous (-ly, -els, things, work), miracles, perform, separate, make singular, (be, great, make) wonderful (-ers, -ly, things, works), wondrous (things, works, -ly).

H6382.full: peh'-leh From H6381; a miracle: - marvellous thing, wonder (-ful, -fully).

H6383.full: pil-ee', paw-lee' From H6381; remarkable: - secret, wonderful.

H6384.full: pal-loo-ee' Patronymic from H6396; a Palluite (collectively) or descendant of Pallu: - Palluites.

H6385.full: A primitive root; to split (literally or figuratively): - divide.

H6388.full: From H6385; a rill (that is, small channel of water, as in irrigation): - river, stream.

H6389.full: The same as H6388; earthquake; Peleg, a son of Shem: - Peleg.

H6390.full: From H6385; a runlet, that is, gully: - division, river.

H6393.full: From an unused root meaning to divide; a cleaver, that is, iron armature (of a chariot): - torch.

H6394.full: Of uncertain derivation; Pildash, a relative of Abraham: - Pildash.

H6395.firstSense: put a difference, show marvellous, separate, set apart, sever, make wonderfully
H6395.full: A primitive root; to distinguish (literally or figuratively): - put a difference, show marvellous, separate, set apart, sever, make wonderfully.

H6396.full: pal-loo' From H6395; distinguished; Pallu, an Israelite: - Pallu, Phallu.

H6397.full: Patronymic from an unused name (from H6395) meaning separate; a Pelonite or inhabitant of an unknown Palon: - Pelonite.

H6398.firstSense: bring forth, cleave, cut, shred, strike through
H6398.full: A primitive root; to slice, that is, break open or pierce: - bring forth, cleave, cut, shred, strike through.

H6399.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H6398; to serve or worship: - minister, serve.

H6401.full: pil-khaw' From H6400; slicing; Pilcha, an Israelite: - Pilcha.

H6403.firstSense: calve, carry away safe, deliver, (cause to) escape
H6403.full: A primitive root; to slip out, that is, escape; causatively to deliver: - calve, carry away safe, deliver, (cause to) escape.

H6404.full: From H6403; escape; Pelet, the name of two Israelites: - Pelet. See also H1046.

H6406.full: From H6403; delivered; Palti, the name of two Israelites: - Palti, Phalti.

H6407.full: Patronymic from H6406; a Paltite or descendant of Palti: - Paltite.

H6408.full: For H6407; Piltai, an Israelite: - Piltai.

H6409.full: From the same as H6404 and H410; deliverance of God; Paltiel, the name of two Israelites: - Paltiel, Phaltiel.

H6410.full: From H6403 and H3050; Jah has delivered; Pelatjah, the name of four Israelites: - Pelatiah.

H6411.full: pel-aw-yaw', pel-aw-yaw' From H6381 and H3050; Jah has distinguished; Pelajah, the name of three Israelites: - Pelaiah.

H6412.full: From H6403; a refugee: - (that have) escape (-d, -th), fugitive.

H6413.full: Feminine of H6412; deliverance; concretely an escaped portion: - deliverance, (that is) escape (-d), remnant.

H6418.full: From an unused root meaning to be round; a circuit (that is, district); also a spindle (as whirled); hence a crutch: - (di-) staff, part.

H6419.full: A primitive root; to judge (officially or mentally); by extension to intercede, pray: - intreat, judge (-ment), (make) pray (-er, -ing), make supplication.

H6420.full: From H6419; judge; Palal, an Israelite: - Palal.

H6421.full: From H6419 and H3050; Jah has judged; Pelaljah, an Israelite: - Pelaliah.

H6422.full: Probably for H6423; a certain one, that is, so and so: - certain.

H6423.full: From H6395; such a one, that is, a specified person: - such.

H6424.full: A primitive root; properly to roll flat, that is, prepare (a road); also to revolve, that is, weigh (mentally): - make, ponder, weigh.

H6425.full: From H6424; a balance: - scales, weight.

H6426.full: A primitive root; properly perhaps to rend, that is, (by implication) to quiver: - tremble.

H6427.full: From H6426; affright: - fearfulness, horror, trembling.

H6428.full: A primitive root; to roll (in dust): - roll (wallow) self.

H6429.full: From H6428; rolling, that is, migratory; Pelesheth, a region of Syria: - Palestina, Palestine, Philistia, Philistines.

H6430.full: Patrial from H6429; a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth: - Philistine.

H6431.full: From an unused root meaning to flee; swiftness; Peleth, the name of two Israelites: - Peleth.

H6432.full: From the same form as H6431; a courier (collectively) or official messenger: - Pelethites.

H6433.full: pûm poom (Chaldee); probably for H6310; the mouth (literally or figuratively): - mouth.

H6434.full: pên pane From an unused root meaning to turn; an angle (of a street or wall): - corner.

H6435.full: pên pane From H6437; properly removal; used only (in the constructive) adverbially as conjugation lest: - (lest) (peradventure), that . . . not.

H6436.full: Of uncertain derivation; probably pastry: - Pannag.

H6437.firstSense: appear, at [even-] tide, behold, cast out, come on, X corner, dawning, empty, go away,…
H6437.full: A primitive root; to turn; by implication to face, that is, appear, look, etc.: - appear, at [even-] tide, behold, cast out, come on, X corner, dawning, empty, go away, lie, look, mark, pass away, prepare, regard, (have) respect (to), (re-) turn (aside, away, back, face, self), X right [early].

H6438.full: Feminine of H6434; an angle; by implication a pinnacle; figuratively a chieftain: - bulwark, chief, corner, stay, tower.

H6439.full: pen-oo-ale', pen-ee-ale' From H6437 and H410; face of God; Penuel or Peniel, a place East of Jordan; also (as Penuel) the name of two Israelites: - Peniel, Penuel.

H6440.firstSense: + accept, a (be-) fore (-time), against, anger, X as (long as), at, + battle, + because…
H6440.full: Plural (but always used as a singular) of an unused noun (ôּðä pâneh, paw-neh'; from 6437); the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.): - + accept, a (be-) fore (-time), against, anger, X as (long as), at, + battle, + because (of), + beseech, countenance, edge, + employ, endure, + enquire, face, favour, fear of, for, forefront (-part), form (-er time, -ward), from, front, heaviness, X him (-self), + honourable, + impudent, + in, it, look [-eth] (-s), X me, + meet, X more than, mouth, of, off, (of) old (time), X on, open, + out of, over against, the partial, person, + please, presence, prospect, was purposed, by reason, of, + regard, right forth, + serve, X shewbread, sight, state, straight, + street, X thee, X them (-selves), through (+ -out), till, time (-s) past, (un-) to (-ward), + upon, upside (+ down), with (-in, + stand), X ye, X you.

H6441.full: From H6440 with directive enclitic; faceward, that is, indoors: - (with-) in (-ner part, -ward).

H6443.full: From the same as H6434; probably a pearl (as round): - ruby.

H6444.full: Probably feminine from H6443 contracted; Peninnah, an Israelitess: - Peninnah.

H6445.full: A primitive root; to enervate: - bring up.

H6446.full: pas pas From H6461; properly the palm (of the hand) or sole (of the foot), (compare H6447); by implication (plural) a long and sleeved tunic (perhaps simply a wide one; from the original sense of the root, that is, of many breadths): - (divers) colours.

H6447.full: pas pas (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H6461; to palm (of the hand, as being spread out): - part.

H6448.full: A primitive root; to cut up, that is, (figuratively) contemplate: - consider.

H6449.full: From H6448; a cleft; Pisgah, a mountain East of Jordan: - Pisgah.

H6450.full: From H6446 and the plural of H1818; palm (that is, dell) of bloodshed; Pas-Dammim, a place in Palestine: - Pas-dammim. Compare H658.

H6451.full: From H6461; expansion, that is, abundance: - handful.

H6452.firstSense: halt, become lame, leap, pass over
H6452.full: A primitive root; to hop, that is, (figuratively) skip over (or spare); by implication to hesitate; also (literally) to limp, to dance: - halt, become lame, leap, pass over.

H6453.full: From H6452; a pretermission, that is, exemption; used only technically of the Jewish Passover (the festival or the victim): - passover (offering).

H6454.full: From H6452; limping; Paseach, the name of two Israelites: - Paseah, Phaseah.

H6456.full: From H6458; an idol: - carved (graven) image, quarry.

H6457.full: From an unused root meaning to divide; divider; Pasak, an Israelite: - Pasach.

H6458.full: A primitive root; to carve, whether wood or stone: - grave, hew.

H6459.full: From H6458; an idol: - carved (graven) image.

H6460.full: (Chaldee); a transliteration of the Greek (not in lexicon) psalterion; a lyre: - psaltery.

H6461.full: A primitive root; probably to disperse, that is, (intransitively) disappear: - cease.

H6462.full: Perhaps from H6461; dispersion; Pispah, an Israelite: - Pispah.

H6463.full: A primitive root; to scream: - cry.

H6464.full: From H6463; screaming; Pau or Pai, a place in Edom: - Pai, Pau.

H6465.full: From H6473; a gap; Peor, a mountain East of Jordan; also (for H1187) a deity worshipped there: - Peor. See also H1047.

H6466.firstSense: commit, [evil-] do (-er), make (-r), ordain, work (-er), wrought
H6466.full: A primitive root; to do or make (systematically and habitually), especially to practise: - commit, [evil-] do (-er), make (-r), ordain, work (-er), wrought.

H6467.firstSense: act, deed, do, getting, maker, work
H6467.full: From H6466; an act or work (concretely): - act, deed, do, getting, maker, work.

H6468.full: Feminine passive participle of H6466; (abstractly) work: - labour, reward, wages, work.

H6469.full: From H6468; laborious; Peullethai, an Israelite: - Peulthai.

H6470.full: A primitive root; to tap, that is, beat regularly; hence (generally) to impel or agitate: - move, trouble.

H6471.firstSense: anvil, corner, foot (-step), going, [hundred-] fold, X now, (this) + once, order, rank,…
H6471.full: From H6470; a stroke, literally or figuratively (in various applications): - anvil, corner, foot (-step), going, [hundred-] fold, X now, (this) + once, order, rank, step, + thrice, [often-], second, this, two) time (-s), twice, wheel.

H6472.full: From H6471; a bell (as struck): - bell.

H6473.full: A primitive root; to yawn, that is, open wide (literally or figuratively): - gape, open (wide).

H6474.full: From H6473; yawning; Paarai, an Israelite: - Paarai.

H6475.full: A primitive root; to rend, that is, open (especially the mouth): - deliver, gape, open, rid, utter.

H6476.firstSense: break (forth, forth into joy), make a loud noise
H6476.full: A primitive root; to break out (in joyful sound): - break (forth, forth into joy), make a loud noise.

H6478.full: A primitive root; to peel: - pill.

H6480.full: A primitive root; to rend (by earthquake): - break.

H6481.full: A primitive root; to split, that is, wound: - wound.

H6483.full: From an unused root meaning to dissever; dispersive; Pitstsets, a priest: - Apses [includ. the article.]

H6484.full: A primitive root; to peck at, that is, (figuratively) stun or dull: - press, urge, stubbornness.

H6485.firstSense: appoint, X at all, avenge, bestow, (appoint to have the, give a) charge, commit, count,…
H6485.full: A primitive root; to visit (with friendly or hostile intent); by analogy to oversee, muster, charge, care for, miss, deposit, etc.: - appoint, X at all, avenge, bestow, (appoint to have the, give a) charge, commit, count, deliver to keep, be empty, enjoin, go see, hurt, do judgment, lack, lay up look, make X by any means, miss, number, officer, (make) overseer have (the) oversight, punish, reckon, (call to) remember (-brance), set (over), sum, X surely, visit, want.

H6486.firstSense: account, (that have the) charge, custody, that which
H6486.full: Feminine passive participle of H6485; visitation (in many senses, chiefly official): - account, (that have the) charge, custody, that which . . . laid up, numbers, office (-r), ordering, oversight, + prison, reckoning, visitation.

H6487.firstSense: that which was delivered (to keep), store
H6487.full: From H6485; a deposit: - that which was delivered (to keep), store.

H6489.full: From H6485; punishment; Pekod, a symbolical name for Babylon: - Pekod.

H6490.full: From H6485; properly appointed, that is, a mandate (of God; plural only, collectively for the Law): - commandment, precept, statute.

H6491.full: A primitive root; to open (the senses, especially the eyes); figuratively to be observant: - open.

H6492.full: From H6491; watch; Pekach, an Israelite king: - Pekah.

H6493.full: From H6491; clear sighted; figuratively intelligent: - seeing, wise.

H6494.full: From H6491 and H3050; Jah has observed; Pekachjah, an Israelitish king: - Pekahiah.

H6495.full: From H6491 redoubled; opening (of a dungeon), that is, jail delivery (figuratively salvation from sin): - opening of the prison.

H6496.firstSense: which had the charge, governor, office, overseer, [that] was set
H6496.full: From H6485; a superintendent (civil, military or religious): - which had the charge, governor, office, overseer, [that] was set.

H6497.full: From an unused root meaning to burst; only used as an architectural term of an ornament similar to H6498, a semi-globe: - knop.

H6498.full: From the same as H6497; the wild cucumber (from splitting open to shed its seeds): - gourd.

H6499.full: par pâr par, pawr From H6565; a bullock (apparently as breaking forth in wild strength, or perhaps as dividing the hoof): - (+ young) bull (-ock), calf, ox.

H6500.full: A primitive root; to bear fruit: - be fruitful.

H6501.full: peh'-reh, peh'-reh From H6500 in the secondary sense of running wild; the onager: - wild (ass).

H6502.full: pir-awm' From H6501; wildly; Piram, a Canaanite: - Piram.

H6503.full: Of foreign origin; Parbar or Parvar, a quarter of Jerusalem: - Parbar, suburb.

H6504.firstSense: disperse, divide, be out of joint, part, scatter (abroad), separate (self), sever self,…
H6504.full: A primitive root; to break through, that is, spread or separate (oneself): - disperse, divide, be out of joint, part, scatter (abroad), separate (self), sever self, stretch, sunder.

H6505.full: From H6504; a mule (perhaps from his lonely habits): - mule.

H6506.full: Feminine of H6505; a she mule: - mule.

H6507.full: Feminine passive participle of H6504; something separated, that is, a kernel: - seed.

H6508.full: Of foreign origin; a park: - forest, orchard.

H6509.firstSense: bear, bring forth (fruit), (be, cause to be, make) fruitful, grow, increase
H6509.full: A primitive root; to bear fruit (literally or figuratively): - bear, bring forth (fruit), (be, cause to be, make) fruitful, grow, increase.

H6510.full: Feminine of H6499; a heifer: - cow, heifer, kine.

H6511.full: The same as H6510; Parah, a place in Palestine: - Parah.

H6512.full: From H6331; a hole (as broken, that is, dug): - + mole. Compare H2661.

H6513.full: For H6288; foliage; Purah, an Israelite: - Phurah.

H6514.full: per-oo-daw', per-ee-daw' From H6504; dispersion; Peruda or Perida, one of Solomon's servants: - Perida, Peruda.

H6515.full: Passive participle of H6524; blossomed; Paruach, an Israelite: - Paruah.

H6516.full: Of foreign origin; Parvajim, an Oriental region: - Parvaim.

H6517.full: Passive participle of H6565 in the sense of spreading out (compare H6524); a skillet (as flat or deep): - pan, pot.

H6518.full: From an unused root meaning to separate, that is, decide; a chieftain: - village.

H6519.full: From the same as H6518; an open country: - (unwalled) town (without walls), unwalled village.

H6520.full: From the same as H6518; magistracy, that is, leadership (also concretely chieftains): - village.

H6522.full: For H6521; inhabitant of the open country; a Perizzite, one of the Canaanitish tribes: - Perizzite.

H6524.firstSense: X abroad, X abundantly, blossom, break forth (out), bud, flourish, make fly, grow, spre…
H6524.full: A primitive root; to break forth as a bud, that is, bloom; generally to spread; specifically to fly (as extending the wings); figuratively to flourish: - X abroad, X abundantly, blossom, break forth (out), bud, flourish, make fly, grow, spread, spring (up).

H6525.full: From H6524; calyx (natural or artificial); generally bloom: - blossom, bud, flower.

H6526.full: From H6524; progeny, that is, a brood: - youth.

H6527.full: A primitive root; to scatter words, that is, prate (or hum): - chant.

H6528.full: From H6527; a stray or single berry: - grape.

H6529.full: From H6509; fruit (literally or figuratively): - bough, ([first-]) fruit ([-ful]), reward.

H6530.full: From H6555; violent, that is, a tyrant: - destroyer, ravenous, robber.

H6531.full: From an unused root meaning to break apart; fracture, that is, severity: - cruelty, rigour.

H6532.full: Feminine active participle of the same as H6531; a separatrix, that is, (the sacred) screen: - vail.

H6533.full: A primitive root; to tear: - rend.

H6534.full: par-mash-taw' Of Persian origin; Parmashta, a son of Haman: - Parmasta.

H6535.full: Of uncertain derivation; Parnak, an Israelite: - Parnach.

H6536.firstSense: deal, divide, have hoofs, part, tear
H6536.full: A primitive root; to break in pieces, that is, (usually without violence) to split, distribute: - deal, divide, have hoofs, part, tear.

H6537.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H6536; to split up: - divide, [U-] pharsin.

H6538.full: From H6536; a claw; also a kind of eagle: - claw, ossifrage.

H6539.full: Of foreign origin; Paras (that is, Persia), an Eastern country, including its inhabitants: - Persia, Persians.

H6541.full: Feminine of H6538; a claw or split hoof: - claw, [cloven-] footed, hoof.

H6542.full: Patrial from H6539; a Parsite (that is, Persian), or inhabitant of Peres: - Persian.

H6544.firstSense: avenge, avoid, bare, go back, let, (make) naked, set at nought, perish, refuse, uncover
H6544.full: A primitive root; to loosen; by implication to expose, dismiss; figuratively absolve, begin: - avenge, avoid, bare, go back, let, (make) naked, set at nought, perish, refuse, uncover.

H6545.full: From H6544; the hair (as dishevelled): - locks.

H6546.full: Feminine of H6545 (in the sense of beginning); leadership (plural concretely leaders): - + avenging, revenge.

H6547.full: Of Egyptian derivation; Paroh, a generic title of Egyptian kings: - Pharaoh.

H6548.full: Of Egyptian derivation; Paroh-Chophra, an Egyptian king: - Pharaoh-hophra.

H6549.full: Of Egyptian derivation; Paroh Nekoh (or Neko), an Egyptian king: - Pharaoh-necho, Pharaoh-nechoh.

H6550.full: Probably from H6544 and H6211; a flea (as the isolated insect): - flea.

H6551.full: The same as H6550; Parosh, the name of four Israelites: - Parosh, Pharosh.

H6552.full: From H6546; chieftaincy; Pirathon, a place in Palestine: - Pirathon.

H6553.full: Patrial from H6552; a Pirathonite or inhabitant of Pirathon: - Pirathonite.

H6554.full: Probably from H6565 in the sense of rushing; rapid; Parpar, a river of Syria: - Pharpar.

H6555.firstSense: X abroad, (make a) breach, break (away, down, -er, forth, in, up), burst out come (spre…
H6555.full: A primitive root; to break out (in many applications, direct and indirect, literally and figuratively): - X abroad, (make a) breach, break (away, down, -er, forth, in, up), burst out come (spread) abroad, compel, disperse, grow, increase, open, press, scatter, urge.

H6556.firstSense: breach, breaking forth (in), X forth, gap
H6556.full: From H6555; a break (literally or figuratively): - breach, breaking forth (in), X forth, gap.

H6557.full: The same as H6556; Perets, the name of two Israelites: - Perez, Pharez.

H6558.full: Patronymic from H6557; a Partsite (collectively) or descendant of Perets: - Pharzites.

H6559.full: Plural of H6556; breaks; Peratsim, a mountain in Palestine: - Perazim.

H6560.full: peh'-rets ooz-zaw' From H6556 and H5798; break of Uzza; Perets-Uzza, a place in Palestine: - Perez-uzza.

H6561.firstSense: break (off), deliver, redeem, rend (in pieces), tear in pieces
H6561.full: A primitive root; to break off or craunch; figuratively to deliver: - break (off), deliver, redeem, rend (in pieces), tear in pieces.

H6562.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H6561; to discontinue: - break off.

H6563.full: From H6561; rapine; also a fork (in roads): - crossway, robbery.

H6564.full: From H6561; soup (as full of crumbed meat): - broth. See also H4832.

H6565.firstSense: X any ways, break (asunder), cast off, cause to cease, X clean, defeat, disannul, disap…
H6565.full: A primitive root; to break up (usually figuratively, that is, to violate, frustrate): - X any ways, break (asunder), cast off, cause to cease, X clean, defeat, disannul, disappoint, dissolve, divide, make of none effect, fail, frustrate, bring (come) to nought, X utterly, make void.

H6566.firstSense: break, chop in pieces, lay open, scatter, spread (abroad, forth, selves, out), stretch…
H6566.full: A primitive root; to break apart, disperse, etc.: - break, chop in pieces, lay open, scatter, spread (abroad, forth, selves, out), stretch (forth, out).

H6567.full: A primitive root; to separate, literally (to disperse) or figuratively (to specify); also (by implication) to wound: - scatter, declare, distinctly, shew, sting.

H6568.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H6567; to specify: - distinctly.

H6570.full: The same as H6569; Peresh, an Israelite: - Peresh.

H6571.full: From H6567; a steed (as stretched out to a vehicle, not single nor for mounting (compare H5483)); also (by implication) a driver (in a chariot), that is, (collectively) cavalry: - horseman.

H6572.full: Of foreign origin; a transcript: - copy.

H6574.full: Perhaps by compounding H6567 and H6504 (in the sense of straddling), (compare H6576); the crotch (or anus): - dirt.

H6576.full: A root apparently formed by compounding H6567 and that of H6518 (compare H6574); to expand: - spread.

H6577.full: par-shan-daw-thaw' Of Persian origin; Parshandatha, a son of Haman: - Parshandatha.

H6578.full: From an unused root meaning to break forth; rushing; Perath (that is, Euphrates), a river of the East: - Euphrates.

H6579.full: Of Persian origin; a grandee: - (most) noble, prince.

H6580.full: pash pash Probably from an unused root meaning to disintegrate; stupidity (as a result of grossness or of degeneracy): - extremity.

H6581.full: A primitive root; to spread: - spread.

H6582.full: A primitive root; to tear in pieces: - pull in pieces.

H6583.full: Probably from H6582; liberation; Pashchur, the name of four Israelites: - Pashur.

H6584.firstSense: fall upon, flay, invade, make an invasion, pull off, put off, make a road, run upon, ru…
H6584.full: A primitive root; to spread out (that is, deploy in hostile array); by analogy to strip (that is, unclothe, plunder, flay, etc.): - fall upon, flay, invade, make an invasion, pull off, put off, make a road, run upon, rush, set, spoil, spread selves (abroad), strip (off, self).

H6585.full: A primitive root; to stride (from spreading the legs), that is, rush upon: - go.

H6586.full: A primitive root (rather identical with H6585 through the idea of expansion); to break away (from just authority), that is, trespass, apostatize, quarrel: - offend, rebel, revolt, transgress (-ion, -or).

H6588.full: From H6586; a revolt (national, moral or religious): - rebellion, sin, transgression, trespassive

H6589.full: A primitive root; to dispart (the feet or lips), that is, become licentious: - open (wide).

H6590.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H6622; to interpret: - make [interpretations], interpreting.

H6593.full: From the same as H6580 as in the sense of comminuting; linen (that is, the thread, as carded): - flax, linen.

H6594.full: Feminine of H6593; flax; by implication a wick: - flax, tow.

H6595.full: path path From H6626; a bit: - meat, morsel, piece.

H6596.full: From an unused root meaning to open; a hole, that is, hinge or the female pudenda: - hinge, secret part.

H6597.full: pith-ome', pith-ome' From H6621; instantly: - straightway, sudden (-ly).

H6598.full: Of Persian origin; a dainty: - portion (provision) of meat.

H6599.full: Of Persian origin; a (judicial) sentence: - decree, sentence.

H6600.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H6599; a word, answer, letter or decree: - answer, letter, matter, word.

H6601.firstSense: allure, deceive, enlarge, entice, flatter, persuade, silly (one)
H6601.full: A primitive root; to open, that is, be (causatively make) roomy; usually figuratively (in a mental or moral sense) to be (causatively make) simple or (in a sinister way) delude: - allure, deceive, enlarge, entice, flatter, persuade, silly (one).

H6602.full: peth-oo-ale' From H6601 and H410; enlarged of God; Pethuel, an Israelite: - Pethuel.

H6603.full: Passive participle of H6605; sculpture (in low or high relief or even intaglio): - carved (work) (are, en-) grave (-ing, -n).

H6604.full: Of foreign origin; Pethor, a place in Mesopotamia: - Pethor.

H6605.firstSense: appear, break forth, draw (out), let go free, (en-) grave (-n), loose (self), (be, bese…
H6605.full: A primitive root; to open wide (literally or figuratively); specifically to loosen, begin, plough, carve: - appear, break forth, draw (out), let go free, (en-) grave (-n), loose (self), (be, beset) open (-ing), put off, ungird, unstop, have vent.

H6606.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H6605; to open: - open.

H6607.firstSense: door, entering (in), entrance (-ry), gate, opening, place
H6607.full: From H6605; an opening (literally), that is, door (gate) or entrance way: - door, entering (in), entrance (-ry), gate, opening, place.

H6608.full: From H6605; opening (figuratively) that is, disclosure: - entrance.

H6609.full: From H6605; something opened, that is, a drawn sword: - drawn sword.

H6611.full: From H6605 and H3050; Jah has opened; Pethachjah, the name of four Israelites: - Pethakiah.

H6612.full: peth-ee', peh'-thee, peth-aw-ee' From H6601; silly (that is, seducible): - foolish, simple (-icity, one).

H6613.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H6601; open, that is, (as noun) width: - breadth.

H6614.full: Of uncertain derivation; probably a figured mantle for holidays: - stomacher.

H6615.full: From H6612; silliness (that is, seducibility): - simple.

H6616.firstSense: bound, bracelet, lace, line, ribband, thread, wire
H6616.full: From H6617; twine: - bound, bracelet, lace, line, ribband, thread, wire.

H6617.firstSense: (shew self) froward, shew self unsavoury, wrestle
H6617.full: A primitive root; to twine, that is, (literally) to struggle or (figuratively) be (morally) tortuous: - (shew self) froward, shew self unsavoury, wrestle.

H6618.full: From H6617; tortuous (that is, crafty): - crooked.

H6619.full: Of Egyptian derivation; Pithom, a place in Egypt: - Pithom.

H6620.full: From an unused root meaning to twist; an asp (from its contortions): - adder.

H6621.firstSense: at an instant suddenly, X very
H6621.full: From an unused root meaning to open (the eyes); a wink, that is, moment (compare H6597), (used only (with or without preposition) adverbially quickly or unexpectedly): - at an instant suddenly, X very.

H6622.full: A primitive root; to open up, that is, (figuratively) interpret (a dream): - interpret (-ation, -er).

H6623.full: From H6622; interpretation (of a dream): - interpretation.

H6624.full: Of Egyptian derivation; Pathros, a part of Egypt: - Pathros.

H6625.full: Partrial from H6624; a Pathrusite, or inhabitant of Pathros: - Pathrusim.

H6626.full: A primitive root; to open, that is, break: - part.

H6627.full: From H3318; issue, that is, (human) excrement: - that (which) cometh from (out).

H6628.full: tseh'-el From an unused root meaning to be slender; the lotus tree: - shady tree.

H6629.full: tsone, tseh-one' From an unused root meaning to migrate; a collective name for a flock (of sheep or goats); also figuratively (of men): - (small) cattle, flock (+ -s), lamb (+ -s), sheep ([-cote, -fold, -shearer, -herds]).

H6630.full: tsah-an-awn' From the same as H6629 used denominatively; sheep pasture; Zaanan, a place in Palestine: - Zaanan.

H6631.full: tseh-ets-aw' From H3318; issue, that is, produce, children: - that which cometh forth (out), offspring.

H6632.full: tsâb tsawb From an unused root meaning to establish; a palanquin or canopy (as a fixture); also a species of lizard (probably as clinging fast): - covered, litter, tortoise.

H6633.firstSense: assemble, fight, perform, muster, wait upon, war
H6633.full: A primitive root; to mass (an army or servants): - assemble, fight, perform, muster, wait upon, war.

H6634.full: tseb-aw' (Chaldee); corresponding to H6633 in the figuratively sense of summoning one's wishes; to please: - will, would.

H6635.firstSense: appointed time, (+) army, (+) battle, company, host, service, soldiers, waiting upon, w…
H6635.full: tsaw-baw', tseb-aw-aw' From H6633; a mass of persons (or figurative things), especially regularly organized for war (an army); by implication a campaign, literally or figuratively (specifically hardship, worship): - appointed time, (+) army, (+) battle, company, host, service, soldiers, waiting upon, war (-fare).

H6636.full: tseb-o-eem', tseb-ee-yeem', tseb-ee-yeem' Plural of H6643; gazelles; Tseboim or Tsebijim, a place in Palestine: - Zeboiim, Zeboim.

H6637.full: Feminine active participle of the same as H6632; the canopier (with the article); Tsobebah, an Israelitess: - Zobebah.

H6638.full: A primitive root; to amass, that is, grow turgid; specifically to array an army against: - fight, swell.

H6640.full: From H6634; properly will; concretely an affair (as a matter of determination): - purpose.

H6641.full: Passive participle of the same as H6648; dyed (in stripes), that is, the hyena: - speckled.

H6642.full: A primitive root; to grasp, that is, hand out: - reach.

H6643.full: From H6638 in the sense of prominence; splendor (as conspicuous); also a gazelle (as beautiful): - beautiful (-ty), glorious (-ry), goodly, pleasant, roe (-buck).

H6644.full: tsib-yaw' For H6645; Tsibja, an Israelite: - Zibia.

H6645.full: For H6646; Tsibjah, an Israelitess: - Zibiah.

H6646.full: Feminine of H6643; a female gazelle: - roe.

H6647.full: (Chaldee); a root corresponding to that of H6648; to dip: - wet.

H6648.full: From an unused root meaning to dip (into coloring fluid); a dye: - divers, colours.

H6649.full: From the same as H6648; variegated; Tsibon, an Idumaean: - Zibeon.

H6650.full: Plural of H6641; hyenas; Tseboim, a place in Palestine: - Zeboim.

H6651.full: A primitive root; to aggregate: - gather (together), heap (up), lay up.

H6653.full: From an unused root apparently meaning to grip; a lock of stalks: - handful.

H6654.full: tsad tsad Contracted from an unused root meaning to sidle off; a side; figuratively an adversary: - (be-) side.

H6655.full: tsad tsad (Chaldee); corresponding to H6654; used adverbially (with preposition) at or upon the side of: - against, concerning.

H6656.full: tsed-aw' (Chaldee); from an unused root corresponding to H6658 in the sense of intentness; a (sinister) design: - true.

H6657.full: From the same as H6654; a siding; Tsedad, a place near Palestine: - Zedad.

H6658.full: A primitive root; to chase; by implication to desolate: - destroy, hunt, lie in wait.

H6659.full: From H6663; just; Tsadok, the name of eight or nine Israelites: - Zadok.

H6660.full: From H6658; design (compare H6656): - lying in wait.

H6661.full: Plural of H6654; sides; Tsiddim (with the article), a place in Palestine: - Ziddim.

H6662.full: From H6663; just: - just, lawful, righteous (man).

H6663.firstSense: cleanse, clear self, (be, do) just (-ice, -ify, -ify self), (be, turn to) righteous (-n…
H6663.full: A primitive root; to be (causatively make) right (in a moral or forensic sense): - cleanse, clear self, (be, do) just (-ice, -ify, -ify self), (be, turn to) righteous (-ness).

H6664.firstSense: X even, (X that which is altogether) just (-ice), ([un-]) right (-eous) (cause, -ly, -n…
H6664.full: From H6663; the right (natural, moral or legal); also (abstractly) equity or (figuratively) prosperity: - X even, (X that which is altogether) just (-ice), ([un-]) right (-eous) (cause, -ly, -ness).

H6666.full: From H6663; rightness (abstractly), subjectively (rectitude), objectively (justice), morally (virtue) or figuratively (prosperity): - justice, moderately, right (-eous) (act, -ly, -ness).

H6667.full: From H6664 and H3050; right of Jah; Tsidkijah, the name of six Israelites: - Zedekiah, Zidkijah.

H6668.full: A primitive root; to glitter, that is, be golden in color: - X fine.

H6669.full: From H6668; golden in color: - yellow.

H6670.firstSense: bellow, cry aloud (out), lift up, neigh, rejoice, make to shine, shout
H6670.full: A primitive root; to gleam, that is, (figuratively) be cheerful; by transference, to sound clear (of various animal or human expressions): - bellow, cry aloud (out), lift up, neigh, rejoice, make to shine, shout.

H6671.full: A primitive root; to glisten; used only as denominative from H3323, to press out oil: - make oil.

H6672.full: From H6671; a light (that is, window); dual double light, that is, noon: - midday, noon (-day, -tide), window.

H6673.full: tsav tsâv tsav, tsawv From H6680; an injunction: - commandment, precept.

H6674.full: tso, tso From an unused root meaning to issue; soiled (as if excrementitious): - filthy.

H6675.full: Feminine of H6674; excrement; generally dirt; figuratively pollution: - dung, filth (-iness). Marg. for H2716.

H6677.full: tsav-vawr', -vawr', -vaw-rone', -vaw-raw Intensive from H6696 in the sense of binding; the back of the neck (as that on which burdens are bound): - neck.

H6678.full: From an unused root meaning to station; a station; Zoba or Zobah, a region of Syria: - Zoba, Zobah.

H6679.full: tsûd tsood A primitive root; to lie alongside (that is, in wait); by implication to catch an animal (figuratively men); (denominative from H6718) to victual (for a journey): - chase, hunt, sore, take (provision).

H6680.full: A primitive root; (intensively) to constitute, enjoin: - appoint, (for-) bid. (give a) charge, (give a, give in, send with) command (-er, ment), send a messenger, put, (set) in order.

H6681.full: A primitive root; to screech (exultingly): - shout.

H6682.full: From H6681; a screech (of anguish): - cry (-ing).

H6683.full: From an unused root meaning to sink; an abyss (of the sea): - deep.

H6684.full: tsûm tsoom A primitive root; to cover over (the mouth), that is, to fast: - X at all, fast.

H6685.full: tsôm tsôm tsome, tsome From H6684; a fast: - fast (-ing).

H6686.full: From H6819; small; Tsuar, an Israelite: - Zuar.

H6687.full: tsûph tsoof A primitive root; to overflow: - (make to over-) flow, swim.

H6688.full: tsûph tsoof From H6687; comb of honey (from dripping): - honeycomb.

H6689.full: From H6688; honey comb; Tsuph or Tsophai or Tsiph, the name of an Israelite and a place in Palestine: - Zophai, Zuph.

H6690.full: From an unused root meaning to expand, breadth; Tsophach, an Israelite: - Zophah.

H6691.full: From H6852; departing; Tsophar, a friend of Job: - Zophar.

H6692.full: tsûts tsoots A primitive root; to twinkle, that is, glance; by analogy to blossom (figuratively flourish): - bloom, blossom, flourish, shew self.

H6693.firstSense: constrain, distress, lie sore, (op-) press (-or), straiten
H6693.full: tsûq tsook A primitive root; to compress, that is, (figuratively) oppress, distress: - constrain, distress, lie sore, (op-) press (-or), straiten.

H6694.full: tsûq tsook A pirm. root (rather identical with H6693 through the idea of narrowness (of orifice)); to pour out, that is, (figuratively) smelt, utter: - be molten, pour.

H6695.full: From H6693; a strait, that is, (figuratively) distress: - anguish, X troublous.

H6696.firstSense: adversary, assault, beset, besiege, bind (up), cast, distress, fashion, fortify, inclos…
H6696.full: tsûr tsoor A primitive root; to cramp, that is, confine (in many applications, literally and figuratively, formative or hostile): - adversary, assault, beset, besiege, bind (up), cast, distress, fashion, fortify, inclose, lay siege, put up in bags.

H6697.firstSense: edge, X (mighty) God (one), rock, X sharp, stone, X strength, X strong
H6697.full: tsûr tsûr tsoor, tsoor From H6696; properly a cliff (or sharp rock, as compressed); generally a rock or boulder; figuratively a refuge; also an edge (as precipitous): - edge, X (mighty) God (one), rock, X sharp, stone, X strength, X strong. See also H1049.

H6698.full: tsûr tsoor The same as H6697; rock; Tsur, the name of a Midianite and of an Israelite: - Zur.

H6699.full: Feminine of H6697; a rock (Job_28:10); also a form (as if pressed out): - form, rock.

H6700.full: From H6697 and H410; rock of God; Tsuriel, an Israelite: - Zuriel.

H6701.full: From H6697 and H7706; rock of (the) Almighty; Tsurishaddai, an Israelite: - Zurishaddai.

H6702.full: tsûth tsooth A primitive root; to blaze: - burn.

H6703.full: tsach tsakh From H6705; dazzling, that is, sunny, bright, (figuratively) evident: - clear, dry, plainly, white.

H6704.full: From an unused root meaning to glow; parched: - dried up.

H6705.full: A primitive root; to glare, that is, be dazzling white: - be whiter.

H6706.full: From H6705; glaring, that is, exposed to the bright sun: - higher place, top.

H6707.full: Feminine of H6706; a parched region, that is, the desert: - dry land.

H6708.full: From H6706; bare spot, that is, in the glaring sun: - higher place.

H6709.full: From an unused root meaning to putrefy; stench: - ill savour.

H6710.full: From H6705; a dry place, that is, desert: - drought.

H6711.full: A primitive root; to laugh outright (in merriment or scorn); by implication to sport: - laugh, mock, play, make sport.

H6712.full: From H6711; laughter (in pleasure or derision): - laugh (-ed to scorn).

H6713.full: From an unused root meaning to dazzle; sheen, that is, whiteness: - white.

H6714.full: From the same as H6713; whiteness; Tsochar, the name of a Hittite and of an Israelite: - Zohar. Compare H3328.

H6715.full: From the same as H6713; white: - white.

H6716.full: tsı̂y tsee From H6680; a ship (as a fixture): - ship.

H6717.full: tsee-baw' From the same as H6678; station; Tsiba, an Israelite: - Ziba.

H6718.firstSense: X catcheth, food, X hunter, (that which he took in) hunting, venison, victuals
H6718.full: From a form of H6679 and meaning the same; the chase; also game (thus taken); (generally) lunch (especially for a journey): - X catcheth, food, X hunter, (that which he took in) hunting, venison, victuals.

H6719.full: From the same as H6718; a huntsman: - hunter.

H6720.full: Feminine of H6718; food: - meat, provision, venison, victuals.

H6721.full: From H6679 in the sense of catching fish; fishery; Tsidon, the name of a son of Canaan, and of a place in Palestine: - Sidon, Zidon.

H6722.full: Patrial from H6721; a Tsidonian or inhabitant of Tsidon: - Sidonian, of Sidon, Zidonian.

H6723.firstSense: barren, drought, dry (land, place), solitary place, wilderness
H6723.full: From an unused root meaning to parch; aridity; concretely a desert: - barren, drought, dry (land, place), solitary place, wilderness.

H6724.full: From the same as H6723; a desert: - dry place.

H6725.full: From the same as H6723 in the sense of conspicuousness (compare H5329); a monumental or guiding pillar: - sign, title, waymark.

H6726.full: The same (regular) as H6725; Tsijon (as a permanent capital), a mountain of Jerusalem: - Zion.

H6727.full: tsee-kahw', tsee-khaw' As if feminine of H6704; drought; Tsicha, the name of two Nethinim: - Ziha.

H6728.firstSense: wild beast of the desert, that dwell in (inhabiting) the wilderness
H6728.full: From the same as H6723; a desert dweller, that is, nomad or wild beast: - wild beast of the desert, that dwell in (inhabiting) the wilderness.

H6729.full: From an unused root meaning to confine; the pillory: - stocks.

H6730.full: From H6819; small; Tsior, a place in Palestine: - Zior.

H6731.full: tsı̂yts tsits tseets, tseets From H6692; properly glistening, that is, a burnished plate; also a flower (as bright colored); a wing (as gleaming in the air): - blossom, flower, plate, wing.

H6732.full: tsı̂yts tseets The same as H6731; bloom; Tsits, a place in Palestine: - Ziz.

H6733.full: Feminine of H6731; a flower: - flower.

H6734.full: Feminine of H6731; a floral or wing like projection, that is, a fore lock of hair, a tassel: - fringe, lock.

H6735.firstSense: ambassador, hinge, messenger, pain, pang, sorrow
H6735.full: tsı̂yr tseer From H6696; a hinge (as pressed in turning); also a throe (as a physical or mental pressure); also a herald or errand doer (as constrained by the principal): - ambassador, hinge, messenger, pain, pang, sorrow. Compare H6736.

H6736.full: tsı̂yr tseer The same as H6735; a form (of beauty; as if pressed out, that is, carved); hence an (idolatrous) image: - beauty, idol.

H6737.full: A denominative from H6735 in the sense of ambassador; to make an errand, that is, betake oneself: - make as if . . . had been ambassador.

H6738.full: tsêl tsale From H6751; shade, whether literally or figuratively: - defence, shade (-ow).

H6739.full: tsel-aw' (Chaldee); probably corresponding to H6760 in the sense of bowing; pray: - pray.

H6740.full: A primitive root; to roast: - roast.

H6741.full: Feminine of H6738; Tsillah, an antediluvian woman: - Zillah.

H6742.full: From H6749 in the sense of rolling; a (round or flattened) cake: - cake.

H6743.firstSense: break out, come (mightily), go over, be good, be meet, be profitable, (cause to, effect…
H6743.full: A primitive root; to push forward, in various senses (literally or figuratively, transitively or intransitively): - break out, come (mightily), go over, be good, be meet, be profitable, (cause to, effect, make to, send) prosper (-ity, -ous, -ously).

H6744.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H6743; to advance (transitively or intransitively): - promote, prosper.

H6745.full: From H6743; something protracted or flattened out, that is, a platter: - pan.

H6746.full: From H6743; something prolonged or tall, that is, a vial or salt cellar: - cruse.

H6747.full: From H6743; something advanced or deep, that is, a bowl; figuratively the bosom: - bosom, dish.

H6748.full: Passive participle of H6740; roasted: - roast.

H6749.full: A primitive root; properly to tumble down, that is, settle by a waving motion: - sink. Compare H6750, H6751.

H6750.full: A primitive root (rather identical with H6749 through the idea of vibration); to tinkle, that is, rattle together (as the ears in reddening with shame, or the teeth in chattering with fear): - quiver, tingle.

H6751.full: A primitive root (rather identical with H6749 through the idea of hovering over (compare H6754)); to shade, as twilight or an opaque object: - begin to be dark, shadowing.

H6753.full: From H6752 and the active participle of H6437; shade facing; Tselelponi, an Israelitess: - Hazelelponi [includ. the article.]

H6754.full: From an unused root meaning to shade; a phantom, that is, (figuratively) illusion, resemblance; hence a representative figure, especially an idol: - image, vain shew.

H6755.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H6754; an idolatrous figure: - form, image.

H6756.full: From H6754; shady; Tsalmon, the name of a place in Palestine and of an Israelite: - Zalmon.

H6757.full: From H6738 and H4194; shade of death, that is, the grave (figuratively calamity): - shadow of death.

H6758.full: Feminine of H6757; shadiness; Tsalmonah, a palce in the Desert: - Zalmonah.

H6759.full: From H6738 and H4513; shade has been denied; Tsalmunna, a Midianite: - Zalmunna.

H6760.full: A primitive root; probably to curve; used only as denominative from H6763, to limp (as if one sided): - halt.

H6761.full: From H6760; a limping or fall (figuratively): - adversity, halt (-ing).

H6762.full: The same as H6761; Tsela, a place in Palestine: - Zelah.

H6763.firstSense: beem, board, chamber, corner, leaf, plank, rib, side (chamber)
H6763.full: From H6760; a rib (as curved), literally (of the body) or figuratively (of a door, that is, leaf); hence a side, literally (of a person) or figuratively (of an object or the sky, that is, quarter); architecturally a timber (especially floor or ceiling) or plank (single or collectively, that is, a flooring): - beem, board, chamber, corner, leaf, plank, rib, side (chamber).

H6764.full: From an unused root of unknown meaning; Tsalaph, an Israelite: - Zalaph.

H6765.full: From the same as H6764 and H259; Tselophchad, an Israelite: - Zelophehad.

H6766.full: From H6738 and H6703; clear shade; Tseltsach, a place in Palestine: - Zelzah.

H6767.full: From H6750 reduplicated; a clatter, that is, (abstractly) whirring (of wings); (concretely) a cricket; also a harpoon (as rattling), a cymbal (as clanging): - cymbal, locust, shadowing, spear.

H6768.full: From an unused root meaning to split; fissure; Tselek, an Israelite: - Zelek.

H6769.full: From the feminine of H6738; shady; Tsillethai, the anme of two Israelites: - Zilthai.

H6770.full: A primitive root; to thirst (literally or figuratively): - (be a-, suffer) thirst (-y).

H6771.full: From H6770; thirsty (literally or figuratively): - (that) thirst (-eth, -y).

H6772.full: From H6770; thirst (literally or figuratively): - thirst (-y).

H6773.full: tsim-aw' Feminine of H6772; thirst (figuratively of libidinousnes): - thirst.

H6774.full: tsim-maw-one' From H6771; a thirsty place, that is, desert: - drought, dry ground, thirsty land.

H6775.full: A primitive root; to link, that is, gird; figuratively to serve, (mentally) contrive: - fasten, frame, join (self).

H6776.firstSense: acre, couple, X together, two [asses], yoke (of oxen)
H6776.full: A yoke or team (that is, pair); hence an acre (that is, day's task for a yoke of cattle to plough): - acre, couple, X together, two [asses], yoke (of oxen).

H6777.full: From an unused root meaning to fasten on; a veil: - locks.

H6778.full: From H6784; a cake of dried grapes: - bunch (cluster) of raisins.

H6779.firstSense: bear, bring forth, (cause to, make to) bud (forth), (cause to, make to) grow (again, up…
H6779.full: A primitive root; to sprout (transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively): - bear, bring forth, (cause to, make to) bud (forth), (cause to, make to) grow (again, up), (cause to) spring (forth, up).

H6780.firstSense: branch, bud, that which (where) grew (upon), spring (-ing)
H6780.full: From H6779; a sprout (usually concretely), literally or figuratively: - branch, bud, that which (where) grew (upon), spring (-ing).

H6781.full: From H6775; a bracelet or arm clasp; generally a lid: - bracelet, covering.

H6782.full: From the same as H6777; a noose (as fastening); figuratively destruction: - robber.

H6783.full: From H6789; excision, that is, destruction; used only (adverbially) with prepositional prefix to extinction, that is, perpetually: - ever.

H6784.full: A primitive root; to dry up: - dry.

H6785.full: From an unused root probably meaning to be shaggy; wool: - wool (-len).

H6786.full: Patrial from an unused name of a place in Palestine; a Tsemarite or branch of the Canaanites: - Zemarite.

H6787.full: Dual of H6785; double fleece; Tsemarajim, a place in Palestine: - Zemaraim.

H6788.full: From the same as H6785; fleeciness, that is, foliage: - highest branch, top.

H6789.full: A primitive root; to extirpate (literally or figuratively): - consume, cut off, destroy, vanish.

H6790.full: tsin tseen From an unused root meaning to prick; a crag; Tsin, a part of the Desert: - Zin.

H6791.full: tsên tsane From an unused root meaning to be prickly; a thorn; hence a cactus hedge: - thorn.

H6792.full: tso-nay', tso-neh' For H6629; a flock: - sheep.

H6793.full: Feminine of H6791; a hook (as pointed); also a (large) shield (as if guarding by prickliness); also cold (as piercing): - buckler, cold, hook, shield, target.

H6794.full: From an unused root perhaps meaning to be hollow; a culvert: - gutter, water-spout.

H6795.full: A primitive root; to alight; (transitively) to cause to descend, that is, drive down: - fasten, light [from off].

H6796.full: From the same as H6791; a thorn: - thorn.

H6797.full: From H6801; a head dress (that is, piece of cloth wrapped around): - diadem, hood, mitre.

H6798.full: A primitive root; to blast or shrink: - withered.

H6799.full: Probably for H6630; Tsenan, a place near Palestine: - Zenan.

H6800.full: A primitive root; to humiliate: - humbly, lowly.

H6801.firstSense: be attired, X surely, violently turn
H6801.full: A primitive root; to wrap, that is, roll or dress: - be attired, X surely, violently turn.

H6802.full: From H6801; a ball: - X toss.

H6803.full: From the same as H6791; a vase (probably a vial tapering at the top): - pot.

H6804.full: Probably from the same as H6794; a tube: - pipe.

H6805.full: A primitive root; to pace, that is, step regularly; (upward) to mount; (along) to march; (down and causatively) to hurl: - bring, go, march (through), run over.

H6806.full: From H6804; a pace or regular step: - pace, step.

H6807.full: Feminine of H6806; a march; (concretely) an (ornamental) ankle chain: - going, ornament of the legs.

H6808.full: A primitive root; to tip over (for the purpose of spilling or pouring out), that is, (figuratively) depopulate; by implication to imprison or conquer; (reflexively) to lie down (for coition): - captive exile, travelling, (cause to) wander (-er).

H6809.full: From an unused root meaning to wrap over; a veil: - vail.

H6810.full: From H6819; little; (in number) few; (in age) young, (in value) ignoble: - least, little (one), small (one), + young (-er, -est).

H6811.full: The same as H6810; Tsair, a place in Idumaea: - Zair.

H6812.full: Feiminine of H6810; smallness (of age), that is, juvenility: - youth.

H6813.full: A primitive root; to load up (beasts), that is, to migrate: - be taken down.

H6814.full: Of Egyptian derivation; Tsoan, a place in Egypt: - Zoan.

H6815.full: Plural from H6813; removals; Tsaanannim or Tsaanajim, a place in Palestine: - Zaannannim, Zaanaim.

H6816.full: From an unused root meaning to bestrew with carvings; sculpture: - image [work].

H6817.firstSense: X at all, call together, cry (out), gather (selves) (together)
H6817.full: A primitive root; to shriek; (by implication) to proclaim (an assembly): - X at all, call together, cry (out), gather (selves) (together).

H6819.firstSense: be brought low, little one, be small
H6819.full: A primitive root; to be small, that is, (figuratively) ignoble: - be brought low, little one, be small.

H6820.full: From H6819; little; Tsoar, a place East of the Jordan: - Zoar.

H6821.full: A primitive root; to adhere: - cleave.

H6822.firstSense: behold, espy, look up (well), wait for, (keep the) watch (-man)
H6822.full: A primitive root; properly to lean forward, that is, to peer into the distance; by implication to observe, await: - behold, espy, look up (well), wait for, (keep the) watch (-man).

H6823.full: A primitive root (probably rather identical with H6822 through the idea of expansion in outlook transformed to act); to sheet over (especially with metal): - cover, overlay.

H6824.full: From H6823; an inundation (as covering): - X swimmest.

H6825.full: From H6822; observant; Tsepho or Tsephi, an Idumaean: - Zephi, Zepho.

H6826.full: From H6823; encasement (with metal): - covering, overlaying.

H6827.full: Probably for H6837; Tsephon, an Israelite: - Zephon.

H6828.full: From H6845; properly hidden, that is, dark; used only of the north as a quarter (gloomy and unknown): - north (-ern, side, -ward, wind).

H6829.full: The same as H6828; boreal; Tsaphon, a place in Palestine: - Zaphon.

H6831.full: Patronymic from H6827; a Tsephonite, or (collectively) a descendant of Tsephon: - Zephonites.

H6832.full: From the same as H6848; excrement (as protruded): - dung.

H6833.full: From H6852; a little bird (as hopping): - bird, fowl, sparrow.

H6834.full: The same as H6833; Tsippor, a Moabite: - Zippor.

H6835.full: From an unused root meaning to expand; a saucer (as flat): - cruse.

H6837.full: From H6822; watch tower; Tsiphjon, an Israelite: - Ziphion. Compare H6827.

H6838.full: From the same as H6835; a flat thin cake: - wafer.

H6839.full: Plural of active participle of H6822; watchers; Tsophim, a place East of Jordan: - Zophim.

H6840.full: From H6845; a treasure (as hidden): - hid.

H6841.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H6842; a he goat: - he [goat].

H6842.full: From H6852; a male goat (as prancing): - (he) goat.

H6843.full: Feminine formed like H6842; a crown (as encircling the head); also a turn of affairs (that is, mishap): - diadem, morning.

H6845.firstSense: esteem, hide (-den one, self), lay up, lurk (be set) privily, (keep) secret (-ly, place)
H6845.full: A primitive root; to hide (by covering over); by implication to hoard or reserve; figuratively to deny; specifically (favorably) to protect, (unfavorably) to lurk: - esteem, hide (-den one, self), lay up, lurk (be set) privily, (keep) secret (-ly, place).

H6846.full: From H6845 and H3050; Jah has secreted; Tsephanjah, the name of four Israelites: - Zephaniah.

H6847.full: Of Egyptian derivation; Tsophnath-Paneach, Joseph's Egyptian name: - Zaphnath-paaneah.

H6848.full: From an unused root meaning to extrude; a viper (as thrusting out the tongue, that is, hissing): - adder, cockatrice.

H6849.full: Feminine from the same as H6848; an outcast thing: - issue.

H6850.full: A primitive root; to coo or chirp (as a bird): - chatter, peep, whisper.

H6851.full: From H6687; a willow (as growing in overflowed places): - willow tree.

H6852.full: A primitive root; to skip about, that is, return: - depart early.

H6853.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H6833; a bird: - bird.

H6854.full: From H6852 and a word elsewhere unused meaning a swamp; a marsh leaper, that is, frog: - frog.

H6855.full: Feminine of H6833; bird; tsipporah, Moses' wife: - Zipporah.

H6856.full: From H6852 (in the denominative sense (from H6833) of scratching); properly a claw, that is, (human) nail; also the point of a style (or pen, tipped with adamant): - nail, point.

H6857.full: From H6822; watch tower; Tsephath, a place in Palestine: - Zephath.

H6858.full: From an unused root meaning to encircle; a capital of a column: - chapiter.

H6859.full: The same as H6857; Tsephathah, a place in Palestine: - Zephathah.

H6860.full: Of uncertain derivation; Tsiklag or Tsikelag, a place in Palestine: - Ziklag.

H6861.full: From an unused root meaning to wind; a sack (as tied at the mouth): - husk.

H6862.firstSense: adversary, afflicted (-tion), anguish, close, distress, enemy, flint, foe, narrow, smal…
H6862.full: tsar tsâr tsar, tsawr From H6887; narrow; (as a noun) a tight place (usually figuratively, that is, trouble); also a pebble (as in H6864); (transitively) an opponent (as crowding): - adversary, afflicted (-tion), anguish, close, distress, enemy, flint, foe, narrow, small, sorrow, strait, tribulation, trouble.

H6863.full: tsêr tsare From H6887; Tser, a place in Palestine: - Zer.

H6864.full: tsôr tsore From H6696; a stone (as if pressed hard or to a point); (by implication of use) a knife: - flint, sharp stone.

H6865.full: tsôr tsôr tsore, tsore The same as H6864; a rock; Tsor, a place in Palestine: - Tyre, Tyrus.

H6866.full: A primitive root; to burn: - burn.

H6867.full: From H6686; conflagration (of fire or disease): - burning, inflammation.

H6868.full: Apparently from an unused root meaning to pierce; puncture; Tseredah, a place in Palestine: - Zereda, Zeredathah.

H6869.firstSense: adversary, adversity, affliction, anguish, distress, tribulation, trouble
H6869.full: Feminine of H6862; tightness (that is, figuratively trouble); transitively a female rival: - adversary, adversity, affliction, anguish, distress, tribulation, trouble.

H6870.full: Feminine participle passive from the same as H6875; wounded; Tserujah, an Israelitess: - Zeruiah.

H6871.full: Feminine passive participle of H6879; leprous; Tseruah, an Israelitess: - Zeruah.

H6872.firstSense: bag, X bendeth, bundle, least grain, small stone
H6872.full: From H6887; a parcel (as packed up); also a kernel or particle (as if a package): - bag, X bendeth, bundle, least grain, small stone.

H6873.full: A primitive root; to be clear (in tone, that is, shrill), that is, to whoop: - cry, roar.

H6874.full: The same as H6875; Tseri, an Israelite: - Zeri. Compare H3340.

H6875.full: From an unused root meaning to crack (as by pressure), hence to leak; distillation, that is, balsam: - balm.

H6876.full: Patrial from H6865; a Tsorite or inhabitant of Tsor (that is, Syrian): - (man) of Tyre.

H6877.full: From H6873 in the sense of clearness of vision; a citadel: - high place, hold.

H6878.full: From an unused root meaning to need; need: - need.

H6879.full: A primitive root; to scourge, that is, (intransitively and figuratively) to be stricken with leprosy: - leper, leprous.

H6880.full: From H6879; a wasp (as stinging): - hornet.

H6881.full: Apparently another form for H6880; Tsorah, a place in Palestine: - Zareah, Zorah, Zoreah.

H6882.full: Patrial from H6881; a Tsorite or Tsorathite, that is, inhabitant of Tsorah: - Zorites, Zareathites, Zorathites.

H6884.firstSense: cast, (re-) fine (-er), founder, goldsmith, melt, pure, purge away, try
H6884.full: A primitive root; to fuse (metal), that is, refine (literally or figuratively): - cast, (re-) fine (-er), founder, goldsmith, melt, pure, purge away, try.

H6885.full: From H6884; refiner; Tsorephi (with the article), an Israelite: - goldsmith's.

H6886.full: From H6884; refinement; Tsarephath, a place in Palestine: - Zarephath.

H6887.firstSense: adversary, (be in) afflict (-ion), besiege, bind (up), (be in, bring) distress, enemy,…
H6887.full: A primitive root; to cramp, literally or figuratively, transitively or intransitively: - adversary, (be in) afflict (-ion), besiege, bind (up), (be in, bring) distress, enemy, narrower, oppress, pangs, shut up, be in a strait (trouble), vex.

H6888.full: Apparently by erroneous transcription for H6868; Tsererah for Tseredah: - Zereath.

H6889.full: Perhaps from H6671; splendor; Tsereth, an Israelite: - Zereth.

H6890.full: From the same as H6889 and H7837 with the article interposed; splendor of the dawn; Tsereth hash Shachar, a place in Palestine: - Zareth-shahar.

H6891.full: Perhaps for H6868; Tsarethan, a place in Palestine: - Zarthan.

H6893.full: kaw-ath' From H6958; probably the pelican (from vomiting): - cormorant.

H6894.full: qab kab From H6895; a hollow, that is, vessel used as a (dry) measure: - cab.

H6895.full: A primitive root; to scoop out, that is, (figuratively) to malign or execrate (that is, stab with words): - X at all, curse.

H6896.full: From H6895; the paunch (as a cavity) or first stomach of ruminants: - maw.

H6897.full: From H6895; the abdomen (as a cavity): - belly.

H6898.full: From H6895; a pavilion (as a domed cavity): - tent.

H6900.full: Feminine passive participle of H6912; sepulture; (concretely) a sepulchre: - burial, burying place, grave, sepulchre.

H6901.full: A primitive root; to admit, that is, take (literally or figuratively): - choose, (take) hold, receive, (under-) take.

H6902.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H6901; to acquire: - receive, take.

H6903.firstSense: + accounting to, + as, + because, before, + for this cause, + forasmuch as, + by this m…
H6903.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H6905; (adverbially) in front of; usually (with other particles) on account of, so as, since, hence: - + accounting to, + as, + because, before, + for this cause, + forasmuch as, + by this means, over against, by reason of, + that, + therefore, + though, + wherefore.

H6904.full: From H6901 in the sense of confronting (as standing opposite in order to receive); a battering ram: - war.

H6905.full: From H6901 in the sense of opposite (see H6904); the presence, that is, (adverbially) in front of: - before.

H6906.full: A primitive root; to cover, that is, (figuratively) defraud: - rob, spoil.

H6907.full: From H6906; a goblet (as deep like a cover): - dregs.

H6908.firstSense: assemble (selves), gather (bring) (together, selves together, up), heap, resort, X sure…
H6908.full: A primitive root; to grasp, that is, collect: - assemble (selves), gather (bring) (together, selves together, up), heap, resort, X surely, take up.

H6909.full: keb-tseh-ale' From H6908 and H410; God has gathered; Kabtseel, a place in Palestine: - Kabzeel. Compare H3343.

H6910.full: Feminine passive participle of H6908; a hoard: - X gather.

H6911.full: Dual from H6908; a double heap; Kibtsajim, a place in Palestine: - Kibzaim.

H6912.full: A primitive root; to inter: - X in any wise, bury (-ier).

H6913.full: From H6912; a sepulchre: - burying place, grave, sepulchre.

H6914.full: kib-roth' hat-tah-av-aw' From the feminine plural of H6913 and H8378 with the article inteposed; graves of the longing; Kibroth hat Taavh, a place in the Desert: - Kibroth-hattaavah.

H6915.full: A primitive root; to shrivel up, that is, contract or bend the body (or neck) in deference: - bow (down) (the) head, stoop.

H6916.full: From H6915; cassia bark (as in shrivelled rolls): - cassia.

H6917.full: Passive participle of H6923; a pristine hero: - ancient.

H6918.full: From H6942; sacred (ceremonially or morally); (as noun) God (by eminence), an angel, a saint, a sanctuary: - holy (One), saint.

H6919.full: A primitive root to inflame: - burn, kindle.

H6920.full: From H6919; inflammation, that is, febrile disease: - burning ague, fever.

H6921.full: From H6923; the fore or front part; hence (by orientation) the East (often adverbially eastward, for brevity the East wind): - east (-ward, wind).

H6923.full: A primitive root; to project (one self), that is, precede; hence to anticipate, hasten, meet (usually for help): - come (go, [flee]) before, + disappoint, meet, prevent.

H6924.firstSense: aforetime, ancient (time), before, east (end, part, side, -ward), eternal, X ever (-las…
H6924.full: From H6923; the front, of palce (absolutely the fore part, relatively the East) or time (antiquity); often used adverbially (before, anciently, eastward): - aforetime, ancient (time), before, east (end, part, side, -ward), eternal, X ever (-lasting), forward, old, past. Compare H6926.

H6925.firstSense: before, X from, X I (thought), X me, + of, X it pleased, presence
H6925.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H6924; before: - before, X from, X I (thought), X me, + of, X it pleased, presence.

H6926.full: Feminine of H6924; the forward part (or relatively) East (often adverbially on the East or in front): - east (-ward).

H6927.full: From H6923; priority (in time); also used adverbially (before): - afore, antiquity, former (old) estate.

H6928.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H6927; former time: - afore [-time], ago.

H6929.full: From H6923; precedence; Kedemah, a son of Ishmael: - Kedemah.

H6931.firstSense: ancient, they that went before, east, (thing of) old
H6931.full: From H6930; (of time) anterior or (of place) oriental: - ancient, they that went before, east, (thing of) old.

H6932.full: From H6923; beginnings; Kedemoth, a place in eastern Palestine: - Kedemoth.

H6933.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H6923; first: - first.

H6934.full: kad-mee-ale' From H6924 and H410; presence of God; Kadmiel, the name of three Israelites: - Kadmiel.

H6935.full: The same as H6931; ancient, that is, aboriginal; Kadmonite (collectively), the name of a tribe in Palestine: - Kadmonites.

H6936.firstSense: crown (of the head), pate, scalp, top of the head
H6936.full: From H6915; the crown of the head (as the part most bowed): - crown (of the head), pate, scalp, top of the head.

H6937.firstSense: be black (-ish), be (make) dark (-en), X heavily, (cause to) mourn
H6937.full: A primitive root; to be ashy, that is, dark colored; by implication to mourn (in sackcloth or sordid garments): - be black (-ish), be (make) dark (-en), X heavily, (cause to) mourn.

H6938.full: From H6937; dusky (of the skin or the tent); Kedar, a son of Ishmael; also (collectively) bedawin (as his descendants or representatives): - Kedar.

H6939.full: From H6937; dusky place; Kidron, a brook near Jerusalem: - Kidron.

H6941.full: Adverb from H6937; blackish ones (that is, in sackcloth); used adverbially in mourning weeds: - mournfully.

H6942.firstSense: appoint, bid, consecrate, dedicate, defile, hallow, (be, keep) holy (-er, place), keep,…
H6942.full: A primitive root; to be (causatively make, pronounce or observe as) clean (ceremonially or morally): - appoint, bid, consecrate, dedicate, defile, hallow, (be, keep) holy (-er, place), keep, prepare, proclaim, purify, sanctify (-ied one, self), X wholly.

H6943.full: From H6942; a sanctum; Kedesh, the name of four places in Palestine: - Kedesh.

H6944.firstSense: consecrated (thing), dedicated (thing), hallowed (thing), holiness, (X most) holy (X da…
H6944.full: From H6942; a sacred place or thing; rarely abstractly sanctity: - consecrated (thing), dedicated (thing), hallowed (thing), holiness, (X most) holy (X day, portion, thing), saint, sanctuary.

H6945.full: From H6942; a (quasi) sacred person, that is, (technically) a (male) devotee (by prostitution) to licentious idolatry: - sodomite, unclean.

H6946.full: The same as H6945; sanctuary; Kadesh, a place in the Desert: - Kadesh. Compare H6947.

H6947.full: From the same as H6946 and an otherwise unused word (apparently compounded of a correspondent to H1251 and a derivative of H5128) meaning desert of a fugitive; Kadesh of (the) Wilderness of Wandering; Kadesh-Barnea, a place in the Desert: - Kadesh-barnea.

H6948.full: Feminine of H6945; a female devotee (that is, prostitute): - harlot, whore.

H6949.firstSense: be set on edge, be blunt
H6949.full: A primitive root; to be dull: - be set on edge, be blunt.

H6950.full: A primitive root; to convoke: - assemble (selves) (together), gather (selves) (together).

H6951.full: From H6950; assemblage (usually concretely): - assembly, company, congregation, multitude.

H6952.full: From H6950; an assemblage: - assembly, congregation.

H6953.full: Feminine of active participle from H6950; a (female) assembler (that is, lecturer); abstractly preaching (used as a 'nom de plume', Koheleth): - preacher.

H6954.full: From H6950; convocation; Kehelathah, a place in the Desert: - Kehelathah.

H6955.full: From an unused root meaning to ally oneself; allied; Kehath, an Israelite: - Kohath.

H6956.full: Patronymic from H6955; a Kohathite (collectively) or descendant of Kehath: - Kohathites.

H6957.full: qav qâv kav, kawv From H6960 (compare H6961); a cord (as connecting), especially for measuring; figuratively a rule; also a rim, a musical string or accord: - line. Compare H6978.

H6958.full: A primitive root; to vomit: - spue (out), vomit (out, up, up again).

H6959.full: A form collateral to H3553; a helmet: - helmet.

H6960.firstSense: gather (together), look, patiently, tarry, wait (for, on, upon)
H6960.full: A primitive root; to bind together (perhaps by twisting), that is, collect; (figuratively) to expect: - gather (together), look, patiently, tarry, wait (for, on, upon).

H6961.full: From H6960; a (measuring) cord (as if for binding): - line.

H6962.full: A primitive root; properly to cut off, that is, (figuratively) detest: - be grieved, lothe self.

H6963.firstSense: + aloud, bleating, crackling, cry (+ out), fame, lightness, lowing, noise, + hold peace…
H6963.full: qôl qôl kole, kole From an unused root meaning to call aloud; a voice or sound: - + aloud, bleating, crackling, cry (+ out), fame, lightness, lowing, noise, + hold peace, [pro-] claim, proclamation, + sing, sound, + spark, thunder (-ing), voice, + yell.

H6964.full: From H6963 and H3050; voice of Jah; Kolajah, the name of two Israelites: - Kolaiah.
