H6965.firstSense: abide, accomplish, X be clearer, confirm, continue, decree, X be dim, endure, X enemy,…
H6965.full: qûm koom A primitive root; to rise (in various applications, literally, figuratively, intensively and causatively): - abide, accomplish, X be clearer, confirm, continue, decree, X be dim, endure, X enemy, enjoin, get up, make good, help, hold, (help to) lift up (again), make, X but newly, ordain, perform, pitch, raise (up), rear (up), remain, (a-) rise (up) (again, against), rouse up, set (up), (e-) stablish, (make to) stand (up), stir up, strengthen, succeed, (as-, make) sure (-ly), (be) up (-hold, -rising).

H6966.firstSense: appoint, establish, make, raise up self, (a-) rise (up), (make to) stand, set (up)
H6966.full: qûm koom (Chaldee); corresponding to H6965: - appoint, establish, make, raise up self, (a-) rise (up), (make to) stand, set (up).

H6967.firstSense: X along, height, high, stature, tall
H6967.full: From H6965; height: - X along, height, high, stature, tall.

H6968.full: From H6965; elevation, that is, (adverbially) erectly (figuratively): - upright.

H6969.full: qûn koon A primitive root; to strike a musical note, that is, chant or wail (at a funeral): - lament, mourning woman.

H6970.full: Probably from H6972 in the original sense of cutting off; curtailment; Koa, a region of Babylon: - Koa.

H6971.full: qôph qôph kofe, kofe Probably of foreign origin; a monkey: - ape.

H6972.full: qûts koots A primitive root; to clip off; used only as denominative from H7019; to spend the harvest season: - summer.

H6973.firstSense: abhor, be distressed, be grieved, loathe, vex, be weary
H6973.full: qûts koots A primitive root (rather identical with H6972 through the idea of severing oneself from (compare H6962)); to be (causatively make) disgusted or anxious: - abhor, be distressed, be grieved, loathe, vex, be weary.

H6974.full: qûts koots A primitive root (rather identical with H6972 through the idea of abruptness in starting up from sleep (compare H3364)); to awake (literally or figuratively): - arise, (be) (a-) wake, watch.

H6975.full: qôts qôts kotse, kotse From H6972 (in the sense of pricking); a thorn: - thorn.

H6976.full: qôts kotse The same as H6975; Kots, the name of two Israelites: - Koz, Hakkoz [includ. the article.]

H6977.full: Feminine passive participle of H6972 in its original sense; a forelock (as shorn): - lock.

H6978.full: From H6957 (in the sense of a fastening); stalwart: - X meted out.

H6979.firstSense: break down, cast out, destroy, dig
H6979.full: qûr koor A primitive root; to trench; by implication to throw forth; also (denominative from H7023) to wall up, whether literally (to build a wall) or figuratively (to estop): - break down, cast out, destroy, dig.

H6980.full: qûr koor From H6979; (only plural) trenches, that is, a web (as if so formed): - web.

H6981.full: Active participle of H7121; crier; Kore, the name of two Israelites: - Kore.

H6982.full: From H6979; a rafter (forming trenches as it were); by implication a roof: - beam, roof.

H6983.full: qôsh koshe A primitive root; to bend; used only as denominative for H3369, to set a trap: - lay a snare.

H6984.full: From the passive participle of H6983 and H3050; entrapped of Jah; Kushajah, an Israelite: - Kushaiah.

H6985.full: From H6990 in the sense of abbreviation; a little, that is, (adverbially) merely: - very.

H6986.full: From an unused root meaning to cut off; ruin: - destroying, destruction.

H6987.full: From the same as H6986; extermination: - destruction.

H6989.full: Feminine passive participle of H6999; perfumed; Keturah, a wife of Abraham: - Keturah.

H6990.full: A primitive root; to clip off, that is, (figuratively) destroy: - be cut off.

H6991.full: A primitive root; properly to cut off, that is, (figuratively) put to death: - kill, slay.

H6992.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H6991; to kill: - slay.

H6993.full: From H6991; a violent death: - slaughter.

H6994.firstSense: be a (make) small (thing), be not worthy
H6994.full: A primitive root (rather denominative from H6996); to diminish, that is, be (causatively make) diminutive or (figuratively) of no account: - be a (make) small (thing), be not worthy.

H6995.full: From H6994; a pettiness, that is, the little finger: - little finger.

H6996.firstSense: least, less (-ser), little (one), small (-est, one, quantity, thing), young (-er, -est)
H6996.full: From H6962; abbreviated, that is, diminutive, literally (in quantity, size or number) or figuratively (in age or importance): - least, less (-ser), little (one), small (-est, one, quantity, thing), young (-er, -est).

H6997.full: The same as H6996; small; Katan, an Israelite: - Hakkatan [includ. the article.]

H6998.full: A primitive root; to strip off: - crop off, cut down (up), pluck.

H6999.firstSense: burn (incense, sacrifice) (upon), (altar for) incense, kindle, offer (incense, a sacrif…
H6999.full: A primitive root (rather identical with H7000 through the idea of fumigation in a close place and perhaps thus driving out the occupants); to smoke, that is, turn into fragrance by fire (especially as an act of worship): - burn (incense, sacrifice) (upon), (altar for) incense, kindle, offer (incense, a sacrifice).

H7000.full: A primitive root; to inclose: - join.

H7001.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H7000; a knot (as tied up), that is, (figuratively) a riddle; also a vertebra (as if a knot): - doubt, joint.

H7003.full: From H6999; fumigative; Kitron, a place in Palestine: - Kitron.

H7004.full: From H6999; a fumigation: - (sweet) incense, perfume.

H7005.full: From H6996; littleness, Kattath, a place in Palestine: - Kattath.

H7006.full: A primitive root; to vomit: - spue.

H7008.full: From H6999; a fume, that is, cloud: - smoke, vapour.

H7009.full: qı̂ym keem From H6965; an opponent (as rising against one), that is, (collectively) enemies: - substance.

H7010.full: (Chaldee); from H6966; an edict (as arising in law): - decree, statute.

H7011.full: (Chaldee); from H6966; permanent (a rising firmly): - stedfast, sure.

H7012.full: From H6965; an arising: - rising up.

H7013.full: From H6969 in the original sense of fixity; a lance (as striking fast): - spear.

H7014.full: The same as H7013 (with a play upon the affinity to H7069); Kajin, the name of the first child, also of a place in Palestine, and of an Oriental tribe: - Cain, Kenite (-s).

H7015.full: From H6969; a dirge (as accompanied by beating the breasts or on instruments): - lamentation.

H7016.full: The same as H7015; Kinah, a place in Palestine: - Kinah.

H7017.full: Patronymic from H7014; a Kenite or member of the tribe of Kajin: - Kenite.

H7018.full: From the same as H7064; fixed; Kenan, an antediluvian: - Cainan, Kenan.

H7019.full: From H6972; harvest (as the crop), whether the product (grain or fruit) or the (dry) season: - summer (fruit, house).

H7021.full: Perhaps from H7006; the gourd (as nauseous): - gourd.

H7022.full: From H7036; intense disgrace: - shameful spewing.

H7023.firstSense: + mason, side, town, X very, wall
H7023.full: From H6979; a wall (as built in a trench): - + mason, side, town, X very, wall.

H7024.full: qı̂yr keer The same as H7023; fortress; Kir, a place in Assyrian; also one in Moab: - Kir. Compare H7025.

H7025.full: From H7023 and H2789; fortress of earthenware; Kir-Cheres or Kir-Chares-eth, a place in Moab: - Kir-haraseth, Kir-hareseth, Kir-haresh, Kir-heres.

H7026.full: From the same as H7166; ankled; Keros, one of the Nethinim: - Keros.

H7027.full: qı̂ysh keesh From H6983; a bow; Kish, the name of five Israelites: - Kish.

H7028.full: From H6983; winding; Kishon, a river of Palestine: - Kishon, Kison.

H7029.full: From H6983; bowed; Kishi, an Israelite: - Kishi.

H7030.full: (Chaldee); Of Greek origin [H2788]; a lyre: - harp.

H7031.full: qal kal Contracted from H7043; light; (by implication) rapid (also adverbially): - light, swift (-ly).

H7032.full: qâl kawl (Chaldee); corresponding to H6963: - sound, voice.

H7033.full: A primitive root (rather identical with H7034 through the idea of shrinkage by heat); to toast, that is, scorch partially or slowly: - dried, loathsome, parch, roast.

H7034.firstSense: base, contemn, despise, lightly esteem, set light, seem vile
H7034.full: A primitive root; to be light (as implied in rapid motion), but figuratively only (be (causatively hold) in contempt): - base, contemn, despise, lightly esteem, set light, seem vile.

H7035.full: For H6950; to assemble: - gather together.

H7036.full: From H7034; disgrace; (by implication) the pudenda: - confusion, dishonour, ignominy, reproach, shame.

H7037.full: Apparently but a form for H6747; a kettle: - caldron.

H7038.full: A primitive root; to maim: - lacking in his parts.

H7039.full: From H7033; roasted ears of grain: - parched corn.

H7040.full: From H7043; frivolous; Kallai, an Israelite: - Kallai.

H7041.full: From H7034; insignificance; Kelajah, an Israelite: - Kelaiah.

H7042.full: From H7038; maiming; Kelita, the name of three Israelites: - Kelita.

H7043.firstSense: abate, make bright, bring into contempt, (ac-) curse, despise, (be) ease (-y, -ier), (b…
H7043.full: A primitive root; to be (causatively make) light, literally (swift, small, sharp, etc.) or figuratively (easy, trifling, vile, etc.): - abate, make bright, bring into contempt, (ac-) curse, despise, (be) ease (-y, -ier), (be a, make, make somewhat, move, seem a, set) light (-en, -er, ly, -ly afflict, -ly esteem, thing), X slight [-ly], be swift (-er), (be, be more, make, re-) vile, whet.

H7044.full: From H7043; brightened (as if sharpened): - burnished, pol-ished.

H7046.full: A primitive root; to disparage, that is, ridicule: - mock, scoff, scorn.

H7047.full: From H7046; a laughing stock: - derision.

H7049.full: A primitive root; to sling; also to carve (as if a circular motion, or into light forms): - carve, sling (out).

H7050.full: From H7049; a sling; also a (door) screen (as if slung across), or the valve (of the door) itself: - hanging, leaf, sling.

H7051.full: Intensive from H7049; a slinger: - slinger.

H7053.full: From an unused root meaning to prick; a prong, that is, hay fork: - fork.

H7054.full: Feminine of active participle of H6965; something that rises, that is, a stalk of grain: - (standing) corn, grown up, stalk.

H7055.full: kem-oo-ale' From H6965 and H410; raised of God; Kemuel, the name of a relative of Abraham, and of two Israelites: - Kemuel.

H7056.full: From H6965; an elevation; Kamon, a place East of the Jordan: - Camon.

H7057.full: From an unused root meaning to sting; a prickly plant: - nettle. Compare H7063.

H7058.full: From an unused root probably meaning to grind; flour: - flour, meal.

H7059.full: A primitive root; to pluck, that is, destroy: - cut down, fill with wrinkles.

H7060.full: A primitive root; to wither: - hew down, wither.

H7061.full: A primitive root; to grasp with the hand: - take an handful.

H7062.full: From H7061; a grasp, that is, handful: - handful.

H7063.full: From the same as H7057; a prickly plant: - thorn.

H7064.full: qên kane Contracted from H7077; a nest (as fixed), sometimes including the nestlings; figuratively a chamber or dwelling: - nest, room.

H7065.firstSense: (be) envy (-ious), be (move to, provoke to) jealous (-y), X very, (be) zeal (-ous)
H7065.full: A primitive root; to be (causatively make) zealous, that is, (in a bad sense) jealous or envious: - (be) envy (-ious), be (move to, provoke to) jealous (-y), X very, (be) zeal (-ous).

H7066.full: ken-aw' (Chaldee); corresponding to H7069; to purchase: - buy.

H7067.full: kan-naw' From H7065; jealous: - jealous. Compare H7072.

H7068.full: kin-aw' From H7065; jealousy or envy: - envy (-ied), jealousy, X sake, zeal.

H7069.firstSense: attain, buy (-er), teach to keep cattle, get, provoke to jealousy, possess (-or), purch…
H7069.full: A primitive root; to erect, that is, create; by extension to procure, especially by purchase (causatively sell); by implication to own: - attain, buy (-er), teach to keep cattle, get, provoke to jealousy, possess (-or), purchase, recover, redeem, X surely, X verily.

H7070.firstSense: balance, bone, branch, calamus, cane, reed, X spearman, stalk
H7070.full: From H7069; a reed (as erect); by resemblance a rod (especially for measuring), shaft, tube, stem, the radius (of the arm), beam (of a steelyard): - balance, bone, branch, calamus, cane, reed, X spearman, stalk.

H7071.full: Feminine of H7070; reediness; Kanah, the name of a stream and of a place in Palestine: - Kanah.

H7072.full: kan-no' For H7067; jealous or angry: - jealous.

H7073.full: Probably from an unused root meaning to hunt; hunter; Kenaz, the name of an Edomite and of two Israelites: - Kenaz.

H7074.full: Patronymic from H7073, a Kenizzite or descendant of Kenaz: - Kenezite, Kenizzites.

H7075.firstSense: getting, goods, X with money, riches, substance
H7075.full: From H7069; creation, that is, (concretely) creatures; also acquisition, purchase, wealth: - getting, goods, X with money, riches, substance.

H7076.full: From an unused root (meaning to erect); cinnamon bark (as in upright rolls): - cinnamon.

H7077.full: A primitive root; to erect; but used only as denominative from H7064; to nestle, that is, build or occupy as a nest: - make . . . nest.

H7078.full: From an unused root probably meaning to wrench; perversion: - end.

H7079.full: From H7069; possession; Kenath, a place East of the Jordan: - Kenath.

H7080.full: A primitive root; properly to distribute, that is, determine by lot or magical scroll; by implication to divine: - divine (-r, -ation), prudent, soothsayer, use [divination].

H7081.full: From H7080; a lot; also divination (including its fee), oracle: - (reward of) divination, divine sentence, witchcraft.

H7082.full: A primitive root; to lop off: - cut off.

H7083.full: From the same as H3563 (or as H7185); properly a cup, that is, an ink stand: - inkhorn.

H7084.full: Perhaps from H7049 in the sense of inclosing; citadel; Keilah, a place in Palestine: - Keilah.

H7085.full: From the same as H6970; an incision or gash: - + mark.

H7086.full: Probably from H7167; a bowl (as cut out hollow): - charger, dish.

H7087.full: A primitive root; to shrink, that is, thicken (as unracked wine, curdled milk, clouded sky, frozen water): - congeal, curdle, dark`, settle.

H7088.full: A primitive root; to contract, that is, roll together: - cut off.

H7089.full: From H7088; shrinking, that is, terror: - destruction.

H7090.full: From H7088; a species of bird, perhaps the bittern (from its contracted form): - bittern.

H7091.full: From an unused root meaning to contract, that is, spring forward; an arrow snake (as darting on its prey): - great owl.

H7092.firstSense: shut (up), skip, stop, take out of the way
H7092.full: A primitive root; to draw together, that is, close; by implication to leap (by contracting the limbs); specifically to die (from gathering up the feet): - shut (up), skip, stop, take out of the way.

H7093.firstSense: + after, (utmost) border, end, [in-] finite, X process
H7093.full: qêts kates Contracted from H7112; an extremity; adverbially (with prepositional prefix) after: - + after, (utmost) border, end, [in-] finite, X process.

H7094.full: A primitive root; to clip, or (generally) chop: - cut down, shorn.

H7095.full: From H7094; shape (as if cut out); base (as if there cut off): - bottom, size.

H7096.full: A primitive root; to cut off; (figuratively) to destroy; (partially) to scrape off: - cut off, cut short, scrape (off).

H7097.firstSense: X after, border, brim, brink, edge, end, [in-] finite, frontier, outmost coast, quarter…
H7097.full: The second form is negative only; from H7096; an extremity (used in a great variety of applications and idioms; compare H7093): - X after, border, brim, brink, edge, end, [in-] finite, frontier, outmost coast, quarter, shore, (out-) side, X some, ut (-ter-) most (part).

H7098.full: Feminine of H7097; a termination (used like H7097): - coast, corner, (selv-) edge, lowest, (uttermost) part.

H7099.full: From H7096; a limit (used like H7097, but with less variety): - end, edge, uttermost part.

H7100.full: From an unused root apparently meaning to incise; fennel flower (from its pungency): - fitches.

H7101.full: From H7096 in the sense of determining; a magistrate (as deciding) or other leader: - captain, guide, prince, ruler. Compare H6278.

H7102.full: From H7106; cassia (as peeled; plural the bark): - cassia.

H7103.full: The same as H7102; Ketsiah, a daughter of Job: - Kezia.

H7104.full: From H7112; abrupt; Keziz, a valley in Palestine: - Keziz.

H7105.full: From H7114; severed, that is, harvest (as reaped), the crop, the time, the reaper, or figuratively; also a limb (of a tree, or simply foliage): - bough, branch, harvest (man).

H7106.full: A primitive root; to strip off, that is, (partially) scrape; by implication to segregate (as an angle): - cause to scrape, corner.

H7107.firstSense: (be) anger (-ry), displease, fret self, (provoke to) wrath (come), be wroth
H7107.full: A primitive root; to crack off, that is, (figuratively) burst out in rage: - (be) anger (-ry), displease, fret self, (provoke to) wrath (come), be wroth.

H7108.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H7107; to become enraged: - be furious.

H7110.full: From H7107; a splinter (as chipped off); figuratively rage or strife: - foam, indignation, X sore, wrath.

H7112.firstSense: cut (asunder, in pieces, in sunder, off), X utmost
H7112.full: A primitive root; to chop off (literally or figuratively): - cut (asunder, in pieces, in sunder, off), X utmost.

H7114.firstSense: X at all, cut down, much discouraged, grieve, harvestman, lothe, mourn, reap (-er), (be…
H7114.full: A primitive root; to dock off, that is, curtail (transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively); especially to harvest (grass or grain): - X at all, cut down, much discouraged, grieve, harvestman, lothe, mourn, reap (-er), (be, wax) short (-en, -er), straiten, trouble, vex.

H7115.full: From H7114; shortness (of spirit), that is, impatience: - anguish.

H7116.full: From H7114; short (whether in size, number, life, strength or temper): - few, hasty, small, soon.

H7117.full: From H7096; a termination (literally or figuratively); also (by implication) a portion; adverbially (with prepositional prefix) after: - end, part, X some.

H7119.full: qar kar Contracted from an unused root meaning to chill; cool; figuratively quiet: - cold, excellent [from the margin].

H7120.full: qôr kore From the same as H7119; cold: - cold.

H7121.firstSense: bewray [self], that are bidden, call (for, forth, self, upon), cry (unto), (be) famous,…
H7121.full: A primitive root (rather identical with H7122 through the idea of accosting a person met); to call out to (that is, properly address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications): - bewray [self], that are bidden, call (for, forth, self, upon), cry (unto), (be) famous, guest, invite, mention, (give) name, preach, (make) proclaim (-ation), pronounce, publish, read, renowned, say.

H7122.firstSense: befall, (by) chance, (cause to) come (upon), fall out, happen, meet
H7122.full: A primitive root; to encounter, whether accidentally or in a hostile manner: - befall, (by) chance, (cause to) come (upon), fall out, happen, meet.

H7123.full: ker-aw' (Chaldee); corresponding to H7121: - call, cry, read.

H7124.full: Properly active participle of H7121; a caller, that is, partridge (from its cry): - partridge. See also H6981.

H7125.firstSense: X against (he come), help, meet, seek, X to, X in the way
H7125.full: keer-aw' From H7122; an encountering, accidental, friendly or hostile (also adverbially opposite): - X against (he come), help, meet, seek, X to, X in the way.

H7126.firstSense: (cause to) approach, (cause to) bring (forth, near), (cause to) come (near, nigh), (cau…
H7126.full: A primitive root; to approach (causatively bring near) for whatever purpose: - (cause to) approach, (cause to) bring (forth, near), (cause to) come (near, nigh), (cause to) draw near (nigh), go (near), be at hand, join, be near, offer, present, produce, make ready, stand, take.

H7127.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H7126: - approach, come (near, nigh), draw near.

H7128.full: From H7126; hostile encounter: - battle, war.

H7130.firstSense: X among, X before, bowels, X unto charge, + eat (up), X heart, X him, X in, inward (X -…
H7130.full: From H7126; properly the nearest part, that is, the centre, whether literally, figuratively or adverbially (especially with preposition): - X among, X before, bowels, X unto charge, + eat (up), X heart, X him, X in, inward (X -ly, part, -s, thought), midst, + out of, purtenance, X therein, X through, X within self.

H7131.full: From H7126; near: - approach, come (near, nigh), draw near.

H7132.full: From H7126; approach: - approaching, draw near.

H7133.full: From H7126; something brought near the altar, that is, a sacrificial present: - oblation, that is offered, offering.

H7134.full: Perhaps from H6923 in the sense of striking upon; an axe: - ax.

H7136.firstSense: appoint, lay (make) beams, befall, bring, come (to pass unto), floor, [hap] was, happen…
H7136.full: A primitive root; to light upon (chiefly by accident); causatively to bring about; specifically to impose timbers (for roof or floor): - appoint, lay (make) beams, befall, bring, come (to pass unto), floor, [hap] was, happen (unto), meet, send good speed.

H7137.full: From H7136; an (unfortunate) occurrence, that is, some accidental (ceremonial) disqualification: - uncleanness that chanceth.

H7138.firstSense: allied, approach, at hand, + any of kin, kinsfolk (-sman), (that is) near (of kin), nei…
H7138.full: From H7126; near (in place, kindred or time): - allied, approach, at hand, + any of kin, kinsfolk (-sman), (that is) near (of kin), neighbour, (that is) next, (them that come) nigh (at hand), more ready, short (-ly).

H7139.full: A primitive root; to depilate: - make (self) bald.

H7140.full: From H7139; ice (as if bald, that is, smooth); hence, hail; by resemblance, rock crystal: - crystal, frost, ice.

H7141.full: From H7139; ice; Korach, the name of two Edomites and three Israelites: - Korah.

H7142.full: From H7139; bald (on the back of the head): - bald (head).

H7143.full: From H7139; bald; Kareach, an Israelite: - Careah, Kareah.

H7144.full: kor-khaw', kor-khaw' From H7139; baldness: - bald (-ness), X utterly.

H7145.firstSense: Korahite, Korathite, sons of Kore, Korhite
H7145.full: Patronymic from H7141; a Korchite (collectively) or descendant of Korach: - Korahite, Korathite, sons of Kore, Korhite.

H7146.full: From H7139; a bald spot (on the back of the head); figuratively a threadbare spot (on the back side of the cloth): - bald head, bare within.

H7148.full: From H7121; called, that is, select: - famous, renowned.

H7149.full: keer-yaw', keer-yaw' (Chaldee); corresponding to H7151: - city.

H7150.full: ker-ee-aw' From H7121; a proclamation: - preaching.

H7151.full: From H7136 in the sense of flooring, that is, building; a city: - city.

H7152.full: Plural of H7151; buildings; Kerioth, the name of two places in Palestine: - Kerioth, Kirioth.

H7153.full: (keer-yath') ar-bah', haw-ar-bah' The second form, used in Neh_11:25, has the article interposed; from H7151 and H704 or H702; city of Arba, or city of the four (giants); Kirjath-Arba or Kirjath-ha-Arba, a place in Palestine: - Kirjath-arba.

H7154.full: From H7151 and H1168; city of Baal; Kirjath Baal, a place in Palestine: - Kirjath-baal.

H7155.full: From H7151 and the feminine plural of H2351; city of streets; Kirjath Chutsoth, a place in Moab: - Kirjath-huzoth.

H7156.full: Dual of H7151; double city; Kirjathaim, the name of two places in Palestine: - Kiriathaim, Kirjathaim.

H7157.full: Used in Jer_26:20 with the article interposed; or in Jos_18:28 using simply the former part of the word; from H7151 and the plural of H3293 or H5892; city of forests, or city of towns; Kirjath Jearim or Kirjath Arim, a place in Palestine: - Kirjath, Kirjath-jearim, Kirjath-arim.

H7158.full: From H7151 and a simpler feminine from the same as H5577, or (for the second form) H5612; city of branches, or of a book; Kirjath Sannah or Kirjath Sepher, a place in Palestine: - Kirjath-sannah, Kirjath-sepher.

H7159.full: A primitive root; to cover: - cover.

H7160.full: A primitive root; to push or gore; used only as denominative from H7161, to shoot out horns; figuratively rays: - have horns, shine.

H7161.full: From H7160; a horn (as projecting); by implication a flask, cornet; by resemblance an elephant's tooth (that is, ivory), a corner (of the altar), a peak (of a mountain), a ray (of light); figuratively power: - X hill, horn.

H7162.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H7161; a horn (literally or for sound): - horn, cornet.

H7163.full: From H7161 and H6320; horn of cosmetic; Keren-hap-Puk, one of Job's daughters: - Keren-happuch.

H7164.full: A primitive root; properly to protrude; used only as denominative from H7165 (for alliteration with H7167), to hunch, that is, be humpbacked: - stoop.

H7165.full: From H7164; a knob or belaying pin (from its swelling form): - tache.

H7166.full: From H7164; an ankle (as a protuberance or joint): - foot.

H7167.firstSense: cut out, rend, X surely, tear
H7167.full: A primitive root; to rend, literally or figuratively (revile, paint the eyes, as if enlarging them): - cut out, rend, X surely, tear.

H7168.full: From H7167; a rag: - piece, rag.

H7169.full: A primitive root; to pinch, that is, (partially) to bite the lips, blink the eyes (as a gesture of malice), or (fully) to squeeze off (a piece of clay in order to mould a vessel from it): - form, move, wink.

H7170.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H7171 in the sense of a bit (to eat the morsels of any one, that is, chew him up (figuratively) by slander): - + accuse.

H7171.full: From H7169; extirpation (as if by constriction): - destruction.

H7172.firstSense: bottom, (X one side of the) floor
H7172.full: From H7167; floor (as if a pavement of pieces or tesserae), of a building or the sea: - bottom, (X one side of the) floor.

H7173.full: The same as H7172; ground floor; Karka (with the article prefixed), a place in Palestine: - Karkaa.

H7174.full: From H6979; foundation; Karkor, a place East of the Jordan: - Karkor.

H7175.full: From an unused root meaning to split off; a slab or plank; by implication a deck of a ship: - bench, board.

H7176.full: From H7136 in the sense of building; a city: - city.

H7177.full: From H7176; city; Kartah, a place in Palestine: - Kartah.

H7178.full: From H7176; city plot; Kartan, a place in Palestine: - Kartan.

H7179.full: qash kash From H7197; straw (as dry): - stubble.

H7180.full: kish-shoo' From an unused root (meaning to be hard); a cucumber (from the difficulty of digestion): - cucumber.

H7181.firstSense: attend, (cause to) hear (-ken), give heed, incline, mark (well), regard
H7181.full: A primitive root; to prick up the ears, that is, hearken: - attend, (cause to) hear (-ken), give heed, incline, mark (well), regard.

H7182.firstSense: X diligently, hearing, much heed, that regarded
H7182.full: From H7181; a hearkening: - X diligently, hearing, much heed, that regarded.

H7184.full: From an unused root meaning to be round; a jug (from its shape): - cover, cup.

H7185.firstSense: be cruel, be fiercer, make grievous, be ([ask a], be in, have, seem, would) hard (-en,…
H7185.full: A primitive root; properly to be dense, that is, tough or severe (in various applications): - be cruel, be fiercer, make grievous, be ([ask a], be in, have, seem, would) hard (-en, [labour], -ly, thing), be sore, (be, make) stiff (-en, [-necked]).

H7186.firstSense: churlish, cruel, grievous, hard ([-hearted], thing), heavy, + impudent, obstinate, prev…
H7186.full: From H7185; severe (in various applications): - churlish, cruel, grievous, hard ([-hearted], thing), heavy, + impudent, obstinate, prevailed, rough (-ly), sore, sorrowful, stiff ([-necked]), stubborn, + in trouble.

H7188.full: A primitive root; to be (causatively make) unfeeling: - harden.

H7189.full: From an unused root meaning to balance; equity (as evenly weighed), that is, reality: - certainty, truth.

H7191.full: From H7190; hard ground; Kishjon, a place in Palestine: - Kishion, Keshon.

H7192.full: From an unused root (probably meaning to weigh out); an ingot (as definitely estimated and stamped for a coin): - piece of money (silver).

H7193.full: By reduplication from an unused root meaning to shale off as bark; a scale (of a fish); hence a coat of mail (as composed of or covered with jointed plates of metal): - mail, scale.

H7194.firstSense: bind (up), (make a) conspire (-acy, -ator), join together, knit, stronger, work [treason]
H7194.full: A primitive root; to tie, physically (gird, confine, compact) or mentally (in love, league): - bind (up), (make a) conspire (-acy, -ator), join together, knit, stronger, work [treason].

H7195.full: From H7194; an (unlawful) alliance: - confederacy, conspiracy, treason.

H7196.full: From H7194; an (ornamental) girdle (for women): - attire, headband.

H7197.full: A primitive root; to become sapless through drought; used only as denominative from H7179; to forage for straw, stubble or wood; figuratively to assemble: - gather (selves) (together).

H7198.full: From H7185 in the original sense (of H6983) of bending; a bow, for shooting (hence figuratively strength) or the iris: - X arch (-er), + arrow, bow ([-man, -shot]).

H7199.full: Intensive (as denominative) from H7198; a bowman: - X archer.

H7200.firstSense: advise self, appear, approve, behold, X certainly, consider, discern, (make to) enjoy,…
H7200.full: A primitive root; to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitively, intransitively and causatively): - advise self, appear, approve, behold, X certainly, consider, discern, (make to) enjoy, have experience, gaze, take heed, X indeed, X joyfully, lo, look (on, one another, one on another, one upon another, out, up, upon), mark, meet, X be near, perceive, present, provide, regard, (have) respect, (fore-, cause to, let) see (-r, -m, one another), shew (self), X sight of others, (e-) spy, stare, X surely, X think, view, visions.

H7201.full: From H7200; a bird of prey (probably the vulture, from its sharp sight): - glede. Compare H1676.

H7202.full: raw-eh' From H7200; seeing, that is, experiencing: - see.

H7203.full: ro-eh' Active participle of H7200; a seer (as often rendered); but also (abstractly) a vision: - vision.

H7204.full: From H7203; prophet; Roeh, an Israelite: - Haroeh [includ. the article.]

H7205.full: reh-oo-bane' From the imperative of H7200 and H1121; see ye a son; Reuben, a son of Jacob: - Reuben.

H7206.full: Patronymic from H7205; a Reubenite or descendant of Reuben: - children of Reuben, Reubenites.

H7207.full: rah-av-aw' From H7200; sight, that is, satisfaction: - behold.

H7208.full: reh-oo-maw' Feminine passive participle of H7213; raised; Reumah, a Syrian woman: - Reumah.

H7209.full: reh-ee' From H7200; a mirror (as seen): - looking glass.

H7210.full: From H7200; sight, whether abstractly (vision) or concretely (a spectacle): - gazingstock, look to, (that) see (-th).

H7211.full: reh-aw-yaw' From H7200 and H3050; Jah has seen; Reajah, the name of three Israelites: - Reaia, Reaiah.

H7213.full: raw-am' A primitive root; to rise: - be lifted up.

H7214.full: reh-ame', reh-ame', rame, rame From H7213; a wild bull (from its conspicuousness): - unicorn.

H7215.full: From H7213; something high in value, that is, perhaps coral: - coral.

H7216.full: raw-moth', raw-moth' Plural of H7215; heights; Ramoth, the name of two places in Palestine: - Ramoth.

H7217.full: raysh (Chaldee); corresponding to H7218; the head; figuratively the sum: - chief, head, sum.

H7218.firstSense: band, beginning, captain, chapiter, chief (-est place, man, things), company, end, X ev…
H7218.full: roshe From an unused root apparently meaning to shake; the head (as most easily shaken), whether literally or figuratively (in many applications, of place, time, rank, etc.): - band, beginning, captain, chapiter, chief (-est place, man, things), company, end, X every [man], excellent, first, forefront, ([be-]) head, height, (on) high (-est part, [priest]), X lead, X poor, principal, ruler, sum, top.

H7219.full: roshe, roshe Apparently the same as H7218; a poisonous plant, probably the poppy (from its conspicuous head); generally poison (even of serpents): - gall, hemlock, posion, venom.

H7220.full: roshe Probably the same as H7218; Rosh, the name of an Israelite and of a foreign nation: - Rosh.

H7221.full: ree-shaw' From the same as H7218; a beginning: - beginning.

H7222.full: ro-shaw' Feminine of H7218; the head: - head [-stone].

H7223.firstSense: ancestor, (that were) before (-time), beginning, eldest, first, fore [-father] (-most),…
H7223.full: ree-shone', ree-shone' From H7221; first, in place, time or rank (as adjective or noun): - ancestor, (that were) before (-time), beginning, eldest, first, fore [-father] (-most), former (thing), of old time, past.

H7225.firstSense: beginning, chief (-est), first (-fruits, part, time), principal thing
H7225.full: ray-sheeth' From the same as H7218; the first, in place, time, order or rank (specifically a firstfruit): - beginning, chief (-est), first (-fruits, part, time), principal thing.

H7226.full: rah-ash-oth' From H7218; a pillow (being for the head): - bolster.

H7227.firstSense: (in) abound (-undance, -ant, -antly), captain, elder, enough, exceedingly, full, great…
H7227.full: rab rab By contraction from H7231; abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality): - (in) abound (-undance, -ant, -antly), captain, elder, enough, exceedingly, full, great (-ly, man, one), increase, long (enough, [time]), (do, have) many (-ifold, things, a time), ([ship-]) master, mighty, more, (too, very) much, multiply (-tude), officer, often [-times], plenteous, populous, prince, process [of time], suffice (-ient).

H7228.full: rab rab By contraction from H7232; an archer (or perhaps the same as H7227): - archer.

H7229.firstSense: captain, chief, great, lord, master, stout
H7229.full: rab rab (Chaldee); corresponding to H7227: - captain, chief, great, lord, master, stout.

H7230.firstSense: abundance (-antly), all, X common [sort], excellent, great (-ly, -ness, number), huge,…
H7230.full: rôb robe From H7231; abundance (in any respect): - abundance (-antly), all, X common [sort], excellent, great (-ly, -ness, number), huge, be increased, long, many, more in number, most, much, multitude, plenty (-ifully), X very [age].

H7231.firstSense: increase, be many (-ifold), be more, multiply, ten thousands
H7231.full: A primitive root; properly to cast together (compare H7241), that is, increase, especially in number; also (as denominative from H7233) to multiply by the myriad: - increase, be many (-ifold), be more, multiply, ten thousands.

H7232.full: A primitive root (rather identical with H7231 through the idea of projection); to shoot an arrow: - shoot.

H7233.firstSense: many, million, X multiply, ten thousand
H7233.full: rebâbâh reb-aw-baw From H7231; abundance (in number), that is, (specifically) a myriad (whether definite or indefinite): - many, million, X multiply, ten thousand.

H7234.full: A primitive root; to spread: - deck.

H7235.firstSense: [bring in] abundance (X -antly), + archer [by mistake for H7232], be in authority, brin…
H7235.full: A primitive root; to increase (in whatever respect): - [bring in] abundance (X -antly), + archer [by mistake for H7232], be in authority, bring up, X continue, enlarge, excel, exceeding (-ly), be full of, (be, make) great (-er, -ly), X -ness), grow up, heap, increase, be long, (be, give, have, make, use) many (a time), (any, be, give, give the, have) more (in number), (ask, be, be so, gather, over, take, yield) much (greater, more), (make to) multiply, nourish, plenty (-eous), X process [of time], sore, store, thoroughly, very.

H7236.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H7235: - make a great man, grow.

H7237.full: Feminine of H7227; great; Rabbah, the name of two places in Palestine, East and West: - Rabbah, Rabbath.

H7238.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H7235; increase (of dignity): - greatness, majesty.

H7239.firstSense: great things, ten ([eight] -een, [for] -ty, + sixscore, + threescore, X twenty, [twen]…
H7239.full: rib-bo', rib-bo' From H7231; a myriad, that is, indefinite large number: - great things, ten ([eight] -een, [for] -ty, + sixscore, + threescore, X twenty, [twen] -ty) thousand.

H7240.firstSense: X ten thousand times ten thousand
H7240.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H7239: - X ten thousand times ten thousand.

H7241.full: From H7231; a rain (as an accumulation of drops): - shower.

H7242.full: From H7234; a collar (as spread around the neck): - chain.

H7243.full: From H7251; fourth; also (fractionally) a fourth: - four-square, fourth (part).

H7245.full: From H7231; multitude; Rabbith, a place in Palestine: - Rabbith.

H7246.full: A primitive root; to soak (bread in oil): - baken, (that which is) fried.

H7247.full: From an unused root meaning to be fruitful; fertile; Riblah, a place in Syria: - Riblah.

H7248.full: From H7227 and a foreign word for a Magian; chief Magian; Rab-Mag, a Babylonian official: - Rab-mag.

H7249.full: From H7227 and a foreign word for a eunuch; chief chamberlain; Rab-Saris, a Babylonian official: - Rab-saris.

H7250.full: A primitive root; to squat or lie out flat, that is, (specifically) in copulation: - let gender, lie down.

H7251.full: A primitive root (rather identical with H7250 through the idea of sprawling at all fours (or possibly the reverse is the order of derivation); compare H702); properly to be four (sided); used only as denominative of H7253; to be quadrate: - (four-) square (-d).

H7252.full: From H7250; prostration (for sleep): - lying down.

H7253.full: From H7251; a fourth (part or side): - fourth part, side, square.

H7254.full: The same as H7253; Reba, a Midianite: - Reba.

H7255.full: From H7251; a quarter: - fourth part.

H7256.full: From H7251; a descendant of the fourth generation, that is, great great grandchild: - fourth.

H7257.firstSense: crouch (down), fall down, make a fold, lay (cause to, make to) lie (down), make to rest…
H7257.full: A primitive root; to crouch (on all four legs folded, like a recumbent animal); by implication to recline, repose, brood, lurk, imbed: - crouch (down), fall down, make a fold, lay (cause to, make to) lie (down), make to rest, sit.

H7258.firstSense: where each lay, lie down in, resting place
H7258.full: From H7257; a couch or place of repose: - where each lay, lie down in, resting place.

H7259.full: From an unused root probably meaning to clog by tying up the fetlock; fettering (by beauty); Ribkah, the wife of Isaac: - Rebekah.

H7260.full: (Chaldee); from H7229; huge (in size); domineering (in character): - (very) great (things).

H7261.full: (Chaldee); from H7260; a magnate: - lord, prince.

H7262.full: From H7227 and H8284; chief butler; Rabshakeh, a Babylonian official: - Rabshakeh.

H7263.full: From an unused root meaning to pile together; a lump of clay: - clod.

H7264.firstSense: be afraid, stand in awe, disquiet, fall out, fret, move, provoke, quake, rage, shake, t…
H7264.full: A primitive root; to quiver (with any violent emotion, especially anger or fear): - be afraid, stand in awe, disquiet, fall out, fret, move, provoke, quake, rage, shake, tremble, trouble, be wroth.

H7265.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H7264: - provoke unto wrath.

H7267.full: From H7264; commotion, restlessness (of a horse), crash (of thunder), disquiet, anger: - fear, noise, rage, trouble, (-ing), wrath.

H7270.firstSense: backbite, search, slander, (e-) spy (out), teach to go, view
H7270.full: A primitive root; to walk along; but only in specific applications, to reconnoitre, to be a tale bearer (that is, slander); also (as denominative from H7272) to lead about: - backbite, search, slander, (e-) spy (out), teach to go, view.

H7272.firstSense: X be able to endure, X according as, X after, X coming, X follow, ([broken-]) foot ([-e…
H7272.full: From H7270; a foot (as used in walking); by implication a step; by euphemism the pudenda: - X be able to endure, X according as, X after, X coming, X follow, ([broken-]) foot ([-ed, -stool]), X great toe, X haunt, X journey, leg, + piss, + possession, time.

H7273.full: From H7272; a foot man (soldier): - (on) foot (-man).

H7274.full: Plural of active participle of H7270; fullers (as tramping the cloth in washing); Rogelim, a place East of the Jordan: - Rogelim.

H7275.full: A primitive root (compare H7263, H7321 and H7551); to cast together (stones), that is, to lapidate: - X certainly, stone.

H7276.full: From H7275; stone heap; Regem, an Israelite: - Regem.

H7277.full: Feminine of the same as H7276; a pile (of stones), that is, (figuratively) a throng: - council.

H7278.full: From H7276 and H4428; king's heap; Regem Melek, an Israelite: - Regem-melech.

H7279.full: A primitive root; to grumble, that is, rebel: - murmur.

H7280.firstSense: break, divide, find ease, be a moment, (cause, give, make to) rest, make suddenly
H7280.full: A primitive root; properly to toss violently and suddenly (the sea with waves, the skin with boils); figuratively (in a favorable manner) to settle, that is, quiet; specifically to wink (from the motion of the eye lids): - break, divide, find ease, be a moment, (cause, give, make to) rest, make suddenly.

H7281.full: From H7280; a wink (of the eyes), that is, a very short space of time: - instant, moment, space, suddenly.

H7282.full: From H7280; restful, that is, peaceable: - that are quiet.

H7283.full: A primitive root; to be tumultuous: - rage.

H7284.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H7283; to gather tumultuously: - assemble (together).

H7285.full: From H7283; a tumultuous crowd: - company, insurrection.

H7286.full: A primitive root; to tread in pieces, that is, (figuratively) to conquer, or (specifically) to overlay: - spend, spread, subdue.

H7287.firstSense: (come to, make to) have dominion, prevail against, reign, (bear, make to) rule, (-r, ov…
H7287.full: A primitive root; to tread down, that is, subjugate; specifically to crumble off: - (come to, make to) have dominion, prevail against, reign, (bear, make to) rule, (-r, over), take.

H7288.full: Intensive from H7287; domineering; Raddai, an Israelite: - Raddai.

H7289.full: From H7286 in the sense of spreading; a veil (as expanded): - vail, veil.

H7290.firstSense: (be fast a-, be in a deep, cast into a dead, that) sleep (-er, -eth)
H7290.full: A primitive root; to stun, that is, stupefy (with sleep or death): - (be fast a-, be in a deep, cast into a dead, that) sleep (-er, -eth).

H7291.firstSense: chase, put to flight, follow (after, on), hunt, (be under) persecute (-ion, -or), pursu…
H7291.full: A primitive root; to run after (usually with hostile intent; figuratively (of time) gone by): - chase, put to flight, follow (after, on), hunt, (be under) persecute (-ion, -or), pursue (-r).

H7292.firstSense: overcome, behave self proudly, make sure, strengthen
H7292.full: A primitive root; to urge severely, that is, (figuratively) importune, embolden, capture, act insolently: - overcome, behave self proudly, make sure, strengthen.

H7294.full: The same as H7293; Rahab (that is, boaster), an epithet of Egypt: - Rahab.

H7297.full: A primitive root; to fear: - be afraid.

H7298.full: From an unused root apparently meaning to hollow out; a channel or watering box; by resemblance a ringlet of hair (as forming parallel lines): - gallery, gutter, trough.

H7299.full: rêv rave (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H7200; aspect: - form.

H7300.firstSense: have the dominion, be lord, mourn, rule
H7300.full: rûd rood A primitive root; to tramp about, that is, ramble (free or disconsolate): - have the dominion, be lord, mourn, rule.

H7301.firstSense: bathe, make drunk, (take the) fill, satiate, (abundantly) satisfy, soak, water (abundan…
H7301.full: A primitive root; to slake the thirst (occasionally of other appetites): - bathe, make drunk, (take the) fill, satiate, (abundantly) satisfy, soak, water (abundantly).

H7302.full: From H7301; sated (with drink): - drunkenness, watered.

H7303.full: From an unused root probably meaning to cry out; outcry; Rohagah, an Israelite: - Rohgah.

H7304.full: A primitive root (rather identical with H7306); properly to breathe freely, that is, revive; by implication to have ample room: - be refreshed, large.

H7305.full: From H7304; room, literally (an interval) or figuratively (deliverance): - enlargement, space.

H7306.firstSense: accept, smell, X touch, make of quick understanding
H7306.full: A primitive root; properly to blow, that is, breathe; only (literally) to smell or (by implication perceive (figuratively to anticipate, enjoy): - accept, smell, X touch, make of quick understanding.

H7307.firstSense: air, anger, blast, breath, X cool, courage, mind, X quarter, X side, spirit ([-ual]), t…
H7307.full: From H7306; wind; by resemblance breath, that is, a sensible (or even violent) exhalation; figuratively life, anger, unsubstantiality; by extension a region of the sky; by resemblance spirit, but only of a rational being (including its expression and functions): - air, anger, blast, breath, X cool, courage, mind, X quarter, X side, spirit ([-ual]), tempest, X vain, ([whirl-]) wind (-y).

H7308.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H7307: - mind, spirit, wind.

H7309.full: Feminine of H7305; relief: - breathing, respite.

H7310.full: From H7301; satisfaction: - runneth over, wealthy.

H7311.firstSense: bring up, exalt (self), extol, give, go up, haughty, heave (up), (be, lift up on, make…
H7311.full: rûm room A primitive root; to be high actively to rise or raise (in various applications, literally or figuratively): - bring up, exalt (self), extol, give, go up, haughty, heave (up), (be, lift up on, make on, set up on, too) high (-er, one), hold up, levy, lift (-er) up, (be) lofty, (X a-) loud, mount up, offer (up), + presumptuously, (be) promote (-ion), proud, set up, tall (-er), take (away, off, up), breed worms.

H7312.full: rûm rûm room, room From H7311; (literally) elevation or (figuratively) elation: - haughtiness, height, X high.

H7313.full: rûm room (Chaldee); corresponding to H7311; (figuratively only): - extol, lift up (self), set up.

H7314.full: rûm room (Chaldee); from H7313; (literally) altitude: - height.

H7315.full: rôm rome From H7311; elevation, that is, (adverbially) aloft: - on high.

H7316.full: From H7311; height; Rumah, a place in Palestine: - Rumah.

H7317.full: Feminine of H7315; elation, that is, (adverbially) proudly: - haughtily.

H7318.full: From H7426; exaltation, that is, (figuratively and specifically) praise: - be extolled.

H7319.full: Feminine active participle of H7426; exaltation, that is, praise: - high.

H7320.full: From H7311 and H5828; I have raised up a help; Romamti-Ezer, an Israelite: - Romamti-ezer.

H7321.firstSense: blow an alarm, cry (alarm, aloud, out), destroy, make a joyful noise, smart, shout (for…
H7321.full: A primitive root; to mar (especially by breaking); figuratively to split the ears (with sound), that is, shout (for alarm or joy): - blow an alarm, cry (alarm, aloud, out), destroy, make a joyful noise, smart, shout (for joy), sound an alarm, triumph.

H7322.full: rûph roof A primitive root; properly to triturate (in a mortar), that is, (figuratively) to agitate (by concussion): - tremble.

H7323.firstSense: break down, divide speedily, footman, guard, bring hastily, (make) run (away, through),…
H7323.full: rûts roots A primitive root; to run (for whatever reason, especially to rush): - break down, divide speedily, footman, guard, bring hastily, (make) run (away, through), post, stretch out.

H7324.firstSense: X arm, cast out, draw (out), (make) empty, pour forth (out)
H7324.full: rûq rook A primitive root; to pour out (literally or figuratively), that is, empty: - X arm, cast out, draw (out), (make) empty, pour forth (out).

H7325.full: rûr roor A primitive root; to slaver (with spittle), that is, (by analogy) to emit a fluid (ulcerous or natural): - run.

H7326.full: rûsh roosh A primitive root; to be destitute: - lack, needy, (make self) poor (man).

H7327.full: rûth rooth Probably for H7468; friend; Ruth, a Moabitess: - Ruth.

H7328.full: râz rawz (Chaldee); from an unused root probably meaning to attenuate, that is, (figuratively) hide; a mystery: - secret.

H7329.full: A primitive root; to emaciate, that is, make (become) thin (literally or figuratively): - famish, wax lean.

H7330.full: râzeh raw-zeh From H7329; thin: - lean.

H7331.full: From H7336; prince; Rezon, a Syrian: - Rezon.

H7332.full: From H7329; thinness: - leanness, X scant.

H7335.full: A primitive root; to twinkle the eye (in mockery): - wink.

H7336.full: A primitive root; probably to be heavy, that is, (figuratively) honorable: - prince, ruler.

H7337.firstSense: be an en- (make) large (-ing), make room, make (open) wide
H7337.full: A primitive root; to broaden (intransitively or transitively, literally or figuratively): - be an en- (make) large (-ing), make room, make (open) wide.

H7338.full: From H7337; a width: - breadth, broad place.

H7339.full: From H7337; a width, that is, (concretely) avenue or area: - broad place (way), street. See also H1050.

H7340.full: The same as H7339; Rechob, the name of a place in Syria, also of a Syrian and an Israelite: - Rehob.

H7341.full: From H7337; width (literally or figuratively): - breadth, broad, largeness, thickness, wideness.

H7342.firstSense: broad, large, at liberty, proud, wide
H7342.full: From H7337; roomy, in any (or every) direction, literally or figuratively: - broad, large, at liberty, proud, wide.

H7343.full: The same as H7342; proud; Rachab, a Canaanitess: - Rahab.

H7344.full: Plural of H7339; streets; Rechoboth, a place in Assyria and one in Palestine: - Rehoboth.

H7345.full: From H7337 and H3050; Jah has enlarged; Rechabjah, an Israelite: - Rehabiah.

H7346.full: From H7337 and H5971; a people has enlarged; Rechabam, an Israelite king: - Rehoboam.

H7347.full: From an unused root meaning to pulverize; a mill stone: - mill (stone).

H7348.full: A form of H7349; Rechum, the name of a Persian and of three Israelites: - Rehum.

H7349.full: From H7355; compassionate: - full of compassion, merciful.

H7350.firstSense: (a-) far (abroad, off), long ago, of old, space, great while to come
H7350.full: From H7368; remote, literally of figuratively, of place or time; specifically precious; often used adverbially (with preposition): - (a-) far (abroad, off), long ago, of old, space, great while to come.

H7351.full: From the same as H7298; a panel (as resembling a trough): - rafter.

H7353.full: From an unused root meaning to journey; a ewe (the females being the predominant element of a flock), (as a good traveller): - ewe, sheep.

H7354.full: The same as H7353; Rachel, a wife of Jacob: - Rachel.

H7355.firstSense: have compassion (on, upon), love, (find, have, obtain, shew) mercy (-iful, on, upon), (…
H7355.full: A primitive root; to fondle; by implication to love, especially to compassionate: - have compassion (on, upon), love, (find, have, obtain, shew) mercy (-iful, on, upon), (have) pity, Ruhamah, X surely.

H7356.firstSense: bowels, compassion, damsel, tender love, (great, tender) mercy, pity, womb
H7356.full: From H7355; compassion (in the plural); by extension the womb (as cherishing the foetus); by implication a maiden: - bowels, compassion, damsel, tender love, (great, tender) mercy, pity, womb.

H7357.full: The same as H7356; pity; Racham, an Israelite: - Raham.

H7358.full: From H7355; the womb (compare H7356): - matrix, womb.

H7360.full: From H7355; a kind of vulture (supposed to be tender towards its young): - gier-eagle.

H7361.full: Feminine of H7356; a maiden: - damsel.

H7363.full: A primitive root; to brood; by implication to be relaxed: - flutter, move, shake.

H7364.full: A primitive root; to lave (the whole or a part of the thing): - bathe (self), wash (self).

H7365.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H7364 (probably through the accessory idea of ministering as a servant at the bath); to attend upon: - trust.

H7367.full: Feminine of H7366; a bathing place: - washing.

H7368.firstSense: (a, be, cast, drive, get, go, keep [self], put, remove, be too, [wander], withdraw) far…
H7368.full: A primitive root; to widen (in any direction), that is, (intransitively) recede or (transitively) remove (literally or figuratively, of place or relation): - (a, be, cast, drive, get, go, keep [self], put, remove, be too, [wander], withdraw) far (away, off), loose, X refrain, very, (be) a good way (off).

H7369.full: From H7368; remote: - that are far.

H7370.full: A primitive root; to gush: - indite.

H7371.full: From H7306; a winnowing fork (as blowing the chaff away): - shovel.

H7372.full: A primitive root; to be moist: - be wet.

H7374.full: From an unused root meaning to tremble; terror: - fear.

H7375.full: A root compounded from H7373 and H2954; to be rejuvenated: - be fresh.

H7376.full: A primitive root; to dash down: - dash (in pieces).

H7377.full: rı̂y ree From H7301; irrigation, that is, a shower: - watering.

H7378.firstSense: adversary, chide, complain, contend, debate, X ever, X lay wait, plead, rebuke, strive,…
H7378.full: øåּá øéáo rı̂yb rûb reeb, roob A primitive root; properly to toss, that is, grapple; mostly figuratively to wrangle, that is, hold a controversy; (by implication) to defend: - adversary, chide, complain, contend, debate, X ever, X lay wait, plead, rebuke, strive, X thoroughly.

H7379.firstSense: + adversary, cause, chiding, contend (-tion), controversy, multitude [from the margin],…
H7379.full: rı̂yb rib reeb, reeb From H7378; a contest (personal or legal): - + adversary, cause, chiding, contend (-tion), controversy, multitude [from the margin], pleading, strife, strive (-ing), suit.

H7380.full: From H7378; contentious; Ribai, an Israelite: - Ribai.

H7381.full: From H7306; odor (as if blown): - savour, scent, smell.

H7383.full: From H7322; (only plural), grits (as pounded): - ground corn, wheat.

H7384.full: The second form is probably by orthographical error; of foreign origin; Riphath, a grandson of Jepheth and his descendants: - Riphath.

H7385.firstSense: empty, to no purpose, (in) vain (thing), vanity
H7385.full: rı̂yq reek From H7324; emptiness; figuratively a worthless thing; adverbially in vain: - empty, to no purpose, (in) vain (thing), vanity.

H7386.full: rêyq rêq rake, rake From H7324; empty; figuratively worthless: - emptied (-ty), vain (fellow, man).

H7387.firstSense: without cause, empty, in vain, void
H7387.full: From H7386; emptily; figuratively (objectively) ineffectually, (subjectively) undeservedly: - without cause, empty, in vain, void.

H7388.full: rı̂yr reer From H7325; saliva; by resemblance broth: - spittle, white [of an egg].

H7389.full: raysh, raysh, reesh From H7326; poverty: - poverty.

H7390.full: rak rak From H7401; tender (literally or figuratively); by implication weak: - faint [-hearted], soft, tender ([-hearted], one), weak.

H7391.full: rôk roke From H7401; softness (figuratively): - tenderness.

H7392.firstSense: bring (on [horse-] back), carry, get [oneself] up, on [horse-] back, put, (cause to, ma…
H7392.full: A primitive root; to ride (on an animal or in a vehicle); causatively to place upon (for riding or generally), to despatch: - bring (on [horse-] back), carry, get [oneself] up, on [horse-] back, put, (cause to, make to) ride (in a chariot, on, -r), set.

H7393.firstSense: chariot, (upper) millstone, multitude [from the margin], wagon
H7393.full: From H7392; a vehicle; by implication a team; by extension cavalry; by analogy a rider, that is, the upper millstone: - chariot, (upper) millstone, multitude [from the margin], wagon.

H7394.full: From H7392; rider; Rekab, the name of two Arabs and of two Israelites: - Rechab.

H7395.firstSense: chariot man, driver of a chariot, horseman
H7395.full: From H7392; a charioteer: - chariot man, driver of a chariot, horseman.

H7396.full: Feminine of H7393; a chariot (collectively): - chariots.

H7397.full: Probably feminine from H7401; softness; Rekah, a place in Palestine: - Rechah.

H7398.full: From passive participle of H7392; a vehicle (as ridden on): - chariot.

H7399.full: From passive participle of H7408; property (as gathered): - good, riches, substance.

H7400.full: From H7402; a scandal monger (as travelling about): - slander, carry tales, talebearer.

H7401.firstSense: (be) faint ([-hearted]), mollify, (be, make) soft (-er), be tender
H7401.full: A primitive root; to soften (intransitively or transitively), used figuratively: - (be) faint ([-hearted]), mollify, (be, make) soft (-er), be tender.

H7402.full: A primitive root; to travel for trading: - (spice) merchant.

H7403.full: From H7402; merchant; Rakal, a place in Palestine: - Rachal.

H7404.full: Feminine passive participle of H7402; trade (as peddled): - merchandise, traffic.

H7405.full: A primitive root; to tie: - bind.

H7406.full: From H7405; a mountain ridge (as of tied summits): - rough place.

H7407.full: From H7405; a snare (as of tied meshes): - pride.

H7408.full: A primitive root; to lay up, that is, collect: - gather, get.

H7409.full: From H7408; a relay of animals on a post route (as stored up for that purpose); by implication a courser: - dromedary, mule, swift beast.

H7410.full: râm rawm Active participle of H7311; high; Ram, the name of an Arabian and of an Israelite: - Ram. See also H1027.

H7411.firstSense: beguile, betray, [bow-] man, carry, deceive, throw
H7411.full: A primitive root; to hurl; specifically to shoot; figuratively to delude or betray (as if causing to fall): - beguile, betray, [bow-] man, carry, deceive, throw.

H7412.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H7411; to throw, set, (figuratively) assess: - cast (down), impose.

H7413.full: Feminine active participle of H7311; a height (as a seat of idolatry): - high place.

H7414.full: The same as H7413; Ramah, the name of four places in Palestine: - Ramah.

H7415.full: From H7426 in the sense of breeding (compare H7311); a maggot (as rapidly bred), literally or figuratively: - worm.

H7416.full: From H7426; a pomegranate, the tree (from its upright growth) or the fruit (also an artificial ornament): - pomegranate.

H7417.full: The same as H7416; Rimmon, the name of a Syrian deity, also of five places in Palestine. The additon of "-methoar" (the fourth form) is a passive participle of H8388 with the article; the (one) marked off, that is, which pertains; mistaken for part of the name: - Remmon, Rimmon. The addition "-methoar" (Jos_19:13) is äîּúàø hammethô'âr, ham-meth-o-awr; passive participle of H8388 with the article the (one) marked off, That is,which pertains; mistaken for part of the name.

H7418.firstSense: south Ramoth, Ramath of the south
H7418.full: From the plural or constructive of H7413 and H5045; heights (or height) of the South; Ramoth-Negeb or Ramoth-Negeb, a place in Palestine: - south Ramoth, Ramath of the south.

H7419.full: From H7311; a heap (of carcases): - height.

H7420.full: From an unused root meaning to hurl; a lance (as thrown); especially the iron point: - buckler, javelin, lancet, spear.

H7421.full: For H761; a Ramite, that is, Aramaean: - Syrian.

H7422.full: From H7311 and H3050; Jah has raised; Ramjah, an Israelite: - Ramiah.

H7423.firstSense: deceit (-ful, -fully), false, guile, idle, slack, slothful
H7423.full: From H7411; remissness, treachery: - deceit (-ful, -fully), false, guile, idle, slack, slothful.

H7424.full: Of foreign origin; a brood mare: - dromedary.

H7425.full: From an unused root and H3050 (perhaps meaning to deck); Jah has bedecked; Remaljah, an Israelite: - Remaliah.

H7426.firstSense: exalt, get [oneself] up, lift up (self), mount up
H7426.full: A primitive root; to rise (literally or figuratively): - exalt, get [oneself] up, lift up (self), mount up.

H7427.full: From the active participle of H7426; exaltation: - lifting up of self.

H7428.full: From H7416 and H6556; pomegranate of the breach; Rimmon Perets, a place in the Desert: - Rimmon-parez.

H7429.firstSense: oppressor, stamp upon, trample (under feet), tread (down, upon)
H7429.full: A primitive root; to tread upon (as a potter, in walking or abusively): - oppressor, stamp upon, trample (under feet), tread (down, upon).

H7430.full: A primitive root; properly to glide swiftly, that is, to crawl or move with short steps; by analogy to swarm: - creep, move.

H7431.full: From H7430; a reptile or any other rapidly moving animal: - that creepeth, creeping (moving) thing.

H7432.full: From H7411; height; Remeth, a place in Palestine: - Remeth.

H7433.full: From the plural of H7413 and H1568; heights of Gilad; Ramoth Gilad, a place East of the Jordan: - Ramoth-gilead, Ramoth in Gilead. See also H7216.

H7434.full: From H7413 and H4707 with the article interposed; height of the watch tower; Ramath ham Mitspeh, a place in Palestine: - Ramath-mizpeh.

H7435.full: Patronymic of H7414; a Ramathite or inhabitant of Ramah: - Ramathite.

H7436.full: From the dual of H7413 and the plural of the active participle of H6822; double height of watchers; Ramathajim Tsophim, a place in Palestine: - Ramathaim-zophim.

H7437.full: From H7413 and H3895; height of a jaw bone; Ramath Lechi, a place in Palestine: - Ramath-lehi.

H7438.full: rôn rone From H7442; a shout (of deliverance): - song.

H7439.full: A primitive root; to whiz: - rattle.

H7440.firstSense: cry, gladness, joy, proclamation, rejoicing, shouting, sing (-ing), triumph
H7440.full: From H7442; properly a creaking (or shrill sound), that is, shout (of joy or grief): - cry, gladness, joy, proclamation, rejoicing, shouting, sing (-ing), triumph.

H7441.full: The same as H7440; Rinnah, an Israelite: - Rinnah.

H7442.firstSense: aloud for joy, cry out, be joyful, (greatly, make to) rejoice, (cause to) shout (for jo…
H7442.full: A primitive root; properly to creak (or emit a stridulous sound), that is, to shout (usually for joy): - aloud for joy, cry out, be joyful, (greatly, make to) rejoice, (cause to) shout (for joy), (cause to) sing (aloud, for joy, out), triumph.

H7443.full: From H7442; an ostrich (from its wail): - X goodly.

H7444.full: Intensive from H7442; shouting (for joy): - singing.

H7445.full: From H7442; a shout (for joy): - joyful (voice), singing, triumphing.

H7446.full: From H7450; a ruin (as dripping to pieces); Rissah, a place in the Desert: - Rissah.

H7447.full: From H7450; properly dripping to pieces, that is, a ruin; also a dew drop: - breach, drop.

H7448.full: From an unused root meaning to curb; a halter (as restraining); by implication the jaw: - bridle.

H7449.full: The same as H7448; Resen, a place in Assyria: - Resen.

H7450.full: A primitive root; to comminute; used only as denominative from H7447, to moisten (with drops): - temper.

H7451.firstSense: adversity, affliction, bad, calamity, + displease (-ure), distress, evil ([-favourednes…
H7451.full: From H7489; bad or (as noun) evil (naturally or morally). This includes the second (feminine) form; as adjective or noun: - adversity, affliction, bad, calamity, + displease (-ure), distress, evil ([-favouredness], man, thing), + exceedingly, X great, grief (-vous), harm, heavy, hurt (-ful), ill (favoured), + mark, mischief, (-vous), misery, naught (-ty), noisome, + not please, sad (-ly), sore, sorrow, trouble, vex, wicked (-ly, -ness, one), worse (-st) wretchedness, wrong. [Including feminine ra'ah; as adjective or noun.]

H7452.full: From H7321; a crash (of thunder), noise (of war), shout (of joy): - X aloud, noise, shouted.

H7453.firstSense: brother, companion, fellow, friend, husband, lover, neighbour, X (an-) other
H7453.full: From H7462; an associate (more or less close): - brother, companion, fellow, friend, husband, lover, neighbour, X (an-) other.

H7454.full: From H7462; a thought (as association of ideas): - thought.

H7455.firstSense: X be so bad, badness, (X be so) evil, naughtiness, sadness, sorrow, wickedness
H7455.full: From H7489; badness (as marring), physically or morally: - X be so bad, badness, (X be so) evil, naughtiness, sadness, sorrow, wickedness.

H7456.firstSense: (suffer to) famish, (be, have, suffer, suffer to) hunger (-ry)
H7456.full: A primitive root; to hunger: - (suffer to) famish, (be, have, suffer, suffer to) hunger (-ry).

H7457.full: From H7456; hungry (more or less intensely): - hunger bitten, hungry.

H7458.full: From H7456; hunger (more or less extensive): - dearth, famine, + famished, hunger.

H7460.full: A primitive root; to shudder (more or less violently): - tremble.

H7461.full: From H7460; a shudder: - fear, trembling.

H7462.firstSense: X break, companion, keep company with, devour, eat up, evil entreat, feed, use as a fri…
H7462.full: A primitive root; to tend a flock, that is, pasture it; intransitively to graze (literally or figuratively); generally to rule; by extension to associate with (as a friend): - X break, companion, keep company with, devour, eat up, evil entreat, feed, use as a friend, make friendship with, herdman, keep [sheep] (-er), pastor, + shearing house, shepherd, wander, waste.

H7464.full: Feminine of H7453; a female associate: - companion, fellow.

H7466.full: For H7471 in the sense of H7453; friend; Reu, a postdiluvian patriarch: - Reu.

H7467.full: From the same as H7466 and H410; friend of God; Reuel, the name of Moses' father in law, also of an Edomite and an Israelite: - Raguel, Reuel.

H7468.full: From H7462 in the sense of H7453; a female associate; generally an additional one: - + another, mate, neighbour.

H7469.full: Probably from H7462; a feeding upon, that is, grasping after: - vexation.

H7470.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H7469; desire: - pleasure, will.

H7472.full: From H7453; social; Rei, an Israelite: - Rei.

H7473.full: From active participle of H7462; pastoral; as noun, a shepherd: - shepherd.

H7474.full: Feminine of H7453; a female associate: - love.

H7475.full: From H7462 in the sense of H7469; desire: - vexation.

H7476.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H7475; a grasp, that is, (figuratively) mental conception: - cogitation, thought.

H7477.full: A primitive root; to reel, that is, (figuratively) to brandish: - terribly shake.

H7478.full: From H7477; a reeling (from intoxication): - trembling.

H7479.full: Feminine of H7478; a long veil (as fluttering): - muffler.

H7480.full: From H7477 and H3050; made to tremble (that is, fearful) of Jah; Reelajah, an Israelite: - Reeliah.

H7481.firstSense: make to fret, roar, thunder, trouble
H7481.full: A primitive root; to tumble, that is, be violently agitated; specifically to crash (of thunder); figuratively to irritate (with anger): - make to fret, roar, thunder, trouble.

H7482.full: From H7481; a peal of thunder: - thunder.

H7483.full: Feminine of H7482; the mane of a horse (as quivering in the wind): - thunder.

H7484.full: The same as H7483; Ramah, the name of a grandson of Ham, and of a place (perhaps founded by him): - Raamah.

H7485.full: From H7481 and H3050; Jah has shaken; Raamjah, an Israelite: - Raamiah.

H7486.full: Of Egypt origin; Rameses or Raamses, a place in Egypt: - Raamses, Rameses.

H7487.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H7488; green, that is, (figuratively) prosperous: - flourishing.

H7488.full: From an unused root meaning to be green; verdant; by analogy new; figuratively prosperous: - green, flourishing.

H7489.firstSense: afflict, associate selves [by mistake for H7462], break (down, in pieces), + displease,…
H7489.full: A primitive root; properly to spoil (literally by breaking to pieces); figuratively to make (or be) good for nothing, that is, bad (physically, socially or morally). (associate selves and show self friendly are by mistake for H7462.): - afflict, associate selves [by mistake for H7462], break (down, in pieces), + displease, (be, bring, do) evil (doer, entreat, man), show self friendly [by mistake for H7462], do harm, (do) hurt, (behave self, deal) ill, X indeed, do mischief, punish, still vex, (do) wicked (doer, -ly), be (deal, do) worse.

H7491.full: A primitive root; to drip: - distil, drop (down).

H7492.full: A primitive root; to break in pieces; figuratively harass: - dash in pieces, vex.

H7493.firstSense: make afraid, (re-) move, quake, (make to) shake, (make to) tremble
H7493.full: A primitive root; to undulate (as the earth, the sky, etc.; also a field of grain), particularly through fear; specifically to spring (as a locust): - make afraid, (re-) move, quake, (make to) shake, (make to) tremble.

H7494.firstSense: commotion, confused noise, earthquake, fierceness, quaking, rattling, rushing, shaking
H7494.full: From H7493; vibration, bounding, uproar: - commotion, confused noise, earthquake, fierceness, quaking, rattling, rushing, shaking.

H7495.firstSense: cure, (cause to) heal, physician, repair, X thoroughly, make whole
H7495.full: A primitive root; properly to mend (by stitching), that is, (figuratively) to cure: - cure, (cause to) heal, physician, repair, X thoroughly, make whole. See H7503.

H7496.full: From H7495 in the sense of H7503; properly lax, that is, (figuratively) a ghost (as dead; in plural only): - dead, deceased.

H7497.full: From H7495 in the sense of invigorating; a giant: - giant, Rapha, Rephaim (-s). See also H1051.

H7498.full: Probably the same as H7497; giant; Rapha or Raphah, the name of two Israelites: - Rapha.

H7499.full: ref-oo-aw' Feminine passive participle of H7495; a medicament: - heal [-ed], medicine.

H7500.full: rif-ooth' From H7495; a cure: - health.

H7501.full: ref-aw-ale' From H7495 and H410; God has cured; Rephael, an Israelite: - Rephael.

H7502.full: A primitive root; to spread (a bed); by implication to refresh: - comfort, make [a bed], spread.

H7503.firstSense: abate, cease, consume, draw [toward evening], fail, (be) faint, be (wax) feeble, forsak…
H7503.full: A primitive root; to slacken (in many applications, literally or figuratively): - abate, cease, consume, draw [toward evening], fail, (be) faint, be (wax) feeble, forsake, idle, leave, let alone (go, down), (be) slack, stay, be still, be slothful, (be) weak (-en). See H7495.

H7504.full: From H7503; slack (in body or mind): - weak.

H7505.full: Passive participle of H7495; cured; Raphu, an Israelite: - Raphu.

H7506.full: From an unused root apparently meaning to sustain; support; Rephach, an Israelite: - Rephah.

H7507.full: From H7502; a railing (as spread along): - bottom.

H7508.full: Plural of the masculine of the same as H7507; ballusters; Rephidim, a place in the Desert: - Rephidim.

H7509.full: From H7495 and H3050; Jah has cured; Rephajah, the name of five Israelites: - Rephaiah.

H7511.full: A primitive root; to trample, that is, prostrate: - humble self, submit self.

H7513.full: From H7511; a raft (as flat on the water): - flote.

H7514.full: A primitive root; to recline: - lean.

H7515.full: A primitive root; to trample, that is, roil water: - foul, trouble.

H7517.full: Probably form H7503; a stall for cattle (from their resting there): - stall.

H7518.full: rats rats Contracted from H7538; a fragment: - piece.

H7519.full: A primitive root; to run; also to delight in: - accept, run.

H7520.full: A primitive root; probably to look askant, that is, (figuratively) be jealous: - leap.

H7521.firstSense: (be) accept (-able), accomplish, set affection, approve, consent with, delight (self),…
H7521.full: A primitive root; to be pleased with; specifically to satisfy a debt: - (be) accept (-able), accomplish, set affection, approve, consent with, delight (self), enjoy, (be, have a) favour (-able), like, observe, pardon, (be, have, take) please (-ure), reconcile self.

H7522.firstSense: (be) acceptable (-ance, -ed), delight, desire, favour, (good) pleasure, (own, self, vol…
H7522.full: From H7521; delight: - (be) acceptable (-ance, -ed), delight, desire, favour, (good) pleasure, (own, self, voluntary) will, as . . . (what) would.

H7523.firstSense: put to death, kill, (man-) slay (-er), murder (-er)
H7523.full: A primitive root; properly to dash in pieces, that is, kill (a human being), especially to murder: - put to death, kill, (man-) slay (-er), murder (-er).

H7524.full: From H7523; a crushing; specifically a murder cry: - slaughter, sword.

H7525.full: rits-yaw' From H7521; delight; Ritsjah, an Israelite: - Rezia.

H7526.full: Probably for H7522; Retsin, the name of a Syrian and of an Israelite: - Rezin.

H7527.full: A primitive root; to pierce: - bore.

H7528.full: A denominative from H7529; to tessellate, that is, embroider (as if with bright stones): - pave.

H7529.full: For H7565; a red hot stone (for baking): - coal.

H7530.full: The same as H7529; Retseph, a place in Assyria: - Rezeph.

H7531.full: Feminine of H7529; a hot stone; also a tessellated pavement: - live coal, pavement.

H7532.full: The same as H7531; Ritspah, an Israelitess: - Rizpah.

H7533.firstSense: break, bruise, crush, discourage, oppress, struggle together
H7533.full: A primitive root; to crack in pieces, literally or figuratively: - break, bruise, crush, discourage, oppress, struggle together.

H7534.full: raq rak From H7556 in its original sense; emaciated (as if flattened out): - lean([-fleshed]), thin.

H7535.firstSense: but, even, except, howbeit howsoever, at the least, nevertheless, nothing but, notwiths…
H7535.full: raq rak The same as H7534 as a noun; properly leanness, that is, (figuratively) limitation; only adverbially merely, or conjugationally although: - but, even, except, howbeit howsoever, at the least, nevertheless, nothing but, notwithstanding, only, save, so [that], surely, yet (so), in any wise.

H7536.full: rôq roke From H7556; spittle: - spit (-ting, -tle).

H7537.full: A primitive root; to decay (as by worm eating): - rot.

H7540.full: A primitive root; properly to stamp, that is, to spring about (wildly or for joy): - dance, jump, leap, skip.

H7541.full: Feminine of H7534; properly thinness, that is, the side of the head: - temple.

H7542.full: From H7534; thinness; Rakkon, a place in Palestine: - Rakkon.

H7543.full: A primitive root; to perfume: - apothecary, compound, make [ointment], prepare, spice.

H7544.full: From H7543; properly perfumery, that is, (by implication) spicery (for flavor): - spiced.

H7545.full: From H7542; an aromatic: - confection, ointment.

H7546.full: From H7543; a male perfumer: - apothecary.

H7547.full: From H7543; a scented substance: - perfume.

H7548.full: Feminine of H7547; a female perfumer: - confectioner.

H7549.full: From H7554; properly an expanse, that is, the firmament or (apparently) visible arch of the sky: - firmament.

H7550.full: From H7556 in its original sense; a thin cake: - cake, wafer.

H7551.full: A primitive root; to variegate color, that is, embroider; by implication to fabricate: - embroiderer, needlework, curiously work.

H7552.full: From H7551; versicolor; Rekem, the name of a place in Palestine, also of a Midianite and an Israelite: - Rekem.

H7553.firstSense: broidered (work), divers colours, (raiment of) needlework (on both sides)
H7553.full: From H7551; variegation of color; specifically embroidery: - broidered (work), divers colours, (raiment of) needlework (on both sides).

H7554.firstSense: beat, make broad, spread abroad (forth, over, out, into plates), stamp, stretch
H7554.full: A primitive root; to pound the earth (as a sign of passion); by analogy to expand (by hammering); by implication to overlay (with thin sheets of metal): - beat, make broad, spread abroad (forth, over, out, into plates), stamp, stretch.

H7555.full: From H7554; beaten out, that is, a (metallic) plate: - broad.

H7556.full: A primitive root; to spit: - spit.

H7557.full: From H7556 in its original sense of diffusing; a beach (as expanded shingle); Rakkath, a place in Palestine: - Rakkath.

H7558.full: From an unused root meaning to have leave; a permit: - grant.

H7559.full: A primitive root; to record: - note.

H7561.firstSense: condemn, make trouble, vex, be (commit, deal, depart, do) wicked (-ly, -ness)
H7561.full: A primitive root; to be (causatively do or declare) wrong; by implication to disturb, violate: - condemn, make trouble, vex, be (commit, deal, depart, do) wicked (-ly, -ness).

H7562.full: From H7561; a wrong (especially moral): - iniquity, wicked(-ness).

H7563.firstSense: + condemned, guilty, ungodly, wicked (man), that did wrong
H7563.full: From H7561; morally wrong; concretely an (actively) bad person: - + condemned, guilty, ungodly, wicked (man), that did wrong.

H7564.full: Feminine of H7562; wrong (especially moral): - fault, wickedly (-ness).

H7565.firstSense: arrow, (burning) coal, burning heat, + spark, hot thunderbolt
H7565.full: From H8313; a live coal; by analogy lightning; figuratively an arrow (as flashing through the air); specifically fever: - arrow, (burning) coal, burning heat, + spark, hot thunderbolt.

H7566.full: The same as H7565; Resheph, an Israelite: - Resheph.

H7567.full: A primitive root; to demolish: - impoverish.

H7568.full: From H3423; a net (as catching animals): - net [-work].

H7570.full: A primitive root; to boil: - boil.

H7571.full: From H7570; a boiling: - X [boil] well.

H7573.full: A primitive root; to yoke up (to the pole of a vehicle): - bind.

H7574.full: From H7573; the Spanish broom (from its pole like stems): - juniper (tree).

H7575.full: Feminine of H7574; Rithmah, a place in the Desert: - Rithmah.

H7576.full: A primitive root; to fasten: - bind.

H7577.full: Feminine passive participle of H7576; something fastened, that is, a chain: - chain.

H7579.full: shaw-ab' A primitive root; to bale up water: - (woman to) draw (-er, water).

H7580.full: shaw-ag' A primitive root; to rumble or moan: - X mightily, roar.

H7581.full: sheh-aw-gaw' From H7580; a rumbling or moan: - roaring.

H7582.full: A primitive root; to rush; by implication to desolate: - be desolate, (make a) rush (-ing), (lay) waste.

H7583.full: A primitive root (rather identical with H7582 through the idea of whirling to giddiness); to stun, that is, (intransitively) be astonished: - wonder.

H7584.full: shah-av-aw' From H7582; a tempest (as rushing): - desolation.

H7585.full: sheh-ole', sheh-ole' From H7592; hades or the world of the dead (as if a subterranian retreat), including its accessories and inmates: - grave, hell, pit.

H7586.full: Passive participle of H7592; asked; Shaul, the name of an Edomite and two Israelites: - Saul, Shaul.

H7587.full: Patronymic from H7856; a Shaulite or descendant of Shaul: - Shaulites.

H7588.firstSense: X horrible, noise, pomp, rushing, tumult (X -uous)
H7588.full: From H7582; uproar (as of rushing); by implication destruction: - X horrible, noise, pomp, rushing, tumult (X -uous).

H7589.full: From an unused root meaning to push aside; contempt: - despite (-ful).

H7590.full: For active participle of H7750 (compare H7589); one contemning: - that (which) despise (-d).

H7592.firstSense: ask (counsel, on), beg, borrow, lay to charge, consult, demand, desire, X earnestly, en…
H7592.full: shaw-al', shaw-ale' A primitive root; to inquire; by implication to request; by extension to demand: - ask (counsel, on), beg, borrow, lay to charge, consult, demand, desire, X earnestly, enquire, + greet, obtain leave, lend, pray, request, require, + salute, X straitly, X surely, wish.

H7593.full: sheh-ale' (Chaldee); corresponding to H7592: - ask, demand, require.

H7594.full: sheh-awl' From H7592; request; Sheal, an Israelite: - Sheal.
