H7595.full: sheh-ay-law' (Chaldee); from H7593; properly a question (at law), that is, judicial decision or mandate: - demand.

H7596.full: sheh-ay-law', shay-law' From H7592; a petition; by implication a loan: - loan, petition, request.

H7597.full: sheh-al-tee-ale', shal-tee-ale' From H7592 and H410; I have asked God; Shealtiel, an Israelite: - Shalthiel, Shealtiel.

H7599.firstSense: be at ease, be quiet, rest
H7599.full: shaw-an' A primitive root; to loll, that is, be peaceful: - be at ease, be quiet, rest. See also H1052.

H7600.firstSense: that is at ease, quiet, tumult
H7600.full: shah-an-awn' From H7599; secure; in a bad sense, haughty: - that is at ease, quiet, tumult. Compare H7946.

H7601.full: shaw-as' A primitive root; to plunder: - spoil.

H7602.firstSense: desire (earnestly), devour, haste, pant, snuff up, swallow up
H7602.full: shaw-af' A primitive root; to inhale eagerly; figuratively to covet; by implication to be angry; also to hasten: - desire (earnestly), devour, haste, pant, snuff up, swallow up.

H7603.full: From H7604; barm or yeast cake (as swelling by fermentation): - leaven.

H7604.firstSense: leave, (be) left, let, remain, remnant, reserve, the rest
H7604.full: shaw-ar' A primitive root; properly to swell up, that is, be (causatively make) redundant: - leave, (be) left, let, remain, remnant, reserve, the rest.

H7605.full: sheh-awr' From H7604; a remainder: - X other, remnant, residue, rest.

H7606.full: sheh-awr' (Chaldee); corresponding to H7605: - X whatsoever more, residue, rest.

H7607.firstSense: body, flesh, food, (near) kin (-sman, -swoman), near (nigh) [of kin]
H7607.full: sheh-ayr' From H7604; flesh (as swelling out), as living or for food; generally food of any kind; figuratively kindred by blood: - body, flesh, food, (near) kin (-sman, -swoman), near (nigh) [of kin]

H7608.full: shah-ar-aw' Feminine of H7607; female kindred by blood: - near kinswomen.

H7609.full: sheh-er-aw' The same as H7608; Sheerah, an Israelitess: - Sherah.

H7610.full: sheh-awr' yaw-shoob' From H7605 and H7725; a remnant will return; Shear-Jashub, the symbolical name of one of Isaiah's sons: - Shear-jashub.

H7611.firstSense: that had escaped, be left, posterity, remain (-der), remnant, residue, rest
H7611.full: sheh-ay-reeth' From H7604; a remainder or residual (surviving, final) portion: - that had escaped, be left, posterity, remain (-der), remnant, residue, rest.

H7613.firstSense: be accepted, dignity, excellency, highness, raise up self, rising
H7613.full: From H5375; an elevation or leprous scab; figuratively elation or cheerfulness; exaltation in rank or character: - be accepted, dignity, excellency, highness, raise up self, rising.

H7614.full: sheb-aw' Of foreign origin; Sheba, the name of three early progenitors of tribes and of an Ethiopian district: - Sheba, Sabeans.

H7615.full: sheb-aw-ee' Patronymic from H7614; a Shebaite or descendant of Sheba: - Sabean.

H7616.full: From an unused root meaning to break up; a fragment, that is, ruin: - broken in pieces.

H7617.firstSense: (bring away, carry, carry away, lead, lead away, take) captive (-s), drive (take) away
H7617.full: A primitive root; to transport into captivity: - (bring away, carry, carry away, lead, lead away, take) captive (-s), drive (take) away.

H7618.full: From an unused root (probably identical with that of H7617 through the idea of subdivision into flashes or streamers (compare H7632)) meaning to flame; a gem (from its sparkle), probably the agate: - agate.

H7619.full: From H7617 (abbreviated) or H7725 and H410; captive (or returned) of God; Shebuel or Shubael, the name of two Israelites: - Shebuel, Shubael.

H7620.full: Properly passive participle of H7650 as a denominative of H7651; literally sevened, that is, a week (specifically of years): - seven, week.

H7621.full: Feminine passive participle of H7650; properly something sworn, that is, an oath: - curse, oath, X sworn.

H7622.full: From H7617; exile; concretely prisoners; figuratively a former state of prosperity: - captive (-ity).

H7623.firstSense: commend, glory, keep in, praise, still, triumph
H7623.full: A primitive root; properly to address in a loud tone, that is, (specifically) loud; figuratively to pacify (as if by words): - commend, glory, keep in, praise, still, triumph.

H7624.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H7623; to adulate, that is, adore: - praise.

H7625.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H7626; a clan: - tribe.

H7626.firstSense: X correction, dart, rod, sceptre, staff, tribe
H7626.full: From an unused root probably meaning to branch off; a scion, that is, (literally) a stick (for punishing, writing, fighting, ruling, walking, etc.) or (figuratively) a clan: - X correction, dart, rod, sceptre, staff, tribe.

H7627.full: Of foreign origin; Shebat, a Jewish month: - Sebat.

H7628.firstSense: captive (-ity), prisoners, X take away, that was taken
H7628.full: From H7618; exiled; captured; as noun, exile (abstractly or concretely and collectively); by extension booty: - captive (-ity), prisoners, X take away, that was taken.

H7629.full: From H7617; captor; Shobi, an Ammonite: - Shobi.

H7630.full: For H7629; Shobai, an Israelite: - Shobai.

H7632.full: From the same as H7616; flame (as split into tongues): - spark.

H7633.full: Feminine of H7628; exile (abstractly or concretely and collectively): - captives (-ity).

H7634.full: Feminine of the same as H7629; captivation; Shobjah, an Israelite: - Shachia [from the margin].

H7635.full: From the same as H7640; a track or passage way (as if flowing along): - path.

H7636.full: From an unused root meaning to interweave; a netting for the hair: - caul.

H7638.full: From an unused root meaning to intwine; a netting (ornament to the capital of a column): - net.

H7639.full: Feminine of H7638; a net work, that is, (in hunting) a snare, (in architecture) a ballustrade; also a reticulated ornament to a pillar: - checker, lattice, network, snare, wreath (-enwork).

H7640.full: From an unused root meaning to flow; a lady's train (as trailing after her): - leg.

H7641.firstSense: branch, channel, ear (of corn), ([water-]) flood, Shibboleth
H7641.full: From the same as H7640; a stream (as flowing); also an ear of grain (as growing out); by analogy a branch: - branch, channel, ear (of corn), ([water-]) flood, Shibboleth. Compare H5451.

H7642.full: From the same as H7640; a snail (as if floating in its own slime): - snail.

H7643.full: Probably from H1313; spice; Sebam or Sibmah, a place in Moab: - Shebam, Shibmah, Sibmah.

H7644.full: sheb-naw', sheb-naw' From an unused root meaning to grow; growth; Shebna or Shebnah, an Israelite: - Shebna, Shebnah.

H7645.full: From the same as H7644 and H3050; Jah has grown (that is, prospered); Shebanjah, the name of three or four Israelites: - Shebaniah.

H7646.firstSense: have enough, fill (full, self, with), be (to the) full (of), have plenty of, be satiate…
H7646.full: A primitive root; to sate, that is, fill to satisfaction (literally or figuratively): - have enough, fill (full, self, with), be (to the) full (of), have plenty of, be satiate, satisfy (with), suffice, be weary of.

H7648.full: From H7646; satisfaction (of food or (figuratively) joy): - fill, full (-ness), satisfying, be satisfied.

H7649.full: From H7646; satiated (in a pleasant or disagreeable sense): - full (of), satisfied (with).

H7650.firstSense: adjure, charge (by an oath, with an oath), feed to the full [by mistake for H7646], tak…
H7650.full: A primitive root; properly to be complete, but used only as a denominative from H7651; to seven oneself, that is, swear (as if by repeating a declaration seven times): - adjure, charge (by an oath, with an oath), feed to the full [by mistake for H7646], take an oath, X straitly, (cause to, make to) swear.

H7651.full: From H7650; a primitive cardinal number; seven (as the sacred full one); also (adverbially) seven times; by implication a week; by extension an indefinite number: - (+ by) seven ([-fold], -s, [-teen, -teenth], -th, times). Compare H7658.

H7652.full: The same as H7651; seven; Sheba, the name of a place in Palestine, and of two Israelites: - Sheba.

H7654.full: Feminine of H7648; satiety: - (to have) enough, X till . . . be full, [un-] satiable, satisfy, X sufficiently.

H7656.full: Masculine of H7651; seven (seventh); Shebah, a well in Palestine: - Shebah.

H7657.full: Multiple of H7651; seventy: - seventy, threescore and ten (+ -teen).

H7658.full: Prolonged for the masculine of H7651; seven: - seven.

H7659.full: Dual (adverb) of H7651; seven times: - seven (-fold, times).

H7660.full: A primitive root; to interweave (colored) threads in squares; by implication (of reticulation) to inchase gems in gold: - embroider, set.

H7661.full: From H7660; intanglement, that is, (figuratively) perplexity: - anguish.

H7662.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to the root of H7733; to quit, that is, allow to remain: - leave, let alone.

H7663.full: The second form being used erroneously in Neh_2:13, Neh_2:15; a primitive root; to scrutinize; by implication (of watching) to expect (with hope and patience): - hope, tarry, view, wait.

H7665.firstSense: break (down, off, in pieces, up), broken ([-hearted]), bring to the birth, crush, destr…
H7665.full: A primitive root; to burst (literally or figuratively): - break (down, off, in pieces, up), broken ([-hearted]), bring to the birth, crush, destroy, hurt, quench, X quite, tear, view [by mistake for H7663].

H7666.full: Denominative from H7668; to deal in grain: - buy, sell.

H7667.firstSense: affliction, breach, breaking, broken [-footed, -handed], bruise, crashing, destruction,…
H7667.full: From H7665; a fracture, figuratively ruin; specifically a solution (of a dream): - affliction, breach, breaking, broken [-footed, -handed], bruise, crashing, destruction, hurt, interpretation, vexation.

H7668.full: The same as H7667; grain (as if broken into kernels): - corn, victuals.

H7669.full: The same as H7667; Sheber, an Israelite: - Sheber.

H7670.full: From H7665; rupture, that is, a pang; figuratively ruin: - breaking, destruction.

H7671.full: Plural of H7667; ruins; Shebarim, a place in Palestine: - Shebarim.

H7672.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H7660; to intangle, that is, perplex: - be astonished.

H7673.firstSense: (cause to, let, make to) cease, celebrate, cause (make) to fail, keep (sabbath), suffer…
H7673.full: A primitive root; to repose, that is, desist from exertion; used in many implied relations (causatively, figuratively or specifically): - (cause to, let, make to) cease, celebrate, cause (make) to fail, keep (sabbath), suffer to be lacking, leave, put away (down), (make to) rest, rid, still, take away.

H7674.firstSense: cease, sit still, loss of time
H7674.full: From H7673; rest, interruption, cessation: - cease, sit still, loss of time.

H7675.full: Infinitive of H3427; properly session; but used also concretely, an abode or locality. Comapre H3429: - place, seat. Compare H3429.

H7676.full: Intensive from H7673; intermission, that is, (specifically) the Sabbath: - (+ every) sabbath.

H7677.full: From H7676; a sabbatism or special holiday: - rest, sabbath.

H7678.full: From H7676; restful; Shabbethai, the name of three Israelites: - Shabbethai.

H7679.full: A primitive root; to grow, that is, (causatively) to enlarge, (figuratively) laud: - increase, magnify.

H7680.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H7679; to increase: - grow, be multiplied.

H7681.full: Probably from H7686; erring; Shage, an Israelite: - Shage.

H7682.firstSense: defend, exalt, be excellent, (be, set on) high, lofty, be safe, set up (on high), be to…
H7682.full: A primitive root; to be (causatively make) lofty, especially inaccessible; by implication safe, strong; used literally and figuratively: - defend, exalt, be excellent, (be, set on) high, lofty, be safe, set up (on high), be too strong.

H7683.firstSense: X also for that, deceived, err, go astray, sin ignorantly
H7683.full: A primitive root; to stray, that is, (figuratively) sin (with more or less apology): - X also for that, deceived, err, go astray, sin ignorantly.

H7684.full: From H7683; a mistake or inadvertent transgression: - error, ignorance, at unawares, unwittingly.

H7685.full: A primitive root; to enlarge (especially upward, also figuratively): - grow (up), increase.

H7686.firstSense: (cause to) go astray, deceive, err, be ravished, sin through ignorance, (let, make to)…
H7686.full: A primitive root; to stray (causatively mislead), usually (figuratively) to mistake, especially (morally) to transgress; by extension (through the idea of intoxication) to reel, (figuratively) be enraptured: - (cause to) go astray, deceive, err, be ravished, sin through ignorance, (let, make to) wander.

H7687.full: From H7682; aloft; Segub, the name of two Israelites: - Segub.

H7688.full: A primitive root; to peep, that is, glance sharply at: - look (narrowly).

H7689.full: sag-ghee' From H7679; (superlatively) mighty: - excellent, great.

H7690.firstSense: exceeding, great (-ly), many, much, sore, very
H7690.full: sag-ghee' H3 (Chaldee); corresponding to H7689; large (in size, quantity or number, also adverbially): - exceeding, great (-ly), many, much, sore, very.

H7691.full: sheg-ee-aw' From H7686; a moral mistake: - error.

H7692.full: From H7686; properly aberration, that is, (technically) a dithyramb or rambling poem: - Shiggaion, Shigio-noth.

H7693.full: A primitive root; to copulate with: - lie with, ravish.

H7694.full: From H7693; a queen (from cohabitation): - queen.

H7695.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H7694; a (legitimate) queen: - wife.

H7696.full: A primitive root; to rave through insanity: - (be, play the) mad (man).

H7698.full: From an unused root probably meaning to eject; the foetus (as finally expelled): - that cometh of, increase.

H7699.full: shad shôd shad, shode Probably from H7736 (in its original sense) contracted; the breast of a woman or animal (as bulging): - breast, pap, teat.

H7700.full: shêd shade From H7736; a daemon (as malignant): - devil.

H7701.firstSense: desolation, destruction, oppression, robbery, spoil (-ed, -er, -ing), wasting
H7701.full: shôd shôd shode, shode From H7736; violence, ravage: - desolation, destruction, oppression, robbery, spoil (-ed, -er, -ing), wasting.

H7702.full: A primitive root; to abrade, that is, harrow a field: - break clods, harrow.

H7703.firstSense: dead, destroy (-er), oppress, robber, spoil (-er), X utterly, (lay) waste
H7703.full: A primitive root; properly to be burly, that is, (figuratively) powerful (passively impregnable); by implication to ravage: - dead, destroy (-er), oppress, robber, spoil (-er), X utterly, (lay) waste.

H7704.firstSense: country, field, ground, land, soil, X wild
H7704.full: From an unused root meaning to spread out; a field (as flat): - country, field, ground, land, soil, X wild.

H7705.full: From H7703; a wife (as mistress of the house): - X all sorts, musical instrument.

H7707.full: shed-ay-oor' From the same as H7704 and H217; spreader of light; Shedejur, an Israelite: - Shedeur.

H7708.full: Plural from the same as H7704; flats; Siddim, a valley in Palestine: - Siddim.

H7709.full: Apparently from H7704; a cultivated field: - blasted, field.

H7710.full: A primitive root; to scorch: - blast.

H7712.full: (Chaldee); a primitive root; to endeavor: - labour.

H7713.full: From an unused root meaning to regulate; a row, that is, rank (of soldiers), story (of rooms): - board, range.

H7714.full: Probably of foreign origin; Shadrak, the Babylonian name of one of Daniel's companions: - Shadrach.

H7716.full: Probably from H7582 through the idea of pushing out to graze; a member of a flock, that is, a sheep or goat: - (lesser, small) cattle, ewe, lamb, sheep.

H7717.full: From an unused root meaning to testify; a witness: - record.

H7718.full: From an unused root probably meaning to blanch; a gem, probably the beryl (from its pale green color): - onyx.

H7719.full: The same as H7718; Shoham, an Israelite: - Shoham.

H7720.firstSense: ornament, round tire like the moon
H7720.full: From the same as H5469; a round pendant for the neck: - ornament, round tire like the moon.

H7721.full: From an unused root (akin to H5375 and H7722) meaning to rise; a rising: - arise.

H7722.full: From an unused root meaning to rush over; a tempest; by implication devastation: - desolate (-ion), destroy, destruction, storm, wasteness.

H7723.full: shawv, shav From the same as H7722 in the sense of desolating; evil (as destructive), literally (ruin) or morally (especially guile); figuratively idolatry (as false, subjectively), uselessness (as deceptive, objectively; also adverbially in vain): - false (-ly), lie, lying, vain, vanity.

H7724.full: shev-aw' From the same as H7723; false; Sheva, an Israelite: - Sheva.

H7725.firstSense: ([break, build, circumcise, dig, do anything, do evil, feed, lay down, lie down, lodge,…
H7725.full: shûb shoob A primitive root; to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbially again: - ([break, build, circumcise, dig, do anything, do evil, feed, lay down, lie down, lodge, make, rejoice, send, take, weep]) X again, (cause to) answer (+ again), X in any case (wise), X at all, averse, bring (again, back, home again), call [to mind], carry again (back), cease, X certainly, come again (back) X consider, + continually, convert, deliver (again), + deny, draw back, fetch home again, X fro, get [oneself] (back) again, X give (again), go again (back, home), [go] out, hinder, let, [see] more, X needs, be past, X pay, pervert, pull in again, put (again, up again), recall, recompense, recover, refresh, relieve, render (again), X repent, requite, rescue, restore, retrieve, (cause to, make to) return, reverse, reward, + say nay, send back, set again, slide back, still, X surely, take back (off), (cause to, make to) turn (again, self again, away, back, back again, backward, from, off), withdraw.

H7726.full: From H7725; apostate, that is, idolatrous: - backsliding, frowardly, turn away [from margin].

H7727.full: The same as H7726; rebellious; Shobab, the name of two Israelites: - Shobab.

H7728.full: From H7725; apostate, that is, heathenish or (actually) heathen: - backsliding.

H7730.full: From H5441; a thicket, that is, interlaced branches: - thick boughs.

H7731.full: Perhaps for H7730; Shobak, a Syrian: - Shobach.

H7732.full: From the same as H7640; overflowing; Shobal, the name of an Edomite and two Israelites: - Shobal.

H7733.full: Active participle from a primitive root meaning to leave (compare H7662); forsaking; Shobek, an Israelite: - Shobek.

H7734.full: A primitive root; to retreat: - turn back.

H7735.full: A primitive root; to hedge in: - make to grow.

H7736.full: shûd shood A primitive root; properly to swell up, that is, figuratively (by implication of insolence) to devastate: - waste.

H7737.firstSense: avail, behave, bring forth, compare, countervail, (be, make) equal, lay, be (make, a-)…
H7737.full: A primitive root; properly to level, that is, equalize; figuratively to resemble; by implication to adjust (that is, counterbalance, be suitable, compose, place, yield, etc.): - avail, behave, bring forth, compare, countervail, (be, make) equal, lay, be (make, a-) like, make plain, profit, reckon.

H7738.full: A primitive root; to destroy: - X substance [from the margin].

H7739.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H7737; to resemble: - make like.

H7740.full: From H7737; plain; Shaveh, a place in Palestine: - Shaveh.

H7741.full: From the same as H7740 and the dual of H7151; plain of a double city; Shaveh Kirjathajim, a place East of the Jordan: - Shaveh Kiriathaim.

H7742.full: A primitive root; to muse pensively: - meditate.

H7743.full: A primitive root; to sink, literally or figuratively: - bow down, incline, humble.

H7744.full: From H7743; dell; Shuach, a son of Abraham: - Shuah.

H7745.full: From H7743; a chasm: - ditch, pit.

H7746.full: The same as H7745; Shuchah, an Israelite: - Shuah.

H7747.full: Patronymic from H7744; a Shuchite or descendant of Shuach: - Shuhite.

H7748.full: From H7743; humbly; Shucham, an Israelite: - Shuham.

H7749.full: Patronymic from H7748; a Shuchamite (collectively): - Shuhamites.

H7750.full: A primitive root; to detrude, that is, (intransitively and figuratively) become derelict (wrongly practise; namely, idolatry): - turn aside to.

H7751.firstSense: go (about, through, to and fro), mariner, rower, run to and fro
H7751.full: A primitive root; properly to push forth; (but used only figuratively) to lash, that is, (the sea with oars) to row; by implication to travel: - go (about, through, to and fro), mariner, rower, run to and fro.

H7752.full: From H7751; a lash (literally or figuratively): - scourge, whip.

H7753.full: A primitive root; to entwine, that is, shut in (for formation, protection or restraint): - fence. (make an) hedge (up).

H7754.full: The second form being feminine; from H7753; a branch (as interleaved): - bough.

H7755.full: From H7753; Sokoh or Soko, the name of two places in Palestine: - Shocho, Shochoh, Sochoh, Soco, Socoh.

H7756.full: Probably patronymic from a name corresponding to H7754 (feminine); a Sukathite or descendant of an unknown Israelite named Sukah: - Suchathite.

H7757.full: shûl shool From an unused root meaning to hang down; a skirt; by implication a bottom edge: - hem, skirt, train.

H7758.full: The second form being used in Mic_1:8; from H7997; nude (especially bare foot); by implication captive: - spoiled, stripped.

H7759.full: From H7999; peaceful (with the article always prefixed, making it a pet name); the Shulammith, an epithet of Solomon's queen: - Shulamite.

H7760.firstSense: X any wise, appoint, bring, call [a name], care, cast in, change, charge, commit, consi…
H7760.full: A primitive root; to put (used in a great variety of applications, literally, figuratively, inferentially and elliptically): - X any wise, appoint, bring, call [a name], care, cast in, change, charge, commit, consider, convey, determine, + disguise, dispose, do, get, give, heap up, hold, impute, lay (down, up), leave, look, make (out), mark, + name, X on, ordain, order, + paint, place, preserve, purpose, put (on), + regard, rehearse, reward, (cause to) set (on, up), shew, + stedfastly, take, X tell, + tread down, ([over-]) turn, X wholly, work.

H7761.firstSense: + command, give, lay, make, + name, + regard, set
H7761.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H7760: - + command, give, lay, make, + name, + regard, set.

H7762.full: shûm shoom From an unused root meaning to exhale; garlic (from its rank odor): - garlic.

H7763.full: Active participle of H8104; keeper; Shomer, the name of two Israelites: - Shomer.

H7764.full: From an unused root meaning to rest; quiet; Shuni, an Israelite: - Shuni.

H7765.full: Patronymic from H7764; a Shunite (collectively) or descendant of Shuni: - Shunites.

H7766.full: Probably from the same as H7764; quietly; Shunem, a place in Palestine: - Shunem.

H7767.full: Patrial from H7766; a Shunammitess, or female inhabitant of Shunem: - Shunamite.

H7768.full: A primitive root; properly to be free; but used only causatively and reflexively to halloo (for help, that is, freedom from some trouble): - cry (aloud, out), shout.

H7769.full: From H7768; a halloo: - cry, riches.

H7770.full: The same as H7769; shua, a Canaanite: - Shua, Shuah.

H7771.full: From H7768 in the original sense of freedom; a noble, that is, liberal, opulent; also (as noun in the derived sense) a halloo: - bountiful, crying, rich.

H7772.full: The same as H7771; rich; Shoa, an Oriental people: - Shoa.

H7774.full: From H7768; wealth; Shua, an Israelitess: - Shua.

H7775.full: Feminine of H7773; a hallooing: - crying.

H7776.full: From the same as H8168; a jackal (as a burrower): - fox.

H7777.full: The same as H7776; Shual, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine: - Shual.

H7778.full: Active participle of H8176 (as denominative from H8179); a janitor: - doorkeeper, porter.

H7779.full: shûph shoof A primitive root; properly to gape, that is, snap at; figuratively to overwhelm: - break, bruise, cover.

H7780.full: From H8210; poured; Shophak, a Syrian: - Shophach.

H7781.full: Patronymic from H8197; a Shuphamite (collectively) or descendant of Shephupham: - Shuphamite.

H7782.full: From H8231 in the original sense of incising; a cornet (as giving a clear sound) or curved horn: - cornet, trumpet.

H7783.full: shûq shook A primitive root; to run after or over, that is, overflow: - overflow, water.

H7784.full: shûq shook From H7783; a street (as run over): - street.

H7785.full: shôq shoke From H7783; the (lower) leg (as a runner): - hip, leg, shoulder, thigh.

H7786.full: A primitive root; properly to vanquish; by implication to rule (causatively crown): - make princes, have power, reign. See H5493.

H7787.full: A primitive root (rather identical with H7786 through the idea of reducing to pieces; compare H4883); to saw: - cut.

H7788.full: shûr shoor A primitive root; properly to turn, that is, travel about (as a harlot or a merchant): - go, sing. See also H7891.

H7789.firstSense: behold, lay wait, look, observe, perceive, regard, see
H7789.full: shûr shoor A primitive root (rather identical with H7788 through the idea of going round for inspection); to spy out, that is, (generally) survey, (for evil) lurk for, (for good) care for: - behold, lay wait, look, observe, perceive, regard, see.

H7790.full: shûr shoor From H7889; a foe (as lying in wait): - enemy.

H7791.full: shûr shoor From H7788; a wall (as going about): - wall.

H7792.full: shûr shoor (Chaldee); corresponding to H7791: - wall.

H7793.full: shûr shoor The same as H7791; Shur, a region of the Desert: - Shur.

H7794.firstSense: bull (-ock), cow, ox, wall [by mistake for H7791]
H7794.full: shôr shore From H7788; a bullock (as a traveller). wall used by mistake for H7791: - bull (-ock), cow, ox, wall [by mistake for H7791].

H7795.full: From H7786 in the primitive sense of H5493; properly a ring, that is, (by analogy) a row (adverbially): - principal.

H7796.full: The same as H8321; a vine; Sorek, a valley in Palestine: - Sorek.

H7797.firstSense: be glad, X greatly, joy, make mirth, rejoice
H7797.full: A primitive root; to be bright, that is, cheerful: - be glad, X greatly, joy, make mirth, rejoice.

H7798.full: shav-shaw' From H7797; joyful; Shavsha, an Israelite: - Shavsha.

H7799.full: From H7797; a lily (from its whiteness), as a flower or architectural ornament; also a (straight) trumpet (from the tubular shape): - lily, Shoshannim.

H7800.full: The same as H7799; Shushan, a place in Persia: - Shushan.

H7801.full: (Chaldee); of foreign origin; a Shushankite (collectively) or inhabitant of some unknown place in Assyria: - Susanchites.

H7802.full: The second form being plural; from H7799 and H5715; lily (or trumpet) of assemblage; Shushan Eduth or Shoshannim Eduth, the title of a popular song: - Shoshannim-Eduth, Shushan-eduth.

H7803.full: Probably from H7582 and the same as H8520; crash of breakage; Shuthelach, the name of two Israelites: - Shuthelah.

H7804.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H5800; to leave, that is, (causatively) free: - deliver.

H7805.full: A primitive root; to tan (by sun burning); figuratively (as if by a piercing ray) to scan: - look up, see.

H7806.full: A primitive root; to twist (a thread of straw): - twine.

H7807.full: shach shakh From H7817; sunk, that is, downcast: - + humble.

H7808.full: From H7879; communion, that is, (reflexively) meditation: - thought.

H7809.full: A primitive root; to donate, that is, bribe: - hire, give a reward.

H7810.full: From H7809; a donation (venal or redemptive): - bribe (-ry), gift, present, reward.

H7811.full: A primitive root; to swim; causatively to inundate: - (make to) swim.

H7812.firstSense: bow (self) down, crouch, fall down (flat), humbly beseech, do (make) obeisance, do reve…
H7812.full: A primitive root; to depress, that is, prostrate (especially reflexively in homage to royalty or God): - bow (self) down, crouch, fall down (flat), humbly beseech, do (make) obeisance, do reverence, make to stoop, worship.

H7813.full: From H7811; a pond (for swimming): - to swim in.

H7814.firstSense: derision, laughter (-ed to scorn, -ing), mocked, sport
H7814.full: From H7832; laughter (in meriment or defiance): - derision, laughter (-ed to scorn, -ing), mocked, sport.

H7815.full: From H7835; dinginess, that is, perhaps soot: - coal.

H7817.firstSense: bend, bow (down), bring (cast) down, couch, humble self, be (bring) low, stoop
H7817.full: A primitive root; to sink or depress (reflexively or causatively): - bend, bow (down), bring (cast) down, couch, humble self, be (bring) low, stoop.

H7818.full: A primitive root; to tread out, that is, squeeze (grapes): - press.

H7819.firstSense: kill, offer, shoot out, slay, slaughter
H7819.full: A primitive root; to slaughter (in sacrifice or massacre): - kill, offer, shoot out, slay, slaughter.

H7820.full: A primitive root (rather identical with H7819 through the idea of striking); to hammer out: - beat.

H7822.full: From an unused root probably meaning to burn; inflammation, that is, an ulcer: - boil, botch.

H7823.full: From an unused root apparently meaning to sprout; after growth: - (that) which springeth of the same.

H7824.full: From the same as H7828; a board (as chipped thin): - cieled with.

H7825.full: From H7812; a pit fall (literally or figuratively): - destruction, pit.

H7826.full: From an unused root probably meaning to roar; a lion (from his characteristic roar): - (fierce) lion.

H7827.full: Apparently from the same as H7826 through some obscure idea, perhaps that of peeling off by concussion of sound; a scale or shell, that is, the aromatic mussel: - onycha.

H7828.full: From an unused root meaning to peel, that is, emaciate; the gull (as thin): - cuckoo.

H7829.full: From the same as H7828; emaciation: - consumption.

H7830.full: From an unused root apparently meaning to strut; haughtiness (as evinced by the attitude): - X lion, pride.

H7831.full: From the same as H7830; proudly; Shachatsom, a place in Palestine: - Shahazimah [from the margin].

H7832.firstSense: deride, have in derision, laugh, make merry, mock (-er), play, rejoice, (laugh to) scor…
H7832.full: A primitive root; to laugh (in pleasure or detraction); by implication to play: - deride, have in derision, laugh, make merry, mock (-er), play, rejoice, (laugh to) scorn, be in (make) sport.

H7833.full: A primitive root; to comminute (by trituration or attrition): - beat, wear.

H7834.full: From H7833; a powder (as beaten small); by analogy a thin vapor; by extension the firmament: - cloud, small dust, heaven, sky.

H7835.full: A primitive root (rather identical with H7836 through the idea of the duskiness of early dawn); to be dim or dark (in color): - be black.

H7836.firstSense: [do something] betimes, enquire early, rise (seek) betimes, seek (diligently) early, in…
H7836.full: A primitive root; properly to dawn, that is, (figuratively) be (up) early at any task (with the implication of earnestness); by extension to search for (with painstaking): - [do something] betimes, enquire early, rise (seek) betimes, seek (diligently) early, in the morning).

H7837.firstSense: day (-spring), early, light, morning, whence riseth
H7837.full: From H7836; dawn (literally, figuratively or adverbially): - day (-spring), early, light, morning, whence riseth.

H7838.full: From H7835; properly dusky, but also (absolutely) jetty: - black.

H7839.full: From H7836; a dawning, that is, (figuratively) juvenescence: - youth.

H7841.full: From H7836 and H3050; Jah has sought; Shecharjah, an Israelite: - Shehariah.

H7842.full: Dual of H7837; double dawn; Shacharajim, an Israelite: - Shaharaim.

H7843.firstSense: batter, cast off, corrupt (-er, thing), destroy (-er, -uction), lose, mar, perish, spil…
H7843.full: A primitive root; to decay, that is, (causatively) ruin (literally or figuratively): - batter, cast off, corrupt (-er, thing), destroy (-er, -uction), lose, mar, perish, spill, spoiler, X utterly, waste (-r).

H7845.full: From H7743; a pit (especially as a trap); figuratively destruction: - corruption, destruction, ditch, grave, pit.

H7846.full: From H7750; a departure from right, that is, sin: - revolter, that turn aside.

H7847.full: A primitive root; to deviate from duty: - decline, go aside, turn.

H7848.full: Feminine of a derivative (the second form being only in the plural, meaning the sticks of wood) from the same as H7850; the acacia (from its scourging thorns): - shittah, shittim. See also H1029.

H7849.firstSense: all abroad, enlarge, spread, stretch out
H7849.full: A primitive root; to expand: - all abroad, enlarge, spread, stretch out.

H7850.full: Active participle of an otherwise unused root meaning (properly to pierce; but only as a denominative from H7752) to flog; a goad: - scourge.

H7851.full: The same as the plural of H7848; acacia trees; Shittim, a place East of the Jordan: - Shittim.

H7852.full: A primitive root; properly to lurk for, that is, persecute: - hate, oppose self against.

H7853.full: A primitive root; to attack, (figuratively) accuse: - (be an) adversary, resist.

H7854.full: From H7853; an opponent; especially (with the article prefixed) Satan, the arch enemy of good: - adversary, Satan, withstand.

H7856.full: The same as H7855; Sitnah, the name of a well in Palestine: - Sitnah.

H7857.firstSense: drown, (over-) flow (-whelm), rinse, run, rush, (throughly) wash (away)
H7857.full: A primitive root; to gush; by implication to inundate, cleanse; by analogy to gallop, conquer: - drown, (over-) flow (-whelm), rinse, run, rush, (throughly) wash (away).

H7858.full: From H7857; a deluge (literally or figuratively): - flood, outrageous, overflowing.

H7859.full: (Chaldee); of uncertain derivation; a side: - a side.

H7860.full: Active participle of an otherwise unused root probably meaning to write; properly a scribe, that is, (by analogy or implication) an official superintendent or magistrate: - officer, overseer, ruler.

H7861.full: From the same as H7860; magisterial; Shitrai, an Israelite: - Shitrai.

H7862.full: Probably from H7737; a gift (as available): - present.

H7863.full: From the same as H7721 by permutation; elevation: - excellency.

H7864.full: sheh-yaw' For H7724; Sheja, an Israelite: - Sheva [from the margin].

H7865.full: From H7863; peak; Sion, the summit of Mt. Hermon: - Sion.

H7866.full: shee-ohn' From the same as H7722; ruin; Shijon, a place in Palestine: - Shihon.

H7867.full: A primitive root; properly to become aged, that is, (by implication) to grow gray: - (be) grayheaded.

H7870.full: By permutation from H7725; a return (of property): - captivity.

H7872.full: Feminine of H7869; old age: - (be) gray (grey, hoar, -y) hairs (head, -ed), old age.

H7873.full: From H7734; a withdrawl (into a private place): - pursuing.

H7874.full: A primitive root probably meaning to boil up (compare H7736); used only as denominative from H7875; to plaster: - plaister.

H7875.full: From H7874; lime (as boiling when slacked): - lime, plaister.

H7876.full: A primitive root; to keep in memory: - be unmindful. [Render Deu_32:18, "A Rock bore thee, thou must recollect; and (yet) thou hast forgotten," etc.]

H7877.full: shee-zaw' Of unknown derivation; Shiza, an Israelite: - Shiza.

H7878.firstSense: commune, complain, declare, meditate, muse, pray, speak, talk (with)
H7878.full: A primitive root; to ponder, that is, (by implication) converse (with oneself, and hence aloud) or (transitively) utter: - commune, complain, declare, meditate, muse, pray, speak, talk (with).

H7879.firstSense: babbling, communication, complaint, meditation, prayer, talk
H7879.full: From H7878; a contemplation; by implication an utterance: - babbling, communication, complaint, meditation, prayer, talk.

H7880.full: From H7878; a shoot (as if uttered or put forth), that is, (generically) shrubbery: - bush, plant, shrub.

H7881.full: Feminine of H7879; reflection; by extension devotion: - meditation, prayer.

H7882.full: From H7745; a pit fall: - pit.

H7883.full: Probably from H7835; dark, that is, turbid; Shichor, a stream of Egypt: - Shihor, Sihor.

H7884.full: From the same as H7883 and H3835; darkish whiteness; Shichor Libnath, a stream of Palestine: - Shihor-libnath.

H7885.full: From H7751; an oar; also (compare H7752) a scourge (figuratively): - oar, scourge.

H7886.full: From H7951; tranquil; Shiloh, an epithet of the Messiah: - Shiloh.

H7887.full: From the same as H7886; Shiloh, a place in Palestine: - Shiloh.

H7888.full: From H7887; a Shilonite or inhabitant of Shiloh: - Shilonite.

H7889.full: Apparently for H3452; desert; Shimon, an Israelite: - Shimon.

H7890.full: From an unused root meaning to urinate; urine: - piss.

H7891.firstSense: behold [by mistake for H7789], sing (-er, -ing man, -ing woman)
H7891.full: shı̂yr shûr sheer, shoor The second form being the original form, used in (1Sa_18:6); a primitive root (rather identical with H7788 through the idea of strolling minstrelsy); to sing: - behold [by mistake for H7789], sing (-er, -ing man, -ing woman).

H7892.full: The second form being feminine; from H7891; a song; abstractly singing: - musical (-ick), X sing (-er, -ing), song.

H7893.full: From an unused root meaning to bleach, that is, whiten; white, that is, marble: - marble. See H8336.

H7894.full: shee-shaw' From the same as H7893; whiteness; Shisha, an Israelite: - Shisha.

H7895.full: Of Egyptian derivation; Shishak, an Egyptian king: - Shishak.

H7896.firstSense: apply, appoint, array, bring, consider, lay (up), let alone, X look, make, mark, put (o…
H7896.full: shı̂yth sheeth A primitive root; to place (in a very wide application): - apply, appoint, array, bring, consider, lay (up), let alone, X look, make, mark, put (on), + regard, set, shew, be stayed, X take.

H7897.full: shı̂yth sheeth From H7896; a dress (as put on): - attire.

H7898.full: From H7896; scrub or trash, that is, wild growth of weeds or briers (as if put on the field): - thorns.

H7899.full: From H5526 in the sense of H7753; a brier (as of a hedge): - prick.

H7900.full: From H5526 in the sense of H7753; a booth (as interlaced): - tabernacle.

H7901.firstSense: X at all, cast down, ([over-]) lay (self) (down), (make to) lie (down, down to sleep, s…
H7901.full: A primitive root; to lie down (for rest, sexual connection, decease or any other purpose): - X at all, cast down, ([over-]) lay (self) (down), (make to) lie (down, down to sleep, still, with), lodge, ravish, take rest, sleep, stay.

H7902.firstSense: X carnally, copulation, X lay, seed
H7902.full: From H7901; a lying down (of dew, or for the sexual act): - X carnally, copulation, X lay, seed.

H7903.full: From H7901; a (sexual) lying with: - X lie.

H7904.firstSense: in the morning [by mistake for H7925]
H7904.full: A primitive root; to roam (through lust). in the morning is by mistake for H7925: - in the morning [by mistake for H7925].

H7905.full: Feminine of H7900 in the sense of H7899; a dart (as pointed like a thorn): - barbed iron.

H7906.full: From an unused root apparently mean to surmount; an observatory (with the article); Seku, a place in Palestine: - Sechu.

H7907.full: From the same as H7906; observant, that is, (concretely) the mind: - heart.

H7908.full: Infinitive of H7921; bereavement: - loss of children, spoiling.

H7909.full: From H7921; bereaved: - barren, bereaved (robbed) of children (whelps).

H7910.full: From H7937; intoxicated, as a state or a habit: - drunk (-ard, -en, -en man).

H7911.full: A primitive root; to mislay, that is, to be oblivious of, from want of memory or attention: - X at all, (cause to) forget.

H7912.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H7911 through the idea of disclosure of a covered or forgotten thing; to discover (literally or figuratively): - find.

H7914.full: Feminine from the same as H7906; a conspicuous object: - picture.

H7915.full: Intensive perhaps from the same as H7906 in the sense of H7753; a knife (as pointed or edged): - knife.

H7916.full: From H7936; a man at wages by the day or year: - hired (man, servant), hireling.

H7917.full: Feminine of H7916; a hiring: - that is hired.

H7918.firstSense: appease, assuage, make to cease, pacify, set
H7918.full: A primitive root; to weave (that is, lay) a trap; figuratively (ghrough the idea of secreting) to allay (passions; physically abate a flood): - appease, assuage, make to cease, pacify, set.

H7919.firstSense: consider, expert, instruct, prosper, (deal) prudent (-ly), (give) skill (-ful), have go…
H7919.full: A primitive root; to be (causeatively make or act) circumspect and hence intelligent: - consider, expert, instruct, prosper, (deal) prudent (-ly), (give) skill (-ful), have good success, teach, (have, make to) understand (-ing), wisdom, (be, behave self, consider, make) wise (-ly), guide wittingly.

H7921.firstSense: bereave (of children), barren, cast calf (fruit, young), be (make) childless, deprive,…
H7921.full: A primitive root; properly to miscarry, that is, suffer abortion; by analogy to bereave (literally or figuratively): - bereave (of children), barren, cast calf (fruit, young), be (make) childless, deprive, destroy, X expect, lose children, miscarry, rob of children, spoil.

H7922.firstSense: discretion, knowledge, policy, prudence, sense, understanding, wisdom, wise
H7922.full: From H7919; intelligence; by implication success: - discretion, knowledge, policy, prudence, sense, understanding, wisdom, wise.

H7923.firstSense: to have after loss of others
H7923.full: Plural from H7921; childlessness (by continued bereavements): - to have after loss of others.

H7925.firstSense: (arise, be up, get [oneself] up, rise up) early (betimes), morning
H7925.full: A primitive root; properly to incline (the shoulder to a burden); but used only as denominative from H7926; literally to load up (on the back of man or beast), that is, to start early in the morning: - (arise, be up, get [oneself] up, rise up) early (betimes), morning.

H7926.full: From H7925; the neck (between the shoulders) as the place of burdens; figuratively the spur of a hill: - back, X consent, portion, shoulder.

H7927.full: The same as H7926; ridge; Shekem, a place in Palestine: - Shechem.

H7928.full: From H7926; Shekem, the name of a Hivite and two Israelites: - Shechem.

H7929.full: Feminine of H7926; the shoulder bone: - shoulder blade.

H7930.full: Patronymic from H7928; a Shikmite (collectively), or descendant of Shekem: - Shichemites.

H7931.firstSense: abide, continue, (cause to, make to) dwell (-er), have habitation, inhabit, lay, place,…
H7931.full: A primitive root (apparently akin (by transmutation) to H7901 through the idea of lodging; compare H5531 and H7925); to reside or permanently stay (literally or figuratively): - abide, continue, (cause to, make to) dwell (-er), have habitation, inhabit, lay, place, (cause to) remain, rest, set (up).

H7932.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H7931: - cause to dwell, have habitation.

H7934.full: From H7931; a resident; by extension a fellow citizen: - inhabitant, neighbour, nigh.

H7935.full: From H7931 and H3050; Jah has dwelt; Shekanjah, the name of nine Israelites: - Shecaniah, Shechaniah.

H7936.firstSense: earn wages, hire (out self), reward, X surely
H7936.full: The second form by permutation and used in Ezr_4:5; a primitive root (apparently akin (by prosthesis) to H3739 through the idea of temporary purchase; compare H7937); to hire: - earn wages, hire (out self), reward, X surely.

H7937.firstSense: (be filled with) drink (abundantly), (be, make) drunk (-en), be merry
H7937.full: A primitive root; to become tipsy; in a qualified sense, to satiate with a stimulating drink or (figuratively) influence. (Superlative of H8248.): - (be filled with) drink (abundantly), (be, make) drunk (-en), be merry. [Superlative of H8248.]

H7939.full: From H7986; payment of contract; concretely salary, fare, maintenance; by implication compensation, benefit: - hire, price, reward [-ed], wages, worth.

H7940.full: The same as H7939; recompense; Sakar, the name of two Israelites: - Sacar.

H7941.full: From H7937; an intoxicant, that is, intensely alcoholic liquor: - strong drink, + drunkard, strong wine.

H7942.full: For H7943; drunkenness; Shikkeron, a place in Palestine: - Shicron.

H7944.full: shal shal From H7952 abbreviated; a fault: - error.

H7945.full: shel shel For the relative H834; used with prepositional prefix, and often followed by some pronoun affixed; on account of, what soever, which soever: - cause, sake.

H7946.full: shal-an-awn' For H7600; tranquil: - being at ease.

H7947.full: A primitive root; to space off; intensively (evenly) to make equidistant: - equally distant, set in order.

H7948.full: From H7947; a spacer or raised interval, that is, the stile in a frame or panel: - ledge.

H7949.full: A primitive root; properly meaning to be white; used only as denominative from H7950; to be snow white (with the linen clothing of the slain): - be as snow.

H7950.full: From H7949; snow (probably from its whiteness): - snow (-y).

H7951.firstSense: be happy, prosper, be in safety
H7951.full: The second form being used in Job_3:26; a primitive root; to be tranquil, that is, secure or successful: - be happy, prosper, be in safety.

H7952.full: A primitive root (probably rather identical with H7953 through the idea of educing); to mislead: - deceive, be negligent.

H7953.full: A primitive root (rather cognate (by contraction) to the base of H5394, H7997 and their congeners through the idea of extracting); to draw out or off, that is, remove (the soul by death): - take away.

H7954.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H7951; to be secure: - at rest.

H7955.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H7952; a wrong: - thing amiss.

H7956.full: The same as H7596 (shortened); request; Shelah, the name of a postdiluvian patriarch and of an Israelite: - Shelah.

H7957.full: From the same as H3851 with sibilant prefixed; a flare of fire: - (flaming) flame.

H7958.full: By orthographical variation from H7951 through the idea of sluggishness; the quail collectively (as slow in flight from its weight): - quails.

H7960.full: (Chaldee); from the same as H7955; a fault: - error, X fail, thing amiss.

H7961.firstSense: (being) at ease, peaceable, (in) prosper (-ity), quiet (-ness), wealthy
H7961.full: From H7951; tranquil; (in a bad sense) careless; abstractly security: - (being) at ease, peaceable, (in) prosper (-ity), quiet (-ness), wealthy.

H7962.full: From H7951; security (genuine or false): - abundance, peace (-ably), prosperity, quietness.

H7963.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H7962; safety: - tranquility. See also H7961.

H7964.full: From H7971; (only in plural) a dismissal, that is, (of a wife) divorce (especially the document); also (of a daughter) dower: - presents, have sent back.

H7965.firstSense: X do, familiar, X fare, favour, + friend, X greet, (good) health, (X perfect, such as b…
H7965.full: From H7999; safe, that is, (figuratively) well, happy, friendly; also (abstractly) welfare, that is, health, prosperity, peace: - X do, familiar, X fare, favour, + friend, X greet, (good) health, (X perfect, such as be at) peace (-able, -ably), prosper (-ity, -ous), rest, safe (-ly), salute, welfare, (X all is, be) well, X wholly.

H7966.full: From H7999; a requital, that is, (secure) retribution, (venal) a fee: - recompense, reward.

H7967.full: The same as H7966; Shallum, the name of fourteen Israelites: - Shallum.

H7968.full: Probably for H7967; Shallun, an Israelite: - Shallum.

H7969.firstSense: + fork, + often [-times], third, thir [-teen, -teenth], three, + thrice
H7969.full: The last two forms being masculine; a primitive number; three; occasionally (ordinal) third, or (multiplicative) thrice: - + fork, + often [-times], third, thir [-teen, -teenth], three, + thrice. Compare H7991.

H7970.full: Multiple of H7969; thirty; or (ordinal) thirtieth: - thirty, thirtieth. Compare H7991.

H7971.firstSense: X any wise, appoint, bring (on the way), cast (away, out), conduct, X earnestly, forsak…
H7971.full: A primitive root; to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications): - X any wise, appoint, bring (on the way), cast (away, out), conduct, X earnestly, forsake, give (up), grow long, lay, leave, let depart (down, go, loose), push away, put (away, forth, in, out), reach forth, send (away, forth, out), set, shoot (forth, out), sow, spread, stretch forth (out).

H7973.firstSense: dart, plant, X put off, sword, weapon
H7973.full: From H7971; a missile of attack, that is, spear; also (figuratively) a shoot of growth, that is, branch: - dart, plant, X put off, sword, weapon.

H7974.full: The same as H7973; Shelach, a postdiluvian patriarch: - Salah, Shelah. Compare H7975.

H7975.full: The second form is in imitation of H7974, used in Neh_3:15; from H7971; rill; Shiloach, a fountain of Jerusalem: - Shiloah, Siloah.

H7976.full: Feminine of H7964; a shoot: - branch.

H7977.full: From H7973; missive, that is, armed; Shilchi, an Israelite: - Shilhi.

H7978.full: Plural of H7973; javelins or sprouts; Shilchim, a place in Palestine: - Shilhim.

H7979.full: From H7971; a table (as spread out); by implication a meal: - table.

H7980.firstSense: (bear, have) rule, have dominion, give (have) power
H7980.full: A primitive root; to dominate, that is, govern; by implication to permit: - (bear, have) rule, have dominion, give (have) power.

H7981.firstSense: have the mastery, have power, bear rule, be (make) ruler
H7981.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H7980: - have the mastery, have power, bear rule, be (make) ruler.

H7982.full: From H7980; probably a shield (as controlling, that is, protecting the person): - shield.

H7985.full: (Chaldee); from H7981; empire (abstractly or concretely.): - dominion.

H7986.full: Feminine from H7980; a vixen: - imperious.

H7988.full: Feminine from H7953; a foetus or babe (as extruded in birth): - young one.

H7989.firstSense: governor, mighty, that hath power, ruler
H7989.full: From H7980; potent; concretely a prince or warrior: - governor, mighty, that hath power, ruler.

H7990.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H7989; mighty; abstractly permission; concretely a premier: - captain, be lawful, rule (-r).

H7991.firstSense: captain, instrument of musick, (great) lord, (great) measure, prince, three [from the m…
H7991.full: (The second form used in 1Ch_11:11, 1Ch_11:12, 1Ch_11:18; the third form used in 2Sa_23:13); from H7969; a triple, that is, (as a musical instrument) a triangle (or perhaps rather three stringed lute); also (as an indefinitely great quantity) a three fold measure (perhaps a treble ephah); also (as an officer) a general of the third rank (upward, that is, the highest): - captain, instrument of musick, (great) lord, (great) measure, prince, three [from the margin].

H7992.full: Ordinal from H7969; third; feminine a third (part); by extension a third (day, year or time); specifically a third story cell): - third (part, rank, time), three (years old).

H7993.firstSense: adventure, cast (away, down, forth, off, out), hurl, pluck, throw
H7993.full: A primitive root; to throw out, down or away (literally or figuratively): - adventure, cast (away, down, forth, off, out), hurl, pluck, throw.

H7994.full: From H7993; bird of prey, usually thought to be the pelican (from casting itself into the sea): - cormorant.

H7995.full: From H7993; a felling (of trees): - when cast.

H7996.full: The same as H7995; Shalleketh, a gate in Jerusalem: - Shalleketh.

H7997.firstSense: let fall, make self a prey, X of purpose, (make a, [take]) spoil
H7997.full: A primitive root; to drop or strip; by implication to plunder: - let fall, make self a prey, X of purpose, (make a, [take]) spoil.

H7999.firstSense: make amends, (make an) end, finish, full, give again, make good, (re-) pay (again), (ma…
H7999.full: A primitive root; to be safe (in mind, body or estate); figuratively to be (causatively make) completed; by implication to be friendly; by extension to reciprocate (in various applications): - make amends, (make an) end, finish, full, give again, make good, (re-) pay (again), (make) (to) (be at) peace (-able), that is perfect, perform, (make) prosper (-ous), recompense, render, requite, make restitution, restore, reward, X surely.

H8000.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H7999; to complete, to restore: - deliver, finish.

H8002.full: From H7999; properly requital, that is, a (voluntary) sacrifice in thanks: - peace offering.

H8003.firstSense: full, just, made ready, peaceable, perfect (-ed), quiet, Shalem [by mistake for a name]…
H8003.full: From H7999; complete (literally or figuratively); especially friendly. (shalem used by mistake for a name.): - full, just, made ready, peaceable, perfect (-ed), quiet, Shalem [by mistake for a name], whole.

H8004.full: The same as H8003; peaceful; Shalem, an early name of Jerusalem: - Salem.

H8006.full: The same as H8005; Shillem, an Israelite: - Shillem.

H8007.full: Probably for H8008; clothing; Salma, the name of two Israelites: - Salma.

H8008.full: Transposition for H8071; a dress ;: - clothes, garment, raiment.

H8009.full: The same as H8008; clothing; Salmah, an Israelite: - Salmon. Compare H8012.

H8010.full: From H7965; peaceful; Shelomoh, David's successor: - Solomon.

H8012.full: From H8008; investiture; Salmon, an Israelite: - Salmon. Compare H8009.

H8013.full: Feminine plural of H7965; pacifications; Shelomoth, the name of two Israelites: - Shelomith [from the margin], Shelomoth. Compare H8019.

H8014.full: From H8008; clothed; Salmai, an Israelite: - Shalmai.

H8015.full: From H7965; peaceable; Shelomi, an Israelite: - Shelomi.

H8016.full: shillêmı̂y shil-lay-mee Patronymic from H8006; a Shilemite (collectively) or descendant of Shillem: - Shillemites.

H8017.full: shel-oo-mee-ale' From H7965 and H410; peace of God; Shelumiel, an Israelite: - Shelumiel.

H8018.full: From H8002 and H3050; thank offering of Jah; Shelemjah, the name of nine Israelites: - Shelemiah.

H8019.full: The second form being used in Ezr_8:10; from H7965; peaceableness; Shelomith, the name of five Israelites and three Israelitesses: - Shelomith.

H8020.full: Of foreign derivation; Shalman, a king apparently of Assyria: - Shalman. Compare H8022.

H8022.full: shal-man-eh'-ser Of foreign derivation; Shalmaneser, an Assyrian king: - Shalmaneser. Compare H8020.

H8023.full: The same as H7888; Shiloni, an Israelite: - Shiloni.

H8024.full: From H7956; a Shelanite (collectively), or descendant of Shelah: - Shelanites.

H8025.full: A primitive root; to pull out, up or off: - draw (off), grow up, pluck off.

H8026.full: From H8025; extract; sheleph, a son of Jokthan: - Sheleph.

H8027.firstSense: do the third time, (divide into, stay) three (days, -fold, parts, years old)
H8027.full: A primitive root perhaps originally to intensify, that is, treble; but apparently used only as denominative from H7969, to be (causatively make) triplicate (by restoration, in portions, strands, days or years): - do the third time, (divide into, stay) three (days, -fold, parts, years old).

H8028.full: From H8027; triplet; Shelesh, an Israelite: - Shelesh.

H8029.full: From H8027; a descendant of the third degree, that is, great grandchild: - third [generation].

H8030.full: Feminine from the same as H8028; triplication; Shilshah, an Israelite: - Shilshah.

H8031.full: Feminine from H8027; trebled land; Shalishah, a place in Palestine: - Shalisha.

H8032.firstSense: + before (that time, -time), excellent things [from the margin], + heretofore, three da…
H8032.full: From the same as H8028; trebly, that is, (in time) day before yesterday: - + before (that time, -time), excellent things [from the margin], + heretofore, three days, + time past.

H8033.firstSense: in it, + thence, there (-in, + of, + out), + thither, + whither
H8033.full: shâm shawm A primitive particle (rather from the relative H834); there (transfered to time) then; often thither, or thence: - in it, + thence, there (-in, + of, + out), + thither, + whither.

H8034.full: shêm shame A primitive word (perhaps rather from H7760 through the idea of definite and conspicuous position; compare H8064); an appellation, as a mark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character: - + base, [in-] fame [-ous], name (-d), renown, report.

H8035.full: shêm shame The same as H8034; name; Shem, a son of Noah (often including his posterity): - Sem, Shem.

H8036.full: shûm shoom (Chaldee); shoom; corresponding to H8034: - name.

H8037.full: sham-maw' From H8074; desolation; Shamma, an Israelite: - Shamma.

H8038.full: shem-ay'-ber Apparently from H8034 and H83; name of pinion, that is, illustrious; Shemeber, a king of Zeboim: - Shem-eber.

H8039.full: shim-aw' Perhaps for H8093; Shimah, an Israelite: - Shimah. Compare H8043.

H8040.full: A primitive word (rather perhaps from the same as H8071 (by insertion of the 'aleph) through the idea of wrapping up); properly dark (as enveloped), that is, the north; hence (by orientation) the left hand: - left (hand, side).

H8041.full: A primitive root (rather denominative from H8040); to use the left hand or pass in that direction: - (go, turn) (on the, to the) left.

H8042.full: From H8040; situated on the left side: - left.

H8043.full: shim-awm' For H8039 (compare H38); Shimam, an Israelite: - Shimeam.

H8044.full: Of uncertain derivation; Shamgar, an Israelite judge: - Shamgar.

H8045.firstSense: destroy (-uction), bring to nought, overthrow, perish, pluck down, X utterly
H8045.full: A primitive root; to desolate: - destroy (-uction), bring to nought, overthrow, perish, pluck down, X utterly.

H8047.full: From H8074; ruin; by implication consternation: - astonishment, desolate (-ion), waste, wonderful thing.

H8048.full: The same as H8047; Shammah, the name of an Edomite and four Israelites: - Shammah.

H8049.full: For H8048; desolation; Shamhuth, an Israelite: - Shamhuth.

H8050.full: shem-oo-ale' From the passive participle of H8085 and H410; heard of God; Shemuel, the name of three Israelites: - Samuel, Shemuel.

H8051.full: From H8074; renowned; Shammua, the name of four Israelites: - Shammua, Shammuah.

H8052.firstSense: bruit, doctrine, fame, mentioned, news, report, rumor, tidings
H8052.full: Feminine passive participle of H8074; something heard, that is, an announcement: - bruit, doctrine, fame, mentioned, news, report, rumor, tidings.

H8053.full: Passive participle of H8103; observed; Shamur, an Israelite: - Shamir [from the margin].

H8054.full: Plural of H8047; ruins; Shammoth, an Israelite: - Shamoth.

H8055.firstSense: cheer up, be (make) glad, (have make) joy (-ful), be (make) merry, (cause to, make to)…
H8055.full: A primitive root; probably to brighten up, that is, (figuratively) be (causatively make) blithe or gleesome: - cheer up, be (make) glad, (have make) joy (-ful), be (make) merry, (cause to, make to) rejoice, X very.

H8056.full: From H8055; blithe or gleeful: - (be) glad, joyful, (making) merry ([-hearted]), rejoice (-ing).

H8057.firstSense: X exceeding (-ly), gladness, joy (-fulness), mirth, pleasure, rejoice (-ing)
H8057.full: From H8056; blithesomeness or glee, (religious or festival): - X exceeding (-ly), gladness, joy (-fulness), mirth, pleasure, rejoice (-ing).

H8058.firstSense: discontinue, overthrow, release, let rest, shake, stumble, throw down
H8058.full: A primitive root; to fling down; incipiently to jostle; figuratively to let alone, desist, remit: - discontinue, overthrow, release, let rest, shake, stumble, throw down.

H8059.full: From H8058; remission (of debt) or suspension (of labor): - release.

H8060.full: From H8073; destructive; Shammai, the name of three Israelites: - Shammai.

H8061.full: Apparently from H8034 and H3045; name of knowing; Shemida, an Israelite: - Shemida, Shemidah.

H8062.full: Patronymic from H8061; a Shemidaite (collectively) or descendant of Shemida: - Shemidaites.

H8063.full: From H5564; a rug (as sustaining the Oriental sitter): - mantle.

H8064.full: The second form being dual of an unused singular; from an unused root meaning to be lofty; the sky (as aloft; the dual perhaps alluding to the visible arch in which the clouds move, as well as to the higher ether where the celestial bodies revolve): - air, X astrologer, heaven (-s).

H8067.full: Feminine of H8066; probably an eight stringed lyre: - Sheminith.

H8068.full: From H8104 in the original sense of pricking; a thorn; also (from its keenness for scratching) a gem, probably the diamond: - adamant (stone), brier, diamond.

H8069.full: The same as H8068; Shamir, the name of two places in Palestine: - Shamir. Compare H8053.

H8070.full: Probably from H8034 and plural of H7413; name of heights; Shemiramoth, the name of two Israelites: - Shemiramoth.

H8071.full: Perhaps by permutation for the feminine of H5566 (through the idea of a cover assuming the shape of the object beneath); a dress, especially a mantle: - apparel, cloth (-es, -ing), garment, raiment. Compare H8008.

H8072.full: Probably for the same se H8071; Samlah, an Edomite: - Samlah.

H8073.full: From H8014; Shamlai, one of the Nethinim: - Shalmai [from the margin].

H8074.firstSense: make amazed, be astonied, (be an) astonish (-ment), (be, bring into, unto, lay, lie, ma…
H8074.full: A primitive root; to stun (or intransitively grow numb), that is, devastate or (figuratively) stupefy (both usually in a passive sense): - make amazed, be astonied, (be an) astonish (-ment), (be, bring into, unto, lay, lie, make) desolate (-ion, places), be destitute, destroy (self), (lay, lie, make) waste, wonder.

H8077.full: Feminine of H8076; devastation; figuratively astonishment: - (laid, X most) desolate (-ion), waste.

H8079.full: Probably from H8074 (in the sense of poisoning); a lizard (from the superstition of its noxiousness): - spider.

H8080.full: A primitive root; to shine, that is, (by analogy) be (causatively make) oily or gross: - become (make, wax) fat.

H8081.firstSense: anointing, X fat (things), X fruitful, oil ([-ed]), ointment, olive, + pine
H8081.full: From H8080; grease, especially liquid (as from the olive, often perfumed); figuratively richness: - anointing, X fat (things), X fruitful, oil ([-ed]), ointment, olive, + pine.

H8082.full: From H8080; greasy, that is, gross; figuratively rich: - fat, lusty, plenteous.

H8083.full: Apparently from H8082 through the idea of plumpness; a cardinal number, eight (as if a surplus above the "perfect" seven); also (as ordinal) eighth: - eight ([-een, -eenth]), eighth.

H8084.full: Multiplicative from H8083; eighty; also eightieth: - eighty (-ieth), fourscore.

H8085.firstSense: X attentively, call (gather) together, X carefully, X certainly, consent, consider, be…
H8085.full: A primitive root; to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively to tell, etc.): - X attentively, call (gather) together, X carefully, X certainly, consent, consider, be content, declare, X diligently, discern, give ear, (cause to, let, make to) hear (-ken, tell), X indeed, listen, make (a) noise, (be) obedient, obey, perceive, (make a) proclaim (-ation), publish, regard, report, shew (forth), (make a) sound, X surely, tell, understand, whosoever [heareth], witness.

H8087.full: For the same as H8088; Shema, the name of a place in Palestine and of four Israelites: - Shema.

H8088.firstSense: bruit, fame, hear (-ing), loud, report, speech, tidings
H8088.full: From H8085; something heard, that is, a sound, rumor, announcement; abstractly audience: - bruit, fame, hear (-ing), loud, report, speech, tidings.

H8090.full: For H8087; Shema, a place in Palestine: - Shema.

H8091.full: From H8085; obedient; Shama, an Israelite: - Shama.

H8092.full: For H8093; Shima, the name of four Israelites: - Shimea, Shimei, Shamma.

H8093.full: Feminine of H8088; annunciation; Shimah, an Israelite: - Shimeah.

H8094.full: For H8093; Shemaah, an Israelite: - Shemaah.

H8095.full: From H8085; hearing; Shimon, one of Jacob's sons, also the tribe descendant from him: - Simeon.

H8096.firstSense: Shimeah [from the margin], Shimei, Shimhi, Shimi
H8096.full: From H8088; famous; Shimi, the name of twenty Israelites: - Shimeah [from the margin], Shimei, Shimhi, Shimi.

H8097.full: Patronymic from H8096; a Shimite (collectively) or descendant of Shimi: - of Shimi, Shimites.

H8098.full: From H8085 and H3050; Jah has heard; Shemajah, the name of twenty five Israelites: - Shemaiah.

H8099.full: Patronymic from H8095; a Shimonite (collectively) or descendant of Shimon: - tribe of Simeon, Simeonites.

H8100.full: Feminine of H8088; annunciation; Shimath, an Ammonitess: - Shimath.

H8101.full: Patronymic from H8093; a Shimathite (collectively) or descendant of Shimah: - Shimeathites.

H8102.full: From an unused root meaning to emit a sound; an inkling: - a little.

H8103.full: Feminine of H8102; scornful whispering (of hostile spectators): - shame.

H8104.firstSense: beware, be circumspect, take heed (to self), keep (-er, self), mark, look narrowly, obs…
H8104.full: A primitive root; properly to hedge about (as with thorns), that is, guard; generally to protect, attend to, etc.: - beware, be circumspect, take heed (to self), keep (-er, self), mark, look narrowly, observe, preserve, regard, reserve, save (self), sure, (that lay) wait (for), watch (-man).

H8105.full: From H8104; something preserved, that is, the settlings (plural only) of wine: - dregs, (wines on the) lees.

H8106.full: The same as H8105; Shemer, the name of three Israelites: - Shamer, Shemer.

H8107.full: From H8104; an observance: - X be (much) observed.

H8108.full: Feminine of an unused noun from H8104 meaning a guard; watchfulness: - watch.

H8109.full: Feminine of passive participle of H8104; something guarded, that is, an eye lid: - waking.

H8110.full: From H8105 in its original sense; guardianship; Shimron, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine: - Shimron.

H8111.full: From the active participle of H8104; watch station; Shomeron, a place in Palestine: - Samaria.

H8112.full: shim-rone' mer-one' From H8110 and a derivative of H4754; guard of lashing; Shimron Meron, a place in Palestine: - Shimon-meron.

H8113.full: From H8105 in its original sense; watchful; Shimri, the name of four Israelites: - Shimri.

H8114.full: From H8104 and H3050; Jah has guarded; Shemarjah, the name of four Israelites: - Shamariah, Shemariah.

H8115.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H8111; Shomrain, a place in Palestine: - Samaria.

H8116.full: Feminine of H8113; female guard; Shimrith, a Moabitess: - Shimrith.

H8117.full: Patronymic from H8110; a Shimronite (collectively) or descendant of Shimron: - Shimronites.

H8118.full: Patrial from H8111; a Shomeronite (collectively) or inhabitant of Shomeron: - Samaritans.

H8119.full: From H8104; guardship; Shimrath, an Israelite: - Shimrath.

H8120.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to the root of H8121 through the idea of activity implied in daylight; to serve: - minister.

H8121.full: From an unused root meaning to be brilliant; the sun; by implication the east; figuratively a ray, that is, (architecturally) a notched battlement: - + east side (-ward), sun ([rising]), + west (-ward), window. See also H1053.

H8122.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H8121; to sun: - sun.

H8123.full: From H8121; sunlight; Shimshon, an Israelite: - Samson.

H8124.full: (Chaldee); from H8122; sunny; Shimshai, a Samaritan: - Shimshai.

H8125.full: Apparently from H8121; sunlike; Shamsherai, an Israelite: - Shamsherai.

H8126.full: Patronymic from an unused name from H7762 probably meaning garlic smell; a Shumathite (collectively) or descendant of Shumah: - Shumathites.

H8127.firstSense: crag, X forefront, ivory, X sharp, tooth
H8127.full: From H8150; a tooth (as sharp); specifically (for H8143) ivory; figuratively a cliff: - crag, X forefront, ivory, X sharp, tooth.

H8128.full: shên shane (Chaldee); corresponding to H8127; a tooth: - tooth.

H8129.full: shên shane The same as H8127; crag; Shen, a palce in Palestine: - Shen.

H8130.firstSense: enemy, foe, (be) hate (-ful, -r), odious, X utterly
H8130.full: A primitive root; to hate (personally): - enemy, foe, (be) hate (-ful, -r), odious, X utterly.

H8132.full: A primitive root; to alter: - change.

H8133.full: shen-aw' (Chaldee); corresponding to H8132: - alter, change, (be) diverse.

H8134.full: shin-awb' Probably from H8132 and H1; a father has turned; Shinab, a Canaanite: - Shinab.

H8136.full: shin-awn' From H8132; change, that is, repetition: - X angels.

H8137.full: shen-ats-tsar' Apparently of Babylonian origin; Shenatstsar, an Israelite: - Senazar.

H8138.firstSense: do (speak, strike) again, alter, double, (be given to) change, disguise, (be) diverse,…
H8138.full: A primitive root; to fold, that is, duplicate (literally or figuratively (); by implication to transmute (transitively or intransitively): - do (speak, strike) again, alter, double, (be given to) change, disguise, (be) diverse, pervert, prefer, repeat, return, do the second time.

H8141.firstSense: + whole age, X long, + old, year (X -ly)
H8141.full: (The first form being in plural only, the second form being feminine); from H8138; a year (as a revolution of time): - + whole age, X long, + old, year (X -ly).

H8142.full: (The second form used in Psa_127:2); from H3462; sleep: - sleep.

H8143.full: From H8127 and the plural apparently of a foreign word; probably tooth of elephants, that is, ivory tusk: - ivory.

H8144.full: Of uncertain derivation; crimson, properly the insect or its color, also stuff dyed with it: - crimson, scarlet (thread).

H8145.full: From H8138; properly double, that is, second; also adverbially again: - again, either [of them], (an-) other, second (time).

H8147.firstSense: both, couple, double, second, twain, + twelfth, + twelve, + twenty (sixscore) thousand,…
H8147.full: (The first form being dual of H8145; the second form being feminine); two; also (as ordinal) twofold: - both, couple, double, second, twain, + twelfth, + twelve, + twenty (sixscore) thousand, twice, two.

H8148.full: From H8150; something pointed, that is, a gibe: - byword, taunt.

H8149.full: From an unused root meaning to be pointed; peak; Shenir or Senir, a summit of Lebanon: - Senir, Shenir.

H8150.full: A primitive root; to point (transitively or intransitively); intensively to pierce; figuratively to inculcate: - prick, sharp (-en), teach diligently, whet.

H8151.full: A primitive root; to compress (with a belt): - gird up.

H8152.full: Probably of foreign derivation; Shinar, a plain in Babylon: - Shinar.

H8154.full: (The second form being used in Isa_10:13); a primitive root; to plunder: - destroyer, rob, spoil (-er).

H8155.full: A primitive root; to plunder: - rifle, spoil.

H8156.full: A primitive root; to split or tear; figuratively to upbraid: - cleave, (be) cloven ([footed]), rend, stay.

H8157.full: From H8156; a fissure: - cleft, clovenfooted.

H8158.full: A primitive root; to cut in pieces, that is, slaughter: - hew in pieces.

H8159.firstSense: depart, be dim, be dismayed, look (away), regard, have respect, spare, turn
H8159.full: A primitive root; to gaze at or about (properly for help); by implication to inspect, consider, compassionate, be nonplussed (as looking around in amazement) or bewildered: - depart, be dim, be dismayed, look (away), regard, have respect, spare, turn.

H8160.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H8159; properly a look, that is, a moment: - hour.

H8161.full: Feminine from an unused root meaning to stamp; a clatter (of hoofs): - stamping.

H8162.firstSense: garment of divers sorts, linen and woollen
H8162.full: Probably of foreign derivation; linsey woolsey, that is, cloth of linen and wool carded and spun together: - garment of divers sorts, linen and woollen.

H8163.firstSense: devil, goat, hairy, kid, rough, satyr
H8163.full: From H8175; shaggy; as noun, a he goat; by analogy a faun: - devil, goat, hairy, kid, rough, satyr.

H8164.full: Formed the same as H8163; a shower (as tempestuous): - small rain.

H8165.full: Formed like H8163; rough; Seir, a mountain of Idumaea and its aboriginal occupants, also one in Palestine: - Seir.

H8166.full: Feminine of H8163; a she goat: - kid.

H8167.full: Formed as H8166; roughness; Seirah, a place in Palestine: - Seirath.

H8168.full: From an unused root meaning to hollow out; the palm; by extension a handful: - handful, hollow of the band.

H8169.full: Plural from H7776; fox holes; Shaalbim or Shaalabbin, a place in Palestine: - Shaalabbin, Shaalbim.

H8170.full: Patrial from H8169; a Shaalbonite or inhabitant of Shaalbin: - Shaalbonite.

H8171.full: Plural of H7776; foxes; Shaalim, a place in Palestine: - Shalim.

H8172.firstSense: lean, lie, rely, rest (on, self), stay
H8172.full: A primitive root; to support one's self: - lean, lie, rely, rest (on, self), stay.

H8173.firstSense: cry (out) [by confusion with H7768], dandle, delight (self), play, shut
H8173.full: A primitive root; (in a good acceptation) to look upon (with complacency), that is, fondle, please or amuse (self); (in a bad one) to look about (in dismay), that is, stare. (cry out is by confusion with H7768.): - cry (out) [by confusion with H7768], dandle, delight (self), play, shut.

H8174.full: From H5586; fluctuation; Shaaph, the name of two Israelites: - Shaaph.

H8175.firstSense: be (horribly) afraid, fear, hurl as a storm, be tempestuous, come like (take away as wi…
H8175.full: A rpim root; to storm; by implication to shiver, that is, fear: - be (horribly) afraid, fear, hurl as a storm, be tempestuous, come like (take away as with) a whirlwind.

H8176.full: A primitive root; to split or open, that is, (literally, but only as denominative from H8179) to act as gate keeper (see H7778); (figuratively) to estimate: - think.

H8178.firstSense: affrighted, X horribly, X sore, storm
H8178.full: From H8175; a tempest; also a terror: - affrighted, X horribly, X sore, storm. See H8181.

H8179.full: From H8176 in its original sense; an opening, that is, door or gate: - city, door, gate, port (X -er).

H8180.full: From H8176; a measure (as a section): - [hundred-] fold.

H8181.full: (The second form used in Isa_7:20); from H8175 in the sense of dishevelling; hair (as if tossed or bristling): - hair (-y), X rough.

H8182.full: From H8176; harsh or horrid, that is, offensive: - vile.

H8183.full: Feminine of H8178; a hurricane: - storm, tempest.

H8184.full: (The feminine form meaning the plant and the masculine form meaning the grain (second form)); from H8175 in the sense of roughness; barley (as villose): - barley.

H8186.full: Feminine from H8176 in the sense of H8175; something fearful: - horrible thing.

H8187.full: From H8176 and H3050; Jah has stormed; Shearjah, an Israelite: - Sheariah.

H8188.full: Masculine plural of H8184; barley grains; Seorim, an Israelite: - Seorim.

H8189.full: Dual of H8179; double gates; Shaarajim, a place in Palestine: - Shaaraim.

H8190.full: Of Persian derivation; Shaashgaz, a eunuch of Xerxes: - Shaashgaz.

H8192.full: A primitive root; to abrade, that is, bare: - high, stick out.

H8193.firstSense: band, bank, binding, border, brim, brink, edge, language, lip, prating, ([sea-]) shore,…
H8193.full: (The second form is in dual and plural); Probably from H5595 or H8192 through the idea of termination (compare H5490); the lip (as a natural boundary); by implication language; by analogy a margin (of a vessel, water, cloth, etc.): - band, bank, binding, border, brim, brink, edge, language, lip, prating, ([sea-]) shore, side, speech, talk, [vain] words.

H8194.full: From H8192 in the sense of clarifying; a cheese (as strained from the whey): - cheese.

H8195.full: From H8192; baldness (compare H8205); Shepho or Shephi, an Idumaean: - Shephi, Shepho.

H8196.full: From H8199; a judicial sentence, that is, punishment: - judgment.

H8197.full: From the same as H8207; serpent like; Shephupham or Shephuphan, an Israelite: - Shephuphan, Shupham.

H8198.full: Feminine from an unused root meaning to spread out (as a family; see H4940); a female slave (as a member of the household): - (bond-, hand-) maid (-en, -servant), wench, bondwoman, womanservant.

H8199.firstSense: + avenge, X that condemn, contend, defend, execute (judgment), (be a) judge (-ment), X…
H8199.full: A primitive root; to judge, that is, pronounce sentence (for or against); by implication to vindicate or punish; by extension to govern; passively to litigate (literally or figuratively): - + avenge, X that condemn, contend, defend, execute (judgment), (be a) judge (-ment), X needs, plead, reason, rule.

H8200.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H8199; to judge: - magistrate.

H8201.full: From H8199; a sentence, that is, infliction: - judgment.

H8202.full: From H8199; judge; Shaphat, the name of four Israelites: - Shaphat.

H8203.full: From H8199 and H3050; Jah has judged; Shephatjah, the name of ten Israelites: - Shephatiah.

H8204.full: From H8199; judge like; Shiphtan, an Israelite.

H8205.full: From H8192; bareness; concretely a bare hill or plain: - high place, stick out.

H8206.full: Plural of an unused noun from the same as H8207 and meaning the same; serpents; Shuppim, an Israelite: - Shuppim.

H8207.full: From an unused root meaning the same as H7779; a kind of serpent (as snapping), probably the cerastes or horned adder: - adder.

H8208.full: From H8231; beautiful; Shaphir, a place in Palestine: - Saphir.

H8209.full: (Chaldee); intensive of a form corresponding to H8208; beautiful: - fair.

H8210.firstSense: cast (up), gush out, pour (out), shed (-der, out), slip
H8210.full: A primitive root; to spill forth (blood, a libation, liquid metal; or even a solid, that is, to mound up); also (figuratively) to expend (life, soul, complaint, money, etc.); intensively to sprawl out: - cast (up), gush out, pour (out), shed (-der, out), slip.

H8211.full: From H8210; an emptying place, for example an ash heap: - are poured out.

H8212.full: Feminine of a derivative from H8210; a pipe (for pouring forth, for example wine), that is, the penis: - privy member.

H8213.firstSense: abase, bring (cast, put) down, debase, humble (self), be (bring, lay, make, put) low (-er)
H8213.full: A primitive root; to depress or sink (especially figuratively to humiliate, intransitively or transitively): - abase, bring (cast, put) down, debase, humble (self), be (bring, lay, make, put) low (-er).

H8214.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H8213: - abase, humble, put down, subdue.

H8216.full: From H8213; an humble rank: - low estate (place).

H8217.full: From H8213; depressed, literally or figuratively: - base (-st), humble, low (-er, -ly).

H8218.full: Feminine of H8216; depression: - low place.

H8219.full: From H8213; Lowland, that is, (with the article) the maritime slope of Palestine: - low country, (low) plain, vale (-ley).

H8221.full: Probably from H8192; bare spot; Shepham, a place in or near Palestine: - Shepham.

H8222.full: From H8193; the beard (as a lip piece): - beard, (upper) lip.

H8223.full: Formed like H8221; baldly; Shapham, an Israelite: - Shapham.

H8224.full: Feminine plural of H8221; Siphmoth, a place in Palestine: - Siphmoth.

H8225.full: Patrial from H8221; a Shiphmite or inhabitant of Shepham: - Shiphmite.

H8226.full: A primitive root; to conceal (as a valuable): - treasure.

H8227.full: From H8226; a species of rock rabbit (from its hiding), that is, probably the hyrax: - coney.

H8228.full: From an unused root meaning to abound; resources: - abundance.
