H8229.full: Feminine of H8228; copiousness: - abundance, company, multitude.

H8230.full: From H8228; copious; Shiphi, an Israelite: - Shiphi.

H8231.full: A primitive root; to glisten, that is, (figuratively) be (causatively make) fair: - X goodly.

H8232.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H8231; to be beautiful: - be acceptable, please, + think good.

H8234.full: The same as H8233; Shepher, a place in the Desert: - Shapper.

H8236.full: The same as H8235; Shiphrah, an Israelitess: - Shiphrah.

H8237.full: From H8231; splendid, that is, a tapestry or canopy: - royal pavilion.

H8238.firstSense: X very early in the morning
H8238.full: (Chaldee); from H8231; the dawn (as brilliant with aurora): - X very early in the morning.

H8239.full: A primitive root; to locate, that is, (generally) hang on or (figuratively) establish, reduce: - bring, ordain, set on.

H8240.full: From H8239; a (double) stall (for cattle); also a (two pronged) hook (for flaying animals on): - hook, pot.

H8241.full: From H7857 (for alliteration with H7110); an outburst (of anger): - little.

H8242.full: śaq sak From H8264; properly a mesh (as allowing a liquid to run through), that is, coarse loose cloth or sacking (used in mourning and for bagging); hence a bag (for grain, etc.): - sack (-cloth, -clothes).

H8243.full: shâq shawk (Chaldee); corresponding to H7785; the leg: - leg.

H8244.full: A primitive root; to fasten: - bind.

H8245.full: A primitive root; to be alert, that is, sleepless; hence to be on the lookout (whether for good or ill): - hasten, remain, wake, watch (for).

H8246.firstSense: make like (unto, after the fashion of) almonds
H8246.full: A denominative from H8247; to be (intensively make) almond shaped: - make like (unto, after the fashion of) almonds.

H8247.full: From H8245; the almond (tree or nut; as being the earliest in bloom): - almond (tree).

H8248.firstSense: cause to (give, give to, let, make to) drink, drown, moisten, water
H8248.full: A primitive root; to quaff, that is, (causatively) to irrigate or furnish a potion to: - cause to (give, give to, let, make to) drink, drown, moisten, water. See H7937, H8354.

H8249.full: From H8248; (plural collectively) a draught: - drink.

H8250.full: From H8248; a beverage; moisture, that is, (figuratively) refreshment: - drink, marrow.

H8251.full: From H8262; disgusting, that is, filthy; especially idolatrous or (concretely) an idol: - abominable filth (idol, -ation), detestable (thing).

H8252.firstSense: appease, idleness, (at, be at, be in, give) quiet (-ness), (be at, be in, give, have, t…
H8252.full: A primitive root; to repose (usually figuratively): - appease, idleness, (at, be at, be in, give) quiet (-ness), (be at, be in, give, have, take) rest, settle, be still.

H8254.firstSense: pay, receive (-r), spend, X throughly, weigh
H8254.full: A primitive root; to suspend or poise (especially in trade): - pay, receive (-r), spend, X throughly, weigh.

H8255.full: From H8254; probably a weight; used as a commercial standard: - shekel.

H8256.full: (The second form is feminine); of uncertain derivation; a sycamore (usually the tree): - sycamore (fruit, tree).

H8257.firstSense: make deep, let down, drown, quench, sink
H8257.full: (Abbreviated in Amo_8:8); a primitive root; to subside; by implication to be overflowed, cease; causatively to abate, subdue: - make deep, let down, drown, quench, sink.

H8258.full: From H8257; a depression: - hollow strake.

H8259.full: A primitive root; properly to lean out (of a window), that is, (by implication) peep or gaze (passively be a spectacle): - appear, look (down, forth, out).

H8260.full: From H8259; a loophole (for looking out), to admit light and air: - window.

H8261.full: Passive participle of H8259; an embrasure or opening (compare H8260) with bevelled jam: - light, window.

H8262.firstSense: abhor, make abominable, have in abomination, detest, X utterly
H8262.full: A primitive root; to be filthy, that is, (intensively) to loathe, pollute: - abhor, make abominable, have in abomination, detest, X utterly.

H8263.full: From H8262; filth, that is, (figuratively and specifically) an idolatrous object: - abominable (-tion).

H8264.firstSense: have appetite, justle one against another, long, range, run (to and fro)
H8264.full: A primitive root; to course (like a beast of prey); by implication to seek greedily: - have appetite, justle one against another, long, range, run (to and fro).

H8265.full: A primitive root; to ogle, that is, blink coquettishly: - wanton.

H8266.full: A primitive root; to cheat, that is, be untrue (usually in words): - fail, deal falsely, lie.

H8267.firstSense: without a cause, deceit (-ful), false (-hood, -ly), feignedly, liar, + lie, lying, vain…
H8267.full: From H8266; an untruth; by implication a sham (often adverbially): - without a cause, deceit (-ful), false (-hood, -ly), feignedly, liar, + lie, lying, vain (thing), wrongfully.

H8268.full: From H8248; a trough (for watering): - trough.

H8269.firstSense: captain (that had rule), chief (captain), general, governor, keeper, lord, ([-task-]) m…
H8269.full: śar sar From H8323; a head person (of any rank or class): - captain (that had rule), chief (captain), general, governor, keeper, lord, ([-task-]) master, prince (-ipal), ruler, steward.

H8270.full: shôr shore From H8324; a string (as twisted (compare H8306)), that is, (specifically) the umbilical cord (also figuratively as the centre of strength): - navel.

H8271.full: sher-ay' (Chaldee); a root corresponding to that of H8293; to free, separate; figuratively to unravel, commence; by implication (of unloading beasts) to reside: - begin dissolve, dwell, loose.

H8272.full: shar-eh'-tser Of foreign derivation; Sharetser, the name of an Assyrian and an Israelite: - Sharezer.

H8273.full: From an unused root meaning to glare; quivering glow (of the air), especially the mirage: - heat, parched ground.

H8274.full: From H8273 and H3050; Jah has brought heat; Sherebjah, the name of two Israelites: - Sherebiah.

H8275.full: From H7626; a rod of empire: - sceptre.

H8276.full: A primitive root; to intwine: - wrap together, wreath.

H8277.full: A primitive root; properly to puncture (compare H8279), that is, (figuratively through the idea of slipping out) to escape or survive: - remain.

H8278.full: From H8277; stitching (as pierced with a needle): - service.

H8279.full: From H8277; a (carpenter's) scribing awl (for pricking or scratching measurements): - line.

H8280.full: A primitive root; to prevail: - have power (as a prince).

H8281.full: A primitive root; to free: - direct.

H8282.full: Feminine of H8269; a mistress, that is, female noble: - lady, princess, queen.

H8283.full: The same as H8282; Sarah, Abraham's wife: - Sarah.

H8284.full: Probably feminine of H7791; a fortification (literally or figuratively). ("sing" is by mistake for H7891.): - sing [by mistake for H7891], wall.

H8285.full: From H8324 in its original sense of pressing; a wrist band (as compact or clasping): - bracelet.

H8286.full: From H8276; tendril; Serug, a postdiluvian patriarch: - Serug.

H8287.full: Probably from H8281 (in the sense of dwelling (compare H8271)) and H2580; abode of pleasure; Sharuchen, a place in Palestine: - Sharuhen.

H8288.full: From H8308; a thong (as laced or tied): - ([shoe-]) latchet.

H8289.full: Probably abridged from H3474; plain; Sharon, the name of a place in Palestine: - Lasharon, Sharon.

H8290.full: Patrial from H8289; a Sharonite or inhabitant of Sharon: - Sharonite.

H8291.full: Passive participle from the same as H8321; a grapevine: - principal plant. See H8320, H8321.

H8292.full: (The second form is by permutation); feminine passive participle of H8319; a whistling (in scorn); by analogy a piping: - bleating, hissing.

H8294.full: By permutation for H5629; superfluity; Serach, an Israelitess: - Sarah, Serah.

H8295.full: A primitive root; to gash: - cut in pieces, make [cuttings] pieces.

H8297.full: From H8269; dominative; Sarai, the wife of Abraham: - Sarai.

H8298.full: Probably from H8324; hostile; Sharay, an Israelite: - Sharai.

H8299.full: From H8276; a tendril (as intwining): - branch.

H8300.firstSense: X alive, left, remain (-ing), remnant, rest
H8300.full: From H8277; a survivor: - X alive, left, remain (-ing), remnant, rest.

H8301.full: The same as H8300; Sarid, a place in Palestine: - Sarid.

H8302.firstSense: breastplate, coat of mail, habergeon, harness
H8302.full: From H8281 in the original sense of turning; a corslet (as if twisted): - breastplate, coat of mail, habergeon, harness. See H5030.

H8303.full: The same as H8304 (that is, sheeted with snow); Shirjon or Sirjon, a peak of the Lebanon: - Sirion.

H8304.full: From H8280 and H3050; Jah has prevailed; Serajah, the name of nine Israelites: - Seraiah.

H8305.full: From the same as H8321 in the original sense of piercing; hetchelling (or combing flax), that is, (concretely) tow (by extension linen cloth): - fine.

H8306.full: From H8324 in the original sense as in H8270 (compare H8326); a cord, that is, (by analogy) sinew: - navel.

H8307.full: From H8324 in the sense of twisted, that is, firm; obstinacy: - imagination, lust.

H8308.full: A primitive root; to interlace: - traverse.

H8309.full: Probably by orthographical error for H7709; a common: - field.

H8310.full: Of foreign derivation; Sarsekim, a Babylonian general: - Sarsechim.

H8311.firstSense: stretch out self, (have any) superfluous thing
H8311.full: A primitive root; to prolong, that is, (reflexively) be deformed by excess of members: - stretch out self, (have any) superfluous thing.

H8313.firstSense: (cause to, make a) burn ([-ing], up), kindle, X utterly
H8313.full: A primitive root; to be (causatively set) on fire: - (cause to, make a) burn ([-ing], up), kindle, X utterly.

H8314.full: From H8313; burning, that is, (figuratively) poisonous (serpent); specifically a saraph or symbolical creature (from their copper color): - fiery (serpent), seraph.

H8315.full: The same as H8314; Saraph, an Israelite: - Saraph.

H8317.firstSense: breed (bring forth, increase) abundantly (in abundance), creep, move
H8317.full: A primitive root; to wriggle, that is, (by implication) swarm or abound: - breed (bring forth, increase) abundantly (in abundance), creep, move.

H8318.full: From H8317; a swarm, that is, active mass of minute animals: - creep (-ing thing), move (-ing creature).

H8319.full: A primitive root; properly to be shrill, that is, to whistle or hiss (as a call or in scorn): - hiss.

H8320.full: From H8319; bright red (as piercing to the sight), that is, bay: - speckled. See H8291.

H8321.full: (The third form is feminine); from H8319 in the sense of redness (compare H8320); a vine stock (properly one yielding purple grapes, the richest variety): - choice (-st, noble) wine. Compare H8291.

H8323.firstSense: X altogether, make self a prince, (bear) rule
H8323.full: A primitive root; to have (transitively exercise; reflexively get) dominion: - X altogether, make self a prince, (bear) rule.

H8324.full: A primitive root; to be hostile (only active participle an opponent): - enemy.

H8325.full: From H8324; hostile; Sharar, an Israelite: - Sharar.

H8326.full: From H8324 in the sense of twisting (compare H8270); the umbilical cord, that is, (by extension) a bodice: - navel.

H8327.full: A primitive root; to root, that is, strike into the soil, or (by implication) to pluck from it: - (take, cause to take) root (out).

H8328.full: From H8327; a root (literally or figuratively): - bottom, deep, heel, root.

H8329.full: The same as H8328; Sheresh, an Israelite: - Sharesh.

H8331.full: From H8327; a chain (as rooted, that is, linked): - chain. Compare H8333.

H8332.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H8327; eradication, that is, (figuratively) exile: - banishment.

H8333.full: From H8327 (compare H8331); a chain; (architecturally) probably a garland: - chain.

H8334.full: A primitive root; to attend as a menial or worshipper; figuratively to contribute to: - minister (unto), (do) serve (-ant, -ice, -itor), wait on.

H8335.full: infinitive of H8334; service (in the Temple): - minister (-ry).

H8336.firstSense: X blue, fine [(twined]) linen, marble, silk
H8336.full: (The second form for alliteration with H4897); for H7893; bleached stuff, that is, white linen or (by analogy) marble: - X blue, fine [(twined]) linen, marble, silk.

H8337.full: (The second form is masculine); a primitive number; six (as an overplus (see H7797) beyond five or the fingers of the hand); as ordinal sixth: - six ([-teen, -teenth]), sixth.

H8338.firstSense: leave but the sixth part [by confusion with H8341]
H8338.full: shaw-shaw' A primitive root; apparently to annihilate. (Translated by confusion with H8341.): - leave but the sixth part [by confusion with H8341].

H8339.full: Of foreign derivation; Sheshbatstsar, Zerubbabel's Persian name: - Sheshbazzar.

H8341.full: A denominative from H8337; to sixth or divide into sixths: - give the sixth part.

H8342.full: From H7797; cheerfulness; specifically welcome: - gladness, joy, mirth, rejoicing.

H8343.full: Perhaps from H8336; whitish; Shashai, an Israelite: - Shashai.

H8344.full: Probably for H8343; Sheshai, a Canaanite: - Sheshai.

H8345.full: From H8337; sixth, ordinal or (feminine) fractional: - sixth (part).

H8346.full: Multiple of H8337; sixty: - sixty, three score.

H8347.full: Of foreign derivation; Sheshak, a symbolical name of Babylonian: - Sheshach.

H8348.full: Perhaps for H7799; lily; Sheshan, an Israelite: - Sheshan.

H8349.full: Probably from the base of H7785; pedestrian; Shashak, an Israelite: - Shashak.

H8350.full: Perhaps from the base of H8324 in the sense of that of H8320; red ochre (from its piercing color): - vermillion.

H8351.full: shêth shayth Used in Num_24:17; from H7582; tumult: - Sheth.

H8352.full: shêth shayth From H7896; put, that is, substituted; Sheth, third son of Adam: - Seth, Sheth.

H8353.full: shêth shith shayth, sheeth (Chaldee); corresponding to H8337: - six (-th).

H8354.firstSense: X assuredly, banquet, X certainly, drink (-er, -ing), drunk (X -ard), surely
H8354.full: A primitive root; to imbibe (literally or figuratively). : - X assuredly, banquet, X certainly, drink (-er, -ing), drunk (X -ard), surely. [Prop. intensive of H8248.]

H8356.full: From H7896; a basis, that is, (figuratively) political or moral support: - foundation, purpose.

H8357.full: From H7896; the seat (of the person): - buttock.

H8359.full: From H7896; a fixture, that is, the warp in weaving: - warp.

H8361.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H8346 (compare H8353); sixty: - three-score.

H8362.full: A primitive root; to transplant: - plant.

H8363.full: From H8362; a sprig (as if transplanted), that is, sucker: - plant.

H8364.full: Patronymic from H7803; a Shuthalchite (collectively) or descendant of Shuthelach: - Shuthalhites.

H8365.full: A primitive root; to unveil (figuratively): - be open.

H8366.full: A primitive root; (causatively) to make water, that is, urinate: - piss.

H8367.full: A primitive root; to subside: - be calm, cease, be quiet.

H8368.full: A primitive root; to break out (as an eruption): - have in [one's] secret parts.

H8369.full: Of foreign derivation; Shethar, a Persian satrap: - Shethar.

H8370.full: Of foreign derivation; Shethar-Bozenai, a Persian officer: - Shethar-boznai.

H8371.full: A primitive root; to place, that is, array; reflexively to lie: - be laid, set.

H8372.full: (The second form being feminine and used in Eze_40:12); from (the base of) H8376; a room (as circumscribed): - (little) chamber.

H8373.full: taw-ab' A primitive root; to desire: - long.

H8374.full: taw-ab' A primitive root (probably rather identical with H8373 through the idea of puffing disdainfully at; compare H340); to loathe (morally): - abhor.

H8375.full: tah-ab-aw' From H8374 (compare H15); desire: - longing.

H8376.full: A primitive root; to mark off, that is, (intensively) designate: - point out.

H8377.full: The second form being the original form; from H8376; a species of antelope (probably from the white stripe on the cheek): - wild bull (ox).

H8378.firstSense: dainty, desire, X exceedingly, X greedily, lust (ing), pleasant
H8378.full: tah-av-aw' From H183 (abbreviated); a longing; by implication a delight (subjectively satisfaction, objectively a charm): - dainty, desire, X exceedingly, X greedily, lust (ing), pleasant. See also H6914.

H8379.full: tah-av-aw' From H8376; a limit, that is, full extent: - utmost bound.

H8380.full: From H8382; a twin (in plural only), literally or figuratively: - twins.

H8381.full: tah-al-aw' From H422; an imprecation: - curse.

H8382.full: taw-am' A primitive root; to be complete; but used only as denominative from H8380, to be (causatively make) twinned, that is, (figuratively) duplicate or (architecturally) jointed: - coupled (together), bear twins.

H8383.full: teh-oon' From H205; naughtiness, that is, toil: - lie.

H8384.full: teh-ane', teh-ay-naw' The second form being singular and feminine; perhaps of foreign derivation; the fig (tree or fruit): - fig (tree).

H8385.full: From H579; an opportunity or (subjectively) purpose: - occasion.

H8387.full: tah-an-ath' shee-lo' From H8385 and H7887; approach of Shiloh; Taanath Shiloh, a place in Palestine: - Taanath-shiloh.

H8388.firstSense: be drawn, mark out, [Rimmon-] methoar [by union with H7417]
H8388.full: taw-ar' A primitive root; to delineate; reflexively to extend. (Rimmon methoar by union with H7417.): - be drawn, mark out, [Rimmon-] methoar [by union with H7417].

H8389.firstSense: + beautiful, X comely, countenance, + fair, X favoured, form, X goodly, X resemble, visage
H8389.full: to'-ar From H8388; outline, that is, figure or appearance: - + beautiful, X comely, countenance, + fair, X favoured, form, X goodly, X resemble, visage.

H8390.full: Perhaps from H772; Taarea, an Israelite: - Tarea. See H8475.

H8391.full: teh-ash-shoor' From H833; a species of cedar (from its erectness): - box (tree).

H8392.full: Perhaps of foreign derivation; a box: - ark.

H8393.full: teb-oo-aw' From H935; income, that is, produce (literally or figuratively): - fruit, gain, increase, revenue.

H8394.full: The second and third forms being feminine; from H995; intelligence; by implication an argument; by extension caprice: - discretion, reason, skilfulness, understanding, wisdom.

H8395.full: From H947; a treading down, that is, ruin: - destruction.

H8396.full: From a root corresponding to H8406; broken region; Tabor, a mountain in Palestine, also a city adjacent: - Tabor.

H8397.full: Apparently from H1101; mixture, that is, unnatural bestiality: - confusion.

H8398.full: From H2986; the earth (as moist and therefore inhabited); by extension the globe; by implication its inhabitants; specifically a particular land, as Babylonia or Palestine: - habitable part, world.

H8400.full: From H1101 in the original sense of flowing; a cataract (in the eye): - blemish.

H8401.full: Probably from H1129; properly material, that is, (specifically) refuse haum or stalks of grain (as chopped in threshing and used for fodder): - chaff, straw, stubble.

H8402.full: From H8401; strawy; Tibni, an Israelite: - Tibni.

H8403.full: From H1129; structure; by implication a model, resemblance: - figure, form, likeness, pattern, similitude.

H8404.full: From H1197; burning; Taberah, a place in the Desert: - Taberah.

H8405.full: From the same as H948; whiteness; Tebets, a place in Palestine: - Thebez.

H8406.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H7665; to be fragile (figuratively): - broken.

H8407.full: tig-lath' pil-eh'-ser, (more not shown) Of foreign derivation; Tiglath-Pileser or Tilgath-pilneser, an Assyrian king: - Tiglath-pileser, Tilgath-pilneser.

H8409.full: From H1624; strife, that is, infliction: - blow.

H8410.full: Apparently from H1725; enduring; a species of hard wood or lasting tree (perhaps oak): - pine (tree).

H8411.full: ted-ee-raw' (Chaldee); from H1753 in the original sense of enduring; permanence, that is, (adverbially) constantly: - continually.

H8412.full: (The second form used in 1Ki_9:18), apparently from H8558; palm city; Tadmor, a place near Palestine: - Tadmor.

H8413.full: Perhaps from H1763; fearfulness; Tidal, a Canaanite: - Tidal.

H8414.firstSense: confusion, empty place, without form, nothing, (thing of) nought, vain, vanity, waste,…
H8414.full: From an unused root meaning to lie waste; a desolation (of surface), that is, desert; figuratively a worthless thing; adverbially in vain: - confusion, empty place, without form, nothing, (thing of) nought, vain, vanity, waste, wilderness.

H8415.full: (Usually feminine) from H1949; an abyss (as a surging mass of water), especially the deep (the main sea or the subterranean water supply): - deep (place), depth.

H8416.full: From H1984; laudation; specifically (concretely) a hymn: - praise.

H8417.full: Feminine of an unused noun (apparently from H1984) meaning bluster; braggadocio, that is, (by implication) fatuity: - folly.

H8418.full: From H1980; a procession: - X went.

H8419.full: From H2015; a perversity or fraud: - (very) froward (-ness, thing), perverse thing.

H8420.full: tâv tawv From H8427; a mark; by implication a signature: - desire, mark.

H8421.full: tûb toob (Chaldee), corresponding to H7725; to come back; specifically (transitively and elliptically) to reply: - answer, restore, return (an answer).

H8422.full: Probably of foreign derivation; Tubal, a postdiluvian patriarch and his posterity: - Tubal.

H8423.full: Apparently from H2986 (compare H2981) and H7014; offspring of Cain; Tubal Kajin, an antediluvian patriarch: - Tubal-cain.

H8424.full: From H3013; depression (of spirits); concretely a grief: - heaviness, sorrow.

H8425.full: Probably of foreign derivation; Togarmah, a son of Gomer and his posterity: - Togarmah.

H8426.full: From H3034; properly an extension of the hand, that is, (by implication) avowal, or (usually) adoration; specifically a choir of worshippers: - confession, (sacrifice of) praise, thanks (-giving, offering).

H8427.full: A primitive root; to mark out, that is, (primitive) scratch or (definitely) imprint: - scrabble, set [a mark].

H8428.full: A primitive root (or perhaps identical with H8427 through a similar idea from scraping to pieces); to grieve. (By confusion with H8427): - limit [by confusion with H8427].

H8429.full: (Chaldee), corresponding to H8539 or perhaps to H7582 through the idea of sweeping to ruin (compare H8428); to amaze, that is, (reflexively by implication) take alarm: - be astonied.

H8430.full: From an unused root meaning to depress; humble; Toach, an Israelite: - Toah.

H8432.firstSense: among (-st), X between, half, X (there-, where-) in (-to), middle, mid [-night], midst…
H8432.full: From an unused root meaning to sever; a bisection, that is, (by implication) the centre: - among (-st), X between, half, X (there-, where-) in (-to), middle, mid [-night], midst (among), X out (of), X through, X with (-in).

H8433.firstSense: argument, X chastened, correction, reasoning, rebuke, reproof, X be (often) reproved
H8433.full: From H3198; chastisement; figuratively (by words) correction, refutation, proof (even in defence): - argument, X chastened, correction, reasoning, rebuke, reproof, X be (often) reproved.

H8434.full: From H3205; posterity; Tolad, a place in Palestine: - Tolad. Compare H513.

H8435.full: From H3205; (plural only) descent, that is, family; (figuratively) history: - birth, generations.

H8436.full: From H8524; suspension; Tulon, an Israelite: - Tilon [from the margin].

H8437.full: From H3213; causing to howl, that is, an oppressor: - that wasted.

H8438.full: From H3216; a maggot (as voracious); specifically (often with ellipsis of H8144) the crimson grub, but used only (in this connection) of the color from it, and cloths dyed therewith: - crimson, scarlet, worm.

H8439.full: The same as H8438; worm; Tola, the name of two Israelites: - Tola.

H8440.full: Patronymic from H8439; a Tolaite (collectively) or descendant of Tola: - Tolaites.

H8441.full: Feminine active participle of H8581; properly something disgusting (morally), that is, (as noun) an abhorrence; especially idolatry or (concretely) an idol: - abominable (custom, thing), abomination.

H8442.full: Feminine active participle of H8582; mistake, that is, (morally) impiety, or (political) injury: - error, hinder.

H8443.full: From H3286; (only in plural collective) weariness, that is, (by implication) toil (treasure so obtained) or speed: - plenty, strength.

H8444.full: From H3318; (only in plural collective) exit, that is, (geographical) boundary, or (figuratively) deliverance, (actively) source: - border (-s), going (-s) forth (out), issues, outgoings.

H8445.full: From the same as H3349; obedience; Tokahath, an Israelite. (By correction for H8616.): - Tikvath [by correction for H8616].

H8446.firstSense: chap [-man], sent to descry, be excellent, merchant [-man], search (out), seek, (e-) sp…
H8446.full: tûr toor A primitive root; to meander (causatively guide) about, especially for trade or reconnoitring: - chap [-man], sent to descry, be excellent, merchant [-man], search (out), seek, (e-) spy (out).

H8447.full: tôr tôr tore, tore From H8446; a succession, that is, a string or (abstractly) order: - border, row, turn.

H8448.full: tôr tore Probably the same as H8447; a manner (as a sort of turn): - estate.

H8449.full: tôr tôr tore, tore Probably the same as H8447; a ring dove, often (figuratively) as a term of endearment: - (turtle) dove.

H8450.full: tôr tore (Chaldee), corresponding (by permutation) to H7794; a bull: - bullock, ox.

H8451.full: From H3384; a precept or statute, especially the Decalogue or Pentateuch: - law.

H8452.full: Probably feminine of H8448; a custom: - manner.

H8453.full: (The second form used in Kings Num_17:1); from H3427; a dweller (but not outlandish, H5237); especially (as distinguished from a native citizen (active participle of H3427) and a temporary inmate, H1616, or mere lodger, H3885) resident alien: - foreigner-inhabitant, sojourner, stranger.

H8454.firstSense: enterprise, that which (thing as it) is, substance, (sound) wisdom, working
H8454.full: From an unused root probably meaning to substantiate; support or (by implication) ability, that is, (direct) help, (in purpose) an undertaking, (intellectual) understanding: - enterprise, that which (thing as it) is, substance, (sound) wisdom, working.

H8455.full: From an unused root meaning to smite: - darts.

H8456.full: A primitive root; to lop off: - cut down.

H8457.full: From H2181; harlotry, that is, (figuratively) idolatry: - fornication, whoredom.

H8458.full: From H2254 as denominative from H2256; (only in plural) properly steerage (as a management of ropes), that is, (figuratively) guidance or (by implication) a plan: - good advice, (wise) counsels.

H8459.full: From an unused root meaning to depress; abasement; Tochu, an Israelite: - Tohu.

H8461.full: Probably for H2453; sagacious; Tachkemoni, an Israelite: - Tachmonite.

H8462.full: From H2490 in the sense of opening; a commencement; relatively original (adverbially originally): - begin (-ning), first (time).

H8463.full: takh-al-oo', takh-al-oo' From H2456; a malady: - disease, X grievous, (that are) sick (-ness).

H8464.full: From H2554; a species of unclean bird (from its violence), perhaps an owl: - night hawk.

H8465.full: Probably from H2583; station; Tachan, the name of two Israelites: - Tahan.

H8466.full: From H2583; (only plural collectively) an encampment: - camp.

H8467.full: From H2603; graciousness; causatively entreaty: - favour, grace, supplication.

H8468.full: The same as H8467; Techinnah, an Israelite: - Tehinnah.

H8469.full: From H2603; earnest prayer: - intreaty, supplication.

H8470.full: Patronymic from H8465; a Tachanite (collectively) or descendant of Tachan: - Tahanites.

H8471.full: (The second form used in Eze_30:18); (the third form used in Jer_2:16); of Egyptian derivation; Tachpanches, Techaphneches or Tachpenes, a place in Egypt: - Tahapanes, Tahpanhes, Tehaphnehes.

H8472.full: Of Egyptian derivation; Tachpenes, an Egyptian woman: - Tahpenes.

H8473.full: takh-ar-aw' From H2734 in the original sense of H2352 or H2353; a linen corslet (as white or hollow): - habergeon.

H8474.full: A factitious root from H2734 through the idea of the heat of jealousy; to vie with a rival: - close, contend.

H8475.full: For H8390; Tachrea, an Israelite: - Tahrea.

H8476.full: Probably of foreign derivation; a (clean) animal with fur, probably a species of antelope: - badger.

H8477.full: The same as H8476; Tachash, a relative of Abraham: - Thahash.

H8478.firstSense: as, beneath, X flat, in (-stead), (same) place (where
H8478.full: From the same as H8430; the bottom (as depressed); only adverbially below (often with prepositional prefix underneath), in lieu of, etc.: - as, beneath, X flat, in (-stead), (same) place (where . . . is), room, for . . . sake, stead of, under, X unto, X when . . . was mine, whereas, [where-] fore, with.

H8480.full: The same as H8478; Tachath, the name of a place in the Desert, also of three Israelites: - Tahath.

H8482.full: From H8478; lowermost; as noun (feminine plural) the depths (figuratively a pit, the womb): - low (parts, -er, -er parts, -est), nether (part).

H8483.full: Apparently from the plural masculine of H8482 or H8478 and H2320; lower (ones) monthly; Tachtim Chodshi, a place in Palestine: - Tahtim-hodshi.

H8485.full: Probably of foreign derivation; Tema, a son of Ishmael, and the region settled by him: - Tema.

H8486.full: Denominative from H3225; the south (as being on the right hand of a person facing the east): - south (side, -ward, wind).

H8487.full: The same as H8486; Teman, the name of two Edomites, and of the region and descendants of one of them: - south, Teman.

H8488.full: Probably for H8489; Temeni, an Israelite: - Temeni.

H8489.full: Patronymic from H8487; a Temanite or descendant of Teman: - Temani, Temanite.

H8490.full: From the same as H8558; a column, that is, cloud: - pillar.

H8491.full: Partrial or patronymic from an unused noun of uncertain meaning; a Titsite or descendant or inhabitant of an unknown Tits: - Tizite.

H8492.full: From H3423 in the sense of expulsion; must or fresh grape juice (as just squeezed out); by implication (rarely) fermented wine: - (new, sweet) wine.

H8493.full: tee-reh-yaw' Probably from H3372; fearful; Tirja, an Israelite: - Tiria.

H8494.full: Probably of foreign derivation; Tiras, a son of Japheth: - Tiras.

H8495.full: From an unused root meaning to butt; a buck or he goat (as given to butting): - he goat.

H8496.full: tôk tôk toke, toke (The second form used in Psa_72:14); from the same base as H8432 (in the sense of cutting to pieces); oppression: - deceit, fraud.

H8497.full: A primitive root; to strew, that is, encamp: - sit down.

H8498.full: Feminine passive participle of H8505; adjustment, that is, structure; by implication equipage: - fashion, store.

H8499.full: From H3559; or probably identical with H8498; something arranged or fixed, that is, a place: - seat.

H8500.full: Probably of foreign derivation; some imported creature, probably a peacock: - peacock.

H8501.full: From an unused root meaning to dissever, that is, crush: - deceitful.

H8503.full: From H3615; completion; by implication an extremity: - end, perfect (-ion).

H8504.full: Probably for H7827; the cerulean mussel, that is, the color (violet) obtained therefrom or stuff dyed therewith: - blue.

H8505.firstSense: bear up, direct, be ([un-]) equal, mete, ponder, tell, weigh
H8505.full: A primitive root; to balance, that is, measure out (by weight or dimension); figuratively to arrange, equalize, through the idea of levelling (mentally estimate, test): - bear up, direct, be ([un-]) equal, mete, ponder, tell, weigh.

H8506.full: From H8505; a fixed quantity: - measure, tale.

H8507.full: The same as H8506; Token, a place in Palestine: - Tochen.

H8508.full: From H8506; admeasurement, that is, consummation: - pattern, sum.

H8509.full: Apparently from an unused root meaning to encompass; a wrapper or robe: - garment.

H8510.full: têl tale By contraction from H8524; a mound: - heap, X strength.

H8511.full: A primitive root; to suspend; figuratively (through hesitation) to be uncertain; by implication (of mental dependence) to habituate: - be bent, hang (in doubt).

H8512.full: From H8510 and H24; mound of green growth; Tel-Abib, a place in Chaldaea: - Tel-abib.

H8513.full: tel-aw-aw' From H3811; distress: - travail, travel, trouble.

H8514.full: tal-oo-baw' From H3851; desiccation: - great drought.

H8515.full: tel-as-sar', tel-as-sar' Of foreign derivation; Telassar, a region of Assyria: - Telassar.

H8518.full: A primitive root; to suspend (especially to gibbet): - hang (up).

H8519.full: From H3885 in the sense of obstinacy; a grumbling: - murmuring.

H8520.full: Probably form an unused root meaning to dissever; breach; Telach, an Israelite: - Telah.

H8521.full: tale khar-shaw' From H8510 and the feminine of H2798; mound of workmanship; Tel-Charsha, a place in Babylon: - Tel-haresha, Tel-harsa.

H8522.full: Probably from H8518; a quiver (as slung): - quiver.

H8524.full: A primitive root; to pile up, that is, elevate: - eminent. Compare H2048.

H8525.full: From an unused root meaning to accumulate; a bank or terrace: - furrow, ridge.

H8526.full: From H8525; ridged; Talmai, the name of a Canaanite and a Syrian: - Talmai.

H8528.full: From H8510 and H4417; mound of salt; Tel-Melach, a palce in Babylon: - Tel-melah.

H8529.full: A denominative from H8438; to crimson, that is, dye that color: - X scarlet.

H8530.full: Feminine from an unused root meaning to tower; something tall, that is, (plural collectively) slenderness: - armoury.

H8531.full: (Chaldee); from H8532; a tertiary rank: - third.

H8532.full: tel-awth', tel-aw-thaw', tel-aw-thaw' (Chaldee); corresponding to H7969; three or third: - third, three.

H8533.full: Multiplicative of H8532; ten times three: - thirty.

H8534.full: By reduplication from H8524 through the idea of vibration; a trailing bough (as pendulous): - bushy.

H8535.firstSense: coupled together, perfect, plain, undefiled, upright
H8535.full: tâm tawm From H8552; complete; usually (morally) pious; specifically gentle, dear: - coupled together, perfect, plain, undefiled, upright.

H8536.full: tâm tawm (Chaldee); corresponding to H8033; there: - X thence, there, X where.

H8537.firstSense: full, integrity, perfect (-ion), simplicity, upright (-ly, -ness), at a venture
H8537.full: tôm tome From H8552; completeness; figuratively prosperity; usually (morally) innocence: - full, integrity, perfect (-ion), simplicity, upright (-ly, -ness), at a venture. See H8550.

H8539.firstSense: be amazed, be astonished, marvel (-lously), wonder
H8539.full: A primitive root; to be in consternation: - be amazed, be astonished, marvel (-lously), wonder.

H8540.full: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to H8539; a miracle: - wonder.

H8542.full: Of uncertain derivation; Tammuz, a Phoenician deity: - Tammuz.

H8543.firstSense: + before (-time), + these [three] days, + heretofore, + time past, yesterday
H8543.full: Probably for H865; properly ago, that is, a (short or long) time since; especially yesterday, or (with H8032) day before yesterday: - + before (-time), + these [three] days, + heretofore, + time past, yesterday.

H8544.full: From H4327; something portioned (that is, fashioned) out, as a shape, that is, (indefinitely) phantom, or (specifically) embodiment, or (figuratively) manifestation (of favor): - image, likeness, similitude.

H8545.full: From H4171; barter, compensation: - (ex-) change (-ing), recompense, restitution.

H8546.full: From H4191; execution (as a doom): - death, die.

H8547.full: Of uncertain derivation; Temach, one of the Nethinim: - Tamah, Thamah.

H8548.full: From an unused root meaning to stretch; properly continuance (as indefinite extension); but used only (attributively as adjective) constant (or adverbially constantly); elliptically the regular (daily) sacrifice: - alway (-s), continual (employment, -ly), daily, ([n-]) ever (-more), perpetual.

H8549.firstSense: without blemish, complete, full, perfect, sincerely (-ity), sound, without spot, undefi…
H8549.full: From H8552; entire (literally, figuratively or morally); also (as noun) integrity, truth: - without blemish, complete, full, perfect, sincerely (-ity), sound, without spot, undefiled, upright (-ly), whole.

H8550.full: Plural of H8537; perfections, that is, (technically) one of the epithets of the objects in the high priest's breastplate as an emblem of complete Truth: - Thummim.

H8551.full: A primitive root; to sustain; by implication to obtain, keep fast; figuratively to help, follow close: - (take, up-) hold (up), maintain, retain, stay (up).

H8552.firstSense: accomplish, cease, be clean [pass-] ed, consume, have done, (come to an, make an) end,…
H8552.full: A primitive root; to complete, in a good or a bad sense, literally or figuratively, transitively or intransitively: - accomplish, cease, be clean [pass-] ed, consume, have done, (come to an, make an) end, fail, come to the full, be all gone, X be all here, be (make) perfect, be spent, sum, be (shew self) upright, be wasted, whole.

H8553.full: From H4487; a portion assigned; Timnah, the name of two places in Palestine: - Timnah, Timnath, Thimnathah.

H8554.full: Patrial from H8553; a Timnite or inhabitant of Timnah: - Timnite.

H8555.full: From H4513; restraint; Timna, the name of two Edomites: - Timna, Timnah.

H8556.full: From H8553 and H2775; portion of (the sun; Timnath Cheres, a place in Palestine: - Timnath-heres, Timnath-serah.

H8557.full: From H4529; liquefaction, that is, disappearance: - melt.

H8558.full: From an unused root meaning to be erect; a palm tree: - palm (tree).

H8559.full: The same as H8558; Tamar, the name of three women and a place: - Tamar.

H8560.full: From the same root as H8558; a palm trunk: - palm tree.

H8561.full: (The first is plural only, while the second is feminine, singular and plural); from the same root as H8558; (architecturally) a palm like pilaster (that is, umbellate): - palm tree.

H8562.full: From H4838; properly a scouring, that is, soap or perfumery for the bath; figuratively a detergent: - X cleanse, (thing for) purification (-fying).

H8563.full: From H4843; bitterness (plural as collective): - X most bitter (-ly).

H8564.full: From the same root as H8558; an erection, that is, pillar (probably for a guide board): - high heap.

H8565.full: tan tan From an unused root probably meaning to elongate; a monster (as preternaturally formed), that is, a sea serpent (or other huge marine animal); also a jackal (or other hideous land animal): - dragon, whale. Compare H8577.

H8566.full: A primitive root; to present (a mercenary inducement), that is, bargain with (a harlot): - hire.

H8567.full: A primitive root (rather identical with H8566 through the idea of attributing honor); to ascribe (praise), that is, celebrate, commemorate: - lament, rehearse.

H8568.full: Probably feminine of H8565; a female jackal: - dragon.

H8569.full: ten-oo-aw' From H5106; alienation; by implication enmity: - breach of promise, occasion.

H8571.full: Perhaps form the same as H594 through the idea of protraction; a pinnacle, that is, extremity: - tip.

H8572.full: From H5123; drowsiness, that is, sleep: - slumber (-ing).

H8573.full: From H5130; a brandishing (in threat); by implication tumult; specifically the official undulation of sacrificial offerings: - offering, shaking, wave (offering).

H8574.full: From H5216; a fire pot: - furnace, oven.

H8575.full: The third form is feminine; from H5162; compassion, solace: - comfort, consolation.

H8576.full: For H8575 (feminine); Tanchumeth, an Israelite: - Tanhumeth.

H8577.full: (The second form used in Eze_29:3); intensive from the same as H8565; a marine or land monster, that is, sea serpent or jackal: - dragon, sea-monster, serpent, whale.

H8579.full: (Chaldee), from H8578; a second time: - again.

H8580.full: From H5395; properly a hard breather, that is, the name of two unclean creatures, a lizard and a bird (both perhaps from changing color through their irascibility), probably the tree toad and the water hen: - mole, swan.

H8581.firstSense: (make to be) abhor (-red), (be, commit more, do) abominable (-y), X utterly
H8581.full: A primitive root; to loathe, that is, (morally) detest: - (make to be) abhor (-red), (be, commit more, do) abominable (-y), X utterly.

H8582.firstSense: (cause to) go astray, deceive, dissemble, (cause to, make to) err, pant, seduce, (make…
H8582.full: A primitive root; to vacillate, that is, reel or stray (literally or figuratively); also causatively of both: - (cause to) go astray, deceive, dissemble, (cause to, make to) err, pant, seduce, (make to) stagger, (cause to) wander, be out of the way.

H8583.full: From H8582; error; Tou or Toi, a Syran king: - Toi, Tou.

H8584.full: From H5749; attestation, that is, a precept, usage: - testimony.

H8585.firstSense: conduit, cured, healing, little river, trench, watercourse
H8585.full: From H5927; a channel (into which water is raised for irrigation); also a bandage or plaster (as placed upon a wound): - conduit, cured, healing, little river, trench, watercourse.

H8586.full: From H5953; caprice (as a fit coming on), that is, vexation; concretely a tyrant: - babe, delusion.

H8587.full: From H5956; a secret: - thing that is hid, secret.

H8588.full: The third form being feminine; from H6026; luxury: - delicate, delight, pleasant.

H8589.full: From H6031; affliction (of self), that is, fasting: - heaviness.

H8590.full: Of uncertain derivation; Taanak or Tanak, a place in Palestine: - Taanach, Tanach.

H8591.full: A primitive root; to cheat; by analogy to maltreat: - deceive, misuse.

H8593.full: From H6168; a knife or razor (as making bare); also a scabbard (as being bare, that is, empty): - [pen-] knife, rasor, scabbard, shave, sheath.

H8594.full: From H6148; suretyship, that is, (concretely) a pledge: - + hostage.

H8596.full: tôph tofe From H8608 contracted; a tambourine: - tabret, timbrel.

H8597.firstSense: beauty (-iful), bravery, comely, fair, glory (-ious), honour, majesty
H8597.full: tif-aw-raw', tif-eh'-reth From H6286; ornament (abstractly or concretely, literally or figuratively): - beauty (-iful), bravery, comely, fair, glory (-ious), honour, majesty.

H8598.full: From H5301; an apple (from its fragrance), that is, the fruit or the tree (probably including others of the pome order, as the quince, the orange, etc.): - apple (tree). See also H1054.

H8599.full: The same as H8598; Tappuach, the name of two places in Palestine, also of an Israelite: - Tappuah.

H8601.full: From H644; cookery, that is, (concretely) a cake: - baked piece.

H8602.full: From an unused root meaning to smear; plaster (as gummy) or slime; (figuratively) frivolity: - foolish things, unsavoury, untempered.

H8603.full: From the same as H8602; quagmire; Tophel, a place near the Desert: - Tophel.

H8604.full: From the same as H8602; frivolity: - folly, foolishly.

H8605.full: From H6419; intercession, supplication; by implication a hymn: - prayer.

H8607.full: From H6452; ford; Tiphsach, a place in Mesopotamia: - Tipsah.

H8608.full: A primitive root; to drum, that is, play (as) on the tambourine: - taber, play with timbrels.

H8609.full: A primitive root; to sew: - (women that) sew (together).

H8610.firstSense: catch, handle, (lay, take) hold (on, over), stop, X surely, surprise, take
H8610.full: A primitive root; to manipulate, that is, seize; chiefly to capture, wield; specifically to overlay; figuratively to use unwarrantably: - catch, handle, (lay, take) hold (on, over), stop, X surely, surprise, take.

H8611.full: From the base of H8608; a smiting, that is, (figuratively) contempt: - tabret.

H8612.full: The same as H8611; Topheth, a place near Jerusalem: - Tophet, Topheth.

H8613.full: Probably a form of H8612; Tophteh, a place of cremation: - Tophet.

H8614.full: (Chaldee), perhaps from H8199; judicial, that is, a lawyer: - sheriff.

H8615.firstSense: expectation ([-ted]), hope, live, thing that I long for
H8615.full: From H6960; literally a cord (as an attachment (compare H6961)); figuratively expectancy: - expectation ([-ted]), hope, live, thing that I long for.

H8616.full: The same as H8615; Tikvah, the name of two Israelites: - Tikvah.

H8617.full: From H6965; resistfulness: - power to stand.

H8618.full: From H6965; an opponent: - rise up against.

H8619.full: From H8628 (in the muscal sense); a trumpet: - trumpet.

H8620.full: A form of H8619; Tekoa, a place in Palestine: - Tekoa, Tekoah.

H8621.full: Patronymic from H8620; a Tekoite or inhabitant of Tekoah: - Tekoite.

H8622.full: From H5362; a revolution, that is, (of the sun) course, (of time) lapse: - circuit, come about, end.

H8625.full: (Chaldee); corresponding to H8254; to balance: - Tekel, be weighed.

H8626.full: A primitive root; to equalize, that is, straighten (intransitively or transitively); figuratively to compose: - set in order, make straight.

H8627.full: (Chaldee), corresponding to H8626; to straighten up, that is, confirm: - establish.

H8628.firstSense: blow ([a trumpet]), cast, clap, fasten, pitch [tent], smite, sound, strike, X suretishi…
H8628.full: A primitive root; to clatter, that is, slap (the hands together), clang (an instrument); by analogy to drive (a nail or tent pin, a dart, etc.); by implication to become bondsman (by handclasping): - blow ([a trumpet]), cast, clap, fasten, pitch [tent], smite, sound, strike, X suretiship, thrust.

H8629.full: From H8628; a blast of a trumpet: - sound.

H8630.full: A primitive root; to overpower: - prevail (against.).

H8631.full: (Chaldee), corresponding to H8630; to become (causatively make) mighty or (figuratively) obstinate: - make firm, harden, be (-come) strong.

H8632.full: (Chaldee), corresponding to H8633; power: - might, strength.

H8633.full: From H8630; might or (figuratively) positiveness: - authority, power, strength.

H8634.full: tar-al-aw' Probably for H8653; a reeling; Taralah, a place in Palestine: - Taralah.

H8635.full: From H7235; multiplication, that is, progeny: - increase.

H8636.full: From H7235; multiplication, that is, percentage or bonus in addition to principal: - increase, unjust gain.

H8637.full: A denominative from H7270; to cause to walk: - teach to go.

H8638.full: A denominative from H7275 in the sense of throwing over; to transfer, that is, translate: - interpret.

H8639.full: From H7290; a lethargy or (by implication) trance: - deep sleep.

H8640.full: Of foreign derivation; Tirhakah, a king of Kush: - Tirhakah.

H8641.full: (The second form used in Deu_12:11); from H7311; a present (as offered up), especially in sacrifice or as tribute: - gift, heave offering ([shoulder]), oblation, offered (-ing).

H8642.full: Formed as H8641; a sacrificial offering: - oblation.

H8643.firstSense: alarm, blow (-ing) (of, the) (trumpets), joy, jubile, loud noise, rejoicing, shout (-in…
H8643.full: From H7321; clamor, that is, acclamation of joy or a battle cry; especially clangor of trumpets, as an alarum: - alarm, blow (-ing) (of, the) (trumpets), joy, jubile, loud noise, rejoicing, shout (-ing), (high, joyful) sound (-ing).

H8644.full: From H7322 in the sense of its congener H7495; a remedy: - medicine.

H8645.full: Probably from H7329; a species of tree (apparently from its slenderness), perhaps the cypress: - cypress.

H8646.full: Of uncertain derivation; Terach, the father of Abraham; also a place in the Desert: - Tarah, Terah.

H8647.full: Of uncertain derivation; Tirchanah, an Israelite: - Tirhanah.

H8648.full: (Chaldee), the secend form is feminine; corresponding to H8147; two: - second, + twelve, two.

H8650.full: Probably for H766; a pole (as a mast or flag staff): - beacon, mast.

H8651.full: (Chaldee), corresponding to H8179; a door; by implication a palace: - gate mouth.

H8654.full: Patrial from an unused name meaning gate; a Tirathite or inhabitant of an unknown Tirah: - Tirathite.

H8655.full: Plural perhaps from H7495; a healer; Teraphim (singular or plural) a family idol: - idols (-atry), images, teraphim.

H8656.full: From H7521; delightsomeness; Tirtsah, a place in Palestine; also an Israelitess: - also an Israelitess: - Tirzah.

H8657.full: Of foreign derivation; Teresh, a eunuch of Xerxes: - Teresh.

H8658.full: Probably of foreign derivation (compare H8659); a gem, perhaps the topaz: - beryl.

H8659.full: Probably the same as H8658 (as the region of the stone, or the reverse); Tarshish, a place on the Mediterranean, hence the epithet of a merchant vessel (as if for or from that port); also the name of a Persian and of an Israelite: - Tarshish, Tharshish.

H8660.full: teer-shaw-thaw' Of foreign derivation; the title of a Persian deputy or governor: - Tirshatha.

H8661.full: Of foreign derivation; Tartan, an Assyrian: - Tartan.

H8662.full: Of foreign derivation; Tartak, a deity of the Avvites: - Tartak.

H8663.full: tesh-oo-aw' From H7722; a crashing or loud clamor: - crying, noise, shouting, stir.

H8664.full: Patrial from an unused name meaning recourse; a Tishbite or inhabitant of Tishbeh (in Gilead): - Tishbite.

H8665.full: From H7660; checkered stuff (as reticulated): - broidered.

H8666.full: From H7725; a recurrence (of time or place); a reply (as returned): - answer, be expired, return.

H8667.full: From H7760; a deposit, that is, pledging: - + fellowship.

H8668.full: From H7768 in the sense of H3467; rescue (literally or figuratively, personal, national or spiritual): - deliverance, help, safety, salvation, victory.

H8669.full: From H7783 in the original sense of stretching out after; a longing: - desire.

H8670.full: From H7788 in the sense of arrival; a gift: - present.

H8672.full: The second form is the masculine of the first; perhaps from H8159 through the idea of a turn to the next or full number ten; nine or (ordinal) ninth: - nine (+ -teen, + -teenth, -th).

H8674.full: Of foreign derivation; Tattenai, a Persian: - Tatnai.
